## Abstract




＃＃ 抽象的


Social media is one of the most disruptive technologies in executing a firm’s digital business transformation strategies. Does the firm’s ability to use social media affect its proficiency in exploring and exploiting knowledge? What should be the role of business analytics talent in this equation? We study theoretically and empirically these cutting-edge research questions. Our proposed research model argues that social media capability enables the development of knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and business analytics talent exerts a positive reinforcing role in the impact of social media on knowledge exploration. We empirically tested the proposed research model with a secondary dataset from a sample of US firms using PLS path modeling. After running a robustness test by estimating eight alternatives/competing models, the empirical analysis revealed that social media capability is positively related to knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, but with a stronger effect on knowledge exploration. Moreover, business analytics talent plays a positive moderator role in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. This study contributes to the IS research by (1) introducing, developing, and operationalizing the concepts of social media capability and business analytics talent; and (2) theoretically arguing and empirically showing the pivotal role of social media capability in exploring new knowledge and the complementary role of business analytics talent. Our study also provides several critical lessons learned for top executives and proposes promising future IS research avenues.




社交媒体是执行公司数字业务转型战略时最具颠覆性的技术之一。公司使用社交媒体的能力是否会影响其探索和利用知识的熟练程度？商业分析人才在这个等式中应该扮演什么角色？我们从理论上和实证上研究这些前沿研究问题。我们提出的研究模型认为，社交媒体能力促进了知识探索和知识利用的发展，商业分析人才在社交媒体对知识探索的影响中发挥着积极的强化作用。我们使用 PLS 路径建模，使用美国公司样本的辅助数据集对所提出的研究模型进行了实证测试。通过估计八种替代/竞争模型进行稳健性测试后，实证分析表明，社交媒体能力与知识探索和知识利用呈正相关，但对知识探索的影响更强。此外，商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系中发挥着积极的调节作用。本研究通过以下方式为信息系统研究做出贡献：（1）引入、开发和实施社交媒体能力和商业分析人才的概念； （2）从理论上论证并从实证上论证社交媒体能力在探索新知识方面的关键作用以及商业分析人才的补充作用。我们的研究还为高层管理人员提供了一些重要的经验教训，并提出了有前途的未来信息系统研究途径。


Keywords: Social Media Capability, Knowledge Exploration, Knowledge Exploitation, Business Analytics Talent, Business Value of Social Media, ADANCO




关键词：社交媒体能力、知识探索、知识利用、商业分析人才、社交媒体的商业价值、ADANCO


Patrick Chau was the accepting senior editor. This research article was submitted on June 3, 2019 and underwent three revisions.




Patrick Chau 是接受高级编辑。该研究文章于2019年6月3日提交，历经3次修改。


## 1 Introduction




## 1 简介


Social media represents one of the most disruptive technologies in executing a firm’s digital business transformation strategies (Benitez, Ruiz et al., 2020; Wessel et al., 2021). However, our theoretical understanding of this new corporate phenomenon is in its initial stages (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). Social media can play a key role in collecting, monitoring, and analyzing data to generate business value (He et al., 2015), and social media platforms are considered one of the most popular online communication tools and sources of information, acting as facilitators of knowledge with potential impacts on firm performance (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Chai et al., 2011; Krancher et al., 2018; Leonardi, 2014; Luo et al., 2015). For example, firms can use social media (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, corporate blogs) to build awareness about their products and initiatives and test them by collecting opinions, impressions, and ideas from customers (Dong and Wu, 2015). As an illustrative example, Lay’s (a potato chip manufacturer) ran a campaign on social media (Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram) called “Do us a flavor.” This campaign aimed to innovate about the next potato chip flavor by collecting ideas from customers. Four finalist flavors were sold provisionally, and customers voted in social media for the best one, with the Southern Biscuits and Gravy flavor eventually being sold. Thus, social media provides a vast amount of customer, competitor, and supplier data that can be leveraged by the firm to innovate and improve firm performance (Aral et al., 2013; Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). Based on the organizational capabilities-based theory, this study introduces, develops, and focuses on social media capability, which refers to the firm’s ability to use and leverage external social media to execute business activities. Firms with a high level of social media capability may convert social media into a golden source of data, changing how firms exchange information (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; French et al., 2017).




社交媒体是执行公司数字业务转型战略时最具颠覆性的技术之一（Benitez、Ruiz 等人，2020 年；Wessel 等人，2021 年）。然而，我们对这种新企业现象的理论理解还处于初级阶段（Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018）。社交媒体可以在收集、监控和分析数据以产生商业价值方面发挥关键作用（He et al., 2015），社交媒体平台被认为是最流行的在线交流工具和信息来源之一，充当对公司绩效具有潜在影响的知识促进者（Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Chai et al., 2011; Krancher et al., 2018; Leonardi, 2014；罗等人，2015）。例如，公司可以使用社交媒体（例如 Facebook、Twitter、企业博客）来建立对其产品和计划的认识，并通过收集客户的意见、印象和想法来测试它们（Dong 和 Wu，2015）。作为一个说明性的例子，乐事（一家薯片制造商）在社交媒体（Facebook、Twitter 和 Instagram）上开展了一场名为“给我们来个口味”的活动。该活动旨在通过收集顾客的想法来创新下一代薯片口味。四种入围口味暂时出售，顾客在社交媒体上投票选出最好的一种，最终出售南方饼干和肉汁口味。因此，社交媒体提供了大量客户、竞争对手和供应商数据，公司可以利用这些数据进行创新和提高公司绩效（Aral 等人，2013 年；Benitez、Castillo 等人，2018 年）。本研究以组织能力为基础，引入、发展并关注社交媒体能力，即企业利用和利用外部社交媒体来执行业务活动的能力。拥有高水平社交媒体能力的企业可能会将社交媒体转化为黄金数据源，从而改变企业交换信息的方式（Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018；French et al., 2017）。


Social media may have the potential to enable firms to analyze and examine new knowledge (i.e., knowledge exploration) and recombine existing knowledge (i.e., knowledge exploitation). Knowledge exploration refers to the learning obtained from acquiring/creating, sharing, and storing new knowledge. Knowledge exploitation is the learning process of assimilating, reusing, reinterpreting, applying, and leveraging new/existing knowledge (Gupta et al., 2006; March, 1991). However, despite the suggested potential value, how firms leverage external social media to explore knowledge and exploit knowledge needs further development and empirical testing.




社交媒体可能有潜力使企业能够分析和检查新知识（即知识探索）并重新组合现有知识（即知识利用）。知识探索是指通过获取/创造、共享和存储新知识而获得的学习。知识利用是吸收、重用、重新解释、应用和利用新/现有知识的学习过程（Gupta 等，2006 年；1991 年 3 月）。然而，尽管存在潜在价值，但企业如何利用外部社交媒体探索知识和利用知识还需要进一步发展和实证检验。


Generating and collecting social data (i.e., data from social media) might not be enough to use information efficiently. The value creation from social data requires knowledge understanding. Monitoring, analyzing, and identifying relevant social media-based information is critical for transforming information into business gains. Ransbotham et al. (2015) suggested that using social data effectively may be critical to support business activities. The process of changing data into valuable insights to support business activities is called “business analytics” (Chen et al., 2012; Holsapple et al., 2014; Zhang et al., forthcoming). Business analytics refers to the support of decision-making and problem resolution in firms through two main capabilities: “speed to insight” (i.e., how fast firms can transform social data into useful insights) and “pervasive use” (i.e., deep usage of business analytics across the firm) (Wixom et al., 2013). In this sense, firms face the challenge of attracting, hiring, developing, and retaining business analytics talent to transform social data into valuable insights for supporting business activities. This paper focuses on business analytics talent. As a scarce and valuable resource, business analytics talent may explain the variation in performance among contemporary firms (Edwards, 2020; Ransbotham et al., 2015). Business analytics talent is the firm’s talent regarding effectively applying business analytics at the firm level by transforming data into valuable insights for supporting business activities (Ransbotham et al., 2015). Firms with business analytics talent can effectively perform business analytics to turn analytical insight into business actions. Firms effectively performing business analytics move from descriptive analytics, to determine what occurred in the past and what occurs now and why, to predictive analytics to model what will happen in the future, to prescriptive analysis to develop multiple options about the future and help determine the course of action (Ransbotham et al., 2015). Given its importance, business analytics talent is a scarce and valuable information technology (IT) resource that may help firms build IT wisdom in contemporary firms (Liu et al., 2020). It has been estimated that 2.7 million business analytics jobs will be posted in the US in 2020 alone (Fenlon & Peters, 2020).




生成和收集社交数据（即来自社交媒体的数据）可能不足以有效地使用信息。社交数据的价值创造需要知识理解。监控、分析和识别基于社交媒体的相关信息对于将信息转化为业务收益至关重要。兰斯博瑟姆等人。 (2015) 认为，有效使用社交数据对于支持商业活动可能至关重要。将数据转变为有价值的见解以支持业务活动的过程称为“业务分析”（Chen 等人，2012 年；Holsapple 等人，2014 年；Zhang 等人，即将出版）。商业分析是指通过两种主要能力为公司决策和问题解决提供支持：“洞察速度”（即公司将社交数据转化为有用见解的速度）和“普遍使用”（即在整个公司内深度使用业务分析）（Wixom 等，2013）。从这个意义上说，公司面临着吸引、雇用、培养和保留业务分析人才的挑战，以将社交数据转化为支持业务活动的有价值的见解。本文重点关注业务分析人才。作为一种稀缺而宝贵的资源，商业分析人才可以解释当代企业绩效的差异（Edwards，2020；Ransbotham 等，2015）。业务分析人才是公司在公司层面有效应用业务分析的人才，将数据转化为支持业务活动的有价值的见解（Ransbotham 等，2015）。拥有业务分析人才的公司可以有效地执行业务分析，将分析洞察转化为业务行动。有效执行业务分析的公司从描述性分析（确定过去发生的情况、现在发生的情况及其原因）转向预测分析（对未来将发生的情况进行建模），再转向规范性分析（以开发有关未来的多种选项并帮助确定行动方案）（Ransbotham 等，2015）。鉴于其重要性，业务分析人才是一种稀缺且有价值的信息技术 (IT) 资源，可以帮助企业在当代企业中构建 IT 智慧（Liu 等人，2020）。据估计，仅 2020 年美国就会新增 270 万个商业分析职位（Fenlon & Peters，2020）。


Information systems (IS) research lacks theory building on how firms perform social media initiatives and how they may affect a firm’s knowledge exploration and exploitation activities (Dong & Wu, 2015; Ngai et al., 2015). Firms may invest in managing social media effectively to acquire and exploit social data to improve their performance. This argument introduces this study's first research question: (1) Does social media capability enable knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation? This study tries to fill this research gap and answer this question. The effect of social media capability on knowledge exploration may be stronger in firms that transform social data into new useful social knowledge through business analytics talent (Davenport et al., 2010; Ransbotham et al., 2015). This rationale motivates the second research question of this paper: (2) Can the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration be strengthened when business analytics talent comes into play?




信息系统（IS）研究缺乏关于企业如何执行社交媒体计划以及它们如何影响企业的知识探索和利用活动的理论（Dong & Wu，2015；Ngai 等，2015）。公司可以投资有效管理社交媒体，以获取和利用社交数据来提高绩效。这一论点引入了本研究的第一个研究问题：（1）社交媒体能力是否能够实现知识探索和知识利用？本研究试图填补这一研究空白并回答这个问题。对于通过业务分析人才将社交数据转化为新的有用社交知识的公司来说，社交媒体能力对知识探索的影响可能更强（Davenport 等，2010；Ransbotham 等，2015）。这一基本原理引发了本文的第二个研究问题：（2）当商业分析人才发挥作用时，社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系能否得到加强？


We argue that social media capability can enable firms to explore and exploit knowledge, and that firms with more and better business analytics talent can amplify and strengthen the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. This is the central theoretical proposition of this manuscript. We tested the proposed research model using partial least squares (PLS) path modeling with a secondary dataset on a sample of US firms. After estimating eight alternatives/competing models in the robustness check, the empirical analysis provides substantial support to our central proposition.




我们认为，社交媒体能力可以使企业探索和利用知识，拥有更多更好的商业分析人才的企业可以放大和加强社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系。这是本文的中心理论命题。我们使用偏最小二乘 (PLS) 路径建模和美国公司样本的辅助数据集测试了所提出的研究模型。在稳健性检查中估计了八个替代方案/竞争模型后，实证分析为我们的中心命题提供了实质性支持。


## 2 Theory and Hypotheses




## 2 理论和假设


## 2.1 Organizational Capabilities-Based Theory, IT-Enabled Organizational Capabilities, Organizational Learning Framework, and the Complementary Resource Perspective




## 2.1 基于组织能力的理论、IT支持的组织能力、组织学习框架和互补资源视角


Organizational capabilities-based theory suggests that firms design and execute IT and business strategies based on their portfolio of organizational capabilities, which explains the difference in competitiveness among firms (Grant, 1996). Organizational capabilities<sup>1</sup> can be classified into dynamic capabilities (a firm’s proficiency in adapting its resource base in response to changes in the business environment) (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Teece, 2007); operational capabilities (a firm’s proficiency in solving operational problems and implementing the operations strategy by using interrelated operational routines) (Benitez, Chen et al., 2018; Wu et al., 2010); and dual-purpose capabilities (organizational capabilities that are dynamic and operational capabilities because they can be controlled and exploited at both strategic/corporate and operational level) (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Helfat & Winter, 2011). We use the organizational capabilities-based theory to conceptualize social media capability, knowledge exploration, knowledge exploitation, business analytics talent (the key constructs of this study), and to link social media capability to knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation.




基于组织能力的理论表明，企业根据其组织能力组合来设计和执行 IT 和业务战略，这解释了企业之间竞争力的差异（Grant，1996）。组织能力<sup>1</sup>可分为动态能力（企业根据业务环境变化调整其资源库的能力）（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018；Teece, 2007）；运营能力（企业通过使用相互关联的运营例程解决运营问题和实施运营战略的熟练程度）（Benitez, Chen et al., 2018；Wu et al., 2010）；和双重目的能力（组织能力是动态的和可操作的能力，因为它们可以在战略/公司和操作层面上进行控制和利用）（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Helfat & Winter, 2011）。我们使用基于组织能力的理论来概念化社交媒体能力、知识探索、知识利用、商业分析人才（本研究的关键概念），并将社交媒体能力与知识探索和知识利用联系起来。


The IT-enabled organizational capabilities perspective has emerged as a solid theoretical base in the IS literature to explain the value creation from IT by arguing that IT helps firms create business value by developing intermediate organizational/process capabilities (Lin et al., 2020; Mandrella et al., 2020; Mikalef et al., 2020; Schmiedel et al., 2020). Some of these organizational capabilities include business flexibility (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018; Chen et al., 2017), supply chain management (Ajamieh et al., 2016), corporate entrepreneurship (Chen et al., 2015), new product development (Pavlou & El Sawy, 2006), and knowledge search and relational search management (Hensen & Dong, 2020). Since social media technology is a new type of digital technology, ITenabled organizational capabilities theory provides a useful conceptual framework to theorize that social media capability enables knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation.




IT 支持的组织能力视角已成为 IS 文献中的坚实理论基础，通过认为 IT 通过开发中间组织/流程能力帮助企业创造商业价值来解释 IT 的价值创造（Lin 等，2020；Mandrella 等，2020；Mikalef 等，2020；Schmiedel 等，2020）。其中一些组织能力包括业务灵活性（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018；Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018；Chen et al., 2017）、供应链管理（Ajamieh et al., 2016）、企业创业（Chen et al., 2015）、新产品开发（Pavlou & El Sawy, 2006）以及知识搜索和关系搜索管理（Hensen 和 Dong，2020）。由于社交媒体技术是一种新型的数字技术，IT支持的组织能力理论提供了一个有用的概念框架来理论化社交媒体能力能够实现知识探索和知识利用。


Organizational learning refers to how firms pursue organizational renewal by creating knowledge, explaining, and codifying this knowledge, and sharing and transferring this knowledge within the firm to be used and embedding it through rules and procedures (March, 1991). This study draws on the organizational learning framework, which considers knowledge exploration and exploitation as two firms’ learning activities (Gupta et al., 2006). Knowledge exploration is the learning process of acquiring/creating, sharing, and storing new knowledge, while knowledge exploitation is composed of the learning obtained from the process of assimilating, reusing, reinterpreting, applying, and leveraging new/existing knowledge (Gupta et al., 2006; March, 1991). Ambidextrous firms in managing knowledge are those that efficiently achieve exploration and exploitation of knowledge simultaneously for operational purposes (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Levinthal & March, 1993; Tushman and O’Reilly, 1996). Simultaneously achieving knowledge exploration and exploitation may help firms attain long term business benefits (Raisch & Birkinshaw, 2008). Despite the importance of understanding how knowledge ambidexterity works, there is a critical difference between a firm’s knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation because they require significantly different structures, processes, strategies, capabilities, and cultural values (Dominguez & Massaroli, 2018). In this sense, knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation may have different relationships with other variables such as social media capability, business analytics talent, and firm performance. For example, knowledge exploration is related to organic structure, flexible systems, autonomy, and improvisation, whereas knowledge exploitation is related to mechanical structure, rigid systems, control, bureaucracy, and routine (Dominguez & Massaroli, 2018). For these reasons, this study focuses on the individual impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation instead of examining the effect of social media capability on knowledge ambidexterity. We use the organizational learning framework to conceptualize knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation.




组织学习是指公司如何通过创造知识、解释和编纂这些知识、在公司内部共享和转移这些知识以供使用以及通过规则和程序将其嵌入来追求组织更新（1991 年 3 月）。本研究借鉴了组织学习框架，该框架将知识探索和利用视为两家公司的学习活动（Gupta 等，2006）。知识探索是获取/创造、共享和存储新知识的学习过程，而知识利用则是从吸收、重用、重新解释、应用和利用新的/现有知识的过程中获得的学习组成（Gupta et al., 2006; March, 1991）。管理知识的双元型企业是那些能够同时有效地实现知识探索和利用以用于运营目的的企业（Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Levinthal & March, 1993; Tushman and O’Reilly, 1996）。同时实现知识探索和利用可能有助于企业获得长期商业利益（Raisch & Birkinshaw，2008）。尽管了解知识双元性如何运作很重要，但公司的知识探索和知识利用之间存在重大差异，因为它们需要显着不同的结构、流程、战略、能力和文化价值观（Dominguez & Massaroli，2018）。从这个意义上说，知识探索和知识利用可能与其他变量（例如社交媒体能力、业务分析人才和公司绩效）有不同的关系。例如，知识探索与有机结构、灵活系统、自主性和即兴创作有关，而知识利用与机械结构、刚性系统、控制、官僚主义和常规有关（Dominguez & Massaroli，2018）。由于这些原因，本研究重点关注社交媒体能力对知识探索和知识利用的个体影响，而不是考察社交媒体能力对知识双元性的影响。我们使用组织学习框架来概念化知识探索和知识利用。


The complementary resource perspective is a theoretical framework that suggests that the firm’s resource complementarity explains the differential effect in business benefits. Complementarity between resources/capabilities denotes the mutual reinforcing of the resources/capabilities where the presence of a resource/capability allows other resources/capabilities to exert their value (Ennen & Richter, 2010). These complementary relationships may drive the pursuit of more efficient processes, which may differ from the sum of the individual effects considered in isolation (Adegbesan, 2009; Bharadwaj et al., 2007). Our central proposition is that the positive effect of social media capability on knowledge exploration can be amplified if the firm also has business analytics talent. We use the complementary resource perspective to explain how business analytics talent complements social media capability to enable knowledge exploration.




资源互补视角是一种理论框架，认为企业的资源互补性可以解释商业效益的差异效应。资源/能力之间的互补性是指资源/能力的相互增强，其中一种资源/能力的存在允许其他资源/能力发挥其价值（Ennen & Richter，2010）。这些互补关系可能会推动对更高效流程的追求，这可能不同于孤立考虑的个体效应的总和（Adegbesan，2009；Bharadwaj 等，2007）。我们的中心主张是，如果公司还拥有业务分析人才，那么社交媒体能力对知识探索的积极影响就可以放大。我们使用互补资源的视角来解释业务分析人才如何补充社交媒体能力以实现知识探索。


## 2.2 Impact of Social Media on Organizations and Individuals, and Opportunities for IS Research




## 2.2 社交媒体对组织和个人的影响以及信息系统研究的机会


Although prior studies in this stream of IS research have highlighted the critical role of social media and provided some evidence about its impact on individuals’ and organizations’ knowledge sharing, there are two research opportunities in the existing literature. First, although the crucial challenge for organizations is to learn how they can develop the ability to effectively select, use, and leverage external social media among changing platforms in order to scan, learn, and internalize knowledge, it remains rather unclear how companies can develop a social media capability and create business value from this capability. Instead, prior IS research has focused on understanding the knowledge sharing behavior of employees in enterprise social media (Beck et al., 2014; Leonardi, 2014; Neely & Leonardi, 2018; Song et al., 2019), user-generated content, and customer engagement to diffuse information through social media (Bapna et al., 2019; Yang et al., 2019). Prior IS research has also focused on exploring customer behavior in social media through complaints (Gunarathne et al., 2017) service (Gunarathne et al., 2018), and the knowledge-sharing behavior of bloggers (Chai et al., 2011). Prior IS research has mainly focused on the employee, customer, and user, devoting less attention to organizations as the main level of analysis (see Table A1 in the Appendix). Despite the plausible role that the firm’s proficiency in using and selecting external social media may play in exploring new knowledge and exploiting existing knowledge (Chau & Xu, 2012), this research topic is undertheorized in IS research.




尽管信息系统研究领域的先前研究强调了社交媒体的关键作用，并提供了一些关于其对个人和组织知识共享影响的证据，但现有文献中有两个研究机会。首先，尽管组织面临的关键挑战是了解如何发展在不断变化的平台中有效选择、使用和利用外部社交媒体的能力，以扫描、学习和内化知识，但企业如何发展社交媒体能力并利用这种能力创造商业价值仍然相当不清楚。相反，之前的信息系统研究侧重于了解员工在企业社交媒体中的知识共享行为（Beck et al., 2014; Leonardi, 2014; Neely & Leonardi, 2018; Song et al., 2019）、用户生成的内容以及客户通过社交媒体传播信息的参与度（Bapna et al., 2019; Yang et al., 2019）。之前的 IS 研究还侧重于通过投诉（Gunarathne 等人，2017）服务（Gunarathne 等人，2018）以及博主的知识共享行为（Chai 等人，2011）来探索社交媒体中的客户行为。先前的信息系统研究主要集中在员工、客户和用户，而较少关注组织作为主要分析层面（参见附录中的表A1）。尽管公司熟练使用和选择外部社交媒体可能在探索新知识和利用现有知识方面发挥看似合理的作用（Chau & Xu，2012），但这一研究主题在信息系统研究中并未得到充分理论化。


Although firms’ business analytics talent may perform a critical role in understanding and acquiring new knowledge from big data on customers in social media, this plausible effect is not well understood. Instead, prior IS research has primarily focused on the impact of big data analytics capability on competitive performance (Mikalef et al., 2020) and its reinforcing role in creating synergies and improving market performance (Dong & Yang, 2020). However, an overemphasis on analytics software seems to prevail, minimizing the role of people and analytics talent (Conboy et al., 2020). The goal of our research is to address these research opportunities. First, our study examines the development of social media capability and its impact on the firm’s exploration and exploitation of knowledge. Second, we also examine whether and how business analytics talent reinforces the impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration. Figure 1 presents the proposed research model.




尽管公司的业务分析人才可能在理解和从社交媒体中的客户大数据中获取新知识方面发挥着关键作用，但这种看似合理的影响尚未得到很好的理解。相反，之前的信息系统研究主要关注大数据分析能力对竞争绩效的影响（Mikalef 等，2020）及其在创造协同效应和提高市场绩效方面的强化作用（Dong & Yang，2020）。然而，过分强调分析软件似乎盛行，最大限度地减少了人员和分析人才的作用（Conboy 等人，2020）。我们研究的目标是抓住这些研究机会。首先，我们的研究考察了社交媒体能力的发展及其对公司探索和利用知识的影响。其次，我们还研究了商业分析人才是否以及如何增强社交媒体能力对知识探索的影响。图 1 展示了所提出的研究模型。

## 2.3 Conceptualization of Key Constructs of the Study




## 2.3 研究关键结构的概念化


## 2.3.1 Social Media Capability




## 2.3.1 社交媒体能力


Social media capability concerns the firm’s ability to purposely use and leverage external social media platforms to execute business activities (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). This study considers the three external social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, and corporate blogs) most used by contemporary firms (Culnan et al., 2010). In 2018 89%, 91%, and 53% of the Fortune 500 firms used Facebook, Twitter, and corporate blogs, respectively, for business activities (Barnes et al., 2019). In this sense, social media capability covers three of the most relevant external social media platforms used by firms (Braojos et al., 2015; Braojos et al., 2019). The development of social media capability is heterogeneous among companies, which suggests that companies may vary between high and low social media capabilities. Firms with highly developed social media capabilities can positively engage customers and employees to discuss their activities and cultural values and to share knowledge. Melia Hotels International (a leading hotel group worldwide) is an example of a company with high social media capabilities. Melia has leveraged social media to better manage the customer relationship/experience, improve its digital brand and web traffic, co-create knowledge, attract talent, and improve its employer branding.<sup>2</sup> In contrast, Molson Company (a multinational brewing company) illustrates a company with low social media capabilities. Molson Company had a static presence on Facebook in 2007 when it decided to exploit the potential of social media by launching a Facebook campaign that encouraged university students to post pictures of drinking. The company was criticized for promoting irresponsible drinking, which negatively affected its corporate reputation (Compeau & Qureshi, 2008).




社交媒体能力涉及公司有目的地使用和利用外部社交媒体平台来执行业务活动的能力（Benitez、Castillo 等，2018）。本研究考虑了当代企业最常使用的三个外部社交媒体平台（Facebook、Twitter 和企业博客）（Culnan 等，2010）。 2018 年，财富 500 强企业中分别有 89%、91% 和 53% 使用 Facebook、Twitter 和企业博客进行业务活动（Barnes 等，2019）。从这个意义上说，社交媒体能力涵盖了企业使用的三个最相关的外部社交媒体平台（Braojos等，2015；Braojos等，2019）。不同公司的社交媒体能力发展情况存在差异，这表明公司的社交媒体能力可能存在高低差异。拥有高度发达的社交媒体功能的公司可以积极吸引客户和员工讨论他们的活动和文化价值观并分享知识。美利亚国际酒店集团（全球领先的酒店集团）是拥有强大社交媒体能力的公司的一个例子。 Melia 利用社交媒体更好地管理客户关系/体验、改善其数字品牌和网络流量、共同创造知识、吸引人才并改善其雇主品牌。<sup>2</sup>相比之下，Molson Company（一家跨国啤酒公司）说明了一家社交媒体能力较低的公司。 2007 年，Molson 公司在 Facebook 上占据了一席之地，当时该公司决定通过发起 Facebook 活动鼓励大学生发布饮酒照片来挖掘社交媒体的潜力。该公司因提倡不负责任的饮酒而受到批评，这对其企业声誉产生了负面影响（Compeau & Qureshi，2008）。


Recent IS research on IT and knowledge management capabilities has operationalized the concept of ITenabled capabilities (Joshi et al., 2010; Saldanha et al., 2020). For example, Joshi et al. (2010) conceptualized IT-enabled absorptive capacity as the IT contributions to firms’ abilities to acquire, assimilate, transform, and exploit knowledge. Saldanha et al. (2020) have operationalized IT-enabled social integration capacity as the firm’s IT use that fosters social capital through social interaction and connectedness. For this purpose, they also introduced several internal and external IT applications (e.g., wikis, blogs, enterprise social networking sites). We draw on this prior IS research to conceptualize social media capability. However, our social media capability concept presents unique and original characteristics concerning IT-enabled absorptive capacity and IT-enabled social integration capacity. First, social media capability refers directly and exclusively to the firm’s ability to leverage external social media platforms (i.e., a specific IT). Second, in contrast to prior IS research (e.g., Andrade et al., 2018; Saldanha et al., 2020), the current study focuses not only on acquiring or recombining knowledge but on how social media capability affects firms’ knowledge exploration (i.e., acquiring/creating, sharing, and storing new knowledge) and knowledge exploitation (i.e., assimilating, reusing, reinterpreting, applying, and leveraging existing knowledge).




最近的信息系统关于 IT 和知识管理能力的研究已经将 IT 能力的概念付诸实践（Joshi 等人，2010 年；Saldanha 等人，2020 年）。例如，乔希等人。 (2010) 将 IT 支持的吸收能力概念化为 IT 对企业获取、吸收、转化和利用知识的能力的贡献。萨尔达尼亚等人。 （2020）已将 IT 支持的社会整合能力运作为公司的 IT 使用，通过社会互动和联系来培育社会资本。为此，他们还引入了一些内部和外部 IT 应用程序（例如维基、博客、企业社交网站）。我们利用先前的信息系统研究来概念化社交媒体功能。然而，我们的社交媒体能力概念在信息化吸收能力和信息化社会融合能力方面呈现出独特的、原创性的特征。首先，社交媒体能力直接且排他地指公司利用外部社交媒体平台（即特定IT）的能力。其次，与之前的信息系统研究（例如Andrade等人，2018；Saldanha等人，2020）相比，当前的研究不仅关注知识的获取或重组，还关注社交媒体能力如何影响企业的知识探索（即获取/创建、共享和存储新知识）和知识利用（即同化、重用、重新解释、应用和利用现有知识）。


## 2.3.2 Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation




## 2.3.2 知识探索与知识利用


Knowledge exploration refers to the learning process of experimenting with new knowledge and business opportunities by acquiring/creating, sharing, and storing this new knowledge (March, 1991). In prior literature, two theories on organizational viability coexist to explore and exploit knowledge: as two extremes of a continuum (tradeoffs) or as two independent activities (complementary strategies) (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Gupta et al., 2006). As two extremes of a continuum, exploration of new knowledge and the exploitation of existing knowledge are two extremes of the same continuum (Rosenkopf & McGrath, 2011), which invites specializing/focusing exploration or exploitation (March, 1991). A company may be situated in an intermediate position, instead of at one of the extremes, where the consideration of exploration and exploitation would be in equilibrium.




知识探索是指通过获取/创建、共享和存储新知识来尝试新知识和商业机会的学习过程（1991 年 3 月）。在先前的文献中，关于组织生存力的两种理论并存以探索和利用知识：作为连续体的两个极端（权衡）或作为两种独立的活动（互补策略）（Benitez、Castillo 等人，2018；Gupta 等人，2006）。作为连续体的两个极端，对新知识的探索和对现有知识的利用是同一连续体的两个极端（Rosenkopf＆McGrath，2011），这需要专门/集中的探索或利用（3月，1991年）。公司可能处于中间位置，而不是极端位置之一，此时勘探和开发的考虑将处于平衡状态。


As two independent activities, knowledge exploration and exploitation are orthogonal and differentiated by the level of learning (Gupta et al., 2006; He & Wong, 2004). According to this body of literature, companies can pursue both exploration and exploitation of knowledge. Our study draws on this stream of literature to explore how social media capability affects the firm’s exploration and exploitation of knowledge. Although they are complementary, given that knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation are different, it is rational to think that they may have different relationships with other resources. Therefore, it is important and necessary to understand the different effects of other resources in these two processes. We focus on the interface between business analytics talent and the exploration and exploitation of knowledge-driven social media capability.




作为两项独立的活动，知识探索和利用是正交的，并且根据学习水平进行区分（Gupta 等，2006；He & Wong，2004）。根据这些文献，公司可以同时探索和利用知识。我们的研究利用这些文献来探讨社交媒体功能如何影响公司对知识的探索和利用。尽管它们是互补的，但考虑到知识探索和知识利用是不同的，我们有理由认为它们与其他资源可能有不同的关系。因此，了解其他资源在这两个过程中的不同作用是重要且必要的。我们专注于业务分析人才与知识驱动的社交媒体能力的探索和利用之间的联系。


## 2.3.3 Business Analytics Talent




## 2.3.3 商业分析人才


Business analytics comprise a group of people, approaches, organizational procedures, and tools used in combination that convert data into insights for problem recognition and solving within a business situation context (Holsapple et al., 2014; Trkman et al., 2010; Wixom et al., 2013). The notion of business analytics talent in this study is derived from Ransbotham et al.’s (2015) work on analytics talent, and we draw on this work to conceptualize and measure business analytics talent. Business analytics talent is a firm resource that refers to people’s talent in performing business analytics (i.e., high-level analytical skills) to transform data into insights valuable for supporting business activities (Ransbotham et al., 2015). Business analytics talent is conceptually a different construct than social media capability, as some companies with high/low social media capability do not have business analytics talent because of its scarcity in the market. Our conceptualization is consistent with recent IS research that investigated big data analytics capability individually and highlighted its potential value (e.g., Mikalef et al., 2020). However, other IS scholars may be interested in examining general IT-enabled information management capability, which could potentially combine the analysis of both social media and business data analytics under the same concept and theoretical lens (e.g., Andrade & Kathuria, 2014). Our conceptualization of business analytics talent deliberately excludes business analytics talent. We propose that social media capability can enable firms to explore and exploit knowledge and that firms with more and better business analytics talent can amplify and strengthen the relationship between social media capability and firm knowledge exploration.<sup>3</sup>




业务分析由一组人员、方法、组织程序和工具组成，这些人员、方法、组织程序和工具组合使用，将数据转换为洞察力，以便在业务情境背景下识别和解决问题（Holsapple 等人，2014 年；Trkman 等人，2010 年；Wixom 等人，2013 年）。本研究中商业分析人才的概念源自 Ransbotham 等人 (2015) 关于分析人才的工作，我们利用这项工作来概念化和衡量商业分析人才。业务分析人才是一种公司资源，指人们执行业务分析的才能（即高级分析技能），将数据转化为对支持业务活动有价值的见解（Ransbotham et al., 2015）。商业分析人才在概念上与社交媒体能力是不同的概念，因为一些社交媒体能力高/低的公司由于市场稀缺而没有业务分析人才。我们的概念化与最近的 IS 研究一致，该研究单独调查了大数据分析能力并强调了其潜在价值（例如，Mikalef 等人，2020）。然而，其他 IS 学者可能有兴趣研究一般 IT 支持的信息管理能力，这可能会在相同的概念和理论镜头下结合社交媒体和商业数据分析的分析（例如，Andrade 和 Kathuria，2014）。我们对业务分析人才的概念故意排除了业务分析人才。我们认为社交媒体能力可以帮助企业探索和利用知识，拥有更多更好的商业分析人才的企业可以放大和加强社交媒体能力与企业知识探索之间的关系。<sup>3</sup>


## 2.4 Social Media Capability and Knowledge Exploration




## 2.4 社交媒体能力和知识探索


Social media capability can facilitate the firm’s knowledge exploration. Firms can use external social media (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, corporate blogs) to acquire new knowledge from customers, competitors, and suppliers and to create and share new knowledge with them, thus facilitating the exploration of new knowledge. Firms can use Facebook and Twitter to reach current and potential customers and interact with them to acquire customer knowledge (e.g., customer preferences and feedback on the current firm’s products) (Andrade & Kathuria, 2014). These social media platforms can also be leveraged to co-develop new products with customers, (Patroni et al., forthcoming;




社交媒体功能可以促进公司的知识探索。企业可以利用外部社交媒体（例如Facebook、Twitter、企业博客）从客户、竞争对手和供应商那里获取新知识，并与他们一起创造和分享新知识，从而促进新知识的探索。公司可以使用 Facebook 和 Twitter 来接触当前和潜在客户并与他们互动以获取客户知识（例如客户偏好和对当前公司产品的反馈）（Andrade 和 Kathuria，2014）。这些社交媒体平台还可用于与客户共同开发新产品（Patroni 等人，即将出版；


Testa et al., 2020; Xie et al., 2016), and for knowledge sharing with customers (e.g., communication of new products), thus enabling knowledge exploration. For example, Mercadona (i.e., the leading supermarket chain in Spain) has used Twitter to acquire new customer knowledge in the form of customers complaints about out-of-stock products in stores posted on Mercadona’s Twitter site, allowing them to respond to these complaints more quickly. Mercadona has also leveraged Twitter to recognize new customer preferences (e.g., vegan products) faster than direct competitors. Thus, Mercadona is an example of a company with high-level social media capabilities that uses social media to acquire customer knowledge.




泰斯塔等人，2020； Xie et al., 2016），并与客户共享知识（例如，新产品的交流），从而实现知识探索。例如，Mercadona（即西班牙领先的连锁超市）已使用 Twitter 通过在 Mercadona Twitter 网站上发布的关于商店缺货产品的顾客投诉的形式来获取新的客户知识，从而使他们能够更快地对这些投诉做出反应。 Mercadona 还利用 Twitter 比直接竞争对手更快地识别新客户偏好（例如纯素产品）。因此，Mercadona 是一家拥有高级社交媒体能力、利用社交媒体获取客户知识的公司的例子。


Firms can also use external social media to obtain knowledge from competitors and co-create new knowledge with their supplier network. Firms can monitor social media (Facebook, Twitter, blogs) of direct competitors to acquire knowledge on competitor moves and actions (e.g., a supermarket chain that analyzes the key supplier base of its direct competitors on Twitter) in order to design competitive strategies and actions (Andrade & Kathuria, 2014). A firm’s external social media can also be used as a collaborative platform to enable knowledge exploration with suppliers by exchanging information and co-creating new products and projects. Therefore, we hypothesize:




企业还可以使用外部社交媒体从竞争对手那里获取知识，并与其供应商网络共同创造新知识。企业可以监控直接竞争对手的社交媒体（Facebook、Twitter、博客），以获取有关竞争对手动向和行动的知识（例如，一家连锁超市在 Twitter 上分析其直接竞争对手的主要供应商基础），以便设计竞争策略和行动（Andrade 和 Kathuria，2014）。公司的外部社交媒体也可以用作协作平台，通过交换信息和共同创造新产品和项目，与供应商进行知识探索。因此，我们假设：


H1: There is a positive relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration.




H1：社交媒体能力与知识探索之间存在正相关关系。


## 2.5 Social Media Capability and Knowledge Exploitation




## 2.5 社交媒体能力和知识利用


Social media capability can also positively influence the exploitation of existing knowledge. The firm’s proficiency in selecting, using, and leveraging external social media (Facebook, Twitter, corporate blogs) may help the firm assimilate, reinterpret, reuse, and apply existing knowledge, thus increasing knowledge exploitation. The external social media can serve as customer and competitor knowledge repositories, which facilitate knowledge assimilation and reuse (Jarvenpaa & Majchrzak, 2010; Lu et al., 2015). Companies can also use external social media to develop and maintain long-term relationships with current and potential customers, collaborating and sharing knowledge with the firm to reinterpret and apply customer and product knowledge, thus enabling the exploitation of knowledge. For example, Mercadona uses Twitter to exploit existing knowledge. After its Twitter account was flooded requests for e kefir (i.e., a sour drink containing so-called gutfriendly bacteria). Mercadona applied and leveraged this knowledge to commercialize this product in response to increasing demand in its stores, which has been acknowledged by its customers. One customer uploaded a picture of kefir with the following text: “If there is one thing that I like about Mercadona is that they always listen to the customers’ suggestions.” This example illustrates how firm-customer interactions in external social media (e.g., Twitter) provide Mercadona “clues” for reinterpreting and reusing existing customer and product knowledge, thus facilitating knowledge exploitation. We thus hypothesize:




社交媒体功能还可以对现有知识的利用产生积极影响。公司在选择、使用和利用外部社交媒体（Facebook、Twitter、企业博客）方面的熟练程度可以帮助公司吸收、重新解释、重用和应用现有知识，从而增加知识利用。外部社交媒体可以作为客户和竞争对手的知识库，促进知识同化和重用（Jarvenpaa & Majchrzak，2010；Lu et al.，2015）。公司还可以利用外部社交媒体与当前和潜在客户发展和维持长期关系，与公司合作和共享知识，重新解释和应用客户和产品知识，从而实现知识的利用。例如，Mercadona 使用 Twitter 来利用现有知识。在其推特账户被大量请求购买 e kefir（即一种含有所谓肠道友好细菌的酸饮料）后。 Mercadona 应用并利用这些知识将该产品商业化，以满足其商店日益增长的需求，这一点已得到客户的认可。一位顾客上传了一张克菲尔的照片，并附有以下文字：“如果说我喜欢梅尔卡多纳的一件事就是他们总是倾听顾客的建议。”此示例说明了外部社交媒体（例如 Twitter）中的公司与客户互动如何为 Mercadona 提供重新解释和重用现有客户和产品知识的“线索”，从而促进知识利用。因此我们假设：


H2: There is a positive relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploitation.




H2：社交媒体能力与知识利用之间存在正相关关系。


## 2.6 The Business Value of Business Analytics Talent: Business Analytics Talent as Moderator between Social Media Capability and Knowledge Exploration




## 2.6 商业分析人才的商业价值：商业分析人才作为社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的调节者


We argue that when the firm has talent in business analytics, the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration may be amplified because business analytics talent can play a positive moderator (reinforcing) role in this relationship. Social media facilitates the exploration of a vast amount of new knowledge. However, business analytics talent must have a good understanding in order to efficiently explore this knowledge (Chau & Xu, 2012). Firms with superior business analytics talent can collect, monitor, analyze, and summarize the vast amount of unstructured new information to quickly create new insights and meaningful knowledge (He et al., 2015) that can be easily stored (i.e., knowledge exploration). Social media data are often unstructured, subjective, and massive (Chan et al., 2016). The ideas expressed in social media can be easily misunderstood and misapplied (Faraj et al., 2011), which requires firms to use analytical skills to effectively explore knowledge and convert social data into useful and understandable new knowledge. Business analytics talent is pivotal for firms seeking to create and store useful knowledge acquired from external social media. Therefore, we hypothesize:




我们认为，当公司拥有商业分析人才时，社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系可能会被放大，因为商业分析人才可以在这种关系中发挥积极的调节（强化）作用。社交媒体促进了对大量新知识的探索。然而，业务分析人才必须有很好的理解，才能有效地探索这些知识（Chau & Xu，2012）。拥有卓越商业分析人才的公司可以收集、监控、分析和总结大量非结构化新信息，以快速创建新的见解和有意义的知识（He et al., 2015），并且可以轻松存储（即知识探索）。社交媒体数据通常是非结构化的、主观的和海量的（Chan 等人，2016）。社交媒体中表达的想法很容易被误解和误用（Faraj et al., 2011），这需要企业利用分析技能来有效探索知识，并将社交数据转化为有用且易于理解的新知识。对于寻求创建和存储从外部社交媒体获取的有用知识的公司来说，商业分析人才至关重要。因此，我们假设：


H3: Business analytics talent positively moderates (reinforces and amplifies) the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration.




H3：商业分析人才积极调节（强化和放大）社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系。


Table 1 presents a summary of the main arguments of the hypotheses that composes the proposed research model.




表 1 总结了构成所提出的研究模型的假设的主要论点。


## 3 Research Methodology




## 3 研究方法


## 3.1 Sample




## 3.1 示例


We tested the proposed model with a sample of the 100 small firms listed in the 2013 Forbes America’s Best Small Companies ranking (hereafter, the Forbes database). This ranking comprises the best 100 publicly recognized US small firms with sales under one billion dollars (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). The firms in our sample came from 30 industries, including consulting (18 firms), IT (16 firms), food manufacturing (7 firms), semiconductor manufacturing (6 firms), healthcare (5 firms), chemical (5 firms), and other industries (43 firms).




我们以 2013 年《福布斯》美国最佳小公司排名（以下简称《福布斯》数据库）中列出的 100 家小公司为样本，测试了所提出的模型。该排名包括销售额低于 10 亿美元的美国 100 家最佳小企业（Benitez、Castillo 等人，2018 年）。我们样本中的企业来自 30 个行业，包括咨询（18 家企业）、IT（16 家企业）、食品制造（7 家企业）、半导体制造（6 家企业）、医疗保健（5 家企业）、化工（5 家企业）和其他行业（43 家企业）。


Prior IS research has contextualized several types of studies on the business value of IT using samples of firms included in well-known ranking lists (like the list used in this study) (e.g., Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Benitez & Walczuch, 2012; Joshi et al., 2010), which suggests that our decision to use the Forbes database was rational. We focused on this specific ranking list for two reasons: First, since small firms have a lower portfolio of financial resources they can use to compete in the market, leveraging their investments in social media capability and business analytics talent to manage knowledge remains central, in comparison to large firms (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). Second, most prior IS research on social media and business activities has focused on large firms (Luo et al., 2013; Kane, Palmer et al., 2014).




之前的 IS 研究已经使用知名排名列表（如本研究中使用的列表）中包含的公司样本对 IT 商业价值进行了多种类型的研究（例如，Benitez, Castillo 等人，2018 年；Benitez & Walczuch，2012 年；Joshi 等人，2010 年），这表明我们使用福布斯数据库的决定是理性的。我们关注这个具体排名的原因有两个：首先，由于小企业可用于市场竞争的财务资源组合较少，因此与大企业相比，利用其在社交媒体能力和业务分析人才方面的投资来管理知识仍然是核心（Benitez、Castillo 等，2018）。其次，大多数先前关于社交媒体和商业活动的信息系统研究都集中在大型企业（Luo 等，2013；Kane、Palmer 等，2014）。


To check whether our sample met the minimum required size to examine the proposed model’s effects, we performed a statistical power analysis prior to data collection. Assuming an anticipated medium effect size (f2 = 0.150), to achieve a statistical power of 0.800, five predictors (i.e., the number of effects received by knowledge exploration), and an alpha of 0.05, the minimum required size for our sample was 91 (Cohen, 1988). Our sample size of 100 indicates sufficient statistical power to estimate the research model.




为了检查我们的样本是否满足检查所提出模型的效果所需的最小规模，我们在数据收集之前进行了统计功效分析。假设预期的中等效应大小（f2 = 0.150），为了实现 0.800 的统计功效、五个预测变量（即通过知识探索收到的效应数量）和 0.05 的 alpha，我们的样本所需的最小大小为 91（Cohen，1988）。我们的样本量为 100，表明有足够的统计能力来估计研究模型。


## 3.2 Data and Operationalization of Variables




## 3.2 数据和变量的运算


The data used to measure and test the proposed research model and for testing robustness came from nine databases: Facebook, Twitter, firms’ blog sites, LexisNexis, Knowledge Management World, US Patent and Trademark Office, Datastream, Forbes, and firm websites. Thus, the full dataset provides an innovative and unique set of data and measures to test this study’s central proposition.




用于衡量和测试所提出的研究模型以及测试稳健性的数据来​​自九个数据库：Facebook、Twitter、公司博客网站、LexisNexis、知识管理世界、美国专利商标局、Datastream、福布斯和公司网站。因此，完整的数据集提供了一组创新且独特的数据和措施来测试本研究的中心命题。

## 3.2.1 Specification of the Measurement Model




## 3.2.1 测量模型规范


A clear distinction can be made between behavioral constructs and design constructs (i.e., artifacts and emergent variables) (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler, 2017). While behavioral constructs are usually modeled as common factor (reflective) models, composite-formative<sup>4</sup> (in short, composite) constructs should be the preferred choice for modeling artifacts. These artifacts can be understood as theoretically justified constructs that consist of more elementary components (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018). They are human-made objects and concepts typically created by executives, staff, or the firm, and should be modeled as composites (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020). The artifact serves as a proxy for the concept under investigation and can be understood as a mix of ingredients (indicators) forming the recipe (artifact) (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Henseler, 2015, 2017; Rueda et al., 2017). Composite modeling is how artifacts are estimated (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020). Based on the above arguments, all research constructs were considered to be artifacts and were modeled as composites. For the sake of brevity, we refer to artifacts as composite constructs.




行为构造和设计构造（即工件和涌现变量）之间可以明确区分（Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020；Henseler, 2017）。虽然行为构造通常被建模为公共因素（反射）模型，但复合形成<sup>4</sup>（简而言之，复合）构造应该是建模工件的首选。这些工件可以理解为由更多基本组件组成的理论上合理的构造（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018；Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018）。它们是人造物体和概念，通常由高管、员工或公司创建，应该建模为复合材料（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020）。该工件作为所研究概念的代理，可以理解为形成配方（工件）的成分（指标）的混合（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Henseler, 2015, 2017; Rueda et al., 2017）。复合建模是估计伪影的方式（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020）。基于上述论点，所有研究结构都被认为是工件，并被建模为复合材料。为了简洁起见，我们将工件称为复合构造。


## 3.2.2 Social Media Capability




## 3.2.2 社交媒体能力


Social media capability is a composite second-order construct composed of three dimensions: Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018; Culnan et al., 2010). We used the firm’s social media activities on Facebook, Twitter, and corporate blog(s) because they serve as a good proxy to evaluate social media capability (Braojos et al., 2019). It is rational to expect that firms develop a social media capability by experimenting and executing a high number of social media activities. These social media activities refer to activities performed by the firm and do not include the posts of the social media users, thus removing customer engagement metrics from social media capability measurements. The measurement and conceptualization focus on the firm’s social media activities. Facebook, Twitter, and blogs are three of the most relevant external social media platforms used by companies (Benitez, Ruiz et al., 2020; Culnan et al., 2010). We measured social media capability based on the validated measure scheme from Benitez, Castillo et al. (2018) and Benitez, Ruiz et al. (2020) with data collected in 2014.




社交媒体能力是一个复合二阶结构，由三个维度组成：Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力（Benitez、Castillo 等，2018；Culnan 等，2010）。我们使用了公司在 Facebook、Twitter 和企业博客上的社交媒体活动，因为它们可以作为评估社交媒体能力的良好代理（Braojos 等人，2019）。期望公司通过试验和执行大量社交媒体活动来发展社交媒体能力是合理的。这些社交媒体活动是指公司执行的活动，不包括社交媒体用户的帖子，因此从社交媒体能力衡量中删除了客户参与度指标。衡量和概念化的重点是公司的社交媒体活动。 Facebook、Twitter 和博客是公司使用的三个最相关的外部社交媒体平台（Benitez、Ruiz 等人，2020 年；Culnan 等人，2010 年）。我们根据贝尼特斯、卡斯蒂略等人经过验证的测量方案来测量社交媒体能力。 (2018) 和贝尼特斯、鲁伊斯等人。 (2020)，数据收集于 2014 年。


Facebook capability was evaluated as a composite first-order construct based on the following ingredients: number of events, experience, and updates, using information from the firm’s Facebook site. 74% of the firms of the sample had a Facebook site; if a firm did not have a Facebook site, each of the specific ingredients of Facebook capability was coded as 0. One of these ingredients is the number of events organized on Facebook by the company. Facebook events refer to the number of past and future upcoming calendar-based occasions, such as celebrations, meetings, conferences, and showings organized by a company. From the point at which the firm’s Facebook site was created until the end of the data collection period (2014), the sample firms organized 5.510 events, on average. The second ingredient of Facebook capability was the firm’s experience using Facebook. Firms likely develop the ability to use and leverage Facebook through experience, trial and error, and experimentation. Facebook experience was measured as the average number of months that the firm had been operating on Facebook, from the creation of the Facebook firm’s site until 2014, with information collected from the Twopcharts database. On average, the sample firms had 33.773 months of experience using Facebook. The final ingredient used to asses Facebook capability was the firm’s update activity, which refers to the firm’s activity in updating content on its Facebook site. The logic of this measure is that companies that frequently update their site likely have high Facebook capabilities. We measured the frequency of updates with a score of 1 (low) to 5 (high), based on when the firm made its last comment on Facebook—1: more than one month ago, 2: in the last month, 3: two weeks ago, 4: in the last week, or 5: in the last two days) (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). The average update activity score among the sample firms was 2.740.




Facebook 的能力被评估为基于以下要素的复合一阶结构：事件数量、体验和更新，使用来自公司 Facebook 网站的信息。 74% 的样本公司拥有 Facebook 网站；如果一家公司没有 Facebook 网站，则 Facebook 能力的每个具体要素都被编码为 0。这些要素之一是该公司在 Facebook 上组织的活动数量。 Facebook 活动是指过去和未来即将举行的基于日历的活动的数量，例如公司组织的庆祝活动、会议、会议和展示。从公司 Facebook 网站创建到数据收集期结束（2014 年），样本公司平均组织了 5,510 场活动。 Facebook 能力的第二个要素是公司使用 Facebook 的经验。企业可能会通过经验、试错和实验来培养使用和利用 Facebook 的能力。 Facebook 体验的衡量标准是该公司从 Facebook 公司网站创建到 2014 年在 Facebook 上运营的平均月数，信息来自 Twopcharts 数据库。样本公司平均拥有 33.773 个月的 Facebook 使用经验。用于评估 Facebook 能力的最后一个因素是公司的更新活动，即公司更新其 Facebook 网站内容的活动。这一衡量标准的逻辑是，经常更新网站的公司可能拥有较高的 Facebook 能力。我们根据公司在 Facebook 上发表最后评论的时间，以 1（低）到 5（高）的分数来衡量更新频率 - 1：一个多月前，2：上个月，3：两周前，4：上周，或 5：过去两天）（Benitez、Castillo 等，2018）。样本公司的平均更新活动得分为 2.740。


Twitter capability was operationalized as a composite first-order construct using three indicators: time spent writing tweets, <sup>5</sup> experience, and updates using information collected from the firm’s site in the Twitter and Twopcharts databases. 71% of the sample firms had a Twitter site. If a firm did not have a Twitter site, each of the specific Twitter capability ingredients was coded as 0. The spent time writing tweets refers to the average number of hours the firm spent writing tweets from the creation of the firm’s Twitter site until 2014. This ingredient is likely a good indicator of Twitter capability because it measures the time a company invests in learning to use and leverage Twitter. On average, the sample firms invested 17.280 hours on Twitter. Experience and updates were measured in the same way as for Facebook capability (Braojos et al., 2019). On average, the sample firms had 35.752 months of experience using Twitter and an update activity score of 2.750.




Twitter 功能被操作为使用三个指标的复合一阶构造：编写推文所花费的时间、<sup>5</sup> 体验以及使用从 Twitter 和 Twopcharts 数据库中从公司网站收集的信息进行的更新。 71% 的样本公司拥有 Twitter 网站。如果一家公司没有 Twitter 网站，则每个特定的 Twitter 能力要素都编码为 0。编写推文所花费的时间是指该公司从创建该公司的 Twitter 网站到 2014 年花费在编写推文上的平均小时数。该要素可能是 Twitter 能力的良好指标，因为它衡量了公司在学习使用和利用 Twitter 上投入的时间。样本公司平均在 Twitter 上投入了 17.280 小时。体验和更新的衡量方式与 Facebook 功能相同（Braojos 等人，2019）。平均而言，样本公司有 35.752 个月的 Twitter 使用经验，更新活动得分为 2.750。


Blog capability: Following the measurement scheme validated by Benitez, Castillo et al. (2018) and Benitez, Ruiz et al. (2020), we measured blog capability through a construct composed of firm experience and firm updates on the blog(s) using data collected from the firm’s blog(s). We accessed the firm’s blog by using a direct firm website link to the corporate blog used by firms to interact with their customers and other stakeholders. 35% of the firms of the sample had a corporate blog. If a firm did not have corporate blog(s), each of the specific blog capability ingredients was coded as 0. Experience and updates were measured in the same way as for Facebook capability. On average, the sample firms had 17.266 months of experience using their corporate blog and an update activity of 1.255.




博客功能：遵循贝尼特斯、卡斯蒂略等人验证的测量方案。 (2018) 和贝尼特斯、鲁伊斯等人。 （2020），我们使用从公司博客收集的数据，通过由公司经验和公司博客更新组成的结构来衡量博客能力。我们通过使用指向公司博客的直接公司网站链接来访问该公司的博客，公司使用该博客与客户和其他利益相关者进行互动。 35% 的样本公司拥有企业博客。如果公司没有企业博客，则每个特定博客能力成分都被编码为 0。体验和更新的衡量方式与 Facebook 能力相同。平均而言，样本公司使用企业博客的经验为 17.266 个月，更新活动为 1.255。


## 3.2.3 Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation




## 3.2.3 知识探索与知识利用


Knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation are composite first-order constructs composed of five indicators. We used one indicator for each year from 2014 to 2018 as follows. To measure each indicator of knowledge exploration and exploitation, we performed a structured content analysis following Joshi et al. (2010)’s measurement scheme, which has been widely accepted in the IS community.<sup>6</sup> We used secondary data based on a comprehensive examination of corporate news from various data sources. These objective data are not susceptible to common method variance or respondents’ perceptions (Joshi et al., 2010). In addition to Joshi et al. (2010), other prior IS studies have suggested that these objective data and this measurement scheme are a feasible approach to measure IT applications that bolster knowledge management capabilities (e.g., Bharadwaj et al., 1999; Brynjolfsson & Hitt, 1996; Hitt & Brynjolfsson, 1996).




知识探索和知识利用是由五个指标组成的复合一阶结构。 2014 年至 2018 年，我们每年使用一个指标如下。为了衡量知识探索和利用的每个指标，我们按照 Joshi 等人的研究进行了结构化内容分析。 (2010) 的测量方案，已被 IS 界广泛接受。<sup>6</sup>我们使用基于对各种数据源的企业新闻进行全面检查的二手数据。这些客观数据不易受到共同方法方差或受访者看法的影响（Joshi 等，2010）。除了乔希等人。 (2010)，其他先前的信息系统研究表明，这些客观数据和这种测量方案是测量增强知识管理能力的 IT 应用程序的可行方法（例如，Bharadwaj 等人，1999 年；Brynjolfsson & Hitt，1996 年；Hitt & Brynjolfsson，1996 年）。


We measured knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation as follows. First, we used nine keywords related to IT applications that support knowledge exploration activities and nine keywords related to IT applications that support knowledge exploitation activities to select the firm’s news published in 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018 from LexisNexis and Knowledge Management World databases. <sup>7</sup> The selection of IT applications that enable knowledge exploration and the list of IT applications that facilitate knowledge exploitation comes from Joshi et al. (2010). They “reviewed more than 300 articles and identified a list of IT application titles that were specifically mentioned and tied to one or more knowledge activities and capabilities in these articles.” (Joshi et al., 2010, p. 482), and “created a mapping between IT technologies and knowledge capabilities based on the technology capability linkages provided in the literature.” (Joshi et al., 2010, p. 482). Joshi et al. (2010) also developed six iterations until they agreed on the list of IT applications that support knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation and engaged two external experts in IT and knowledge management “to independently assess” their coding protocol and mapping between technology categories and knowledge capabilities” (p. 484).




我们测量知识探索和知识利用如下。首先，我们使用9个与支持知识探索活动的IT应用相关的关键词和9个与支持知识探索活动的IT应用相关的关键词，从LexisNexis和Knowledge Management World数据库中筛选出该公司2014年、2015年、2016年、2017年和2018年发布的新闻。 <sup>7</sup> 支持知识探索的 IT 应用程序选择和促进知识开发的 IT 应用程序列表来自 Joshi 等人。 （2010）。他们“审查了 300 多篇文章，并确定了一系列 IT 应用程序标题，这些标题特别提到并与这些文章中的一个或多个知识活动和功能相关。” （Joshi 等人，2010 年，第 482 页），并“根据文献中提供的技术能力联系，创建了 IT 技术和知识能力之间的映射。” （Joshi 等人，2010 年，第 482 页）。乔希等人。 （2010）还开发了六次迭代，直到他们就支持知识探索和知识利用的 IT 应用程序列表达成一致，并聘请了两名 IT 和知识管理方面的外部专家“独立评估”其编码协议以及技术类别和知识能力之间的映射”（第 484 页）。


The news coding protocol: We followed the news coding protocol established in well-known prior studies (Andrade & Kathuria, 2014; Chi et al., 2010; Joshi et al., 2010; Saldanha et al., 2020; Zelner et al., 2009). In our study, the news coding protocol was performed by two authors and one independent external coder. Once they selected news containing our 18 keywords, the news items were carefully read to decide whether the firm used (or not) the specific IT applications, making a distinction between those that supported the acquisition and storage of knowledge in the firm (knowledge exploration), and those that supported the application and usage of knowledge in the firm (knowledge exploitation). The irrelevant news was removed. The coders fully read the entire paragraph where a keyword appeared. The disagreements between the three coders were discussed until agreement was reached. The coding protocol was then further refined based on the discussions.




新闻编码协议：我们遵循先前众所周知的研究中建立的新闻编码协议（Andrade & Kathuria，2014；Chi et al.，2010；Joshi et al.，2010；Saldanha et al.，2020；Zelner et al.，2009）。在我们的研究中，新闻编码协议由两名作者和一名独立的外部编码员执行。一旦他们选择了包含我们的18个关键词的新闻，就会仔细阅读新闻条目，以决定公司是否使用了特定的IT应用程序，区分支持公司内知识获取和存储的应用程序（知识探索）和支持公司内知识应用和使用的应用程序（知识利用）。无关新闻已被删除。编码员完整阅读了出现关键字的整个段落。三位编码员之间的分歧进行了讨论，直到达成一致。然后根据讨论进一步完善编码协议。


As an illustrative example, in one piece of news, the coders found the following information: “The firm has migrated to a unified ERP backbone (with an expansion from nine to 12 instances),” indicating that this firm uses enterprise resource planning (ERP). Since ERP is an IT application that supports knowledge exploration activities, we coded this firm as pursuing knowledge exploration activities. In this way, knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation were measured as the total number of news items on knowledge management (knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation) enabled by IT applications in each year (Joshi et al., 2010). From the total number of news items identified in the databases, 10,099 news items indicated that firms used specific IT applications that support knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. The coders found and read 5291 news items about knowledge exploration (538 news items for 2014, 656 news items for 2015, 954 news items for 2016, 1044 news items for 2017, and 2099 news items for 2018). For knowledge exploitation, the coders found and read 4808 news items (341 news items for 2014, 353 news items for 2015, 796 news items for 2016, 1438 news items for 2017, and 1880 news items for 2018). Table 2 provides a list of these 18 keywords.




举个例子，在一则新闻中，程序员发现了以下信息：“该公司已迁移到统一的 ERP 主干网（实例从 9 个扩展到 12 个）”，表明该公司使用企业资源规划 (ERP)。由于ERP是一个支持知识探索活动的IT应用程序，因此我们将这家公司编码为追求知识探索活动。这样，知识探索和知识利用被衡量为每年由IT应用实现的知识管理（知识探索和知识利用）的新闻总数（Joshi等，2010）。在数据库中确定的新闻总数中，有 10,099 条新闻表明企业使用了支持知识探索和知识利用的特定 IT 应用程序。编码员发现并阅读了 5291 条有关知识探索的新闻（2014 年 538 条新闻、2015 年 656 条新闻、2016 年 954 条新闻、2017 年 1044 条新闻、2018 年 2099 条新闻）。对于知识利用，编码员发现并阅读了 4808 条新闻（2014 年 341 条新闻、2015 年 353 条新闻、2016 年 796 条新闻、2017 年 1438 条新闻和 2018 年 1880 条新闻）。表 2 提供了这 18 个关键字的列表。


## 3.2.4 Business Analytics Talent




## 3.2.4 商业分析人才


Business analytics talent is a first-order construct composed of five indicators. To measure business analytics talent, we performed structured content analysis on the firms’ news published in 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018, using the LexisNexis database.<sup>8</sup> Business analytics talent was measured as the total number of news items on the features of business analytics talent (i.e., distinctive attributes of business analytics talent) present in the firm. The data collection and coding protocol were developed as follows. First, based on Ransbotham et al.’s (2015) applied research report, we selected a list of critical keywords related to business analytics talent. We identified all the keywords related to the business analytics talent concept in this report, resulting in a list of 22 critical keywords.




商业分析人才是由五个指标组成的一阶结构。为了衡量商业分析人才，我们使用 LexisNexis 数据库对公司 2014 年、2015 年、2016 年、2017 年和 2018 年发布的新闻进行了结构化内容分析。<sup>8</sup>商业分析人才的衡量标准是公司中存在的有关商业分析人才特征（即商业分析人才的独特属性）的新闻条目总数。数据收集和编码协议开发如下。首先，根据 Ransbotham 等人（2015）的应用研究报告，我们选择了与业务分析人才相关的关键关键词列表。我们在本报告中确定了与业务分析人才概念相关的所有关键词，从而形成了 22 个关键关键词的列表。

## 3.2.5 Control Variables




## 3.2.5 控制变量


We controlled for firm size, industry, and firm age regarding knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. It is rational to expect that larger and more experienced firms may have more resources to invest in firm activities involving knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation (Benitez & Walczuch, 2012). Firm size was measured as the natural logarithm of the average number of employees per firm, with data collected from the Forbes database (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). Firm age was measured as the natural logarithm of the number of years that each firm was in operation (Chen et al., 2015), using information collected from the Forbes database. The exploration and exploitation of knowledge may depend on the industry where the firm operates (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). The industry was measured as a dummy variable (0: manufacturing firm, 1: service firm) using information collected from the Forbes database and the firm’s website (Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018). Table 5 presents the descriptive statistics of the control variables.




我们控制了有关知识探索和知识利用的公司规模、行业和公司年龄。我们可以合理地预期，规模更大、经验更丰富的公司可能有更多的资源来投资于涉及知识探索和知识利用的公司活动（Benitez & Walczuch，2012）。公司规模以每家公司平均员工人数的自然对数来衡量，数据来自福布斯数据库（Benitez、Castillo et al., 2018）。使用从福布斯数据库收集的信息，将企业年龄衡量为每个企业运营年数的自然对数（Chen 等，2015）。知识的探索和利用可能取决于公司所在的行业（Benitez, Castillo et al., 2018）。使用从福布斯数据库和公司网站收集的信息，将该行业作为虚拟变量（0：制造公司，1：服务公司）进行衡量（Benitez，Castillo et al.，2018）。表5列出了控制变量的描述性统计。

使用 PLS 路径建模估计对所提出的研究模型进行了实证测试。 PLS 是一种成熟的、成熟的结构方程建模 (SEM) 估计方法 (Benitez et al., 2017; Henseler et al., 2016)，通常用于 IS 领域 (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Chen et al., 2015; Ringle et al., 2012; Schmiedel et al., 2014)。

Its use is appropriate to test the proposed research model for several reasons: First, PLS is appropriate for confirmatory and explanatory IS research (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Braojos et al., 2020; Henseler, 2018). Second, all constructs of the proposed model were specified as artifacts and PLS is an optimal estimation method for composite models (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler et al., 2014; Henseler et al., 2016). Third, the proposed model has a multidimensional construct (social media capability), which increases the model’s complexity. PLS method is considered to be more flexible than a covariancebased method of estimation to estimate this type of model (Hair et al., 2012).




它的使用适合测试所提出的研究模型，原因如下：首先，PLS 适合验证性和解释性 IS 研究（Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020；Braojos et al., 2020；Henseler, 2018）。其次，所提出模型的所有构造都被指定为工件，并且 PLS 是复合模型的最佳估计方法（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020；Henseler 等人，2014；Henseler 等人，2016）。第三，所提出的模型具有多维结构（社交媒体功能），这增加了模型的复杂性。 PLS 方法被认为比基于协方差的估计方法更灵活地估计此类模型（Hair 等人，2012）。


ADANCO software package: We employed the statistical software package Advanced Analysis for Composites (ADANCO) 2.1 Professional for Windows (http://www.composite-modeling.com/) (Henseler & Dijkstra, 2015). ADANCO is a software package for composite-based SEM with a clear graphical user interface. It facilitates various secondgeneration statistical analyses, such as confirmatory factor analysis, confirmatory composite analysis, and SEM. Version 1.0 was introduced in 2015 by Joerg Henseler and Theo Dijkstra (Henseler & Dijkstra, 2015) to implement their recent developments, i.e., consistent PLS (Dijkstra & Henseler, 2015a, 2015b), the HTMT (Henseler et al., 2015), and the confirmatory composite analysis (Henseler et al., 2014).




ADANCO 软件包：我们采用了统计软件包 Advanced Analysis for Composites (ADANCO) 2.1 Professional for Windows (http://www.composite-modeling.com/) (Henseler & Dijkstra, 2015)。 ADANCO 是一款基于复合材料的 SEM 软件包，具有清晰的图形用户界面。它有利于各种第二代统计分析，例如验证性因素分析、验证性复合分析和SEM。 1.0 版本由 Joerg Henseler 和 Theo Dijkstra (Henseler & Dijkstra, 2015) 于 2015 年推出，以实现他们最近的发展，即一致 PLS (Dijkstra & Henseler, 2015a, 2015b)、HTMT (Henseler et al., 2015) 和验证性复合分析 (Henseler et al., 2015)。 2014）。


ADANCO was programmed as a response to the criticism of existing PLS software [expressed, for instance, by Ronkko and Evermann, 2013]. Two of ADANCO’s features are particularly worth mentioning: In contrast to older PLS software such as PLS-Graph and SmartPLS, the specified graphical model corresponds with the estimated statistical model. Consequently, ADANCO provides consistent estimates for the statistical model at hand. And whereas other PLS software (e.g., PLS-Graph, SmartPLS, WarpPLS, or XLSTAT-PLS) mainly aims at exploratory and predictive research, ADANCO is fully devoted to confirmatory research. As such, it puts goodness of model fit central; it encourages analysts to make use of bootstrap-based tests of goodness of model fit. Besides, it can consistently estimate both composite and common factor models. ADANCO is maintained regularly; Version 2.2 will be launched in Fall 2020. Moreover, a dedicated textbook will be published at the end of 2020 [Henseler, 2020].<sup>9</sup>




ADANCO 的编程是为了回应对现有 PLS 软件的批评 [例如，由 Ronkko 和 Evermann，2013 年表达]。 ADANCO 的两个功能特别值得一提：与 PLS-Graph 和 SmartPLS 等较旧的 PLS 软件相比，指定的图形模型与估计的统计模型相对应。因此，ADANCO 为现有的统计模型提供了一致的估计。其他 PLS 软件（例如 PLS-Graph、SmartPLS、WarpPLS 或 XLSTAT-PLS）主要针对探索性和预测性研究，而 ADANCO 完全致力于验证性研究。因此，它将模型拟合的优度置于中心位置；它鼓励分析师利用基于引导程序的模型拟合优度测试。此外，它可以一致地估计复合模型和公因子模型。 ADANCO 定期维护； 2.2 版本将于 2020 年秋季推出。此外，专门的教科书将于 2020 年底出版 [Henseler, 2020]。<sup>9</sup>


We use the ADANCO software package because it provides consistent estimates, and it is appropriate for confirmatory research, such as that performed by our study.




我们使用 ADANCO 软件包是因为它提供了一致的估计，并且适合验证性研究，例如我们的研究进行的研究。


## 4.1 Measurement Model Evaluation




## 4.1 测量模型评估


## 4.1.1 Confirmatory Composite Analysis




## 4.1.1 验证性综合分析


We conducted confirmatory composite analysis to confirm that our composite measures structure was correct and supported by the data (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler et al., 2014). This confirmatory composite analysis analyzes the composite model’s adequacy, comparing the empirical correlation matrix and the model-implied correlation matrix. It shows whether the structure of the measurements (the saturated model) is correct. We evaluated the discrepancy between the empirical correlation matrix and the saturated model-implied correlation matrix at first-order, second-order, and control variable levels (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler, 2015) by calculating the standardized root mean squared residual (SRMR), unweighted least squares (ULS) discrepancy (d<sub>ULS</sub>), and geodesic discrepancy (d<sub>G</sub>) (Henseler et al., 2014), three well-accepted measures of the discrepancy mentioned above (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Kim et al., 2019). The structure of measurements is supported by the confirmatory composite analysis when the value of the discrepancies is lower than the 95% (or 99%) quantile of the bootstrap discrepancies. When the value of the discrepancies is lower than the 95% quantile of the bootstrap discrepancies, the structure of measurements is supported with a 5% probability (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018). When the value of the discrepancies is lower than the 99% quantile of the bootstrap discrepancies, the structure of measurements is supported with a 1% probability (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020). All discrepancies were below the 95% quantile of the bootstrap discrepancies (Henseler et al., 2016) for both the first- and second-order steps. None of these two models should be rejected based on an alpha level of 0.05. This means that with a probability of 5%, we can assume that the structure of measures of our model is correct. Table 6 shows the overall model fit evaluation for the confirmatory composite analysis.




我们进行了验证性综合分析，以确认我们的综合衡量结构是正确的并得到数据的支持（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020 年；Henseler 等人，2014 年）。这种验证性复合分析通过比较经验相关矩阵和模型隐含相关矩阵来分析复合模型的充分性。它显示了测量的结构（饱和模型）是否正确。我们通过计算标准化均方根残差 (SRMR)、未加权最小二乘 (ULS) 差异 (d<sub>ULS</sub>) 和测地线差异来评估一阶、二阶和控制变量级别的经验相关矩阵与饱和模型隐含相关矩阵之间的差异 (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler, 2015) (d<sub>G</sub>) (Henseler et al., 2014)，针对上述差异的三种广为接受的措施(Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Kim et al., 2019)。当差异值低于引导差异的 95%（或 99%）分位数时，测量结构得到验证性复合分析的支持。当差异值低于自举差异的 95% 分位数时，测量结构以 5% 的概率得到支持（Benitez、Ray 等人，2018）。当差异值低于自举差异的 99% 分位数时，测量结构以 1% 的概率得到支持（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020）。对于一阶和二阶步骤，所有差异均低于引导差异的 95% 分位数（Henseler 等人，2016）。这两个模型均不应基于 0.05 的 alpha 水平而被拒绝。这意味着我们可以以 5% 的概率假设模型的度量结构是正确的。表 6 显示了验证性复合分析的总体模型拟合评估。


## 4.1.2 Evaluation of the Measurement Properties




## 4.1.2 测量特性评估


The constructs of our model (social media capability, knowledge exploration, knowledge exploitation, business analytics talent) are composite. Thus, we evaluated their multicollinearity, weights, loadings, and level of significance (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Cenfetelli & Bassellier, 2009), by running a bootstrap analysis using 4,999 subsamples. To ensure that multicollinearity is not a problem, the variance inflation factor (VIF) must be below the suggested threshold of 10 (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Tanriverdi & Uysal, 2015). For weights estimated by Mode A, an assessment of multicollinearity is not necessary, as they are scaled covariances and therefore ignore multicollinearity (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Rigdon, 2012). Higher VIFs for knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation (both constructs estimated by Mode A) are not a problem in the proposed model. The VIFs of the proposed model’s indicators/dimensions, which are estimated by Sum Score, ranged from 1.000 to 1.470, suggesting that multicollinearity is not a problem in our data (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018). All indicators/dimensions of the model have significant weights (ranging from 0.133\*\*\* to 0.714\*\*\* for indicators, and from 0.483\*\*\* to 0.483\*\*\* for dimensions) and significant loadings (ranging from 0.508\*\*\* to 0.979\*\*\* for indicators, and from 0.520\*\*\* to 0.780\*\*\* for dimensions). We performed the two-step approach to estimate the proposed model since social media capability is a second-order construct. First, we freely correlated all the first-order constructs and dimensions of the second-order constructs to obtain the dimensions’ latent variables scores. Second, we used these latent variables scores as the ingredients that compose social media capability.




我们的模型的构造（社交媒体能力、知识探索、知识利用、业务分析人才）是复合的。因此，我们通过使用 4,999 个子样本运行引导分析，评估了它们的多重共线性、权重、载荷和显着性水平（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020 年；Cenfetelli 和 Bassellier，2009 年）。为了确保多重共线性不是问题，方差膨胀因子 (VIF) 必须低于建议的阈值 10（Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020；Tanriverdi & Uysal, 2015）。对于模式 A 估计的权重，不需要评估多重共线性，因为它们是缩放协方差，因此忽略多重共线性（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020 年；Rigdon，2012 年）。用于知识探索和知识利用的更高 VIF（这两种结构均由模式 A 估计）在所提出的模型中不是问题。所提出模型的指标/维度的 VIF（通过 Sum Score 估计）范围为 1.000 到 1.470，这表明多重共线性在我们的数据中不是问题（Benitez、Ray 等人，2018）。模型的所有指标/维度都具有显着的权重（指标的范围从 0.133\*\*\* 到 0.714\*\*\*，维度的范围从 0.483\*\*\* 到 0.483\*\*\*）和显着的载荷（指标的范围从 0.508\*\*\* 到 0.979\*\*\*，并且从尺寸为 0.520\*\*\* 至 0.780\*\*\*）。由于社交媒体功能是二阶构造，因此我们采用两步方法来估计所提出的模型。首先，我们将所有一阶结构和二阶结构的维度自由相关，以获得维度的潜在变量分数。其次，我们使用这些潜在变量分数作为构成社交媒体能力的成分。


We executed the following weighting scheme in our estimation. First, we started the estimation by using Mode B for all constructs. Second, we employed Mode A for those constructs with VIF values higher than 10 and/or negative weights (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018). Finally, we selected Sum Score as the preferred weighting scheme of some of the constructs, as suggested by the incremental improvements in the overall fit of the estimated model (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020). The measurement model evaluation is presented in Table 7. The results in the confirmatory composite analysis and the evaluation of the measurement properties are good, enabling us to proceed with testing the proposed hypotheses included in the proposed research model.




我们在估计中执行了以下加权方案。首先，我们对所有结构使用模式 B 开始估计。其次，我们对 VIF 值高于 10 和/或负权重的构建体采用模式 A（Benitez、Ray 等人，2018）。最后，我们选择总分作为某些结构的首选加权方案，正如估计模型整体拟合的增量改进所表明的那样（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020）。测量模型评估如表7所示。验证性综合分析和测量属性评估的结果良好，使我们能够继续测试所提出的研究模型中所提出的假设。

## 4.2.1 Overall Model Fit Evaluation of the Estimated Model




## 4.2.1 估计模型的总体模​​型拟合评估


The overall goodness of the estimated model fit was also evaluated similarly to the confirmatory composite analysis, but for the estimated model(s) (Dijkstra and Henseler, 2015a; Henseler et al., 2014). This measure of goodness of fit evaluates the discrepancy between the empirical correlation matrix and the estimated model-implied correlation matrix (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Henseler et al., 2014; Henseler, 2015). The lower the SRMR, dULS, and dG, the better the fit between the proposed model and the data (Henseler & Dijkstra, 2015). Overall, our proposed model should not be rejected based on the alpha level of 0.05 because all the discrepancies are below the 95% quantile of the bootstrap discrepancies (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Henseler et al., 2014). These results mean that with a probability of 5%, we can claim that the proposed research model of social media and knowledge exploration and exploitation is correct for explaining how the corporate and IT world functions.




估计模型拟合的整体优度也以类似于验证性复合分析的方式进行评估，但针对的是估计模型（Dijkstra 和 Henseler，2015a；Henseler 等人，2014）。这种拟合优度度量评估了经验相关矩阵与估计的模型隐含相关矩阵之间的差异（Benitez、Ray 等人，2018 年；Henseler 等人，2014 年；Henseler，2015 年）。 SRMR、dULS 和 dG 越低，所提出的模型和数据之间的拟合越好（Henseler & Dijkstra，2015）。总体而言，我们提出的模型不应基于 0.05 的 alpha 水平而被拒绝，因为所有差异均低于引导差异的 95% 分位数（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020；Henseler 等人，2014）。这些结果意味着，我们可以以 5% 的概率声称所提出的社交媒体和知识探索与利用的研究模型对于解释企业和 IT 世界如何运作是正确的。

## 4.2.2 Test of Hypotheses




## 4.2.2 假设检验


To test the hypothesized relationships, we performed a PLS estimation (Dijkstra & Henseler, 2015b) to evaluate the beta coefficients and their significance for the proposed model by running a bootstrap analysis with 4,999 subsamples. The R2 values and the effect size (f2) of the proposed relationships were also evaluated. First, we evaluated a baseline model to test H1 and H2. This baseline model describes the base relationships, including all control variables and excluding the moderator variable (business analytics talent). Second, we tested Model 1, which includes business analytics talent and adds the interaction terms (social media capability x Business analytics talent) to the baseline model to test H3. H1 and H2 are supported, suggesting that social media capability enables knowledge exploration (H1) $( \beta = 0 . 2 7 0 , p <$ 0.001), and knowledge exploitation (H2) $( \beta = 0 . 1 3 4 , p$ $< 0 . 0 1 )$ . H3 is also supported, which suggests that the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration is amplified (positively moderated and reinforced) when the firm has business analytics talent $( \beta = 0 . 5 8 4 , p < 0 . 0 1 )$ . Thus, business analytics talent plays a reinforcing moderator role in this relationship.




为了测试假设的关系，我们进行了 PLS 估计（Dijkstra & Henseler，2015b），通过对 4,999 个子样本运行引导分析来评估 beta 系数及其对所提出模型的显着性。还评估了所提出的关系的 R2 值和效应大小 (f2)。首先，我们评估了一个基线模型来测试 H1 和 H2。该基线模型描述了基本关系，包括所有控制变量，但不包括调节变量（业务分析人才）。其次，我们测试了模型1，其中包括业务分析人才，并将交互项（社交媒体能力x业务分析人才）添加到基线模型中以测试H3。 H1 和 H2 得到支持，表明社交媒体功能能够实现知识探索 (H1) $( \beta = 0 . 2 7 0 , p <$ 0.001) 和知识利用 (H2) $( \beta = 0 . 1 3 4 , p$ $< 0 . 0 1 )$ 。 H3 也得到支持，这表明当公司拥有业务分析人才 $( \beta = 0 . 5 8 4 , p < 0 . 0 1 )$ 时，社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系会被放大（正向调节和加强）。因此，业务分析人才在这种关系中发挥着强化调节作用。


Control variables did not show any significant relationship with knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation in our model’s context, except industry. The relationships between industry and knowledge exploration and industry and knowledge exploitation are positive and significant, suggesting that firms of services industries explore and exploit knowledge more than firms of manufacturing industries. The $\mathbf { R } ^ { 2 }$ values are 0.177 and 0.060 for the baseline model and 0.750 and 0.060 for Model 1. The $\textbf { f } ^ { 2 }$ values of the key relationships of the proposed model range from 0.079 to 0.017 for the baseline model and from 0.017 to 0.136 for Model 1, which indicate from weak to medium-large effect sizes between the exogenous and endogenous variables of the proposed theory (Benitez, Henseler et al., 2020; Cohen, 1988). Figure 2 depicts the results of the empirical analysis. Table 8 shows the results of the test of hypotheses. Table 9 presents the correlation matrix.




在我们的模型背景下，控制变量没有显示出与知识探索和知识利用的任何显着关系（行业除外）。产业与知识探索、产业与知识利用之间存在正相关且显着的关系，这表明服务业企业比制造业企业更多地探索和利用知识。基线模型的 $\mathbf { R } ^ { 2 }$ 值为 0.177 和 0.060，模型 1 的值为 0.750 和 0.060。建议模型的关键关系的 $\textbf { f } ^ { 2 }$ 值范围为：基线模型为 0.079 至 0.017，模型 1 为 0.017 至 0.017。模型 1 为 0.136，表明所提出理论的外生变量和内生变量之间的效应大小从弱到中大（Benitez、Henseler 等人，2020；Cohen，1988）。图 2 描述了实证分析的结果。表 8 显示了假设检验的结果。表 9 列出了相关矩阵。


## 4.3 Robustness Testing




## 4.3 稳健性测试


We tested for the robustness of the proposed research model by estimating eight alternative/competing models. In the first alternative model, social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and business analytics talent moderates both the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration and the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploitation. The rationale for this model is that firms may additionally use analytical skills to assimilate and exploit knowledge (e.g., making predictions). In the second alternative model, social media capability affects knowledge ambidexterity (i.e., a composite first-order construct composed of two indicators: knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation), and business analytics talent moderates the relationship between social media capability and knowledge ambidexterity. The rationale for this research model is to examine the effects of social media and business analytics talent in the simultaneous pursuit of exploration and exploitation (i.e., knowledge ambidexterity).




我们通过估计八个替代/竞争模型来测试所提出的研究模型的稳健性。在第一个替代模型中，社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，商业分析人才调节社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系以及社交媒体能力和知识利用之间的关系。该模型的基本原理是，企业可以额外使用分析技能来吸收和利用知识（例如，做出预测）。在第二种替代模型中，社交媒体能力影响知识双元性（即由知识探索和知识利用两个指标组成的复合一阶构造），而业务分析人才调节社交媒体能力和知识双元性之间的关系。该研究模型的基本原理是研究社交媒体和商业分析人才在同时追求探索和利用（即知识双元性）时的影响。


In the third alternative model, social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, which affect firm performance, retaining the moderating role of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. The rationale for this research model is to examine the final and full effects on firm performance. In the fourth alternative model, social media capability enables knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and knowledge exploration facilitates knowledge exploitation, preserving the moderating role of business analytics talent. Benitez, Llorens et al. (2018) found that firms explore business opportunities first and then exploit opportunities through operational capabilities (the company's heart and core). Drawing on Benitez, Llorens et al. (2018), the rationale for this fourth alternative research model is that knowledge exploration may precede knowledge exploitation. In the fifth alternative model, social media capability enables knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, knowledge exploration facilitates knowledge exploitation, and business analytics talent moderates both the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration and the relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation.




在第三种替代模型中，社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，从而影响公司绩效，保留了商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识探索之间关系中的调节作用。该研究模型的基本原理是检验对公司绩效的最终和全面影响。在第四种替代模型中，社交媒体能力支持知识探索和知识利用，知识探索促进知识利用，保留商业分析人才的调节作用。贝尼特斯、洛伦斯等人。 （2018）发现，企业首先探索商业机会，然后通过运营能力（公司的心脏和核心）来利用机会。借鉴贝尼特斯、洛伦斯等人的经验。 （2018），第四种替代研究模型的基本原理是知识探索可能先于知识利用。在第五种替代模型中，社交媒体能力促进知识探索和知识利用，知识探索促进知识利用，商业分析人才调节社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系以及知识探索和知识利用之间的关系。


In the sixth alternative model, we measure Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability with experience and updates, that is, with homogeneous measurements, but every other model specification stays the same. The seventh alternative model controls for advertising spending on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. The rationale is that the development of social media capability and its effects on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation may be affected by the firm’s marketing activities. Finally, the eighth alternative model combines the model specifications of the second and seventh alternative models but estimates knowledge ambidexterity by multiplying knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. The next section presents the results of the estimation of these eight alternative models.




在第六个替代模型中，我们通过经验和更新来衡量 Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力，即使用同质测量，但所有其他模型规格保持不变。第七种替代模型控制知识探索和知识利用的广告支出。其理由是，社交媒体能力的发展及其对知识探索和知识利用的影响可能会受到公司营销活动的影响。最后，第八种替代模型结合了第二种和第七种替代模型的模型规范，但通过乘以知识探索和知识利用来估计知识二元性。下一节介绍这八个替代模型的估计结果。
