## 4.3.1 Business Analytics Talent as Moderator between Social Media Capability and Knowledge Exploitation




## 4.3.1 商业分析人才作为社交媒体能力和知识利用之间的调节者


In the first alternative model, we assume that social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and that business analytics talent moderates both relationships (i.e., social media capability affects knowledge exploration and social media capability affects knowledge exploitation). The rationale for testing this model is that business analytics talent may enable firms to extract, monitor, and analyze unstructured existing/new knowledge to be reused, transformed, applied, and leveraged in the firm, which may reinforce the effect of social media capability on knowledge exploitation. This first alternative model yielded results similar to those obtained in the proposed model, but the moderating effect of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploitation was not significant (β = -0.476). Table 10 shows the results of this robustness model, indicating that business analytics talent does not amplify the effect of social media capability on knowledge exploitation.




在第一个替代模型中，我们假设社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，并且业务分析人才调节这两种关系（即社交媒体能力影响知识探索，社交媒体能力影响知识利用）。测试该模型的理由是，业务分析人才可以使公司能够提取、监控和分析非结构化的现有/新知识，以便在公司中重用、转换、应用和利用，这可能会加强社交媒体能力对知识利用的影响。第一个替代模型产生的结果与拟议模型中获得的结果类似，但商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识利用之间关系中的调节作用并不显着（β = -0.476）。表 10 显示了该稳健性模型的结果，表明业务分析人才不会放大社交媒体能力对知识利用的影响。

## 4.3.2 The Relationship between Social Media Capability and Knowledge Ambidexterity




## 4.3.2 社交媒体能力与知识双元化的关系


In the second alternative model, we propose that social media capability affects knowledge ambidexterity, and business analytics talent moderates the relationship between social media capability and knowledge ambidexterity. Thus, we examine the potential enabling role of social media capability on knowledge ambidexterity and the potential amplifying role of business analytics talent in this relationship. We operationalized knowledge ambidexterity as a composite first-order construct composed of two indicators: knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. Results show that the link between social media capability and knowledge ambidexterity in the baseline model (i.e., a model describing the base relationship between social media capability and knowledge ambidexterity, including all control variables and excluding business analytics talent) was positive and significant $( \beta ~ = ~ 0 . 2 8 5 , ~ p ~ < ~ 0 . 0 0 1 )$ Moreover, the moderating effect of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge ambidexterity was positive and significant $( \beta = 0 . 5 2 4 , p < 0 . 0 5 )$ . The results of this empirical analysis suggest that firms effectively using social media simultaneously explore and exploit knowledge, and that business analytics talent amplifies the impact of social media capability on knowledge ambidexterity. Table 11 presents the results of this alternative model.




在第二种替代模型中，我们提出社交媒体能力影响知识二元性，而业务分析人才调节社交媒体能力和知识二元性之间的关系。因此，我们研究了社交媒体能力对知识二元性的潜在促进作用以及商业分析人才在这种关系中的潜在放大作用。我们将知识双元性操作为由两个指标组成的复合一阶结构：知识探索和知识利用。结果表明，在基线模型（即描述社交媒体能力与知识二元性之间的基础关系的模型，包括所有控制变量且排除商业分析人才）中，社交媒体能力与知识二元性之间的联系是正向且显着的 $( \beta ~ = ~ 0 . 2 8 5 , ~ p ~ < ~ 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 此外，商业分析人才对社交媒体能力与知识之间关系的调节作用双元性为正且显着 $( beta = 0 . 5 2 4 , p < 0 . 0 5 )$ 。这一实证分析的结果表明，有效使用社交媒体的公司同时探索和利用知识，并且商业分析人才放大了社交媒体能力对知识双元性的影响。表 11 列出了该替代模型的结果。


## 4.3.3 The Relationship between Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation and Firm Performance




## 4.3.3 知识探索和知识利用与企业绩效之间的关系


In the third alternative model, we propose that social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, which affects firm performance, preserving the moderating role of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. Prior research has suggested a firm’s knowledge management activities as a source of superior firm performance (Lee et al., 2020; Tanriverdi, 2005). The ability to bring new knowledge from social media to the firm (i.e., knowledge exploration) increases the diversity and heterogeneity of the firm’s knowledge pool and the possibilities of new knowledge combinations, thus improving firm performance such as innovation performance (Katila & Ahuja, 2002). When the discovered knowledge is exploited and leveraged, the firm creates business value (e.g., converting new knowledge in product and process innovation) (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018, Lubatkin et al., 2006). In this alternative model, we operationalized firm performance in terms of financial performance, marketing performance, and innovation performance. To measure financial performance and marketing performance, we collected data from the Datastream database from 2014 to 2018. To measure innovation performance, we collected data from the US Patent and Trademark Office in the same period. The links between knowledge exploration and firm performance $( \beta = 0 . 1 4 5 , \ p < 0 . 0 5 )$ , and knowledge exploitation and firm performance $( \beta ^ { \mathrm { ~ = ~ } 0 . 2 5 6 , \mathrm { ~ } p \mathrm { ~ < ~ } }$ 0.001) are positive and significant. Therefore, the empirical analysis results for this alternative model suggest that firms effectively use social media to explore and exploit knowledge. The firm’s proficiency in exploring new knowledge and exploiting existing/new knowledge enables the firm to improve performance. Since the analysis of the effects of knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation on firm performance goes beyond the goal of this paper and has already been explored in prior IS research (e.g., Kathuria et al. 2016), we kept this model only in the robustness check. Table 12 shows the results of this alternative model.




在第三种替代模型中，我们提出社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，从而影响公司绩效，保留商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识探索之间关系中的调节作用。先前的研究表明，公司的知识管理活动是公司卓越绩效的源泉（Lee et al., 2020；Tanriverdi, 2005）。将社交媒体中的新知识引入企业的能力（即知识探索）增加了企业知识库的多样性和异质性以及新知识组合的可能性，从而提高了创新绩效等企业绩效（Katila＆Ahuja，2002）。当发现的知识被开发和利用时，公司就会创造商业价值（例如，在产品和流程创新中转化新知识）（Benitez, Ray et al., 2018; Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018; Lubatkin et al., 2006）。在这个替代模型中，我们根据财务绩效、营销绩效和创新绩效来运作公司绩效。为了衡量财务绩效和营销绩效，我们从 Datastream 数据库收集了 2014 年至 2018 年的数据。为了衡量创新绩效，我们从美国专利商标局收集了同期的数据。知识探索与企业绩效 $( \beta = 0 . 1 4 5 , \ p < 0 . 0 5 )$ 以及知识利用与企业绩效 $( \beta ^ { \mathrm { ~ = ~ } 0 . 2 5 6 , \mathrm { ~ } p \mathrm { ~ < ~ } }$ 0.001) 之间的联系是积极且显着的。因此，该替代模型的实证分析结果表明，企业有效地利用社交媒体来探索和利用知识。公司在探索新知识和利用现有/新知识方面的熟练程度使公司能够提高绩效。由于知识探索和知识利用对企业绩效影响的分析超出了本文的目标，并且已经在先前的 IS 研究中进行了探索（例如，Kathuria 等人，2016），因此我们仅在稳健性检查中保留该模型。表 12 显示了该替代模型的结果。


## 4.3.4 The Relationship between Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation




## 4.3.4 知识探索与知识利用之间的关系


In the fourth alternative model, we assume that social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and knowledge exploration affects knowledge exploitation preserving the moderating role of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. The theoretical argument to test this model is based on prior studies, suggesting that exploration enables exploitation in different contexts. Evidence supports the effect of exploration on exploitation in the context of business opportunities (Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018) and the context of mergers and acquisitions (Benitez, Ray et al., 2018). However, in the specific context of knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, in our sample of small US firms, we did not find a significant relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation $( \beta = 0 . 0 7 1 )$ . Future research should explore the relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation in firms of different sizes and geographic contexts.




在第四种替代模型中，我们假设社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，知识探索影响知识利用，从而保留商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识探索之间关系中的调节作用。测试该模型的理论论证基于先前的研究，表明探索可以在不同的背景下进行开发。有证据支持在商业机会（Benitez、Llorens 等人，2018）和并购背景下（Benitez、Ray 等人，2018）探索对剥削的影响。然而，在知识探索和知识利用的具体背景下，在我们的美国小企业样本中，我们没有发现知识探索和知识利用之间存在显着关系 $( \beta = 0 . 0 7 1 )$ 。未来的研究应该探索不同规模和地理环境的企业中知识探索和知识利用之间的关系。


## 4.3.5 Business Analytics Talent as Moderator between Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation




## 4.3.5 商业分析人才作为知识探索和知识利用之间的调节者


In the fifth alternative model, we assume that social media capability affects knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation, and knowledge exploration affects knowledge exploitation, keeping the moderator role of business analytics talent in the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration and adding a moderator role of business analytics talent in the relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation.




在第五种替代模型中，我们假设社交媒体能力影响知识探索和知识利用，知识探索影响知识利用，保留商业分析人才在社交媒体能力和知识探索关系中的调节作用，并增加商业分析人才在知识探索和知识利用关系中的调节作用。

The rationale for testing this model is that business analytics talent can be the pivotal complementary resource to move explored social media-enabled knowledge into exploited knowledge. This additional analysis might explain the lack of support for the effect of knowledge exploration on knowledge exploitation in the fourth alternative model. <sup>11</sup> However, in this alternative model, the moderating effect of business analytics talent in the relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation was not significant (β = -0.413). Future IS research should explore the relationship between knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation and the potential moderator role of business analytics talent in firms of different sizes (e.g., small European firms) and geographic contexts (e.g., Asian companies).




测试该模型的理由是，业务分析人才可以成为将探索的社交媒体知识转化为可利用知识的关键补充资源。这一额外的分析可能解释了第四种替代模型中缺乏对知识探索对知识利用的影响的支持。 <sup>11</sup> 然而，在这个替代模型中，商业分析人才对知识探索和知识利用之间关系的调节作用并不显着（β = -0.413）。未来的信息系统研究应该探讨知识探索和知识利用之间的关系，以及不同规模（例如，欧洲小公司）和地理环境（例如，亚洲公司）的企业中商业分析人才的潜在调节作用。


## 4.3.6 Model with Homogeneous Measurements for Facebook Capability, Twitter Capability, and Blog Capability




## 4.3.6 Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力同质测量模型


We are confident in the alignment between the conceptualization and measurement of social media capability, and the confirmatory composite analysis has also supported our measurements. However, there are small differences in the ingredients of Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability that can be explained by the nature of the social media platforms (e.g., number of events in Facebook capability) and the data availability (e.g., time spent writing tweets as a measure of Twitter capability). The two common and homogeneous measurements of the three social media capabilities are experience and updates. In the sixth alternative model, we measure Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability using experience and updates only—that is, using homogeneous measurements—with every other model specification kept the same. Table 13 presents the results of this alternative model. The results of this model are consistent with our hypothesis testing results and indicate that the variation in the ingredients of Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability does not affect the findings of this study.




我们对社交媒体能力的概念化和测量之间的一致性充满信心，并且验证性综合分析也支持了我们的测量。然而，Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力的构成要素存在细微差别，这可以通过社交媒体平台的性质（例如，Facebook 能力中的事件数量）和数据可用性（例如，作为 Twitter 能力衡量标准的撰写推文所花费的时间）来解释。三种社交媒体功能的两个常见且同质的衡量标准是体验和更新。在第六个替代模型中，我们仅使用经验和更新来衡量 Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力，即使用同质测量，而所有其他模型规范保持不变。表 13 列出了该替代模型的结果。该模型的结果与我们的假设检验结果一致，表明 Facebook 能力、Twitter 能力和博客能力成分的变化不会影响本研究的结果。


## 4.3.7 Model Controlling for Firm’s Advertising Spending on Knowledge Exploration and Knowledge Exploitation




## 4.3.7 企业知识探索和知识利用广告支出的模型控制


The seventh alternative model controls for firms advertising spending on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. The rationale is that the development of social media capability and its effects on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation may be affected by a firm’s marketing activities and resources. We measure the firm’s advertising spending as the firm’s average annual advertising spending for the years 2014- 2018, using information from the ORBIS database. Table 14 presents the results of this model, which suggest that, after controlling for the firm’s advertising spending, our study’s findings are consistent and robust.




第七种替代模型控制公司在知识探索和知识利用方面的广告支出。其基本原理是，社交媒体能力的发展及其对知识探索和知识利用的影响可能会受到公司营销活动和资源的影响。我们使用 ORBIS 数据库中的信息，将公司的广告支出衡量为公司 2014-2018 年的平均年度广告支出。表 14 列出了该模型的结果，这表明在控制公司的广告支出后，我们的研究结果是一致且稳健的。


## 4.3.8 Model Controlling for Firm’s Advertising Spending on Knowledge Ambidexterity




## 4.3.8 企业广告支出对知识双元性的模型控制


The eighth alternative model combines the model specifications of the second and seventh alternative models but estimates knowledge ambidexterity by multiplying knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. This ingredient specification is another alternative way to measure ambidexterity, as suggested by prior organizational ambidexterity literature. The firm’s advertising spending (control variable) was measured as in the seventh alternative model. Table 15 presents the results of the eighth alternative model. This additional analysis suggests that the construct specification of knowledge ambidexterity after controlling for advertising spending does not affect the findings of this study.




第八替代模型结合了第二和第七替代模型的模型规范，但通过乘以知识探索和知识利用来估计知识二元性。正如先前的组织双元性文献所建议的，该成分规范是衡量双元性的另一种替代方法。该公司的广告支出（控制变量）按照第七种替代模型进行测量。表 15 列出了第八种替代模型的结果。这项额外的分析表明，控制广告支出后知识二元性的构造规范不会影响本研究的结果。

## 5 Discussion and Core Conclusions




## 5 讨论和核心结论


## 5.1 Summary of Findings




## 5.1 调查结果摘要


Managing organizational knowledge is critical in increasingly competitive environments (He et al., 2015). Prior IS literature considers social media to be a key source of information and data (Leonardi, 2014). However, acquiring and generating social media data is not a sufficient condition for creating business value. Monitoring, analyzing, and identifying relevant information is key in transforming social media data into valuable information, knowledge, and business gains (Ransbotham et al., 2015). Firms face difficulties in efficiently selecting and assimilating social media data and converting them into business benefits (Chan et al., 2016). We propose that firms with social media capability can exploit and explore knowledge. Moreover, we argue that the effective application of social media data in business activities can be achieved if firms explore and exploit knowledge and leverage business analytics talent. This study analyzed the impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation and examined the potential moderator role of business analytics talent. The proposed research model was tested using a unique set of archival data from a sample of US firms. After checking eight additional alternative explanations/research models in robustness testing, we are confident that the empirical analysis strongly supports our proposed research model. <sup>12</sup>




在竞争日益激烈的环境中，管理组织知识至关重要（He et al., 2015）。先前的 IS 文献认为社交媒体是信息和数据的关键来源（Leonardi，2014）。然而，获取和生成社交媒体数据并不是创造商业价值的充分条件。监控、分析和识别相关信息是将社交媒体数据转化为有价值的信息、知识和商业收益的关键（Ransbotham 等，2015）。企业在有效选择和吸收社交媒体数据并将其转化为商业利益方面面临困难（Chan 等，2016）。我们建议具有社交媒体能力的公司可以利用和探索知识。此外，我们认为，如果企业探索和利用知识并利用商业分析人才，就可以实现社交媒体数据在商业活动中的有效应用。本研究分析了社交媒体能力对知识探索和知识利用的影响，并检验了商业分析人才的潜在调节作用。使用来自美国公司样本的一组独特的档案数据对拟议的研究模型进行了测试。在检查了稳健性测试中的八个其他替代解释/研究模型后，我们相信实证分析强烈支持我们提出的研究模型。 <sup>12</sup>


How does social media capability influence knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation? The empirical analysis results show that social media capability enables firms to explore and exploit knowledge because social media are new organizational channels capable of facilitating knowledge management (e.g., acquiring and transferring new knowledge; recombining, modifying, and integrating new/existing knowledge). Social media capability helps firms acquire knowledge from customers, competitors, and suppliers. In this way, firms can identify valuable information from suppliers, competitors, and customers and apply and leverage this useful information to achieve improvements in firm performance. Even though we find that social media capability enables both the exploration and exploitation of knowledge, the effect is greater for knowledge exploration than for knowledge exploitation, suggesting that social media plays a more important role in exploring new knowledge than in exploiting existing knowledge. Furthermore, our results show that business analytics talent amplifies the impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration by helping firms quickly create meaningful new knowledge from unstructured information. Dong and Yang (2020) find that social media diversity and big data analytics have a positive interaction effect on market performance, which is more salient for small than for large firms. Our findings are consistent with Dong and Yang’s (2020) work. We show that business analytics talent is a valuable IT resource that can help firms convert unstructured social data (captured through social media capability) into useful new knowledge to be explored, shared, and stored. In this sense, the empirical analysis supports our proposed research model.




社交媒体能力如何影响知识探索和知识利用？实证分析结果表明，社交媒体能力使企业能够探索和利用知识，因为社交媒体是能够促进知识管理（例如获取和转移新知识；重组、修改和整合新知识/现有知识）的新组织渠道。社交媒体功能帮助公司从客户、竞争对手和供应商那里获取知识。通过这种方式，公司可以识别来自供应商、竞争对手和客户的有价值的信息，并应用和利用这些有用的信息来提高公司绩效。尽管我们发现社交媒体能力既可以促进知识的探索，也可以促进知识的利用，但对知识探索的影响大于对知识利用的影响，这表明社交媒体在探索新知识方面比在利用现有知识方面发挥着更重要的作用。此外，我们的结果表明，业务分析人才可以帮助企业从非结构化信息中快速创建有意义的新知识，从而放大社交媒体功能对知识探索的影响。 Dong 和 Yang（2020）发现，社交媒体多样性和大数据分析对市场表现具有积极的交互作用，这对于小公司来说比大公司更为显着。我们的研究结果与 Dong 和 Yang (2020) 的工作一致。我们表明，业务分析人才是一种宝贵的 IT 资源，可以帮助企业将非结构化社交数据（通过社交媒体功能捕获）转换为可供探索、共享和存储的有用新知识。从这个意义上说，实证分析支持了我们提出的研究模型。


Based on our robustness testing, we obtained additional results regarding how knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation (driven by social media capability and amplified by business analytics talent) affect firm performance. Both exploration and exploitation have been found to help firms increase their business benefits. Organizational knowledge is a resource that is difficult to imitate and may be a source of competitive advantage (Alavi & Leidner, 2001). As an illustrative example of the role of social media and knowledge management in improving firm performance, Dell created a social media platform (http://ww.ideastorm.com/) to acquire and exploit social data from their customers that enabled their customers to submit ideas, vote for other ideas, and comment on the ideas of other customers. Dell managed customers’ data to implement the best ideas (e.g., biodegradable packing material), which led to improved firm performance. This shows how effective exploration and exploitation of knowledge can provide an excellent return on firm investment (Dong & Wu, 2015). Indeed, our results suggest that knowledge exploitation has a greater effect on firm performance than knowledge exploration, which is rational and consistent with prior IS research (Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018). The acquisition and creation of new knowledge are related to sensing new business opportunities (Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018; Cui et al., 2019) and affect firm performance. However, the biggest effect on firm performance is realized once the company assimilates, uses, and exploits the knowledge related to the exploitation of business opportunities. Therefore, it is rational to expect that the effect on firm performance of using, leveraging, and applying knowledge (knowledge exploitation) is greater than the creation, sharing, and storage of knowledge (knowledge exploration).




根据我们的稳健性测试，我们获得了关于知识探索和知识利用（由社交媒体能力驱动并由业务分析人才放大）如何影响公司绩效的额外结果。人们发现勘探和开采都可以帮助公司增加商业利益。组织知识是一种难以模仿的资源，并且可能是竞争优势的来源（Alavi＆Leidner，2001）。作为社交媒体和知识管理在提高公司绩效方面的作用的一个说明性例子，戴尔创建了一个社交媒体平台（http://ww.ideastorm.com/）来获取和利用来自客户的社交数据，使客户能够提交想法、投票支持其他想法以及评论其他客户的想法。戴尔管理客户的数据以实施最佳创意（例如可生物降解的包装材料），从而提高了公司业绩。这表明有效的知识探索和利用可以为公司投资提供丰厚的回报（Dong & Wu，2015）。事实上，我们的研究结果表明，知识利用比知识探索对企业绩效的影响更大，这是合理的，并且与之前的信息系统研究一致（Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018）。新知识的获取和创造与感知新商机有关（Benitez, Llorens et al., 2018；Cui et al., 2019）并影响企业绩效。然而，一旦公司吸收、使用和利用与利用商机相关的知识，就会对公司绩效产生最大的影响。因此，可以合理地预期，使用、利用和应用知识（知识开发）对企业绩效的影响大于知识的创造、共享和存储（知识探索）。


## 5.2 Key Contributions to IS Research




## 5.2 对信息系统研究的主要贡献


This study draws on IS literature on knowledge management and the business value of social media to link social media capability and firms’ knowledge exploration and knowledge exploitation. This paper contributes to IS research in three ways. First, although the crucial challenge for organizations is to learn how they can develop the ability to effectively select, use, and leverage external social media in order to scan, learn, and internalize knowledge, it remains rather unclear how companies can develop social media capabilities and create business value based on these capabilities. Prior IS research has largely focused on understanding employees’ knowledge sharing behavior in enterprise social media (e.g., Beck et al., 2014; Leonardi), user-generated content, and customer engagement in diffusing information on social media platforms (e.g., Bapna et al., 2019). In contrast to prior IS research on this topic, which has emphasized the employee, customer, and user as units of analysis, we focus on the organizational level. We develop the concept of social media capability, explain it theoretically, provide a set of measures that can be built with archival data, and offer empirical evidence on how firms can explore and exploit knowledge from social media. This is the primary contribution of this manuscript to IS research.




本研究借鉴了有关知识管理和社交媒体商业价值的信息系统文献，将社交媒体能力与企业的知识探索和知识利用联系起来。本文从三个方面对信息系统研究做出了贡献。首先，尽管组织面临的关键挑战是了解如何发展有效选择、使用和利用外部社交媒体的能力，以扫描、学习和内化知识，但公司如何发展社交媒体能力并基于这些能力创造商业价值仍然相当不清楚。之前的信息系统研究主要集中在了解员工在企业社交媒体中的知识共享行为（例如，Beck 等人，2014；Leonardi）、用户生成的内容以及客户在社交媒体平台上传播信息的参与度（例如，Bapna 等人，2019）。与之前关于该主题的信息系统研究强调将员工、客户和用户作为分析单位相比，我们专注于组织层面。我们提出了社交媒体能力的概念，从理论上对其进行了解释，提供了一套可以利用档案数据构建的衡量标准，并提供了企业如何探索和利用社交媒体知识的经验证据。这是本文对信息系统研究的主要贡献。


Second, although a firm’s business analytics talent may perform a critical role in understanding and acquiring new knowledge from big data on customers in social media, this plausible effect has been undertheorized in IS research. Prior IS research has focused mainly on the impact of big data analytics capability on competitive performance (Mikalef et al., 2020) and on its reinforcing role to create synergies and improve market performance (Dong & Yang, 2020). We believe that the extant literature overemphasizes the importance of analytics software and minimizes the significance of people and analytics talent (Conboy et al., 2020). Drawing on Ransbotham et al.’s (2015) managerial paper, we develop the concept and measure of business analytics talent and show how this resource reinforces the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. This study suggests that business analytics talent is a complementary resource of social media capability since they mutually reinforce each other in that the presence of business analytics talent amplifies the impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration. Thus, business analytics talent enables firms to better explore new knowledge derived from external social media. We also propose and build a measure of business analytics talent supported by empirical analysis, which can be used in future impactful IS research. This represents our second major contribution to IS research.




其次，尽管公司的业务分析人才可能在理解和从社交媒体中的客户大数据中获取新知识方面发挥着关键作用，但这种看似合理的效应在信息系统研究中并未得到充分的理论化。之前的信息系统研究主要关注大数据分析能力对竞争绩效的影响（Mikalef 等人，2020）及其在创造协同效应和提高市场绩效方面的强化作用（Dong & Yang，2020）。我们认为，现有文献过分强调了分析软件的重要性，而最小化了人员和分析人才的重要性（Conboy 等人，2020）。借鉴 Ransbotham 等人 (2015) 的管理论文，我们开发了商业分析人才的概念和衡量标准，并展示了该资源如何加强社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系。这项研究表明，商业分析人才是社交媒体能力的补充资源，因为它们相互促进，商业分析人才的存在放大了社交媒体能力对知识探索的影响。因此，商业分析人才使企业能够更好地探索来自外部社交媒体的新知识。我们还提出并建立了一个由实证分析支持的商业分析人才衡量标准，可用于未来有影响力的信息系统研究。这是我们对信息系统研究的第二个重大贡献。


Finally, our study confirmed the proposed research model with consistent estimates, using the PLS estimator and the ADANCO software statistical package. Both IS research and PLS path modeling require the usage of the most up-to-date statistical standards. Using ADANCO, this paper illustrates how to run a confirmatory composite analysis to confirm that the structure of measures is correct. Beyond this, it demonstrated how to evaluate whether the proposed research model is correct by evaluating the overall fit of the estimated model. We integrate this into the eight alternative models that are included in our robustness testing. Our third contribution to IS research is our introduction of the ADANCO software package, our recommendation of its use for future confirmatory IS research, and our illustration of its use in a study on the business value of social media capability.




最后，我们的研究使用 PLS 估计器和 ADANCO 统计软件包证实了所提出的研究模型具有一致的估计。 IS 研究和 PLS 路径建模都需要使用最新的统计标准。本文使用 ADANCO 说明了如何运行验证性复合分析来确认措施结构的正确性。除此之外，它还演示了如何通过评估估计模型的整体拟合来评估所提出的研究模型是否正确。我们将其集成到稳健性测试中包含的八个替代模型中。我们对 IS 研究的第三个贡献是我们引入了 ADANCO 软件包，我们建议将其用于未来验证性 IS 研究，并说明其在社交媒体功能商业价值研究中的使用。


## 5.3 Limitations and Avenues for Future IS Research




## 5.3 未来信息系统研究的局限性和途径


This paper also has some limitations, which also suggest excellent avenues for further IS research. First, these results can only be generalized to small firms in the US market. Future IS research could investigate whether the proposed research model is also supported in different geographic markets and larger companies. Second, we restricted our focus to a limited number of external social media platforms. This approach implies that the effects explored by this study on knowledge exploration and exploitation can only be associated with firms’ external social media. Although we examined three of the most popular external social media platforms (Braojos et al., 2019; Culnan et al., 2010), our research does not explore enterprise/internal social media platforms (e.g., Microsoft Yammer, Facebook Workplace) and other important external social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, LinkedIn). Moreover, cultural differences may influence how firms leverage social media capability and business analytics talent. We encourage IS scholars to investigate these potential differences in future IS studies. For instance, exploring how the external social media platforms used by Chinese firms (e.g., WeChat) and the digital ecosystem of Chinese firms/customers are different from those used by US firms/customers could be an interesting topic for future impactful IS research. Further, IS research could extend this study by examining enterprise social media platforms and other new external social media platforms and including them in conceptualizing social media capability. Third, we are confident that the ingredients used to assess Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability represent a good proxy to evaluate these constructs, which has also been supported by the confirmatory composite analysis. However, we recognize that our measurements of these constructs may present some “noise” between the conceptualization and the measurements, which is typical when a study uses secondary data. Future IS research could develop perceptual measures for social media capability and validate them through a confirmatory composite/factor analysis, which would offer a valuable means of replicating our study results.




本文也有一些局限性，这也为进一步的信息系统研究提供了很好的途径。首先，这些结果只能推广到美国市场的小企业。未来的信息系统研究可以调查所提出的研究模型是否也得到不同地理市场和大公司的支持。其次，我们将注意力集中在有限的外部社交媒体平台上。 This approach implies that the effects explored by this study on knowledge exploration and exploitation can only be associated with firms’ external social media.尽管我们研究了三个最受欢迎的外部社交媒体平台（Braojos 等人，2019 年；Culnan 等人，2010 年），但我们的研究并未探讨企业/内部社交媒体平台（例如 Microsoft Yammer、Facebook Workplace）和其他重要的外部社交媒体平台（例如 Instagram、LinkedIn）。此外，文化差异可能会影响公司如何利用社交媒体能力和业务分析人才。我们鼓励信息系统学者在未来的信息系统研究中调查这些潜在的差异。 For instance, exploring how the external social media platforms used by Chinese firms (e.g., WeChat) and the digital ecosystem of Chinese firms/customers are different from those used by US firms/customers could be an interesting topic for future impactful IS research. Further, IS research could extend this study by examining enterprise social media platforms and other new external social media platforms and including them in conceptualizing social media capability. Third, we are confident that the ingredients used to assess Facebook capability, Twitter capability, and blog capability represent a good proxy to evaluate these constructs, which has also been supported by the confirmatory composite analysis. However, we recognize that our measurements of these constructs may present some “noise” between the conceptualization and the measurements, which is typical when a study uses secondary data. Future IS research could develop perceptual measures for social media capability and validate them through a confirmatory composite/factor analysis, which would offer a valuable means of replicating our study results.


Fourth, the development of social media capability and its exploitation to create business value may be contingent on the firm’s social media governance mechanisms. How could the firm’s governance structure best maximize the value creation from social media? Future IS research could theorize and empirically examine the effects of social media governance mechanisms on social media’s business value. This seems an excellent research topic to explore in future IS research. Fifth, we found a greater effect of social media capability on knowledge exploration than on knowledge exploitation, which offers an opportunity for future research to theorize on moderators of the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploitation that firms may need, and organizational capabilities that could mediate this relationship. We encourage IS scholars interested in this research topic to theorize and investigate organizational capabilities that can exploit existing knowledge. Finally, this study conceptualizes and finds discriminant validity between social media capability and business analytics talent. However, some IS scholars may consider these concepts to be closely related or even part of each other if they focus on a more general concept such as IT-enabled information management capability. We thus call for further knowledge discovery to address this debate, which represents another exciting avenue for IS research.




第四，社交媒体能力的发展及其利用其创造商业价值可能取决于公司的社交媒体治理机制。公司的治理结构如何才能最好地最大化社交媒体的价值创造？未来的信息系统研究可以从理论上和实证上检验社交媒体治理机制对社交媒体商业价值的影响。这似乎是未来信息系统研究中值得探索的一个极好的研究课题。第五，我们发现社交媒体能力对知识探索的影响比对知识利用的影响更大，这为未来的研究提供了机会，对社交媒体能力和企业可能需要的知识利用之间关系的调节因素以及可以调解这种关系的组织能力进行理论化。我们鼓励对这一研究主题感兴趣的信息系统学者对可以利用现有知识的组织能力进行理论化和研究。最后，本研究概念化并发现了社交媒体能力和业务分析人才之间的区分有效性。然而，如果一些IS学者关注更普遍的概念，例如IT支持的信息管理能力，他们可能会认为这些概念是密切相关的，甚至是彼此的一部分。因此，我们呼吁进一步的知识发现来解决这一争论，这代表了信息系统研究的另一个令人兴奋的途径。


Nevertheless, this paper has the capacity to change some of the existing paradigms in IS research in two directions. The first potential change is methodological. The current scenario of IS research provides us with the opportunity to build innovative datasets and search for confirmatory IS research. We hope this study inspires other IS scholars to use our secondary data-based measurements and test their consistency and adequacy through an overall fit evaluation of the saturated model. This study also shows that IS research can confirm the proposed research model through the estimated model’s overall fit evaluation. We introduce the ADANCO software package, explain when it could be used, and illustrate how to use it for confirmatory IS research in the research stream of the business value of IT.




尽管如此，本文有能力在两个方向上改变信息系统研究中的一些现有范式。第一个潜在的变化是方法上的。当前 IS 研究的情况为我们提供了构建创新数据集和搜索验证性 IS 研究的机会。我们希望这项研究能够激励其他 IS 学者使用我们基于二次数据的测量方法，并通过饱和模型的整体拟合评估来测试其一致性和充分性。本研究还表明IS研究可以通过估计模型的整体拟合评估来确认所提出的研究模型。我们介绍 ADANCO 软件包，解释何时可以使用它，并说明如何将其用于 IT 商业价值研究流中的验证性 IS 研究。


The second potential change is related to digital capabilities. The design and execution of digital transformation strategies have become “a must” for companies. This strategic imperative has been accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. In the future, exploring new digital resources will require new digital capabilities for firms. These new digital capabilities (e.g., leveraging artificial intelligence, 5G, blockchain) have the capacity to serve business activities and maximize business benefits. However, many of these new digital capabilities will need to be conceptualized and tested empirically in isolation from prior IT capabilities, as was done in this study with social media capability and business analytics talent. We hope this paper inspires others in this direction. In the words of Coco Channel, “I do not do fashion. I am fashion”; similarly, IS research does not do fashionable research, IS research is fashion. Future paradigms in IS research may involve “unframed thinking.” Who wishes to take up this challenge?




第二个潜在的变化与数字能力有关。数字化转型战略的设计和执行已成为企业的“必须”。 COVID-19 大流行加速了这一战略要务。未来，探索新的数字资源需要企业新的数字化能力。这些新的数字能力（例如利用人工智能、5G、区块链）有能力服务于商业活动并最大化商业利益。然而，许多新的数字能力需要独立于先前的 IT 能力进行概念化和实证测试，正如本研究中针对社交媒体能力和业务分析人才所做的那样。我们希望这篇论文能够在这个方向上启发其他人。用Coco Channel的话说，“我不做时尚，我就是时尚”；同样，IS研究不是时尚研究，IS研究是时尚。信息系统研究的未来范式可能涉及“无框架思维”。谁愿意接受这个挑战？


## 5.4 Key Lessons Learned for IT and Business Executives




## 5.4 IT 和业务主管的重要经验教训


The findings of this study also provide important lessons learned for IT and business executives. First, developing social media capability enables firms to explore and exploit knowledge. Executives should be aware of the potential benefits associated with the usage of external social media to acquire customer, competitor, and supplier data. Companies can also use social media to promote their products and initiatives to collect valuable opinions, preferences, suggestions for improvement, ideas from customers and suppliers, and competitor’s strategic information. Social media can also be leveraged to co-create knowledge with customers and suppliers. Thus, this study suggests that managers should invest, deploy, and leverage social media to acquire and exploit knowledge. For example, Grupo Expansion (a leading Mexican communication industry holding) has the capacity to use external social media (e.g., Facebook, Twitter) to reach potential customers, run marketing campaigns, and acquire knowledge from current customers and competitors, thus enabling the exploration of new knowledge (Hootsuite, 2020b).




这项研究的结果还为 IT 和业务主管提供了重要的经验教训。首先，发展社交媒体能力使企业能够探索和利用知识。高管应该意识到使用外部社交媒体获取客户、竞争对手和供应商数据的潜在好处。公司还可以利用社交媒体来推广其产品和举措，以收集有价值的意见、偏好、改进建议、客户和供应商的想法以及竞争对手的战略信息。还可以利用社交媒体与客户和供应商共同创造知识。因此，这项研究建议管理者应该投资、部署和利用社交媒体来获取和利用知识。例如，Grupo Expansion（墨西哥领先的通信行业控股公司）有能力使用外部社交媒体（例如 Facebook、Twitter）来接触潜在客户、开展营销活动并从现有客户和竞争对手那里获取知识，从而能够探索新知识（Hootsuite，2020b）。


Second, firms can amplify the impact of social media capability on knowledge exploration if they recruit, develop, and retain business analytics talent. This study shows evidence of strategies that can be deployed to win the war for top tech talent. Executives should be aware of the importance of employing specialized business analytics experts, keeping in mind the expected shortage of this market talent. Since business analytics talent is scarce, companies should go the extra mile to attract, retain, and develop such talent (e.g., by developing an outstanding employer branding) and be willing to train those with high potential. Firms with high levels of business analytics talent are in a position to benefit more from social media since social media capability and business analytics talent reinforce each other to attain better knowledge exploration. The new knowledge created and captured today will constitute the base of the firm’s future exploitation activities, which will help to ensure the future survival of the firm. Grupo Expansion also uses business analytics talent to convert external social media data into useful new knowledge. They use Hootsuite Analytics to assess social media metrics (e.g., number of followers and clicks, customer engagement) to better create content and acquire customer knowledge. Andrea Sanchez, the senior specialist of digital products of Grupo Expansion, made the following statement, which is consistent with our findings: “Analytics helps our team to convert data into useful information and specific recommendations. Our digital team can make strategic decisions based on business intelligence, and we are obtaining business benefits” (Hootsuite, 2020b, p. 3).




其次，如果企业招聘、培养和留住商业分析人才，就可以放大社交媒体能力对知识探索的影响。这项研究展示了可以采取的策略来赢得顶尖科技人才争夺战的证据。高管们应该意识到聘请专业业务分析专家的重要性，并牢记该市场人才的预期短缺。由于商业分析人才稀缺，公司应该付出更多努力来吸引、留住和培养此类人才（例如，通过建立杰出的雇主品牌），并愿意培训具有高潜力的人才。拥有高水平商业分析人才的公司能够从社交媒体中获益更多，因为社交媒体能力和商业分析人才相互促进，以实现更好的知识探索。今天创造和获取的新知识将构成公司未来开发活动的基础，这将有助于确保公司未来的生存。 Grupo Expansion 还利用业务分析人才将外部社交媒体数据转化为有用的新知识。他们使用 Hootsuite Analytics 来评估社交媒体指标（例如关注者和点击数量、客户参与度），以更好地创建内容并获取客户知识。 Grupo Expansion 数字产品高级专家 Andrea Sanchez 发表了以下声明，这与我们的发现一致：“分析帮助我们的团队将数据转换为有用的信息和具体建议。我们的数字团队可以根据商业智能做出战略决策，我们正在获得商业利益”（Hootsuite，2020b，第 3 页）。


## 5.5 Core Conclusions




## 5.5 核心结论


Social media are disruptive IT resources that can transform firms digitally, build a seamless digital business strategy, and help ensure firms’ long-term survival in the digital disruption era. This paper proposes a research model on social media capability, knowledge exploration, knowledge exploitation, and business analytics talent, finding that social media capability enables firms to explore new knowledge and exploit existing knowledge. We also discovered that business analytics talent reinforces the relationship between social media capability and knowledge exploration. Although social media data have become a gold mine for business intelligence, companies need business analytics talent to reveal useful new knowledge. By drawing on the lens of knowledge exploration and exploitation and business analytics talent, we offer a new theoretical explanation and empirical evidence to the IS research community by investigating social media’s business value through knowledge exploration and exploitation. Of course, IT does matter. Quo Vadis? (Palvia et al., 2020).




社交媒体是颠覆性的 IT 资源，可以对企业进行数字化转型，构建无缝的数字业务战略，并帮助确保企业在数字颠覆时代的长期生存。本文提出了一个关于社交媒体能力、知识探索、知识利用和商业分析人才的研究模型，发现社交媒体能力使企业能够探索新知识和利用现有知识。我们还发现，商业分析人才加强了社交媒体能力和知识探索之间的关系。尽管社交媒体数据已成为商业智能的金矿，但公司需要商业分析人才来揭示有用的新知识。通过利用知识探索和利用以及商业分析人才的视角，我们通过知识探索和利用来调查社交媒体的商业价值，为信息系统研究界提供新的理论解释和实证证据。当然，IT 确实很重要。瓦迪斯？ （帕尔维亚等人，2020）。

To create this table, we followed the following procedure. We ran a search by topics in the Web of Science, including selecting multiple keywords: social media, social networking, Facebook, Twitter, blogs, knowledge management, knowledge exchange, exploration, and exploitation. We filtered the results focusing on the most reputable journals in IS and other academic disciplines. The following academic IS journals were especially considered: MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, Journal of Management Information Systems, European Journal of Information Systems, Information Systems Journal, Journal of Information Technology, Journal of Strategic Information Systems, Information &amp; Management, and Decision Support Systems. Our list of leading journals also included top managerial IS journals (e.g., MIT Sloan Management Review) and top journals in strategy and organizational theory (e.g., Strategic Management Journal, Organization Science). After that, we read the abstract of the papers' potential list to select the papers to read, use, and reference. The final selection of relevant prior research on social media and knowledge management was included in Table A1 or referenced in our study's theoretical arguments.</td></tr></table>

## About the Authors




## 关于作者


Ana Castillo is an assistant professor of IS at the School of Business and Economics, University of Granada, Granada, Spain. Her research interests cover how firms leverage social media capabilities to transform business activities and improve firm performance. She holds a PhD in business administration (with a concentration in IS) from the University of Granada, Spain. Her research has been published in the Journal of the Association for Information Systems, Decision Support Systems, and Information & Management. She has presented her research at the Academy of Management Annual Meeting, European Conference on Information Systems, Americas Conference on Information Systems, and Pacific Asia Conference on Information Systems.




Ana Castillo 是西班牙格拉纳达格拉纳达大学商业与经济学院 IS 助理教授。她的研究兴趣包括企业如何利用社交媒体功能来转变业务活动并提高企业绩效。她拥有西班牙格拉纳达大学工商管理博士学位（主修信息系统）。她的研究成果发表在《信息系统协会杂志》、《决策支持系统》和《信息与管理》上。她曾在管理学院年会、欧洲信息系统会议、美洲信息系统会议和亚太信息系统会议上发表过她的研究成果。


Jose Benitez is a full professor of management information systems at EDHEC Business School, Lille, and Paris, France. Previously, Jose held senior faculty member and academic leadership positions at Rennes School of Business (Rennes, France) and the University of Granada (Granada, Spain). His research interests cover the study of how firms design and execute digitally driven business transformation initiatives to improve firm performance and the development of quantitative research methods in the field of IS. His research has been published in top IS journals such as MIS Quarterly, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, European Journal of Information Systems, Journal of Information Technology, Information & Management, Decision Support Systems, Decision Sciences, and Journal of Business Research. He currently serves as senior editor of the European Journal of Information Systems and Decision Support Systems and associate editor for the Journal of the Association for Information Systems and Information & Management. Jose has served as Guest Editor of Decision Sciences. Jose's engagement with the IS discipline has been recognized, designating him as an Association for Information Systems Distinguished Member Cum Laude.




Jose Benitez 是法国里尔和巴黎 EDHEC 商学院的管理信息系统正教授。此前，何塞曾在雷恩商学院（法国雷恩）和格拉纳达大学（西班牙格拉纳达）担任高级教员和学术领导职务。他的研究兴趣包括研究企业如何设计和执行数字驱动的业务转型计划以提高企业绩效以及信息系统领域定量研究方法的开发。他的研究成果发表在顶级 IS 期刊上，例如 MIS Quarterly、Journal of the Association for Information Systems、European Journal of Information Systems、Journal of Information Technology、Information & Management、Decision Support Systems、Decision Sciences 和 Journal of Business Research。他目前担任《欧洲信息系统和决策支持系统杂志》的高级编辑以及《信息系统协会杂志》和《信息与管理》的副主编。何塞曾担任《决策科学》的客座编辑。 Jose 对 IS 学科的参与得到了认可，并指定他为信息系统协会杰出会员（Cum Laude）。


Javier Llorens is a full professor of operations management at the University of Granada, Granada, Spain. His work has been published in top operations management and IS journals such as Journal of Operations Management, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, Decision Support Systems, Information & Management, International Journal of Operations & Production Management, International Journal of Production Economics, Omega-International Journal of Management Science, British Journal of Management, European Journal of Operational Research, International Journal of Production Research, and Supply Chain Management-An International Journal.




哈维尔·洛伦斯 (Javier Llorens) 是西班牙格拉纳达格拉纳达大学运营管理学正教授。他的研究成果发表在顶级运营管理和信息系统期刊上，如《Journal of Operations Management》、《Journal of the Association for Information Systems》、《Decision Support Systems》、《Information & Management》、《International Journal of Operations & Production Management》、《International Journal of Production Economics》、《Omega-International Journal of Management Science》、《British Journal of Management》、《European Journal of Operations Research》、《International Journal of Production Research》和《Supply Chain Management-An International Journal》。


Jessica Braojos is an associate professor of IS at the IQS School of Management of Ramon Llull University, Barcelona, Spain. She holds a PhD in business administration (with a concentration in IS) from the University of Granada, Granada, Spain. Jessica’s research interests cover how firms can select and leverage social media to create and capture business value. Her research has been published in Journal of the Association for Information Systems, Information & Management, Journal of Business Research, International Journal of Information Management, and International Journal of Hospitality Management, and presented in top conferences such as the Academy of Management Annual Meeting, Americas Conference on Information Systems, Pacific Asia Conference on Information Systems, and the Annual Conference of the European Decision Sciences Institute.




Jessica Braojos 是西班牙巴塞罗那 Ramon Llull 大学 IQS 管理学院 IS 副教授。她拥有西班牙格拉纳达格拉纳达大学工商管理博士学位（主修信息系统）。杰西卡的研究兴趣包括企业如何选择和利用社交媒体来创造和获取商业价值。她的研究成果发表在《Journal of the Association for Information Systems》、《Information & Management》、《Journal of Business Research》、《International Journal of Information Management》和《International Journal of Hospitality Management》上，并在管理学会年会、美洲信息系统会议、亚太信息系统会议和欧洲决策科学研究所年会等顶级会议上发表。

# The Impact of Feature Exploitation and Exploration on Mobile Application Evolution and Success




# 功能开发和探索对移动应用程序演进和成功的影响


Shadi Shuraida,<sup>1</sup> Qiang Gao,<sup>2</sup> Hani Safadi,<sup>3</sup> Radhika Jain<sup>4</sup>
