## Abstract




＃＃ 抽象的


Mobile device applications are the largest segment of IS with an estimated 5 billion users. Yet despite their widespread and growing use, there is little research examining how these mobile applications evolve with each new release update. To ensure market success, developers need to satisfy their user base by incorporating users’ reviews and feedback on the one hand and exploring new features and content that allow them to stay competitive on the other. Drawing on the organizational learning and innovation literature, the findings of the present study suggest that a mix of these two activities of exploitation and exploration in consequent app updates is likely to result in the app’s success. We further contribute to this body of work by examining the influence of users’ online review characteristics on exploitation and exploration activities in app development. The findings suggest that users’ convergence on similar issues (review concurrence) is likely to favor an orientation prioritizing exploitation over exploration activities, while the number of user reviews (review volume) has a curvilinear relationship with it.




移动设备应用程序是信息系统的最大部分，估计有 50 亿用户。然而，尽管它们的使用广泛且不断增长，但很少有研究研究这些移动应用程序如何随着每个新版本的更新而演变。为了确保市场成功，开发者需要一方面整合用户的评论和反馈，另一方面探索新的功能和内容以保持竞争力，从而满足用户群的需求。根据组织学习和创新文献，本研究的结果表明，在随后的应用程序更新中结合利用和探索这两种活动可能会导致应用程序的成功。我们通过研究用户在线评论特征对应用程序开发中的利用和探索活动的影响，进一步为这项工作做出贡献。研究结果表明，用户在类似问题上的趋同（评论并发度）可能倾向于优先考虑开发活动而不是探索活动，而用户评论数量（评论量）与之呈曲线关系。


Keywords: Mobile Application Development, Mobile Application Evolution, Online User Reviews, Technological Innovation, Exploitation, Exploration




关键词：移动应用开发、移动应用演化、在线用户评论、技术创新、开发、探索


Giri Tayi was the accepting senior editor. This research article was submitted on December 20, 2021 and underwent four revisions.




Giri Tayi 是接受高级编辑。该研究文章于2021年12月20日提交，历经四次修改。


## 1 Introduction




## 1 简介


In mobile platform ecosystems, app evolution is defined as the system’s adaptability to serve new purposes and exploit emerging possibilities (de Weck et al., 2011). App evolution is characterized by a low development cost and high imitation rate (Wang et al., 2018) and often takes place in an extreme environment characterized by “compressed development schedules, emerging technologies, criticality of performance, [and] insufficient requirements specifications” (Bragge & Merisalo-Rantanen, 2002, p. 197), leading to short app revision cycles often measured in days. While the majority of top free apps in the Google Play




在移动平台生态系统中，应用程序进化被定义为系统服务于新目的和利用新兴可能性的适应性（de Weck 等，2011）。应用程序演进的特点是开发成本低、模仿率高（Wang et al., 2018），并且经常发生在以“压缩开发进度、新兴技术、性能关键性、[和]需求规范不足”为特征的极端环境中（Bragge & Merisalo-Rantanen, 2002, p. 197），导致应用程序修订周期短，通常以天为单位。虽然 Google Play 中的大多数顶级免费应用程序


Store are updated every six weeks (Yang et al., 2022), many app developers often release daily updates of their applications (Openja et al., 2020). Previous empirical studies have found that frequent faster version updates that respond to users’ feedback have a significant impact on their apps’ quality and market success (Allon et al., 2022; Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015; Lee & Raghu, 2014; Palomba et al., 2018; Soh & Grover, 2020; Tiwana, 2015; Zhou et al., 2018). However, besides the speed and frequency of updates, a less studied aspect that defines the evolution of mobile apps is the content of the update itself, i.e., how the app’s features change from one update to the next.




商店每六周更新一次（Yang 等人，2022），许多应用程序开发人员经常发布其应用程序的每日更新（Openja 等人，2020）。先前的实证研究发现，响应用户反馈的频繁、更快的版本更新对其应用程序的质量和市场成功具有重大影响（Allon et al., 2022; Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015; Lee & Raghu, 2014; Palomba et al., 2018; Soh & Grover, 2020; Tiwana, 2015; Zhou et al., 2018）。然而，除了更新的速度和频率之外，定义移动应用程序演变的一个较少研究的方面是更新本身的内容，即应用程序的功能如何从一次更新到下一次更新。


In the competitive environment of mobile app development, developers need to make constant decisions about how to evolve their apps with each update release. This is no simple feat given that the design landscape for mobile apps is immense (Brunswicker et al., 2019) with near-infinite possibilities of features that developers can incorporate (Boudreau, 2012). The previous literature suggests that the majority of developers draw on users’ online reviews as a rich source of information to evolve their apps (Palomba et al., 2018), and that responding to these reviews increases the app’s market success (Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). Such an approach is consistent with traditional IS development approaches that emphasize meeting users’ requirements (Fernandez et al., 2017).




在移动应用程序开发的竞争环境中，开发人员需要不断决定如何在每次更新版本中改进其应用程序。鉴于移动应用程序的设计前景广阔（Brunswicker 等人，2019 年），开发人员可以融入近乎无限的功能可能性（Boudreau，2012 年），这绝非易事。之前的文献表明，大多数开发者利用用户的在线评论作为丰富的信息来源来改进他们的应用程序（Palomba 等人，2018），并且对这些评论的回应会增加应用程序的市场成功（Palomba 等人，2018；Zhou 等人，2018）。这种方法与强调满足用户需求的传统 IS 开发方法一致（Fernandez 等，2017）。


On the other hand, app development remains a creative endeavor in which developers must often experiment with novel features that differ substantively from existing features to differentiate their apps from rival offerings (Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015; Boudreau, 2012; McIlroy et al., 2016; Reeck et al., 2023; Soh & Grover, 2022) and explore opportunities to expand beyond their existing user base. To do so, app developers rely on various internal (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013) and external sources for evolving their apps (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Liu et al, 2023; Tiwana, 2015). Yet the outcome of such experimentation with novel features that users did not ask for is often uncertain in terms of the app’s success (Boudreau, 2012).




另一方面，应用程序开发仍然是一项创造性的工作，开发人员必须经常尝试与现有功能有本质区别的新颖功能，以将其应用程序与竞争对手的产品区分开来（Agarwal & Tiwana，2015；Boudreau，2012；McIlroy 等人，2016；Reeck 等人，2023；Soh & Grover，2022），并探索扩大现有用户群的机会。为此，应用程序开发人员依赖各种内部（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021；Pagano & Bruegge，2013）和外部资源来发展他们的应用程序（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021；Liu 等人，2023；Tiwana，2015）。然而，就应用程序的成功而言，这种对用户未要求的新颖功能进行实验的结果往往是不确定的（Boudreau，2012）。


While a focus on exploitative activities such as incorporating user-driven stated features is likely to increase app quality and market return, it may also stifle the introduction of innovative features that are necessary for adaptation and differentiation from rivals (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Andriopoulos & Lewis, 2009; Levinthal & March, 1993). Hence, app developers need to divide their limited attention and resources between two activities: the first is the directed search to leverage and exploit the existing knowledge reflected by users’ reviews, and the second is exploration reflected by experimentation with new content and features (Benner & Tushman, 2002; McGrath, 2001, p. 118). However, little research has examined how app developers navigate between exploitation and exploration activities and how this impacts their app’s success.




虽然关注开发活动（例如合并用户驱动的既定功能）可能会提高应用程序质量和市场回报，但它也可能会抑制创新功能的引入，而这些创新功能是适应和区别于竞争对手所必需的（Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Andriopoulos & Lewis, 2009; Levinthal & March, 1993）。因此，应用程序开发人员需要将有限的注意力和资源分配给两项活动：第一个是定向搜索，以利用和利用用户评论所反映的现有知识，第二个是通过新内容和功能的实验来反映的探索（Benner & Tushman，2002；McGrath，2001，第 118 页）。然而，很少有研究探讨应用程序开发人员如何在利用和探索活动之间进行导航，以及这如何影响他们的应用程序的成功。


The present study fills this research gap by examining the dynamics of exploitation and exploration activities within the rapidly evolving and highly competitive mobile app development environment. More specifically, it addresses the following research questions: (1) What is the impact of developers’ exploitation and exploration activities on mobile app success? (2) What is the role of users’ review feedback on developers’ exploitation and exploration activities? To address the first question, we draw on the organizational learning and innovation literature (March, 1991) to propose that developers’ mix of exploitation and exploration activities positively impacts an app’s success. We then draw on the information processing literature (Simon, 1956, 1973) and propose two user review characteristics that influence developers’ exploitation and exploration app development activities. The first is (1) review concurrence, which is the magnitude of users convergence on similar issues, and the second is (2) review volume, which is the number of different reviews following an app release. The proposed research model was tested and validated using a dataset of 1,046,553 online user reviews of 119 apps.




本研究通过研究快速发展和竞争激烈的移动应用程序开发环境中开发和探索活动的动态来填补这一研究空白。更具体地说，它解决了以下研究问题：（1）开发者的开发和探索活动对移动应用程序成功有何影响？ （2）用户的评论反馈对于开发者的开发探索活动有什么作用？为了解决第一个问题，我们借鉴组织学习和创新文献（1991 年 3 月）提出，开发人员的开发和探索活动的结合会对应用程序的成功产生积极影响。然后，我们借鉴信息处理文献（Simon，1956，1973）并提出了两个影响开发人员利用和探索应用程序开发活动的用户评论特征。第一个是（1）评论并发度，这是用户在类似问题上趋同的程度，第二个是（2）评论量，这是应用程序发布后不同评论的数量。所提出的研究模型使用包含 119 个应用程序的 1,046,553 条在线用户评论的数据集进行了测试和验证。


## 2 Theory Development




## 2 理论发展


Continuous development is essential for apps’ success, as it allows them to keep up with the competition and survive (Allon et al., 2022; Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015). Previous research has contributed to our knowledge about mobile app release evolution in terms of frequency and speed; however, little research has examined the effect of app update content and source on app success (e.g., Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). While the few studies examining the content of app updates have shown that addressing users feedback in consecutive update releases increases the likelihood of app success (Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018), other studies have argued that mobile applications are creative innovations that also need to explore new features (Boudreau, 2012; Ye & Kankanhalli, 2020; Yin et al., 2014) and adapt to market forces to succeed (Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015; Soh & Grover, 2020).




持续开发对于应用程序的成功至关重要，因为它使它们能够跟上竞争并生存（Allon 等人，2022 年；Agarwal 和 Tiwana，2015 年）。之前的研究有助于我们了解移动应用程序发布频率和速度的演变；然而，很少有研究探讨应用程序更新内容和来源对应用程序成功的影响（例如，Palomba 等人，2018 年；Zhou 等人，2018 年）。虽然少数研究检查应用程序更新的内容表明，在连续更新版本中解决用户反馈会增加应用程序成功的可能性（Palomba 等人，2018 年；Zhou 等人，2018 年），但其他研究认为移动应用程序是创造性的创新，也需要探索新功能（Boudreau，2012 年；Ye 和 Kankanhalli，2020 年；Yin 等人，2014 年）并适应市场力量才能成功。 （Agarwal 和 Tiwana，2015；Soh 和 Grover，2020）。


Indeed, prior literature on app development has highlighted the importance of exploiting users reviews in order to satisfy and retain the existing user base (Lee & Raghu, 2014; Nayebi et al., 2016; Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). However, a few studies in app and product development (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Greve, 2007; Jiang et al., 2019), as well as broader work in organizational learning, have cautioned against overexploitation of “things already known” and suggested the need to also explore new possibilities (Levinthal & March, 1993, p. 105; March, 1991; O’Reilly & Tushman, 2013).




事实上，先前有关应用程序开发的文献已经强调了利用用户评论来满足和留住现有用户群的重要性（Lee & Raghu，2014；Nayebi 等人，2016；Palomba 等人，2018；Zhou 等人，2018）。然而，应用程序和产品开发方面的一些研究（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021 年；Greve，2007 年；Jiang 等人，2019 年）以及组织学习方面更广泛的工作，都警告不要过度利用“已知的事物”，并建议还需要探索新的可能性（Levinthal & March，1993，第 105 页；March，1991；O’Reilly &图什曼，2013）。


![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/462622f69e5eef51dfdb521a8a584c97c9b435f7c1807eb0ee27dd298f07201a.jpg)  
Figure 1. Research Model




![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/462622f69e5eef51dfdb521a8a584c97c9b435f7c1807eb0ee27dd298f07201a.jpg)  
图 1. 研究模型


We draw on the organizational learning literature (March, 1991) to propose that developers’ app update activities should consist of a mix of exploitation and exploration activities. Further, while developers need to use a mix of both activities to be successful in the marketplace, we also argue that they face a trade-off decision between these two activities given that they are competing for limited resources. We also focus on the role of external feedback in shaping this decision. Specifically, we argue that app developers are rationally bounded and build on the information processing literature (Simon, 1956) to suggest that the extent of their exploitation and exploration activities is likely to be influenced by the nature of the information they receive from users’ reviews. Specifically, we propose that two characteristics of users’ online reviews—review concurrence and review volume— influence app developers’ orientation toward exploitation versus exploration activities, which in turn influences the app’s success. The research model is presented in Figure 1 and developed in the following sections.




我们借鉴组织学习文献（1991 年 3 月）建议开发人员的应用程序更新活动应包括开发和探索活动的组合。此外，虽然开发人员需要结合使用这两种活动才能在市场上取得成功，但我们还认为，鉴于他们正在争夺有限的资源，他们面临着这两种活动之间的权衡决定。我们还关注外部反馈在制定这一决策中的作用。具体来说，我们认为应用程序开发人员受到理性限制，并以信息处理文献（Simon，1956）为基础，表明他们的开发和探索活动的程度可能会受到他们从用户评论中收到的信息的性质的影响。具体来说，我们提出用户在线评论的两个特征——评论并发度和评论量——会影响应用程序开发人员对开发活动和探索活动的定位，进而影响应用程序的成功。研究模型如图 1 所示，并在以下部分中展开。


## 2.1 The Notions of Exploitation and Exploration




## 2.1 利用和探索的概念


In his seminal article about organizational learning, March (1991) proposed that individuals and organizations conduct two types of activities that can explain the “evolutionary models of organizational forms and technologies” (p. 72): exploitation and exploration. Despite the various definitions found in the literature, there is consensus among scholars that exploitation refers to the “refinement and extension” of existing knowledge, whereas exploration refers to the “experimentation with new alternatives” (Lavie et al., 2010; March, 1991, p. 85). Over the last three decades, a substantive body of research has consistently supported March’s (1991) notion that systems need to conduct both types of activities to survive and prosper (e.g., Benner & Tushman, 2003; Gupta et al., 2006; Katila & Ahuja, 2002; Uotila et al., 2009). These findings support the idea that exploitation is necessary for improving and refining an organizational form or technology in order to ensure its current viability and success, whereas the exploration of new forms and functions differentiates the technology to ensure its competitiveness and survival in the market.




March (1991) 在他关于组织学习的开创性文章中提出，个人和组织进行两种可以解释“组织形式和技术的进化模型”（第 72 页）的活动：利用和探索。尽管文献中有不同的定义，但学者们一致认为，利用是指对现有知识的“提炼和扩展”，而探索是指“用新的替代方案进行实验”（Lavie et al., 2010; March, 1991, p. 85）。在过去的三十年中，大量研究一直支持 March（1991）的观点，即系统需要进行两种类型的活动才能生存和繁荣（例如，Benner & Tushman，2003；Gupta 等，2006；Katila 和 Ahuja，2002；Uotila 等，2009）。这些发现支持这样一种观点，即开发对于改进和完善组织形式或技术以确保其当前的可行性和成功是必要的，而对新形式和功能的探索使技术与众不同，以确保其在市场中的竞争力和生存。


## 2.1.1 The Appropriate Balance Between Exploitation and Exploration




## 2.1.1 开发与探索之间的适当平衡


In essence, firms must decide between exploitation activities that focus on cultivating existing resources and knowledge with clear and certain returns, or exploration activities that emphasize experimentation with new alternatives that have uncertain outcomes but can potentially enable firms to address new markets and adapt to changing environments (Levinthal, 2021). Undue focus on either activity can harm overall firm performance and thus demonstrates the need for approaches to appropriately balance exploitation and exploration activities (He & Wong, 2004; Uotila et al., 2009). Meta-analysis studies have found a positive relationship between balancing exploitation and exploration activities and performance, which is even more pronounced in technologically dynamic environments (Junni et al., 2013; Uotila et al., 2009). In such dynamic environments, the threat of rapidly aging technologies requires constant exploration, which may undermine the ability to exploit existing technologies and the associated rewards. Operating in such an environment requires an appropriate balance between both activities to maintain a competitive advantage.




从本质上讲，企业必须在专注于培养现有资源和知识并获得明确和确定回报的开发活动与强调试验新替代方案的探索活动之间做出选择，这些新替代方案虽然结果不确定，但有可能使企业能够应对新市场并适应不断变化的环境（Levinthal，2021）。对任何一项活动的过度关注都会损害公司的整体绩效，因此需要适当平衡开采和勘探活动的方法（He & Wong，2004 年；Uotila 等人，2009 年）。荟萃分析研究发现，平衡开发和勘探活动与绩效之间存在正相关关系，这种关系在技术动态环境中更为明显（Junni 等人，2013 年；Uotila 等人，2009 年）。在这种动态环境中，快速老化技术的威胁​​需要不断探索，这可能会削弱利用现有技术和相关奖励的能力。在这样的环境中运营需要在两项活动之间取得适当的平衡，以保持竞争优势。


The need to conduct both activities has been recognized by IS researchers who have examined the role of technologies such as social media (Castillo et al., 2021), digital infrastructure (Montealegre et al., 2019), digitization (Park et al., 2020) emails, knowledge repositories, and groupware (Kane & Alavi, 2007) in finding an appropriate balance (achieving desired levels of equilibria) between knowledge exploitation and exploration activities. These activities have also been viewed as distinct within software development research (Vinekar et al., 2006). For example, Temizkan and Kumar (2015) examined the role of OSS communities’ social network structure on the success of their exploitative and explorative activities in the form of patch development and feature-request activities, respectively. Also, Ramesh et al. (2012) identified practices for balancing exploitation and exploration activities to manage inherent tensions in the context of agile distributed development teams.




信息系统研究人员认识到开展这两项活动的必要性，他们研究了社交媒体（Castillo 等人，2021）、数字基础设施（Montealegre 等人，2019）、数字化（Park 等人，2020）、电子邮件、知识存​​储库和群件（Kane & Alavi，2007）等技术在知识利用和探索活动之间寻找适当平衡（达到所需的平衡水平）的作用。这些活动在软件开发研究中也被视为独特的（Vinekar 等，2006）。例如，Temizkan 和 Kumar（2015）分别研究了 OSS 社区的社交网络结构对其以补丁开发和功能请求活动的形式进行的利用和探索活动的成功的作用。此外，拉梅什等人。 (2012) 确定了平衡开发和探索活动的实践，以管理敏捷分布式开发团队中固有的紧张局势。


The innovation literature also highlights the benefits of balancing exploitation and exploration for increasing the sales growth rate (He & Wong, 2004) and new product innovativeness (Katila & Ahuja, 2002). Some studies in innovation have examined the effect of organizational slack resources, ROA (Greve, 2007), and process management activities such as ISO 9000 certifications (Benner & Tushman, 2002) on the level of exploitation and exploration activities. This literature has conceptualized the exploitation and exploration of innovations according to their technological trajectory (incremental/radical) or their proximity to meeting existing customer needs (Benner & Tushman, 2003). Within this view, incremental innovations that meet existing customer needs are exploitative, whereas radical innovations or ones that seek emergent needs and markets are explorative (Benner & Tushman, 2003; Levinthal & March, 1993).




创新文献还强调了平衡利用和探索对于提高销售增长率（He & Wong，2004）和新产品创新性（Katila & Ahuja，2002）的好处。一些创新研究考察了组织闲置资源、ROA（Greve，2007）以及 ISO 9000 认证（Benner & Tushman，2002）等流程管理活动对开发和探索活动水平的影响。这些文献根据创新的技术轨迹（增量/激进）或与满足现有客户需求的接近程度，概念化了创新的利用和探索（Benner & Tushman，2003）。在这种观点下，满足现有客户需求的渐进式创新是剥削性的，而激进的创新或寻求紧急需求和市场的创新是探索性的（Benner & Tushman，2003；Levinthal & March，1993）。


While these definitions of exploitation and exploration are useful at an industry level, they need to be further specified to consider the level of novelty of an innovation for a particular firm (Greve, 2007). For example, while a firm may perceive an innovation to be radical in relation to its existing knowledge and processes, it may be incremental at an industry level. As such, Greve (2007) defined these activities from a firm’s perspective and according to its assessment regarding the probability of success of an innovation. More specifically, Greve (2007, p. 3) conceptualized exploration as the development of an innovation with less knowledge and certainty regarding “the probability of successfully … launching it in the market,” and exploitation as the development of an innovation that has predictable success in the existing market, such as ones designed according to customer requests. We adopt this view in the present study by defining exploitation activities in app development as ones that incorporate features that have increased certainty of acceptance by the existing customer base, and exploration activities as ones that emphasize experimentation with new characteristics that have less predictable market success (Benner & Tushman, 2003; Greve, 2007).




虽然这些开发和探索的定义在行业层面很有用，但需要进一步具体化，以考虑特定公司创新的新颖程度（Greve，2007）。例如，虽然一家公司可能认为一项创新相对于其现有知识和流程来说是激进的，但它在行业层面上可能是渐进式的。因此，Greve（2007）从公司的角度并根据其对创新成功概率的评估来定义这些活动。更具体地说，Greve (2007, p. 3) 将探索概念化为对“成功……在市场上推出的可能性”的知识和确定性较少的创新的开发，而开发则概念化为在现有市场中取得可预测成功的创新的开发，例如根据客户要求设计的创新。我们在本研究中采用了这一观点，将应用程序开发中的开发活动定义为包含增加现有客户群接受确定性的功能的活动，并将探索活动定义为强调试验市场成功程度较难预测的新功能的活动（Benner & Tushman，2003；Greve，2007）。


## 2.1.2 The Exploitation-Exploration Trade-Off




## 2.1.2 开发-探索权衡


In addition to the argument that finding an appropriate balance between exploitation and exploration is crucial for success, another central premise of March’s (1991) argument is that there is an inherent tension between exploitation and exploration activities as a result of resource allocation that may be exacerbated by inertia (Lavie et al., 2010; Levinthal & March, 1993). According to Levinthal and March (1993), these two activities compete for limited resources, such that any time and resources dedicated to one activity imply fewer resources for the other. Further, each of the activities is self-reinforcing. The outcome of exploration activities is uncertain and often leads to failure, which in turn promotes further exploration activities that may potentially lead to more failures. In contrast, exploitation activities often lead to immediate success, which in turn promotes more exploitation activities that diminish the resources available for exploration (Gupta et al., 2006; Levinthal & March, 1993; Luger et al., 2018). One notable example of the trade-off between exploitation and exploration is Meta’s (formerly Facebook) investment in developing the metaverse. The market success of activities related to this project is uncertain (exploration), and dedicating resources to it can hemorrhage funds away from Meta’s existing app development activities that would more likely appeal to its customer base, i.e., exploitation activities (Hays, 2022).




除了在开发和勘探之间找到适当的平衡对于成功至关重要的论点之外，March（1991）论点的另一个中心前提是，由于资源分配，开发和勘探活动之间存在固有的紧张关系，而这种紧张关系可能会因惯性而加剧（Lavie et al., 2010; Levinthal & March, 1993）。根据 Levinthal 和 March (1993) 的说法，这两项活动争夺有限的资源，因此投入一项活动的任何时间和资源都意味着另一项活动的资源更少。此外，每项活动都是自我强化的。勘探活动的结果是不确定的，常常导致失败，这反过来又促进了进一步的勘探活动，可能会导致更多的失败。相比之下，开采活动往往会立即取得成功，进而促进更多的开采活动，从而减少可用于勘探的资源（Gupta 等人，2006 年；Levinthal 和 March，1993 年；Luger 等人，2018 年）。开发与探索之间权衡的一个显着例子是 Meta（前 Facebook）对开发元宇宙的投资。与该项目相关的活动在市场上的成功是不确定的（探索），并且为其投入资源可能会导致 Meta 现有的应用程序开发活动的资金流失，而这些活动更有可能吸引其客户群，即开发活动（Hays，2022）。


Although the trade-off perspective has been supported in some studies (Uotila et al., 2009), others have suggested that firms with sufficient resources can pursue both activities (Luger et al., 2018; Raisch et al., 2009). As such, while smaller firms may have to make decisions regarding the level of exploitation and exploration activities they undertake, larger firms with slack resources may sometimes be able to conduct both activities without sacrificing either (Gupta et al., 2006). In the context of mobile application development, developers need to make decisions with limited resources. For one, a large fraction of applications is developed by individuals or very small companies (Borck et al., 2021). Indeed, a typical app development company “consists of just a handful of developers, with 40% of all app developers having a separate main job and 21% working only part-time on apps” (Nayebi et al., 2016, p. 552). In addition, developers typically must make app update decisions within very short time constraints, often measured in days. Indeed, while it is estimated that most developers of top free apps in the Google Play Store update their apps within a six-week period (Yang et al., 2022), many developers release daily updates of their apps (Openja et al., 2020). Given these constraints, it is reasonable to assume that app developers make trade-off decisions between exploitation and exploration activities in updating their apps.




尽管权衡观点得到了一些研究的支持（Uotila et al., 2009），但其他研究表明，拥有足够资源的企业可以同时开展这两种活动（Luger et al., 2018；Raisch et al., 2009）。因此，虽然较小的公司可能必须就其所从事的开采和勘探活动的水平做出决定，但拥有闲置资源的较大公司有时可能能够在不牺牲任何一项活动的情况下开展这两项活动（Gupta 等，2006）。在移动应用开发的背景下，开发人员需要利用有限的资源做出决策。首先，很大一部分应用程序是由个人或非常小的公司开发的（Borck 等人，2021）。事实上，典型的应用程序开发公司“仅由少数开发人员组成，其中 40% 的应用程序开发人员有单独的主要工作，21% 的人仅兼职开发应用程序”（Nayebi 等人，2016 年，第 552 页）。此外，开发人员通常必须在非常短的时间内（通常以天为单位）做出应用程序更新决策。事实上，虽然据估计 Google Play 商店中的大多数顶级免费应用程序的开发者都会在六周内更新其应用程序（Yang 等人，2022 年），但许多开发者每天都会发布其应用程序的更新（Openja 等人，2020 年）。考虑到这些限制，可以合理地假设应用程序开发人员在更新应用程序时在利用和探索活动之间做出权衡决策。


## 2.2 Exploitation and Exploration in Mobile App Evolution




## 2.2 移动App演进的探索与探索


Most app developers rely on open mobile app marketplaces such as Google Play, Amazon Appstore, and Apple App Store to release and distribute their apps. While these marketplaces facilitate the adoption of new apps by reducing the barrier between developers and users, they also promote fierce competition by lowering imitation and switching costs, often with a winner-take-all outcome (Wang et al., 2018). Within this highly competitive and dynamic environment (Wen & Zhu, 2019), app developers need to retain their existing customer base by addressing their needs and improving their applications on the one hand, and exploring new features to differentiate their offering, expand their market share, and adapt to the rapidly changing environment on the other.




大多数应用程序开发人员依赖开放的移动应用程序市场（例如 Google Play、Amazon Appstore 和 Apple App Store）来发布和分发他们的应用程序。虽然这些市场通过减少开发者和用户之间的障碍来促进新应用程序的采用，但它们也通过降低模仿和转换成本来促进激烈的竞争，通常会带来赢家通吃的结果（Wang et al., 2018）。在这个竞争激烈且充满活力的环境中（Wen & Zhu，2019），应用程序开发人员需要一方面满足他们的需求并改进他们的应用程序，另一方面探索新功能以区分他们的产品、扩大他们的市场份额并适应快速变化的环境，从而保留现有的客户群。


Yet retaining existing app users and attracting new ones is no easy feat. A recent market study estimated that while the top 10 apps lose over 30% of their users in the first week after installation, the average app loses over 80% of its users.<sup>1</sup> This is not surprising given that unlike traditional IS, app developers cater to heterogeneous and geographically dispersed users who may diverge in their needs and specific uses of the application and who face low switching costs between an abundance of substitutes. However, an app does not necessarily need to meet all of its potential users’ needs, and its success ultimately depends on satisfying a large number of users to ensure its widespread mass adoption (Lee & Raghu, 2014; Noei et al., 2021).




然而，留住现有的应用程序用户并吸引新用户并不是一件容易的事。最近的一项市场研究估计，排名前 10 的应用程序在安装后的第一周内就会失去超过 30% 的用户，而平均应用程序会失去超过 80% 的用户。<sup>1</sup>这并不奇怪，因为与传统的 IS 不同，应用程序开发人员迎合的是异构且地理位置分散的用户，这些用户的需求和应用程序的特定用途可能存在差异，并且在大量替代品之间面临较低的转换成本。然而，应用程序不一定需要满足所有潜在用户的需求，其成功最终取决于满足大量用户以确保其广泛的大规模采用（Lee & Raghu，2014；Noei 等人，2021）。


Consequently, in order to evolve and improve their apps and retain existing customers, the majority of developers often rely on users’ online feedback (Palomba et al., 2018). It is estimated that nearly a quarter to one-third of these reviews provide software requirements and user experience feedback that can be useful for developers to improve the quality of the software (Iacob & Harrison, 2013). Indeed, updates that emanate from user reviews often involve improvements that existing users appreciate (Pagano & Maalej, 2013) and that increase the app’s quality and market success (Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018; Noei et al., 2021). This approach of employing user reviews in “designing and customizing products … based on customer requests” (Greve, 2007, p. 3) is consistent with the exploitation view, which emphasizes incorporating features that have a high certainty of acceptance by the existing customer base. As such, we conceptualize incorporating users’ reviews (known needs) into release updates as exploitation activities.




因此，为了发展和改进他们的应用程序并留住现有客户，大多数开发人员经常依赖用户的在线反馈（Palomba et al., 2018）。据估计，这些评论中有近四分之一到三分之一提供了软件需求和用户体验反馈，这对于开发人员提高软件质量很有用（Iacob & Harrison，2013）。事实上，来自用户评论的更新通常涉及现有用户欣赏的改进（Pagano & Maalej，2013），并提高应用程序的质量和市场成功（Palomba 等人，2018；Zhou 等人，2018；Noei 等人，2021）。这种在“根据客户要求设计和定制产品”（Greve，2007，第 3 页）中采用用户评论的方法与开发观点一致，后者强调合并现有客户群高度确定接受的功能。因此，我们将用户的评论（已知需求）纳入到发布更新中作为开发活动进行概念化。


On the other hand, developers also rely on other diverse sources beyond user reviews for evolving their apps, such as their internal roadmaps and vision for the app (Nayebi et al., 2016; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013), rival product development efforts (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Jiang et al., 2019), and “opportunities opened up by external technological advances” for updating their apps (Tiwana, 2015, p. 267). For example, Nayebi et al. (2016) surveyed app developers and found that half of those who participated followed a planned app release and update strategy, and some did not deviate from that strategy throughout the app’s lifecycle. In addition, many app developers scan competitors’ apps for feature ideas to identify emerging trends and remain competitive (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Jiang et al., 2019). Further, developers often update their apps in response to market and platform changes (Soh & Grover, 2020; Tiwana, 2015).




另一方面，开发人员还依赖用户评论之外的其他不同来源来改进应用程序，例如应用程序的内部路线图和愿景（Nayebi 等人，2016 年；Pagano 和 Bruegge，2013 年）、竞争对手的产品开发工作（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021 年；Jiang 等人，2019 年）以及更新应用程序的“外部技术进步带来的机会”（Tiwana， 2015 年，第 267 页）。例如，纳耶比等人。 (2016) 对应用程序开发人员进行了调查，发现一半的参与者遵循计划的应用程序发布和更新策略，有些人在应用程序的整个生命周期中都没有偏离该策略。此外，许多应用程序开发人员会扫描竞争对手的应用程序以获取功能创意，以识别新兴趋势并保持竞争力（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021 年；Jiang 等人，2019 年）。此外，开发人员经常更新他们的应用程序以响应市场和平台变化（Soh & Grover，2020；Tiwana，2015）。


Update activities following internal planning, market analysis, or technological changes are all exploration activities because they do not capitalize on existing certainties of what is likely to succeed in the marketplace. Whereas prior work points to the existence and importance of such exploration activities, it also cautions against their potential risk and negative consequences. For example, while following a planned feature update strategy potentially allows developers to be ahead of users’ needs (Allon et al., 2022; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013) and quicker to market than their competition (Nayebi et al., 2016), it may impede developers from adjusting their plans based on user and market feedback (Liu et al., 2023; Nayebi et al., 2016). Hence, app developers who allocate their time and effort to pursuing exploratory activities may end up with updates that do not pay off. For example, many app developers took advantage of the 3D touch feature of iOS introduced in 2015 and then had to readapt their apps when it was discontinued in 2019.<sup>2</sup> These updates exemplify exploration activities for which market success is ambiguous and less certain than development activities addressing user requests (Greve, 2007).




内部规划、市场分析或技术变革之后的更新活动都是探索活动，因为它们没有利用可能在市场上取得成功的现有确定性。尽管之前的工作指出了此类勘探活动的存在和重要性，但它也警告其潜在风险和负面后果。例如，虽然遵循计划的功能更新策略可能会让开发人员领先于用户的需求（Allon 等人，2022 年；Pagano 和 Bruegge，2013 年）并且比竞争对手更快地进入市场（Nayebi 等人，2016 年），但它可能会阻碍开发人员根据用户和市场反馈调整他们的计划（Liu 等人，2023 年；Nayebi 等人，2016 年）。因此，分配时间和精力进行探索性活动的应用程序开发人员可能最终会得到没有回报的更新。例如，许多应用程序开发人员利用了 2015 年推出的 iOS 3D 触摸功能，然后在 2019 年停止使用时不得不重新调整他们的应用程序。<sup>2</sup>这些更新说明了探索活动的市场成功是模糊的，并且不如满足用户请求的开发活动那么确定（Greve，2007）。


In summary, this prior work on app development (1) emphasizes the importance of exploitation activities to satisfy and retain the user base, (2) points to several exploration opportunities traditionally taken by app developers, and (3) highlights the uncertainties and risks associated with these exploration activities. We draw on these findings and prior work in organizational learning in the next section to suggest that app success can benefit from a mix of exploitation and exploration activities.




总之，这项关于应用程序开发的先前工作 (1) 强调了开发活动对于满足和留住用户群的重要性，(2) 指出了应用程序开发人员传统上采取的几种探索机会，(3) 强调了与这些探索活动相关的不确定性和风险。我们在下一节中利用这些发现和组织学习方面的先前工作来表明应用程序的成功可以从利用和探索活动的组合中受益。


## 2.2.1 The Effect of Exploitation-Exploration Orientation on App Success




## 2.2.1 开发探索方向对应用程序成功的影响


In updating and releasing their apps, developers can exploit and focus on existing users’ needs by incorporating feedback from users’ reviews or explore new unanticipated needs by experimenting with new features. The rapid turnaround time between consecutive app releases and the limited resources available means that any increase in exploitation is at the expense of exploration activity and vice versa. Therefore, the degree to which developers engage in exploitation versus exploration activities is an important strategic decision. Following prior work that has examined the trade-off between exploitation and exploration activity (Uotila et al., 2009), we refer to this factor as exploitation-exploration orientation.




在更新和发布应用程序时，开发人员可以通过合并用户评论的反馈来利用和关注现有用户的需求，或者通过尝试新功能来探索新的意外需求。连续应用程序发布之间的快速周转时间和有限的可用资源意味着开发的任何增加都会以探索活动为代价，反之亦然。因此，开发商参与开发与勘探活动的程度是一个重要的战略决策。根据先前研究开发和勘探活动之间权衡的工作（Uotila 等，2009），我们将此因素称为开发-勘探方向。


Exploitation-exploration orientation reflects the mix of both activities, i.e., the degree to which a firm engages in one activity versus the other. This view is consistent with March’s (1991) original conceptualization of exploration-exploitation as activities that compete for resources and attention and therefore exist on two ends of a continuum (see Gupta et al., 2006 and Lavie et al. 2010 for a more detailed review). Hence, exploitationexploration orientation is viewed as a continuum representing the degree of developers’ exploitation versus exploration activities, with absolute exploration and absolute exploitation located on polar opposites of the continuum. Accordingly, a high exploitationexploration orientation reflects an emphasis on exploitation over exploration activities, while a low exploitation-exploration orientation reflects an emphasis on exploration activities. It is worth noting that while the organizational learning literature suggests that firms should balance exploitation and exploration (March, 1991; O'Reilly & Tushman, 2013), an appropriate balance does not necessarily imply an even 50/50 split but rather refers to an optimal mix of both activities that is contingent upon the firm and its environment (Uotila et al., 2009; Junni et al., 2013; Luger et al., 2018).




开发-探索导向反映了两种活动的混合，即企业参与一项活动相对于另一项活动的程度。这一观点与 March (1991) 最初的概念是一致的，即探索-开发是争夺资源和注意力的活动，因此存在于连续体的两端（更详细的综述请参见 Gupta 等人，2006 年和 Lavie 等人，2010 年）。因此，开发勘探方向被视为代表开发商开发与勘探活动程度的连续体，绝对勘探和绝对开发位于连续体的对立面。因此，高开采勘探方向反映了对勘探活动的重视，而低勘探勘探方向反映了对勘探活动的重视。值得注意的是，虽然组织学习文献表明企业应该平衡利用和探索（March，1991；O'Reilly & Tushman，2013），但适当的平衡并不一定意味着均匀的 50/50 分配，而是指取决于企业及其环境的两种活动的最佳组合（Uotila 等，2009；Junni 等，2013；Luger 等， 2018）。


Regarding app development, prior studies have established the necessity of exploitation activities for developing successful apps (Lee & Raghu, 2014; Nayebi et al., 2016; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013; Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). This is not surprising given that app success ultimately depends on user satisfaction and adoption. As such, developers can improve their apps and retain their customer base by incorporating user feedback into consecutive app updates, i.e., exploitation activities. Hence, an increased exploitation-exploration orientation (i.e., more exploitation) is likely to increase app success.




关于应用程序开发，先前的研究已经确定了开发成功应用程序的开发活动的必要性（Lee & Raghu，2014；Nayebi 等人，2016；Pagano & Bruegge，2013；Palomba 等人，2018；Zhou 等人，2018）。鉴于应用程序的成功最终取决于用户满意度和采用率，这并不奇怪。因此，开发人员可以通过将用户反馈纳入连续的应用程序更新（即开发活动）来改进他们的应用程序并保留客户群。因此，增加开发探索方向（即更多的开发）可能会增加应用程序的成功。


However, some exploration activities remain important, especially in competitive and dynamic environments because they enable firms to quickly adapt to rapid changes (Benner & Tushman, 2002; Levinthal & March, 1993). In environments characterized by an abundance of substitutes, low switching costs, and rapid technological advances (Wang et al., 2018; Wen & Zhu, 2019), app developers must explore new features to keep up with the competition (Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015; Tiwana, 2015) and retain and expand their user base. Therefore, insufficient exploration (i.e., too much exploitation) can diminish the app’s capacity to adapt to its competitive environment.




然而，一些探索活动仍然很重要，特别是在竞争和动态环境中，因为它们使企业能够快速适应快速变化（Benner & Tushman，2002；Levinthal & March，1993）。在替代品丰富、转换成本低和技术快速进步的环境中（Wang et al., 2018；Wen & Zhu, 2019），应用程序开发人员必须探索新功能以跟上竞争（Agarwal & Tiwana, 2015；Tiwana, 2015）并保留和扩大其用户群。因此，探索不足（即过多利用）可能会削弱应用程序适应竞争环境的能力。


Thus, while exploitation is necessary for app success, overexploitation can compromise it. Hence, when considering the trade-off between these two activities, an emphasis on exploitation over exploration activities results in increased app success up to a certain point, after which it starts to decline. This motivates our first hypothesis:




因此，虽然利用对于应用程序的成功是必要的，但过度利用可能会损害它。因此，在考虑这两项活动之间的权衡时，强调利用而不是探索活动会导致应用程序成功率在一定程度上增加，之后开始下降。这激发了我们的第一个假设：


H1: The exploitation-exploration orientation in app updates has a curvilinear (inverted U-shape) effect on app success.




H1：应用程序更新中的开发探索方向对应用程序的成功具有曲线（倒 U 形）效应。


## 2.3 The Role of Feedback on the Degree of Exploitation and Exploration Activities




## 2.3 反馈对开发和探索活动程度的作用


The majority of prior work has assumed the decision to balance exploration and exploitation to be internal to the organization as either a strategic decision with calculative considerations of alternative strategies (e.g., Miranda et al., 2022) or as the result of an arrangement of organizational forms and processes (Manso, 2017; March, 1991).




大多数先前的工作都假设平衡探索和利用的决定是组织内部的，作为考虑替代战略的战略决策（例如，Miranda 等人，2022）或作为组织形式和流程安排的结果（Manso，2017 年；1991 年 3 月）。


The choice between exploration and exploitation is a crucial decision made by both organizations and individuals. The behavioral theory of the firm links organizational decision-making to the decisions made by individuals within the organization. This theory suggests that while organizations use information to make decisions, these decisions are influenced by the limited rationality of the individuals involved and their ability to process information from the environment (March & Simon, 1958; Cyert & March, 1963; Simon, 1956; 1979). In line with the behavioral theory of the firm, our study considers app developers to be individuals who make app update decisions based on rational limitations in order to achieve greater app success. Thus, developers’ decisions regarding exploration and exploitation, whether made individually or as a group, can be better understood by accounting for their individual cognitive limitations and the information they receive from their environment.




探索和利用之间的选择是组织和个人做出的关键决定。公司行为理论将组织决策与组织内个人做出的决策联系起来。该理论表明，虽然组织使用信息来做出决策，但这些决策受到所涉及个人的有限理性及其处理来自环境的信息的能力的影响（March＆Simon，1958；Cyert＆March，1963；Simon，1956；1979）。根据公司的行为理论，我们的研究认为应用程序开发人员是基于理性限制做出应用程序更新决策的个人，以取得更大的应用程序成功。因此，开发者关于探索和开发的决策，无论是单独做出还是作为一个团队做出，都可以通过考虑他们的个人认知局限性和他们从环境中接收到的信息来更好地理解。


However, little research has investigated what drives the decision to exploit or explore (Raisch et al., 2009). Some scholars suggest that external performance feedback mechanisms are likely to impact decisionmaking activities (Adner & Levinthal, 2002; Levinthal, 2021). The impact of external feedback is likely to be greater for small enterprises. Although large and established organizations have slack resources that allow them to pursue exploration and exploitation activities (Luger et al., 2018), their elaborate organizational structures can make them insensitive to environmental feedback, as signals need to travel from front-liners to upper management (Adner & Levinthal, 2002; Levinthal, 2021).




然而，很少有研究调查驱动开发或探索决策的因素（Raisch 等，2009）。一些学者认为，外部绩效反馈机制可能会影响决策活动（Adner & Levinthal，2002；Levinthal，2021）。对于小企业来说，外部反馈的影响可能更大。尽管大型和成熟的组织拥有允许他们进行勘探和开采活动的闲置资源（Luger et al., 2018），但其复杂的组织结构可能使他们对环境反馈不敏感，因为信号需要从一线传递到高层管理人员（Adner & Levinthal, 2002; Levinthal, 2021）。


In contrast, small enterprises such as app development ones, need to be attuned and responsive to their external environment as they lack the resources for engaging in superfluous activities (Luger et al., 2018) that do not contribute to their market success and survival (Adner & Levinthal, 2008). As such, feedback from the external environment plays an important role in small organizations’ strategic decisions, including balancing exploration and exploitation. This effect will likely be amplified in the highly dynamic app development environment characterized by short update times (McIlroy et al., 2016; Yang et al., 2022) and immense competition (Wen & Zhu, 2019). Because developers eventually make decisions about app updates, they need to pay close attention to feedback available to them about the performance of their apps.




相比之下，应用程序开发等小型企业需要对外部环境进行调整和响应，因为它们缺乏资源来从事多余的活动（Luger et al., 2018），而这些活动无助于其市场成功和生存（Adner & Levinthal, 2008）。因此，外部环境的反馈在小型组织的战略决策中发挥着重要作用，包括平衡探索和利用。在更新时间短（McIlroy 等人，2016 年；Yang 等人，2022 年）和竞争激烈（Wen 和 Zhu，2019 年）的高度动态的应用程序开发环境中，这种影响可能会被放大。由于开发人员最终会做出有关应用程序更新的决定，因此他们需要密切关注有关应用程序性能的反馈。


In the present paper, we argue that developers’ exploitation-exploration orientation is influenced by the nature of the information they receive. More specifically, we propose that the nature of users’ online app reviews influences this orientation. This view is consistent with previous empirical studies in the information processing and decision-making domains, which have shown that decision makers’ attention is driven by the characteristics of the information they receive (Haas et al., 2015).




在本文中，我们认为开发人员的开发探索方向受到他们收到的信息的性质的影响。更具体地说，我们建议用户在线应用程序评论的性质会影响这一方向。这一观点与之前信息处理和决策领域的实证研究一致，这些研究表明决策者的注意力是由他们接收到的信息的特征驱动的（Haas等，2015）。


## 2.3.1 The Role of Users’ Reviews on the Exploitation-Exploration Orientation




## 2.3.1 用户评价对开发探索方向的作用


It is well documented in the literature that users’ online app reviews constitute a major—if not the main— source of feedback that developers use for updating their apps in consecutive iterations (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Nayebi et al., 2016; Noei et al., 2021; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013; Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). This feedback enables developers to improve the quality of their apps by providing them with information about system bugs, unappreciated or requested features and functionalities, in addition to usage scenarios (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021).




文献中有详细记载，用户的在线应用程序评论构成了开发人员在连续迭代中更新应用程序时使用的主要（如果不是主要）反馈来源（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021；Nayebi 等人，2016；Noei 等人，2021；Pagano & Bruegge，2013；Palomba 等人，2018；Zhou 等人，2018）。除了使用场景之外，这种反馈使开发人员能够通过向他们提供有关系统错误、未欣赏或请求的特性和功能的信息来提高应用程序的质量（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021）。


To use these reviews for improving the quality of their apps, developers need to first identify the relevant information (Noei et al., 2021; Pagano & Maalej, 2013), then prioritize and decide which user feedback to incorporate in the subsequent releases (Noei et al., 2021; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013). This is not an easy feat given that users’ reviews are often unstructured, unclear, and potentially overwhelming in quantity. This problem is further exacerbated by repetitive and uninformative reviews (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021). While the advancements in text review mining tools are promising, they remain in their infancy and are relatively expensive (Demoulin & Coussement, 2020), keeping them out of reach for most small app developers. Even if these tools are used to aggregate users’ feedback, developers still need to review and decide which user input to address in consecutive app releases. As such, many developers rely on their intuition when it comes to identifying, prioritizing, and implementing users’ feedback in their consecutive app release iterations (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013). This is not surprising given the time and resource limitations app developers face (Nayebi et al., 2016) in evaluating the high volume and velocity of generated user reviews. Under such circumstances, app developers face a bounded rationality problem (Simon, 1956; 1973).




为了利用这些评论来提高应用程序的质量，开发人员需要首先确定相关信息（Noei et al., 2021；Pagano & Maalej, 2013），然后确定优先级并决定将哪些用户反馈纳入后续版本中（Noei et al., 2021；Pagano & Bruegge, 2013）。这并不是一件容易的事，因为用户的评论往往是非结构化的、不明确的，而且数量可能令人难以承受。重复且无信息的评论进一步加剧了这个问题（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021）。虽然文本评论挖掘工具的进步很有希望，但它们仍处于起步阶段，而且相对昂贵（Demoulin & Coussement，2020），这使得大多数小型应用程序开发人员无法接触到它们。即使这些工具用于汇总用户的反馈，开发人员仍然需要审查并决定在连续的应用程序版本中处理哪些用户输入。因此，许多开发人员在连续的应用程序发布迭代中识别、优先考虑和实施用户反馈时，依靠直觉（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021 年；Pagano 和 Bruegge，2013 年）。考虑到应用程序开发人员在评估生成的用户评论的大量和速度时面临的时间和资源限制（Nayebi 等人，2016），这并不奇怪。在这种情况下，应用程序开发人员面临有限理性问题（Simon，1956；1973）。


The fundamental argument underlying bounded rationality is that under complex and uncertain conditions, individuals are limited in their ability to gather and process information to make inferences for making decisions. These limitations are a result of task and environment complexity, human cognitive capacities, and finite resources such as time. Hence, individuals make decisions based on heuristics that result in satisfactory rather than optimal choices, which are determined by the available information they have and the environmental context in which they operate (Simon, 1979; Lejarraga & Pindard-Lejarraga, 2020). More specifically, bounded rationality suggests that decision makers use heuristics to search and process a subset of select information to make decisions quickly and frugally (Simon, 1979; Gigerenzer & Gaissmaier, 2011). This view is in contrast with the classical and neoclassical rational choice perspective, where decision makers need to collect exhaustive information and evaluate all possible options to make an optimal decision. Rather, bounded rationality deviates from the classical rationality perspective and examines the success of decision makers’ strategies with respect to the task environment and its objectives (Gigerenzer, 2004).




有限理性的基本论点是，在复杂和不确定的条件下，个人收集和处理信息以做出决策的推理的能力是有限的。这些限制是任务和环境复杂性、人类认知能力以及时间等有限资源造成的。因此，个人根据启发式做出决策，从而得到令人满意的而非最优的选择，这是由他们所拥有的可用信息和他们所处的环境背景决定的（Simon，1979；Lejarraga＆Pindard-Lejarraga，2020）。更具体地说，有限理性表明决策者使用启发式方法来搜索和处理选定信息的子集，以快速、节俭地做出决策（Simon，1979；Gigerenzer & Gaissmaier，2011）。这种观点与古典和新古典理性选择观点形成鲜明对比，在古典和新古典理性选择观点中，决策者需要收集详尽的信息并评估所有可能的选择以做出最佳决策。相反，有限理性偏离了经典理性的视角，并考察了决策者在任务环境及其目标方面的策略是否成功（Gigerenzer，2004）。


Within the app development context, developers largely rely on the quantitative (Zhou et al., 2018) and qualitative (Pagano & Bruegge, 2013) information cues they receive from users’ online reviews to identify the relevant and important features to include in successive app releases. Hence, app developers use these information cues to make inferences regarding their level of exploitation versus exploration activities (Zhou et al., 2018; Palomba et al., 2018) in order to satisfy the largest number of users. Prior studies in the social psychology and marketing literatures that have investigated the effect of information cues from multiple disparate sources on decision makers (e.g., Harkins and Petty, 1987; Thakur, 2018) have notably focused on message content and volume. Drawing on this literature, we propose and develop two new constructs that characterize the quantity and quality of user reviews and test their influence on developers’ exploitation-exploration orientation. The first is review concurrence, which is the magnitude of users’ convergence on similar issues, and the second is review volume, which is the number of reviews following an app release.




在应用程序开发环境中，开发人员很大程度上依赖从用户在线评论中收到的定量（Zhou et al., 2018）和定性（Pagano & Bruegge, 2013）信息提示来确定要包含在连续应用程序版本中的相关且重要的功能。因此，应用程序开发人员使用这些信息线索来推断其开发水平与探索活动（Zhou et al., 2018；Palomba et al., 2018），以满足最大数量的用户。社会心理学和营销文献中的先前研究调查了来自多个不同来源的信息线索对决策者的影响（例如 Harkins 和 Petty，1987 年；Thakur，2018 年），特别关注消息内容和数量。借鉴这些文献，我们提出并开发了两种新的结构来表征用户评论的数量和质量，并测试它们对开发者开发探索方向的影响。第一个是评论并发度，即用户在类似问题上趋同的程度；第二个是评论量，即应用程序发布后的评论数量。


## 2.3.2 Review Concurrence




## 2.3.2 审核并发


Prior work suggests that developers attend to recurrent themes found in different users’ reviews, thereby focusing on issues that affect the largest number of users (Noei et al., 2021; Pagano & Bruegge, 2013). Accordingly, we develop the construct of review concurrence, which is the magnitude of users’ convergence on similar issues, and suggest that app developers are more likely to attend to issues reported in more user reviews (higher review concurrence).




之前的研究表明，开发人员应关注不同用户评论中反复出现的主题，从而关注影响最多用户的问题（Noei 等人，2021 年；Pagano 和 Bruegge，2013 年）。因此，我们开发了评论并发性的结构，即用户在类似问题上的收敛程度，并建议应用程序开发人员更有可能关注更多用户评论中报告的问题（更高的评论并发性）。


It is reasonable for developers to attempt to satisfy the largest number of users given that the ultimate success of an app relies on its mass adoption (Lee & Raghu, 2014; Noei et al., 2021). Within the information-rich environment of app user reviews, developers will rely on heuristics to form judgments about which issues afflict many users. Previous studies have found that a recipient evaluates repeated messages from different sources as more important (Gallivan & Keil, 2003) and credible (Harkins & Petty, 1987). For example, Gallivan and Keil (2003) found that developers of a traditional IS attended to the issues most cited by the different users at the expense of other system issues. This is in accordance with studies in cognitive psychology which found that a message received from multiple sources increased the importance and credibility of the received information (Harkins & Petty, 1987). These studies suggest that messages repeated by multiple sources are taken more seriously and attended to.




鉴于应用程序的最终成功取决于其大规模采用，开发人员尝试满足最大数量的用户是合理的（Lee & Raghu，2014；Noei 等人，2021）。在应用程序用户评论的信息丰富的环境中，开发人员将依靠启发式方法来判断哪些问题困扰着许多用户。先前的研究发现，接收者将来自不同来源的重复消息评估为更重要（Gallivan＆Keil，2003）和可信（Harkins＆Petty，1987）。例如，Gallivan 和 Keil (2003) 发现传统 IS 的开发人员以牺牲其他系统问题为代价来关注不同用户最常提及的问题。这与认知心理学的研究一致，该研究发现从多个来源接收到的消息会增加所接收信息的重要性和可信度（Harkins & Petty，1987）。这些研究表明，多个来源重复的信息会得到更认真的对待和关注。


In the context of app development, issues reported by more app users serve as a signal to the developers about the importance of those issues to the users. More specifically, users’ concurrence on certain issues in their reviews provides a clear indication regarding what content developers need to address in their next release update in order to satisfy a certain number of their user base. Further, issues cited by multiple users are also likely to signal quality issues that developers can address to improve the quality of their apps. The fact that multiple users note these issues further signals the significance of the feedback to the developers.




在应用程序开发的背景下，更多应用程序用户报告的问题向开发人员发出了一个信号，表明这些问题对用户的重要性。更具体地说，用户对评论中某些问题的同意可以清楚地表明开发人员需要在下一个版本更新中解决哪些内容，才能满足一定数量的用户群。此外，多个用户提到的问题也可能表明开发人员可以解决这些问题以提高应用程序的质量。多个用户注意到这些问题的事实进一步表明了反馈对开发人员的重要性。


As such, in order to improve the quality of their apps and satisfy and retain their existing users, developers are likely to spend their time addressing issues that users agree on in their reviews, i.e., exploitation activities. Hence, app developers are likely to attend to issues that more users report in their reviews at the expense of exploring new features, i.e., review concurrence is likely to result in an increased exploitation-exploration orientation. This motivates our second hypothesis:




因此，为了提高应用程序的质量并满足和留住现有用户，开发人员可能会花时间解决用户在评论中同意的问题，即开发活动。因此，应用程序开发人员可能会以牺牲探索新功能为代价来关注更多用户在评论中报告的问题，即评论并发可能会导致开发探索方向的增加。这激发了我们的第二个假设：


H2: Review concurrence leads to an increased exploitation-exploration orientation in app updates.




H2：审核并发导致应用程序更新中的开发探索方向增加。


## 2.3.3 Review Volume




## 2.3.3 审核量


It is quite common for a moderately successful app to receive thousands of new user reviews per release<sup>3</sup> that can potentially provide developers with valuable information they can use to improve the quality of their apps (Al-Subaihin et al., 2021) and increase user satisfaction and engagement (Thakur, 2018; Sheng, 2019; Park & Allen, 2013). For example, users may write online reviews to express their negative or positive experiences with a product (Thakur, 2018).<sup>4</sup> Thus, the volume of user reviews following a version release is a cue for developers regarding app issues or user engagement with the app (Thakur, 2018; Sheng, 2019).




对于一个相当成功的应用程序来说，每个版本都会收到数千条新用户评论<sup>3</sup>，这很常见，这可能会为开发者提供有价值的信息，他们可以利用这些信息来提高应用程序的质量（Al-Subaihin 等人，2021 年）并提高用户满意度和参与度（Thakur，2018 年；Sheng，2019 年；Park & Allen，2013 年）。例如，用户可能会撰写在线评论来表达他们对产品的负面或正面体验（Thakur，2018）。<sup>4</sup>因此，版本发布后的用户评论量可以为开发者提供有关应用问题或用户与应用互动的线索（Thakur，2018；Sheng，2019）。


The volume of reviews related to app issues is likely to correspond to the number of issues identified in the app release or the significance of the issues causing user dissatisfaction. In this case, developers are likely to devote their efforts to addressing the identified app issues in the next release. Thus, as issue-related review volume increases, developers are likely to dedicate more of their limited time toward addressing user issues, i.e., exploitation activities. This response is reasonable given the developers’ objective to improve the quality of their apps in order to satisfy the largest number of users.




与应用程序问题相关的评论量可能与应用程序版本中发现的问题数量或导致用户不满意的问题的严重程度相对应。在这种情况下，开发人员可能会致力于在下一个版本中解决已识别的应用程序问题。因此，随着与问题相关的评论量的增加，开发人员可能会将更多的有限时间用于解决用户问题，即利用活动。鉴于开发人员的目标是提高应用程序的质量以满足最大数量的用户，这种反应是合理的。


In addition, some reviews may reflect engaged users experience with the app and reflect their desires and expectations (Park & Allen, 2013; Thakur, 2018). In this sense, engaged users are participants in the development of the app. Prior research in marketing has found that firms that respond to user reviews can quickly strengthen these users’ engagement and loyalty to the firm (Sheng, 2019). By responding to their reviews, developers signal to engaged users that their voices are being heard and addressed, which in turn increases users’ engagement with the app. This will likely motivate developers to devote their time and effort toward addressing users’ online needs. Accordingly, as the volume of online reviews increases, developers are likely to devote more effort to exploitation activities at the expense of exploration activities, i.e., increase their exploitation-exploration orientation.




此外，一些评论可能反映了用户对应用程序的参与体验，并反映了他们的愿望和期望（Park & Allen，2013；Thakur，2018）。从这个意义上说，参与的用户是应用程序开发的参与者。先前的营销研究发现，对用户评论做出回应的公司可以快速增强这些用户对公司的参与度和忠诚度（Sheng，2019）。通过回复他们的评论，开发人员向参与的用户发出信号，表明他们的声音正在被听到和解决，这反过来又增加了用户对应用程序的参与度。这可能会激励开发人员投入时间和精力来满足用户的在线需求。相应地，随着在线评论量的增加，开发者可能会以牺牲探索活动为代价，将更多精力投入到开发活动中，即增加开发-探索导向。


However, after a certain level, a higher review volume is likely to result in a greater cognitive load for developers which diminishes their ability to process the information. While prior studies have found that individuals’ decision quality increased with increased information, there was an inverted U-curve between the amount of information and decision quality under conditions of time pressure (Herbig & Kramer, 1994; Hahn et al., 1992; Buchanan & Kock, 2001). More specifically, under time constraints, individuals’ decision quality improved with increased information and then decreased as the volume of information increased. This U-curve relation can be explained by information overload, which suggests that especially under conditions of time pressure, individuals become confused because they are unable to locate and identify the relevant and critical information needed to make effective decisions (Buchanan & Kock, 2001; Herbig & Kramer, 1994). Consequently, individuals cope with information overload by ignoring a large amount of the available information (Malhotra, 1984).




然而，在达到一定水平之后，较高的评论量可能会给开发人员带来更大的认知负担，从而削弱他们处理信息的能力。虽然先前的研究发现个体的决策质量随着信息的增加而提高，但在时间压力条件下，信息量和决策质量之间存在倒U型曲线（Herbig＆Kramer，1994；Hahn等，1992；Buchanan＆Kock，2001）。更具体地说，在时间限制下，个人的决策质量随着信息的增加而提高，然后随着信息量的增加而降低。这种 U 型曲线关系可以用信息超载来解释，这表明，特别是在时间压力的情况下，个人会变得困惑，因为他们无法定位和识别做出有效决策所需的相关和关键信息（Buchanan & Kock，2001；Herbig & Kramer，1994）。因此，个人通过忽略大量可用信息来应对信息过载（Malhotra，1984）。


Therefore, due to time and resource constraints, developers facing information overload are likely to ignore a large number of users’ reviews. Hence, while an increasing volume of reviews provides developers with the information they can use to update their apps, at a certain point, the volume of information will become overwhelming, thus reducing their ability to process the information and address users’ reviews, i.e. reduce their exploitation-exploration orientation. As such, whereas increased user reviews provide developers with information they can use to improve their apps and satisfy their users, too much information is likely to confuse them. This suggests that with increasing information overload, developers will become less certain about what information from user feedback they should use to update their apps, and the utility of addressing user feedback will become more ambiguous. As such, beyond a certain point, an increased user review volume is likely to overload developers and diminish their ability to process the content of these reviews and incorporate them into app updates, i.e., reducing exploitation activities.




因此，由于时间和资源的限制，面临信息过载的开发者很可能会忽略大量用户的评论。因此，虽然越来越多的评论为开发者提供了可用于更新应用程序的信息，但到了一定程度，信息量将变得难以承受，从而降低了他们处理信息和处理用户评论的能力，即降低了他们的开发探索导向。因此，虽然增加的用户评论为开发人员提供了可用于改进应用程序并满足用户需求的信息，但太多的信息可能会让他们感到困惑。这表明，随着信息过载的增加，开发人员将越来越不确定他们应该使用用户反馈中的哪些信息来更新他们的应用程序，并且解决用户反馈的效用将变得更加模糊。因此，超过某一点，用户评论量的增加可能会使开发人员超载，并削弱他们处理这些评论内容并将其纳入应用程序更新的能力，即减少利用活动。


Hence, given that exploitation and exploration activities compete for developers’ attention, the net result will be a curvilinear effect on exploitationexploration orientation in the following app update release. This motivates our third hypothesis:




因此，考虑到开发和探索活动争夺开发者的注意力，最终的结果将是在接下来的应用程序更新版本中对开发探索方向产生曲线效应。这激发了我们的第三个假设：


H3: Review volume has a curvilinear (inverted U shape) effect on the exploitation-exploration orientation in app updates.




H3：评论量对应用程序更新中的开发探索方向具有曲线（倒 U 形）效应。


## 3 Methods




## 3种方法


## 3.1 Data




## 3.1 数据


We sampled Android apps and then collected and integrated data about the apps’ release history and user reviews from the following sources. First, we obtained a list of 8,950 popular Google Play app titles from APK4Fun. Second, we collected each app’s general information and release history from AppAnnie, a leading aggregator of mobile market data. For each app, this platform provides detailed app information, including description, category, and review rating (e.g., number of stars). It also provides detailed information about each app’s version release, including the release date, new features, and updates.




我们对 Android 应用程序进行了采样，然后从以下来源收集并整合了有关应用程序的发布历史和用户评论的数据。首先，我们从 APK4Fun 获取了 8,950 个热门 Google Play 应用程序的列表。其次，我们从领先的移动市场数据聚合商 AppAnnie 收集了每个应用程序的一般信息和发布历史记录。对于每个应用程序，该平台提供详细的应用程序信息，包括描述、类别和评论评级（例如星级）。它还提供有关每个应用程序版本发布的详细信息，包括发布日期、新功能和更新。


Third, we collected app reviews from AppBot, which is a mainstream app review aggregation platform. This platform provides complete reviews and analytics from Google Play Store apps. Because the analytics were only available for apps released after 2014, we selected apps that were created after April 12, 2015 in order to capture all user reviews of an app and its trajectory since its inception. Consequently, given that our study examined the effect of user reviews on app updates, we removed apps with fewer than 10 releases and those that had no reviews between consecutive releases. This left us with a sample of 1190 apps. AppBot usage limitation constrained us to a random selection of 10% of the apps. We reviewed the selected apps and found our selection to be representative of major app segments such as business, lifestyle, and education. Finally, for the 119 selected apps, we extracted all reviews written in English between April 13, 2015 and May 26, 2017. Each app had an average of 13.83 releases, resulting in a final dataset of 1,046,553 reviews for the 119 apps. Each review included the review date, content, subject, rating, app version, author, and emotion. This data was aggregated at the release level of each app to construct an app-release panel dataset.




第三，我们从主流应用程序评论聚合平台AppBot收集了应用程序评论。该平台提供来自 Google Play 商店应用程序的完整评论和分析。由于分析仅适用于 2014 年之后发布的应用程序，因此我们选择了 2015 年 4 月 12 日之后创建的应用程序，以便捕获应用程序的所有用户评论及其自推出以来的轨迹。因此，考虑到我们的研究考察了用户评论对应用程序更新的影响，我们删除了版本少于 10 个的应用程序以及连续版本之间没有评论的应用程序。这给我们留下了 1190 个应用程序的样本。 AppBot 使用限制使我们只能随机选择 10% 的应用程序。我们审查了所选的应用程序，发现我们的选择代表了商业、生活方式和教育等主要应用程序领域。最后，对于 119 个选定的应用程序，我们提取了 2015 年 4 月 13 日至 2017 年 5 月 26 日期间用英文撰写的所有评论。每个应用程序平均有 13.83 个版本，最终数据集为 119 个应用程序的 1,046,553 条评论。每条评论都包含评论日期、内容、主题、评分、应用版本、作者和情感。该数据在每个应用程序的发布级别进行聚合，以构建应用程序发布面板数据集。


## 3.2 Variables and Measurements




## 3.2 变量和测量


The dependent (i.e., exploitation-exploration orientation and app success) and independent variables (i.e., review concurrence and review volume) were operationalized as follows.




因变量（即开发探索方向和应用程序成功）和自变量（即审核并发度和审核量）的操作如下。


## 3.2.1 Exploitation-Exploration Orientation




## 3.2.1 开发-探索导向


We measured exploitation-exploration orientation as the degree of exploitation to which developers devoted their app update efforts. The choice to measure orientation from an exploitation perspective was motivated by our intention to examine the effects of user reviews on app developers. Therefore, exploitation-exploration orientation was measured using the following formula:




我们将开发-探索导向衡量为开发人员致力于应用程序更新工作的开发程度。选择从开发角度衡量方向的动机是我们想要检查用户评论对应用程序开发人员的影响。因此，利用以下公式来衡量开发-探索方向：


$$
E x p l o i t a t i o n - E x p l o r a t i o n O r i e n t a t i o n
$$




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


$$
= \frac {U p d a t e E x p l o i t a t i o n}{U p d a t e E x p l o i t a t i o n + U p d a t e E x p l o r a t i o n}
$$




$$
= \frac {更新扩展}{更新扩展 + 更新扩展}
$$


Update exploitation measures app version updates that reflect users’ review feedback following the prior release. This part was quantified using the similarity between the description of the current release of the app and the content of the reviews following the previous release. More specifically, for each app release, we compared two texts. The first comprised all user reviews generated between the previous and the current release of the app. The second consisted of the updated feature texts of the current release. These texts were then cleaned according to standard text preprocessing procedures (Bird, 2006), which included removing the stop words and stemming. The count of the resulting matched content words between the two texts provided the measurement for update exploitation. In contrast, update exploration was measured as the number of content words in the updated feature texts of the current release that were not in the user’s previous reviews. A higher exploitationexploration orientation value indicates that app developers’ activities tilted more toward exploitation, i.e., the app updates reflected users’ feedback.




更新利用措施应用程序版本更新，反映用户在先前版本之后的评论反馈。这部分是利用应用程序当前版本的描述与上一版本之后的评论内容之间的相似性来量化的。更具体地说，对于每个应用程序版本，我们比较了两个文本。第一个包含应用程序的先前版本和当前版本之间生成的所有用户评论。第二个包含当前版本的更新功能文本。然后根据标准文本预处理程序（Bird，2006）对这些文本进行清理，其中包括删除停用词和词干。两个文本之间所得到的匹配内容词的计数提供了更新利用的测量。相比之下，更新探索的衡量标准是当前版本的更新功能文本中未出现在用户之前评论中的实词数量。较高的剥削探索导向值表明应用程序开发者的活动更倾向于剥削，即应用程序更新反映了用户的反馈。


Our exploitation-exploration orientation measure is based on the assumption that there is a trade-off between exploitation and exploration, which implies a negative correlation between both activities. This assumption was validated with an average correlation factor of -0.48 (p < 0.01) between these two measurements within the same app, indicating that developers engaged in exploitation at the expense of exploration and vice versa.




我们的开发-探索导向措施基于这样的假设：开发和探索之间存在权衡，这意味着两种活动之间存在负相关性。这一假设得到了验证，同一应用程序中这两个测量值之间的平均相关系数为 -0.48 (p < 0.01)，这表明开发人员以牺牲探索为代价进行开发，反之亦然。


## 3.2.2 App Success




## 3.2.2 应用成功


While information systems success has been defined in numerous ways, including rating (Tiwana, 2015) and survival on top charts (Lee & Raghu, 2014), Agarwal and Tiwana (2015, p. 478) argued that a system’s mortality may be “the most meaningful” outcome measure. This is particularly a meaningful view of app success because of the fast-changing nature of mobile devices and the need to continuously update apps for them to work on new operating systems and hardware infrastructures. In this environment, apps that fail to continuously release new updates quickly become obsolete (Lee & Raghu, 2014; Palomba et al., 2018; Zhou et al., 2018). Thus, we define an app’s market success by its survival in the marketplace. This survival depends on users’ adopting the app, which in turn provides developers with resources to continue updating their apps.




虽然信息系统的成功有多种定义，包括评级（Tiwana，2015）和排行榜上的生存率（Lee & Raghu，2014），但 Agarwal 和 Tiwana（2015，第 478 页）认为系统的死亡率可能是“最有意义”的结果衡量标准。这是应用程序成功的一个特别有意义的观点，因为移动设备具有快速变化的性质，并且需要不断更新应用程序以使其在新的操作系统和硬件基础设施上运行。在这种环境下，无法持续发布新更新的应用程序很快就会被淘汰（Lee & Raghu, 2014；Palomba et al., 2018；Zhou et al., 2018）。因此，我们通过应用程序在市场中的生存来定义其市场成功。这种生存取决于用户对应用程序的采用，这反过来又为开发人员提供了继续更新其应用程序的资源。


The market success of the app was operationalized as the release of new updates, which serves as an indicator of survival in the marketplace. However, this data was right censored because app developers steadily release new versions in a stochastic manner over a period of time and then become inactive. While inactivity signals exiting the market, developers may still release an update after a period of inactivity. Accordingly, we employed survival analysis to estimate the probability of survival using app release frequencies as well as timing.




该应用程序的市场成功通过新更新的发布来实现，这是市场生存的指标。然而，这些数据受到了正确的审查，因为应用程序开发人员在一段时间内以随机方式稳定发布新版本，然后变得不活跃。虽然不活动表明退出市场，但开发人员仍可能在一段时间不活动后发布更新。因此，我们采用生存分析，通过应用程序发布频率和时间来估计生存概率。


To model whether app developers would release new versions using past data, we used the Pareto/Negative binomial distribution (Pareto/NBD) survival models (Schmittlein et al., 1987). This model is widely accepted and used for forecasting customer churn (Fader et al., 2005) which is a similar context to ours— although customers purchase regularly for a period, they may become inactive. This model includes two components. The first is the Pareto component which models the time to inactivity, and the second is the NBD component, which models the frequency of purchases. This model requires two main inputs to estimate the probabilities of survival: recency, which describes when the last update occurred, and frequency, which shows how many releases an app had within a specific time period. We used the previous release history to estimate the probability of a new release for each app (i.e., survival). Further, given that the average time in days between each app release was about a month, we used the Lifetimes Python package<sup>5</sup> to estimate the probability of app short-term and long-term survival within one month and three years consecutively.<sup>6</sup>




为了模拟应用程序开发人员是否会使用过去的数据发布新版本，我们使用了帕累托/负二项分布 (Pareto/NBD) 生存模型 (Schmittlein et al., 1987)。该模型被广泛接受并用于预测客户流失（Fader et al., 2005），这与我们的环境类似——尽管客户在一段时间内定期购买，但他们可能会变得不活跃。该模型包括两个组件。第一个是 Pareto 组件，对不活动时间进行建模，第二个是 NBD 组件，对购买频率进行建模。该模型需要两个主要输入来估计生存概率：新近度（描述上次更新发生的时间）和频率（显示应用程序在特定时间段内发布的数量）。我们使用之前的发布历史记录来估计每个应用程序新版本的概率（即生存率）。此外，考虑到每个应用发布之间的平均时间间隔约为一个月，我们使用 Lifetimes Python 包<sup>5</sup>来估计应用在连续一个月和三年内短期和长期生存的概率。<sup>6</sup>


## 3.2.3 Review Volume and Review Concurrence




## 3.2.3 审阅量和审阅并发数


Following previous studies that have viewed review volume as the number of issues competing for attention (Haas et al., 2015), we measured it as the number of reviews in thousands created before the current release and after the previous release for the same app. The new construct of review concurrence was measured as follows. We first used the standard text processing procedure of removing the stop words and stemming the remaining words to extract content words. Then, we kept the words appearing in at least two reviews, leaving a total of 2827 words, which were ranked based on their frequencies. Finally, one expert familiar with app development went through the remaining list and removed irrelevant words. Our final list included 467 words related to apps and their features. Then, for each release of every app, we extracted all reviews generated between the current release and the previous release for the same app and also implemented the standard text processing procedure. Next, we counted the number of keywords in these reviews and the number of reviews that contain each keyword, to calculate review concurrence as follows:




之前的研究将评论量视为争夺关注的问题数量（Haas 等，2015），我们将其衡量为同一应用程序在当前版本之前和上一个版本之后创建的评论数量（以千计）。审查一致性的新结构测量如下。我们首先使用标准文本处理过程，即删除停用词并对剩余单词进行词干提取以提取内容词。然后，我们保留出现在至少两次评论中的单词，总共留下 2827 个单词，并根据它们的频率进行排名。最后，一位熟悉应用程序开发的专家检查了剩余的列表并删除了不相关的单词。我们的最终列表包括 467 个与应用程序及其功能相关的单词。然后，对于每个应用程序的每个版本，我们提取了同一应用程序的当前版本和先前版本之间生成的所有评论，并实施了标准文本处理程序。接下来，我们统计这些评论中的关键词数量以及包含每个关键词的评论数量，计算评论并发度，如下所示：


$$
\text { Review   Concurrence } _ {i j} = \frac {\sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \# o f R e v i e w s _ {k i j}}{\# o f R e v i e w s _ {i j} \times K _ {i j}}
$$




$$
\text { 审核并发度 } _ {i j} = \frac {\sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \# o of R e v i e w s _ {k i j}}{\# o f R e v i e w s _ {i j} \times K _ {i j}}
$$

在哪里 ？？？？？？？？？？？？ ????????????????????? $^ { ? } i j$ 用于应用程序 i 的版本 j。 #??????????????? $\varsigma _ { k i j }$ 是包含应用程序 i 的版本 j 的关键字 k 的评论数量。 #??????????????? ${ \dot { \boldsymbol { \mathfrak { s } } } } _ { i j } .$ 是应用程序 i 的版本 j 的评论数。 $K _ { i j }$ 是应用程序 i 的版本 j 的关键字总数。


## 3.2.4 Control Variables




## 3.2.4 控制变量


We measured two groups of variables to control for the heterogeneity of reviews and app releases. The first group is review and release control information, which consists of seven variables measuring the characteristics of reviews created between the current release and the previous release of an app. These are rating, sentiment, review length, release, update length, review velocity, and quarter. The second group, app control information, consists of four variables measuring the characteristics of the current release: inapp purchase, app category, user base, and Android system. The variables’ definitions and measures are described in Table 1, and their descriptive statistics and correlation matrix are shown in Table 2.




我们测量了两组变量来控制评论和应用程序发布的异质性。第一组是评论和发布控制信息，其中包含七个变量，用于衡量应用程序的当前版本和先前版本之间创建的评论的特征。这些是评级、情绪、评论长度、发布、更新长度、评论速度和季度。第二组是应用程序控制信息，由四个衡量当前版本特征的变量组成：应用程序内购买、应用程序类别、用户群和 Android 系统。变量的定义和测量如表1所示，其描述性统计和相关矩阵如表2所示。

## 4 分析和结果


## 4.1 Effect of Exploitation-Exploration Orientation on App Success




## 4.1 开发探索方向对应用程序成功的影响


## 4.1.1 Main Analysis




## 4.1.1 主要分析


We tested the effect of developers’ exploitationexploration orientation activities on apps’ success, measured by their survival in the marketplace over time (H1). Given that the dependent variable is a probability (survival) that was censored, we applied Tobit models at the app level of analysis, with exploitation-exploration orientation as the independent variable. We estimated the following model:




我们测试了开发人员的开发探索导向活动对应用程序成功的影响，以应用程序在市场中随时间的生存情况来衡量（H1）。鉴于因变量是经过审查的概率（生存），我们在应用程序级别的分析中应用了 Tobit 模型，以开发探索方向作为自变量。我们估计了以下模型：


$$
\begin{array}{r l} & Y _ {i t} \\ & = \alpha + \beta_ {0} \times U p d a t e E x p l o i t a t i o n _ {i t} \\ & + \beta_ {1} \\ & \times E x p l o i t a t i o n - E x p l o r a t i o n O r i e n t a t i o n _ {i t} \\ & + \beta_ {2} \\ & \times E x p l o i t a t i o n - E x p l o r a t i o n O r i e n t a t i o n _ {i t} ^ {2} \\ & + \gamma \times X _ {i t} + \varepsilon_ {i t} \end{array}\tag{1}
$$




$$
\begin{array}{r l} & Y _ {i t} \\ & = \alpha + \beta_ {0} \times Up p d a t e 探索 _ {i t} \\ & + \beta_ {1} \\ & \times 探索 - 探索方向on _ {i t} \\ & + \beta_ {2} \\ & \times 探索 - 探索 方向 _ {i t} ^ {2} \\ & + \gamma \times X _ {i t} + \varepsilon_ {i t} \end{array}\tag{1}
$$


where $Y _ { i }$ is the survival probability of an app $i , \beta _ { 1 }$ is the ???????????????????????? − ?????????????????????? ?????????????????????? $_ { i t }$ parameter that measures the linear relationship of exploitation to exploration, and $\beta _ { 2 }$ , is the quadratic term of ???????????????????????? − ?????????????????????? ?????????????????????? $_ { i t }$ that measures the nonlinear effects of exploitation. $X _ { i t }$ represents a vector of covariates that may influence developers’ decisions, including review information, release, app control information, and quarter dummies, as specified in Table 1. It is worth noting this model excludes update exploration given the high multicollinearity between update exploitation and update exploration (VIF value of 8.22). We estimated two model specifications using Survival at 1 month and Survival at 3 years as the dependent variables, which respectively examine short-term and long-term survival.




其中 $Y _ { i }$ 是应用程序 $i 的生存概率， \beta _ { 1 }$ 是 ???????????????????????? - ???????????????????????? ???????????????????????? $_ { i t }$ 参数测量利用与探索的线性关系，而 $\beta _ { 2 }$ 是 ???????????????????????? 的二次项- ???????????????????????? ???????????????????????? $_ { i t }$ 衡量剥削的非线性影响。 $X _ { i t }$ 表示可能影响开发人员决策的协变量向量，包括评论信息、版本、应用程序控制信息和季度虚拟变量，如表 1 所示。我们进一步控制了 ???????????? ???????????????????????? $_ { i t } ,$ 衡量更新利用情况。值得注意的是，鉴于更新利用和更新探索之间存在高度多重共线性（VIF 值为 8.22），该模型排除了更新探索。我们使用 1 个月生存率和 3 年生存率作为因变量估计了两个模型规范，分别检查短期和长期生存。


The results are reported in Table 3 and are consistent with H1, demonstrating an inverted U-shaped relationship between exploitation-exploration orientation and app short and long-term survival. <sup>7</sup> While the coefficients of the exploitation-exploration orientation variable are statistically (positively) related to app short and long-term survival, the quadratic terms are significantly (negatively) associated with app survival. We found that exploitation-exploration orientation is positively associated with app survival up to a point after which this positive relationship declines. To calculate the threshold’s inflection point, we used the following equation for the polynomial regression of exploitation-exploration orientation:




结果如表 3 所示，与 H1 一致，表明开发-探索方向与应用程序短期和长期生存之间存在倒 U 形关系。 <sup>7</sup> 虽然开发-探索方向变量的系数与应用程序的短期和长期生存率在统计上（正）相关，但二次项与应用程序的生存率显着（负）相关。我们发现，开发-探索方向与应用程序的生存呈正相关，直到一定程度后，这种正相关关系就会下降。为了计算阈值的拐点，我们使用以下方程进行开发-探索方向的多项式回归：


$$
\begin{array}{l} Y = \beta_ {0} + \beta_ {1} E x p l o i t a t i o n - \\ E x p l o r a t i o n o r i e n t a t i o n + \beta_ {2} E x p l o i t a t i o n - \\ E x p l o r a t i o n o r i e n t a t i o n ^ {2} + \varepsilon . \end{array}
$$




$$
\begin{array}{l} Y = \beta_ {0} + \beta_ {1} 扩展 - \\ 扩展 + \beta_ {2} 扩展 - \\ 扩展 ^ {2} + \varepsilon 。 \结束{数组}
$$


We then computed the inflection point by the coefficients of the predictor exploitation-exploration orientation as shown by the following equation: Orientation $i n f l e c t i o n = - \beta _ { 1 } / 2 \beta _ { 2 }$ . The inflection point is 0.433 (exploitation activities are 0.76 (=0.433/(1- 0.433)) times more than developer’s exploration activities) for short-term survival; additionally, this U-shaped pattern is illustrated in Figure 2. Thus, H1 is supported.

<table><tr><td>构造</td><td>定义</td><td>衡量</td></tr><tr><td>成功</td><td>应用程序在市场中的生存率。</td><td>衡量应用程序生存一个月（短期）和三年（长期）的可能性的概率</td></tr><tr><td>更新开发</td><td>新应用版本中的开发活动程度</td><td>当前版本更新文本的特征文本与同一应用在当前版本之前和上一版本之后创建的评论之间匹配的内容词数量</td></tr><tr><td>更新探索</td><td>新应用版本中的探索活动程度</td><td>新版本的功能文本中的内容词数量更新但不在同一应用的先前评论中</td></tr><tr><td>开发-探索方向</td><td>开发人员在新应用版本中参与开发与探索活动的程度</td><td>该变量使用以下公式进行测量：开发 - 探索方向 = 更新开发 + 更新探索</td></tr><tr><td>评论并发</td><td>用户数量级应用程序发布后，他们对同一问题的评论趋于一致。</td><td>该值使用以下公式计算：Review Concurrenceij = Σk=1k #ofReviewskij / #ofReviewsij × KijReview Concurrenceij 适用于应用程序 i 的版本 j。 #ofReviewskij 是包含应用程序 i 的版本 j 的关键字 k 的评论数量。 #ofReviewsij 是应用程序 i 的版本 j 的评论数量。 Kij 是应用程序 i 的版本 j 的关键字总数</td></tr><tr><td>评论量</td><td>应用程序发布后开发者收到的用户评论数量</td><td>同一应用程序在新版本发布之前和上一版本发布之后创建的评论数量（以千为单位）</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">用户评论和应用发布控制变量</td></tr><tr><td>平均评分</td><td>用平均评分衡量的应用声誉。</td><td>消费者在新版本发布之前和上一版本发布之后对应用版本给出的平均评分。此变量的范围从 1 到 5。</td></tr><tr><td>平均评论数 (k)</td><td>截至当前版本的每个版本的平均用户评论数</td><td>截至当前版本的应用程序每个版本的平均评论数（以千为单位）</td></tr><tr><td>平均情绪</td><td>消费者对应用程序的情绪app</td><td>新版本之前和上一个版本之后创建的应用版本的平均情绪得分，编码为 1（正面）、-1（负面）或中性 (0)。</td></tr><tr><td>评论长度</td><td>评论的平均长度</td><td>新版本之前和上一个版本之后创建的应用版本的评论中的平均字数版本</td></tr><tr><td>审核速度</td><td>连续审核之间的平均天数</td><td>记录新版本之前和上一个版本之后创建的应用版本的连续审核之间的平均小时数</td></tr><tr><td>版本</td><td>焦点应用的当前版本号。</td><td>焦点当前版本的顺序号应用程序，从1开始</td></tr><tr><td>更新长度</td><td>新版本更新内容的长度。</td><td>新版本中的内容字数。</td></tr><tr><td>季度</td><td>新版本发布的季度</td><td>显示最近应用发布的年份季度的变量第一、第二、第三或第四季度。</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">应用控制变量</td></tr><tr><td>应用内购买</td><td>付费应用</td><td>如果是付费应用，则等于 1，否则为 0</td></tr><tr><td>应用类别</td><td>应用所属的类别</td><td>表示 Google Play 商店提供的应用类别。有 5 个应用类别：教育、商业、娱乐、生活方式和旅行</td></tr><tr><td>用户群</td><td>应用的估计下载次数</td><td>指示应用的估计下载范围的变量。有4个范围：<100万，
1-500万、5-5000万、5000万以上。</td></tr></table>
