## 4.1.2 Robustness Tests




## 4.1.2 稳健性测试


In our main analysis, we measured exploitation and exploration according to whether the features described in the app updates appeared in app users’ reviews. This is a conservative method that captures exactly matched text content found in user reviews and update descriptions and may not capture the semantic similarity between user reviews and mobile app update descriptions. For example, a user request could suggest that “it would be better to show playing duration of the song,” while the app update text might state: “Added an option to display the song remaining time on the player screen.” Although both texts discuss the same topic—displaying song play time, our conservative approach of exact matching would not capture this review as being exploited. To address this concern and test the robustness of our findings, we implemented the BERT (bidirectional encoder representations for transformers) model to capture the semantic similarity of these two texts (see Koroteev, 2021, for a review). The output of this process is a semantic similarity score ranging from 0 (absolutely not similar) to 1 (almost identical). The higher the score, the more exploitation activity is undertaken by the developer. In the given example above, the similarity score of 0.803 indicates that these two texts have similar content. We implemented this approach to quantify the semantic similarity between app update descriptions and app user reviews and also used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to verify the performance of our similarity analysis.




在我们的主要分析中，我们根据应用程序更新中描述的功能是否出现在应用程序用户的评论中来衡量利用和探索。这是一种保守的方法，可以捕获用户评论和更新描述中完全匹配的文本内容，并且可能无法捕获用户评论和移动应用程序更新描述之间的语义相似性。例如，用户请求可能会建议“最好显示歌曲的播放持续时间”，而应用程序更新文本可能会指出：“添加了在播放器屏幕上显示歌曲剩余时间的选项。”尽管两篇文章都讨论了相同的主题——显示歌曲播放时间，但我们保守的精确匹配方法不会将这条评论视为被利用。为了解决这个问题并测试我们研究结果的稳健性，我们实现了 BERT（变压器双向编码器表示）模型来捕获这两个文本的语义相似性（请参阅 Koroteev，2021 年的评论）。此过程的输出是语义相似度得分，范围从 0（绝对不相似）到 1（几乎相同）。分数越高，开发者进行的开发活动就越多。在上面给出的示例中，相似度得分为 0.803 表明这两个文本具有相似的内容。我们实施了这种方法来量化应用程序更新描述和应用程序用户评论之间的语义相似性，并使用 Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) 来验证我们的相似性分析的性能。


We then repeated our H1 analysis using this alternative measurement. Specifically, we replaced update exploitation, exploitation-exploration orientation, and the exploitation-exploration orientation quadratic term in the main analysis with this newly created measurement and its quadratic term. The results are consistent with those in our main analysis. That is, the semantic similarity between app update descriptions and app user reviews is positively associated with app survival up to a threshold after which this positive relationship declines. The detailed process of this robustness test and its results are provided in Appendix A.




然后我们使用这种替代测量方法重复我们的 H1 分析。具体来说，我们用这个新创建的测量及其二次项替换了主要分析中的更新开发、开发-探索导向和开发-探索导向二次项。结果与我们主要分析的结果一致。也就是说，应用程序更新描述和应用程序用户评论之间的语义相似性与应用程序生存呈正相关，达到阈值后，这种正相关关系就会下降。稳健性测试的详细过程及其结果在附录 A 中提供。


In the second and third robustness tests, we used two alternative dependent variables to test H1. Specifically, we replaced the dependent variable (app survival) with (1) users’ app ratings and (2) users’ sentiments regarding the app. Accordingly, we estimated two model specifications of the effect of addressing users’ reviews in app updates on their ratings and sentiment. For each app, we used the change in users’ ratings between two consecutive versions as the first new dependent variable in one specification and the change in user sentiment between them as the second new dependent variable in another specification. The main independent variables in both models were exploitationexploration orientation from the earlier app version and its quadratic term. We also included the same set of controls as our main analysis. The results of this analysis are shown in Appendix B (Table B1) and are also consistent with our main analysis results.




在第二次和第三次稳健性检验中，我们使用两个替代因变量来检验 H1。具体来说，我们将因变量（应用程序生存率）替换为 (1) 用户的应用程序评分和 (2) 用户对应用程序的看法。因此，我们估计了应用程序更新中处理用户评论对其评分和情绪的影响的两个模型规范。对于每个应用程序，我们使用两个连续版本之间的用户评分变化作为一个规范中的第一个新因变量，并将它们之间的用户情绪变化作为另一个规范中的第二个新因变量。两个模型中的主要自变量都是早期应用程序版本及其二次项的开发探索方向。我们还包括与我们的主要分析相同的控件集。该分析结果如附录B（表B1）所示，也与我们的主要分析结果一致。


## 4.2 The Effect of Review Concurrence and Volume on Exploitation-Exploration Orientation




## 4.2 复习同时度和复习量对开发探索取向的影响


## 4.2.1 Main Analysis




## 4.2.1 主要分析


Initially, we used a visual approach to explore the curvilinear effect of review volume on exploitationexploration orientation (H3). Specifically, we regressed exploitation-exploration orientation on review volume and its quadratic term. Then, we plotted the resulting fitted line along with a 95% confidence interval, showing support for a curvilinear relation. As shown in Figure 3, exploitation-exploration orientation initially increases with the increase of review volume, then gradually drops after review volume reaches a value of around 3.5 (the log value of the number of reviews in thousands).




最初，我们使用视觉方法来探索评论量对开发探索方向的曲线效应（H3）。具体来说，我们对评论量及其二次项回归了开发探索方向。然后，我们绘制了所得的拟合线以及 95% 置信区间，显示了对曲线关系的支持。如图3所示，开发-探索取向最初随着评论量的增加而增加，然后在评论量达到3.5左右（评论数的对数值，以千为单位）后逐渐下降。


We ran two regression specifications to test H2 and H3. The dependent variable was exploitation-exploration orientation. Specification 1 included review concurrence, and review volume and its quadratic term as the independent variables and tested their effects on exploitation-exploration orientation without covariates. On top of Specification 1, Specification 2 included additional control variables in the user reviews and app release control variables group in Table 1. In both specifications, we also included quarter dummies to control for time effects. We estimated the following OLS models with app fixed effects:




我们运行两个回归规范来测试 H2 和 H3。因变量是开发-探索方向。规范 1 将评论并发度、评论量及其二次项作为自变量，并在没有协变量的情况下测试了它们对开发-探索方向的影响。除了规范 1 之外，规范 2 在表 1 中的用户评论和应用程序发布控制变量组中还包括了额外的控制变量。在这两个规范中，我们还包含了季度虚拟变量来控制时间效应。我们估计了以下具有应用程序固定效应的 OLS 模型：


$$

where $Y _ { i t }$ is the exploitation-exploration orientation between update contents of the $i ^ { \bar { t h } }$ release and review contents between the $i ^ { t h }$ release and $( i - I ) ^ { t h }$ release. ReviewVolume<sub>it</sub> and ReviewConcurrence<sub>it</sub> are the main independent variables. ## 4.2.2 Addressing Endogeneity




## 4.2.2 解决内生性


There are three potential endogeneity risks in our analysis. The first is reverse causality, which is not an issue in the present study, given that the outcomedependent variable lagged the independent variables by one time period (i.e., previous reviews caused subsequent app updates). The other two potential endogeneity risks are omitted variables and simultaneity. Regarding omitted variables, developers’ decisions may be influenced by other information, such as privacy policies that necessitate additional security features. These variables correlated with our endogenous variables (review concurrence and review volume) and entered into the error term when omitted, resulting in endogeneity. In contrast, simultaneity arises when the independent variables are simultaneously determined along with the dependent variable. In particular, apps within the same category cross-influence app developers and users. An additional feature in other apps could lead app developers of the focal app to add that feature and users of focal apps to comment on that feature.




我们的分析存在三个潜在的内生性风险。第一个是反向因果关系，这在本研究中不是问题，因为结果依赖变量滞后于自变量一个时间段（即之前的评论导致随后的应用程序更新）。另外两个潜在的内生性风险是遗漏变量和同时性。关于省略的变量，开发人员的决策可能会受到其他信息的影响，例如需要额外安全功能的隐私政策。这些变量与我们的内生变量（审阅并发数和审阅量）相关，并且在省略时进入误差项，从而产生内生性。相反，当自变量与因变量同时确定时，就会出现同时性。特别是，同一类别内的应用程序会交叉影响应用程序开发人员和用户。其他应用程序中的附加功能可能会导致焦点应用程序的应用程序开发人员添加该功能，并导致焦点应用程序的用户对该功能发表评论。


These endogenous concerns are commonly addressed by using instrumental variables (IV) (Wooldridge, 2010). The instrumental variables need to be exogenous (uncorrelated with the error term) but partially correlated with endogenous variables. However, finding appropriate instrumental variables in panel data is challenging because of time-related shocks that may occur during the data generation of both independent and exogenous variables (Menon & Kohli, 2013). Following common practice in IS studies using panel data (e.g., Chen et al., 2015; Greenwood & Gopal, 2015; Jabr & Zheng, 2014), we implemented the dynamic model proposed by Arellano and Bond (1991) to address these concerns. In the dynamic panel model, the lag terms of the dependent variable and endogenous explanatory variables (i.e., review volume and review concurrence) are exogenous, and can therefore be used as instrumental variables (Mallipeddi et al., 2021). More specifically, we implemented the system generalized method of moment (GMM) estimator (Arellano & Bond, 1991) to help resolve the endogenous issues described above. The estimator employs a system of two equations:




这些内生性问题通常通过使用工具变量 (IV) 来解决（Wooldridge，2010）。工具变量必须是外生的（与误差项不相关），但与内生变量部分相关。然而，在面板数据中找到适当的工具变量具有挑战性，因为在自变量和外生变量的数据生成过程中可能会发生与时间相关的冲击（Menon & Kohli，2013）。遵循使用面板数据进行信息系统研究的常见做法（例如，Chen 等人，2015 年；Greenwood & Gopal，2015 年；Jabr & Cheng，2014 年），我们实施了 Arellano 和 Bond (1991) 提出的动态模型来解决这些问题。在动态面板模型中，因变量和内生解释变量（即审阅量和审阅并发度）的滞后项是外生的，因此可以用作工具变量（Mallipeddi et al., 2021）。更具体地说，我们实现了系统广义矩法 (GMM) 估计器（Arellano & Bond，1991）来帮助解决上述内生问题。估计器采用两个方程组：


$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta Y _ {i t} = \alpha \Delta Y _ {i t - 1} + \beta \times \Delta W _ {i t} + \emptyset \Delta X _ {i t} + \Delta \varepsilon_ {i t} \\ \text {(first - differences equation)} \end{array}\tag{4}
$$




$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta Y _ {i t} = \alpha \Delta Y _ {i t - 1} + \beta \times \Delta W _ {i t} + \emptyset \Delta X _ {i t} + \Delta \varepsilon_ {i t} \\ \text {(一阶差分方程)} \end{array}\tag{4}
$$


$$
\begin{array}{l} Y _ {i t} = \alpha Y _ {i t - 1} + \beta \times W _ {i t} + \emptyset X _ {i t} + \varepsilon_ {i t} (\text { levels } \\ \text { equation) } \end{array}\tag{5}
$$




$$
\begin{array}{l} Y _ {i t} = \alpha Y _ {i t - 1} + \beta \times W _ {i t} + \emptyset X _ {i t} + \varepsilon_ {i t} (\text {levels } \\ \text {equation) } \end{array}\tag{5}
$$


where $W _ { i t }$ is a vector of endogenous regressors (????????????????????????<sub>????</sub> and its quadratic terms and ?????????????????????????????????? ). After removing the fixed effects through the first-differences equation (Equation 4), the system GMM estimator uses the lagged values of the differences as instruments with a minimum lag difference of one and a maximum lag difference of five periods.




其中 $W _ { i t }$ 是内生回归量的向量（?????????????????????<sub>????</sub> 及其二次项和??????????????????????????????????????????????????????<sub>????</sub> 及其二次项和???????????????????????????????????????????????????通过一阶差分方程（方程 4）消除固定效应后，系统 GMM 估计器使用差异的滞后值作为工具，最小滞后差为 1 个周期，最大滞后差为 5 个周期。

The Arellano-Bond test suggests that the first-order serial correlation (AR1) is significant, but we did not find evidence of the secondorder serial correlation (AR2). This implies that using t-1 is adequate for our analysis. ## 4.2.3 Robustness Tests




## 4.2.3 稳健性测试


To further confirm our findings of H2 and H3, we ran a series of robustness tests. We first replaced exploitation-exploration orientation with the semantic similarity score used in Section 4.1 as a dependent variable. The two model specifications of Equations (2) and (3) above were then estimated using the alternate dependent variable. The results of this analysis are reported in Columns 2 and 3 of Table 6, further confirming our initial findings, which support H2 and H3.




为了进一步证实 H2 和 H3 的发现，我们进行了一系列稳健性测试。我们首先用第 4.1 节中使用的语义相似度得分作为因变量替换了开发探索方向。然后使用替代因变量估计上述方程（2）和（3）的两个模型规格。该分析的结果报告在表 6 的第 2 列和第 3 列中，进一步证实了我们支持 H2 和 H3 的初步发现。


For the second robustness test, we used a mixed-effects linear model. In the main analysis above (Equations 2 and 3 in Section 4.2.1 above), we ran an app fixedeffects analysis assuming that the estimated parameter ?? did not vary for the different apps, i.e., the estimate is at the app level considering aggregated reviews. However, in reality, these estimates may differ within each app. To account for this in our robustness test, we conducted a linear mixed-effects rather than a linear fixed-effects model. This analysis allowed us to explore the difference in effects between and within apps (Torres-Reyna, 2007). We ran a maximum likelihood estimator and relaxed the assumption to allow both fixed and random effects in our estimates. We thus implemented a multilevel mixed-effects linear model (Rabe-Hesketh et al., 2002), to consider applevel and release-level variables. This model accommodates the dependence between app releases and reviews in addition to the variability in exploitation-exploration orientation within and between apps. The random effects are at the app level. All models include the same set of controls.




对于第二个稳健性测试，我们使用了混合效应线性模型。在上面的主要分析中（上面第 4.2.1 节中的方程 2 和方程 3），我们运行了应用程序固定效应分析，假设估计参数 ??对于不同的应用程序而言，没有变化，即，考虑到汇总评论，估计是在应用程序级别进行的。然而，实际上，每个应用程序中的这些估计可能有所不同。为了在我们的稳健性测试中考虑到这一点，我们进行了线性混合效应而不是线性固定效应模型。该分析使我们能够探索应用程序之间和应用程序内部效果的差异（Torres-Reyna，2007）。我们运行了最大似然估计器并放宽了假设，以允许我们的估计中存在固定效应和随机效应。因此，我们实现了一个多级混合效应线性模型（Rabe-Hesketh 等，2002），以考虑应用级和发布级变量。除了应用程序内部和之间的开发探索方向的可变性之外，该模型还适应应用程序发布和评论之间的依赖性。随机效应发生在应用程序级别。所有型号均包含同一组控件。


The results shown in Columns 4 and 5 of Table 6 confirm our initial findings that review concurrence positively affects exploitation-exploration orientation and that the relationship between review volume and exploitation-exploration orientation is curvilinear. Therefore, these results confirm our main findings, supporting H2 and H3.




表 6 第 4 列和第 5 列中显示的结果证实了我们的初步发现，即评论并发度对开发-探索方向产生积极影响，并且评论量与开发-探索方向之间的关系是曲线形的。因此，这些结果证实了我们的主要发现，支持了 H2 和 H3。

In the last robustness test, we explored how developers are likely to respond to the different types of review content (e.g., system bugs, new features, praise, etc.). More specifically, we implemented automatic approaches to categorize user review content and then investigated whether app developers responded differently to these reviews. The results of this analysis support our main findings by demonstrating that app developers are more likely to include features frequently mentioned by app users. In addition, it demonstrates that developers prioritize user issues (i.e., concerns) over new features requested by users. Appendix C provides the details of this analysis.




在最后的稳健性测试中，我们探讨了开发人员可能如何响应不同类型的评论内容（例如系统错误、新功能、赞扬等）。更具体地说，我们实施了自动方法来对用户评论内容进行分类，然后调查应用程序开发人员对这些评论的反应是否不同。此分析的结果证明应用程序开发人员更有可能包含应用程序用户经常提到的功能，从而支持了我们的主要发现。此外，它还表明开发人员优先考虑用户问题（即关注点）而不是用户请求的新功能。附录 C 提供了该分析的详细信息。


## 4.2.4 Post Hoc Analysis: Moderating Effect of Review Sentiment




## 4.2.4 事后分析：评论情绪的调节作用


One common finding among existing studies on user online reviews is that online reviews can affect consumers’ decisions via review sentiment (e.g., Duan et al., 2008; Yin et al., 2017). App developers (i.e., sellers) in our context are likely aware of the potential effects of review sentiment on app users (i.e., consumers) and are thus likely to consider review sentiment when updating apps. Thus, we explore how review sentiment can moderate the relationship between review volume/concurrence and exploitationexploration orientation. We briefly present this analysis here and provide the results in more detail in Appendix E.




现有关于用户在线评论的研究中一个常见的发现是，在线评论可以通过评论情绪影响消费者的决策（例如，Duan et al., 2008；Yin et al., 2017）。在我们的背景下，应用程序开发人员（即卖家）可能意识到评论情绪对应用程序用户（即消费者）的潜在影响，因此在更新应用程序时可能会考虑评论情绪。因此，我们探讨评论情绪如何调节评论量/并发度与开发探索方向之间的关系。我们在此简要介绍此分析，并在附录 E 中提供更详细的结果。


To measure the moderating effect of review sentiment on our findings, we estimated the same model as our main model but added interaction terms between review sentiment and review volume/concurrence. The results in Table E1 (and Figures E2 and E3) show that with increased negative review sentiment, review volume will have a more positive effect on exploitation-exploration orientation. As noted above, this is expected, given that app users may write online reviews to express their negative or positive experiences with the app. Negative reviews often reflect dissatisfaction from app users, and the extremity of such negative sentiment likely implies the significance of the concern. As such, a large number of negative sentiment reviews are likely to focus app developers’ attention and efforts on addressing identified user issues in the next version release.




为了衡量评论情绪对我们的研究结果的调节作用，我们估计了与我们的主要模型相同的模型，但添加了评论情绪和评论量/并发之间的交互项。表E1（以及图E2和E3）中的结果表明，随着负面评论情绪的增加，评论量将对开发探索方向产生更积极的影响。如上所述，这是预期的，因为应用程序用户可能会撰写在线评论来表达他们对应用程序的负面或正面体验。负面评论通常反映了应用程序用户的不满，而这种负面情绪的极端程度可能意味着担忧的严重性。因此，大量的负面情绪评论可能会吸引应用程序开发人员的注意力和努力，以解决下一个版本发布中已识别的用户问题。


The results in Table E1 also show that with increased review sentiment, there is an insignificant, negative relationship between review concurrence and exploitation-exploration orientation. We would expect that given more recurring positive themes, app developers may believe that the existing features and functionalities of the app have fewer critical problems or that there are fewer complaints about the app. Consequently, developers may make fewer changes in new releases or focus on exploring new innovative features to stay ahead of the competition. However, this insignificant relationship suggests that the relationship between review concurrence and exploitationexploration orientation is less influenced by review sentiment. That said, the negative relationship suggests that while recurring negative themes may compel developers to address the identified issues of dissatisfied users, recurring positive themes may discourage developers from making changes to better satisfy users’ needs and desires.




表E1中的结果还表明，随着评论情绪的增加，评论同意度与开发探索方向之间存在不显着的负相关关系。我们预计，鉴于更多重复出现的积极主题，应用程序开发人员可能会认为该应用程序的现有特性和功能的关键问题较少，或者对该应用程序的投诉较少。因此，开发人员可能会在新版本中进行更少的更改，或者专注于探索新的创新功能，以在竞争中保持领先地位。然而，这种不显着的关系表明评论同意度和开发探索方向之间的关系受评论情绪的影响较小。也就是说，负面关系表明，虽然反复出现的负面主题可能迫使开发人员解决用户不满意的已识别问题，但反复出现的积极主题可能会阻止开发人员做出改变以更好地满足用户的需求和愿望。


## 5 Discussion and Contributions




## 5 讨论和贡献


In the present study, we examined the influence of users’ online reviews on mobile application evolution and success. We distinguished between two types of app evolution mechanisms: exploitation activities, which rely on users’ online reviews, and exploration activities, which are guided by other internal and external sources. The findings suggest that the content and quantity of user reviews influence developers’ resource allocation toward exploitation or exploration activities, which in turn impact app market success. More specifically, the findings support the notion that developers’ design decisions are more likely to focus on issues that affect a large number of users (review concurrence)—i.e., review concurrence positively influences the exploitation-exploration orientation, which we define as prioritizing exploitation. Further, the findings suggest that more reviews following a release engage developers and provide them with the information they need to improve apps based on users’ feedback, thereby increasing their exploitation activities. However, our findings suggest that beyond a certain volume of reviews, developers become overwhelmed by the amount of information and become incapable of addressing the issues identified in the reviews. This finding supports the notion that the number of reviews has a curvilinear relationship with exploitation-exploration orientation. We further found that this relationship is negatively moderated by review sentiment. In addition, and consistent with the principles of learning and innovation (March, 1991), we found that an appropriate mix of exploitation and exploration activities leads to an increased likelihood of app survival in the market.




在本研究中，我们研究了用户在线评论对移动应用程序发展和成功的影响。我们区分了两种类型的应用程序进化机制：依赖于用户在线评论的开发活动和受其他内部和外部来源引导的探索活动。研究结果表明，用户评论的内容和数量会影响开发者对开发或探索活动的资源分配，进而影响应用程序市场的成功。更具体地说，研究结果支持这样一种观点，即开发人员的设计决策更有可能关注影响大量用户的问题（审查并发性），即审查并发性对开发-探索方向产生积极影响，我们将其定义为优先开发。此外，研究结果表明，发布后更多的评论会吸引开发人员，并为他们提供根据用户反馈改进应用程序所需的信息，从而增加他们的利用活动。然而，我们的研究结果表明，超过一定数量的评论后，开发人员就会被大量的信息淹没，并且无法解决评论中发现的问题。这一发现支持了评论数量与开发探索方向呈曲线关系的观点。我们进一步发现这种关系受到评论情绪的负面调节。此外，根据学习和创新的原则（1991 年 3 月），我们发现开发和探索活动的适当组合可以增加应用程序在市场上生存的可能性。


## 5.1 Theoretical Contributions




## 5.1 理论贡献


From a theoretical standpoint, our findings contribute to the IS development literature. With nearly five billion users, mobile apps represent the largest segment of adopted systems, and their widespread proliferation is increasing over time. In 2020, approximately 142.9 billion apps were downloaded (Iqbal, 2021). Yet despite the importance and prevalence of these systems in the IS field, there is surprisingly very little research examining their development, particularly in terms of how developers make design decisions and incorporate users’ feedback in consecutive updates to increase the market success of their apps. A large body of previous




从理论角度来看，我们的研究结果对信息系统发展文献做出了贡献。移动应用程序拥有近 50 亿用户，代表了所采用系统的最大部分，并且随着时间的推移，它们的广泛扩散正在不断增加。 2020 年，应用程序下载量约为 1,429 亿次（Iqbal，2021）。然而，尽管这些系统在 IS 领域非常重要且普遍存在，但令人惊讶的是，很少有研究检验它们的开发，特别是在开发人员如何做出设计决策并将用户反馈纳入连续更新以提高其应用程序的市场成功方面。以前的大体


IS development literature has provided developers with valuable approaches for acquiring users’ organizational and enterprise system needs (Fernandez et al., 2017; Tuunanen et al., 2007). However, these approaches mainly rely on direct communication between users and developers (e.g., Appan & Browne, 2010; Gallivan & Keil, 2003; Hartwick & Barki, 2001; Marakas & Elam, 1998; Pitts & Browne, 2007) that are unlikely to be useful in the context of app development due to the massive, geographically dispersed, heterogeneous user base. Our study extends the IS development literature to the context of massdistributed apps and suggests that developers can acquire knowledge of users’ needs from their online feedback and that they need to strike an appropriate balance between satisfying users’ requests to improve their apps while experimenting with new features.




IS 开发文献为开发人员提供了获取用户组织和企业系统需求的宝贵方法（Fernandez 等，2017；Tuunanen 等，2007）。然而，这些方法主要依赖于用户和开发人员之间的直接通信（例如，Appan & Browne，2010；Gallivan & Keil，2003；Hartwick & Barki，2001；Marakas & Elam，1998；Pitts & Browne，2007），由于用户群庞大、地理分散、异构，因此在应用程序开发环境中不太可能有用。我们的研究将 IS 开发文献扩展到大规模分布式应用程序的背景，并建议开发人员可以从用户的在线反馈中了解用户的需求，并且他们需要在满足用户改进应用程序的请求与尝试新功能之间取得适当的平衡。


Further, the present study also contributes to the organizational learning and innovation literature. First, while prior work has largely conceptualized exploitation and exploration according to an innovation’s industry-level technological or market trajectory (incremental or radical) (Benner & Tushman, 2003), the present study considers these activities at a firm level according to the probability of their acceptance by the existing customer base. More specifically, we conceptualize exploitation activities as incorporating users’ known needs and exploration activities as incorporating features not suggested by users in consecutive app releases. Further, we argue that these activities are incompatible in the context of a small size, dynamic, and competitive app development environment, and that app developers have limited resources that necessitate making a tradeoff between these two activities. This is consistent with the studies by Gupta et al. (2006) and Luger et al. (2018), which suggest that the organizational context determines whether these two activities are complementary or contradictory.




此外，本研究还对组织学习和创新文献做出了贡献。首先，虽然之前的工作主要根据创新的行业级技术或市场轨迹（增量或激进）概念化开发和探索（Benner＆Tushman，2003），但本研究根据现有客户群接受这些活动的概率在公司层面考虑这些活动。更具体地说，我们将利用活动概念化为纳入用户的已知需求，将探索活动概念化为纳入用户在连续应用程序版本中未建议的功能。此外，我们认为这些活动在小规模、动态和竞争性的应用程序开发环境中是不兼容的，并且应用程序开发人员的资源有限，因此需要在这两种活动之间进行权衡。这与 Gupta 等人的研究一致。 （2006）和卢格等人。 （2018），这表明组织环境决定这两项活动是互补还是矛盾。


Second, there is a paucity of prior work investigating what drives the decision to exploit or explore (Raisch et al., 2009). For the most part, prior studies have considered the balancing of exploration and exploitation as a strategic organizational decision with calculative considerations (Levinthal, 2021). For example, some organizations are exploring alternative investment and competitive strategies such as blockchain as an alternative to centralized IT (Miranda et al., 2022). However, the decision could also be the result of organizational forms and processes (March, 1991)—for instance, companies like IBM, 3M, and Google give employees the freedom to pursue projects of their personal interests without management involvement (Manso, 2017). However, the decision to engage in exploration or exploitation activities can also be driven by feedback from the external environment. While prior work has examined the role of external feedback in reinforcing organizational decisionmaking, it has focused on large organizations where there is distance between the top management decision makers and entrepreneurs (e.g., engineers and programmers) (Levinthal, 2021).




其次，之前的工作很少调查驱动开发或探索决策的因素（Raisch 等，2009）。在大多数情况下，先前的研究都将探索和利用的平衡视为具有计算性考虑的战略组织决策（Levinthal，2021）。例如，一些组织正在探索另类投资和竞争策略，例如区块链作为集中式 IT 的替代方案（Miranda 等人，2022）。然而，这一决定也可能是组织形式和流程的结果（1991 年 3 月），例如，IBM、3M 和 Google 等公司让员工可以自由地追求个人利益的项目，而无需管理层参与（Manso，2017 年）。然而，参与勘探或开采活动的决定也可能受到外部环境反馈的影响。虽然之前的工作研究了外部反馈在加强组织决策中的作用，但它主要关注高层管理决策者和企业家（例如工程师和程序员）之间存在距离的大型组织（Levinthal，2021）。


We contribute to this body of work on organizational learning by demonstrating the role of the external environment in exploitation and exploration activity decisions, especially for small organizations that are more sensitive to market feedback. Two characteristics differentiate such small organizations from large ones in terms of exploration and exploitation decisions. First, in contrast to large organizations, small organizations are tightly coupled with their external environment (Adner & Levinthal, 2002). They have higher selection pressure as they lack resources for long-term survival without achieving market success. Hence, small organizations pay more attention to signals about the performance of their products. Second, in small organizations, the distance between entrepreneurs (i.e., developers) and their customers is small, which allows them to scan the environment for further cues and details beyond the market success of their products. Entrepreneurs typically seek feedback to improve their products and services (Dabas et al., 2021; Elias et al., 2018). The present study contributes to this work by providing evidence regarding how feedback characteristics, i.e., review volume and review concurrence, can ultimately affect app developers’ development activities. We further contribute to this line of study by suggesting that review sentiment can moderate the effects of those feedback characteristics on development activities.




我们通过展示外部环境在开发和探索活动决策中的作用，为组织学习的这一工作做出贡献，特别是对于对市场反馈更敏感的小型组织。在勘探和开发决策方面，这些小型组织与大型组织有两个特征不同。首先，与大型组织相比，小型组织与其外部环境紧密耦合（Adner & Levinthal，2002）。他们面临更大的选择压力，因为他们缺乏长期生存的资源而无法取得市场成功。因此，小型组织更加关注有关其产品性能的信号。其次，在小型组织中，企业家（即开发人员）与其客户之间的距离很小，这使他们能够扫描环境以获取超出其产品市场成功的进一步线索和细节。企业家通常会寻求反馈来改进他们的产品和服务（Dabas 等人，2021；Elias 等人，2018）。本研究通过提供有关反馈特征（即评论量和评论并发度）如何最终影响应用程序开发人员的开发活动的证据，为这项工作做出了贡献。我们通过建议评论情绪可以调节这些反馈特征对开发活动的影响来进一步促进这一研究。


Finally, app development involves products that are tightly coupled with the market (Adner & Levinthal, 2002) and are developed primarily by small organizations. Our findings show that these organizations, while sensitive to positive market feedback, still need to infuse exploration into their activities. In addition, the decision to balance exploitation with exploration is guided by market feedback. This presents a dilemma for these organizations and their members. They need to attend to user feedback but not overly so. Our findings show that bounded rationality provides one constraint to attending to this feedback. Future studies can examine how organizational members can productively limit their attention to external feedback.




最后，应用程序开发涉及与市场紧密结合的产品（Adner & Levinthal，2002）并且主要由小型组织开发。我们的研究结果表明，这些组织虽然对积极的市场反馈敏感，但仍然需要在其活动中注入探索。此外，平衡开采与勘探的决定是由市场反馈决定的。这给这些组织及其成员带来了两难的境地。他们需要关注用户反馈，但又不能过度关注。我们的研究结果表明，有限理性为关注这一反馈提供了一个限制。未来的研究可以研究组织成员如何有效地限制他们对外部反馈的注意力。


## 5.2 Practical Implications




## 5.2 实际意义


Our findings have strategic and policy implications for app developers and app stores in the context of app development. For app developers, the findings demonstrate that app developers need to exploit users’ reviews and explore new innovative features in order to succeed in these competitive markets. This finding should guide developers to conduct a mix of exploitation and exploration. The specific mix of these activities will likely rely on numerous contextual variables (such as app category, user base size, and free or purchased, as identified in Table 3).




我们的研究结果对应用程序开发背景下的应用程序开发人员和应用程序商店具有战略和政策意义。对于应用程序开发人员来说，研究结果表明，应用程序开发人员需要利用用户的评论并探索新的创新功能，才能在这些竞争激烈的市场中取得成功。这一发现应该指导开发人员进行开发和探索的结合。这些活动的具体组合可能依赖于众多上下文变量（例如应用程序类别、用户群规模以及免费或购买，如表 3 所示）。


Our findings regarding user feedback suggest that app developers should regularly collect and analyze user data to understand user behavior and preferences, which can inform both exploitation and exploration efforts. They can leverage user feedback and analytics such as review volume, review concurrence, and review sentiment to identify areas for improvement and to gather insights for potential new features. Since a typical app is generally developed by a handful of developers who have limited resources (Nayebi et al., 2016), they can develop a strategic roadmap that outlines both short- and long-term goals for their apps so that they can effectively allocate their limited resources. Specifically, app developers can design apps with a modular and scalable architecture, which will allow them to implement A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to systematically test new features and variations with a subset of users (Xu and Chen, 2016). By using gathered empirical evidence to create different versions of an app to reflect varying levels of exploitation to exploration, these developers will be rewarded with quicker feedback regarding the “optimal” mix of exploitation and exploration in their app updates. Given the short time horizon in app updates, this flexibility could be crucial for success in a competitive market.




我们关于用户反馈的调查结果表明，应用程序开发人员应定期收集和分析用户数据，以了解用户行为和偏好，这可以为开发和探索工作提供信息。他们可以利用用户反馈和分析（例如评论量、评论并发度和评论情绪）来确定需要改进的领域并收集对潜在新功能的见解。由于典型的应用程序通常由少数资源有限的开发人员开发（Nayebi 等人，2016），因此他们可以制定战略路线图，概述其应用程序的短期和长期目标，以便他们可以有效地分配有限的资源。具体来说，应用程序开发人员可以使用模块化和可扩展的架构来设计应用程序，这将使他们能够实施 A/B 测试和实验框架，以便系统地测试新功能和与一小部分用户的变化（Xu 和 Chen，2016）。通过使用收集到的经验证据来创建应用程序的不同版本，以反映不同程度的开发和探索，这些开发人员将获得有关应用程序更新中开发和探索的“最佳”组合的更快反馈。鉴于应用程序更新的时间较短，这种灵活性对于在竞争激烈的市场中取得成功至关重要。


Further, the finding that app developers’ exploitation and exploration activities are influenced by the information they receive from users’ reviews could potentially draw developers’ attention to the role of information and bounded rationality in their app development activities. While boundedly rational individuals use information to make rational satisfactory decisions (Gigerenzer, 2004), an overload of information is likely to diminish their ability to process the information (Simon, 1956). As such, app developers need to be mindful of the potential for cognitive overload as they draw on users’ feedback to update their apps and may wish to use text-review mining tools or AI to help them curate and organize users’ reviews.




此外，发现应用程序开发人员的开发和探索活动受到从用户评论中收到的信息的影响，这可能会引起开发人员对信息和有限理性在其应用程序开发活动中的作用的关注。虽然有限理性的个人使用信息来做出合理且令人满意的决策（Gigerenzer，2004），但信息过载可能会削弱他们处理信息的能力（Simon，1956）。因此，应用程序开发人员需要注意潜在的认知超载，因为他们利用用户的反馈来更新他们的应用程序，并可能希望使用文本评论挖掘工具或人工智能来帮助他们策划和组织用户的评论。


App store managers could also benefit from our findings. Store managers could implement policies to attract both developers and users by helping practitioners balance both exploitation and exploration. They could provide analytics tools to track user behavior, engagement metrics, and conversion rates and analyze this data to gain insights into user preferences and identify and highlight areas for improvement. They could also create systems to facilitate feedback about user experience.




应用商店经理也可以从我们的研究结果中受益。商店经理可以通过帮助从业者平衡开发和探索来实施吸引开发者和用户的政策。他们可以提供分析工具来跟踪用户行为、参与度指标和转化率，并分析这些数据以深入了解用户偏好，并识别和突出需要改进的领域。他们还可以创建系统来促进有关用户体验的反馈。


The balance between exploitation and exploration is a critical consideration for policy and strategy discussions across various domains, including business, technology, and innovation. Our findings also provide insights for these fields.




开发和探索之间的平衡是跨多个领域（包括商业、技术和创新）的政策和战略讨论的关键考虑因素。我们的研究结果也为这些领域提供了见解。


## 5.3 Study Limitations and Future Research Opportunities




## 5.3 研究局限性和未来研究机会


A potential limitation of this study is the biased selection of studied apps. Given our objective of examining the effect of user reviews on app evolution, we excluded apps with less than 10 releases, and then randomly selected 10% of those, given the manual effort required to collect user reviews from third-party aggregators. However, the randomly selected apps were not significantly different from those excluded in terms of average rating $( t = - 0 . 5 7 8 , p = 0 . 5 6 4 )$ or average length of release update $( t = - 1 . 3 8 9 , p = 0 . 1 6 5 )$ indicating both groups had a similar profile. Future research could validate this study’s findings using a different and larger sample of applications.




这项研究的一个潜在局限性是所研究的应用程序的选择存在偏见。鉴于我们的目标是检查用户评论对应用程序演变的影响，我们排除了版本少于 10 个的应用程序，然后随机选择其中的 10%，因为从第三方聚合商收集用户评论需要手动操作。然而，随机选择的应用程序在平均评分 $( t = - 0 . 5 7 8 , p = 0 . 5 6 4 )$ 或发布更新的平均长度 $( t = - 1 . 3 8 9 , p = 0 . 1 6 5 ) $ 方面与排除的应用程序没有显着差异，这表明两组具有相似的配置文件。未来的研究可以使用不同的、更大的应用样本来验证这项研究的结果。


This study also focused on apps in open marketplaces. App development in other contexts, such as enterprise, may differ given the lesser role of external feedback. Furthermore, as software marketplaces are becoming the norm for distributing all kinds of applications (mobile, desktop, and server), it would be interesting to test the limitations of our findings in these other contexts. The results of some control variables used in this study are also interesting and could stimulate the study of other online review variables capable of influencing the exploitation-exploration orientation. For example, Table 4 above shows that review length positively affects app developers’ exploitation activities, while review velocity does not. One possible explanation is that app developers normally release regular updates rather than ad hoc updates and their decisions are less likely to be affected by review velocity in our studied context. Future research may also wish to explore the alternate forces that shape mobile app evolution, including the desire to imitate successful apps (Wang et al., 2018) and the desire to stand out from the competition by introducing distinctive features.




这项研究还关注开放市场中的应用程序。鉴于外部反馈的作用较小，其他环境（例如企业）的应用程序开发可能会有所不同。此外，随着软件市场正在成为分发各种应用程序（移动、桌面和服务器）的规范，在这些其他环境中测试我们的发现的局限性将会很有趣。本研究中使用的一些控制变量的结果也很有趣，可以刺激其他能够影响开发探索方向的在线评论变量的研究。例如，上面的表 4 显示审核长度对应用程序开发人员的开发活动产生积极影响，而审核速度则不会。一种可能的解释是，应用程序开发人员通常会发布定期更新而不是临时更新，并且他们的决策不太可能受到我们研究背景下审核速度的影响。未来的研究可能还希望探索塑造移动应用程序演变的替代力量，包括模仿成功应用程序的愿望（Wang 等人，2018）以及通过引入独特功能从竞争中脱颖而出的愿望。


The findings of this study could also be extended to other IS development contexts. We found that app developers need to use a mix of exploitation and exploration to evolve successful apps. In contrast, traditional IS development has focused on exploiting users’ requirements and needs. To our knowledge, there is no research that has examined the effect of exploration on traditional IS development success. Future research could investigate the generalizability of this study’s findings for enterprise IS development.




这项研究的结果也可以扩展到其他信息系统发展背景。我们发现应用程序开发人员需要结合利用和探索来开发成功的应用程序。相比之下，传统的信息系统开发侧重于开发用户的要求和需求。据我们所知，还没有研究考察过探索对传统信息系统开发成功的影响。未来的研究可以调查本研究结果对企业信息系统开发的普遍性。

## Appendix A: Using Similarity Scores between Mobile App Update Texts and User Reviews as Alternative Main Independent Variable




## 附录 A：使用移动应用程序更新文本和用户评论之间的相似度分数作为替代主要自变量


We define mobile app features described in update descriptions as either exploitation or exploration based on whether these features appeared in app users’ reviews. This is a conservative method since only exactly matched text content in both texts was included. This method may not capture the semantic similarity between user reviews and mobile app update descriptions. For example, whereas the mobile app update description states: “Added an option to display the song remaining time on the player screen,” a mobile app review stated: “it would be better to show playing duration of the song.” Although both texts discussed the same topic of displaying song playing time, our conservative approach, exact matching, does not capture the exploitative side of user reviews.




我们根据这些功能是否出现在应用程序用户的评论中，将更新描述中描述的移动应用程序功能定义为利用或探索。这是一种保守的方法，因为仅包含两个文本中完全匹配的文本内容。此方法可能无法捕获用户评论和移动应用程序更新描述之间的语义相似性。例如，移动应用程序更新说明指出：“添加了在播放器屏幕上显示歌曲剩余时间的选项”，而移动应用程序评论则指出：“最好显示歌曲的播放持续时间。”尽管两篇文章都讨论了显示歌曲播放时间的相同主题，但我们保守的方法（精确匹配）并没有捕捉到用户评论的剥削性一面。


## Semantic Similarity Score




## 语义相似度得分


To address this concern and to test the robustness of our findings, we implemented a BERT (bidirectional encoder representations for transformers) model to capture the semantic similarity of these two texts. The output of this process was a semantic similarity score that ranged between 0 (absolutely not similar) and 1 (almost identical). The higher the score, the more the app developer was engaged in exploitation activities. In the given example above, the similarity score of 0.803 shows that these two texts likely have similar content.




为了解决这个问题并测试我们研究结果的稳健性，我们实现了 BERT（变压器双向编码器表示）模型来捕获这两个文本的语义相似性。此过程的输出是语义相似度得分，范围在 0（绝对不相似）和 1（几乎相同）之间。分数越高，应用程序开发人员参与的利用活动就越多。在上面给出的示例中，相似度得分 0.803 表明这两个文本可能具有相似的内容。


BERT is a state-of-the-art deep learning approach for many natural language processing (NLP) tasks including measuring the semantic similarity of texts (see Koroteev, 2021, for a review). This method has been widely implemented by IS researchers for tasks such as identifying whether a text is written by medical professionals (Mousavi et al., 2020), defining media text complexity (Shin et al., 2020), and classifying whether a text is fake news (Wei et al., 2020).




BERT 是一种最先进的深度学习方法，适用于许多自然语言处理 (NLP) 任务，包括测量文本的语义相似性（请参阅 Koroteev，2021 年的评论）。这种方法已被 IS 研究人员广泛应用于识别文本是否由医疗专业人员撰写（Mousavi 等人，2020）、定义媒体文本复杂性（Shin 等人，2020）以及对文本是否为假新闻进行分类（Wei 等人，2020）等任务。


BERT is a language representation model introduced by Devlin et al. (2018). It uses transformers to learn contextual relationships between tokens (e.g. words) in a text document. Transformers are models that process words in relation to all the other words in a text. That is, BERT models consider the full context of a word by looking at the words that come before and after it. BERT is a pretrained model that was trained and built using text data from both Wikipedia and BookCorpus. For each word, BERT returns a vector representation of words. These representations are used in NLP tasks. Details about BERT models, model training, and applications can be found in Devlin et al. (2018)<sup>9</sup> and Reimers and Gurevych (2019).<sup>10</sup>




BERT 是 Devlin 等人提出的一种语言表示模型。 （2018）。它使用转换器来学习文本文档中标记（例如单词）之间的上下文关系。变形金刚是处理与文本中所有其他单词相关的单词的模型。也就是说，BERT 模型通过查看单词前后的单词来考虑单词的完整上下文。 BERT 是一种预训练模型，使用来自 Wikipedia 和 BookCorpus 的文本数据进行训练和构建。对于每个单词，BERT 返回单词的向量表示。这些表示用于 NLP 任务。有关 BERT 模型、模型训练和应用的详细信息，请参阅 Devlin 等人。 (2018)<sup>9</sup> 以及 Reimers 和 Gurevych (2019)。<sup>10</sup>


In our study, we were interested in comparing the semantic similarity between mobile app update descriptions and user reviews. Figure 1 shows how semantic representation and similarity scores were generated and used in this study. In Step 1, we implemented natural language processing techniques to process our review and mobile app update data. Specifically, we first cleaned all texts (e.g., removing HTML tags) and converted cleaned review and app update texts into lowercase. In Step 2, we used the BERT Base model to generate vector representations for both reviews and mobile app update texts. BERT Base returns a vector of length 768 for each word in each text. These vectors represent the semantic meaning of the word. In Step 3, the vector representations of two texts were then used in a cosine similarity task to generate a similarity score between 0 (absolutely not similar) and 1 (almost identical).




在我们的研究中，我们有兴趣比较移动应用程序更新描述和用户评论之间的语义相似性。图 1 显示了本研究中如何生成和使用语义表示和相似性分数。在第 1 步中，我们实施了自然语言处理技术来处理我们的评论和移动应用程序更新数据。具体来说，我们首先清理所有文本（例如，删除 HTML 标签）并将清理后的评论和应用程序更新文本转换为小写。在步骤 2 中，我们使用 BERT Base 模型为评论和移动应用程序更新文本生成向量表示。 BERT Base 为每个文本中的每个单词返回一个长度为 768 的向量。这些向量代表单词的语义。在步骤 3 中，两个文本的向量表示被用于余弦相似度任务，以生成 0（绝对不相似）和 1（几乎相同）之间的相似度得分。

## Similarity Verification Using Amazon Mechanical Turk




## 使用 Amazon Mechanical Turk 进行相似性验证


We used Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to verify our similarity analysis approach by examining the correlation between similarity scores of a pair of texts obtained from our approach and MTurk workers’ perceptions of the similarity between these texts. Recall that similarity scores are computed based on automated, easily scalable methods. Thus, it is possible that either humans disagree with our metrics, or our measures do not capture the semantic similarity in the same manner as most humans.




我们使用 Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) 来验证我们的相似性分析方法，方法是检查从我们的方法获得的一对文本的相似性分数与 MTurk 工作人员对这些文本之间相似性的看法之间的相关性。回想一下，相似性分数是根据自动化、易于扩展的方法计算的。因此，人类可能不同意我们的指标，或者我们的测量方法没有以与大多数人相同的方式捕获语义相似性。


We started with creating pairs of text samples. We first calculated similarity scores between mobile app update texts for a new release and review texts given by app users for the period between a previous release and a new release. Then, we split pair of these texts into four quartiles based on quartiles of similarity scores. Next, we randomly extracted 20 pairs from each quartile as coding samples.




我们首先创建文本样本对。我们首先计算了新版本的移动应用程序更新文本与应用程序用户在先前版本和新版本之间给出的评论文本之间的相似度得分。然后，我们根据相似性得分的四分位数将这些文本对分成四个四分位数。接下来，我们从每个四分位数中随机抽取 20 对作为编码样本。


We recruited 240 Amazon Mechanic Turk workers (i.e., MTurkers) residing in the United States. We restricted participation to those who had at least 500 approved hits and 95% approval ratings. First, all participants were instructed to read a pair of randomly assigned texts. After reading these texts, these participants were asked to rate the similarity between the pair of texts using a 5- point Likert scale by performing the following task: “Please rate the similarity between these two texts from highest (5-absolutely similar) to the lowest (1-absolutely not similar).” Each pair of texts is randomly assigned to three MTurkers. A Pearson’s correlation analysis shows a positive, significant correlation between our semantic similarity scores and MTurkers’ perceived similarity for pairs of texts (0.73, p < 0.01). This result shows that our semantic similarity analysis achieved our purpose.




我们招募了 240 名居住在美国的 Amazon Mechanic Turk 工人（即 MTurkers）。我们限制了那些获得至少 500 个批准点击率和 95% 批准率的人参与。首先，所有参与者都被要求阅读一对随机分配的文本。阅读这些文本后，这些参与者被要求通过执行以下任务，使用 5 点李克特量表来评估这对文本之间的相似性：“请从最高（5-绝对相似）到最低（1-绝对不相似）对这两个文本之间的相似性进行评分。”每对文本被随机分配给三个 MTurkers。 Pearson 相关分析显示，我们的语义相似度得分与 MTurkers 对文本对的感知相似度之间存在显着正相关（0.73，p < 0.01）。这个结果表明我们的语义相似性分析达到了我们的目的。


## Analysis and Results




## 分析与结果


We repeated our analyses in Section 4.1, which examined the relationship between exploitation-exploration orientation and mobile app survival, using this newly created measurement (review-update similarity). Specifically, we replaced update exploitation, exploitation-exploration orientation, and its quadratic term in our main analysis with the newly created measurement (i.e., review-update similarity) and its quadratic term. The results in Table A1 show that the coefficients of review-update similarity are positive and the coefficients of its quadratic terms are negative and statistically significant. Specifically, we found the semantic similarity between app update descriptions and app user reviews (review-update similarity), to be positively associated with app short- and long-term survival up to a threshold, after which the positive relationship declines. These results further confirm our main findings and support H1.




我们重复了第 4.1 节中的分析，该分析使用这个新创建的测量（审查-更新相似性）检查了开发-探索方向和移动应用程序生存之间的关系。具体来说，我们在主要分析中用新创建的测量（即审查-更新相似性）及其二次项替换了更新利用、利用-探索方向及其二次项。表 A1 的结果表明，评论更新相似度的系数为正，其二次项的系数为负，且具有统计显着性。具体来说，我们发现应用程序更新描述和应用程序用户评论之间的语义相似性（评论更新相似性）与应用程序的短期和长期生存呈正相关，达到阈值后，正相关关系会下降。这些结果进一步证实了我们的主要发现并支持 H1。

## Appendix C: Review Content and App Updates




## 附录 C：查看内容和应用程序更新


## Review Content Analysis




##回顾内容分析


User feedback is an important information source for developers to improve mobile application quality (Groen et al. 2017). Marketplaces such as AppStore and PlayStore allow users to submit feedback in the form of reviews for mobile applications. These user reviews contain valuable information such as bug reports, feature requests, and feature evaluations that are helpful for developers seeking to improve their apps (Chen et al. 2014). However, the enormous volume of reviews received for an app makes the manual analysis of these reviews unpractical. We, therefore, implemented automatic approaches to identify user intentions and extract app features from user app reviews.




用户反馈是开发者提高移动应用程序质量的重要信息来源（Groen et al. 2017）。 AppStore 和 PlayStore 等市场允许用户以移动应用程序评论的形式提交反馈。这些用户评论包含有价值的信息，例如错误报告、功能请求和功能评估，这些信息对寻求改进应用程序的开发人员很有帮助（Chen 等人，2014 年）。然而，应用程序收到的大量评论使得对这些评论的手动分析变得不切实际。因此，我们实施了自动方法来识别用户意图并从用户应用程序评论中提取应用程序功能。


## Identifying User Intentions




## 识别用户意图


We first identified users’ review intentions. Several approaches have been proposed to automate the process of identifying users’ intentions (see Dąbrowski et al., 2022, for an excellent review). These approaches include tools such as MARA (Mobile App Review Analyzer) (Iacob & Harrison 2013) to rank informative reviews or SURF (Summarizer of User Reviews Feedback) to summarize reviews (Di Sorbo et al. 2017). In this study, we adopted ARdoc (App Reviews Development Oriented Classifier), one of the most well-accepted approaches for identifying user review intentions (Panichella et al. 2016)




我们首先识别用户的评论意图。人们提出了几种方法来自动化识别用户意图的过程（参见 Dąbrowski 等人，2022 年的精彩评论）。这些方法包括 MARA（移动应用评论分析器）（Iacob & Harrison 2013）等工具，用于对信息丰富的评论进行排名，或用于总结评论的 SURF（用户评论反馈汇总器）（Di Sorbo 等人，2017 年）。在本研究中，我们采用了 ARdoc（面向应用程序评论开发的分类器），这是识别用户评论意图最广为接受的方法之一（Panichella 等人，2016 年）


ARdoc, a mobile app reviews classifier, is developed based on the taxonomy developed by Panichella et al. (2015) to identify user intentions. It combines natural language processing (NLP) and text analysis techniques to automatically mine intentions in user reviews. We chose this approach over other methods because this approach not only satisfies our objective of identifying user intentions from app user reviews but has also been validated through real-world user studies (app developers) and achieves high precision and recall (over 85% in both metrics).




ARdoc 是一款移动应用评论分类器，是根据 Panichella 等人开发的分类法开发的。 （2015）识别用户意图。它结合了自然语言处理（NLP）和文本分析技术，可以自动挖掘用户评论中的意图。我们选择这种方法而不是其他方法，因为这种方法不仅满足了我们从应用程序用户评论中识别用户意图的目标，而且还通过现实世界的用户研究（应用程序开发人员）进行了验证，并实现了高精度和召回率（两个指标均超过 85%）。


![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/92ed0c9f1bdef2dca2ea452b7ec464f7fa85ee4ef5be9e8a20d840a6c7662fde.jpg)  
Figure C1. Mobile App Review Classification Framework




![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/92ed0c9f1bdef2dca2ea452b7ec464f7fa85ee4ef5be9e8a20d840a6c7662fde.jpg)  
图C1。移动应用审查分类框架


We followed the study of Panichella et al. (2016) to classify user app reviews into review categories. Figure C-1 shows the app review classification process used in this study. In Step 1, we implemented natural language processing techniques to process our review data. Specifically, we first converted each review text into lowercase and then broke it up into individual sentences. Then, we turned words in each sentence into their base form (i.e., stemming or lemmatization). Finally, we removed function and stop words. At the same time, we performed text analysis to create NLP heuristics from coded review data provided by Panichella et al. (2016). In Step 2, we extracted text features from processed review texts and built machine learning (ML) models using NLP heuristics extracted from Step 1. In Step 3, we used the built ML model to classify each review sentence into one of the review categories (i.e., feature request, problem discovery, information seeking, information giving, or other). We implemented ARdoc Java $\mathsf { A P I } ^ { 1 1 }$ up to this step. Finally, we used MTurk to evaluate classification outcomes for feature requests and problem discovery since these two categories are the focus of this analysis.




我们跟踪了 Panichella 等人的研究。 （2016）将用户应用程序评论分类为评论类别。图 C-1 显示了本研究中使用的应用程序评论分类流程。在第一步中，我们实施了自然语言处理技术来处理我们的评论数据。具体来说，我们首先将每个评论文本转换为小写，然后将其分解为单独的句子。然后，我们将每个句子中的单词转换为其基本形式（即词干提取或词形还原）。最后，我们删除了功能和停用词。同时，我们进行文本分析，根据 Panichella 等人提供的编码评论数据创建 NLP 启发式方法。 （2016）。在第 2 步中，我们从处理后的评论文本中提取文本特征，并使用从第 1 步中提取的 NLP 启发式方法构建机器学习 (ML) 模型。在第 3 步中，我们使用构建的 ML 模型将每个评论句子分类为评论类别之一（即特征请求、问题发现、信息查找、信息提供或其他）。到这一步为止，我们实现了 ARdoc Java $\mathsf { A P I } ^ { 1 1 }$。最后，我们使用 MTurk 来评估功能请求和问题发现的分类结果，因为这两个类别是本次分析的重点。


When we evaluated classification outcomes, we first randomly extracted 600 review sentences classified as either feature request or problem discovery (300 sentences in each category). Then, we hired workers from MTurk to answer one of the following questions after reading a randomly assigned review sentence. If the sentence was classified in the problem discovery category, a worker assigned to this sentence was asked to answer the following question: “Is this review for a mobile app talking about issue(s) in the mobile app?” If the sentence was classified as a feature request category, a worker assigned to this sentence was asked to answer the following question: “Is this review for a mobile app requesting feature(s) to be added to this mobile app?” Each sentence was randomly assigned to two workers, and each worker could only view one sentence from each classification category. We conducted a Cohen’s interrater reliability test for outcomes and obtained a kappa coefficient (κ) of 0.8, which shows substantial agreement between raters. 76.7% of MTurk workers agreed with our identified user intentions. Table C1 provides explanations and review distributions for each review category.




当我们评估分类结果时，我们首先随机提取 600 个评论句子，分为特征请求或问题发现（每个类别 300 个句子）。然后，我们聘请 MTurk 的工作人员在阅读随机分配的评论句子后回答以下问题之一。如果该句子属于问题发现类别，则分配到该句子的工作人员会被要求回答以下问题：“此针对移动应用程序的评论是否谈论移动应用程序中的问题？”如果该句子被归类为功能请求类别，则分配给该句子的工作人员被要求回答以下问题：“此评论是否针对请求将功能添加到此移动应用程序的移动应用程序？”每个句子被随机分配给两名工作人员，每个工作人员只能查看每个分类类别中的一个句子。我们对结果进行了 Cohen 评估者间可靠性测试，并获得了 0.8 的 kappa 系数 (κ)，这表明评估者之间基本一致。 76.7% 的 MTurk 员工同意我们确定的用户意图。表 C1 提供了每个评论类别的解释和评论分布。

We further analyzed review sentences classified as problem discovery to obtain more insights into what problems user reviews disclose. We first implemented a natural language processing procedure to clean review texts (e.g., removing URL and stop and functional words). Then, we found frequencies of uni- and bi-gram within each review sentence. Finally, we ranked words/word phrases based on their frequencies. Figure C2 shows a word cloud of the top 100 words/word phrases that appeared in reviews classified as bug reports. The most frequent words or word phrases in user reviews reported issues such as freezes, crashing, bugs, lost updates, and the app no longer working.

## App Feature Extractions




## 应用特征提取


We next extracted app features from app user reviews and app description texts. Several studies have implemented classification approaches such as topic modeling (Guzman & Maalej, 2014) and supervised tagging models (e.g., SURminer from Gu & Kim, 2015, and AR-miner from Chen et al., 2014) to automatically classify app features. However, Maalej and Nabil (2015) suggest that extracting such complex features may not be necessary and comparable results can be obtained by using simple lexical characteristics. In this study, we implemented SAFE (simple approach for feature extraction), a rule-based approach, to extract app features (Johann et al., 2017). Johann et al. (2017) used 18 Part-of-Speech (POS) patterns and five sentence patterns to automatically extract app features from app descriptions and app reviews and showed better performance than other previously proposed approaches. We followed their procedure, as specified in Figure 3, to extract features from user app reviews and app descriptions. We implemented the Python SAFE package for this process and identified a total of 69,288 unique features.<sup>12</sup> Among sentences classified as feature requests, the top 20 most frequently requested features are shown in Figure C3.




接下来，我们从应用程序用户评论和应用程序描述文本中提取应用程序功能。一些研究已经实现了主题建模（Guzman & Maalej，2014）和监督标记模型（例如 Gu & Kim，2015 年的 SURminer，以及 Chen 等人，2014 年的 AR-miner）等分类方法来自动对应用程序功能进行分类。然而，Maalej 和 Nabil (2015) 认为提取如此复杂的特征可能没有必要，并且可以通过使用简单的词汇特征来获得可比较的结果。在本研究中，我们实施了 SAFE（简单特征提取方法），这是一种基于规则的方法，用于提取应用程序特征（Johann 等人，2017）。约翰等人。 (2017) 使用 18 种词性 (POS) 模式和 5 种句子模式从应用程序描述和应用程序评论中自动提取应用程序特征，并显示出比其他先前提出的方法更好的性能。我们遵循他们的程序，如图 3 所示，从用户应用程序评论和应用程序描述中提取特征。我们为此过程实现了 Python SAFE 包，并总共识别了 69,288 个独特特征。<sup>12</sup>在分类为特征请求的句子中，前 20 个最常请求的特征如图 C3 所示。


![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/4686fecf912eb866e0e46c0e73f13bdb2166ceca87cd412285fdc3c94d343470.jpg)  
Figure C3. Mobile App Feature Extraction Framework




![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/4686fecf912eb866e0e46c0e73f13bdb2166ceca87cd412285fdc3c94d343470.jpg)  
图C3。移动应用特征提取框架


After extracting features from review sentences, we verified extracted results using workers from MTurk. Specifically, we created a random number generator and then randomly chose 600 sentences with extracted features. Then, we randomly assigned each sentence to two different workers and asked each worker to verify whether the identified app features in the sentence were focal features. Our Cohen’s interrater reliability test showed substantial agreement between raters with a kappa coefficient (κ) of 0.74. Over 78.6% of MTurk workers agreed with our identified app features. Figure C4 shows the top 20 features mentioned in user reviews.




从评论句子中提取特征后，我们使用 MTurk 的工作人员验证了提取的结果。具体来说，我们创建了一个随机数生成器，然后随机选择 600 个具有提取特征的句子。然后，我们将每个句子随机分配给两个不同的工作人员，并要求每个工作人员验证句子中识别出的应用程序功能是否是焦点功能。我们的 Cohen 评级者间可靠性测试显示评级者之间基本一致，kappa 系数 (κ) 为 0.74。超过 78.6% 的 MTurk 员工同意我们确定的应用程序功能。图 C4 显示了用户评论中提到的前 20 个功能。

Figure C4. Top 20 Features Mentioned in User Reviews




![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/e41724c5bb5148fb88331c06f7b405cb40347e4e1efe0bbf521a71d9c136e577.jpg)  
图C4。用户评论中提到的前 20 个功能


We also explored how app developers consider app features that appear in user reviews. Since app developers are unlikely to include all app features mentioned in user reviews, they will likely prioritize some features over others. We focused on features that had issues or were requested by users. We assume that app developers are more likely to first update app features that address app users’ common concerns rather than including new features. We tested this conjecture using all app revision update data and app features that appeared in user reviews that were classified as either problem discovery or feature request. There was a total of 20,645 features. The analysis is at the app versionfeature level. The dependent variable is binary, indicating whether a feature was included in the app’s next update. The main independent variables include feature category (feature categories, which equals 1 when the type of a feature is problem discovery and 0 when the type of a feature is a requested feature), the frequency of this feature (feature frequencies), and the interaction of these two independent variables. We estimated a regression model with app version fixed effects.




我们还探讨了应用程序开发人员如何考虑用户评论中出现的应用程序功能。由于应用程序开发人员不太可能包含用户评论中提到的所有应用程序功能，因此他们可能会优先考虑某些功能而不是其他功能。我们专注于有问题或用户要求的功能。我们假设应用程序开发人员更有可能首先更新解决应用程序用户常见问题的应用程序功能，而不是包含新功能。我们使用用户评论中出现的所有应用程序修订更新数据和应用程序功能来测试此猜想，这些评论被分类为问题发现或功能请求。共有 20,645 个特征。分析是在应用程序版本功能级别进行的。因变量是二进制的，指示应用程序的下一次更新中是否包含某个功能。主要自变量包括特征类别（特征类别，当特征类型为问题发现时等于1，当特征类型为请求特征时等于0）、该特征的频率（特征频率）以及这两个自变量的交互作用。我们估计了具有应用程序版本固定效应的回归模型。


Table C2 reports the results. The coefficients of all variables are positive and statistically significant at a 0.01 level. These results show that app developers are more likely to include features that are related to app issues than features requested by users (0.3641, $p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ ) and features that are frequently mentioned by app users $( 0 . 0 0 1 0 , p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ in revisions. Most importantly, we found that app developers are more likely to include features more frequently mentioned by users among app bug features. The plot in Figure C5 shows the interaction term between feature categories and feature frequencies and further confirms our findings.




表 C2 报告了结果。所有变量的系数均为正，且在 0.01 水平上具有统计显着性。这些结果表明，应用程序开发人员更有可能在修订中包含与应用程序问题相关的功能，而不是用户请求的功能 (0.3641, $p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ ) 和应用程序用户 $( 0 . 0 0 1 0 , p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 经常提到的功能。最重要的是，我们发现应用程序开发人员更有可能在应用程序错误功能中包含用户更常提到的功能。图 C5 中的图显示了特征类别和特征频率之间的交互项，进一步证实了我们的发现。

# Appendix D: Robustness Tests (Alternative Exploitation-Exploration Orientation)




# 附录 D：稳健性测试（替代开发-探索方向）


## The Effects of Exploration Orientation on Survival




## 探索方向对生存的影响


We tested the effect of developers’ exploitation-exploration orientation on apps’ success measured by their survival in the marketplace over time (H1) in our main analysis and found that exploitation-exploration orientation has an inverted U-shape relationship with mobile app survival. Exploitation-exploration orientation (i.e., exploitation orientation) has thus far been measured from an exploitation perspective, as in Table 2, because we wished to examine the effects of user reviews on app developers. We recreated this measure from an exploration perspective:




我们在主要分析中测试了开发人员的开发-探索导向对应用程序成功的影响（通过一段时间（H1）衡量应用程序在市场中的生存情况），发现开发-探索导向与移动应用程序的生存呈倒U形关系。到目前为止，开发-探索方向（即开发方向）是从开发角度来衡量的，如表 2 所示，因为我们希望检查用户评论对应用程序开发人员的影响。我们从探索的角度重新创建了这个衡量标准：


???????????????????????? − ?????????????????????? ?????????????????????? (??. ??. , ?????????????????????? ??????????????????????)




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


$$
= \frac {\text {Update Exploration}}{\text {Update Exploitation} + \text {Update Exploration}}
$$




$$
= \frac {\text {更新探索}}{\text {更新探索} + \text {更新探索}}
$$


Since exploration and exploitation orientations have a perfect negative correlation, as shown in Figure D1, we expect that exploitation orientation also has an inverted U-shape relationship with mobile app survival. We test our conjecture in this section.




由于探索和利用方向具有完美的负相关关系，如图 D1 所示，我们预计利用方向与移动应用生存也存在倒 U 形关系。我们在本节中测试我们的猜想。

We estimated the same model specification as Equation (1) but replaced the exploitation-exploration orientation (i.e., exploitation orientation) with this new exploitation-exploration orientation (i.e., exploration orientation). The dependent variable is app survival at 1 month and 3 years. Table D1 reports the results. In both model specifications, while the coefficients of exploitation-exploration orientation are positive and statistically significant, the coefficients of its quadratic term, exploitation-exploration orientation<sup>2</sup> are negative and statistically significant. we found that exploitation-exploration orientation is positively associated with app survival up to a threshold after which this positive relationship declines. We implemented the same method used in the main analysis and computed the inflection point. The inflection point is 0.493 for short-term survival. This U-shaped pattern is illustrated in Figure D1. Thus, Hypothesis 1 is further confirmed.

## The Effect of Review Volume and Review Concurrence on Exploitation-Exploration Orientation




## 审阅量和审阅并发度对开发探索取向的影响


We further ran two regression specifications to test the effects of review volume and review concurrence on exploration orientation. In our main analysis, we found that review volume has an inverted U-shape relationship with exploitation orientation and that review concurrence has a positive relationship with exploitation orientation. Given the perfect negative correlation between exploration and exploitation orientation, if our findings are valid, we would expect a Ushape relationship between review volume and exploration orientation and a positive relationship between review concurrence and exploration orientation. We estimated the two models specified in Equations (2) and (3) of the main analysis but replaced exploitation orientation with exploration orientation as the dependent variables.




我们进一步运行了两个回归规范来测试评论量和评论并发对探索方向的影响。在我们的主要分析中，我们发现评论量与利用方向呈倒U型关系，评论并发度与利用方向呈正相关。鉴于探索和利用方向之间存在完美的负相关关系，如果我们的研究结果有效，我们预计评论量和探索方向之间存在 Ushape 关系，而评论并发数和探索方向之间存在正相关关系。我们估计了主要分析的方程（2）和（3）中指定的两个模型，但用探索导向代替了开发导向作为因变量。


Table D2 reports the results. In both model specifications, the coefficients of the review volume variable are negative and statistically significant at the 1% level and the coefficient of its quadratic term is statistically significant with a positive value in Specification 2. These results imply a curvilinear (U-shape) relationship between review volume and exploration orientation. Further, review concurrence coefficients are negative and statistically significant in both specifications. These results exactly match our expectations and further support our findings regarding H2 and H3.




表 D2 报告了结果。在两个模型规范中，评论量变量的系数均为负值，且在 1% 水平上具有统计显着性，而其二次项的系数在规范 2 中具有统计显着性且为正值。这些结果意味着评论量与探索方向之间存在曲线（U 形）关系。此外，在这两个规范中，审查并发系数均为负且具有统计显着性。这些结果完全符合我们的预期，并进一步支持我们关于 H2 和 H3 的发现。

## Appendix E: Moderating Effect of Sentiment on the Relationship between Review Volume/Concurrence and Exploitation-Exploration Orientation




## 附录E：情绪对审阅量/并发数与开发探索方向关系的调节作用


Numerous studies on user online reviews in the information systems and marketing fields have examined the effect of online reviews on consumer behaviors. One common finding is that online review sentiment can affect consumers’ decisions (e.g., Duan et al., 2008, Yin et al., 2017). In the context of app development, developers (i.e., sellers) are also likely aware of the potential effects of review sentiment on app users (i.e., consumers) and thus consider review sentiment when updating apps. In this section, we explore the moderating role of review sentiment on our findings.




信息系统和营销领域的大量关于用户在线评论的研究都考察了在线评论对消费者行为的影响。一个常见的发现是在线评论情绪会影响消费者的决策（例如，Duan et al., 2008；Yin et al., 2017）。在应用程序开发的背景下，开发人员（即卖家）也可能意识到评论情绪对应用程序用户（即消费者）的潜在影响，因此在更新应用程序时考虑评论情绪。在本节中，我们探讨评论情绪对我们的研究结果的调节作用。


We initially explore the relationship between review volume and review sentiment. Previous scholars suggest that consumers often write online reviews to either express their negative or positive experiences with a product (Thakur, 2018). Our initial exploration in Figure E1 confirms this in the context of app reviews, implying that review sentiment (either negative or positive) likely moderates the relationship between review volume and exploitation-exploration orientation. On the other hand, our initial exploration shows no significant correlation between review sentiment and review concurrence (0.03, p = 0.17).




我们首先探讨评论量和评论情绪之间的关系。之前的学者认为，消费者经常撰写在线评论来表达他们对产品的负面或正面体验（Thakur，2018）。我们在图 E1 中的初步探索在应用程序评论的背景下证实了这一点，这意味着评论情绪（无论是负面的还是正面的）可能会调节评论量和利用探索方向之间的关系。另一方面，我们的初步探索表明评论情绪和评论并发度之间没有显着相关性（0.03，p = 0.17）。


![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/cc9b2ad815d633f14198d2784ac17f5e8efbdbcfb99a72ac25831eddecb3228e.jpg)  
Figure E1. Review Sentiment: Review Volume




![](/api/attachments/3D4C6PCR/fulltext/images/cc9b2ad815d633f14198d2784ac17f5e8efbdbcfb99a72ac25831eddecb3228e.jpg)  
图E1。评论情绪：评论量


In order to explore the moderating effect of review sentiment, we estimated the same model as our main model but added the interaction terms between review sentiment and review volume and concurrence using all app release data. Appbot, from which we obtained our dataset, provides a sentiment score for each user review. The sentiment outcome is generated by using state-of-the-art machine learning approaches achieving 93% accuracy. It is also widely used by 500 Fortune companies such as Microsoft, LinkedIn, and Expedia (Garousi et al. 2022). Avg sentiment captures the average sentiment score for an app release created before the new release and after the previous release.




为了探索评论情绪的调节作用，我们估计了与我们的主要模型相同的模型，但使用所有应用程序发布数据添加了评论情绪与评论量和并发度之间的交互项。我们从中获取数据集的 Appbot 为每个用户评论提供情绪评分。情绪结果是通过使用最先进的机器学习方法生成的，准确率达到 93%。它也被 Microsoft、LinkedIn 和 Expedia 等财富 500 强公司广泛使用（Garousi 等人，2022）。平均情绪捕获新版本之前和上一个版本之后创建的应用程序版本的平均情绪分数。


Table E1 reports the results. We first see that the coefficient of the interaction term between average sentiment and review volume is negative and statistically significant at the 0.01 level. This result shows that as review sentiment becomes more negative, review volume has a more positive effect on exploitation-exploration orientation. Figure E2 further confirms our findings: for a given review volume, exploitation-exploration orientation increases when review sentiment becomes more negative. We also see that although the coefficient of the interaction term between avg sentiment and review concurrence is negative, it is insignificant. This result shows that when the review sentiment becomes more positive, review concurrence is likely to have insignificant but negative effects on exploitation exploration orientation. This result is also shown in Figure E3.




表 E1 报告了结果。我们首先看到平均情绪与评论量之间的交互项系数为负，并且在 0.01 水平上具有统计显着性。这一结果表明，随着评论情绪变得更加消极，评论量对开发探索方向的影响更加积极。图 E2 进一步证实了我们的发现：对于给定的评论量，当评论情绪变得更加负面时，利用探索方向就会增加。我们还看到，虽然平均情绪与评论同意度之间的交互项系数为负，但并不显着。这一结果表明，当评论情绪变得更加积极时，评论同意度可能对开发探索方向产生不显着但负面的影响。该结果也显示在图 E3 中。

## About the Authors




## 关于作者


Shadi Shuraida is an associate professor of information technology management at TÉLUQ—University of Quebec. He completed his PhD in management information technologies from HEC Montreal, and his research efforts focus on the development, implementation, and impact of information systems. His research has been published in European Journal of Information Systems, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, International Journal of Production Economics, AIS Transactions on Human-Computer Interaction, and Technology in Society.




Shadi Shuraida 是魁北克大学 TÉLUQ 信息技术管理副教授。他在蒙特利尔高等商学院获得了管理信息技术博士学位，他的研究重点是信息系统的开发、实施和影响。他的研究成果发表在《European Journal of Information Systems》、《Journal of the Association for Information Systems》、《International Journal of Production Economics》、《AIS Transactions on Human-Computer Interaction》和《Technology in Society》上。


Qiang Gao is an assistant professor in business analytics at Baruch College, City University of New York. He received his PhD in management information systems from the University of Arizona. Dr. Gao’s current research interests include financial technologies (fintech), internet-enabled communities and markets, machine learning, and business models as drivers of innovation and entrepreneurship. Dr. Gao’s work has been published in academic journals such as Information Systems Research, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, Decision Sciences, and Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology.




高强是纽约城市大学巴鲁克学院商业分析助理教授。他在亚利桑那大学获得管理信息系统博士学位。高博士目前的研究兴趣包括金融技术（fintech）、互联网社区和市场、机器学习以及作为创新和创业驱动力的商业模式。高博士的研究成果发表在Information Systems Research、Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis、Decision Sciences、Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology等学术期刊上。


Hani Safadi is associate professor at Terry College of Business, University of Georgia. He is interested in online communities, social media, health IT, information systems development, and the application of computational techniques in management research. His research has been published in outlets such as MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, Organization Science, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, and Journal of Medical Internet Research.




哈尼·萨法迪 (Hani Safadi) 是佐治亚大学特里商学院副教授。他对在线社区、社交媒体、健康 IT、信息系统开发以及计算技术在管理研究中的应用感兴趣。他的研究成果发表在 MIS Quarterly、Information Systems Research、Organization Science、Journal of the Association for Information Systems 和 Journal of Medical Internet Research 等媒体上。


Radhika Jain is an associate professor of information systems at the Zicklin School of Business, Baruch College. Her research focuses on open source software development, platform development, business process integration, and information systems sourcing strategies. Her research has been published in Journal of Management Information Systems, European Journal of Information Systems, ACM Transactions on Management Information Systems, IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management, Communications of the ACM, and Decision Support Systems. She completed her PhD in computer information systems at the J. Mack Robinson College of Business, Georgia State University.




Radhika Jain 是巴鲁克学院齐克林商学院信息系统副教授。她的研究重点是开源软件开发、平台开发、业务流程集成和信息系统采购策略。她的研究成果发表在《Journal of Management Information Systems》、《European Journal of Information Systems》、《ACM Transactions on Management Information Systems》、《IEEE Transactions on Engineering Management》、《Communications of the ACM》和《决策支持系统》上。她在佐治亚州立大学 J. Mack Robinson 商学院获得了计算机信息系统博士学位。

# Multicommunicating: Juggling Multiple Conversations in the Workplace




# 多重沟通：在工作场所处理多种对话


Ann-Frances Cameron




安-弗朗西斯·卡梅伦


HEC Montréal, Montréal, Québec H3T 2A7, Canada, ann-frances.cameron@hec.ca




HEC 蒙特利尔，蒙特利尔，魁北克 H3T 2A7，加拿大，ann-frances.cameron@hec.ca


Jane Webster




简·韦伯斯特


Queen’s School of Business, Queen’s University, Kingston, Ontario K7L 3N6, Canada, jwebster@business.queensu.ca




皇后大学皇后商学院，Kingston，Ontario K7L 3N6，加拿大，jwebster@business.queensu.ca


s a result of newer communication technologies and an increase in virtual communication, employees often find themselves multicommunicating, or participating in multiple conversations at the same time. This research seeks to explore multicommunicating from the perspective of the person juggling multiple conversations at the same time—the focal individual. To better understand this phenomenon, we extend previous theorizing by including the concepts of the episode initiator (whether the second conversation was focal or partner initiated), the fit of the set of media used in the episode, one process gain (conversation leveraging), and process losses. Employing a series of pilot studies and a main study, the resulting model was analyzed using structural equation modeling, finding overall support for the model. Findings suggest that experienced intensity is an important factor influencing process losses experienced during multicommunicating, whereas episode initiator influences process losses and the process gain. Further, media fit moderates the relationship between intensity and process losses. The importance of multicommunicating in the workplace is discussed, the theoretical and practical contributions of this research are described, and limitations and suggestions for future research are outlined.




由于更新的通信技术和虚拟通信的增加，员工经常发现自己在进行多种通信，或同时参与多个对话。本研究旨在从同时处理多个对话的人（焦点个人）的角度来探索多重沟通。为了更好地理解这一现象，我们扩展了之前的理论，包括情节发起者的概念（第二次对话是焦点还是合作伙伴发起的）、情节中使用的媒体集的适合度、一个过程增益（对话杠杆）和过程损失。通过一系列试点研究和一项主要研究，使用结构方程模型对所得模型进行了分析，找到了对该模型的总体支持。研究结果表明，体验强度是影响多重通信过程中经历的过程损失的重要因素，而事件发起者影响过程损失和过程增益。此外，介质适合度调节强度和过程损失之间的关系。讨论了工作场所多重沟通的重要性，描述了本研究的理论和实践贡献，并概述了未来研究的局限性和建议。


Key words: multicommunicating; polychronic communication; multitasking; dual-task performance; fit; productivity; process losses; intensity; PLS




关键词： 多重沟通；多时通讯；多任务处理；双任务性能；合身;生产率;过程损失；强度;偏最小二乘法


History: Elena Karahanna, Senior Editor; Katherine Stewart, Associate Editor. This paper was received on July 22, 2009, and was with the authors 17 months for 4 revisions. Published online in Articles in Advance November 8, 2012.




历史：Elena Karahanna，高级编辑；凯瑟琳·斯图尔特，副主编。该论文于2009年7月22日接收，与作者历时17个月，修改4次。在线发表于《提前文章》，2012 年 11 月 8 日。


Traditionalists say the use of BlackBerrys and iPhones in meetings is as gauche as ordering out for pizza. Technoevangelists insist that to ignore real-time text messages in a need-it-yesterday world is to invite peril. (Williams 2009, p. A1)




传统主义者表示，在会议中使用黑莓手机和 iPhone 就像叫披萨一样粗俗。技术传播者坚持认为，在一个需要它的昨天的世界中忽视实时短信会带来危险。 （威廉姆斯，2009 年，第 A1 页）


With the proliferation of new communication technologies and the increase in virtual communication (Morello 2005), many workers are expected to be continually “online.” They need to be constantly available to their customers, coworkers, and managers and feel pressure to answer an incoming call, reply to an email, or write a quick response to an instant message even when they are already engaged in a telephone call, face-to-face conversation, or ongoing meeting. As a result, workers often find themselves participating in multiple overlapping interactions.




随着新通信技术的普及和虚拟通信的增加（Morello 2005），许多工人预计将持续“在线”。他们需要随时为客户、同事和经理服务，即使他们已经在打电话、面对面交谈或正在进行的会议，但他们也会因接听来电、回复电子邮件或快速回复即时消息而感到压力。因此，员工经常发现自己参与多种重叠的互动。


This behavior is termed multicommunicating (MC) and occurs when an individual (the focal individual) engages in multiple overlapping conversations with multiple others (the communication partners) within a given time period (Turner and Tinsley 2002) such that the conversations show a pattern of interleaved speaking turns (Reinsch et al. 2008). Examples include an employee sending an instant message to a coworker while on the telephone with a client or a manager reading an email on her BlackBerry while in a faceto-face boardroom meeting. Researchers in the areas of management information systems (MIS), humancomputer interaction (HCI), and computer-supported cooperative work have all highlighted the practice of MC (e.g., Cameron and Webster 2005, Kakihara and Sorensen 2001, Nardi and Whittaker 2002).




这种行为被称为多重沟通（MC），当一个人（焦点个人）在给定时间段内与多个其他人（沟通伙伴）进行多次重叠对话时就会发生（Turner and Tinsley 2002），这样对话就会呈现出交错说话轮流的模式（Reinsch et al. 2008）。例如，员工在与客户通电话时向同事发送即时消息，或者在面对面的董事会会议上，经理在她的 BlackBerry 上阅读电子邮件。管理信息系统（MIS）、人机交互（HCI）和计算机支持的协作工作领域的研究人员都强调了 MC 的实践（例如，Cameron 和 Webster 2005、Kakihara 和 Sorensen 2001、Nardi 和 Whittaker 2002）。


The current prevalence of communication technologies facilitates MC (Reinsch et al. 2008). For example, two face-to-face conversations occurring at the same time will often merge and become a group conversation, whereas newer technologies make it easier to maintain two distinct conversations (where each conversation partner may or may not be aware of the other conversation). Thus, the goal of this research is to increase our understanding of MC where at least one of the conversations is technology mediated.<sup>1</sup> Because studying the impacts of our technologies (Benbasat and Zmud 2003) and investigating the transformative nature of technologies for communication and work tasks (Agarwal and Lucas 2005) are core properties of the MIS discipline, MC represents an interesting opportunity for IS researchers.




当前通信技术的流行促进了 MC（Reinsch et al. 2008）。例如，同时发生的两个面对面的对话通常会合并并成为一个群组对话，而更新的技术使得维护两个不同的对话变得更容易（每个对话伙伴可能会或可能不会知道另一个对话）。因此，本研究的目标是增进我们对 MC 的理解，其中至少有一次对话是由技术介导的。<sup>1</sup>由于研究我们的技术的影响（Benbasat 和 Zmud 2003）以及调查通信和工作任务技术的变革性质（Agarwal 和 Lucas 2005）是 MIS 学科的核心属性，因此 MC 为 IS 研究人员提供了一个有趣的机会。


It has been proposed that MC can result in gains for organizations. For example, employees may be more available to colleagues (Cameron and Webster 2011, Turner and Reinsch 2007), become more efficient as they hold concurrent discussions with others to help shed light on an issue (Reinsch et al. 2008), or integrate information from diverse sources to develop more creative solutions (Turner and Reinsch 2007). However, a potential problem with MC is suggested by the multitasking literature: people have problems performing two even relatively simple tasks at the same time (Pashler 1994). Given the efficiency-seeking approach of most organizations, it is important that employees and managers understand the productionrelated outcomes of MC as well as any factors that influence these outcomes.<sup>2</sup> Therefore, this research seeks to address the following research question: In an organizational context, what are the relevant production-related outcomes of MC for the focal individual and what factors influence these outcomes? In this research we focus on the MC episode, a communication experience where multiple conversations show a pattern of interleaved speaking turns.




有人提出，MC 可以为组织带来收益。例如，员工可能会更愿意为同事服务（Cameron 和 Webster 2011，Turner 和 Reinsch 2007），在与其他人同时进行讨论以帮助阐明问题时变得更有效率（Reinsch 等人，2008），或者整合来自不同来源的信息以开发更具创造性的解决方案（Turner 和 Reinsch 2007）。然而，多任务处理文献指出了 MC 的一个潜在问题：人们在同时执行两个相对简单的任务时会遇到问题（Pashler 1994）。鉴于大多数组织都追求效率，员工和管理者了解 MC 的生产相关结果以及影响这些结果的任何因素非常重要。<sup>2</sup>因此，本研究旨在解决以下研究问题：在组织背景下，对于焦点个人而言，MC 的相关生产相关结果是什么，以及哪些因素影响这些结果？在这项研究中，我们重点关注 MC 情节，这是一种交流体验，其中多个对话显示出交错的轮流说话模式。


To address this research question, we draw largely on the theorizing of Reinsch et al. (2008) about MC. We extend their work by incorporating two additional constructs to understand this behavior: media fit and the MC episode initiator. We further refine their work by examining specific process losses and one possible benefit of MC and by offering new insights into the various dimensions of MC intensity. Finally, through a large-scale survey, our work is the first to offer an empirical examination of the production-related outcomes of MC.




为了解决这个研究问题，我们主要借鉴 Reinsch 等人的理论。 （2008）关于MC。我们通过合并两个额外的结构来扩展他们的工作来理解这种行为：媒体契合度和 MC 剧集发起者。我们通过检查特定的过程损失和 MC 的一项可能的好处，并提供对 MC 强度的各个维度的新见解，进一步完善他们的工作。最后，通过大规模调查，我们的工作首次对 MC 的生产相关结果进行了实证检验。


## Understanding Multicommunicating




## 了解多重通信


Multicommunicating represents the managing of multiple conversations at the same time that show a pattern of interleaved speaking turns (Reinsch et al. 2008). We consider MC to be a particular type of multitasking. MC and multitasking have significant overlap: both involve engaging in multiple tasks at the same time and both are affected by the limits of our cognitive processing (Miller 1956). Thus, our understanding of MC can benefit from the existing multitasking literature, including research on dual-task interference, rapid task switching, and cognitive load (e.g., Haigney and Westerman 2001, Hancock et al. 2003, Pashler 1994, Rogers and Monsell 1995). This literature suggests that there are limits to our working memory that in turn restrict our cognitive information processing capabilities (Miller 1956). Performance deteriorates when these limits are exceeded (Sweller 1988, Sweller et al. 1998). Because of these limits, performing two tasks at the same time or rapidly switching between two tasks results in decreased task performance in terms of accuracy and response time (Pashler 1994, Rogers and Monsell 1995). These problems can be partially alleviated (but not eliminated) by practice (Ruthruff et al. 2001, Yeung and Monsell 2003) and physical compatibility of the tasks being performed (Haigney et al. 2000), but they increase with task complexity (Gillie and Broadbent 1989) and age (Verhaeghen et al. 2003).




多重沟通代表同时管理多个对话，呈现出交错轮流说话的模式（Reinsch et al. 2008）。我们认为 MC 是一种特殊类型的多任务处理。 MC 和多任务处理有显着的重叠：两者都涉及同时参与多个任务，并且都受到我们认知处理限制的影响（Miller 1956）。因此，我们对 MC 的理解可以受益于现有的多任务文献，包括双任务干扰、快速任务切换和认知负荷的研究（例如，Haigney 和 Westerman 2001、Hancock 等人 2003、Pashler 1994、Rogers 和 Monsell 1995）。该文献表明，我们的工作记忆存在局限性，进而限制了我们的认知信息处理能力（Miller 1956）。当超过这些限制时，性能就会恶化（Sweller 1988，Sweller et al. 1998）。由于这些限制，同时执行两项任务或在两项任务之间快速切换会导致任务性能在准确性和响应时间方面下降（Pashler 1994，Rogers 和 Monsell 1995）。这些问题可以通过实践（Ruthruff et al. 2001，Yeung and Monsell 2003）和所执行任务的物理兼容性（Haigney et al. 2000）得到部分缓解（但不能消除），但它们会随着任务复杂性（Gillie and Broadbent 1989）和年龄（Verhaeghen et al. 2003）而增加。
