Although the literature on multitasking can inform our understanding of MC, it still does not speak to all of the particularities of MC. MC is an extremely demanding form of multitasking: in addition to focusing on multiple tasks, individuals must balance different media, conversations, and communication partners (Reinsch et al. 2008). Existing multitasking literature has examined task pairs such as letter classification and number classification (Rogers and Monsell 1995), alphabetic arithmetic and geometric comparison (Yeung and Monsell 2003), transcription and listening (Brown et al. 1988), reading while listening to music (Kallinen 2002), and using cell phones while driving (Haigney et al. 2000). None of the existing research examines managing multiple communications, multiple media, or dealing with multiple communication partners.<sup>3</sup> Thus, additional research attention to MC and its outcomes is warranted.




尽管有关多任务处理的文献可以帮助我们理解 MC，但它仍然没有说明 MC 的所有特殊性。 MC 是一种要求极高的多任务处理形式：除了专注于多项任务之外，个人还必须平衡不同的媒体、对话和沟通伙伴（Reinsch 等，2008）。现有的多任务文献研究了诸如字母分类和数字分类（Rogers and Monsell 1995）、字母算术和几何比较（Yeung and Monsell 2003）、转录和听力（Brown et al. 1988）、边听音乐边阅读（Kallinen 2002）以及开车时使用手机（Haigney et al. 2000）等任务对。现有研究均未探讨如何管理多种沟通、多种媒体或与多个沟通伙伴打交道。<sup>3</sup>因此，有必要对 MC 及其结果进行额外的研究关注。


## Theoretical Development




## 理论发展


Although communication at work can serve multiple functions such as production (related to the performance of the task), group-well being, and member support (McGrath 1991), this research focuses on production-related processes and outcomes of MC and their antecedents. We examine five process losses and one type of gain—conversation leveraging— relevant in the context of MC. Drawing on existing theorizing on MC (Reinsch et al. 2008), technology fit (Dennis et al. 2001, Goodhue and Thompson 1995, Zigurs and Buckland 1998), and the sender versus receiver perspective (Straub and Karahanna 1998), we develop model hypotheses (see Figure 1) using realworld examples where possible to illustrate and add richness to our hypotheses’ development. These realworld examples come from our observations of and interviews with five employees of different organizations, interviews that were conducted to better understand the nature of this emerging phenomenon.<sup>4</sup>




尽管工作中的沟通可以发挥多种功能，例如生产（与任务的执行相关）、团体福祉和成员支持（McGrath 1991），但本研究重点关注 MC 的生产相关过程和结果及其前因。我们研究了与 MC 相关的五种流程损失和一种类型的收益（对话利用）。借鉴现有的 MC 理论（Reinsch et al. 2008）、技术契合度（Dennis et al. 2001、Goodhue and Thompson 1995、Zigurs and Buckland 1998）以及发送者与接收者视角（Straub and Karahanna 1998），我们使用现实世界的例子开发模型假设（见图 1），尽可能地说明并丰富我们假设的发展。这些现实世界的例子来自我们对不同组织的五名员工的观察和采访，这些采访是为了更好地了解这一新兴现象的本质。<sup>4</sup>


Figure 1 Model of Multicommunicating Processes and Outcomes  
![](/api/attachments/PK8M8NTY/fulltext/images/909e9d8ce9f5f5c4734093f620f201ee7fd48626bf639faa13b833e3d2135907.jpg)




图 1 多重通信过程和结果模型  
![](/api/attachments/PK8M8NTY/fulltext/images/909e9d8ce9f5f5c4734093f620f201ee7fd48626bf639faa13b833e3d2135907.jpg)


Multicommunicating Intensity. MC intensity is defined as the extent of multitasking during an MC episode. As we describe below, it can be conceptualized as a more objective multidimensional construct (measured formatively) or as experienced intensity (an overall perception measured reflectively). In determining the extent of multitasking, one may think of MC as the managing of multiple conversations at the same time, but research in cognitive psychology suggests that—much like a computer processor—the human brain is actually only processing one task at a time and can exhibit processing bottlenecks when working on more than one task at the same time (e.g., Levy and Pashler 2001, Pashler 1994, Pashler et al. 2001, Ruthruff et al. 2003). Most of these studies examine task performance and define bottlenecks in terms of milliseconds. To an observer we may appear to be performing multiple tasks at the same time, but in reality, our brains are feverishly working to switch back and forth between tasks as needed.<sup>5</sup> Each switch incurs a cost in terms of reaction time or cognitive processing (Rogers and Monsell 1995, Sohn and Anderson 2001), and these costs can add up when we are rapidly switching back and forth between many tasks. Further, some switches are cognitively more difficult and thus more costly than others (Yeung and Monsell 2003). Outside of a tightly controlled laboratory experiment, it may not be possible to capture each individual switching cost and total them. Instead, we attempt to assess the intensity of the MC episode to capture the level of switching costs associated with a particular MC episode. We now turn to distinguishing objective from experienced MC intensity.




多重沟通强度。 MC 强度定义为 MC 发作期间多任务处理的程度。正如我们下面所描述的，它可以被概念化为更客观的多维结构（形成性测量）或体验强度（反思性测量的整体感知）。在确定多任务处理的程度时，人们可能会认为 MC 是同时管理多个对话，但认知心理学研究表明，就像计算机处理器一样，人脑实际上一次只处理一项任务，并且在同时处理多个任务时可能会出现处理瓶颈（例如，Levy 和 Pashler 2001、Pashler 1994、Pashler 等人 2001、Ruthruff 等人 2001）。 2003）。这些研究大多数都检查任务性能并以毫秒为单位定义瓶颈。对于观察者来说，我们可能会同时执行多项任务，但实际上，我们的大脑正在根据需要在任务之间来回切换。<sup>5</sup>每次切换都会在反应时间或认知处理方面产生成本（Rogers 和 Monsell 1995，Sohn 和 Anderson 2001），当我们在许多任务之间快速来回切换时，这些成本会增加。此外，某些转换在认知上更加困难，因此比其他转换成本更高（Yeung 和 Monsell 2003）。在严格控制的实验室实验之外，可能无法捕获每个单独的转换成本并将其总计。相反，我们尝试评估 MC 事件的强度，以捕获与特定 MC 事件相关的转换成本水平。我们现在转向区分目标和经验丰富的 MC 强度。


Objective MC Intensity. Objective MC intensity is formed by episode characteristics such as the number of conversations, social roles, topics, and the complexity of those topics. Each dimension contributes to the number or difficulty of task switches at the cognitive level. For example, Reinsch et al. conceptualize a more intense episode as one where “(a) the number of open interactions is larger, (b) the pace of the interactions is more rapid, (c) the person’s evoked social roles are more numerous and more segmented, and (d) the interactions deal with more—and more cognitively challenging—topics” (2008, p. 394). MC intensity describes the multitasking experienced in the episode, but it is distinct from whether or not the focal individual effectively handles the multitasking demanded by the episode. Thus, MC intensity does not measure cognitive load but the multitasking characteristics of the situation (which could result in higher cognitive load). This is similar to the task demands or task characteristics described in the theory of cognitive load (Paas and Van Merrienboer 1994a, Paas et al. 2003).




目标 MC 强度。客观 MC 强度由情节特征形成，例如对话数量、社会角色、主题以及这些主题的复杂性。每个维度都会影响认知层面任务切换的数量或难度。例如，赖因施等人。将更激烈的情节概念化为“（a）开放互动的数量更多，（b）互动的节奏更快，（c）人诱发的社会角色更多且更细分，以及（d）互动涉及更多且更具认知挑战性的主题”（2008，第394页）。 MC 强度描述了事件中经历的多任务处理，但它与焦点个体是否有效处理事件所需的多任务处理不同。因此，MC 强度并不衡量认知负荷，而是衡量情境的多任务处理特征（这可能导致更高的认知负荷）。这类似于认知负荷理论中描述的任务需求或任务特征（Paas and Van Merrienboer 1994a，Paas et al. 2003）。


Previous MC research has conceptualized but not measured objective intensity or its formative dimensions. Similarly, the multitasking literature has not measured multitasking intensity but has inferred its level from deteriorations in performance (e.g., Bourke 1997, Pashler et al. 2001, Rogers and Monsell 1995) or from increases in cognitive load (e.g., Paas and Van Merrienboer 1994b). We now turn to describing MC intensity’s dimensions.




以前的 MC 研究已经概念化但没有测量客观强度或其形成维度。同样，多任务处理文献也没有测量多任务处理的强度，而是根据表现的恶化（例如，Bourke 1997，Pashler et al. 2001，Rogers 和 Monsell 1995）或认知负荷的增加（例如，Paas 和 Van Merrienboer 1994b）来推断其水平。我们现在开始描述 MC 强度的维度。


Number of Overlapping Conversations. We define the number of overlapping conversations in an episode as the maximum number of focal individual conversations open at one time—that is, begun but not yet terminated during the episode. For example, if the focal starts conversation A, then conversations B and C, and then terminates conversation A and B, she or he was involved in a maximum of three overlapping conversations during the episode. However, if the focal starts conversation A, then conversation B, then finishes conversation A before starting conversation C, she or he was involved in only two overlapping conversations. Our exploratory interviews revealed some anecdotes of three, four, and even five conversations at one time, but most were two overlapping conversations.




重叠对话的数量。我们将一个情节中重叠对话的数量定义为一次打开的焦点个人对话的最大数量，即在该情节期间开始但尚未终止的对话。例如，如果焦点开始对话 A，然后对话 B 和 C，然后终止对话 A 和 B，则她或他在该片段期间最多参与三个重叠对话。然而，如果焦点开始对话 A，然后对话 B，然后在开始对话 C 之前完成对话 A，则她或他仅参与两个重叠的对话。我们的探索性采访揭示了一些同时进行三、四甚至五次对话的轶事，但大多数是两次重叠的对话。


Multitasking research generally examines two tasks at one time and has not compared the effects of differing numbers of tasks (e.g., Levy and Pashler 2001, Pashler 1994, Rogers and Monsell 1995, Van Selst et al. 1999). The multitasking literature does suggest, however, that each task to which we attend has an associated task set—a configuration of cognitive processes outlining the rules, appropriate responses, motor processes, etc., necessary for the performance of that task (Sakai 2008). Being able to switch back and forth between tasks requires that we actively maintain these task sets in working memory, and it takes cognitive effort to maintain each task set. The higher the number of tasks, the higher the number of task sets that need to be maintained, increasing our cognitive processing (Rogers and Monsell 1995). For MC, the higher the number of overlapping conversations, the higher the number of task sets that need to be stored in working memory and the higher the cognitive switching costs. This supports the Reinsch et al. (2008) proposition that the number of open interactions or conversations is an important dimension of intensity.




多任务研究通常同时检查两项任务，并且没有比较不同数量任务的效果（例如，Levy 和 Pashler 2001、Pashler 1994、Rogers 和 Monsell 1995、Van Selst 等人 1999）。然而，多任务处理文献确实表明，我们参与的每项任务都有一个相关的任务集——概述执行该任务所需的规则、适当反应、运动过程等的认知过程配置（Sakai 2008）。能够在任务之间来回切换需要我们在工作记忆中主动维护这些任务集，并且需要认知努力来维护每个任务集。任务数量越多，需要维护的任务集数量就越多，从而增加我们的认知处理能力（Rogers 和 Monsell 1995）。对于MC来说，重叠对话的数量越多，需要存储在工作记忆中的任务集数量就越多，认知切换成本就越高。这支持了 Reinsch 等人的观点。 (2008) 认为开放互动或对话的数量是强度的一个重要维度。


Pace of Switching. We define pace of switching as the frequency with which the focal individual shifts attention between conversations. One of our interviewees reported a “mental moment of losing [his] thought” during rapid switching between conversations. However, we observed that employees were largely able to handle slower switching between conversations— e.g., giving a response to a single question in a second conversation and then returning to the first conversation—without disrupting the flow of the first conversation. Faster paced switching between the multiple conversations means that our brains not only have to process the content of the multiple conversations themselves but also face an increasing number of switching costs.




切换的节奏。我们将切换速度定义为焦点人物在对话之间转移注意力的频率。我们的一位受访者报告说，在对话之间快速切换时，“精神上失去了思考”。然而，我们观察到，员工在很大程度上能够处理对话之间较慢的切换，例如，在第二次对话中回答单个问题，然后返回到第一个对话，而不会中断第一个对话的流程。多个对话之间更快的切换意味着我们的大脑不仅必须自己处理多个对话的内容，而且还要面临越来越多的切换成本。


Multitasking research has also found that predictability and foreknowledge regarding the change from one task to another (e.g., a predictable pace) partially reduces the switching costs (Rogers and Monsell 1995, Sohn and Anderson 2001). In MC, any jumps or switches between conversations usually follow the flow of the conversations. There is little predictability because the timing of the switching is not completely under the control of the focal individual but depends on the actions of the communication partners. Because MC is a type of multitasking where it is particularly difficult to predict switches in advance, the effects of faster paced switching may be exacerbated. Thus, consistent with Reinsch et al. (2008), we conceptualize pace of switching as an important dimension of intensity.




多任务研究还发现，从一项任务转换到另一项任务的可预测性和预知性（例如，可预测的速度）部分降低了转换成本（Rogers 和 Monsell 1995，Sohn 和 Anderson 2001）。在 MC 中，对话之间的任何跳转或切换通常都遵循对话的流程。几乎没有可预测性，因为切换的时间并不完全由焦点个人控制，而是取决于通信伙伴的行为。由于 MC 是一种多任务处理类型，提前预测切换特别困难，因此更快节奏切换的影响可能会加剧。因此，与 Reinsch 等人的观点一致。 （2008），我们将转换速度概念化为强度的一个重要维度。


Segmentation of Social Roles. Segmentation of social roles is the extent to which the focal individual draws on different social roles in each MC conversation. One interviewee reported concerns when juggling a client telephone conversation at the same time as engaging in a face-to-face conversation with a family member—an example of highly segmented roles. When managing multiple conversations as part of his customer support function, however, the same individual did not even consider that this was an example of MC. As evidenced in these illustrations, MC is an inherently social phenomenon; during conversations, individuals are enacting particular social roles and drawing on stored role schemas to determine the set of behaviors that are appropriate for those roles (Fiske and Taylor 1991).




社会角色的细分。社会角色的细分是指焦点个人在每次 MC 对话中利用不同社会角色的程度。一位受访者表示，他在与客户电话交谈的同时又与家庭成员进行面对面交谈时感到担忧——这是角色高度细分的一个例子。然而，当管理多个对话作为其客户支持职能的一部分时，同一个人甚至没有考虑到这是 MC 的一个例子。正如这些插图所证明的那样，MC 本质上是一种社会现象；在对话过程中，个人扮演特定的社会角色，并利用存储的角色模式来确定适合这些角色的行为集（Fiske and Taylor 1991）。


Because managing role schemas and other relationship processes during a conversation requires cognitive processing, people have limits on how many different roles they can effectively support at one time (Brodt et al. 2002). When dealing with multiple conversations involving separate social roles, focal individuals may have to draw on multiple internally stored schemas to communicate with their multiple conversation partners. Individuals must make transitions by switching between these social roles, which can result in role conflict and higher intensity (Reinsch et al. 2008). Conversely (like our interviewee above), managing multiple conversations while fulfilling the same social role may be perceived as lower intensity MC because only one role schema needs to be managed. Thus, consistent with Reinsch et al.




由于在对话期间管理角色模式和其他关系过程需要认知处理，因此人们对一次可以有效支持的不同角色数量存在限制（Brodt et al. 2002）。当处理涉及不同社会角色的多个对话时，焦点个人可能必须利用多个内部存储的模式来与他们的多个对话伙伴进行通信。个人必须通过在这些社会角色之间切换来实现转变，这可能会导致角色冲突和更高的强度（Reinsch et al. 2008）。相反（就像我们上面的受访者一样），在履行相同的社会角色的同时管理多个对话可能会被视为较低强度的 MC，因为只需要管理一种角色模式。因此，与 Reinsch 等人的观点一致。


(2008), we model the segmentation of social roles as a dimension of intensity.




（2008），我们将社会角色的细分建模为强度维度。


Differences in Topics. Reinsch et al. (2008) suggest that the number and the challenge of the topics during MC represent another dimension of intensity. However, we conceptualize these as two separate and important dimensions of intensity: differences in topics and topic complexity.




主题的差异。赖因施等人。 (2008) 表明 MC 期间主题的数量和挑战代表了强度的另一个维度。然而，我们将它们概念化为两个独立且重要的强度维度：主题差异和主题复杂性。


Differences in topics indicates the extent to which the topics in each MC conversation are dissimilar. Our observations and interviews suggest that similarity between topics used in each conversation may reduce, whereas dissimilarity may increase, intensity. One of our interviewees related an MC episode in which it was difficult to multitask because the two conversations were about different topics. Further, some focal individuals attempt to only multicommunicate when the conversations have similar topics (Turner and Reinsch 2007). When the topics are similar, only one set of task information (e.g., information on the context of this particular topic) needs to be retained in working memory, reducing the amount of cognitive switching required. When MC happens with two different topics, focal individuals need to retain information about both topics in working memory and need to alternate between the sets of information to appropriately respond and contribute to the multiple conversations. Thus, we propose that it is differences in topics rather than number of topics that increases intensity.




主题差异表示每个 MC 对话中主题的不同程度。我们的观察和访谈表明，每次对话中使用的主题之间的相似性可能会降低，而不同性可能会增加强度。我们的一位受访者提到了 MC 的一集，其中很难同时处理多项任务，因为两次对话涉及不同的主题。此外，一些焦点人物仅在对话具有相似主题时才尝试进行多重交流（Turner 和 Reinsch 2007）。当主题相似时，仅需要在工作记忆中保留一组任务信息（例如，有关该特定主题的上下文的信息），从而减少所需的认知切换量。当 MC 发生在两个不同的主题时，焦点个人需要在工作记忆中保留有关两个主题的信息，并且需要在信息集之间交替，以适当地响应并为多个对话做出贡献。因此，我们建议增加强度的是主题的差异而不是主题的数量。


Complexity of Topics. Topic complexity is a function of objective topic characteristics that increase the cognitive demands placed on the focal individual (Campbell 1988). These characteristics could include elements such as the number of interrelated or conflicting sub-elements (Campbell and Gingrich 1986), the number of decisions and decision criteria (Fisher et al. 2003), the multiplicity of alternative paths for achieving the same goals (Terborg and Miller 1978), and the associated level of uncertainty (March and Simon 1958).




主题的复杂性。主题复杂性是客观主题特征的函数，它增加了对焦点个体的认知需求（Campbell 1988）。这些特征可能包括诸如相互关联或冲突的子元素的数量（Campbell 和 Gingrich 1986）、决策和决策标准的数量（Fisher 等人 2003）、实现相同目标的替代路径的多样性（Terborg 和 Miller 1978）以及相关的不确定性水平（March 和 Simon 1958）等要素。


All of our interviewees discussed the issue of topic complexity, leading us to propose this as an important dimension of intensity that is separate from differences in topics. One manager explained that he regularly brought his laptop and checked his email during low complexity meetings (such as those involving information sharing rather than decision making) because those types of meetings require less focus and, as a result, are appropriate for MC. Prior research has also found that multitasking with high complexity tasks may overload an individual’s cognitive resources (Gillie and Broadbent 1989, Nunes and Recarte 2002). Similarly, group support systems researchers suggest that complexity may increase demands for cognitive attention, and they call for further research on the topic (Heninger et al. 2006). Drawing on media richness theory (Daft and Lengel 1986), Turner and Reinsch (2007) propose that employees will face multiple and conflicting interpretations of issues as MC topics become more equivocal. With higher equivocality, employees will be less likely to multicommunicate (Turner and Reinsch 2007). In support of this, they found that the most frequently occurring theme in a qualitative study of MC was topic complexity and, with more complex topics, employees were less likely to multicommunicate. Further, in an MBA student vignette study, they found that higher equivocality related to a lower likelihood of MC.




我们所有的受访者都讨论了主题复杂性的问题，这使我们提出将其作为与主题差异无关的重要强度维度。一位经理解释说，他经常在低复杂度的会议（例如涉及信息共享而不是决策的会议）期间携带笔记本电脑并检查电子邮件，因为这些类型的会议需要较少的焦点，因此适合 MC。先前的研究还发现，高复杂性任务的多任务处理可能会使个人的认知资源超载（Gillie 和 Broadbent 1989，Nunes 和 Recarte 2002）。同样，群体支持系统研究人员认为，复杂性可能会增加对认知注意力的需求，他们呼吁对该主题进行进一步研究（Heninger 等，2006）。 Turner 和 Reinsch (2007) 根据媒体丰富性理论（Daft 和 Lengel，1986）提出，随着 MC 主题变得更加模棱两可，员工将面临对问题的多重且相互冲突的解释。歧义越高，员工进行多重沟通的可能性就越小（Turner 和 Reinsch 2007）。为了支持这一点，他们发现在 MC 定性研究中最常出现的主题是主题复杂性，并且主题越复杂，员工进行多重交流的可能性就越小。此外，在一项 MBA 学生小插曲研究中，他们发现较高的歧义性与较低的 MC 可能性相关。


Topic complexity increases the difficulty of switching from one task to another and, thus, contributes to MC intensity. Further, we propose that the topic complexity of each conversation contributes independently to MC intensity. That is, one conversation could be low whereas the other one is high in complexity with the complexities of both conversations contributing to intensity. Similarly, past researchers have not examined overall complexity but have argued that it is the complexity of each conversation that is important (e.g., Turner and Reinsch 2007).




主题复杂性增加了从一项任务切换到另一项任务的难度，从而增加了 MC 强度。此外，我们提出每个对话的主题复杂性独立地影响 MC 强度。也就是说，一个对话的复杂度可能较低，而另一个对话的复杂度可能较高，而这两种对话的复杂性都会增加强度。同样，过去的研究人员没有研究整体复杂性，但认为每个对话的复杂性才是重要的（例如，Turner 和 Reinsch 2007）。


Experienced MC intensity. Although intensity can be an objective assessment of the extent of multitasking during a MC episode, experienced intensity subjectively measures an individual’s perception of this. Although the objective and experienced measures should be related, they are not equal: the same objective extent of multitasking may be experienced as more intense by some persons and less intense by others. Taking into account the Reinsch et al. (2008) theory, as well as our extensions above, we expect that objective intensity will be related to experienced intensity.




经验丰富的MC强度。虽然强度可以客观评估 MC 期间多任务处理的程度，但经验强度可以主观地衡量个人对此的看法。尽管客观测量和经验测量应该是相关的，但它们并不相等：相同客观程度的多任务处理可能会被某些人体验为更强烈，而另一些人则感觉不太强烈。考虑到 Reinsch 等人。 （2008）理论以及我们上面的扩展，我们期望客观强度将与经验强度相关。


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>1</sup> <sup>(H1).</sup> Objective MC intensity—determined by the dimensions of (a) number of overlapping conversations, (b) pace of switching, (c) segmentation of social roles, (d) differences in topics, and (e) complexity of topics—will influence experienced MC intensity.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>1</sup> <sup>(H1)。</sup> 目标 MC 强度（由 (a) 重叠对话数量、(b) 切换速度、(c) 社会角色细分、(d) 主题差异和 (e) 主题复杂性等维度确定）将影响体验的 MC 强度。


It is important to note that it is the experienced, rather than the more objective, intensity construct that is important to the outcomes of intensity.




值得注意的是，对强度结果来说重要的是经验丰富的强度结构，而不是更客观的强度结构。


Experienced MC Intensity and Process Losses. Reinsch and colleagues (2008) propose a relationship between MC intensity and performance. Those episodes that are experienced as more intense can impose a higher load on the focal individual’s cognitive functioning. There are limits to our cognitive information processing capabilities, and performance deteriorates when these limits are exceeded (Miller 1956, Sweller 1988, Sweller et al. 1998). The idea of limited working memory has been used in many areas of research including group support systems (Grisé and Gallupe 1999), decision support systems (Speier et al. 2003), electronic communication (Brodt et al. 2002, Hiltz and Turoff 1985), knowledge management (Gray and Meister 2004), and HCI (Nilsson and Mayer 2002). For instance, Heninger et al. (2006) found that individuals who were both reading and contributing to group support tasks experienced reduced information processing as compared to those who only read. Consequently, episodes that are experienced as higher in MC intensity should result in more process losses.<sup>6</sup>




经历过 MC 强度和过程损失。 Reinsch 及其同事（2008）提出了 MC 强度和绩效之间的关系。那些经历得更强烈的事件会给焦点个人的认知功能带来更高的负担。我们的认知信息处理能力是有限的，当超过这些限制时，性能就会下降（Miller 1956，Sweller 1988，Sweller et al. 1998）。有限工作记忆的概念已被应用于许多研究领域，包括群体支持系统（Grisé and Gallupe 1999）、决策支持系统（Speier et al. 2003）、电子通信（Brodt et al. 2002、Hiltz and Turoff 1985）、知识管理（Gray and Meister 2004）和人机交互（Nilsson and Mayer 2002）。例如，海宁格等人。 （2006）发现，与只阅读的人相比，同时阅读并为团体支持任务做出贡献的人的信息处理能力有所减少。因此，MC 强度较高的事件会导致更多的过程损失。<sup>6</sup>


Although Reinsch et al. (2008) propose a relationship between intensity and performance, they do not theorize about what is meant by performance in the context of MC. Using an input-processingoutput approach, we differentiate between the impacts of experienced intensity on the specific behaviors, actions, and states that we experience during the MC episode (captured by process losses—Alavi 1994, Pinsonneault et al. 1999, Steiner 1972) and on outcomes (captured by productivity—see below). In the group decision literature, process losses are defined as factors that inhibit the groups’ generation of ideas (Pinsonneault et al. 1999). For MC, we define process losses as the series of actions, behaviors, or states experienced during the MC episode that inhibit the focal individual from accomplishing his or her communication tasks.




尽管 Reinsch 等人。 (2008) 提出了强度和表现之间的关系，但他们没有对 MC 背景下的表现含义进行理论化。使用输入-处理输出方法，我们区分了体验强度对我们在 MC 期间经历的特定行为、行动和状态的影响（由过程损失捕获 - Alavi 1994，Pinsonneault 等人 1999，Steiner 1972）和结果（由生产力捕获 - 见下文）。在群体决策文献中，过程损失被定义为抑制群体产生想法的因素（Pinsonneault 等，1999）。对于 MC，我们将过程损失定义为在 MC 事件期间经历的一系列阻碍焦点个体完成他或她的沟通任务的动作、行为或状态。


Specific process losses emerged during our exploratory observations and interviews. When juggling multiple, complex conversations, interviewees reported errors during MC such as spelling mistakes in typed messages. They also sometimes experienced confusion and reported that it was like “losing your thought” during the MC episode. In one episode, the focal individual was asked a direct question twice in a row and had to ask that the question be repeated a third time before he was able to respond. In addition, one interviewee exhibited a delay of several seconds in a face-to-face conversation when also checking his BlackBerry, and another reported that “it may be 5 to 10 minutes before you respond and someone might think that you have fallen off the face of the Earth.” In another example, one employee received some texts while in an interview with the first author.




在我们的探索性观察和访谈中出现了具体的过程损失。在处理多个复杂的对话时，受访者报告了 MC 期间的错误，例如输入消息中的拼写错误。他们有时也会感到困惑，并报告说在 MC 节目中就像“失去了思考”。在一次事件中，焦点人物连续两次被问到一个直接问题，并且必须要求他重复第三次这个问题才能做出回应。此外，一位受访者在面对面交谈时查看黑莓手机时出现了几秒钟的延迟，另一位受访者则报告说“可能需要 5 到 10 分钟才能做出回应，有人可能会认为你已经从地球表面掉下来了。”在另一个例子中，一名员工在采访第一作者时收到了一些短信。


The employee averaged 101 words each time he spoke to the author before receiving the texts and 16 words each time he spoke during the texts, exhibiting reduced participation in the interview. Thus, process losses relevant in the context of MC are errors, confusion, repetition, slower responses, and reduced participation on the part of the focal individual.<sup>7</sup> In line with limited cognitive processing, and using the outcomes that emerged during our exploratory study, we propose that increases in experienced intensity should increase these process losses:




该员工在收到短信之前平均每次与作者交谈 101 个单词，而在短信期间每次与作者交谈平均 16 个单词，这表明他对采访的参与度有所下降。因此，与 MC 相关的过程损失包括错误、混乱、重复、反应较慢以及焦点个人的参与减少。<sup>7</sup>根据有限的认知处理，并使用我们探索性研究中出现的结果，我们建议体验强度的增加应该会增加这些过程损失：


## <sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>(H2).</sup> Higher experienced MC intensity will result in more process losses.




## <sup>假设</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>(H2)。</sup> 经验丰富的 MC 强度越高，将导致更多的过程损失。


Media Fit. The notion of fit has been extensively studied in the MIS literature (Daft and Lengel 1986, Dennis et al. 2001, Dennis et al. 2008, Goodhue and Thompson 1995), and we suggest that this literature must incorporate another fit construct—medium-tomedium fit (herein termed media fit)—that is important for MC. In our exploratory study and the existing literature (Turner et al. 2006, Woerner et al. 2004), certain combinations of media were used more frequently than others. Reinsch et al. (2008) propose that certain technologies have features that are particularly supportive of MC. We propose that it is not only the features of a single technology that are important, but the fit of the set of media that are used during MC. Further, it is not just the media themselves that are important (e.g., pairing telephone with instant messaging), but the media capabilities or the “potential structures provided by a medium” (Dennis et al. 2008, p. 583) that should be examined (e.g., pairing two media without visibility). Thus, we examine media fit, or the extent to which the capabilities of the medium used for one conversation complement the capabilities of the medium used for the second conversation (Cameron and Webster 2011). Although fit is a widely used term, its “precise nature and meaning are rarely stated” (Joyce et al. 1982, as cited in Zigurs and Buckland 1998, p. 322). In our study, media fit is an episode-neutral, contextfree assessment of fit that only takes into account the characteristics of the media.




媒体适合。适合度的概念在 MIS 文献中得到了广泛的研究（Daft 和 Lengel 1986、Dennis 等人 2001、Dennis 等人 2008、Goodhue 和 Thompson 1995），我们建议这些文献必须包含另一种适合度结构——中等-中等适合度（本文称为媒体适合度）——这对于 MC 很重要。在我们的探索性研究和现有文献中（Turner 等人，2006 年，Woerner 等人，2004 年），某些媒体组合比其他媒体组合使用得更频繁。赖因施等人。 (2008) 提出某些技术具有特别支持 MC 的特性。我们认为，重要的不仅是单一技术的特性，还有 MC 期间使用的媒体集的适合度。此外，重要的不仅仅是媒体本身（例如，将电话与即时消息配对），还应该检查媒体功能或“媒体提供的潜在结构”（Dennis et al. 2008，第 583 页）（例如，在不可见的情况下配对两个媒体）。因此，我们检查媒体契合度，或者用于一次对话的媒体功能与用于第二次对话的媒体功能互补的程度（Cameron 和 Webster 2011）。尽管“适合”是一个广泛使用的术语，但其“精确的性质和含义很少被阐明”（Joyce 等人，1982 年，Zigurs 和 Buckland 1998 年，第 322 页引用）。在我们的研究中，媒体契合度是一种与事件无关、与情境无关的契合度评估，仅考虑媒体的特征。


We hypothesize that media fit moderates the relationship between experienced intensity and process losses. That is, when media fit is low, an increase in intensity will result in an increase in process losses as our communication activities start to overtax our cognitive resources. In contrast, when media fit is high, an increase in intensity may not result in an increase in process losses because we are able to use the characteristics of the media pair to mitigate the damage or reduce our cognitive load during these episodes. We provide the rationale for this moderator relationship in our discussion of media fit that follows.




我们假设媒体适合度调节体验强度和过程损失之间的关系。也就是说，当媒体适合度较低时，强度的增加将导致过程损失的增加，因为我们的沟通活动开始过度消耗我们的认知资源。相反，当媒体适合度很高时，强度的增加可能不会导致过程损失的增加，因为我们能够利用媒体对的特征来减轻这些事件期间的损害或减少我们的认知负荷。我们在接下来的媒体契合度讨论中提供了这种主持人关系的基本原理。


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>(H3).</sup> Media fit will moderate the relationship between experienced MC intensity and process losses.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>(H3)。</sup>介质适合度将调节经历的 MC 强度和过程损失之间的关系。


We adopt the profile-deviation perspective of fit: how well the media fit together depends on the extent of “adherence to an externally specified profile” (Venkatraman 1989, p. 433). Researchers develop these externally specified profiles either theoretically or empirically by using data not part of the main model testing (Venkatraman 1989). We did both, developing theoretically derived profiles and then testing these profiles with data from another study (see online Appendix 3, available at http://dx.doi .org/10.1287/isre.1120.0446). Our media fit profiles were theoretically derived by examining combinations of specific media capabilities. Although future research may find other media capabilities to be important, our exploratory observations as well as the existing literature led us to focus on four capabilities: reviewability, revisability, visibility, and delayability.




我们采用轮廓偏差的拟合观点：介质的配合程度取决于“遵守外部指定轮廓”的程度（Venkatraman 1989，第 433 页）。研究人员通过使用不属于主要模型测试的数据，从理论上或经验上开发这些外部指定的配置文件（Venkatraman 1989）。我们同时进行了这两项工作，开发了理论上得出的配置文件，然后使用另一项研究的数据测试这些配置文件（请参阅在线附录 3，可在 http://dx.doi .org/10.1287/isre.1120.0446 上获取）。从理论上讲，我们的介质适合度是通过检查特定介质功能的组合而得出的。尽管未来的研究可能会发现其他媒体功能也很重要，但我们的探索性观察以及现有文献使我们重点关注四种功能：可审查性、可修订性、可见性和可延迟性。


A medium with reviewability means that messages are available for review later in the conversation (Clark and Brennan 1991; termed reprocessability in Dennis et al. 2008). Email and most instant messaging programs support the review of messages from earlier in the conversation. In our exploratory study, three MC episodes were observed where the focal individual had to ask the person at the other end of the telephone to repeat what was said. However, such repetition was not observed in any MC episodes involving at least one medium with reviewability. Multicommunicating with media that have reviewability means that episodes experienced as higher in intensity do not result in process losses: because focal individuals are able to review messages from earlier in the conversation, they do not need to hold as much information about that conversation in working memory because it is readily available. They have more cognitive resources to devote to effectively manage the multiple conversations and limit their process losses. In addition, although focal individuals may need to expend extra cognitive effort reviewing the messages, the messages are available for review at a later time and they can engage in the reviewing during a cognitive lull in the episode.




具有可审查性的媒介意味着消息可以在对话的后期进行审查（Clark 和 Brennan 1991；在 Dennis 等人 2008 中称为可再处理性）。电子邮件和大多数即时消息程序都支持查看对话早期的消息。在我们的探索性研究中，观察到了三起 MC 事件，其中焦点人物必须要求电话另一端的人重复所说的话。然而，在任何涉及至少一种具有可审查性的媒体的 MC 事件中，没有观察到这种重复。与具有可审查性的媒体进行多重交流意味着经历的强度较高的事件不会导致过程损失：因为焦点个人能够回顾对话早期的消息，所以他们不需要在工作记忆中保留有关该对话的尽可能多的信息，因为这些信息很容易获得。他们拥有更多的认知资源来有效管理多个对话并限制流程损失。此外，尽管焦点个人可能需要花费额外的认知努力来查看这些消息，但这些消息可以在稍后的时间进行查看，并且他们可以在该事件的认知间歇期间参与查看。


Revisability means the medium allows messages to be changed before sending them (Clark and Brennan 1991; termed rehearsability in Dennis et al. 2008). Email and most instant messaging programs allow focal individuals to revise messages before sending them. One employee revealed that she commonly wrote emails while on the telephone. However, she would always quickly review an email for content, spelling, and grammatical mistakes before sending it. With media that support revisability, high experienced intensity episodes are less likely to result in process losses such as errors or confusion because focal individuals can create a draft version of what they would like to say and then revise it if needed. In media without revisability, focal individuals must attempt to compose a perfect final version mentally because they cannot refine their messages. In a high intensity episode, this overloads the focal individual’s cognitive processing and makes it more likely that process losses will be experienced.




可修改性意味着媒介允许在发送消息之前对其进行更改（Clark 和 Brennan 1991；在 Dennis 等人 2008 中称为可演练性）。电子邮件和大多数即时通讯程序允许焦点个人在发送消息之前修改消息。一名员工透露，她通常在打电话时写电子邮件。然而，她总是会在发送之前快速检查电子邮件的内容、拼写和语法错误。使用支持可修改性的媒体，高经验强度事件不太可能导致错误或混乱等过程损失，因为焦点个人可以创建他们想说的内容的草稿版本，然后在需要时进行修改。在没有可修改性的媒体中，焦点人物必须尝试在精神上撰写完美的最终版本，因为他们无法完善自己的信息。在高强度事件中，这会使焦点个人的认知处理超载，并且更有可能经历过程损失。


During face-to-face conversations, focal individuals communicate with all of their senses. Facial expressions and body movements are interpreted by the communication partners, whether those expressions were expressly intended for that conversation or not. However, a medium with invisibility does not allow these visual cues to be exchanged during the interaction (e.g., telephone, email, or instant messaging). Invisibility is related to the Reinsch et al. notion of compartmentalization, or “the extent to which a medium restricts the concurrent availability of communicative cues from an interaction to only those participating in the interaction” (2008, p. 396). Visual cues are one type of cue that can be restricted during MC. Invisibility makes it easier to compartmentalize the different conversations, and the focal individual does not have to expend effort masking facial reactions to the other conversation. Thus, invisibility of both media is needed to reduce the cognitive effort associated with masking facial reactions (for example, even when only one of the conversations is face to face, masking is required). In high experienced intensity episodes, the effort associated with controlling facial expressions increases the focal individual’s cognitive load, increasing the likelihood of process losses.




在面对面的交谈中，焦点人物会用他们所有的感官进行交流。面部表情和身体动作由交流伙伴解释，无论这些表情是否明确用于该对话。然而，隐形媒介不允许在交互过程中交换这些视觉线索（例如，电话、电子邮件或即时消息）。隐形与 Reinsch 等人有关。区隔化的概念，或“媒介将交互中的交流线索的并发可用性限制为仅限于参与交互的人的程度”（2008，第396页）。视觉提示是 MC 期间可以限制的一种提示。隐形使得区分不同的对话变得更加容易，并且焦点个人不必花费精力掩盖对其他对话的面部反应。因此，需要两种媒体的不可见性来减少与掩盖面部反应相关的认知工作（例如，即使只有其中一种对话是面对面的，也需要掩盖）。在经历过的高强度事件中，与控制面部表情相关的努力会增加焦点个体的认知负荷，从而增加过程损失的可能性。


Although different media have some inherent amount of delay as a result of their physical characteristics (a letter may be in transit for days, an email in transit for minutes, a word uttered on the telephone in transit for nanoseconds), our concept of delayability also includes an element that is socially construed. That is, delayability is also derived from what is socially allowed in the use of that medium (Dennis et al. 2008). We define a medium with delayability as one that allows communicators to delay their responses or vary the tempo of their conversations (termed flexibility of tempo in Reinsch et al. 2008). Communicators can maintain flexibility by including at least one medium in which a communication partner will tolerate delayed responses (Reinsch et al. 2008). For media such as email, and to a lesser extent instant messaging, the delay can be long and it may be some time before partners “think you have fallen off the face of the Earth” (interviewee). However, for face-to-face and telephone conversations, “you have to be continuously answering, so any little distraction could be too much” (interviewee). During a high experienced intensity MC episode, the cognitive load of the focal individual is constantly changing depending on the demands of the moment, creating a pattern of peaks and valleys. It is during these peaks that the focal individual’s cognitive load may be too high, leading to overload and process losses. MC using at least one medium with delayability means that the focal individual can delay his or her responses during peak periods in the conversation using that medium, responding instead during a “valley” or lull in the other conversation. Smoothing out these peaks and valleys enables the focal individual to minimize moments of cognitive overload and results in fewer process losses.<sup>8</sup>




尽管不同的媒体由于其物理特性而具有一些固有的延迟量（一封信可能会传输几天，一封电子邮件可能会传输几分钟，电话中说出的一个词可能会传输几纳秒），但我们的延迟性概念还包括一个社会解释的元素。也就是说，延迟性也源自社会允许使用该媒介的内容（Dennis 等人，2008）。我们将具有延迟性的媒介定义为允许沟通者延迟响应或改变对话节奏的媒介（Reinsch 等人，2008 年称为节奏灵活性）。沟通者可以通过至少包含一种沟通伙伴能够容忍延迟响应的媒介来保持灵活性（Reinsch et al. 2008）。对于电子邮件等媒体，以及较小程度上的即时消息传递，延迟可能会很长，并且可能需要一段时间合作伙伴才会“认为您已经从地球表面掉下来”（受访者）。然而，对于面对面和电话交谈，“你必须不断地回答，所以任何一点点的干扰都可能会导致太多”（受访者）。在高强度 MC 发作期间，焦点个体的认知负荷会根据当时的需求不断变化，从而形成峰值和谷值的模式。正是在这些高峰期间，焦点个人的认知负荷可能过高，导致超载和过程损失。 MC 使用至少一种具有可延迟性的媒介意味着焦点个人可以在使用该媒介的对话高峰期延迟其响应，而在其他对话的“低谷”或平静期进行响应。平滑这些高峰和低谷可以让焦点个人最大限度地减少认知超负荷的时刻，从而减少过程损失。<sup>8</sup>


Given the arguments above, media fit will be higher for a pair of media when at least one has the capability of reviewability, revisability, and delayability and both have invisibility. Thus, we suggest that the media pairs with highest media fit are those that include at least one medium with delayability, reviewability, and revisability and both media with invisibility (e.g., instant messaging paired with telephone), whereas moderate media fit are pairs with at least one medium with delayability, reviewability, and revisability and one medium with visibility (e.g., email paired with face-to-face). The remaining media pairs are considered low media fit.<sup>9</sup>




鉴于上述论点，当至少一个媒体具有可审阅性、可修改性和可延迟性的能力并且两者都具有不可见性时，一对媒体的媒体契合度将会更高。因此，我们建议具有最高媒体适合性的媒体对是指至少包含一种具有可延迟性、可审查性和可修改性的媒体以及两种具有不可见性的媒体（例如，即时消息与电话配对）的媒体对，而中等媒体适合性是包含至少一种具有可延迟性、可审查性和可修改性的媒体以及一种具有可见性的媒体（例如，电子邮件与面对面配对）。其余介质对被视为低介质适合度。<sup>9</sup>


Conversation Leveraging. One should not solely focus on the process losses associated with MC without considering that there may also be gains or benefits associated with this behavior. One possible advantage of MC that emerged in our exploratory study was conversation leveraging, or the focal individual’s use of information from one conversation to “invest” in another conversation. We observed several examples of focal individuals gathering information from one conversation and using it immediately in the other conversation. As one interviewee explained,




对话杠杆。人们不应只关注与 MC 相关的过程损失，而不考虑与此行为相关的收益或好处。我们的探索性研究中出现的 MC 的一个可能优势是对话杠杆，或者焦点个人使用一次对话中的信息来“投资”另一次对话。我们观察到几个例子，焦点人物从一次对话中收集信息并立即在另一次对话中使用它。正如一位受访者解释的那样，


When I am on conference calls, sometimes I am aware of people who have input that could be valuable to the conversation at hand. Somebody has a question and I remember talking to somebody about that [issue] and it’s someone who is not participating here. I’ll send off an [instant message] to get an immediate response such that I don’t have to interrupt the [conference] call.




当我参加电话会议时，有时我知道有人提出的意见可能对当前的对话有价值。有人有一个问题，我记得和某人谈论过这个问题，但这个人没有参与这里。我将发送一条[即时消息]以获得立即回复，这样我就不必中断[会议]通话。


Other benefits of MC may exist, but the present research focuses on conversation leveraging as it emerged during our exploratory study and is particularly relevant to production-related MC outcomes.




MC 可能还存在其他好处，但目前的研究重点是对话利用，因为它是在我们的探索性研究中出现的，并且与生产相关的 MC 结果特别相关。


Multicommunicating Initiator. Although not part of the theorizing by Reinsch et al. (2008), MC episodes can either be initiated by the focal individual (i.e., the focal individual is engaged in one conversation and initiates a second conversation at the same time) or by a communication partner (i.e., the focal individual is engaged in one conversation and someone else initiates a second conversation with that focal individual). The existing multitasking literature does not shed much light on this construct: it largely examines multitasking that is initiated by some external force or mechanism (e.g., a ticking metronome as described in Rohrer and Pashler 2003 or a tape recorded message used in Brown et al. 1988) and does not examine the performance of self-initiated multitasking. It has been suggested that multitasking may be more voluntary in some cases than in other cases (Persing 1999), but there are no studies to date that compare voluntary and involuntary multitasking.




多方通信发起者。尽管不是 Reinsch 等人的理论的一部分。 (2008)，MC 事件可以由焦点个人发起（即，焦点个人正在进行一次对话，同时发起第二次对话），也可以由通信伙伴发起（即，焦点个人正在进行一次对话，而其他人与该焦点个人发起第二次对话）。现有的多任务文献并没有对这种结构进行太多阐述：它主要研究由某种外力或机制启动的多任务处理（例如，Rohrer 和 Pashler 2003 中描述的滴答作响的节拍器或 Brown 等人 1988 中使用的磁带记录的消息），并且没有检查自我启动的多任务处理的性能。有人认为，在某些情况下，多任务处理可能比其他情况下更自愿（Persing 1999），但迄今为止还没有研究比较自愿和非自愿的多任务处理。


The importance of the initiator of a conversation has been highlighted in computer mediated communication (CMC) research: when a message is initiated, it is usually at the convenience of the sender but not necessarily the recipient of that message. Recipients may not always be available or the timing of the message may be inconvenient for them (Straub and Karahanna 1998). However, this sender-receiver divide has not been examined when managing multiple conversations at the same time. We propose next that whether the second conversation is focal individual or partner initiated has effects on both conversation leveraging and process losses.




计算机中介通信 (CMC) 研究中强调了对话发起者的重要性：当消息发起时，通常是在发送者方便的时候，但不一定是该消息的接收者。收件人可能并不总是有空，或者消息的发送时间可能对他们来说不方便（Straub 和 Karahanna 1998）。然而，在同时管理多个对话时，这种发送者与接收者之间的分歧尚未得到检验。接下来我们提出，第二次对话是由焦点个人还是合作伙伴发起，都会对对话利用和流程损失产生影响。


Initiator and Conversation Leveraging. The initiator of the second conversation may influence conversation leveraging. Although some focal individuals decide to MC in an attempt to do more, Rennecker and Godwin (2005) found that the first conversation itself may be the reason the focal individual initiates the second conversation. Similarly, in our exploratory study, the focal individual was always the initiator of the second conversation when conversation leveraging occurred. When the second conversation is focal initiated, the focal individual is able to purposefully select the partner for and the timing of the second conversation to maximize the chances that she or he can access the information necessary to achieve the goals of the first conversation. With a partner-initiated second conversation, it would be much less likely that another individual would contact the focal individual at the correct time to fulfill his or her needs in the first conversation. Thus




发起者和对话杠杆。第二对话的发起者可能会影响对话的利用。尽管一些焦点个人决定进行MC以尝试做更多事情，但Rennecker和Godwin（2005）发现第一次对话本身可能是焦点个人发起第二次对话的原因。同样，在我们的探索性研究中，当对话杠杆发生时，焦点个人始终是第二次对话的发起者。当第二次对话由焦点发起时，焦点个人能够有目的地选择第二次对话的合作伙伴和时间，以最大限度地提高她或他访问实现第一次对话目标所需信息的机会。通过合作伙伴发起的第二次对话，另一个人在正确的时间联系焦点个人以满足他或她在第一次对话中的需求的可能性就会小得多。因此


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>(H4).</sup> Conversation leveraging is more likely when the second conversation is focal initiated than when it is partner initiated.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>(H4)。</sup>第二次对话由焦点发起时比由合作伙伴发起时更有可能利用对话。


Initiator and Process Losses. The initiator of the second conversation may also influence the process losses experienced by the focal individual during MC. In exploratory interviews, four out of five interviewees used the term interruption to refer to MC when the second conversation was other initiated (i.e., when the focal individual was part of one conversation and a communication partner initiated a second conversation). Describing other-initiated MC as an interruption implies that the timing of this event is not within the control of the person being contacted. Three interviewees described a process whereby they made a decision concerning whether or not they were going to respond to the interrupting conversation. However, although focal individuals ultimately decide whether or not to respond (e.g., pick up a ringing telephone), they cannot consistently ignore these other-initiated communication requests because timely responses are often a part of their job requirements. Thus, although other-initiated requests to communicate may involve a decision on the part of focal individuals, these requests also imply a general lack of control: the timing and nature of the interrupting conversation is not the focal individual’s choice but is “thrust” upon them.




引发剂和过程损失。第二次对话的发起者也可能影响焦点个人在 MC 期间经历的过程损失。在探索性访谈中，五分之四的受访者在第二次对话由其他人发起时（即，当焦点个人是一次对话的一部分，而沟通伙伴发起第二次对话时）使用术语“中断”来指代 MC。将其他发起的 MC 描述为中断意味着该事件的时间不在被联系的人的控制范围内。三名受访者描述了他们决定是否回应打断谈话的过程。然而，尽管焦点个人最终决定是否响应（例如，拿起正在响铃的电话），但他们不能始终忽视这些其他人发起的通信请求，因为及时响应通常是他们工作要求的一部分。因此，尽管其他人发起的沟通请求可能涉及焦点个人的决定，但这些请求也意味着普遍缺乏控制：打断对话的时间和性质不是焦点个人的选择，而是“强加”在他们身上的。


Perception of control is known to result in decreased stress and increased performance (e.g., Dollard et al. 2000, Kushnir and Melamed 1991, Macan 1994, Wall et al. 1996), and research in multitasking provides support for a relationship between control and outcomes. For instance, research has demonstrated that control over interruptions relates to performance (McFarlane 2002) and that low job control and lack of perceived control result in decreased outcomes (Karasek 1979, Macan et al. 1990, Spector 1986). One interviewee recounted an MC episode where someone interrupted her phone call with a quick face-to-face question. Even though she considered that the episode itself was not particularly complex or demanding, she found it difficult to multicommunicate without asking the communication partners to repeat themselves. In contrast, when a focal individual is part of one conversation and she actively seeks or initiates a second conversation, the timing and nature of the MC is at her discretion. In support of this, no themes related to control emerged in our exploratory study when the second conversation was self-initiated. Thus, we propose the following:




众所周知，控制感会导致压力减轻和绩效提高（例如，Dollard et al. 2000，Kushnir and Melamed 1991，Macan 1994，Wall et al. 1996），多任务处理的研究为控制与结果之间的关系提供了支持。例如，研究表明，对干扰的控制与绩效相关（McFarlane 2002），而工作控制力低和缺乏感知控制会导致结果下降（Karasek 1979、Macan et al. 1990、Spector 1986）。一位受访者讲述了一次主持人的经历，其中有人打断了她的电话，并提出了一个简短的面对面问题。尽管她认为这一事件本身并不是特别复杂或要求很高，但她发现在不要求交流伙伴重复自己的情况下很难进行多次交流。相比之下，当焦点人物参与一次对话并且她积极寻求或发起第二次对话时，MC 的时间和性质由她自行决定。为了支持这一点，当第二次对话是自我发起时，在我们的探索性研究中没有出现与控制相关的主题。因此，我们提出以下建议：


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>(H5).</sup> Process losses are more likely to be experienced during the MC episode when the second conversation is partner initiated than when it is focal initiated.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>(H5)。</sup>当第二次对话由伙伴发起时，在 MC 期间比由焦点发起时更有可能经历流程损失。


Multicommunicating and Productivity. Although process losses and conversation leveraging focus on what is happening during the MC episode, the productivity that results from the episode is also important (McGrath 1991).<sup>10</sup> Productivity can be assessed by effectiveness, efficiency, and how well results meet goals (Burton-Jones and Straub 2006, Campbell 1990, Beal et al. 2003). Therefore, we define productivity as how efficiently and effectively focal individuals complete their communication tasks during their MC episodes. Steiner’s (1972) equation—productivity equals gains minus losses—suggests that, all else remaining equal, process losses experienced during MC should result in lower productivity. For example, it is likely that focal individuals who request the same information multiple times during the episode or who are contributing less utterances to the conversation because of MC are not communicating efficiently; it will likely take them longer to complete their communication tasks. Those who are confused and making errors are probably reducing the effectiveness of their conversations and likewise may need more time to clarify the information or fix the errors made during MC. In our exploratory study, one interviewee suggested that too much confusion and too many errors that need to be fixed during MC result in an ineffective use of time. Although the intent of engaging in multiple conversations at the same time is increased productivity, MC with high process losses will reduce the focal individual’s productivity. Therefore,




多重沟通和生产力。尽管流程损失和对话利用重点关注 MC 期间发生的事情，但该事件产生的生产力也很重要 (McGrath 1991)。<sup>10</sup>生产力可以通过有效性、效率以及结果实现目标的程度来评估 (Burton-Jones and Straub 2006、Campbell 1990、Beal et al. 2003)。因此，我们将生产力定义为焦点个人在 MC 事件期间如何高效且有效地完成其沟通任务。 Steiner (1972) 的方程——生产率等于收益减去损失——表明，在其他条件保持不变的情况下，MC 期间经历的过程损失应该会导致生产率降低。例如，焦点人物在事件中多次请求相同信息，或者由于 MC 而在对话中贡献较少话语的人可能无法有效沟通；他们可能需要更长的时间才能完成沟通任务。那些感到困惑和犯错误的人可能会降低谈话的有效性，同样可能需要更多时间来澄清信息或纠正在 MC 期间犯下的错误。在我们的探索性研究中，一位受访者表示，MC 期间需要修复的混乱和错误太多，导致时间利用效率低下。尽管同时进行多个对话的目的是提高生产力，但流程损失较高的 MC 会降低焦点个人的生产力。所以，


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>(H6).</sup> Process losses experienced during an MC episode will be negatively related to productivity.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>6</sup> <sup>(H6)。</sup> MC 期间经历的过程损失与生产率呈负相关。


Whereas process losses should decrease productivity, process gains such as conversation leveraging should enhance the focal individual’s productivity. In support of this assertion, one of our exploratory study interviewees noted that conversation leveraging results in on-demand access to time-critical information for the focal individual. It can add value to an existing conversation by solving a problem or resolving an issue in real time, allowing the individual or group of individuals to continue working, thereby increasing their productivity. Consequently, we propose the following:




虽然流程损失会降低生产力，但对话利用等流程收益应该会提高焦点个人的生产力。为了支持这一说法，我们的一位探索性研究受访者指出，对话利用可以使焦点个人按需访问时间关键的信息。它可以通过解决问题或实时解决问题来为现有对话增加价值，从而允许个人或一组人继续工作，从而提高他们的生产力。因此，我们提出以下建议：


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>(H7).</sup> Conversation leveraging during MC will result in higher productivity than MC that does not employ conversation leveraging.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>7</sup> <sup>(H7)。</sup> MC 期间的对话利用将比不采用对话利用的 MC 带来更高的生产力。


Multicommunicating Preferences. It is widely acknowledged in the MIS literature that our preferences shape our perceptions regarding behaviors (Davis 1989, Taylor and Todd 1995). One individual characteristic that may be particularly pertinent to MC is the focal individual’s preference for MC. Multitasking research indicates that some people “(1) prefer to be engaged in two or more tasks or events simultaneously; and (2) believe their preference is the best way to do things” (Bluedorn et al. 1999, p. 207). Similarly, some focal individuals may have “values, beliefs, and attitudes that predispose [them] to engage in polychronic communication and to regard polychronic communication as a good thing” (Turner and Reinsch 2004, p. 7). This is termed polychronic communication<sup>11</sup> orientation (PCO).




多重通信偏好。 MIS 文献中广泛承认，我们的偏好塑造了我们对行为的看法（Davis 1989，Taylor 和 Todd 1995）。可能与 MC 特别相关的一项个人特征是焦点个人对 MC 的偏好。多任务研究表明，有些人“(1) 更喜欢同时从事两项或多项任务或事件；(2) 相信他们的偏好是做事的最佳方式”（Bluedorn 等人，1999 年，第 207 页）。同样，一些焦点个人可能有“价值观、信仰和态度，这些价值观、信仰和态度使[他们]倾向于参与多时性沟通，并将多时性沟通视为一件好事”（Turner and Reinsch 2004，p.7）。这称为多时性沟通<sup>11</sup>取向（PCO）。


An individual’s preference for multicommunicating (as indicated by PCO) should affect communication outcomes (Turner and Reinsch 2004). Those with higher polychronic communication orientations respond more flexibly to organizational norms for using media, whereas those with lower polychronic orientations are less able to switch modes of conversation (Turner et al. 2006). Those with positive orientations toward multicommunicating may view it as a way of increasing their productivity. The participants in our exploratory study exhibited varying preferences toward managing multiple tasks or conversations at the same time. Although several participants indicated that they prefer to work on one activity at a time, the observational data show that their job requirements often influence them to engage in other-initiated multicommunicating even though it was their stated preference not to multitask. The data further suggest that participants’ orientations may influence how they perceive the outcomes of this behavior. For example, Participant A, who exhibited a positive orientation toward multicommunicating, stated that he personally saw no problems or issues with the behavior. This observed relationship can be explained by cognitive dissonance theory (Festinger 1957), which suggests that individuals prefer consistency between their beliefs and perceptions and are motivated to change one or the other when they are in conflict. Thus, an individual whose beliefs regarding MC are positive would experience discomfort if those beliefs came up against a conflicting perception—such as a particular MC episode experienced as negative. In order to reduce this conflict, the individual may change his beliefs (which tend to be held long term) or, more likely, his perceptions of that one episode (which tend to be more transient). This may lead to a halo bias where the individual tends to more readily see positive outcomes of MC and to downplay its negatives. Thus, an individual who prefers MC behaviors would also perceive higher productivity and higher conversational leveraging—both of which are positive outcomes of this behavior. The same individual would perceive lower process losses or tend to overlook the losses that do occur because these are negative outcomes of the behavior. Therefore,




个人对多重沟通的偏好（如 PCO 所示）应该会影响沟通结果（Turner 和 Reinsch 2004）。那些具有较高多时性沟通取向的人对使用媒体的组织规范做出更灵活的反应，而那些具有较低多时性沟通取向的人则不太能够切换对话模式（Turner et al. 2006）。那些对多重沟通持积极态度的人可能会将其视为提高生产力的一种方式。我们的探索性研究的参与者对同时管理多个任务或对话表现出不同的偏好。尽管一些参与者表示他们更喜欢一次只从事一项活动，但观察数据表明，他们的工作要求经常影响他们参与其他人发起的多重沟通，尽管他们声称不喜欢同时处理多项任务。数据进一步表明，参与者的取向可能会影响他们如何看待这种行为的结果。例如，参与者 A 对多重沟通表现出积极的态度，他表示他个人认为这种行为没有任何问题或问题。这种观察到的关系可以用认知失调理论（Festinger 1957）来解释，该理论表明，个体更喜欢信念和感知之间的一致性，并且在发生冲突时有动力去改变其中一个或另一个。因此，如果一个人对 MC 的信念是积极的，那么如果这些信念与相互冲突的看法发生冲突，例如某个特定的 MC 事件被认为是消极的，那么他就会感到不适。为了减少这种冲突，个人可能会改变他的信念（往往是长期持有的），或更可能的是，改变他对某一事件的看法（往往是短暂的）。这可能会导致光环偏见，即个人更容易看到 MC 的积极结果，而淡化其负面影响。因此，喜欢 MC 行为的人也会感知到更高的生产力和更高的对话杠杆——这两者都是这种行为的积极结果。同一个人会认为较低的过程损失或倾向于忽视确实发生的损失，因为这些是行为的负面结果。所以，


<sup>Hypothesis</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>(H8).</sup> As compared to focal individuals with lower multicommunicating preferences, focal individuals with higher multicommunicating preferences will perceive (a) lower process losses, (b) higher productivity, and (c) higher conversational leveraging.




<sup>假设</sup> <sup>8</sup> <sup>(H8)。</sup>与具有较低多重通信偏好的焦点个人相比，具有较高多重通信偏好的焦点个人将感知到 (a) 较低的流程损失、(b) 较高的生产力和 (c) 较高的对话杠杆。


## Method




＃＃ 方法


For our main study, we employed a survey methodology 4n = 3705 to test the hypotheses; as described below, we also conducted multiple pilot studies before doing so (overall n = 911).<sup>12</sup> Because our exploratory observations suggested that managing three or more conversations at the same time is still relatively rare in the workplace, the present study was designed to investigate two conversations at a time (and therefore one dimension of intensity—number of overlapping conversations—was held constant in this research). Thus, H1(a) was not tested.




对于我们的主要研究，我们采用了 4n = 3705 的调查方法来检验假设；如下所述，我们在此之前还进行了多项试点研究（总体 n = 911）。<sup>12</sup>由于我们的探索性观察表明，在工作场所同时管理三个或更多对话的情况相对较少，因此本研究旨在一次调查两个对话（因此，强度的一个维度（重叠对话的数量）在本研究中保持不变）。因此，没有测试 H1(a)。


Because MC is an emerging phenomenon and it is not known in which situations it occurs more or less frequently, our survey was administered to a broad sample of organizational employees from many different organizations and industries, through the StudyResponse Project. This project “facilitates online research for behavioral, social, and organizational science researchers” (StudyResponse Project 2011). A random selection of StudyResponse volunteers who were currently employed received an email requesting participation and providing a link to the survey Web page. StudyResponse has been used in previous management and psychology research and typical response rates are around 15% (e.g., Piccolo and Colquitt 2006). In the current study, a response rate of 17% was received. Sixty-three percent of our sample was female, the average age was 37, the average years of work experience was 16, and the average respondent had at least a college diploma. Although our response rate is typical of other StudyResponse studies (StudyResponse Project 2006), it is fairly low. Examining the data for response bias, we found that age, gender, and education level of those who responded were not different from the demographic information obtained from the StudyResponse website for the overall panel (overall panel: 66% female, average age 37, 15 years of work experience, and about 2 years of college education). Further, t-tests for differences in construct means across waves of respondents found no significant differences.




由于 MC 是一种新兴现象，并且不知道它在哪些情况下发生的频率更高或更低，因此我们的调查通过 StudyResponse 项目针对来自许多不同组织和行业的广泛组织员工进行了调查。该项目“促进行为、社会和组织科学研究人员的在线研究”（StudyResponse Project 2011）。随机选择的目前在职的 StudyResponse 志愿者收到了一封请求参与并提供调查网页链接的电子邮件。 StudyResponse 已用于之前的管理和心理学研究，典型的响应率约为 15%（例如，Piccolo 和 Colquitt 2006）。在当前的研究中，反应率为 17%。我们的样本中 63% 是女性，平均年龄为 37 岁，平均工作经验为 16 年，平均受访者至少拥有大学文凭。尽管我们的回复率是其他 StudyResponse 研究（StudyResponse Project 2006）的典型回复率，但它相当低。检查数据是否存在回答偏差，我们发现回答者的年龄、性别和教育水平与从 StudyResponse 网站获得的整个小组的人口统计信息没有什么不同（总体小组：66% 为女性，平均年龄 37，15 年工作经验，约 2 年大学教育）。此外，对几批受访者之间的构造均值差异进行 t 检验，发现没有显着差异。


In the survey, participants were asked to describe a recent incident at work in which they “were in a conversation with one person and were part of a second separate conversation with a different person at the same time.” That is, they described an incident that they directly experienced as the focal individual. Any respondents who did not report on an MC episode in which they were the focal individual, who reported on an episode that did not occur in an organizational setting, who reported on two face-toface conversations, or who could not recall an episode were removed from the sample. Three hundred and seventy usable responses were received (see online Appendix 1 for demographics). Of these, approximately 25% of the episodes involved either instant messaging or email, and the remainder involved at least one telephone conversation (regular, cell phone, or teleconferencing).




在调查中，参与者被要求描述最近在工作中发生的一件事，其中他们“正在与一个人交谈，同时又与另一个人进行第二次单独的交谈”。也就是说，他们描述了他们作为焦点个人直接经历的事件。任何未报告其为焦点个人的 MC 事件、报告未在组织环境中发生的事件、报告两次面对面谈话或记不起事件的受访者都将从样本中删除。我们收到了 370 份可用的回复（有关人口统计信息，请参阅在线附录 1）。其中，大约 25% 的事件涉及即时消息或电子邮件，其余事件涉及至少一次电话交谈（常规、手机或电话会议）。


Measures. In the survey, respondents were asked to describe (i) their MC episode, (ii) specific details concerning the episode, (iii) some outcomes of the episode, (iv) several marker variables (trust and social desirability) to assess common method bias, (v) a control variable (cognitive failures), and (vi) general demographic information (see online Appendix 2 for details). Before conducting the survey, any new or adjusted measures were tested in card sorts (Moore and Benbasat 1991) and surveys. Card sorts were administered to graduate students 4n = 225. Pilot surveys were administered to graduate students and employees at a North American university 4n = 815 and to StudyResponse volunteers 4n = 8085. The measures used in the survey as well as in the pilot studies are described in online Appendices 2 and 3.




措施。在调查中，受访者被要求描述 (i) 他们的 MC 发作，(ii) 有关发作的具体细节，(iii) 发作的一些结果，(iv) 评估共同方法偏差的几个标记变量（信任和社会期望），(v) 控制变量（认知障碍），以及 (vi) 一般人口统计信息（详情请参阅在线附录 2）。在进行调查之前，任何新的或调整后的措施都通过卡片分类（Moore 和 Benbasat 1991）和调查进行测试。对研究生 4n = 225 名进行了卡片分类。对北美大学的研究生和员工 4n = 815 名以及 StudyResponse 志愿者 4n = 8085 名进行了试点调查。在线附录 2 和 3 中描述了调查和试点研究中使用的措施。


Data Analysis and Results. The model was tested using PLS-Graph, a partial least squares-based structural equation modeling (SEM) software package. PLS allows for interplay between theory and data and can be appropriate for research areas that are still in their exploratory stages (Barclay et al. 1995, Chin 1998). A bootstrapping technique with a sample size of 200 (Chin 1998) was used to estimate the significance of the path coefficients. With 370 participants, there should be enough power to detect path relationships as low as 0.2 in this PLS analysis (Marcoulides and Saunders 2006), and the heuristic of 10 cases per most complex multiple regression in the structural model (Barclay et al. 1995, Chin 1998) was more than satisfied.




数据分析和结果。该模型使用 PLS-Graph 进行测试，PLS-Graph 是一种基于偏最小二乘的结构方程建模 (SEM) 软件包。 PLS 允许理论和数据之间的相互作用，并且适用于仍处于探索阶段的研究领域（Barclay et al. 1995，Chin 1998）。使用样本量为 200 的自举技术（Chin 1998）来估计路径系数的显着性。对于 370 名参与者，在这个 PLS 分析中应该有足够的能力来检测低至 0.2 的路径关系（Marcoulides 和 Saunders 2006），并且结构模型中每个最复杂的多重回归 10 个案例的启发式（Barclay 等人 1995 年，Chin 1998）是非常令人满意的。


Most constructs were modeled as reflective. Experienced MC intensity was modeled as a reflective construct whereas objective MC intensity was included as a formative construct. Conversation leveraging was also modeled as formative. Procedures outlined in Petter and colleagues (2007) were used to validate and assess our formative measures. The two items measuring conversation leveraging were highly correlated 4r = 00815 and their weights when running the full model indicated a problem with multicollinearity. As suggested by Petter et al. (2007), one of the items (Lever2) was removed, leaving only Lever1 in the analysis that follows.




大多数构造都被建模为反射。经验的 MC 强度被建模为反思性结构，而客观的 MC 强度被包含为形成性结构。对话杠杆也被建模为形成性的。 Petter 及其同事（2007）中概述的程序用于验证和评估我们的形成性措施。测量对话杠杆的两个项目高度相关 4r = 00815，并且在运行完整模型时它们的权重表明存在多重共线性问题。正如彼得等人所建议的。 (2007)，其中一项 (Lever2) 被删除，在接下来的分析中只留下 Lever1。


The formative measure of intensity was conceptualized as a second-order construct made up of multiple dimensions, each captured with reflective items. Although two sets of indicators (reflective and formative) can be assessed using one construct in covariance-based SEM techniques (called MIMIC analysis—for an example, see Barki et al. 2007), PLS does not allow one construct to have both formative and reflective indicators. Therefore, two measures are used—one with the formative items, with a path leading to the experienced measure with the reflective items (called redundancy analysis—Cenfetelli and Bassellier 2009). The strength of the structural path between the formatively measured and reflectively measured constructs indicates the validity of the construct (Chin 2010).




强度的形成性测量被概念化为由多个维度组成的二阶构造，每个维度都用反射性物品捕获。尽管可以使用基于协方差的 SEM 技术（称为 MIMIC 分析，例如，参见 Barki 等人，2007）中的一种构造来评估两组指标（反射性指标和形成性指标），但 PLS 不允许一种构造同时具有形成性指标和反射性指标。因此，使用了两种测量方法——一种是形成性项目，一条路径通向带有反思性项目的经验测量（称为冗余分析——Cenfetelli and Bassellier 2009）。形成性测量和反思性测量结构之间结构路径的强度表明了该结构的有效性（Chin 2010）。


With MC intensity as a second-order formative construct, we employed the method suggested by Chin et al. (2003) and used by others (e.g., Agarwal and Karahanna 2000, Pavlou and El Sawy 2006, Yi and Davis 2003). That is, using the weights derived from a confirmatory factor analysis, we created factor scores for each of the dimensions of intensity and used these factor scores in the structural model. Thus, we first performed a confirmatory factor analysis (to create the factor scores for intensity dimensions and to examine the psychometric properties of all scales). Then we used the factor scores instead of reflective measures for each dimension of intensity and ran the PLS model. We created one factor score each for pace of switching, segmentation of social roles, differences in topics, topic complexity of the first conversation, and topic complexity of the second conversation. The complexity for each conversation was modeled as separate dimensions because we theorize they should independently contribute to experienced intensity.<sup>13</sup> The variance inflation factor (VIF) for each indicator suggests that multicollinearity is not a problem (VIF < 303).




将 MC 强度作为二阶形成结构，我们采用了 Chin 等人建议的方法。 (2003) 并被其他人使用（例如，Agarwal 和 Karahanna 2000、Pavlou 和 El Sawy 2006、Yi 和 Davis 2003）。也就是说，使用从验证性因素分析中得出的权重，我们为每个强度维度创建了因子得分，并在结构模型中使用了这些因子得分。因此，我们首先进行了验证性因子分析（创建强度维度的因子得分并检查所有量表的心理测量特性）。然后，我们对每个强度维度使用因子得分而不是反射测量，并运行 PLS 模型。我们为切换速度、社会角色细分、主题差异、第一次对话的主题复杂性和第二次对话的主题复杂性分别创建了一个因素评分。每个对话的复杂性被建模为单独的维度，因为我们理论上认为它们应该独立地影响体验强度。<sup>13</sup>每个指标的方差膨胀因子 (VIF) 表明多重共线性不是问题 (VIF < 303)。


Although we measured process losses for both the first and second conversations, we do not analyze process losses separately for each conversation. Given the focus and context of our research, the different process losses encountered for conversation A and conversation B are interchangeable: all are indicators of the extent to which the focal individual is encountering problems during MC and all should be tapping into the overall construct of process losses. When the focal individual’s cognitive processing is overloaded, no research exists that would suggest that process losses should be higher for one conversation than the other. Further, no research suggests that there should be differences in which specific process losses are experienced (pauses versus errors versus confusion)—they may all result from cognitive overload. Therefore, we model process losses as one construct with reflective indicators because an underlying construct is predicting the indicators, the indicators covary, the indicators have the same predictors, and dropping one of them does not change what is being measured (Jarvis et al. 2003, Petter et al. 2007).<sup>14</sup>




尽管我们测量了第一次和第二次对话的流程损失，但我们不会单独分析每个对话的流程损失。鉴于我们研究的重点和背景，对话 A 和对话 B 遇到的不同流程损失是可以互换的：所有这些都是焦点个人在 MC 期间遇到问题程度的指标，并且所有人都应该利用流程损失的整体结构。当焦点个人的认知处理超载时，没有研究表明一次对话的过程损失应该比另一次对话更高。此外，没有研究表明，经历特定过程损失的情况应该存在差异（停顿、错误和混乱）——它们可能都是由认知超载造成的。因此，我们将过程损失建模为具有反射指标的一种构造，因为底层构造正在预测指标，指标协变，指标具有相同的预测变量，并且删除其中一个不会改变正在测量的内容（Jarvis 等人，2003 年；Petter 等人，2007 年）。<sup>14</sup>


Measurement Model. First, the measurement model was examined and construct reliability as well as convergent and discriminant validity were assessed. The item loadings and cross-loadings of the measurement model are available in online Appendix 4. Although “established thresholds do not yet exist for loadings to establish convergent and disciminant validity” (Gefen and Straub 2005, p. 93), Comrey and Lee (1992) suggest that factor loadings in excess of 0.71 are considered excellent, 0.63 are very good, 0.55 are good, and 0.45 are fair (Tabachnick and Fidell 2007, p. 649). Forty-four of the items loaded above 0.71, an additional seven loaded above 0.63, two loaded above 0.55, and four loaded above 0.45. All four items of this latter group were from an existing scale, cognitive failures, and did not cross-load on any other constructs. For all constructs, the square root of the average variance extracted (AVE) was greater than 0.50 (see online Appendix 6), providing further evidence of convergent validity (Fornell and Larcker 1981).




测量模型。首先，检查测量模型并评估构建可靠性以及收敛效度和判别效度。测量模型的项目载荷和交叉载荷可在在线附录 4 中找到。尽管“尚不存在建立收敛和判别有效性的载荷阈值”（Gefen 和 Straub 2005，第 93 页），Comrey 和 Lee（1992）认为因子载荷超过 0.71 被认为是优秀的，0.63 是非常好的，0.55 是好的，0.45 是一般的（Tabachnick 和 Fidell 2007，第 649 页）。其中 44 项加载值高于 0.71，另外 7 项加载值高于 0.63，2 项加载值高于 0.55，4 项加载值高于 0.45。后一组的所有四个项目均来自现有量表、认知失败，并且不会交叉加载任何其他结构。对于所有构造，提取的平均方差 (AVE) 的平方根大于 0.50（参见在线附录 6），提供了收敛有效性的进一步证据（Fornell 和 Larcker 1981）。


Each item loaded higher on its own construct than on any other construct (online Appendix 6), providing evidence of discriminant validity (Barclay et al. 1995). In further support of disciminant validity, each construct’s square root of the AVE (online




每个项目在其自身构造上的负载均高于任何其他构造（在线附录 6），提供了区分有效性的证据（Barclay 等人，1995）。为了进一步支持判别有效性，每个结构的 AVE 平方根（在线


Appendix 6) was larger than the correlation of that construct with any other constructs (Chin 1998).<sup>15</sup> Further, Cronbach’s alpha and composite reliability of each construct are all above 0.80 (online Appendix 5), exceeding the thresholds set by Fornell and Larcker (1981).




附录 6）大于该构造与任何其他构造的相关性（Chin 1998）。<sup>15</sup>此外，每个构造的 Cronbach α 和复合可靠性均高于 0.80（在线附录 5），超出了 Fornell 和 Larcker（1981）设定的阈值。


Common Method Bias. Before the structural model was examined, the potential for the results to be explained by common method bias (CMB) was assessed. Common method biases “pose a rival explanation for the correlation observed between the measures” and can be especially problematic in self-report research methodologies such as surveys (Podsakoff et al. 2003, p. 879). In the present study, multiple methods were used to control and to account for common method bias.<sup>16</sup> The tests performed indicated that CMB is likely not a concern.




常见方法偏差。在检查结构模型之前，评估了用共同方法偏差 (CMB) 解释结果的可能性。共同方法偏差“对测量之间观察到的相关性提出了相反的解释”，并且在调查等自我报告研究方法中尤其容易出现问题（Podsakoff 等人，2003 年，第 879 页）。在本研究中，使用了多种方法来控制和解释共同方法偏差。<sup>16</sup>进行的测试表明，CMB 可能不是一个问题。


Structural Model. Figure 2 depicts the path coefficients and the explanatory power of the PLS results. As described earlier, all constructs were modeled as reflective except for the formative measure of MC intensity and conversation leveraging. The path between the formatively measured objective intensity and the reflectively measured experienced intensity was 0.67, indicating that we are capturing a significant part of the intensity construct, but it is still below the recommended 0.80 threshold (Chin 2010).




结构模型。图 2 描述了 PLS 结果的路径系数和解释力。如前所述，除了 MC 强度和对话杠杆的形成性衡量之外，所有结构都被建模为反思性的。形成性测量的客观强度和反射性测量的经验强度之间的路径为 0.67，表明我们捕获了强度构造的重要部分，但它仍然低于建议的 0.80 阈值（Chin 2010）。


Turning to the hypotheses, the factor weights indicate that the multiple dimensions of MC intensity are significant except segmentation of social roles, providing partial support for H1. Because social roles and topics are correlated 0.41 (see Appendix 6), we explored the possibility of multicollinearity by running the model two additional times: first removing topics and then removing social roles. With social roles removed, topics retained its weight of 0.21. With topics removed, social roles’ weight was still nonsignificant.




回到假设，因子权重表明，除了社会角色细分之外，MC 强度的多个维度都很显着，为 H1 提供了部分支持。由于社会角色和主题的相关性为 0.41（参见附录 6），因此我们通过额外运行模型两次来探索多重共线性的可能性：首先删除主题，然后删除社会角色。删除社会角色后，主题的权重仍为 0.21。除去话题后，社会角色的权重仍然不重要。
