## 3.3 Usage features: Recommendations on social media




## 3.3 使用特点：社交媒体推荐


Recommendations on social media refer to the extent to which readers recommend news on the third-party social media, which promotes the dissemination and discussion of online news. Recently, social media has become more influential, accompanied with an ever-increasing business value [20]. Companies of the information industry hope to establish connections




社交媒体推荐是指读者在第三方社交媒体上推荐新闻的程度，促进了网络新闻的传播和讨论。近年来，社交媒体的影响力越来越大，商业价值也不断增加[20]。信息产业企业希望建立联系


#




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


with social media for the promotion their own development, and online news websites are no exception [32]. In fact, many websites have built a green channel connecting their own online news websites to their own social media platforms，which allows users to easily share online news in social media. In addition, news websites provide the social media links of other network operators. The effective connection between news websites and social media provides a convenient and easy way for readers to transfer between the two platforms. Effective information transmission [32,75] and aggregation effect on people with common interests of social media [47,70] improve the possibility of concerns about the news [32,52,66]. In addition, in the era of News 2.0, readers are not only consumers, but also active spreaders and commentators of news [26,67]. The role shift of readers makes them play a key role in news transmission. Thus, social media recommendations cannot be ignored in the present research.




利用社交媒体促进自身发展，网络新闻网站也不例外[32]。事实上，很多网站都建立了连接自己的网络新闻网站和自己的社交媒体平台的绿色通道，让用户可以轻松地在社交媒体上分享网络新闻。此外，新闻网站还提供其他网络运营商的社交媒体链接。新闻网站和社交媒体之间的有效连接，为读者在两个平台之间转移提供了方便快捷的方式。有效的信息传播[32,75]以及社交媒体对有共同兴趣的人群的聚合效应[47,70]提高了关注新闻的可能性[32,52,66]。此外，在新闻2.0时代，读者不仅是消费者，也是新闻的主动传播者和评论者[26,67]。读者的角色转变使得他们在新闻传播中发挥着关键作用。因此，在当前的研究中，社交媒体推荐不容忽视。


In this framework, reader recommendation has multiple roles. Both text and content attributes of online news can make readers share news or news links on social media profiles. Recommendations on social media increase the number of online news transmission channels, allowing the news to become more accessible to potential readers [45]. Access is the premise and foundation of the information process; more access may lead to more reader comments. readers and commentators compared with traditional online news websites. Recommenders and their friends or followers have certain similarities [51]. In other words, friends of recommenders are more interested in browsing and commenting on recommended online news compared with average readers. Furthermore, a few words attached to news recommendation provide clues about the news, which can inspire other readers to generate new thoughts or comments. Consequently, active recommendation from readers on social media will increase the number of comments of the news to a great degree.




在这个框架中，读者推荐具有多重作用。在线新闻的文本和内容属性都可以使读者在社交媒体资料上分享新闻或新闻链接。社交媒体上的推荐增加了在线新闻传播渠道的数量，使潜在读者更容易获取新闻[45]。获取是信息处理的前提和基础；更多的访问可能会带来更多的读者评论。与传统在线新闻网站相比，读者和评论员。推荐者和他们的朋友或关注者有一定的相似之处[51]。换句话说，与普通读者相比，推荐者的朋友更有兴趣浏览和评论推荐的网络新闻。此外，新闻推荐中附带的几句话提供了有关新闻的线索，可以激发其他读者产生新的想法或评论。因此，社交媒体上读者的积极推荐将在很大程度上增加新闻的评论量。


## 3.4 Online news features




## 3.4 在线新闻功能


## 3.4.1 Structural features




## 3.4.1 结构特点


Structural features, such as news release time, pictures, the number of words, videos, summaries, headlines with locational information, and locations of news events, describe the objective features of online news text. Overall, we assume that the group of structural variables influences readers to share news or news links on social media profiles and post comments on online news websites. Structure of the text is a carrier that conveys news and information to readers, inevitably influencing reader’s recommendations and comments. As discussed in 2.2, structural variables were tested in many empirical studies on online news popularity. For example, Zhang et al. [74] examined the length of tweets and tweeting time that contribute to the popularity of tweets, number of re-tweeting and number of comments. Relatively, researchers can easily observe such variables and assign values to them.




结构特征，如新闻发布时间、图片、字数、视频、摘要、带有位置信息的标题、新闻事件发生地点等，描述了网络新闻文本的客观特征。总体而言，我们假设这组结构变量会影响读者在社交媒体资料上分享新闻或新闻链接以及在在线新闻网站上发表评论。文本结构是向读者传递新闻和信息的载体，不可避免地影响读者的推荐和评论。正如 2.2 中所讨论的，结构变量在许多关于在线新闻流行度的实证研究中得到了检验。例如，张等人。 [74]研究了推文长度和推文时间对推文受欢迎程度、转发数量和评论数量的影响。相对而言，研究人员可以很容易地观察这些变量并为其赋值。


## 3.4.2 Content features




## 3.4.2 内容特征


Content features concentrate on the attributes of online news content. Content, as the object of user comments accounts for the comment number of online news. In this group, the features of subjective opinion [1,6], positiveness/negativeness [6,8], which were proposed in previous research, are refined. Furthermore, we propose utilizing the other six variables, namely controversial news, serial news, news referring to the future, life-related news, private matters, and peculiarities, to obtain a comprehensive view of news content attributes (Table 3). Former empirical studies, which relied on superficial classifications [1,67], rarely focused on generalizing the content attributes of online news. In contrast with the thematic categories of news，this present study extracts deep attributes of online news content to understand user comments.




内容特征集中于网络新闻内容的属性。内容作为用户评论的对象，占网络新闻的评论数。在该组中，对先前研究中提出的主观意见[1,6]、积极/消极[6,8]的特征进行了细化。此外，我们建议利用其他六个变量，即争议新闻、连环新闻、涉及未来的新闻、与生活相关的新闻、私人事务和特殊性，来获得新闻内容属性的综合视图（表3）。以往的实证研究依赖于肤浅的分类[1,67]，很少关注概括网络新闻的内容属性。与新闻的主题类别相反，本研究提取网络新闻内容的深层属性来理解用户评论。


On the whole, we assume that the group of content variables influences the social media recommendation and the number of news comments. In systematic mode of information processing, individuals’ decisions toward messages are affected by contents implied in the message [60]. The content of news articles catches attentions from readers and makes them read and think about the news, which further induces readers’ comments or recommendation of the news on social media. Bandari et al. [8] examined that an article written in a more emotional, more personal, and more subjective voice can resonate stronger with the readers, which could further improve the popularity of tweets.




总的来说，我们假设这组内容变量影响社交媒体推荐和新闻评论数量。在信息处理的系统模式中，个体对消息的决策受到消息隐含内容的影响[60]。新闻文章的内容引起读者的注意，引起读者阅读和思考新闻，进而引发读者在社交媒体上对新闻的评论或推荐。班达里等人。 [8]研究发现，一篇以更情绪化、更个人化、更主观的声音写的文章可以引起读者更强烈的共鸣，这可以进一步提高推文的受欢迎程度。


## 4. Research Methodology




## 4. 研究方法


## 4.1 Backgrounds of the online news




## 4.1 网络新闻的背景


Our study explains the number of online news comments on NetEase News (http://news.163.com/), which is one of the largest online news sites in China. NetEase News aims to create a ―news portal with attitude‖ and encourages users to comment on the news. NetEase can bring users the timeliest updated news and the most fluent news display. On July 9, 2013, users of NetEase News exceeded 120 million and active users reached 40 million in a day [53].




我们的研究解释了网易新闻（http://news.163.com/）的在线新闻评论数量，网易新闻是中国最大的在线新闻网站之一。网易新闻致力于打造“有态度的新闻门户”，鼓励用户对新闻进行评论。网易可以为用户带来最及时的更新新闻和最流畅的新闻展示。 2013年7月9日，网易新闻用户突破1.2亿，日活跃用户达到4000万[53]。


In the News 2.0 era, besides browsing news and commenting on news, users can also recommend news. The news that a number of users recommend are shown on the home page of JianXinWen, which is a website that NetEase established by to collect recommended news. In addition, NetEase News cooperates with third party party media sites, which permit users to create a newsfeed on social media. Four third-party media sites are used, including: NetEase Microblog and JianXinWen, which are owned by NetEase; and Sina Microblog and Q-zone , which are the social media of other organizations.




在新闻2.0时代，用户除了浏览新闻、评论新闻外，还可以推荐新闻。简新闻是网易为了收集推荐新闻而建立的网站，首页上会显示一些用户推荐的新闻。此外，网易新闻还与第三方媒体网站合作，允许用户在社交媒体上创建新闻源。使用四个第三方媒体网站，包括：网易旗下的网易微博和简新闻；以及其他组织的社交媒体新浪微博和Q区。


## 4.2 Data collection




## 4.2 数据收集


Data collection involved two rounds. The purpose of round one was to gather online news articles. We used four different online news data sets to obtain generalizable insights on the popularity of online news: (1) social news, (2) entertainment news, (3) SciTech news, (4) and financial news, which have received widespread concern from the public. Two of the authors and two graduate students who were familiar with the data collection approach from personal experience, collected 2008 pieces of online news articles. Each was responsible for one news data set. From June 9 to June 15, 2014, news articles were collected from the ranking list of NetEase news every day. The variables of structure features, news release time, pictures, the number of words, videos, summaries, headlines with locational information, and locations of news events, which are the objective data of an online news article, was also recorded.




数据收集涉及两轮。第一轮的目的是收集在线新闻文章。我们使用四个不同的在线新闻数据集来获得有关在线新闻受欢迎程度的普遍见解：（1）社会新闻，（2）娱乐新闻，（3）科技新闻，（4）和财经新闻，这些新闻受到了公众的广泛关注。其中两位作者和两位研究生因个人经验而熟悉数据收集方法，收集了 2008 篇网络新闻文章。每个人负责一组新闻数据。 2014年6月9日至6月15日，每日新闻文章均来自网易新闻排行榜。还记录了结构特征、新闻发布时间、图片、字数、视频、摘要、带有位置信息的标题以及新闻事件发生地点等变量，这些都是网络新闻文章的客观数据。


In round two, the number of comments and the recommendations on social media were collected. Tatar et al. [63] observed that the majority of news articles receive all comments within the first day after publication. For insurance purposes, we collected the number of comments from June 23 to June 30, 2014, which was approximately one week (seven days) after data collection of round one. Concurrently, we began data collection by keywords including ―the title of online news‖ and ―NetEase‖ on Sina microblog, NetEase microblog, and Q-space. Two authors and two graduate students read through all the microblogs to collect the number of forwards and remove irrelevant microblogs. Then, the number of recommendations from JianXinWen was collected.




第二轮收集社交媒体上的评论和推荐数量。鞑靼等人。 [63]观察到大多数新闻文章在发表后的第一天就收到了所有评论。出于保险目的，我们收集了2014年6月23日至6月30日期间的评论数量，即第一轮数据收集后大约一周（7天）。同时，我们开始对新浪微博、网易微博、Q空间等平台上的“网络新闻标题”、“网易”等关键词进行数据采集。两名作者和两名研究生通读所有微博，收集转发数并删除不相关的微博。然后收集简新闻的推荐数量。


## 4.3 Variables and operationalization




## 4.3 变量和操作化


Three groups of features were considered: structural features, content features, and usage features, for the dependent variable, which is, the number of comments. Table 3 summarizes all features.




对于因变量（即评论数量），考虑了三组特征：结构特征、内容特征和使用特征。表 3 总结了所有功能。


Dependent variable. ―The number of comments‖ refers to how many users have commented on a news item. This is a continuous variable as well, which is operationalized by ―the number of the follow-up comments‖ shown on the page of NetEase News.




因变量。 “评论数”是指有多少用户对一条新闻进行了评论。这也是一个连续变量，通过网易新闻页面显示的“后续评论数”来操作。


Usage features. ―Social media recommendation‖ refers to the extent to which a reader recommends news on third-party social media. This continuous variable is operationalized through four social media: NetEase Microblog, Sina Microblog, Q-zone, and Recommended News. The present study adds the number of times the news item is forwarded in the four media platforms to present the total promotional effect of a news item.




使用特点。 “社交媒体推荐”是指读者在第三方社交媒体上推荐新闻的程度。这个连续变量通过网易微博、新浪微博、Q区、推荐新闻这四个社交媒体来运作。本研究将新闻在四大媒体平台的转发次数相加，以呈现新闻的总体推广效果。


Structural features. ―News release time‖, a nominal variable, refers the time when a news item is released. According to ―the release time‖ on the NetEase News page, the present study divides online news into four categories: from 7 am to 12 pm o’clock is marked as 1, 12 pm to 5 pm as 2, 5 pm to 10 pm as 3, and 10 pm to 7 am as 4. ―Picture‖ refers to the number of pictures involved in a news item. ―The number of words‖ refers to the number of Chinese characters involved in a news text. The present study adopts a text statistical software to count the number of words. ―Video‖ refers to the number of videos involved in a news item. ―Picture‖, ―the number of words‖, and ―video‖ are continuous variables. ―Summary‖ refers to information that presents or summarizes the main idea of a news item at the beginning of the news text. ―Headline with locational information‖ refers to the explicit location information in the headline of a news item. ―Location of news event‖ refers to where a news event happened. The present study divides the location into three categories: regional, inland, and overseas, which includes Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan. ―Summary‖, ―headline with locational information‖ and ―location of news event‖ are classified variables.




结构特点。 “新闻发布时间”是一个名义变量，指新闻发布的时间。根据网易新闻页面的“发布时间”，本研究将网络新闻分为四类：上午7点至中午12点标记为1，中午12点至下午5点标记为2，下午5点至晚上10点标记为3，晚上10点至上午7点标记为4。“图片”是指新闻中涉及图片的数量。 “字数”是指新闻正文中所涉及的汉字数量。本研究采用文本统计软件来统计字数。 “视频”是指一条新闻中涉及的视频数量。 “图片”、“字数”、“视频”是连续变量。 “摘要”是指在新闻正文开头呈现或概括新闻主要内容的信息。 “带有位置信息的标题”是指新闻标题中包含明确的位置信息。 “新闻事件发生地”是指新闻事件发生的地点。本研究将地点分为三类：地区、内地和海外，其中包括香港、澳门和台湾。 “摘要”、“带有位置信息的标题”和“新闻事件的位置”是分类变量。


Content features. Variables related to the content are coded in the news text, which will be explained in detail (4.4).




内容特点。与内容相关的变量被编码在新闻文本中，这将在（4.4）中详细解释。

## 4.4 Extraction of Content Features by Content analysis




## 4.4 通过内容分析提取内容特征


## 4.4.1 Coding scheme for content features




## 4.4.1 内容特征的编码方案


Content analysis was used to extract the quantification of the content features [2] variables because these variables were embedded in each online news article. Content analysis is a popular technique that transforms the meaning of text into objective data by systematic procedures to ensure the objectivity, reproducibility, and reliability of the data analysis [3,4,22,57]. Each online news article was coded to measure the content features variables (Table 3). In addition, content feature variables were dichotomously coded through checking the presence of variable traits in a news article (Table 4).




内容分析用于提取内容特征 [2] 变量的量化，因为这些变量嵌入在每篇在线新闻文章中。内容分析是一种流行的技术，通过系统的程序将文本的含义转化为客观数据，以确保数据分析的客观性、再现性和可靠性[3,4,22,57]。每篇在线新闻文章都经过编码以测量内容特征变量（表 3）。此外，通过检查新闻文章中变量特征的存在，对内容特征变量进行二分编码（表4）。


―Subjective opinion‖ refers to the presence of subjective opinion in a news text, as in the following three circumstances: (1) news about the views of experts or scholars, i.e., Example 1 in Table 4a; (2) the news text describes the event while having opinions from people on all sides, i.e., Example 2 in Table 4a; (3) hearsay or unverified news, i.e., Example 3 in Table 4a. The news that did not contain subjective opinions under the following three conditions was coded: (1) a news text that merely describes the event objectively, i.e., Example 4 in Table 4a; (2) the objective information related to the news event that was received from somebody in the news text, i.e., Example 5 in Table 4a; (3) policies, views, and speeches from state leaders or the government (news related to Chinese state leaders or the government are often objective reports of given facts), i.e., Example 6 in Table 4a.




“主观意见”是指新闻文本中存在主观意见，如以下三种情况：（1）有关专家、学者观点的新闻，即表4a中的例1； (2)新闻文本描述事件，同时听取各方意见，即表4a中的例2； (3)道听途说或未经证实的消息，即表4a中的例3。在以下三种情况下对不含主观意见的新闻进行编码：（1）仅客观描述事件的新闻文本，即表4a中的例4； (2)新闻文本中从某人处收到的与新闻事件相关的客观信息，即表4a中的示例5； （3）国家领导人或政府的政策、观点和讲话（与中国国家领导人或政府有关的新闻往往是对既定事实的客观报道），即表4a中的例6。

Tutors of the Voice of China Section 3 were determined: Na Ying, Wang Feng, Luo Dayou and Yang Kun. (report of an objective incident)</td></tr><tr><td>2. Bankers: alipay is a pity for banks. The present study sets the variable ―positiveness/negativeness‖ based on the definition from van Atteveldt et al. (2008), who provided three dimensions of positiveness/negativeness: (1) Relation: Given two concepts located in the online news article, the relation may be positive (cooperative, supportive), i.e., Example 1 in Table 4b, or negative (conflictive, critical), i.e., Example 4 in Table 4b; (2) Performance: Given a concept located in the online news article, the concept may be successful (increasing, winning) , i.e., Example 2 in Table 4b, or failing (decreasing, losing), i.e., Example 5 in Table 4b; (3) Evaluation: Given a concept located in the online news article, the evaluation may be positive (good, sincere, or beautiful) , i.e., Example 3 in Table 4b, or negative (evil, wicked, or ugly), i.e., Example 6 in Table 4b. Two components, i.e., positive and negative are in a news text. Previous research coded these news (positive and negative news) as neutral [5,26]. This approach is not precise. We regard the news events as a process of development when coding these complicated news items. We code the news as positiveness when a news event develops from the bad aspect to the good aspect. By contrast, we code the news as negativeness when the opposite occurs.




本研究根据 van Atteveldt 等人的定义设置变量“积极/消极”。 (2008)，他提供了积极性/消极性的三个维度： (1)关系：给定在线新闻文章中的两个概念，关系可能是积极的（合作的、支持的），即表 4b 中的示例 1，也可能是消极的（冲突的、批评的），即表 4b 中的示例 4； (2)表现：给定在线新闻文章中的一个概念，该概念可能会成功（增加、获胜），即表4b中的示例2，也可能会失败（减少、失败），即表4b中的示例5； (3)评价：给定在线新闻文章中的概念，评价可能是正面的(好的、真诚的或美丽的)，即表4b中的示例3，也可能是负面的(邪恶的、邪恶的或丑陋的)，即表4b中的示例6。新闻文本中有两个组成部分，即正面和负面。先前的研究将这些新闻（正面和负面新闻）编码为中性[5,26]。这种方法并不精确。在对这些复杂的新闻项目进行编码时，我们将新闻事件视为一个发展过程。当新闻事件从坏的方面发展到好的方面时，我们将新闻编码为积极的。相比之下，当相反的情况发生时，我们将新闻编码为负面新闻。


Controversial news indicates at least two different opinions, comments or advice in a news text. Specific examples are shown in Table 4c.




有争议的新闻表明新闻文本中至少有两种不同的观点、评论或建议。具体例子如表4c所示。


Serial news is a follow-up report about the previous related news event. A news text can be coded as ―serial news‖ in the following two circumstances: (1) symbolic words are found in the headline, such as ―follow-up,‖ ―deny,‖ ―respond,‖ ―another news,‖ or ―another report,‖ e.g., example 1 in Table 4d; and (2) an obvious review about the previous situation of the event in the news text exists, e.g., example 2 in Table 4d.




连环新闻是对前一相关新闻事件的后续报道。新闻文本在以下两种情况下可编码为“连环新闻”：（1）标题中出现象征性词语，如“跟进”、“否认”、“回应”、“另一新闻”或“另一报道”，例如表4d中的示例1； (2)新闻文本中存在对事件先前情况的明显回顾，例如表4d中的示例2。


News referring to the future pertains to a news item that includes the prediction of the performance or development tendency of the event aside from the report of the news event itself. Specific examples are shown in Table 4e.




未来新闻是指除新闻事件本身的报道外，还包括对事件的表现或发展趋势的预测的新闻。具体例子如表4e所示。

Life-related news. This variable refers to news that are related to daily life, including the following aspects: (1) food, such as food safety, e.g., example 1 in Table 4f; (2) consumer price, such as price index, e.g., example 2 in Table 4f; (3) housing, such as the increase in housing prices; (4) investment, such as stock information; (5) children, such as campus news, e.g., example 3 in Table 4f; (6) safety, such as violent and terrorist events or air pollution, e.g. example 4 in Table 4f; (7) education, such as problems of entering a higher school; and (8) medical problems, such as medical disputes and medical negligence.




与生活相关的新闻。该变量指与日常生活相关的新闻，包括以下几个方面：（1）食品，如食品安全，如表4f中的例1； (2)消费者价格，如价格指数，如表4f中的例2； （三）住房，如房价上涨； (4) 股票信息等投资； (5)儿童，如校园新闻，如表4f中的例3； （6）安全，例如暴力恐怖事件或空气污染等。表4f中的实施例4； （七）教育问题，如升学问题； （八）医疗纠纷、医疗过失等医疗问题。


Private matters refer to news events involve private instances, which the people who are involved would prefer not to disclose to others, such as sexual relations, family affairs, or private lives of famous persons. Specific examples are shown in Table 4g.




私人事务是指涉及私人事件，当事人不愿向他人透露的新闻事件，如性关系、家庭事务、名人的私生活等。具体例子如表4g所示。

## 4.4.2 Content analysis procedure




## 4.4.2 内容分析程序


We followed the steps of content coding and analysis that were suggested by Krippendorff [42] and Landis and Koch [44]. In our research, the unit of analysis was an online news article. For the content coding, four graduate students were hired to code the online news data separately. We ensured that each news set was coded by two persons separately. The authors were not involved in content coding. The graduate student coders were not allowed to communicate with one another while coding and were asked not to spend more than two hours each day in data coding to minimize fatigue-related coding errors.




我们遵循 Krippendorff [42] 以及 Landis 和 Koch [44] 建议的内容编码和分析步骤。在我们的研究中，分析单位是一篇在线新闻文章。对于内容编码，聘请了四名研究生分别对在线新闻数据进行编码。我们确保每个新闻集都由两个人分别编码。作者没有参与内容编码。研究生编码员在编码时不允许相互交流，并被要求每天花在数据编码上的时间不要超过两个小时，以尽量减少与疲劳相关的编码错误。


Pilot data coding was performed for the online news data sets. Our goal for pilot coding was to repeat the coding and refine the coding book. If the pilot coding result did not reach the Kappa threshold value of $0 . 7 0 ,$ then the two authors and all student coders discussed the disputed coding results. The coding disagreements were adjudicated by discussion, and consensus was reached after a joint examination of the feature. Inter-coder reliability, which was computed using the agreement percentage for all variables, ranged from 0.70 to 0.97, which showed high reliability levels for all variables [42,44].




对在线新闻数据集进行了试点数据编码。我们试点编码的目标是重复编码并完善编码书。如果导频编码结果没有达到Kappa阈值$0。 7 0 ,$ 然后两位作者和所有学生编码员讨论了有争议的编码结果。通过讨论来裁决编码分歧，并在对功能进行联合检查后达成共识。使用所有变量的一致性百分比计算得出的编码器间可靠性范围为 0.70 到 0.97，这表明所有变量的可靠性水平都很高 [42,44]。


## 4.5 Analysis method




## 4.5 分析方法


Given the dichotomous nature of certain independent variables (such as the summary, title with location information, and positiveness/negativeness), we employed the logistic regression method. Logistic regression was appropriate for the outcome and predictor variables to come out dichotomous, continuous, or categorical [24]. Tsagkias et al. [67] showed that the linear log method was also reliable for predicting the popularity of news articles.




考虑到某些自变量的二分性质（例如摘要、带有位置信息的标题以及正/负），我们采用了逻辑回归方法。逻辑回归适用于结果和预测变量的二分、连续或分类[24]。察基亚斯等人。 [67]表明线性对数方法对于预测新闻文章的受欢迎程度也是可靠的。


The Spearman rank correlation test results (Appendix C) indicated that, all the correlations were less than 0.3, except for one item. The correlation between social media recommendations and the number of comments was 0.607, which mean that this relationship warrants further research. Moreover, the multicollinearity problems test (Appendix D) indicated that all tolerances were close to 1 and the VIFs were less than 1.4 for both the number of browses and comments [54]. All these results indicated that no significant multicollinearity problems were found.




Spearman等级相关检验结果（附录C）表明，除一项外，所有相关性均小于0.3。社交媒体推荐与评论数量之间的相关性为0.607，这意味着这种关系值得进一步研究。此外，多重共线性问题测试（附录D）表明，浏览次数和评论次数的所有公差都接近1，VIF 均小于1.4 [54]。所有这些结果表明没有发现显着的多重共线性问题。


We conducted t-tests to determine whether the overall data (social, entertainment, SciTech, and financial news) could be pooled and treated as a single sample [39]. The results revealed no significant differences among the four news categories for all the independent and dependent variables. However, the samples can be combined.




我们进行了 t 检验，以确定整体数据（社交、娱乐、科技和财经新闻）是否可以合并并视为单个样本 [39]。结果显示，四种新闻类别之间的所有自变量和因变量没有显着差异。然而，可以组合样本。


## 5. Evaluation Results




## 5. 评估结果


## 5.1 Three group features to explain the number of readers’ comments




## 5.1 三组特征解释读者评论数量


Using logistic regression analysis, we explained the number of comments in online news sites using 16 independent variables. To determine the extent, structural features, content features, and usage features to help explain the variance in the number of comments, we conducted three hierarchical regressions. In step 1, we entered the structural features, which we named ―model 1‖. In step 2, we entered the content features, which we named ―model 2‖. In step 3, we entered the usage feature, which we named ―model 3‖. Such hierarchical regressions allowed us to determine the unique variance that was measured as the increment in the R-square change and in the F-value, which showed how each set of IVs contributed to the dependent variables [15,38] in our study, i.e., the number of comments.




通过逻辑回归分析，我们使用 16 个自变量解释了在线新闻网站的评论数量。为了确定程度、结构特征、内容特征和使用特征以帮助解释评论数量的差异，我们进行了三个层次回归。在第一步中，我们输入了结构特征，我们将其命名为“模型1”。在步骤2中，我们输入了内容特征，我们将其命名为“模型2”。在步骤3中，我们输入了使用特征，我们将其命名为“模型3”。这种分层回归使我们能够确定唯一的方差，该方差以 R 方变化和 F 值的增量来衡量，这显示了每组 IV 对我们研究中的因变量 [15,38]（即评论数量）的贡献。


Table 5 shows that the R-square changes of the three regression steps are all significant at the p< 0.01 level, including the regressions of the structural features (model 1), content features (model 2), and usage features (model 3). Although each of the specific structural, content, and usage features did not have the same influence on the number of comments, the overall significance of the R-square changed for models 1, 2, and 3, which verified that the three sets of IVs contributed to the number of comments in principle. 对于使用特征，我们发现社交媒体推荐对评论数量有积极影响 $( \beta = 0 . 4 6 5 , \rho < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 。


We further explained social media recommendation on online news sites for the structural and content features. Table 4 shows our observations on the effect of structural and content features on social media recommendation. For the structural features: (1) pictures were found to positively affect the social media recommendation $( \beta = 0 . 1 8 8 , \rho < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ . (2) The number of words was found to positively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = 0 . 1 4 6 , \ p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ ). (3) Video was found to positively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = 0 . 0 5 9 , \rho < 0 . 0 1 )$ ). (4) A headline with location information was found to positively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = 0 . 3 2 1 , \mathrm { ~ p ~ < ~ } 0 . 0 0 1 )$ . (5) The location of a news event was found to negatively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = - 0 . 1 2 8 , \mathrm { ~ p ~ < ~ } 0 . 0 0 1 )$ . For the content features: (1) the positiveness/negativeness of the content was found to negatively affect socia media recommendation $( \beta \ = \ - 0 . 1 5 7 , \ \mathrm { p } \ < \ 0 . 0 0 1 )$ . (2) A life-related news was found to positively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = 0 . 1 3 5 , \rho < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ ). (3) Private matters were found to negatively affect social media recommendation $( \beta = - 0 . 0 4 9 , \rho < 0 . 0 5 )$ \_




我们进一步解释了在线新闻网站社交媒体推荐的结构和内容特征。表 4 显示了我们对结构和内容特征对社交媒体推荐影响的观察。对于结构特征：（1）发现图片对社交媒体推荐产生积极影响$( \beta = 0 . 1 8 8 , \rho < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 。 (2) 发现单词数量对社交媒体推荐产生积极影响 $( \beta = 0 . 1 4 6 , \ p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ )。 (3) 视频被发现对社交媒体推荐产生积极影响 $( \beta = 0 . 0 5 9 , \rho < 0 . 0 1 )$ )。 (4) 含有位置信息的标题被发现对社交媒体推荐有积极影响 $( \beta = 0 . 3 2 1 , \mathrm { ~ p ~ < ~ } 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 。 (5) 发现新闻事件的位置会对社交媒体推荐产生负面​​影响 $( \beta = - 0 . 1 2 8 , \mathrm { ~ p ~ < ~ } 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 。对于内容特征：（1）发现内容的积极/消极会对社交媒体推荐产生负面​​影响 $( \beta \ = \ - 0 . 1 5 7 , \ \mathrm { p } \ < \ 0 . 0 0 1 )$ 。 (2) 与生活相关的新闻被发现对社交媒体推荐有积极影响$( \beta = 0 . 1 3 5 , \rho < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ )。 (3) 私人事务被发现对社交媒体推荐产生负面​​影响 $( \beta = - 0 . 0 4 9 , \rho < 0 . 0 5 )$ \_


## 5.2 Mediating effect of social media recommendation on number of comments




## 5.2 社交媒体推荐对评论数的中介作用


Social media recommendation affects the number of comments, and is influenced by both structural and content features (Table 5). We further investigated the mediating role of social media recommendations, which mediates the relationship between structural and content features, and the number of online news comments, and we determined whether recommendation had a partial or full mediation. To test this mediating effect, we used three regression analysis and followed Sobel’s procedure [10,34], which allowed us to examine whether the relationship between features and the number of comments was considerably reduced (partial mediation) or completely diminished (full mediation) when we incorporated social media recommendation into the model.




社交媒体推荐会影响评论数量，并受到结构和内容特征的影响（表 5）。我们进一步研究了社交媒体推荐的中介作用，它调节结构特征和内容特征与在线新闻评论数量之间的关系，并确定推荐是否具有部分或完全中介作用。为了测试这种中介效应，我们使用了三个回归分析并遵循 Sobel 的程序 [10,34]，这使我们能够检查当我们将社交媒体推荐纳入模型时，特征与评论数量之间的关系是否显着减少（部分中介）或完全减弱（完全中介）。

图 2. 解释评论数量的中介模型


Based on these results, we constructed a mediation model, that indicated the significance of social media recommendation in explaining the number of comments. The mediating effect of social media indicated that both structural (pictures, video, headline with locational information, and locations of news events) and content (subjective opinion, positiveness/negativeness, controversial news, and life-related news) features affected the number of comments both directly and indirectly, whereas the summary affected the number of comments indirectly only.




基于这些结果，我们构建了一个中介模型，表明社交媒体推荐在解释评论数量方面的重要性。社交媒体的中介效应表明，结构（图片、视频、带有位置信息的标题和新闻事件的地点）和内容（主观意见、正面/负面、争议性新闻和生活相关新闻）特征都直接和间接影响评论数量，而摘要仅间接影响评论数量。


## 6. Discussion




## 6.讨论


## 6.1 Key findings




## 6.1 主要发现


The objective of this research is to explain the reason behind the difference in the number of online news comments. We developed a framework that integrated three types of features (structural, content, and usage features), to explain the number of comments. This study is the first to thoroughly examine the role of the structural, content, and usage features in the online news context. The regression model reveals 47.1% of the variance in the number of comments. In general, this result shows that the framework is powerful in explaining the number of comments. Based on the data analysis results, we obtained three main findings. First, in addition to the attributes of online news, our study also conceptualized, operationalized, and validated the nature of the social media recommendations. We explored the relative role of social media recommendation as the usage feature, rather than the structural and content features, to explain the number of comments. Second, we found a mediation model of social media recommendation for the explanation of the number of comments. This mediation model indicates that social media recommendation may be an important path and mechanism for structural and content features that affect the reader’s comments. Finally, we have developed six content features, namely, controversial news, serial news, news referring to the future, life-related news, private matters, and peculiarities, from the online news article content. Content features are important attributes of online news, which could be extracted through content analysis method. The logistic regression results show that content features have significant effects on the number of online news comments.




本研究的目的是解释在线新闻评论数量差异背后的原因。我们开发了一个框架，集成了三种类型的特征（结构、内容和使用特征），来解释评论的数量。这项研究首次全面研究了结构、内容和使用特征在在线新闻环境中的作用。回归模型揭示了评论数量的 47.1% 的方差。总的来说，这个结果表明该框架在解释评论数量方面是强大的。根据数据分析结果，我们获得了三个主要发现。首先，除了在线新闻的属性之外，我们的研究还对社交媒体推荐的性质进行了概念化、操作化和验证。我们探讨了社交媒体推荐作为使用特征而不是结构和内容特征的相对作用，以解释评论数量。其次，我们找到了一个社交媒体推荐的中介模型来解释评论数量。这种中介模型表明，社交媒体推荐可能是影响读者评论的结构和内容特征的重要路径和机制。最后，我们从网络新闻文章内容中开发出六种内容特征，即争议新闻、连环新闻、涉及未来的新闻、生活相关新闻、私人事务和奇特新闻。内容特征是网络新闻的重要属性，可以通过内容分析方法提取。逻辑回归结果表明，内容特征对网络新闻评论数量有显着影响。


## 6.1.1 Usage features




## 6.1.1 使用特点


#




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


Social media recommendation is positively significant and is the most effective feature for explaining the number of comments. Readers’ recommendation promotes online news on social media to attract online readers, who have more or less similar interests with the recommender. The efficient promotional effect of social media generates more attention and comments for the online news. Our analyses show that the explaining power of the model is improved as usage features (social media recommendation) are added into the framework. The results also further confirm the superiority of social media recommendation over structural and content features in explaining the number of comments.




社交媒体推荐具有积极意义，是解释评论数量的最有效特征。读者推荐在社交媒体上推广在线新闻，以吸引与推荐者有或多或少相似兴趣的在线读者。社交媒体高效的宣传效果为网络新闻带来更多的关注和评论。我们的分析表明，随着使用特征（社交媒体推荐）被添加到框架中，模型的解释能力得到了提高。结果还进一步证实了社交媒体推荐在解释评论数量方面相对于结构和内容特征的优越性。


Furthermore, our findings reveal the key role of social media recommendation in explaining the number of comments, by mediating the influences of recommendation on structural features (pictures, video, summary, headline with location information, and location of news event) and content features (subjective opinion, positiveness/negativeness, controversial news, and life-related news). From these results, we constructed a mediation model to explain the number of comments，which meant that social media recommendation may be the valuable mechanism for structural and content features that affect readers comments.




此外，我们的研究结果揭示了社交媒体推荐在解释评论数量方面的关键作用，通过调节推荐对结构特征（图片、视频、摘要、带有位置信息的标题和新闻事件的位置）和内容特征（主观意见、积极/消极、有争议的新闻和生活相关新闻）的影响。根据这些结果，我们构建了一个中介模型来解释评论数量，这意味着社交媒体推荐可能是影响读者评论的结构和内容特征的有价值的机制。


## 6.1.2 Structural features




## 6.1.2 结构特点


The logistic regression results for the number of comments indicate that although the number of words, videos, and summary do not contribute to the number of comments, news release time, pictures, headline with location information, and location of the news event have significant contributions. If we remove the content and usage features from the model, the results show that the number of words and videos both significantly affect the number of




评论数的逻辑回归结果表明，虽然文字数、视频数和摘要数对评论数贡献不大，但新闻发布时间、图片、带有位置信息的标题和新闻事件的位置有显着的贡献。如果我们从模型中删除内容和使用特征，结果表明单词和视频的数量都会显着影响


This result implies that users would be more active to longer online news with pictures and videos. The number of words, pictures, and video, as carriers of online news, could convey rich information, which could arouse the readers’ attention extensively. Moreover, readers who pay more attention to online news will more likely tend to post comments. Online news that are released from 10 pm to 7 am are found to generate a larger number of comments, whereas online news that are released from 7 am to 12 am generate fewer comments. This observation may be because many people prefer to read the news in the morning, which are published the previous night (10 pm to 7 am). The large number of readings in the morning will result in more comments on the news that are released from 10 pm to 7am. The location information mentioned in the online news headline could arouse some readers’ interest, especially for those who live in the area mentioned or those who are concerned about the area. Regional online news receives more comments, because regional online news can strongly resonate with the readers. Unexpectedly, the summary has no contributions to the number of comments, which may be because 64% of the news articles in our sample has the summary at the beginning and the summary shows the basic writing skills of the news author.




这一结果意味着用户对带有图片和视频的较长在线新闻会更加积极。大量的文字、图片、视频作为网络新闻的载体，能够传递丰富的信息，能够引起读者的广泛关注。此外，更关注在线新闻的读者更有可能发表评论。研究发现，晚上 10 点至凌晨 7 点发布的网络新闻产生的评论数量较多，而上午 7 点至凌晨 12 点发布的网络新闻产生的评论数量较少。这一观察结果可能是因为许多人更喜欢在早上阅读前一天晚上（晚上 10 点至早上 7 点）发布的新闻。上午的阅读量较大，导致晚上10点到早上7点发布的新闻评论较多。在线新闻标题中提到的位置信息可能会引起一些读者的兴趣，特别是对于那些居住在所提到的地区或关心该地区的人来说。地方性网络新闻受到更多的评论，因为地方性网络新闻能够引起读者的强烈共鸣。出乎意料的是，摘要对评论数没有任何贡献，这可能是因为我们样本中64%的新闻文章开头都有摘要，摘要显示了新闻作者的基本写作能力。


## 6.1.3 Content features




## 6.1.3 内容特征


In addition to the subjective opinion, other content features have significant effects on the number of comments on online news sites. The logistic regression results indicate that negative news articles received much more comments than positive news articles. Negative information can encourage the readers’ thinking and criticism to the online news event, which result in active discussions. Online news articles with controversial opinions are more likely to receive comments because a double controversy could be discuss material for readers. Controversy attracts, readers’ critical thinking which could, then urge the readers to express their views. If the news event has already been released (i.e., has accumulated a large amount of attention) recently, the series of online news articles on this event will receive more views from commenters. This higher number of comments may be caused by the promotional effect of preliminary reports on the news event, and subsequent reports can more easily catch readers’ attention. Future-related online news articles receive much more comments, because the uncertainty of a forecast could attract readers’ expectations, which could urge the readers to think about the developmental trend of the news event and express their views on this news. Given that readers’ concerns and demands are closely related to their daily life, life-related news receive an even higher number of comments. In addition, reader focus more on private matters, such as matters that actors prefer to hide. Given reader curiosity, they are more likely to comment on online news that are related to private matters. Interestingly, the results indicate that readers do not like to comment on the odd news, which may be because most odd news are deviated from facts, deliberately exaggerated, and may even be false news, which arouses readers’ antipathy.




除了主观意见外，其他内容特征对在线新闻网站的评论数量也有显着影响。逻辑回归结果表明，负面新闻文章获得的评论远多于正面新闻文章。负面信息可以激发读者对网络新闻事件的思考和批评，从而引发积极的讨论。具有争议观点的在线新闻文章更有可能收到评论，因为双重争议可能会成为读者讨论的材料。争议吸引读者的批判性思维，从而促使读者发表自己的观点。如果该新闻事件最近已经发布（即积累了大量关注度），则有关该事件的一系列网络新闻文章将获得更多评论者的浏览。评论数量较高可能是由于前期报道对新闻事件的宣传作用，后续报道更容易引起读者的注意。与未来相关的网络新闻文章受到的评论要多得多，因为预测的不确定性会引起读者的期待，从而促使读者思考新闻事件的发展趋势并表达自己对新闻的看法。由于读者关心的问题和诉求与日常生活息息相关，生活类新闻的评论量甚至更高。此外，读者更关注私人事务，例如演员喜欢隐藏的事务。考虑到读者的好奇心，他们更有可能对与私人事务相关的在线新闻发表评论。有趣的是，结果表明读者不喜欢评论奇闻，这可能是因为大多数奇闻都偏离事实、故意夸大，甚至可能是假新闻，引起读者的反感。


By contrast from previous literature [8], online news articles that are written in a more emotional, personal, and subjective tone do not receive more comments. We further test the effect of subjective opinion in different types of online news. The results indicate that subjective opinions have a negatively significant effect on the number of comments for social and entertainment news. Understanding the social and entertainment news events is easier for most online news readers. Thus, readers tend to explore the truth behind the news events, and readers tend to independently express their own views without others’ opinions. However, for SciTech and financial news, subjective opinion has a positively significant effect on the number of comments. Understanding the relevant professional knowledge in SciTech and financial news is difficult for most readers. To help readers understand the news events, and to urge the readers to express their points of view in these types of news, expert analysis is needed.




与之前的文献[8]相比，以更加情绪化、个人化和主观语气撰写的网络新闻文章并没有收到更多的评论。我们进一步测试了主观意见在不同类型的网络新闻中的影响。结果表明，主观意见对社交娱乐新闻的评论数量有显着的负向影响。对于大多数在线新闻读者来说，了解社交和娱乐新闻事件更容易。因此，读者倾向于探索新闻事件背后的真相，读者倾向于独立表达自己的观点，而不考虑他人的意见。然而，对于科技和财经新闻来说，主观意见对评论数量有显着的正向影响。了解科技和财经新闻的相关专业知识对于大多数读者来说是困难的。为了帮助读者了解新闻事件，促使读者对这类新闻发表自己的观点，需要专家的分析。


## 6.2 Theoretical contributions




## 6.2 理论贡献


This study deepens and extends prior research by proposing a new framework, which is the first study to thoroughly examine the role of structural, content, and usage features in the online news context, to explain the number of readers’ comments on the online news sites. Prior research on social media have mainly focused on the exploration of how structural features, such as days of the week [1], regional coverage [1] and articles that are published at the same hour for a source [68], and on the prediction of the comment number of comments in the news articles. Given that readers’ comments on online news sites are becoming more complex and multifaceted, introducing more features from a holistic perspective is necessary. The present research provides a powerful framework for gaining a better understanding of the number of readers’ comments. Future research should further develop this framework, which can be applied in shaping comments in other media contexts.




本研究通过提出一个新的框架来深化和扩展先前的研究，这是第一个彻底考察结构、内容和使用特征在网络新闻语境中的作用的研究，以解释读者对在线新闻网站的评论数量。先前对社交媒体的研究主要集中在探索结构特征，例如星期几[1]、区域覆盖范围[1]和同一时间发布的文章[68]，以及新闻文章中评论数量的预测。鉴于读者对在线新闻网站的评论变得更加复杂和多元化，有必要从整体角度引入更多功能。目前的研究为更好地了解读者评论的数量提供了一个强大的框架。未来的研究应该进一步发展这个框架，它可以应用于塑造其他媒体环境中的评论。


Our research framework offer several important theoretical contributions and implications for future online news comment research. First, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that examines the nature and role of social media recommendation. With regard to the 16 features variables, we highly consider social media recommendation as relatively more important than structural and content features for explaining the number of comments. Prior research has ignored the critical role of social media recommendation in online news comments. This study extends our understanding of the promotional effect of social media in explaining the number of readers’ comments. The superiority of social media recommendation suggests future research should conceptualize the effects of recommendation in understanding the number of readers’ comments.




我们的研究框架为未来的在线新闻评论研究提供了一些重要的理论贡献和启示。首先，据我们所知，这是第一项探讨社交媒体推荐的性质和作用的研究。对于这 16 个特征变量，我们高度认为社交媒体推荐比解释评论数量的结构和内容特征相对更重要。先前的研究忽略了社交媒体推荐在在线新闻评论中的关键作用。这项研究扩展了我们对社交媒体在解释读者评论数量方面的推广效果的理解。社交媒体推荐的优越性表明，未来的研究应该概念化推荐在理解读者评论数量方面的效果。


Second, based on the framework and data analysis results, we have found a mediation model of social media recommendation to explain the number of comments. Previous researches have ignored the path analysis between the various features and the number of reader comments. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to develop recommendation on the social media construct. Furthermore, the construct of social media recommendation as mediator for the five structural features (pictures, video, summary, headline with location information, and location of news event) and four content features (subjective opinion, positiveness/negativeness, controversial news and life-related news) to explain the number of comments, has been tested by data analysis. The mediation effect of social media recommendation in explaining the number of readers’ comments suggests that future research on online news comments should consider this promotional effect construct and should conceptualize not only the independent effects, but also the potential mediation effect in understanding the number of readers’ comments on online news.




其次，基于框架和数据分析结果，我们找到了社交媒体推荐的中介模型来解释评论数量。以往的研究忽略了各种特征与读者评论数量之间的路径分析。据我们所知，这项研究是第一个针对社交媒体结构开发推荐的研究。此外，通过数据分析测试了社交媒体推荐作为五种结构特征（图片、视频、摘要、带有位置信息的标题和新闻事件位置）和四种内容特征（主观意见、积极/消极、争议新闻和生活相关新闻）的中介来解释评论数量。社交媒体推荐在解释读者评论数量方面的中介效应表明，未来对网络新闻评论的研究应考虑这种促进效应结构，不仅应概念化独立效应，而且应概念化理解读者对网络新闻评论数量的潜在中介效应。


Third, our study primarily conceptualizes, operationalizes, and validates the six content features, namely, controversial news, serial news, news referring to the future, life-related news, private matters, and peculiarity, from online news articles. Prior research on online news mainly focus on the objective structural features [1,25,67] and propose subjective/negative and positive/negative [6,8,72] features for the online news content. Our study provides a deep understanding of online news content attributes and work on generalizes these content features. Future online news research might consider these content features as a possible factor for the study of online news comments.




第三，我们的研究主要对网络新闻文章的六种内容特征进行概念化、操作化和验证，即争议新闻、连续新闻、涉及未来的新闻、与生活相关的新闻、私人事务和特殊性。先前对网络新闻的研究主要集中在客观结构特征[1,25,67]上，并提出了网络新闻内容的主观/负面和正面/负面特征[6,8,72]。我们的研究提供了对在线新闻内容属性的深入理解，并致力于概括这些内容特征。未来的在线新闻研究可能会将这些内容特征视为研究在线新闻评论的一个可能因素。


## 6.3 Practical Contributions




## 6.3 实际贡献


Our findings have important practical implications for both online news websites and marketing managers of other industries.




我们的研究结果对于在线新闻网站和其他行业的营销经理都有重要的实际意义。


This explanation model for the number of online news will help news websites and their managers to better understand the determinants of the number of comments in a news item, which allows the managers to develop effective methods to improve the number of comments in a news item. According to the logistic regression results in this paper, online news websites can add pictures and videos; use more words; highlight the location information in the titles,; emphasize the objective, positive, controversial, serial, future-oriented, life-related, and impersonal contents, to foster more user comments.




这种在线新闻数量的解释模型将有助于新闻网站及其管理者更好地理解新闻评论数量的决定因素，从而使管理者能够制定有效的方法来提高新闻评论数量。根据本文的逻辑回归结果，网络新闻网站可以添加图片和视频；使用更多的词语；突出显示标题中的位置信息；强调客观、积极、有争议、系列化、面向未来、与生活相关、非个人化的内容，以培养更多的用户评论。


Most importantly, the results of data mining show that reader recommendation on social media is the most powerful factor for increasing online news comments. News sites should attach importance to social media and to recommenders. News websites should practice measures to attract the attentions of potential recommenders, and to provide facilities that would allow endorsing the news on the personal profiles of the recommenders. These possible facilities include technical feasibility and a variety of incentives.




最重要的是，数据挖掘的结果表明，社交媒体上的读者推荐是增加在线新闻评论的最有力因素。新闻网站应该重视社交媒体和推荐人。新闻网站应采取措施吸引潜在推荐者的注意，并提供允许在推荐者的个人资料上认可新闻的设施。这些可能的设施包括技术可行性和各种激励措施。


The findings of this study also benefit business companies. Based on these results, marketing managers can identify news web pages that aid in gaining more and deeper concers from readers, and helps in a more effective investment of the business advertisement of marketing managers. Particularly, advertising online news with pictures; videos; more words; and objective, positive, controversial, serial, future-oriented, life-related, and impersonal contents, it cost effective for business companies.




这项研究的结果也使商业公司受益。根据这些结果，营销经理可以识别出有助于获得读者更多、更深层次关注的新闻网页，并有助于营销经理更有效地进行商业广告投资。特别是带有图片的网络新闻广告；视频；更多的话；客观、积极、有争议、系列化、面向未来、贴近生活、非个人化的内容，对于商业公司来说是划算的。


## 6.4 Limitations and suggestion for future research




## 6.4 未来研究的局限性和建议


Similar to other studies, this study also has limitations. First, various kinds of news in online news sites exist, with different characteristics. This study only considers four news types news, namely, social, entertainment, SciTech, and financial news. Although these four news types are on top of news rankings, other news types are also popular, such as sports news. Future research should extend the scope of online news. Moreover, our current treatment of online news does not distinguish the four news types. To extend our understanding of the specific online news types, future research should identify the different online news types, and compare the relative roles of different antecedents, as identified in our proposed framework.




与其他研究类似，这项研究也有局限性。首先，网络新闻网站的新闻种类繁多，各有特点。本研究仅考虑四种新闻类型，即社交新闻、娱乐新闻、科技新闻和财经新闻。虽然这四种新闻类型在新闻排行榜上名列前茅，但其他新闻类型也很受欢迎，例如体育新闻。未来的研究应该扩大在线新闻的范围。而且，我们目前对网络新闻的处理并没有区分这四种新闻类型。为了扩展我们对特定在线新闻类型的理解，未来的研究应该确定不同的在线新闻类型，并比较不同前因的相对作用，如我们提出的框架中所确定的。


Second, we have only considered eight content features (subjective opinion, positiveness/negativeness, controversial news, serial news, news that refer to the future, life-related news, private matters, and peculiarities) and one usage features (social media recommendation) in our study. However, the attributes of online news, and the interaction between online news sites and social media are complex, which may affect readers’ comments. Future research could exceed these content and usage features that we used and explore more complex features as antecedents for readers’ comments. For example, ―the celebrity effect‖ [26] and ―actors identity‖ are both possible influential factors.




其次，我们在研究中只考虑了八种内容特征（主观意见、积极/消极、有争议的新闻、系列新闻、涉及未来的新闻、与生活相关的新闻、私人事务和特殊性）和一种使用特征（社交媒体推荐）。然而，网络新闻的属性以及网络新闻网站与社交媒体之间的互动复杂，可能会影响读者的评论。未来的研究可能会超越我们使用的这些内容和使用特征，并探索更复杂的特征作为读者评论的前因。例如，“名人效应”[26]和“演员身份”都是可能的影响因素。


Third, news articles are extremely time sensitive by nature [8]. We have tested the number of comments only with seven days after the news is being released. Testing the number of comments at different times is worthwhile, such as in the first 30 minutes of the online news or on the first day of the online news. Panel data is meaningful for future research, which could be used to observe the developmental trend of news comments and compare the relatively important features to explain readers’ comments at different times.




第三，新闻文章本质上对时间极其敏感[8]。我们只测试了新闻发布后7天的评论数。测试不同时间的评论数量是值得的，例如在线新闻的前 30 分钟或在线新闻的第一天。面板数据对未来的研究有意义，可以用来观察新闻评论的发展趋势，比较相对重要的特征，以解释不同时期读者的评论。


## 7. Conclusion




## 7. 结论


Drawing from the attributes of online news and readers’ social media recommendation, we introduced three sets of features (structural, content, and usage features) as the framework to explain the number of readers’ comments on online news sites. We first developed six content features and obtained data extracted from online news articles through the content analysis method. In addition to the structural and content features, we also first developed the construct of ―social media recommendation‖ as the usage features. We then used logistic regression to testify the proposed framework. The results indicated that it is a powerful framework to explain the number of readers’ comments. Furthermore, we demonstrated the superiority of social media recommendation than structural and content features in explaining the number of the number of readers’ comments. Subsequently, we found the mediation model of ―social media recommendation‖ for five structural features and four content features to explain the number of comments. The results should be valuable for online news providers to devise effective interventions to encourage more reader comments.




从网络新闻和读者社交媒体推荐的属性出发，我们引入了三组特征（结构特征、内容特征和使用特征）作为解释网络新闻网站读者评论数量的框架。我们首先开发了六个内容特征，并通过内容分析方法获得了从在线新闻文章中提取的数据。除了结构和内容特征之外，我们还首先开发了“社交媒体推荐”的结构作为使用特征。然后我们使用逻辑回归来验证所提出的框架。结果表明，它是解释读者评论数量的强大框架。此外，我们证明了社交媒体推荐在解释读者评论数量方面比结构和内容特征的优越性。随后，我们找到了五个结构特征和四个内容特征的“社交媒体推荐”中介模型来解释评论数量。研究结果对于在线新闻提供商制定有效的干预措施以鼓励更多读者评论应该很有价值。

# Changing the Competitive Landscape: Continuous Innovation Through IT-Enabled Knowledge Capabilities




# 改变竞争格局：通过 IT 支持的知识能力持续创新


K. D. Joshi




K·D·乔希


Department of Entrepreneurship and Information Systems, College of Business, Washington State University, Pullman, Washington 99163, joshi@wsu.edu




华盛顿州立大学商学院创业与信息系统系，普尔曼，华盛顿 99163，joshi@wsu.edu


Lei Chi




雷驰


Lally School of Management and Technology, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Troy, New York 12180, chil2@rpi.edu




伦斯勒理工学院拉利管理与技术学院，特洛伊，纽约 12180，chil2@rpi.edu


Avimanyu Datta




阿维曼纽·达塔


Department of Entrepreneurship and Information Systems, College of Business, Washington State University, Pullman, Washington 99163, adatta@wsu.edu




华盛顿州立大学商学院创业与信息系统系，普尔曼，华盛顿 99163，adatta@wsu.edu


Shu Han Sy Syms School of Business, Yeshiva University, New York, New York 10016, shan@yu.edu




Shu Han Sy Syms 商学院，叶史瓦大学，纽约，纽约 10016，shan@yu.edu


W<sup>e</sup> <sup>theoretically</sup> <sup>and</sup> <sup>empirically</sup> <sup>investigate</sup> <sup>the</sup> <sup>relationship</sup> <sup>between</sup> <sup>information</sup> <sup>technology</sup> <sup>(IT)</sup> <sup>and</sup> <sup>firm</sup> innovation. Invoking absorptive capacity (ACAP) theory, we introduce and develop the concepts of three types of IT-enabled knowledge capabilities. Firm innovation is examined through two observable innovation outcomes: patents, and new product and service introductions. These innovation outcomes are often labeled as competitive actions aggressively undertaken by firms to gain market share or to achieve profitability. We use secondary data about IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and innovation outcomes of 110 firms. Our data results provide strong support for our main assertion that knowledge capabilities that are enhanced through the use of IT contribute to firm innovation. The study’s findings suggest that the three types of IT-enabled knowledge capabilities have differential effects on firm innovation. This study substantially contributes to the information systems (IS) research, methodology, and practice in multiple ways.




我们<sup></sup> <sup>理论上</sup> <sup>和</sup> <sup>经验</sup> <sup>调查</sup> <sup></sup> <sup>关系</sup> <sup></sup> <sup>信息</sup> <sup>技术</sup> <sup>（IT）</sup> <sup>和</sup><sup>坚定</sup>创新。我们援引吸收能力（ACAP）理论，引入并发展了三种 IT 支持的知识能力的概念。企业创新通过两个可观察的创新成果来检验：专利以及新产品和服务的推出。这些创新成果通常被标记为企业为获得市场份额或实现盈利而积极采取的竞争行为。我们使用有关 110 家公司的 IT 知识能力和创新成果的二手数据。我们的数据结果为我们的主要主张提供了有力的支持，即通过使用信息技术增强的知识能力有助于企业创新。研究结果表明，三种类型的信息技术支持的知识能力对企业创新具有不同的影响。这项研究以多种方式对信息系统 (IS) 研究、方法论和实践做出了重大贡献。


Key words: absorptive capacity; business value of IT; competitive impacts of IS; firm innovation; IT-enabled knowledge capability; knowledge management; strategic management of IT




关键词：吸收能力； IT 的商业价值；信息系统的竞争影响；坚定创新； IT驱动的知识能力；知识管理； IT战略管理


History: Rajiv Sabherwal, Senior Editor. This paper was received on June 1, 2008, and was with the authors 10 <sup>1</sup> months for 3 revisions.




历史：Rajiv Sabherwal，高级编辑。该论文于2008年6月1日接收，作者历时10<sup>1</sup>个月修改了3次。


## 1. Introduction




## 1.简介


Innovation is defined as “the design, invention, development and/or implementation of new or altered products, services, processes, systems, organizational structures, or business models for the purpose of creating new value for customers and financial returns for the firm” (Advisory Report to the Secretary of Commerce of the United States 2008, p. i). Along the innovation pathway, there are multiple outcomes that could be observed at different stages of innovation (Jensen and Webster 2004). These innovation outcomes involve developed new ideas or technical solutions that often take the form of patent inventions (Nerkar and Shane 2007), new product and service introductions (Hansen and Birkinshaw 2007), diffusion of newly released products and services (Hansen and Birkinshaw 2007, Rogers 1995), and revenues generated from new product and service sales (Nerkar and Shane 2007). Two of them—patent inventions and new product and service introductions—are often labeled as competitive actions that firms aggressively undertake to gain market share or to achieve profitability (Miller and Cheng 1994, Ferrier et al. 1999, Smith et al. 2001).




创新被定义为“设计、发明、开发和/或实施新的或改变的产品、服务、流程、系统、组织结构或商业模式，目的是为客户创造新价值并为公司创造新的财务回报”（2008 年美国商务部长咨询报告，第 i 页）。沿着创新路径，在创新的不同阶段可以观察到多种结果（Jensen 和 Webster 2004）。这些创新成果涉及新的想法或技术解决方案，通常采用专利发明（Nerkar 和 Shane 2007）、新产品和服务推出（Hansen 和 Birkinshaw 2007）、新发布产品和服务的传播（Hansen 和 Birkinshaw 2007、Rogers 1995）以及新产品和服务销售产生的收入（Nerkar 和 Shane 2007）等形式。其中两项——专利发明以及新产品和服务的推出——通常被贴上企业为获得市场份额或实现盈利而积极采取的竞争行为的标签（Miller and Cheng 1994，Ferrier et al. 1999，Smith et al. 2001）。


In the market, while incremental new product and service introductions redistribute shares within an existing market, radical new product and service introductions provide a high potential for market expansion that substantially increase the size of the existing market (Golder and Tellis 1997, Sorescu et al. 2003, Aboulnasr et al. 2008). Newly developed ideas in the form of patent inventions often imply a high potential for market destabilization, not only cannibalizing business from existing competitors but also repositioning existing products relative to each other (Aboulnasr et al. 2008). These innovations undertaken as competitive actions in the product-market space are agents of “creative destruction” (Schumpeter 1942)—they can destroy existing markets and yet often yield vast new market opportunities (Aboulnasr et al. 2008), substantially changing the competitive landscape in the market. Thus they are the focus of this study for this Information Systems Research special issue, which centers on competitive dynamics and digital systems.




在市场中，虽然增量新产品和服务的推出会在现有市场内重新分配份额，但激进的新产品和服务的推出提供了巨大的市场扩张潜力，从而大大增加了现有市场的规模（Golder and Tellis 1997，Sorescu et al. 2003，Aboulnasr et al. 2008）。以专利发明形式出现的新想法往往意味着市场不稳定的可能性很大，不仅会蚕食现有竞争对手的业务，还会重新定位现有产品的相对位置（Aboulnasr 等，2008）。这些在产品市场空间中作为竞争行为而采取的创新是“创造性破坏”的推动者（Schumpeter 1942）——它们可以摧毁现有市场，但往往会产生巨大的新市场机会（Aboulnasr 等人，2008），从而极大地改变市场的竞争格局。因此，它们是本信息系统研究特刊的研究重点，该特刊以竞争动态和数字系统为中心。


This study is motivated by several factors. First, today, to compete and survive, firms increasingly depend on their knowledge capabilities to continuously innovate (Cohen and Levinthal 1990). Information technology (IT) is critical for supporting knowledge management initiatives and nurturing innovation (Alavi and Leidner 2001). IT enables the creation, dissemination, and use of knowledge (Davenport et al. 2008), thus greatly augmenting and enabling firms’ knowledge capabilities (which we refer to as IT-enabled knowledge capabilities). IT’s contribution and assistance in augmenting, building, and strengthening firms’ knowledge capabilities have been recognized (e.g., Alavi and Leidner 2001, Sambamurthy and Subramani 2004, Tanriverdi 2005). The link between knowledge capabilities and firm innovation has also been emphasized (e.g., Leonard-Barton 1995). Yet, limited research has been done to examine theoretically and empirically the link between IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and firm innovation, although a few conceptual and anecdotal studies (e.g., Davenport 1993, Holsapple and Singh 2003, Davenport et al. 2008) and even fewer empirical studies (e.g., Tippins and Sohi 2003, Sabherwal and Sabherwal 2005) have examined this relationship. As more companies turn to IT in an attempt to enhance firm competitiveness through innovation, this gap must be systematically addressed by explicitly examining the relationships between IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and different innovation outcomes along the innovation pathway.




这项研究是由几个因素推动的。首先，今天，为了竞争和生存，企业越来越依赖其知识能力来不断创新（Cohen 和 Levinthal 1990）。信息技术 (IT) 对于支持知识管理计划和培育创新至关重要（Alavi 和 Leidner 2001）。 IT 促进了知识的创造、传播和使用（Davenport 等，2008），从而极大地增强和增强了企业的知识能力（我们将其称为 IT 支持的知识能力）。 IT 在增强、建设和加强企业知识能力方面的贡献和帮助已得到认可（例如，Alavi 和 Leidner 2001、Sambamurthy 和 Subramani 2004、Tanriverdi 2005）。知识能力和企业创新之间的联系也得到了强调（例如，Leonard-Barton 1995）。然而，尽管有一些概念性和轶事研究（例如 Davenport 1993、Holsapple 和 Singh 2003、Davenport 等人 2008）以及更少的实证研究（例如 Tippins 和 Sohi 2003、Sabherwal 和 Sabherwal 2005）探讨了这种关系，但从理论上和实证上检验 IT 驱动的知识能力与企业创新之间联系的研究仍然有限。随着越来越多的公司转向 IT，试图通过创新来增强企业竞争力，必须通过明确检查 IT 支持的知识能力与创新路径上不同创新成果之间的关系来系统地解决这一差距。


Second, mixed results have been found in the literature in establishing a positive relationship between IT and firm performance (Kohli and Devaraj 2003). Emergent empirical evidence has increasingly shown that there is no significant direct relationship between IT investment and firm performance outcomes such as profitability (e.g., Powell and Dent-Micalef 1997, Kohli and Devraj 2003, Tippins and Sohi 2003). It is our premise that to extract the business value from IT, firms need to cultivate IT-enabled knowledge capabilities to innovate continuously so as to enhance firm performance. This relationship is yet to be systematically investigated.




其次，在建立 IT 与公司绩效之间的积极关系方面，文献中发现的结果好坏参半（Kohli 和 Devaraj 2003）。越来越多的实证证据表明，IT 投资与公司绩效结果（例如盈利能力）之间不存在显着的直接关系（例如，Powell 和 Dent-Micalef 1997，Kohli 和 Devraj 2003，Tippins 和 Sohi 2003）。我们的前提是，企业要从IT中获取商业价值，就需要培养IT驱动的知识能力，不断创新，从而提升企业绩效。这种关系还有待系统地研究。


Third, research in competitive dynamics has widely examined patterns of competitive actions (e.g., action repertoire or a series of actions) (Ferrier 2001) and their antecedents and consequences (Smith et al. 2001). Some research has also examined a specific type of competitive actions such as market entry and exit (Baum and Korn 1996). However, patent inventions and new product and service introductions, as two important types of competitive actions that have a great potential to disrupt the competitive status quo and cause disequilibrium in the market, have not yet been carefully examined in the existing literature.




第三，竞争动态研究广泛研究了竞争行为的模式（例如，行动曲目或一系列行动）（Ferrier 2001）及其前因和后果（Smith et al. 2001）。一些研究还考察了特定类型的竞争行为，例如市场进入和退出（Baum 和 Korn 1996）。然而，专利发明和新产品及服务推出作为两种重要的竞争行为，极有可能破坏竞争现状并导致市场失衡，但现有文献尚未对其进行仔细研究。


To bridge the gap in the literature, we draw on absorptive capacity (ACAP) theory to examine whether and how IT-enabled knowledge capabilities affect firm innovation. We argue that IT-enabled knowledge capabilities enhance firm innovation by facilitating creation of patent inventions and introduction of new products and services into the market. Our findings provide strong support for our thesis. We also uncover that IT-enabled knowledge capabilities have differential effects on firm innovation. The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. We begin by discussing the theoretical underpinning of our research model. We then describe our research method and discuss our data analysis and results. We conclude the paper with our research contributions and future research.




为了弥补文献中的空白，我们利用吸收能力（ACAP）理论来研究 IT 驱动的知识能力是否以及如何影响企业创新。我们认为，信息技术支持的知识能力通过促进专利发明的创造以及将新产品和服务引入市场来增强企业创新。我们的研究结果为我们的论文提供了强有力的支持。我们还发现，IT 驱动的知识能力对企业创新具有不同的影响。本文的其余部分组织如下。我们首先讨论我们研究模型的理论基础。然后我们描述我们的研究方法并讨论我们的数据分析和结果。我们以我们的研究贡献和未来的研究来结束本文。


## 2. Theoretical Background




## 2.理论背景


In this section, we develop the concept of IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and provide a theoretical underpinning for our research model by invoking the theory of ACAP. The application of ACAP in various studies has not been literal, and each study instantiates ACAP and its components to accommodate its unique context. This is the case in our work as well. We first invoke the notion of ACAP to frame diverse information technologies that enable firms’ dynamic knowledge capabilities. We then build on ACAP theory to theorize the differential effects of IT-enabled knowledge capabilities on firm innovation.




在本节中，我们提出了 IT 支持的知识能力的概念，并通过引用 ACAP 理论为我们的研究模型提供理论基础。 ACAP 在各种研究中的应用并不是字面意义上的，每项研究都实例化了 ACAP 及其组成部分，以适应其独特的背景。我们的工作中也是如此。我们首先引用 ACAP 的概念来构建各种信息技术，以实现企业的动态知识能力。然后，我们以 ACAP 理论为基础，理论化 IT 驱动的知识能力对企业创新的不同影响。


ACAP is often viewed as a dynamic capability of processing knowledge that enhances firm innovation (Zahra and George 2002). This study nuances the broad notion of ACAP by theorizing and empirically testing IT’s contributions to firms’ abilities to manage knowledge. ACAP literature argues that a set of organizational routines and processes by which firms acquire, assimilate, transform, and exploit knowledge can produce dynamic capabilities (e.g., Cohen and Levinthal 1990; Mowery and Oxley 1995; Kim 1997a, b; Zahra and George 2002). These dynamic capabilities build on each other to yield ACAP. ACAP helps create and deploy the knowledge necessary to build other organizational capabilities (e.g., marketing, distribution, and production). ACAP has been widely invoked in the prior literature. Some studies have invoked ACAP broadly to indicate firms’ receptivity to technological change (Kedia and Bhagat 1988); some have invoked the concept to gauge firms’ ability to use outside knowledge (Koza and Lewin 1998) or replicate new knowledge (Tsai 2001); others have invoked the concept to link firms’ IT usage patterns in the supply chain to their knowledge creation ability (Malhotra et al. 2005). In this study, we invoke ACAP to conceptualize firms’ IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and link these capabilities to firm innovation.




ACAP 通常被视为一种处理知识的动态能力，可以增强企业创新（Zahra 和 George 2002）。本研究通过理论化和实证检验 IT 对企业知识管理能力的贡献，对 ACAP 的广泛概念进行了细致入微的阐述。 ACAP 文献认为，企业获取、吸收、转化和利用知识的一套组织惯例和流程可以产生动态能力（例如，Cohen 和 Levinthal 1990；Mowery 和 Oxley 1995；Kim 1997a, b；Zahra 和 George 2002）。这些动态能力相辅相成，形成 ACAP。 ACAP 帮助创建和部署构建其他组织能力（例如营销、分销和生产）所需的知识。 ACAP 在先前的文献中已被广泛引用。一些研究广泛引用 ACAP 来表明企业对技术变革的接受程度（Kedia 和 Bhagat 1988）；有些人援引这一概念来衡量企业使用外部知识的能力（Koza 和 Lewin，1998）或复制新知识的能力（Tsai，2001）；其他人则援引这一概念，将供应链中企业的 IT 使用模式与其知识创造能力联系起来（Malhotra 等人，2005 年）。在本研究中，我们利用 ACAP 来概念化企业 IT 驱动的知识能力，并将这些能力与企业创新联系起来。


## 2.1. IT-Enabled Absorptive Capacity (IT-ACAP)




## 2.1. IT 支持的吸收能力 (IT-ACAP)


ACAP has two subsets of potential and realized absorptive capacities (RACAP) (Zahra and George 2002). Potential absorptive capacity (PACAP) consists of knowledge acquisition and assimilation capabilities, making the firm amenable to acquiring and assimilating knowledge (Lane and Lubatkin 1998,




ACAP 有两个子集：潜在吸收能力和已实现吸收能力 (RACAP)（Zahra 和 George 2002）。潜在吸收能力（PACAP）由知识获取和同化能力组成，使公司能够获取和同化知识（Lane 和 Lubatkin 1998，


Zahra and George 2002). RACAP consists of knowledge transformation and exploitation capabilities, which reflect firms’ capacity to leverage the knowledge that has been absorbed (Zahra and George 2002). PACAP and RACAP have distinct roles that are complementary.




扎赫拉和乔治 2002）。 RACAP 由知识转化和利用能力组成，反映了企业利用已吸收知识的能力（Zahra 和 George，2002）。 PACAP 和 RACAP 具有互补的独特作用。


2.1.1. IT-Enabled Potential ACAP (IT-PACAP). Information technologies that help support knowledge acquisition and assimilation provide IT-PACAP. Knowledge acquisition involves firms’ capability to identify and obtain knowledge that is critical to their operations. There are several information technologies that can support and enhance firms’ knowledge acquisition capability by enhancing the speed, intensity, and directionality of knowledge identification and selection. Firms that use these technologies are likely to enhance their ability to acquire and retrieve useful knowledge (Tippins and Sohi 2003). For instance, sophisticated retrieval technology such as query software, search engines, expert finder, and knowledge maps can help identify, collect, and extract useful knowledge from a wide variety of knowledge resources with a high speed and accuracy. Employee knowledge directories drive the identification of knowledge in the right direction. Moreover, intelligent mechanisms built into search and retrieval technologies, plus sophisticated data structuring, indexing, and tagging techniques, help navigate the knowledge acquisition process in the right direction.




2.1.1. IT 支持的潜力 ACAP (IT-PACAP)。帮助支持知识获取和同化的信息技术提供了 IT-PACAP。知识获取涉及企业识别和获取对其运营至关重要的知识的能力。有多种信息技术可以通过提高知识识别和选择的速度、强度和方向性来支持和增强企业的知识获取能力。使用这些技术的公司可能会增强获取和检索有用知识的能力（Tippins 和 Sohi 2003）。例如，查询软件、搜索引擎、专家查找器、知识图谱等复杂的检索技术可以帮助从广泛的知识资源中快速、准确地识别、收集和提取有用的知识。员工知识目录推动知识识别朝着正确的方向发展。此外，搜索和检索技术中内置的智能机制，加上复杂的数据结构、索引和标记技术，有助于将知识获取过程引导到正确的方向。


Knowledge assimilation involves firms’ capability to incorporate and make the knowledge part of their organizational memory (Holsapple and Joshi 2002, 2004). This capability allows new knowledge to be understood and integrated into organizational knowledge resources (Zahra and George 2002). Newly acquired knowledge often comes in forms and formats that cannot be readily internalized (Leonard-Barton 1995). The assimilating capability helps with the comprehension and internalization of newly acquired knowledge. Alavi and Leidner (2001) argue that IT can enhance firms’ assimilating capability by creating organizational memory in the form of electronic repositories. Through organizational learning, firms accumulate valuable knowledge that needs to be stored and preserved for future use (Tippins and Sohi 2003). IT can provide the necessary mechanisms and tools to preserve and store this knowledge. IT can help store information in formats such that it can be accessible to firm employees and enable them to interpret it in a consistent manner, thereby becoming a part of the entire firm’s memory. There are several information technologies that can help enhance organizational memory. For instance, asset management systems can help assimilate and manage firms intellectual property. Content management systems, databases, and data warehouses can help store various forms of data, information, and knowledge.




知识同化涉及企业将知识纳入其组织记忆并使之成为其组织记忆的一部分的能力（Holsapple 和 Joshi 2002，2004）。这种能力使得新知识能够被理解并整合到组织知识资源中（Zahra 和 George 2002）。新获得的知识通常以无法轻易内化的形式和格式出现（Leonard-Barton 1995）。同化能力有助于对新获得的知识的理解和内化。 Alavi 和 Leidner (2001) 认为，IT 可以通过以电子存储库的形式创建组织记忆来增强企业的同化能力。通过组织学习，企业积累了宝贵的知识，需要存储和保存以供将来使用（Tippins 和 Sohi 2003）。 IT 可以提供必要的机制和工具来保存和存储这些知识。 IT 可以帮助以公司员工可以访问的格式存储信息，并使他们能够以一致的方式解释信息，从而成为整个公司记忆的一部分。有多种信息技术可以帮助增强组织记忆。例如，资产管理系统可以帮助吸收和管理公司的知识产权。内容管理系统、数据库和数据仓库可以帮助存储各种形式的数据、信息和知识。


2.1.2. IT-Enabled Realized ACAP (IT-RACAP). Information technologies that help support knowledge transformation and exploitation provide IT-enabled realized absorptive capacity (IT-RACAP). Knowledge transformation involves firms’ capability to synthesize, develop, and refine knowledge through addition, deletion, or reinterpretation of the absorbed knowledge. Transformation also allows firms to view and develop knowledge through bisociation. This is achieved when knowledge from “two self-consistent but incompatible frames of reference” (Koestler 1966, p. 35) is visualized and integrated to create new insights, to facilitate the recognition of opportunities, and to alter the ways in which firms see themselves and their competitive landscape. Exploitation capability allows firms to apply and use existing knowledge to create new organizational competencies. It requires using knowledge that already exists and has been internalized for use (Lyles and Schwenk 1992).




2.1.2. IT 支持的已实现 ACAP (IT-RACAP)。帮助支持知识转化和利用的信息技术提供了 IT 支持的实现吸收能力 (IT-RACAP)。知识转型涉及企业通过添加、删除或重新解释所吸收的知识来综合、开发和提炼知识的能力。转型还允许企业通过异化来观察和发展知识。当来自“两个自洽但不相容的参考框架”（Koestler 1966，第 35 页）的知识被可视化和整合以创造新的见解、促进对机会的识别并改变企业看待自身及其竞争格局的方式时，就能实现这一点。开发能力使企业能够应用和使用现有知识来创造新的组织能力。它需要使用已经存在并已内化使用的知识（Lyles 和 Schwenk 1992）。


Knowledge transformation capability can be enhanced or enabled through IT. IT can help create new knowledge by merging, categorizing, reclassifying, and synthesizing existing knowledge. For instance, Sabherwal and Sabherwal (2005) empirically demonstrated that this IT-enabled capability was associated with high innovations within an industry. There are several information technologies that can help support and enhance firms’ knowledge transformation capability. For instance, business intelligence tools such as data mining and analytical software allow firms to transform existing data and knowledge to gain new insights and understanding (Sabherwal and Becerra-Fernandez 2010). Visualization techniques can support bisociation by integrating and mapping disparate knowledge sets to uncover new knowledge.




知识转化能力可以通过IT来增强或启用。 IT 可以通过合并、分类、重新分类和综合现有知识来帮助创造新知识。例如，Sabherwal 和 Sabherwal (2005) 凭经验证明，这种 IT 支持的能力与行业内的高度创新相关。有多种信息技术可以帮助支持和增强企业的知识转化能力。例如，数据挖掘和分析软件等商业智能工具使企业能够转变现有数据和知识，以获得新的见解和理解（Sabherwal 和 Becerra-Fernandez 2010）。可视化技术可以通过整合和映射不同的知识集来发现新知识来支持双联。


IT can enhance exploitation capability by facilitating the use of knowledge preserved and embedded in IT systems to conduct organizational operations (Alavi and Leidner 2001, Gold et al. 2001, Sabherwal and Sabherwal 2005). With the aid of IT, individuals who exploit knowledge do not need to comprehend it (Conner and Prahalad 1996), nor do they need to internalize it (Sabherwal and Sabherwal 2005). There are several information technologies that embody knowledge (such as rules, procedures, routines, directives, instructions, and standards) that can help individuals conduct their knowledge work (Alavi and Leidner 2001) without fully understanding the embedded knowledge. Examples of information technologies that can help enhance knowledge exploitation capability include case-based reasoning and expert systems.




IT 可以通过促进使用 IT 系统中保存和嵌入的知识来进行组织运营来增强开发能力（Alavi 和 Leidner 2001，Gold 等人 2001，Sabherwal 和 Sabherwal 2005）。在信息技术的帮助下，利用知识的个人不需要理解它（Conner 和 Prahalad 1996），也不需要内化它（Sabherwal 和 Sabherwal 2005）。有几种体现知识的信息技术（例如规则、程序、例程、指示、指示和标准）可以帮助个人在不完全理解嵌入知识的情况下开展知识工作（Alavi 和 Leidner 2001）。有助于增强知识利用能力的信息技术的例子包括基于案例的推理和专家系统。


## 2.2. IT-Enabled Social Integration Capacity (IT-SIC)




## 2.2. IT 支持的社会融合能力 (IT-SIC)


Social integration mechanisms are structures that build firms’ social capital (Zahra and George 2002). These structures promote connectedness, interaction, coordination, and communication among members of firms by creating seamless networks of people, devises, and knowledge. In the ACAP literature, the conceptualization and empirical testing of social integration mechanisms within the context of potential and realized ACAP are thin and widely different. Zahra and George (2002) used these mechanisms to suggest ways to bridge the gap between potential and realized capabilities. Jansen et al. (2005) argued that these mechanisms are antecedents to potential and RACAP. Todorova and Durisin (2007) argued that social integration mechanisms can positively or negatively impact both potential and realized capabilities and organizational innovative outcomes.




社会融合机制是建立企业社会资本的结构（Zahra 和 George 2002）。这些结构通过创建人员、设备和知识的无缝网络，促进公司成员之间的联系、互动、协调和沟通。在 ACAP 文献中，潜在 ACAP 和已实现 ACAP 背景下社会融合机制的概念化和实证检验很薄弱且存在很大差异。 Zahra 和 George (2002) 使用这些机制提出了弥合潜在能力和已实现能力之间差距的方法。詹森等人。 (2005) 认为这些机制是潜力和 RACAP 的前提。 Todorova 和 Durisin (2007) 认为，社会融合机制可以对潜在和已实现的能力以及组织创新成果产生积极或消极的影响。


In this study, we extend the notion of social integration mechanisms by arguing that IT can provide a capability to help augment firms’ social capital and support direct interactions among human members of the firms to cultivate shared frame of references. We conceptualize this IT-enabled capability as IT-SIC. IT-SIC enables the development of social capital through direct human interactions and discourse. IT can support and cultivate knowledge synergies by creating electronic networks of alliances and collaborators that can facilitate cross-firm socialization essential for knowledge integration (Tippins and Sohi 2003). For instance, e-community of practice, Web conferencing, and groupware systems are all instrumental in cultivating social interactions and connectedness among individuals and groups; message boards, electronic message software, and chat rooms can help with communication and coordination; RSS technologies can help employees synthesize and share information from multiple sources; wikis and blogs have opened up new opportunities to integrate knowledge and ideas, accelerating knowledge discovery and innovation (Shneiderman 2007). These information technologies augment participation and discourse among individuals for the purposes of knowledge development and integration. Thus, IT can foster and provide both formal and informal SIC by supporting various social integration mechanisms. For instance, the use of video conferencing and groupware facilitates formal integration, while various tools like e-community of practice and blogs create opportunities for informal integration.




在本研究中，我们扩展了社会整合机制的概念，认为 IT 可以提供帮助增强企业社会资本并支持企业成员之间直接互动以培养共享参考框架的能力。我们将这种 IT 支持的功能概念化为 IT-SIC。 IT-SIC 通过直接的人际互动和对话实现社会资本的发展。 IT 可以通过创建联盟和合作者的电子网络来支持和培养知识协同效应，从而促进知识整合所必需的跨公司社会化（Tippins 和 Sohi 2003）。例如，电子实践社区、网络会议和群件系统都有助于培养个人和群体之间的社会互动和联系；留言板、电子信息软件和聊天室可以帮助沟通和协调； RSS技术可以帮助员工综合和共享多个来源的信息；维基和博客开辟了整合知识和思想、加速知识发现和创新的新机会（Shneiderman 2007）。这些信息技术增强了个人之间的参与和讨论，以实现知识开发和整合的目的。因此，信息技术可以通过支持各种社会融合机制来培育和提供正式和非正式的社会信息交流。例如，视频会议和群件的使用促进了正式整合，而电子实践社区和博客等各种工具则为非正式整合创造了机会。


## 2.3. Firm Innovation Outputs




## 2.3。企业创新产出


Prior literature on ACAP has found a strong relationship between ACAP and innovation output. However, this literature does not unpack the notion of firm innovation. In this study, we focus on two specific innovation outcomes: ideated innovation and commercialized innovation (CI ).




先前有关 ACAP 的文献发现 ACAP 与创新产出之间存在密切关系。然而，这些文献并没有阐明企业创新的概念。在本研究中，我们关注两个具体的创新成果：理念创新和商业化创新（CI）。


2.3.1. Ideated Innovation. Drawing on extant literature, we define ideated innovation as knowledge that is created through firms’ innovation efforts and embodied in forms such as inventions, discoveries, developed ideas, and/or solutions of technical problems. This knowledge representation is novel, original, relevant, and valued and can be commercialized into new products or services with potential financial returns (Luecke and Katz 2003). Ideated innovation is widely invoked as an intermediate outcome, which results from knowledge transformation and exploitation but precedes innovation commercialization (Nerkar and Shane 2007, Furman et al. 2002, Penner-Hahn and Shaver 2005, Gold et al. 2001). Ideated innovation often takes the form of patent inventions (e.g., Dutta and Weiss 1997, Decarolis and Deeds 1999, Penner-Hahn and Shaver 2005, Nerkar and Shane 2007, Heeley and Jacobson 2008).




2.3.1.理念创新。借鉴现有文献，我们将理念创新定义为通过企业创新努力创造的知识，并以发明、发现、发展思想和/或技术问题解决方案等形式体现。这种知识表示是新颖的、原创的、相关的和有价值的，可以商业化为具有潜在财务回报的新产品或服务（Luecke 和 Katz 2003）。有创意的创新被广泛视为中间结果，它是知识转化和利用的结果，但先于创新商业化（Nerkar 和 Shane 2007，Furman 等人 2002，Penner-Hahn 和 Shaver 2005，Gold 等人 2001）。有创意的创新通常以专利发明的形式出现（例如，Dutta 和 Weiss 1997、Decarolis 和 Deeds 1999、Penner-Hahn 和 Shaver 2005、Nerkar 和 Shane 2007、Heeley 和 Jacobson 2008）。


2.3.2. CI. The CI brings ideated innovation to market (Nambison and Sawhney 2007, Andrew and Sirkin 2003, Nerkar and Shane 2007). Past research posits that successful commercialization of innovation is necessary for firms to be competitive (Nevens et al. 1990, Nerkar and Shane 2007). CI often takes the form of new product and service introduction that has the potential commercial significance (Katila 2002). In this study, we specifically examine product and service innovation. Product innovation involves the introduction of products that are new or substantially improved, e.g., improvements in functional characteristics, technical abilities, ease of use. Service innovation involves novelty in the way in which services are produced or in the delivery of new creative content of service offerings.




2.3.2. CI。 CI 将有创意的创新推向市场（Nambison 和 Sawhney 2007，Andrew 和 Sirkin 2003，Nerkar 和 Shane 2007）。过去的研究认为，创新的成功商业化对于企业保持竞争力是必要的（Nevens et al. 1990，Nerkar and Shane 2007）。 CI 通常采取具有潜在商业意义的新产品和服务介绍的形式（Katila 2002）。在这项研究中，我们专门研究产品和服务创新。产品创新涉及推出新产品或大幅改进的产品，例如功能特性、技术能力、易用性的改进。服务创新涉及服务生产方式或服务产品新创意内容交付方式的新颖性。


## 3. Model and Hypotheses




## 3.模型和假设


Here, we propose a theoretical model that characterizes the relationships between IT-enabled knowledge capabilities and firm innovation. IT-RACAP directly impacts innovation outcomes because of its generative abilities, whereas IT-RACAP and IT-SIC provide supportive capabilities and may impact innovation indirectly either through other factors (mediation) or through working with other factors (moderation). In this study, as an initial effort to investigate differential impacts of IT on different innovation outcomes, we do not attempt to investigate all possible relationships between IT and innovation; rather, we select the most significant relationships that are grounded in ACAP theory. Thus we focus our investigation on the direct effects of IT-RACAP and indirect effects of IT-PACAP and IT-SIC on different innovation outcomes. Figure 1 depicts this model. The model posits that IT-enabled knowledge capabilities significantly affect firm innovation. Specifically, the model posits that firms’ IT-PACAP enhances IT-RACAP (H1), which, in turn, directly positively affects firms’ ideated innovation (H2) and CI (H3). Ideated innovation positively affects CI (H4). IT-SIC interacts with ideated innovation to affect firms’ ability to commercialize on innovation (H5). The extent to which firms are able to commercialize on their innovation is also affected by firm size and industry type.




在这里，我们提出了一个理论模型来描述 IT 支持的知识能力与企业创新之间的关系。 IT-RACAP 由于其生成能力而直接影响创新成果，而 IT-RACAP 和 IT-SIC 提供支持能力，并可能通过其他因素（中介）或通过与其他因素合作（调节）间接影响创新。在本研究中，作为调查 IT 对不同创新成果的不同影响的初步努力，我们并不试图调查 IT 与创新之间所有可能的关系；相反，我们选择基于 ACAP 理论的最重要的关系。因此，我们重点研究 IT-RACAP 的直接影响以及 IT-PACAP 和 IT-SIC 对不同创新成果的间接影响。图 1 描述了该模型。该模型假设 IT 支持的知识能力显着影响企业创新。具体来说，该模型假设企业的 IT-PACAP 增强了 IT-RACAP (H1)，这反过来又直接对企业的创意创新 (H2) 和 CI (H3) 产生积极影响。有创意的创新对 CI (H4) 产生积极影响。 IT-SIC 与创意创新相互作用，影响企业创新商业化的能力 (H5)。企业将其创新商业化的程度也受到企业规模和行业类型的影响。


## 3.1. IT-PACAP and IT-RACAP




## 3.1. IT-PACAP 和 IT-RACAP


ACAP theory views potential and realized capabilities as two complementary capabilities necessary to improve firms’ innovative outcomes. Firms cannot fully exploit knowledge without first acquiring it. In essence, PACAP forms the basis and foundation for firms’ RACAP, while RACAP is largely viewed as directly impacting firms’ innovative outcomes (Zahra and George 2002).




ACAP 理论将潜在能力和已实现能力视为提高企业创新成果所必需的两种互补能力。如果不首先获取知识，企业就无法充分利用知识。从本质上讲，PACAP 构成了企业 RACAP 的基础和基础，而 RACAP 在很大程度上被视为直接影响企业的创新成果（Zahra 和 George 2002）。


Figure 1 A Theoretical Model of IT-Enabled Knowledge Capabilities and Firm Innovation

Note. For the purpose of simplicity, control variables are not included.




图 1 IT 支持的知识能力和企业创新的理论模型
