Note: These findings suggest that our main results are not driven by firms’ overall levels of general diversification; rather, they are driven by firms’ ability to diversify specifically toward more digital industries. Further, we tested two alternative models, one with the digital proximity measure obtained using the (inverse) mean path-length to digital industries (instead of the shortest path to digital industries) in Model (3), and the other with the ratio of firms’ digital proximity over its industry average in Model (4). The results of Models (3) and (4) are in line with our main results. Robust standard errors in parentheses. \*\*\* $p < 0 . 0 1 , ^ { \star \star } p < 0 . 0 \bar { 5 } , ^ { \star } p < 0 . 1$




注：这些发现表明，我们的主要结果并非由企业的总体多元化水平驱动；相反，它们是由企业专门向数字化行业进行多元化发展的能力所驱动的。此外，我们测试了两种替代模型，一种是在模型（3）中使用数字产业的（逆）平均路径长度（而不是到数字产业的最短路径）获得的数字邻近度度量，另一种是在模型（4）中使用企业数字邻近度与其行业平均水平的比率。模型（3）和（4）的结果与我们的主要结果一致。括号内为稳健标准误。 \*\*\* $p < 0 。 0 1 , ^ { \star \star } p < 0 。 0 \bar { 5 } , ^ { \star } p < 0 。 1$


In our context, any indirect influence of the digital proximity of a focal industry’s neighbors on that focal industry’s intangible value would occur through the focal industry’s own digital proximity via this network-path effect. Accordingly, we calculated the average digital proximity for the set of direct neighbors of each focal industry, which we henceforth refer to as the second-order proximity of the focal industry. Next, we calculated firm-level instrumental variables by constructing the firm-level average of the second-order proximity scores of the industries in which firms report sales, weighted by the number of sales reported. Table 8 presents the first-stage regression models and Table 9 presents the results of instrumental variable analysis. All models show positive and significant results, providing further support for the main results. In addition, the results of the first-stage regression reported in Table 8 and the various statistical tests reported in Table 9 support the validity of the instruments.




在我们的背景下，焦点产业邻居的数字邻近性对该焦点产业无形价值的任何间接影响都将通过该网络路径效应通过焦点产业自身的​​数字邻近性而发生。因此，我们计算了每个焦点行业的直接邻居集合的平均数字邻近度，我们以后将其称为焦点产业的二阶邻近度。接下来，我们通过构建公司报告销售的行业的二阶邻近得分的公司级平均值（按报告的销售数量加权）来计算公司级工具变量。表8给出了第一阶段的回归模型，表9给出了工具变量分析的结果。所有模型都显示出积极且显着的结果，为主要结果提供了进一步的支持。此外，表 8 中报告的第一阶段回归结果和表 9 中报告的各种统计检验支持了工具的有效性。


Second, we implemented the propensity score matching approach used in prior IS research (Chang and Gurbaxani 2012; Mithas and Krishnan 2009; Oestreicher-Singer and Zalmanson 2013) to further investigate the robustness of our causal identification. We began our analysis by clearly defining the sample, the treatment variable, the outcome variable, and the covariates. We used firm-year observations between 2012 and 2016 for the purpose of matching. In order to form a binary outcome variable, we used the average Tobin’s q across firms’ industry participation in 2016. We assigned a value of 1 for all firms with a Tobin’s q score higher than the industry average plus one standard deviation in year 2016, and 0 otherwise. Using a similar approach, we developed our binary treatment variable using digital proximity scores and industry averages from 2015.




其次，我们实施了先前 IS 研究中使用的倾向评分匹配方法（Chang 和 Gurbaxani 2012；Mithas 和 Krishnan 2009；Oestreicher-Singer 和 Zalmanson 2013），以进一步研究我们因果识别的稳健性。我们通过明确定义样本、治疗变量、结果变量和协变量开始分析。我们使用 2012 年至 2016 年的公司年度观察数据进行匹配。为了形成二元结果变量，我们使用了 2016 年各公司行业参与度的托宾 q 平均值。对于托宾 q 得分高于 2016 年行业平均水平加上一个标准差的所有公司，我们将其指定为 1，否则为 0。使用类似的方法，我们使用 2015 年的数字邻近度分数和行业平均值开发了二元治疗变量。


To construct a list of relevant covariates, including various measures of firms’ acquisition and alliancing activities, we used the SDC Platinum database. Strategy and innovation literatures have established mergers, acquisitions, and strategic alliances as important instruments for external innovation (De Man and Duysters 2005; Hagedoorn and Duysters 2002), especially in high-tech industries (Cloodt et al. 2006). IS literature has also explored how mergers, acquisitions, and strategic alliances can enhance firms’ ability to digitize their business processes (Tafti et al. 2013; Trantopoulos et al. 2017) and develop innovative digital products and services (Han et al. 2012; Rahmati et al.




为了构建相关协变量列表，包括公司收购和联盟活动的各种衡量标准，我们使用了 SDC Platinum 数据库。战略和创新文献将合并、收购和战略联盟作为外部创新的重要工具（De Man and Duysters 2005；Hagedoorn and Duysters 2002），特别是在高科技行业（Cloodt et al. 2006）。 IS 文献还探讨了合并、收购和战略联盟如何增强企业业务流程数字化的能力（Tafti 等人，2013 年；Trantopoulos 等人，2017 年）以及开发创新数字产品和服务的能力（Han 等人，2012 年；Rahmati 等人，2017 年）。


2021; Singh et al. 2015). Our list of covariates includes firms’ total number of alliances, joint ventures, software alliances, alliances that include software development, alliances that include marketing services, acquisitions, and software firm acquisitions, as well as the total number of software firm acquisitions in the firm’s primary industry between 2011 and 2015.<sup>5</sup> We report the result of the logit regression model predicting the binary form of the treatment variable digital proximity in Table 10. We also perform an additional robustness check with an alternative list of covariates and report these results in Table A2 in Appendix A.<sup>6</sup>




2021 年；辛格等人。 2015）。我们的协变量列表包括公司的联盟、合资企业、软件联盟、包含软件开发的联盟、包含营销服务、收购和软件公司收购的联盟的总数，以及 2011 年至 2015 年间公司主要产业中软件公司收购的总数。<sup>5</sup>我们在表 10 中报告了逻辑回归模型的结果，该模型预测了处理变量数字邻近度的二进制形式。我们还执行了使用替代协变量列表进行额外的稳健性检查，并在附录 A 的表 A2 中报告这些结果。<sup>6</sup>


The propensity score matching results, reported in Table 11, provide further support for our hypothesis. We performed various matching techniques and specifications to ensure the robustness of our results within parameters for neighbors and calipers, as presented in Table 11. The results are consistent across different matching techniques (Kernel matching in Column 1 and nearest neighbor matching in Columns 2 to 4).




表 11 中报告的倾向得分匹配结果为我们的假设提供了进一步的支持。我们执行了各种匹配技术和规范，以确保我们的结果在邻居和卡尺参数范围内的稳健性，如表 11 所示。不同匹配技术的结果是一致的（第 1 列中的内核匹配和第 2 至 4 列中的最近邻居匹配）。


One strong assumption underlying our matching method is that we can assess firms’ digital proximity using the set of identified covariates; however, identifying the complete set of factors affecting digital proximity and providing an exact prediction of the treatment variable is not feasible. In light of the possibility of biased estimates from unobserved factors (Caliendo and Kopeinig 2008), we assessed the sensitivity of our results to the effects of various unobserved factors. Accordingly, we examined the probability of classifying a firm in the treatment group or the control group based on unobserved factors (Rosenbaum and Rubin 1983) and report the results, critical Rosenbaum’s gamma values, in Table 11.<sup>7</sup> These values fall within an acceptable range (Mithas and Krishnan 2009; Oestreicher-Singer and Zalmanson 2013), between 1.8 to 4.2. Thus, unless we can argue that the unobserved factors can change the odds of having a high level of digital proximity by at least 80%, we can rely on the previously generated estimates. Given that we capture an acceptable level of variation for our set of observed factors, we can conclude that our results are robust to unobserved factors. Table 12 presents the descriptive statistics of covariances before and after matching. We performed additional falsification tests to ensure the identified effect is not attributed to chance and common industry trends and report these results in Table 13.




我们的匹配方法背后的一个强有力的假设是，我们可以使用一组已识别的协变量来评估公司的数字邻近度；然而，确定影响数字接近度的完整因素并提供治疗变量的准确预测是不可行的。鉴于未观察因素造成估计偏差的可能性（Caliendo 和 Kopeinig 2008），我们评估了结果对各种未观察因素影响的敏感性。因此，我们根据未观察到的因素（Rosenbaum 和 Rubin，1983 年）检查了将公司分为处理组或对照组的概率，并在表 11 中报告了结果，即关键的 Rosenbaum 伽玛值。<sup>7</sup>这些值落在可接受的范围内（Mithas 和 Krishnan，2009 年；Oestreicher-Singer 和 Zalmanson，2013 年），介于1.8至4.2。因此，除非我们认为未观察到的因素可以将高水平数字邻近度的几率改变至少 80%，否则我们可以依赖之前生成的估计。鉴于我们捕获了一组观察到的因素的可接受的变化水平，我们可以得出结论，我们的结果对于未观察到的因素是稳健的。表12给出了匹配前后协方差的描述性统计。我们进行了额外的证伪测试，以确保所确定的影响不会归因于偶然和常见的行业趋势，并将这些结果报告在表 13 中。

The statistically insignificant results (comparing the mean to the S.E.) presented in this table show that our identified relationship is not attributed to chance or common industry trends. Column (2) reports the same when shuffling within industries. Finally, Column (3) shows the results of randomly assigning digital proximity scores within each year and industry (i.e., preserving year and industry variables). Pseudo p-values are constructed based on the percentage of times that a z-test reported statistically insignificant differences between the estimated model and the original estimation in Table 5. Highly significant pseudo p-values for all models, therefore, show that the coefficient estimates for digital proximity obtained through shuffling were significantly different from those reported in Table 5. Therefore, the main results are not attributed to chance and common industry trends.




注：第 (1) 列报告随机打乱数字邻近分数并估计系数 100 次时数字邻近系数的平均值和标准误差 (S.E.)。此表中呈现的统计上不显着的结果（将平均值与 S.E. 进行比较）表明，我们确定的关系并非归因于偶然或常见的行业趋势。第 (2) 栏在行业内洗牌时报告了相同的情况。最后，第 (3) 列显示了在每年和行业内随机分配数字邻近度分数的结果（即保留年份和行业变量）。伪 p 值是根据 z 检验报告估计模型与表 5 中的原始估计之间统计上不显着差异的次数百分比构建的。因此，所有模型的高度显着的伪 p 值表明，通过改组获得的数字邻近度的系数估计与表 5 中报告的系数显着不同。因此，主要结果不归因于机会和常见行业趋势。


Following recent research (Burtch and Chan 2019; Lee and Hosanagar 2019), we used the shuffling technique in three separate tests to consider whether the identified relationship arises spuriously. First, we randomly assigned digital proximity scores without considering the industry and year panel variables. Then, we randomly assigned these scores within the same industries and, finally, within the same years in the same industries. For each test, we conducted random shuffling 100 times, reestimating the coefficient for each permutation and reporting the mean and standard error of these 100 coefficient estimates for digital proximity. Lack of statistical significance in all of these models shows that our results are independent of industrial trends and environmental changes. For further details on this procedure, see Good (2005).




根据最近的研究（Burtch 和 Chan 2019；Lee 和 Hosanagar 2019），我们在三个单独的测试中使用了改组技术，以考虑所识别的关系是否是虚假出现的。首先，我们随机分配数字接近度分数，而不考虑行业和年份面板变量。然后，我们在同一行业内随机分配这些分数，最后在同一行业的同一年份内随机分配这些分数。对于每个测试，我们进行了 100 次随机洗牌，重新估计每个排列的系数，并报告这 100 个数字邻近系数估计的平均值和标准误差。所有这些模型都缺乏统计显着性，这表明我们的结果独立于工业趋势和环境变化。有关此过程的更多详细信息，请参阅 Good (2005)。


Finally, we assessed the face validity of the digital proximity measure by comparing it to three measures: (1) similarity to digital knowledge, (2) knowledge complexity, and (3) digital innovations. We report this analysis in Appendix B. We discuss the additional tests performed, the robustness of our results to multicollinearity, unobserved heterogeneities, and reverse causality in Appendix C.




最后，我们通过将数字邻近性度量与以下三个度量进行比较来评估其表面有效性：（1）与数字知识的相似性，（2）知识复杂性，以及（3）数字创新。我们在附录 B 中报告了这一分析。我们在附录 C 中讨论了进行的额外测试、结果对多重共线性、未观察到的异质性和反向因果关系的稳健性。


## Discussion




＃＃ 讨论


## Research Implications




## 研究意义


Inspired by the literature examining the effect of proximity on the innovation output of firms and economies (Green 2018; Hidalgo et al. 2007; Klepper 2010), we introduce the digital proximity construct and its measurement, which captures the closeness of a firm’s products and services to digital industries. We examined the relationship between digital proximity and intangible value over the past several decades by constructing an industry space that shows how firms’ proximity to digital industries evolves over time.




受到研究邻近度对企业和经济体创新产出影响的文献的启发（Green 2018；Hidalgo et al. 2007；Klepper 2010），我们引入了数字邻近度构造及其测量，它捕获了公司产品和服务与数字产业的紧密度。我们通过构建一个行业空间来研究过去几十年来数字邻近度与无形价值之间的关系，该空间显示企业与数字产业的邻近度如何随着时间的推移而演变。


Introducing digital proximity, as a theoretical construct, offers two specific theoretical contributions to the field of IS. First, this work explores IT beyond being a monetary investment with productivity effects, and keys in on the intangible value of digitization of products and services as a form of strategic positioning within the economic network linking all industries. With digital technologies becoming increasingly pervasive in a growing number of products and services previously considered to be nondigital, our results highlight digital innovation as an inherent driver—rather than an appendage of—firms’ business strategy. This implication aligns with prior literature that recognizes IT as an inherent component of firms’ business strategy (Bharadwaj et al. 2013). It also aligns with the contemporary reality of digital transformation (Yoo et al. 2012). By extending research beyond the factors that help firms establish superior IT capabilities, the current investigation motivates further studies on the question of how firms can acquire high levels of digitization. Moving forward, more research is needed to better understand the firm-level and environmental factors that could impact a firm’s ability to translate digitization success into intangible value and a sustainable competitive advantage.




引入数字邻近作为一种理论构造，为信息系统领域提供了两个具体的理论贡献。首先，这项工作探讨了信息技术不仅仅是一种具有生产力效应的货币投资，并重点关注产品和服务数字化的无形价值，作为连接所有行业的经济网络中的一种战略定位形式。随着数字技术在越来越多以前被认为是非数字化的产品和服务中变得越来越普遍，我们的研究结果强调数字创新是公司业务战略的内在驱动力，而不是附属物。这一含义与先前的文献一致，该文献将 IT 视为公司业务战略的固有组成部分（Bharadwaj 等，2013）。它还符合数字化转型的当代现实（Yoo et al. 2012）。通过将研究扩展到帮助企业建立卓越 IT 能力的因素之外，当前的调查激发了对企业如何获得高水平数字化问题的进一步研究。展望未来，需要进行更多研究，以更好地了解可能影响公司将数字化成功转化为无形价值和可持续竞争优势的能力的公司层面和环境因素。


Second, we bring a novel approach to a central and persistent research question concerning the role of digital resources and capabilities in generating firm value in a hypercompetitive environment (Lee et al. 2010; Rai and Tang 2013; Tanriverdi et al. 2010). Our study achieves this by introducing a novel network-based construct, which considers a competitive landscape in defining firms’ success in digitizing their products and services. Because the economy has moved into an age of distributed digital innovation, we believe that the IS literature will benefit from a network-based construct such as that presented in this work, which can help to define firms’ success in digitizing their products and services in relation to the dynamic underlying complementarity networks upon which firms operate. Digital proximity entails the enhancement or deterioration of a firm’s competitive position, even when this movement is caused by the activities of other firms. As a network-based construct, digital proximity considers the macropatterns of change in the overall economic landscape in the movement of firms toward digitization. This approach in analyzing digital innovation empowers researchers to explore digital innovations as generative and interconnected, rather than isolated (Yoo et al. 2012; Yoo et al. 2010).




其次，我们对一个核心且持久的研究问题提出了一种新颖的方法，该问题涉及数字资源和能力在超级竞争环境中创造企业价值的作用（Lee 等人，2010 年；Rai 和 Tang，2013 年；Tanriverdi 等人，2010 年）。我们的研究通过引入一种新颖的基于网络的结构来实现这一目标，该结构考虑了定义企业在产品和服务数字化方面是否成功的竞争格局。由于经济已经进入分布式数字创新时代，我们相信信息系统文献将受益于基于网络的构造，例如本文中提出的构造，这可以帮助定义企业在将其产品和服务数字化与企业运营所依赖的动态基础互补网络相关方面的成功。数字邻近性会导致公司竞争地位的增强或恶化，即使这种变化是由其他公司的活动引起的。作为一种基于网络的构造，数字邻近性考虑了企业数字化运动中整体经济格局变化的宏观模式。这种分析数字创新的方法使研究人员能够探索生成的、相互关联的数字创新，而不是孤立的（Yoo 等人，2012 年；Yoo 等人，2010 年）。


Our novel approach in measuring digitization contributes substantively to the business value of IT literature. First, we measure digital proximity as an outcome-based measure that captures digitization. That is, our measure entails a wide range of factors, such as IT investments and patenting activities, and focuses on how firms translate these factors successfully into digital products and services. In this way, digital proximity reveals another IT capability, one that is not captured by traditional measures. Second, the network-based measure of digital proximity includes firms’ positioning in a competitive landscape when assessing their levels of digitization. Traditional measures of digitization, however, focus only on single firms’ IT investments; in other words, these measures treat firms as isolated entities. Using our measure, a firm’s positioning can improve if other firms in its industry create new complementarities between industry resources and digital resources. Such interfirm effects are not captured in traditional IT investment measures. Third, our measurement procedure overcomes a persistent limitation in research on the business value of IT, which stems from the field’s reliance on survey data and the unavailability of many firms’ IT investment data. Our approach in measuring digitization allows us to base our findings on 20,215 observations from 3,625 unique firms over a time period of almost three decades.




我们测量数字化的新颖方法对 IT 文献的商业价值做出了实质性贡献。首先，我们将数字接近度作为衡量数字化的基于结果的衡量标准。也就是说，我们的衡量标准涵盖了广泛的因素，例如 IT 投资和专利活动，并重点关注企业如何将这些因素成功转化为数字产品和服务。通过这种方式，数字邻近性揭示了另一种 IT 能力，这是传统措施无法捕捉到的。其次，基于网络的数字邻近度衡量标准包括企业在评估其数字化水平时在竞争格局中的定位。然而，传统的数字化衡量标准仅关注单个公司的 IT 投资；换句话说，这些措施将企业视为孤立的实体。根据我们的衡量标准，如果行业中的其他公司在行业资源和数字资源之间创造新的互补性，那么公司的定位就可以得到改善。传统的 IT 投资措施并未体现这种公司间效应。第三，我们的衡量程序克服了 IT 商业价值研究中长期存在的局限性，该局限性源于该领域对调查数据的依赖以及许多公司 IT 投资数据的不可用。我们衡量数字化的方法使我们的研究结果基于 3,625 家独特公司在近三十年时间里的 20,215 项观察。


## Managerial Implications




## 管理影响


Our findings also have important practical implications. First, our results highlight the importance of considering a wider competitive landscape in today’s digital economy. We show how the activities of firms in other industries might create or undermine firms’ paths to digitization. Therefore, in addition to their immediate competitors and partners, firms need strategic insight into other industries that might emerge to create connecting paths to digital industries over time. We also develop the industry space, which maps firms’ competitive environment. Managers could use this network to analyze the relative digital positioning of their firm against competitors and identify potential areas from which new competition may arise. In turn, this work could guide managers when choosing among paths of different complementary technologies.




我们的研究结果也具有重要的实际意义。首先，我们的结果强调了在当今数字经济中考虑更广泛的竞争格局的重要性。我们展示了其他行业企业的活动如何创造或破坏企业的数字化之路。因此，除了直接竞争对手和合作伙伴之外，企业还需要对可能出现的其他行业进行战略洞察，以随着时间的推移创建与数字行业的连接路径。我们还开发行业空间，描绘企业的竞争环境。管理者可以利用这个网络来分析公司相对于竞争对手的相对数字定位，并确定可能出现新竞争的潜在领域。反过来，这项工作可以指导管理者在不同的互补技术路径中进行选择。


Second, our results introduce a novel practical approach for measuring digitization within a wider economic landscape. In this way, our results respond to the call by economics researchers regarding the need for new measures that capture digitization at a macroeconomic level (Greenstein et al. 2013). Our firm-level and industry-level measures of digital proximity equip policy makers with a new tool to measure overall movement toward digitization. For example, an overall average industry-level digital proximity score can measure the digitization of an economy in the same way that the GDP captures its production.




其次，我们的结果介绍了一种在更广泛的经济格局中衡量数字化的新颖实用方法。通过这种方式，我们的结果响应了经济学研究人员的呼吁，即需要采取新措施来捕捉宏观经济层面的数字化（Greenstein et al. 2013）。我们的公司级和行业级数字邻近度衡量标准为政策制定者提供了衡量数字化总体进展的新工具。例如，总体平均行业级数字接近度分数可以衡量经济体的数字化程度，就像 GDP 反映其生产一样。

## About the Authors




## 关于作者


Pouya Rahmati is an assistant professor of management information systems at the Terry College of Business, University of Georgia. His research, which focuses on co-developing digital products in complex economic and organizational environments, employs empirical analyses to identify and quantify the drivers of firms’ success in developing digital products and services. He has presented his works in many prestigious conferences in the field of management information systems. He completed his PhD at the University of Illinois at Chicago and, prior to entering academia, he worked as a software engineer, product manager, and IT-business analyst.




Pouya Rahmati 是佐治亚大学特里商学院管理信息系统助理教授。他的研究重点是在复杂的经济和组织环境中共同开发数字产品，采用实证分析来识别和量化企业成功开发数字产品和服务的驱动因素。他在管理信息系统领域的许多著名会议上展示了他的作品。他在伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校获得博士学位，在进入学术界之前，他曾担任软件工程师、产品经理和 IT 业务分析师。


Ali Tafti is an associate professor of information & decision sciences in the College of Business Administration at the University of Illinois at Chicago. His research interests include economic and strategic impacts of information technology investment, social and collaborative networks, and causal inference methods. Dr. Tafti enjoys teaching graduate-level courses on econometrics, causal inference, and social network analysis. His work has appeared in journals such as Management Science, MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, MIT Sloan Management Review, and PLoS One. He previously served on the faculty at the University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign. He completed his PhD at the University of Michigan, and he previously worked as a software engineer and analyst in the digital business consulting and financial industries.




阿里·塔夫蒂 (Ali Tafti) 是伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校工商管理学院信息与决策科学副教授。他的研究兴趣包括信息技术投资、社会和协作网络以及因果推理方法的经济和战略影响。塔夫蒂博士喜欢教授计量经济学、因果推理和社交网络分析方面的研究生课程。他的研究成果发表在《管理科学》、《管理信息系统季刊》、《信息系统研究》、《麻省理工斯隆管理评论》和《PLoS One》等期刊上。他曾在伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校任教。他在密歇根大学完成了博士学位，此前曾在数字业务咨询和金融行业担任软件工程师和分析师。


J. Christopher Westland is a professor in the Department of Information & Decision Sciences at the University of Illinois. He holds a BA in statistics and an MBA in accounting and received his PhD in computers and information systems from the University of Michigan. His most recent book, Audit Analytics, provides a road map and software for the application of statistical and machine learning in the automation of public accounting. He is the author of numerous academic papers and books, including Financial Dynamics (Wiley 2003), Valuing Technology (Wiley 2002), Global Electronic Commerce (MIT Press 2000), Global Innovation Management (Palgrave Macmillan 2008, Springer 2017), Red Wired: China’s Internet Revolution (Marshall Cavendish, 2010); Structural Equation Modeling (Springer 2015, 2nd edition 2019) and Audit Analytics (Springer 2020). He has served on the editorial boards of numerous scholarly journals and is the current editor-in- chief of the premier Electronic Commerce Research journal. He has served on the faculties of the University of Michigan, University of Southern California, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Tsinghua University, Nanyang Technological University, and other academic institutions. He has been designated by China as a Highlevel Foreign Expert under the 1000-Talents Plan. He has advised on valuation and technology strategy for Microsoft, Intel, Motorola, V-Tech, Aerospace Corporation, IBM, Pacific Bell, and other technology firms.




J. Christopher Westland 是伊利诺伊大学信息与决策科学系教授。他拥有统计学学士学位和会计学 MBA 学位，并在密歇根大学获得计算机和信息系统博士学位。他的最新著作《审计分析》为统计和机器学习在公共会计自动化中的应用提供了路线图和软件。他是众多学术论文和书籍的作者，包括《金融动力学》（Wiley 2003）、《价值技术》（Wiley 2002）、《全球电子商务》（MIT Press 2000）、《全球创新管理》（Palgrave Macmillan 2008，Springer 2017）、《Red Wired：中国的互联网革命》（Marshall Cavendish，2010）；结构方程模型（Springer 2015，2019 年第 2 版）和审计分析（Springer 2020）。他曾在众多学术期刊的编委会任职，并且是顶级电子商务研究期刊的现任主编。曾任教于密歇根大学、南加州大学、香港科技大学、清华大学、南洋理工大学等学术机构。入选国家“千人计划”外国高层次专家。他曾为微软、英特尔、摩托罗拉、V-Tech、航空航天公司、IBM、太平洋贝尔和其他科技公司提供估值和技术战略咨询。


César A. Hidalgo is a Chilean-Spanish-American scholar known for his contributions in economic complexity, data visualization, and artificial intelligence. He holds a PhD in physics from the University of Notre Dame and a bachelor’s degree in physics from Universidad Católica de Chile. Dr. Hidalgo currently holds a chair at the Artificial and Natural Intelligence Toulouse Institute (ANITI), where he leads the Collective Learning group. He is also an honorary professor at the University of Manchester and a visiting professor at Harvard’s School of Engineering and Applied Sciences. Hidalgo is the former head of MIT’s Collective Learning group. He was part of MIT’s faculty from 2010-2019 (first assistant and then associate professor). Prior to joining MIT, Hidalgo was a research fellow at Harvard. Hidalgo is also a founder of Datawheel, an award-winning company specializing in the creation of data distribution and visualization systems.




César A. Hidalgo 是一位智利裔西班牙裔美国学者，以其在经济复杂性、数据可视化和人工智能方面的贡献而闻名。他拥有圣母大学物理学博士学位和智利天主教大学物理学学士学位。 Hidalgo 博士目前担任图卢兹人工智能与自然智能研究所 (ANITI) 的主席，领导集体学习小组。他还是曼彻斯特大学的名誉教授和哈佛大学工程与应用科学学院的客座教授。伊达尔戈是麻省理工学院集体学习小组的前负责人。 2010 年至 2019 年，他担任麻省理工学院教员（第一助理，然后是副教授）。在加入麻省理工学院之前，伊达尔戈是哈佛大学的研究员。 Hidalgo 也是 Datawheel 的创始人，该公司是一家屡获殊荣的公司，专门从事数据分发和可视化系统的创建。

## Background of the Empirical Method




## 经验方法的背景


We build our measurement of the digital proximity construct on some key insights in Porter (2008) regarding the importance of a firm’s positioning in its environment for a competitive advantage, and in Porter and Siggelkow (2008) regarding the dynamic and complex nature of this environment. We conceptualize the industry space environment and extend Porter’s model to an environment made complex by a rich network of contextual complementary interactions. This allows our measurement to address how firms identify and occupy profitable positions when patterns of digitization are constantly changing both the competitive landscape and the pay-offs associated with creating different sets of complementarities (Lee et al. 2010; Tanriverdi et al. 2010).




我们根据 Porter (2008) 中关于企业在其环境中的定位对于竞争优势的重要性以及 Porter 和 Siggelkow (2008) 中关于该环境的动态和复杂性质的一些关键见解来构建数字邻近度结构的测量。我们概念化了行业空间环境，并将波特模型扩展到因丰富的上下文互补交互网络而变得复杂的环境。这使得我们能够衡量当数字化模式不断改变竞争格局以及与创造不同互补性组合相关的回报时，企业如何识别和占据有利可图的位置（Lee et al. 2010；Tanriverdi et al. 2010）。


We develop the competitive landscape based on the theory of economic complements (Milgrom and Roberts 1990). Based on this theory, firms are rational actors that only diversify into a limited set of industries, which allows them to enhance the value they generate from their existing resource and capability structures. Therefore, if a firm has diversified into a certain set of different industries, it can be inferred that the resources and capabilities required for operating in those industries are economic complements. Accordingly, a firm reporting sales in two industries can signal potential complementarities between those two industries, and if many firms do the same, this can be considered a sign of established complementarities between industries.




我们根据经济互补理论开发竞争格局（Milgrom 和 Roberts 1990）。根据这一理论，企业是理性的参与者，只会多元化进入有限的行业，这使得它们能够提高从现有资源和能力结构中产生的价值。因此，如果一家企业多元化进入了某些不同的行业，则可以推断，在这些行业中经营所需的资源和能力是经济互补的。因此，一家公司报告两个行业的销售额可以表明这两个行业之间潜在的互补性，如果许多公司也这样做，这可以被视为行业之间已建立互补性的标志。


The industry space is based on a methodology widely used when analyzing the economic complexity of nations. Hidalgo et al. (2007) use countries’ exports to develop a product space network over which they measure the complexity of different products based on their positioning in the network. To remove marginal exports from their analysis, they consider only the exports in which the exporting country has a revealed comparative advantage (RCA). The RCA is measured using the ratio of the share of the export of a given product from a given country’s exports over the share of the export of that product from the global economy. Only exports with an RCA greater than one are considered in their analysis.




行业空间基于分析国家经济复杂性时广泛使用的方法。伊达尔戈等人。 （2007）利用各国的出口来开发一个产品空间网络，在该网络上，他们根据不同产品在网络中的定位来衡量不同产品的复杂性。为了从分析中剔除边际出口，他们仅考虑出口国具有显性比较优势（RCA）的出口。 RCA 使用特定国家出口中特定产品的出口份额与该产品在全球经济中的出口份额的比率来衡量。分析中仅考虑 RCA 大于 1 的出口。


Based on RCA measures, Hidalgo et al. (2007) form a product space network in which proximity between two products i and j is defined a “the minimum of the pairwise conditional probabilities of a country exporting a good given that it exports another” (p. 484). They define $\phi _ { i , j }$ as the proximity between products i and j and measure it as:




基于 RCA 措施，Hidalgo 等人。 （2007）形成一个产品空间网络，其中两种产品 i 和 j 之间的接近度被定义为“一个国家出口一种商品的成对条件概率的最小值，考虑到它出口另一种商品”（第 484 页）。他们将 $\phi _ { i , j }$ 定义为产品 i 和 j 之间的接近度，并将其测量为：


$$
\phi_ {i, j} = \min [ P (R C A _ {i} | R C A _ {j}), P (R C A _ {j} | R C A _ {i}) ] \quad \text {Eq. (A1)}
$$




$$
\phi_ {i, j} = \min [ P (R C A _ {i} | R C A _ {j}), P (R C A _ {j} | R C A _ {i}) ] \quad \text {Eq. (A1)}
$$


where RCAi represents the event in which a country exports more of product $i ,$ as a share of its total exports, than all countries export on average as a share of their total exports. Hidalgo et al. (2007) develop the economic complexity measure in relation to the proximity of countries’ exports to the core of the product space network—the core being where more sophisticated products are located. Further, they use the product space network to analyze the evolution of countries’ productive structures. They do not develop periodical time-varying product spaces; rather, they use only one product space for their analysis. They look at the set of products for which countries have an RCA and how their export structures evolve into the products that are in close proximity to those products. Their analysis shows that the structure of the product space limits many countries’ ability to approach the core, and that the exports of more developed economies are located around the core of this network.




其中 RCAi 表示一个国家出口的产品 $i ,$ 占其总出口的比例高于所有国家平均出口占其总出口的比例的事件。伊达尔戈等人。 （2007）制定了与国家出口与产品空间网络核心的接近程度相关的经济复杂性衡量标准——核心是更复杂的产品所在的地方。此外，他们利用产品空间网络来分析国家生产结构的演变。他们不开发周期性随时间变化的产品空间；相反，他们仅使用一个产品空间进行分析。他们着眼于各国拥有 RCA 的一系列产品，以及它们的出口结构如何演变为与这些产品非常接近的产品。他们的分析表明，产品空间的结构限制了许多国家接近核心的能力，而较发达经济体的出口位于该网络的核心周围。


## Industry Space




## 产业空间


We develop the industry space using all groups of 6-digit NAICS industry classifications reported in the Compustat Segments database. We use industry classifications because this level of detail represents the products and services firms offer. In this network, each industry is a node, and the weight of the link between two industries i and $j , \phi _ { i , j } ,$ is the maximum of two conditional probabilities: P(xi|xj), the probability that a firm reports sales in industry i given that it reports sales in industry $j ,$ measured as ratio ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } / n _ { j }$ representing the number of firms reporting sales in both industries i and j over the total number of firms with sales in industry ${ j } ;$ and $\mathrm { P } ( x _ { j } | x _ { i } )$ , measured as ratio ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } / _ { n _ { i } } .$




我们使用 Compustat 细分数据库中报告的所有 6 位 NAICS 行业分类组来开发行业空间。我们使用行业分类，因为这种详细程度代表了公司提供的产品和服务。在这个网络中，每个行业都是一个节点，两个行业 i 和 $j 之间的链接权重，\phi _ { i , j } ,$ 是两个条件概率中的最大值：P(xi|xj)，即一家公司报告行业 i 的销售额，假设它报告行业 $j ,$ 的销售额，以比率 ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } } / n _ { j }$ 衡量，表示报告的公司数量行业 i 和 j 的销售额占行业销售额 ${ j } ;$ 和 $\mathrm { P } ( x _ { j } | x _ { i } )$ 的比率，以比率 ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } / _ { n _ { i } } .$ 衡量


$$
\phi_ {i, j} = \max \{\mathrm{P} (x _ {i} | x _ {j}), \mathrm{P} (x _ {j} | x _ {i}) \}
$$




$$
\phi_ {i, j} = \max \{\mathrm{P} (x _ {i} | x _ {j}), \mathrm{P} (x _ {j} | x _ {i}) \}
$$


Eq. (A2)




等式。 (A2)


The industry space network data file is available online at: https://github.com/prahmati86/industry-space. To capture the dynamics of the industry space, we develop different versions of the industry space for different time periods. To facilitate analysis, we develop yearly industry space networks using the sales reported in each year. To create visualizations, we develop periodic industry space networks for five five-year periods (i.e., periods one to five) between 1990 and 2014.




行业空间网络数据文件可在线获取：https://github.com/prahmati86/industry-space。为了捕捉行业空间的动态，我们针对不同时间段开发了不同版本的行业空间。为了便于分析，我们使用每年报告的销售额开发年度行业空间网络。为了创建可视化，我们开发了 1990 年至 2014 年间五个五年期（即第一至第五期）的周期性行业空间网络。


The industry space is a sparse network that actually became sparser until 2010 (see Figure A1b), as evident in the increasing ratio of nodes to edges. In period five (2010-2014), there are 7,142 links between 802 industries. Meanwhile, the weight of the links between industries has been growing, as well (see Figure A1a). The percentage of links with a weight higher than 0.2 has increased from around 10% in period one to around 20% in period five. In the industry space for period five, around 25% of the nodes have a weight lower than 0.022, 50% have a weight lower than 0.060, and around 75% have a weight lower than 0.166.




行业空间是一个稀疏网络，直到 2010 年实际上变得更加稀疏（见图 A1b），节点与边缘的比率不断增加就很明显。第五期（2010-2014年），802个行业之间有7,142个联系。与此同时，行业之间的联系权重也在不断增加（见图A1a）。权重高于 0.2 的链接百分比从第一期的 10% 左右增加到第五期的 20% 左右。在第五期的行业空间中，大约 25% 的节点权重低于 0.022，50% 的节点权重低于 0.060，大约 75% 的节点权重低于 0.166。


The industry space in Figure 1 is developed with undirected links and weights that are based on the number of firms reporting sales. To examine the robustness of this procedure for weighting network links, we develop five alternative weighting schemes for network links. First, we construct an alternative industry space in which links are weighted by the proportional amount of sales in respective industries (rather than number of firms reporting sales); i.e. for eq. A2 above, the ratio $s a l e s _ { i \cap j } \bigg / _ { s a l e s _ { j } }$ is used in place of ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } / n _ { j }$ . Next, for both the original and alternative industry spaces, we construct versions based on directed links. The directed version of the weighting scheme yields two distinct link weights for each pair of industries. Thus, for the original and alternative industry spaces, we have four alternative directed digital proximity measures in addition to two undirected digital proximity measures.




图 1 中的行业空间是通过无向链接和基于报告销售额的公司数量的权重开发的。为了检查该网络链接加权过程的稳健性，我们开发了五种网络链接替代加权方案。首先，我们构建了一个替代行业空间，其中链接按各个行业的销售额比例（而不是报告销售额的公司数量）进行加权；即对于 eq.上面的 A2 中，比率 $s a l e s _ { i \cap j } \bigg / _ { sa l e s _ { j } }$ 用于代替 ${ } ^ { n _ { i \cap j } } / n _ { j }$ 。接下来，对于原始行业空间和替代行业空间，我们基于定向链接构建版本。加权方案的定向版本为每对行业产生两个不同的链接权重。因此，对于原始和替代行业空间，除了两个无向数字邻近度度量之外，我们还有四个替代定向数字邻近度度量。


## Digital Proximity




## 数字邻近


We first measure the digital proximity index in each industry by calculating the shortest-path network distance from each industry to softwareproducing industries. For a definition of digital (i.e. IT-producing) industries, see Table A1. To calculate shortest paths using calculated proximities in the industry space, we transform the proximities (edge weights) to log $( \frac { 1 } { \Phi _ { \mathrm { i , j } } } )$ ) to assign a lower cost to paths with higher proximity in the industry space; then, we use Dijkstra’s algorithm to compute the shortest paths between nodes. We then compute the maximum shortest path length to IT industries. The digital proximity (i.e., digital composition, abbreviated as DC) of industry i is:




我们首先通过计算每个行业到软件生产行业的最短路径网络距离来衡量每个行业的数字邻近指数。有关数字（即 IT 生产）产业的定义，请参阅表 A1。为了使用行业空间中计算出的邻近度来计算最短路径，我们将邻近度（边权重）转换为 log $( \frac { 1 } { \Phi _ { \mathrm { i , j } } } )$ )，以将较低的成本分配给行业空间中具有较高邻近度的路径；然后，我们使用 Dijkstra 算法来计算节点之间的最短路径。然后我们计算到达 IT 行业的最大最短路径长度。行业i的数字接近度（即数字构成，缩写为DC）为：


$$
\mathrm{DC} _ {\mathrm{i}} = \frac {1}{1 + (\text { maximum   shortest   path   to   IT   industries })} \quad \text { Eq.   (A3) }
$$




$$
\mathrm{DC} _ {\mathrm{i}} = \frac {1}{1 + (\text { 通往 IT 行业的最大最短路径})} \quad \text { 等式：   (A3) }
$$


We also consider the three alternative industry space constructions: the alternative undirected industry space and the two alternative directed versions of industry space—each of which yield two distinct directed shortest path lengths for each pair of industries.




我们还考虑了三种替代产业空间结构：替代无向产业空间和产业空间的两个替代有向版本——每个版本为每对产业产生两个不同的有向最短路径长度。


Using the industry-level measure of digital proximity, we then extend this measure to the firm level (???? ) by calculating the average digital proximity (i.e., digital composition) of the n industries that a firm operates in, weighted by the number of sales that the firm reports in each of those industries $( S a l e s _ { k } )$ .




使用行业层面的数字邻近度衡量标准，然后我们通过计算公司所在的 n 个行业的平均数字邻近度（即数字构成），将该衡量标准扩展到公司层面 (????)，并按公司在每个行业中报告的销售额 $( S a l e s _ { k } )$ 进行加权。


$$
d c _ {i} = \frac {\sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} D C _ {k} S a l e s _ {k}}{n}\tag{Eq. (A4}
$$




$$
d c _ {i} = \frac {\sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} D C _ {k} 销售 _ {k}}{n}\tag{Eq. (A4}
$$


Using the digital proximity index allows a comprehensive look at firms' digitization processes, as well as their general diversification. Figure A2 shows how firms that report the same industry as their primary industry might choose different paths in the industry space. Firms in both manufacturing and credit intermediation industries show a diversification trend toward the bottom right of the industry space, where IT industries are located. Firms that drive this shift create direct complementarities with IT industries and have higher digital proximity indices.




使用数字邻近指数可以全面了解公司的数字化流程及其总体多元化程度。图 A2 显示了将同一行业报告为主要行业的公司如何在行业空间中选择不同的路径。制造业和信用中介行业的企业都呈现出向行业空间右下角（IT行业所在）的多元化趋势。推动这一转变的公司与 IT 行业建立了直接的互补性，并拥有更高的数字邻近指数。


## Propensity Score Matching with Alternative Covariates




## 与替代协变量的倾向得分匹配


In order to ensure the robustness of our results to the covariates selected, we repeat the propensity score matching procedure for an alternative set of covariates. These covariates include the sales efficiency, R&D intensity, intangible assets, and net margin associated with firms’ levels of digitization, all of which are available in the Compustat dataset (Chang and Gurbaxani 2012; Im et al. 2001; Kleis et al. 2012); we also use the industry-level average of digital proximity. Taking advantage of the panel nature of our data, we construct our covariates as average values between the years 2013 and 2015, construct our treatment variable at year 2015, and construct our outcome variable at year 2016. We report the result of the logit regression model in Table A2. Table A3 reports the results of our propensity score matching analysis using th nearest neighbor matching technique, with a caliper of 0.01 in Column (1) and 0.001 in Column (2). Both results are consistent with the results generated when using the covariates developed based on strategic alliances, mergers, and acquisitions. We report the relevant mean and median biases and critical gamma values in Table A3 and the descriptive statistics for our covariates before and after matching in Table A4, further establishing the robustness of the alternative propensity score matching results.




为了确保我们的结果对所选协变量的稳健性，我们对另一组协变量重复倾向得分匹配过程。这些协变量包括销售效率、研发强度、无形资产以及与企业数字化水平相关的净利润，所有这些都可以在 Compustat 数据集中找到（Chang 和 Gurbaxani 2012；Im 等人 2001；Kleis 等人 2012）；我们还使用数字邻近度的行业水平平均值。利用我们数据的面板性质，我们将协变量构建为 2013 年至 2015 年之间的平均值，构建 2015 年的治疗变量，并构建 2016 年的结果变量。我们在表 A2 中报告了 Logit 回归模型的结果。表 A3 报告了我们使用最近邻匹配技术进行倾向得分匹配分析的结果，第 (1) 列的卡尺为 0.01，第 (2) 列的卡尺为 0.001。这两个结果与使用基于战略联盟、合并和收购开发的协变量时生成的结果一致。我们在表 A3 中报告了相关的平均值和中位数偏差以及临界伽玛值，并在表 A4 中报告了匹配前后协变量的描述性统计，进一步建立了替代倾向得分匹配结果的稳健性。

## Appendix B




## 附录 B


## Digital Proximity, Similarity to Digital Knowledge, Knowledge Complexity, and Digital Innovations




## 数字邻近性、数字知识的相似性、知识复杂性和数字创新


We assess the face validity of the digital proximity measure by comparing it to three measures of (1) similarity to digital knowledge, (2) knowledge complexity, and (3) digital innovations. First, we use the knowledge similarity measure developed by Farjoun (1994; 1998) (Figure B2a). Following this work, we use Occupational Employment Survey data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) and measure the similarity of the knowledge structure between every 4-digit NAICS code and digital industries by calculating the Euclidian distances between them. We find that the knowledge similarity indices are highly correlated with industry-level digital proximity indices, suggesting the digital proximity measure captures the similarity between industry-level knowledge structures.




我们通过将数字邻近性度量与以下三个度量进行比较来评估其表面有效性：（1）与数字知识的相似性，（2）知识复杂性和（3）数字创新。首先，我们使用 Farjoun (1994; 1998) 开发的知识相似性度量（图 B2a）。在这项工作之后，我们使用美国劳工统计局 (BLS) 的职业就业调查数据，通过计算每个 4 位 NAICS 代码与数字行业之间的欧几里得距离来衡量它们之间知识结构的相似性。我们发现知识相似性指数与行业级数字邻近指数高度相关，这表明数字邻近性度量捕获了行业级知识结构之间的相似性。


Second, we use the BLS dataset to form a directed bipartite network in which each industry code has directed edges pointing to the set of occupations that it reports. In order to construct the measure of knowledge complexity, we use the BLS Occupational Employment Statistics and develop a bipartite network in which nodes represent both the industries and the occupation classifications. In this directed network, there is a link between an industry and an occupation if the occupation is utilized by that industry. We measure link weights as the product of the percentage of the employees working in that occupation in that industry and their median wages in that industry. This helps normalize the effect of less knowledge-intensive occupations (typically earning lower than the median) that form large proportions of an industry’s workforce, as well as more knowledge-intensive occupations (typically earning higher than the median) that form small proportions of an industry’s workforce.




其次，我们使用 BLS 数据集形成一个有向二分网络，其中每个行业代码都有指向其报告的职业集的有向边。为了构建知识复杂性的衡量标准，我们使用 BLS 职业就业统计数据并开发一个二分网络，其中节点代表行业和职业分类。在这个有向网络中，如果某个职业被某个行业利用，那么该行业和该职业之间就存在联系。我们将链接权重衡量为该行业中从事该职业的员工百分比与其在该行业中工资中位数的乘积。这有助于使占行业劳动力较大比例的知识密集程度较低的职业（通常收入低于中位数）以及占行业劳动力比例较小的知识密集型职业（通常收入高于中位数）的影响正常化。


We use the Hyperlink-induced Topic Search (HITS) algorithm in order to assign a hub score to each industry (Kleinberg 1999). This algorithm was originally aimed at assessing the importance of the information that different web pages point to, based on the iterative assessment of the importance of other web pages pointing to the same information. This algorithm assigns two scores of hub and authority to each node in a directed network. The authority scores, representing the significance of the information, are set to be the sum of the hub scores of the nodes that point to them. The hub scores are set to the sum of the authority scores of the nodes that they point to. Therefore, a node that has a high hub score points to a set of nodes with high authorities, and a node that has a high authority score is pointed to by nodes considered information hubs. The algorithm starts by assigning an initial value of 1 for both hub and authority scores for all nodes, updates hub and authority scores iteratively, and normalizes the values by dividing each score by the square root of the sum of the squares of that same score after each iteration.




我们使用超链接引发的主题搜索（HITS）算法来为每个行业分配中心分数（Kleinberg 1999）。该算法最初旨在评估不同网页指向的信息的重要性，基于对其他网页指向相同信息的重要性的迭代评估。该算法为有向网络中的每个节点分配两个分数的集线器和权限。代表信息重要性的权威分数被设置为指向它们的节点的中心分数之和。中心分数设置为它们指向的节点的权威分数之和。因此，具有高枢纽分数的节点指向一组具有高权限的节点，并且具有高权限分数的节点被视为信息枢纽的节点所指向。该算法首先为所有节点的中心分数和权威分数分配初始值 1，迭代更新中心分数和权威分数，并通过在每次迭代后将每个分数除以同一分数平方和的平方根来标准化这些值。


We use this algorithm by considering the authority scores of different occupation groups as a representation of the complexity level associated with them because high authority scores indicate the significant role of those occupation groups in a diverse set of industries. Similarly, we use industry hub scores as a measure of their knowledge structure complexity because high hub scores indicate the use of diverse and complex knowledge structures in an industry. By considering the actual importance and diversity of each occupation group, our approach allows us to go beyond more traditional measures of complexity and diversity, such as count-based measures, and provide a more accurate measure of the knowledge complexity of different industries. Figure B1 compares the two ego networks (of degree two) for the apparel knitting mills industries (left) and computer systems design industries (right). In these networks, the focal industries are indicated by the color red, the occupation groups by the color blue, and other industries by the color green. Industry node size is proportional to their hub scores, and the size of the occupation group nodes is proportional to their authority scores. Comparing the two networks reveals how a more complex industry gains higher hub scores through connections with occupations that have high authority scores, and how a more complex occupation group gains higher authority scores by being connected to a higher number of industries with high hub scores. The visualizations in Figure B1 are developed using hub and authority scores measured based on 2-digit OCC codes; in constructing the original measures, the most granular OCC codes are used.




我们通过将不同职业群体的权威分数视为与其相关的复杂性级别的表示来使用该算法，因为高权威分数表明这些职业群体在不同行业中的重要作用。同样，我们使用行业中心分数作为其知识结构复杂性的衡量标准，因为高中心分数表明行业中使用了多样化且复杂的知识结构。通过考虑每个职业群体的实际重要性和多样性，我们的方法使我们能够超越更传统的复杂性和多样性衡量标准（例如基于计数的衡量标准），并提供对不同行业知识复杂性的更准确衡量。图 B1 比较了服装针织厂行业（左）和计算机系统设计行业（右）的两个自我网络（二级）。在这些网络中，重点行业用红色表示，职业群体用蓝色表示，其他行业用绿色表示。行业节点规模与其枢纽得分成正比，职业群体节点规模与其权威得分成正比。比较这两个网络揭示了更复杂的行业如何通过与具有高权威分数的职业的连接来获得更高的中心分数，以及更复杂的职业群体如何通过与更多数量的具有高中心分数的行业连接来获得更高的权威分数。图 B1 中的可视化是使用基于 2 位 OCC 代码测量的中心和权威分数开发的；在构建原始测量时，使用最细粒度的 OCC 代码。


Substantively, our knowledge complexity measure is similar to the diversity measure developed by Hidalgo and Hausmann (2009). The latter captures the diversity of countries’ exports by looking at the set of products that they produce, and the other countries that produce those products, and so on. The HITS algorithm that produces our hub score-based measure of knowledge complexity has a similarly recursive structure, which is advantageous because it captures the flow of knowledge through indirect connections across the entire network. The knowledge complexity measure is highly correlated with the digital proximity index, confirming the complex nature of digital know-how (Figure B2b).




实质上，我们的知识复杂性度量类似于 Hidalgo 和 Hausmann (2009) 开发的多样性度量。后者通过观察各国生产的一系列产品以及生产这些产品的其他国家等来捕捉各国出口的多样性。生成基于中心分数的知识复杂性度量的 HITS 算法具有类似的递归结构，这是有利的，因为它通过整个网络的间接连接捕获知识流。知识复杂性度量与数字邻近指数高度相关，证实了数字知识的复杂性（图 B2b）。


Third, we use the patents dataset developed by Kogan et al. (2017) to examine the relationship between the digital proximity measure and innovation and digital innovation more specifically. We use the patents data between years 1990 and 2010 and examine the association between digital proximity and firms’ total number of patents, digital patents, and AI-related patents. We consider patent classes between 700 and 726 as digital patents, which include data processing, software, and computer design patents. We consider patent class 706, “digital processing: artificial intelligence,” as AI patents. The results of this analysis, reported in Table B1, show a significant and positive association between digital proximity and firms’ genera innovative output, as well as their digital innovations more specifically.




第三，我们使用 Kogan 等人开发的专利数据集。 （2017）更具体地研究了数字邻近度测量与创新和数字创新之间的关系。我们使用 1990 年至 2010 年的专利数据，研究数字邻近度与企业专利总数、数字专利和人工智能相关专利之间的关联。我们将 700 到 726 之间的专利类别视为数字专利，其中包括数据处理、软件和计算机设计专利。我们将专利类别 706“数字处理：人工智能”视为人工智能专利。表 B1 中报告的分析结果显示，数字邻近度与企业的一般创新产出以及更具体的数字创新之间存在显着且正相关的关系。

## Appendix C




## 附录 C


## Supplementary Robustness Tests




## 补充稳健性测试


We examine the models for potential issues of multicollinearity, unobserved heterogeneity, and reverse causality. First, we address the potential issue of multicollinearities. We start by testing our main models, in Table 5, with and without the control variables and the main independent variable. The coefficient estimates for the digital proximity variable and the control variables remain consistent across different models, providing evidence for no significant multicollinearities in our main models. We further examine our models using alternative digital proximity measures and find similarity between the obtained results. Table C1 compares the results for the main digital proximity measure in Model (1) and the five alternative measures of digital proximity shown in Models (2) to (6). The results show a similar magnitude of effects, with the two directed measures developed based on the shortest paths from IT slightly larger in magnitude and the results based on the number of sales more significant (at p < 0.01 level). Finally, we ran a variance inflation factor (VIF) diagnostic for our main model. These results show a mean VIF of 3.23, which is below a threshold of 10, and all of the VIF values below 10. This undermines potential concerns for multicollinearities.




我们检查模型是否存在多重共线性、未观察到的异质性和反向因果关系等潜在问题。首先，我们解决多重共线性的潜在问题。我们首先测试我们的主要模型，如表 5 所示，包含和不包含控制变量和主要自变量。数字邻近变量和控制变量的系数估计在不同模型中保持一致，这为我们的主要模型中不存在显着的多重共线性提供了证据。我们使用替代的数字邻近度度量进一步检查我们的模型，并发现所获得的结果之间的相似性。表 C1 比较了模型 (1) 中主要数字邻近度测量的结果和模型 (2) 至 (6) 中所示的五种数字邻近度替代测量值。结果显示了类似的影响程度，根据 IT 的最短路径制定的两种定向措施的影响程度稍大，而基于销售数量的结果更显着（p < 0.01 水平）。最后，我们对主模型进行了方差膨胀因子 (VIF) 诊断。这些结果显示平均 VIF 为 3.23，低于阈值 10，并且所有 VIF 值均低于 10。这消除了对多重共线性的潜在担忧。


Second, we explore the potential issue of unobserved heterogeneities. We provide additional tests—in addition to the instrumental variable technique, propensity score matching, shuffling techniques, and testing the models in different sub-samples based on firms’ levels of diversification, as discussed earlier—to further investigate this issue. We start our investigation by comparing the OLS and fixed effects results in order to address potential concerns regarding unobserved variables. Many unobserved factors such as firms’ innovative culture or managerial practices that might affect both intangible value and digital proximity are relatively stable factors with little change over time. While these firm-specific factors are controlled by the use of firm-fixed effect models, comparing the results obtained from these models with those from OLS models could reveal the sensitivity of the identified relationship to these factors. Table 5 compares the OLS and fixed effects results and shows that the magnitude and significance of the effect of digital proximity on Tobin’s q are similar, albeit somewhat higher in the OLS models. The similarities between OLS and the fixed effects model results suggest that unobserved firm-specific factors do not have a significant confounding influence on the effects of digital proximity on intangible value. We also compare other alternative model specifications with our fixed effects results. Although the significant Hausman test statistic suggests that fixed effects rather than random effects models should be used for the hypothesis tests, the range of estimates generated by these two models can help demonstrate the robustness of our main coefficient estimates. While the fixed effects panel models utilized only the longitudinal variation of measures for each firm over time, random effects models are efficient in the sense that they make use of the full range of between-firm and within-firm variation. Table C2 shows random effects panel model results, as well as the two-panel generalized-estimating equation (GEE) with Huber-White robust standard errors. Here, Model (3) allows for exchangeable within-group correlations, and Model (4) allows for autoregressive within-group correlation structures. Coefficient estimates of Models (2), (3), and (4) in Table C2 are broadly similar to the consistent fixed effects estimator in Model (1) in support of the hypothesis, despite the different underlying econometric assumptions distinguishing the models.




其次，我们探讨了未观察到的异质性的潜在问题。正如前面所讨论的，除了工具变量技术、倾向得分匹配、洗牌技术以及根据公司多元化水平在不同子样本中测试模型之外，我们还提供了额外的测试来进一步研究这个问题。我们通过比较 OLS 和固定效应结果来开始调查，以解决有关未观察变量的潜在问题。许多未被观察到的因素，例如可能影响无形价值和数字接近度的公司创新文化或管理实践，都是相对稳定的因素，随着时间的推移几乎不会发生变化。虽然这些公司特定因素是通过使用公司固定效应模型来控制的，但将这些模型获得的结果与 OLS 模型获得的结果进行比较可以揭示已识别的关系与这些因素的敏感性。表 5 比较了 OLS 和固定效应结果，表明数字邻近度对托宾 q 的影响的大小和显着性相似，尽管在 OLS 模型中稍高一些。 OLS 和固定效应模型结果之间的相似性表明，未观察到的公司特定因素对于数字邻近性对无形价值的影响不会产生显着的混杂影响。我们还将其他替代模型规格与我们的固定效应结果进行比较。尽管显着的豪斯曼检验统计量表明应该使用固定效应而不是随机效应模型进行假设检验，但这两个模型生成的估计范围可以帮助证明我们主要系数估计的稳健性。虽然固定效应面板模型仅利用了每个公司随时间推移的测量的纵向变化，但随机效应模型是有效的，因为它们利用了公司间和公司内部的全部变化。表 C2 显示了随机效应面板模型结果，以及具有 Huber-White 鲁棒标准误的两面板广义估计方程 (GEE)。这里，模型（3）允许可交换的组内相关性，模型（4）允许自回归组内相关性结构。表 C2 中模型 (2)、(3) 和 (4) 的系数估计与模型 (1) 中支持假设的一致固定效应估计大致相似，尽管区分模型的基础计量经济学假设不同。


Finally, we further test our models for the potential influence of reverse causality, which may be present to the extent that firms’ pre-existing intangible value allows them to enter new markets and increase their digital proximity. Although the instrumental variables and propensity score matching techniques, to some extent, alleviate the reverse causality concerns, we further examine the potential influence of this factor. We start by performing a formal Granger causality Wald test with six lagged values of Tobin’s q and digital proximity. The test concluded that digital proximity does not Granger-cause Tobin’s q (with a chi-square of 9.53 and p-value of 0.146). We further test several models to consider the effects of digital proximity and Tobin’s q on lagged and lead values of each other. Table C3 shows results examining the effect of digital proximity on past, present, and future values of Tobin’s q. The results in this table show different signs and magnitude of the effect for past and future values of Tobin’s q. We find no significant relationship between digital proximity and past values of intangible value; however, the effect of digital proximity on future values of Tobin’s q is largely positive and significant. We further address the reversecausality concern by examining how firms’ intangible value might affect their digital proximity levels. Model (1) in Table C4 presents the results of this analysis, showing no significant effect of present and past values of Tobin’s q on future values of digital proximity. Granger reverse-causality can be demonstrated to be absent when f(xt|xt-1, yt-1) equals f(xt|xt-1) where x is the set of covariates and y is Tobin’s q; specifically, when yt-1 has no significant effect on the independent variable xt when the past values of the covariates (e.g. xt-1) are included (Greene 2003). Table C4 shows no significant effect on digital proximity for up to six lagged values of Tobin’s q, and the results more generally suggest that lagged values of Tobin’s q have no explanatory effect on digital proximity beyond the factors that our models already control for. Models (2) to (7) in this table show the effect of present and previous years of Tobin’s q on present and future values of digita proximity. We find no significant effect of Tobin’s q on digital proximity. The results reported in Table C4 support those reported in Table 5 in mitigating the reverse causality concern.




最后，我们进一步测试我们的模型，以了解反向因果关系的潜在影响，这种影响可能会在企业预先存在的无形价值允许它们进入新市场并增加数字接近度的情况下出现。尽管工具变量和倾向得分匹配技术在一定程度上缓解了反向因果关系的担忧，但我们进一步检验了该因素的潜在影响。我们首先使用托宾 q 和数字邻近度的六个滞后值执行正式的格兰杰因果关系 Wald 检验。测试得出的结论是，数字邻近性不会导致托宾 q 的格兰杰原因（卡方为 9.53，p 值为 0.146）。我们进一步测试了几个模型，以考虑数字邻近度和托宾 q 对彼此滞后值和超前值的影响。表 C3 显示了检验数字邻近度对托宾 q 的过去、现在和未来值影响的结果。此表中的结果显示了托宾 q 的过去和未来值的不同影响迹象和程度。我们发现数字接近度与无形价值的过去价值之间没有显着关系；然而，数字邻近性对托宾 q 的未来值的影响在很大程度上是积极且显着的。我们通过研究企业的无形价值如何影响其数字邻近水平来进一步解决反向因果关系的问题。表 C4 中的模型 (1) 给出了该分析的结果，表明托宾 q 的当前值和过去值对数字邻近度的未来值没有显着影响。当 f(xt|xt-1, yt-1) 等于 f(xt|xt-1) 时，可以证明格兰杰逆因果关系不存在，其中 x 是协变量集，y 是托宾 q；具体来说，当包含协变量（例如 xt-1）的过去值时，yt-1 对自变量 xt 没有显着影响（Greene 2003）。表 C4 显示，托宾 q 的最多六个滞后值对数字接近度没有显着影响，结果更普遍地表明，托宾 q 的滞后值对超出我们模型已控制的因素的数字接近度没有解释性影响。该表中的模型（2）至（7）显示了当前和前几年的托宾 q 对数字邻近度当前和未来值的影响。我们发现托宾 q 对数字邻近度没有显着影响。表 C4 中报告的结果支持表 5 中报告的结果，减轻了反向因果关系的担忧。

# Consumers’ Opinion Orientations and Their Credit Risk: An Econometric Analysis Enhanced by Multimodal Analytics




# 消费者的意见取向及其信用风险：多模态分析增强的计量经济学分析

王其平,<sup>1</sup> 刘耀强,<sup>2</sup> 倪伟霆,<sup>3</sup> Jason Bennett Thatcher,<sup>4</sup> 徐伟<sup>5</sup> <sup>1</sup>华东师范大学信息管理系, qpwang@fem.ecnu.edu.cn <sup>2</sup>香港城市大学信息系统系，raylau@cityu.edu.hk <sup>3</sup>香港理工大学管理与市场学系，香港特别行政区，eric.ngai@polyu.edu.hk <sup>4</sup>美国科罗拉多大学博尔德分校利兹商学院 / 英国曼彻斯特大学联盟曼彻斯特商学院jason.thatcher@colorado.edu <sup>5</sup>中国人民大学信息学院，weixu@ruc.edu.cn


## Abstract




＃＃ 抽象的


The rise of financial technology (fintech) has motivated practitioners and researchers to explore alternative data sources and enhanced credit scoring methods for better assessment of consumers’ credit risk. In this study, we examine whether deep-level diversity derived from consumers’ multimodal social media posts (i.e., alternative data) can enhance credit risk assessment or not. First, we propose novel lifestyle-based risk constructs (e.g., opinion risk) to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. Second, we incorporate these lifestyle-based risk constructs into econometric models to empirically evaluate the relationship between consumers’ deep-level diversity and their credit risk. Using a credit scoring dataset provided by a fintech firm listed on Nasdaq, our econometric analysis reveals that consumers’ opinion risk constructs extracted from their multimodal social media posts are positively associated with their credit risk. Furthermore, our results show that the proposed opinion risk constructs can significantly improve the effectiveness of predicting consumers’ credit risk. Interestingly, our empirical results also show that combining the opinion risk constructs derived from images and text can significantly improve the effectiveness in credit risk prediction. This work contributes to the fintech domain by proposing novel lifestyle-based risk constructs for decision support in the credit scoring context.




金融科技（fintech）的兴起促使从业者和研究人员探索替代数据源和增强的信用评分方法，以更好地评估消费者的信用风险。在本研究中，我们研究了来自消费者多模式社交媒体帖子（即另类数据）的深层多样性是否可以增强信用风险评估。首先，我们提出了基于生活方式的新型风险结构（例如意见风险），以捕捉消费者的深层多样性。其次，我们将这些基于生活方式的风险结构纳入计量经济学模型，以实证评估消费者的深层多样性与其信用风险之间的关系。使用纳斯达克上市金融科技公司提供的信用评分数据集，我们的计量经济学分析表明，从多模式社交媒体帖子中提取的消费者意见风险结构与其信用风险呈正相关。此外，我们的结果表明，所提出的意见风险结构可以显着提高预测消费者信用风险的有效性。有趣的是，我们的实证结果还表明，结合图像和文本得出的意见风险构造可以显着提高信用风险预测的有效性。这项工作通过提出基于生活方式的新颖风险结构来为信用评分环境中的决策支持做出贡献。


Keywords: Credit Risk, Deep-Level Diversity, Econometric Analysis, Social Media, Fintech




关键词：信用风险、深层多样性、计量经济分析、社交媒体、金融科技


Kim Huat Goh was the accepting senior editor. This research article was submitted on October 12, 2022 and underwent three revisions.




Kim Huat Goh 是接受高级编辑。该研究文章于2022年10月12日提交，经历了3次修改。


## 1 Introduction




## 1 简介


With the rising tide of fintech innovations, financial institutions are rapidly gravitating toward the realm of digital financial services, also known as “d-finance,” capitalizing on their cost-effectiveness and convenience. Digital microfinance (“d-microfinance”) stands out in this landscape as a notable fintech service, witnessing burgeoning interest from both researchers and practitioners. Through d-microfinance, traditional financial boundaries are transcended, with institutions leveraging internet-based platforms to promote innovative services such as online personal wealth management, online insurance, microloans, and peer-topeer lending (Cnudde et al., 2019; Djeundje et al., 2021; Ge et al., 2017). This fintech solution not only offers institutions a gateway into the vast digital consumer market but also provides a lifeline for those often marginalized by the financial system due to a lack of securable assets or comprehensive financial records (Huang et al., 2017). The societal impact of d-Microfinance is significant, as it reduces poverty by fostering financial inclusivity for countless individuals (Cnudde et al., 2019; Copestake, 2007; Durango-Gutiérrez et al., 2023).




随着金融科技创新浪潮的兴起，金融机构利用其成本效益和便利性，迅速转向数字金融服务领域，也称为“d-finance”。数字小额信贷（“d-小额信贷”）作为一项著名的金融科技服务在这一领域脱颖而出，见证了研究人员和从业者日益浓厚的兴趣。通过D-小额信贷，机构超越了传统金融界限，利用互联网平台推广在线个人理财、在线保险、小额贷款和点对点借贷等创新服务（Cnudde等，2019；Djeundje等，2021；Ge等，2017）。这种金融科技解决方案不仅为机构提供了进入广阔的数字消费市场的门户，还为那些因缺乏安全资产或全面的财务记录而经常被金融系统边缘化的人提供了生命线（Huang et al., 2017）。 d-小额信贷的社会影响是巨大的，因为它通过促进无数个人的金融包容性来减少贫困（Cnudde 等人，2019 年；Copestake，2007 年；Durango-Gutiérrez 等人，2023 年）。


However, while d-microfinance is a significant fintech advancement, it may bring excessive credit risk to financial institutions due to a higher likelihood of customer default (Durango-Gutiérrez et al., 2023; Ge et al., 2017; Xu & Chau, 2018). Credit risk refers to the likelihood that an individual or an organization will fail to repay a loan by a given time in the future (i.e., will default) (Noh et al., 2005). One critical contributing factor to the increased risk of default in d-microfinance is the inadequate or absence of comprehensive credit records for internet-based customers, who are the primary users of these services (Durango-Gutiérrez et al., 2023; Xu & Chau, 2018). This leads to the pressing need for financial institutions to explore alternative data sources to enhance their credit scoring processes and reduce the excessive credit risk associated with d-microfinance.




然而，虽然 D-小额信贷是一项重大的金融科技进步，但由于客户违约的可能性较高，它可能会给金融机构带来过高的信用风险（Durango-Gutiérrez 等人，2023 年；Ge 等人，2017 年；Xu 和 Chau，2018 年）。信用风险是指个人或组织在未来特定时间无法偿还贷款（即违约）的可能性（Noh 等，2005）。 d-小额信贷违约风险增加的一个关键因素是互联网客户缺乏全面的信用记录，而这些客户是这些服务的主要用户（Durango-Gutiérrez 等人，2023 年；Xu 和 Chau，2018 年）。这导致金融机构迫切需要探索替代数据源，以增强其信用评分流程并降低与 d-小额信贷相关的过度信用风险。


To achieve a better assessment of credit risk, researchers and practitioners have been exploring various factors for a long time. These include loan characteristics (Emekter et al., 2015); “hard” credit information, such as the demographic attributes (e.g. age, educational background, and marital status) and financial attributes (e.g. income, property ownership, and repayment histories) of consumers (Stein, 2002; Thomas et al., 2005); and “soft” credit information, such as consumers’ social relationships with others (Greiner & Wang, 2009), consumers’ behavioral characteristics (Sarlija et al., 2009; Thomas et al., 2005), and linguistic features extracted from consumers’ textual communications (Larrimore et al., 2011). This type of information is commonly known as “conventional data.” Recently, driven by fintech advancements coupled with the ubiquitous use of the internet and mobile devices, a new form of detailed, usergenerated behavioral data has emerged. This includes consumers’ social media activities, mobile phone usage patterns, online shopping behaviors, and web page activities. This wealth of information is collectively known as “alternative data” (Cnudde et al., 2019; Djeundje et al., 2021). Although this type of data (e.g., social media data) may not be directly related to consumers’ credit behaviors, studies have found that it can reflect their personalities or socioeconomic status, which can significantly influence their default behavior (Berg et al., 2020; Yang et al., 2022).




为了更好地评估信用风险，研究者和实践者长期以来一直在探索各种因素。其中包括贷款特征（Emekter 等，2015）； “硬”信用信息，例如消费者的人口统计属性（例如年龄、教育背景和婚姻状况）和财务属性（例如收入、财产所有权和还款历史）（Stein，2002；Thomas et al.，2005）；和“软”信用信息，例如消费者与他人的社会关系（Greiner＆Wang，2009）、消费者的行为特征（Sarlija等，2009；Thomas等，2005）以及从消费者文本通信中提取的语言特征（Larrimore等，2011）。此类信息通常称为“常规数据”。最近，在金融科技进步以及互联网和移动设备的普遍使用的推动下，出现了一种新形式的详细的、用户生成的行为数据。这包括消费者的社交媒体活动、手机使用模式、在线购物行为和网页活动。这些丰富的信息统称为“替代数据”（Cnudde 等人，2019 年；Djeundje 等人，2021 年）。尽管这类数据（例如社交媒体数据）可能与消费者的信用行为没有直接关系，但研究发现它可以反映消费者的个性或社会经济地位，从而显着影响他们的违约行为（Berg等，2020；Yang等，2022）。


For internet-based consumers, although a significant portion lacks comprehensive credit records, they are avid social media users and enjoy expressing their attitudes, values, views, and opinions—so-called deep-level diversity (Casper et al., 2013; Harrison et al., 1998). This wealth of unstructured data left by individuals on social media could potentially be used to evaluate or forecast their credit risk (Ge et al., 2017). However, previous research has primarily focused on elementary social media features, such as the existence of social media accounts (Lu et al., 2019), number of online friends (Ge et al., 2017), shallow digital footprints (Berg et al., 2020), and email usage patterns (Djeundje et al., 2021). Consumers’ deep-level diversity (Casper et al., 2013; Harrison et al., 1998) remains underexplored by researchers.




对于互联网消费者来说，虽然很大一部分缺乏全面的信用记录，但他们是社交媒体的狂热用户，喜欢表达自己的态度、价值观、观点和意见，即所谓的深层多样性(Casper et al., 2013; Harrison et al., 1998)。个人在社交媒体上留下的大量非结构化数据有可能被用来评估或预测他们的信用风险（Ge et al., 2017）。然而，之前的研究主要集中在基本的社交媒体特征上，例如社交媒体帐户的存在（Lu et al., 2019）、在线好友的数量（Ge et al., 2017）、浅层数字足迹（Berg et al., 2020）和电子邮件使用模式（Djeundje et al., 2021）。研究人员仍未充分探索消费者的深层多样性（Casper 等，2013；Harrison 等，1998）。


Deep-level diversity refers to individuals’ attitudes, opinions, values, and beliefs, which are not readily apparent from surface-level characteristics like age, gender, or ethnicity. Indeed, variations in values, attitudes, or beliefs among consumers can influence their willingness to repay debts (i.e., credit risk). Although various credit scoring models have previously been proposed by researchers, the literature lacks a model with a rigorous theoretical foundation to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. Furthermore, other than a recent study conducted by Shin et al. (2020), most research in information systems (IS) and fintech has only examined consumers’ opinions extracted from text (Lau et al., 2012; Lee et al., 2018). The “variety” of social media big data (Lau et al., 2016), including images, has rarely been explored to improve business decision-making. In general, images speak louder than text (Lee et al., 2015), and they provide more insights into individuals’ behavioral characteristics (Hum et al., 2011). Relying solely on text can inadvertently introduce biases, whereas visual data offers a more holistic, impartial representation of an individual’s lifestyle, expenditure patterns, and preferences, thereby fostering equitable credit assessments. Accordingly, exploring the relationship between consumers’ credit risk and the deep-level diversity captured in both the text and images of multimodal social media posts warrants further investigation.




深层多样性是指个人的态度、观点、价值观和信仰，这些从年龄、性别或种族等表面特征中不容易明显看出。事实上，消费者的价值观、态度或信仰的差异会影响他们偿还债务的意愿（即信用风险）。尽管研究人员之前已经提出了各种信用评分模型，但文献中缺乏具有严格理论基础的模型来捕捉消费者的深层次多样性。此外，除了 Shin 等人最近进行的一项研究之外。 (2020)，大多数信息系统 (IS) 和金融科技研究仅考察从文本中提取的消费者意见（Lau 等人，2012；Lee 等人，2018）。包括图像在内的社交媒体大数据的“多样性”（Lau et al., 2016）很少被用来改善业务决策。一般来说，图像比文本更有说服力（Lee et al., 2015），并且图像可以提供更多关于个人行为特征的见解（Hum et al., 2011）。仅仅依赖文本可能会无意中引入偏见，而视觉数据可以更全面、公正地反映个人的生活方式、支出模式和偏好，从而促进公平的信用评估。因此，探索消费者信用风险与多模式社交媒体帖子文本和图像中所捕捉到的深层多样性之间的关系值得进一步研究。


The theory of lifestyle pattern (LP) provides a comprehensive approach to capturing consumers’ characteristics through four dimensions, namely demographics, activities, interests, and opinions (Plummer, 1971). Previous studies have shown that the dimensions of activities, interests, and opinions can effectively reflect people’s deep-level characteristics, which play a critical role in shaping their subsequent behaviors (Harrison et al., 1998; Holland, 1997). Building on this, this study proposes three novel types of lifestylebased risk constructs (i.e., activity risk, interest risk, and opinion risk) to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. By incorporating these novel constructs into econometric models, we investigate the relationship between consumers’ credit risk and their deep-level diversity extracted from multimodal social media posts. Furthermore, according to the theory of planned behavior (TPB), an individual’s future behavior is influenced by their subjective norms, attitudes, and opinions (Ajzen, 1991; Pavlou & Fygenson, 2006). Accordingly, TPB offers a theoretical basis to explain the possible connection between consumers’ deep-level diversity and their future default behaviors. Our main research questions are as follows:




生活方式模式理论（LP）提供了一种通过四个维度来捕捉消费者特征的综合方法，即人口统计、活动、兴趣和意见（Plummer，1971）。以往的研究表明，活动、兴趣、观点等维度能够有效地反映人们的深层特征，对塑造其后续行为起着至关重要的作用(Harrison等，1998；Holland，1997)。在此基础上，本研究提出了三种新型的基于生活方式的风险结构（即活动风险、兴趣风险和意见风险），以捕捉消费者的深层次多样性。通过将这些新颖的结构纳入计量经济学模型，我们研究了消费者的信用风险与其从多模式社交媒体帖子中提取的深层多样性之间的关系。此外，根据计划行为理论（TPB），个人的未来行为受到其主观规范、态度和意见的影响（Ajzen，1991；Pavlou＆Fygenson，2006）。因此，TPB为解释消费者深层多样性与其未来默认行为之间可能存在的联系提供了理论基础。我们的主要研究问题如下：


RQ1: Are there significant relationships between consumers’ deep-level diversity measured by the respective lifestyle-based risk constructs and their credit risk?




RQ1：通过各自基于生活方式的风险结构衡量的消费者深层多样性与其信用风险之间是否存在显着关系？


RQ2: Does consumers’ deep-level diversity significantly improve the effectiveness of credit risk prediction?




RQ2：消费者的深层次多样性是否显着提高了信用风险预测的有效性？


RQ3: Does consumers’ deep-level diversity extracted from images offer similar predictive power as that extracted from social media text?




RQ3：从图像中提取的消费者深层多样性是否能提供与从社交媒体文本中提取的相似的预测能力？


The theoretical contributions of our study are threefold. First, grounded in theories of deep-level diversity and lifestyle pattern (LP), we developed and evaluated novel lifestyle-based constructs, namely activity risk, interest risk, and opinion risk to measure consumers’ deep-level diversity extracted from their multimodal social media posts. Second, drawing on the theory of planned behavior, we conducted an econometric analysis to empirically examine the relationship between consumers’ deep-level diversity and their credit risk. Finally, we empirically evaluated the predictive power of consumers’ opinion risk constructs derived from social media text and images, respectively. Our findings underscore the usefulness of utilizing multimodal alternative data such as social media text and images to evaluate consumers’ credit risk. As fintech solutions continuously seek innovative data streams, our empirical results accentuate the paramount potential lying in these multimodal digital footprints. The business implications of our study are significant because they provide an avenue for extracting consumers’ deeplevel diversity from multimodal social media big data to enhance an array of business decision-making processes such as credit scoring, personalized wealth management, targeted marketing, etc.




我们的研究的理论贡献有三个方面。首先，基于深层多样性和生活方式模式（LP）理论，我们开发并评估了基于生活方式的新颖结构，即活动风险、兴趣风险和舆论风险，以衡量从多模式社交媒体帖子中提取的消费者的深层多样性。其次，借鉴计划行为理论，我们进行了计量分析，实证检验了消费者深层次多样性与其信用风险之间的关系。最后，我们分别根据社交媒体文本和图像实证评估了消费者意见风险构造的预测能力。我们的研究结果强调了利用社交媒体文本和图像等多模式替代数据来评估消费者信用风险的有用性。随着金融科技解决方案不断寻求创新的数据流，我们的实证结果凸显了这些多模式数字足迹的巨大潜力。我们的研究具有重要的商业意义，因为它们提供了一种从多模式社交媒体大数据中提取消费者深层多样性的途径，以增强一系列商业决策流程，例如信用评分、个性化财富管理、有针对性的营销等。


## 2 Theoretical Background and Hypotheses




## 2 理论背景和假设


## 2.1 Literature Review and Theoretical Foundations




## 2.1 文献综述和理论基础


## 2.1.1 Theory of Lifestyle Pattern




## 2.1.1 生活方式模式理论


In order to develop a holistic credit scoring model that captures consumers’ deep-level diversity (Casper et al., 2013; Harrison et al., 1998), we drew inspiration from the lens of the theory of lifestyle pattern (LP) (Plummer, 1974). This theory has proven successful in capturing the behavioral and psychological traits of consumers that can impact their credit-related decisions or risks (Bernthal et al., 2005; Plummer, 1971; Wickramasinghe & Gurugamage, 2012). LP consists of four dimensions, namely demographics, activities, interests, and opinions (Plummer, 1971). While demographics capture the surface-level attributes of individuals, the latter three dimensions are effective in capturing their deep-level characteristics (Lazer, 1963). Activities (A) refer to the regular actions of individuals, including their hobbies, and spending habits. (Lin & Shih, 2012; Yu, 2011). How individuals manage their spending habits reflects their credit risk. For example, a borrower who spends money responsibly will likely be viewed as less risky than someone with a history of reckless spending. Interests (I) represent the things that individuals consider important in their immediate surroundings (Lin & Shih, 2012; Yu, 2011). This dimension delves into passions and driving forces that steer an individual’s core longterm decisions. For instance, someone interested in establishing a solid family life might first try to secure a steady job. Opinions (O) reflect individuals’ attitudes and beliefs about themselves and the world around them (Lin & Shih, 2012; Sandy et al., 2013). Far from being mere statements, opinions are laden with emotional significance and cognitive reflections. This dimension also delves into individuals’ feelings about the surrounding environment and societal issues. Collectively, the AIO dimensions delve into the intricate web of motivations, behaviors, beliefs, and values that truly define individuals. This intricate capture of deeplevel diversity is crucial for crafting comprehensive profiles, making nuanced predictions, and understanding the multifaceted nature of consumers.




为了开发一个能够捕捉消费者深层多样性的整体信用评分模型（Casper 等，2013；Harrison 等，1998），我们从生活方式模式（LP）理论（Plummer，1974）中汲取灵感。事实证明，该理论成功地捕捉了消费者的行为和心理特征，这些特征可能会影响他们的信用相关决策或风险（Bernthal 等人，2005 年；Plummer，1971 年；Wickramasinghe 和 Gurugamage，2012 年）。 LP由四个维度组成，即人口统计、活动、兴趣和观点（Plummer，1971）。虽然人口统计捕捉了个人的表面特征，但后三个维度可以有效地捕捉其深层特征（Lazer，1963）。活动（A）是指个人的常规行为，包括兴趣爱好和消费习惯。 （Lin & Shih，2012；Yu，2011）。个人如何管理消费习惯反映了他们的信用风险。例如，负责任地花钱的借款人可能会被认为比有鲁莽花钱历史的借款人风险更低。兴趣（I）代表个人认为在其周围环境中重要的事物（Lin & Shih，2012；Yu，2011）。这个维度深入研究引导个人核心长期决策的激情和驱动力。例如，有兴趣建立稳固的家庭生活的人可能会首先尝试找到一份稳定的工作。意见（O）反映了个人对自己和周围世界的态度和信念（Lin & Shih，2012；Sandy 等，2013）。观点不仅仅是陈述，还充满了情感意义和认知反思。这个维度还深入研究了个人对周围环境和社会问题的感受。总的来说，AIO 维度深入研究了真正定义个人的复杂的动机、行为、信仰和价值观网络。这种对深层多样性的复杂捕捉对于制定全面的概况、做出细致入微的预测和理解消费者的多面性至关重要。


Building on this foundation, our research extends the AIO framework to develop novel lifestyle-based risk constructs that aim to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. Specifically, we identify three types of lifestyle-based risk constructs, namely activity risk, interest risk, and opinion risk. Activity risk pertains to the regular activities that consumers engage in and how these activities may impact their ability to repay debts, thereby inducing credit risk. For example, if a consumer spends excessively on hobbies or luxury items, they may be more likely to face financial difficulties and default on their loans (Hackbarth et al., 2006). Interest risk refers to things that people prioritize in their immediate surroundings, which may lead to credit risk. For example, an individual who has a large family with many children may have a higher debt-to-income ratio, which could ultimately lead to higher credit risk (Dinh & Kleimeier, 2007). Finally, opinion risk refers to consumers’ attitudes and beliefs about themselves and the surrounding environment, which may also impact credit risk. For instance, if an individual has an antisocial attitude or negative views of financial responsibility, they may be more likely to engage in risky financial behavior and experience credit risk. In other words, activity risk, interest risk, and opinion risk are subsets of individuals’ activities, interests, and opinions that may impact credit risk. Table 1 shows examples of real-world cases in which consumers multimodal social media posts implicitly reflect one or more of these three types of risk constructs. In addition, we capture consumers’ personal and financial attributes, known as “hard” credit information, through the demographic dimension provided by lifestyle patterns.




在此基础上，我们的研究扩展了 AIO 框架，以开发基于生活方式的新型风险结构，旨在捕捉消费者的深层多样性。具体来说，我们确定了三种基于生活方式的风险结构，即活动风险、兴趣风险和意见风险。活动风险涉及消费者从事的常规活动以及这些活动如何影响其偿还债务的能力，从而引发信用风险。例如，如果消费者在爱好或奢侈品上花费过多，他们可能更有可能面临财务困难和贷款违约（Hackbarth 等，2006）。利率风险是指人们在周围环境中优先考虑的事情，这可能会导致信用风险。例如，拥有多个孩子的大家庭的个人可能有较高的债务收入比，这最终可能导致较高的信用风险（Dinh & Kleimeier，2007）。最后，舆论风险是指消费者对自己和周围环境的态度和信念，这也可能影响信用风险。例如，如果一个人对财务责任有反社会态度或消极看法，他们可能更有可能从事危险的财务行为并经历信用风险。换句话说，活动风险、利率风险和意见风险是可能影响信用风险的个人活动、利益和意见的子集。表 1 显示了现实世界的案例示例，其中消费者多模式社交媒体帖子隐含地反映了这三种类型的风险构造中的一种或多种。此外，我们通过生活方式模式提供的人口统计维度来捕获消费者的个人和财务属性，即“硬”信用信息。
