## 5.4 Alternative Image Representation Schemes




## 5.4 替代图像表示方案


As discussed above, we utilized the MVSO package to develop our image analysis system and identified 4,421 ANPs to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity from multimodal social media posts. To reduce the noise generated during semantic image analysis, we confined our focus to the top 10 ANPs identified by our DCNN for each image’s representation. A concern that may arise is the potential variation in outcomes stemming from different image representation schemes (e.g., 11 ANPs), which could spotlight different image features. Such variations might consequently influence lifestylebased risk calculations, thereby affecting interpretations of credit risk. To address this concern and corroborate the validity of our primary findings rooted in the 10- ANP representation scheme, we embarked on tests employing diverse numbers of ANPs per image representation. We then derived the lifestyle-based risk constructs based on these alternative image representation schemes, as shown in Table 15 above. Our results indicate that the significance of the focal variable (i.e., IOpinion) remained consistent with the main econometric analysis when a range of 6 to 12 ANPs was used to represent an image. However, if more than 12 ANPs were utilized, our regression results differed from the main results because some irrelevant ANPs (i.e., ANPs with relatively low probabilities) were included in the image representation. Overall, our main analysis results are robust in relation to alternative image representation schemes, provided that a reasonable number of ANPs are selected.




如上所述，我们利用 MVSO 包开发图像分析系统，并确定了 4,421 个 ANP，以从多模式社交媒体帖子中捕获消费者的深层多样性。为了减少语义图像分析过程中产生的噪声，我们将注意力集中在 DCNN 为每个图像表示识别的前 10 个 ANP 上。可能出现的一个问题是不同图像表示方案（例如 11 个 ANP）导致结果的潜在变化，这可能会突出不同的图像特征。这些变化可能会影响基于生活方式的风险计算，从而影响信用风险的解释。为了解决这个问题并证实我们基于 10-ANP 表示方案的主要发现的有效性，我们开始对每个图像表示使用不同数量的 ANP 进行测试。然后，我们根据这些替代图像表示方案得出了基于生活方式的风险构造，如上表 15 所示。我们的结果表明，当使用 6 至 12 个 ANP 来表示图像时，焦点变量（即 IOpinion）的显着性与主要计量经济学分析保持一致。然而，如果使用超过 12 个 ANP，我们的回归结果将与主要结果不同，因为图像表示中包含一些不相关的 ANP（即概率相对较低的 ANP）。总的来说，只要选择合理数量的 ANP，我们的主要分析结果相对于替代图像表示方案是稳健的。


## 5.5 Controlling for Predictive Errors




## 5.5 控制预测误差


Deep learning is a powerful analytics method, but it can result in predictive errors that may cause measurement errors in regression models (Yang et al., 2018). These errors could lead to biased coefficient estimates, making it harder to detect the true relationship between deep-level diversity and credit risk. To address this issue, we applied the simulation extrapolation method (SIMEX) (Cook & Stefanski, 1994) to correct the errors introduced by predictive analytics methods. Although it is challenging to obtain the actual variances of predictive errors when applying our multimodal analytics methods (i.e., mBERT and MVSO) to unlabeled Weibo posts, we can estimate them based on similar labeled benchmark datasets. Since previous research has shown that state-of-the-art machine learning-based classification methods achieved comparable performance across various domains (Kratzwald et al., 2018), we thus estimated the variance of predictive errors introduced by the text analytics method (i.e., mBERT<sub>BASE</sub>) based on a named entity recognition (NER) Weibo corpus (Peng & Dredze, 2016). The F1-score achieved by the mBERT method for the NER Weibo corpus was 0.88, which is similar to the F1-score (i.e., 0.85) obtained when mBERT was used to detect consumers’ lifestyle patterns in our main study. This empirical test demonstrates that the estimated variance of predictive error can be reliably applied to the SIMEX computational process. Similarly, we estimated the variance of predictive error for the visual analytics method (i.e., MVSO) by applying it to the ImageNet (Deng et al., 2009) benchmark dataset.




深度学习是一种强大的分析方法，但它可能会导致预测错误，从而导致回归模型中的测量错误（Yang et al., 2018）。这些错误可能会导致系数估计出现偏差，从而使检测深层多样性与信用风险之间的真实关系变得更加困难。为了解决这个问题，我们应用模拟外推法（SIMEX）（Cook & Stefanski，1994）来纠正预测分析方法引入的错误。尽管将我们的多模态分析方法（即 mBERT 和 MVSO）应用于未标记的微博帖子时获得预测误差的实际方差具有挑战性，但我们可以根据类似的标记基准数据集来估计它们。由于之前的研究表明，最先进的基于机器学习的分类方法在各个领域都取得了可比的性能（Kratzwald 等人，2018），因此我们基于命名实体识别（NER）微博语料库估计了文本分析方法（即 mBERT<sub>BASE</sub>）引入的预测误差的方差（Peng & Dredze，2016）。 mBERT 方法在 NER 微博语料库上获得的 F1 分数为 0.88，与我们主要研究中使用 mBERT 检测消费者生活方式模式时获得的 F1 分数（即 0.85）相似。该实证测试表明，预测误差的估计方差可以可靠地应用于 SIMEX 计算过程。同样，我们通过将视觉分析方法（即 MVSO）应用于 ImageNet（Deng 等人，2009）基准数据集来估计预测误差的方差。


By comparing the predicted lifestyle risk labels (e.g., activity, interest, opinion) with the corresponding ground truths provided by domain experts in our Weibo corpus, we obtained a 3×3 covariance matrix of the mBERT model’s predictive error. To correct for any measurement error, we used a two-stage SIMEX correction procedure. In the first simulation stage, a fixed set of values $\left\{ \lambda _ { 1 , } \lambda _ { 2 } , \ldots , \lambda _ { 1 3 8 5 } \right\}$ was selected, and then the impact of measurement error was approximated by using a specific lifestyle risk class ?? with ??<sup>̂</sup> $\left( \lambda _ { k } \right) = X + e \left( \lambda _ { k } \right)$ , where $e { \sim } N ( 0 , \sigma _ { e } ^ { 2 } )$ and $e \left( \lambda _ { k } \right)$ had a variance of (1 + $\lambda _ { k } ) \sigma _ { e } ^ { 2 } \left( k \in \left\{ 1 , 2 , \ldots , 1 3 8 5 \right\} \right)$ ). At this stage, we obtained a set of lifestyle risk class variables $\left\{ \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 1 } ) , \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 2 } ) , \ldots , \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 1 3 8 5 } ) \right\}$ with approximated measurement errors. In the second extrapolation stage, a parameter model, θ(??), was estimated and extrapolated with respect to the (θ(−1)) level, where the measurement error was reduced to 0. The corrected results of the lifestyle-based risk constructs captured in text and images are depicted in Models 6 and 7 in Table 7. Figure 2 illustrates the SIMEX results corresponding to the corrected results shown in Table 7. Our extrapolation results confirm that the lifestyle risk constructs extracted from text and images were properly corrected after controlling for possible predictive errors.




通过将预测的生活方式风险标签（例如活动、兴趣、意见）与微博语料库中领域专家提供的相应基本事实进行比较，我们获得了 mBERT 模型预测误差的 3×3 协方差矩阵。为了纠正任何测量误差，我们使用了两阶段 SIMEX 校正程序。在第一个模拟阶段，选择一组固定值 $\left\{ \lambda _ { 1 , } \lambda _ { 2 } , \ldots , \lambda _ { 1 3 8 5 } \right\}$，然后使用特定的生活方式风险等级 ?? 来近似测量误差的影响。 ??<sup>̂</sup> $\left( \lambda _ { k } \right) = X + e \left( \lambda _ { k } \right)$ ，其中 $e { \sim } N ( 0 , \sigma _ { e } ^ { 2 } )$ 和 $e \left( \lambda _ { k } \right)$ 的方差为 (1 + $\lambda _ { k } ) \sigma _ { e } ^ { 2 } \left( k \in \left\{ 1 , 2 , \ldots , 1 3 8 5 \right\} \right)$ )。在此阶段，我们获得了一组生活方式风险类别变量 $\left\{ \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 1 } ) 、 \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 2 } ) 、 \ldots 、 \hat { X } ( \lambda _ { 1 3 8 5 } ) \right\}$ 以及近似测量误差。在第二个外推阶段，参数模型 θ(??) 相对于 (θ(−1)) 水平进行估计和外推，其中测量误差降至 0。表 7 中的模型 6 和模型 7 描述了文本和图像中捕获的基于生活方式的风险构造的校正结果。图 2 说明了与表 7 中所示的校正结果相对应的 SIMEX 结果。我们的外推结果证实，从文本和图像中提取的生活方式风险构造是控制可能的预测错误后进行适当纠正。


## 6 Concluding Remarks




## 6 结束语


This study examines the relationship between consumers’ deep-level diversity captured in multimodal social media posts and their credit risk. Drawing on the theories of deep-level diversity and lifestyle patterns, we propose novel lifestyle-based risk constructs to capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. By incorporating these lifestyle-based constructs into econometric models, we empirically evaluated both the explanatory and the predictive capabilities of the proposed constructs. Based on a real-world credit scoring dataset provided by a fintech firm listed on Nasdaq, our empirical findings reveal that the opinion risk constructs extracted from text and images of multimodal social media posts are positively associated with consumers’ credit risk. Further examination of the subdimensions of the opinion risk construct shows that consumers’ opinions on themselves and their future, as well as their opinions on political and social issues, are the primary drivers of their credit risk. Finally, our empirical tests demonstrate that the proposed opinion risk construct derived from images has predictive power comparable to that of its textual counterpart. Combining the opinion risk constructs derived from images and text significantly improves the effectiveness of predicting consumers’ credit risk.




本研究探讨了多模式社交媒体帖子中捕获的消费者深层多样性与其信用风险之间的关系。借鉴深层多样性和生活方式模式的理论，我们提出了基于生活方式的新颖风险结构，以捕捉消费者的深层多样性。通过将这些基于生活方式的结构纳入计量经济学模型，我们根据经验评估了所提出的结构的解释和预测能力。基于纳斯达克上市的金融科技公司提供的真实世界信用评分数据集，我们的实证研究结果表明，从多模式社交媒体帖子的文本和图像中提取的意见风险结构与消费者的信用风险呈正相关。对意见风险结构子维度的进一步考察表明，消费者对自己和未来的看法，以及对政治和社会问题的看法，是其信用风险的主要驱动因素。最后，我们的实证测试表明，所提出的从图像衍生的意见风险构造具有与其文本对应物相当的预测能力。结合来自图像和文本的意见风险构造显着提高了预测消费者信用风险的有效性。


## 6.1 Research Contributions




## 6.1 研究贡献


Our research contributes to the literature in three distinct ways. First, this study enriches the IS literature by developing machine learning-enhanced constructs for conducting large-scale empirical studies (Adamopoulos et al., 2022; Shin et al., 2020; Xu et al., 2022; Xu et al., 2023). Using deep learning-based multimodal analytics, this study introduces three innovative lifestyle-based risk constructs that capture consumers’ deep-level diversity extracted from their multimodal social media posts. Among these constructs, the novelty of the “opinion risk” construct is particularly significant because of its ability to capture the intricate attitudes, beliefs, and worldviews deeply rooted in consumers’ lifestyles. In the IS domain, where decision-making has rapidly embraced digital transformation, the “opinion risk” construct offers a profound, more intricate understanding of human inclinations, choices, and behaviors. This innovative construct provides researchers with a more profound lens to tap into individuals’ deep-level diversity for examining various business phenomena such as, but not limited to, credit scoring, online shopping behavior, targeted marketing, personalized wealth management, corporate hiring, and so on.




我们的研究以三种不同的方式对文献做出了贡献。首先，这项研究通过开发用于进行大规模实证研究的机器学习增强结构来丰富信息系统文献（Adamopoulos 等人，2022；Shin 等人，2020；Xu 等人，2022；Xu 等人，2023）。本研究使用基于深度学习的多模态分析，引入了三种基于生活方式的创新风险结构，这些结构捕获了从多模态社交媒体帖子中提取的消费者的深层多样性。在这些构造中，“意见风险”构造的新颖性尤其重要，因为它能够捕捉根深蒂固于消费者生活方式中的复杂态度、信仰和世界观。在信息系统领域，决策已迅速接受数字化转型，“意见风险”结构提供了对人类倾向、选择和行为的深刻、更复杂的理解。这种创新的结构为研究人员提供了更深刻的视角，以挖掘个人深层的多样性，以研究各种商业现象，例如但不限于信用评分、在线购物行为、定向营销、个性化财富管理、企业招聘等。


Second, we empirically examine the relationship between consumers’ deep-level diversity and credit risk. Existing credit scoring studies have primarily focused on discernible factors such as consumers’ sociodemographic characteristics, financial attributes, loan features, and shallow behavioral characteristics (Emekter et al., 2015; Stein, 2002; Thomas et al., 2005). However, the impact of consumers’ deep-level diversity remains underexplored. While an emergent body of literature has investigated the impact of individuals’ deep-level diversity on financial outcomes (Ali et al., 2022; Maati & Maati-Sauvez, 2019) and organizational outcomes (Harrison et al., 1998), this research is the first to unveil the effect of deep-level diversity in the context of consumers’ credit risk assessment. Beyond the surface-level characteristics, deep-level diversity taps into intricate facets of individual values, attitudes, beliefs, and cognitive abilities. These deep-rooted characteristics play a pivotal role in shaping peoples’ financial behaviors, particularly in the realm of credit scoring. Understanding deep-level diversity indicates that beyond the tangible, creditworthiness may be shaped by deeply ingrained attitudes, values, and beliefs. This unveils a broader, more holistic paradigm to assess a person’s likelihood of repaying debt. By applying TPB, we draw empirical connections between consumers’ opinions—particularly regarding themselves, the future, and social and political issues— and their credit risk. This reveals that deeply held beliefs and attitudes, often dismissed as intangible or too abstract, can have real, measurable impacts on financial outcomes.




其次，我们实证检验了消费者深层次多样性与信用风险之间的关系。现有的信用评分研究主要集中在消费者的社会人口特征、金融属性、贷款特征和浅层行为特征等可辨别因素上（Emekter等，2015；Stein，2002；Thomas等，2005）。然而，消费者深层次多样性的影响仍未得到充分探索。虽然大量文献研究了个人深层多样性对财务结果（Ali et al., 2022；Maati & Maati-Sauvez, 2019）和组织结果（Harrison et al., 1998）的影响，但这项研究首次揭示了消费者信用风险评估背景下深层多样性的影响。除了表面特征之外，深层多样性还涉及个人价值观、态度、信仰和认知能力的复杂方面。这些根深蒂固的特征在塑造人们的金融行为方面发挥着关键作用，特别是在信用评分领域。了解深层次的多样性表明，除了有形的之外，信誉可能还受到根深蒂固的态度、价值观和信仰的影响。这揭示了一个更广泛、更全面的范式来评估一个人偿还债务的可能性。通过应用 TPB，我们在消费者的观点（特别是关于他们自己、未来以及社会和政治问题）与其信用风险之间建立了实证联系。这表明，根深蒂固的信念和态度常常被认为是无形的或过于抽象的，但却可以对财务结果产生真实的、可衡量的影响。


Third, the fintech domain has seen a burgeoning interest in harnessing the predictive power of finegrained user behaviors and psychometric features from alternative data sources. Examples include leveraging social capital features from social media activity data to forecast the success of crowdfunding projects (Yeh & Chen, 2022), constructing five behavioral features from P2P lending transaction data to enhance fraud detection (Xu et al., 2022), utilizing personality insights from social media text for credit risk prediction (Yang et al., 2022), and analyzing digital footprints in e-commerce for borrower default prediction (Berg et al., 2020). However, a significant research gap exists in applying consumers’ deep-level diversity to predict their credit risk. Moreover, prior research has predominantly focused on either textual or numerical data. Whether incorporating multimodal data (e.g., text and images) could improve the effectiveness of predicting consumers’ credit risk remains unclear. This research fills the existing gaps by highlighting the advantages of using multimodal data for credit risk prediction. Notably, our findings demonstrate that combining the opinion risk constructs derived from both text and images can significantly improve the predictive effectiveness of consumers’ credit risk. Our novel findings offer new insights into the burgeoning research on the value of multimodal content in credit risk prediction, encouraging researchers to further explore the integration of diverse data modalities in the fintech sector.




第三，金融科技领域对利用来自替代数据源的细粒度用户行为和心理测量特征的预测能力的兴趣日益浓厚。例子包括利用社交媒体活动数据中的社会资本特征来预测众筹项目的成功（Yeh＆Chen，2022），根据P2P借贷交易数据构建五种行为特征以增强欺诈检测（Xu等人，2022），利用社交媒体文本中的个性洞察进行信用风险预测（Yang等人，2022），以及分析电子商务中的数字足迹以预测借款人违约（Berg等人，2020）。然而，在应用消费者的深层多样性来预测其信用风险方面存在重大研究空白。此外，先前的研究主要集中在文本或数字数据上。合并多模态数据（例如文本和图像）是否可以提高预测消费者信用风险的有效性仍不清楚。这项研究通过强调使用多模态数据进行信用风险预测的优势，填补了现有的空白。值得注意的是，我们的研究结果表明，结合来自文本和图像的意见风险构造可以显着提高消费者信用风险的预测有效性。我们的新颖发现为信用风险预测中多模式内容价值的新兴研究提供了新的见解，鼓励研究人员进一步探索金融科技领域多种数据模式的整合。


## 6.2 Business Implications




## 6.2 业务影响


Our research has important implications for lending firms, loan managers, and business decision-making makers. First, without the availability of sufficient credit histories and credit scores of relatively young internet-based consumers for assessing their creditworthiness, lending firms can consider using consumers’ multimodal social media data as an alternative data source to enhance credit risk assessment. This aligns with the growing trend of social media-based credit scoring adopted by d-finance firms worldwide. By leveraging low-cost and readily accessible social media big data, loan managers and credit scoring specialists can significantly improve the effectiveness of consumers’ credit risk prediction. Second, although the sharing of visual content such as images has become increasingly popular among internet-based users, loan managers are encountering difficulties in comprehending and interpreting this type of big data. Our research provides them with a practical analytics methodology that can facilitate the “measurement” of these unstructured (textual and visual) data in a systematic and scalable manner. More specifically, loan managers can leverage the proposed opinion risk constructs to significantly enhance the effectiveness of credit risk prediction. Finally, the proposed analytics methodology and lifestyle-based risk constructs can be extended to other business decision-making processes such as consumer profiling, product co-creation, targeted marketing, personalized wealth management, corporate hiring, and so on. Our research has the potential to make a significant societal impact by proposing a more effective creditworthiness assessment methodology, which can reduce the unnecessary exclusion of consumers who are seeking financial assistance. This, in turn, can reduce poverty and boost the global economy.




我们的研究对贷款公司、贷款经理和商业决策者具有重要意义。首先，如果没有足够的相对年轻的互联网消费者的信用记录和信用评分来评估其信用度，贷款公司可以考虑使用消费者的多模式社交媒体数据作为替代数据源来加强信用风险评估。这与全球金融公司采用基于社交媒体的信用评分的增长趋势相一致。通过利用低成本且易于访问的社交媒体大数据，贷款经理和信用评分专家可以显着提高消费者信用风险预测的有效性。其次，尽管图像等视觉内容的共享在互联网用户中越来越流行，但贷款经理在理解和解释此类大数据时遇到了困难。我们的研究为他们提供了一种实用的分析方法，可以促进以系统和可扩展的方式“测量”这些非结构化（文本和视觉）数据。更具体地说，贷款管理者可以利用所提出的意见风险结构来显着提高信用风险预测的有效性。最后，所提出的分析方法和基于生活方式的风险结构可以扩展到其他业务决策过程，例如消费者分析、产品共同创造、有针对性的营销、个性化财富管理、企业招聘等。我们的研究有可能提出一种更有效的信用评估方法，从而产生重大的社会影响，从而减少对寻求财务援助的消费者的不必要的排斥。这反过来又可以减少贫困并促进全球经济。


## 6.3 Limitations and Future Research




## 6.3 局限性和未来研究


Our study has several limitations that prompt further research. First, the proposed analytics methodology focuses solely on text and image data extracted from social media platforms. Other types of social media data such as audio clips or video clips may also capture consumers’ deep-level diversity. We would like to extend our current methodology to analyze audio and video data by using generative adversarial networks (GANs) (Mao et al., 2019) in the future. Second, our multimodal social media data was collected from one social media platform only. Future work should tap into multiple social media platforms such as Twitter and Facebook to enrich our data collection and analysis process. Third, the credit scoring dataset used in this study was provided by a single fintech firm. Future work will expand our dataset by considering other fintech firms to improve the external validity of our study. Finally, the dataset provided by the fintech firm is cross-sectional, which constrains our capability to scrutinize unobservable factors that may influence our variables of interest. To deepen the rigor and validation of our findings, future research endeavors should prioritize the acquisition and analysis of panel data.




我们的研究有一些局限性，需要进一步研究。首先，所提出的分析方法仅关注从社交媒体平台提取的文本和图像数据。其他类型的社交媒体数据（例如音频剪辑或视频剪辑）也可以捕获消费者的深层多样性。我们希望将来能够使用生成对抗网络（GAN）来扩展我们当前的方法来分析音频和视频数据（Mao et al., 2019）。其次，我们的多模式社交媒体数据仅从一个社交媒体平台收集。未来的工作应该利用 Twitter 和 Facebook 等多个社交媒体平台来丰富我们的数据收集和分析过程。第三，本研究中使用的信用评分数据集由一家金融科技公司提供。未来的工作将通过考虑其他金融科技公司来扩大我们的数据集，以提高我们研究的外部有效性。最后，金融科技公司提供的数据集是横截面的，这限制了我们审查可能影响我们感兴趣的变量的不可观察因素的能力。为了加深我们研究结果的严谨性和验证性，未来的研究工作应优先考虑面板数据的获取和分析。


There may be a concern about the invasion of consumer privacy because the proposed methodology extracts consumers’ deep-level diversity from their multimodal social media posts. The research team has taken measures to address this issue. Prior to extracting data, explicit consent was obtained from clients to use their public social media data. Furthermore, clients’ identities were removed from the dataset before it was provided to the research team. To ensure compliance with general research ethics (Babbie 2004) and protect the privacy of subjects, the institutional review board of the funding university carefully reviewed and approved the research team’s proposal. Although our empirical findings show that consumers’ political opinion orientations can impact their creditworthiness, we do not think that consumers with a certain political opinion orientation should be included or excluded from d-finance. Rather, future research should examine how to ensure that consumers’ political opinion orientations do not influence their access to d-finance.




人们可能会担心侵犯消费者隐私，因为所提出的方法从消费者的多模式社交媒体帖子中提取了消费者的深层多样性。研究小组已采取措施解决这一问题。在提取数据之前，已获得客户明确同意使用其公共社交媒体数据。此外，在将数据提供给研究团队之前，客户的身份已从数据集中删除。为了确保遵守一般研究道德（Babbie 2004）并保护受试者的隐私，资助大学的机构审查委员会仔细审查并批准了研究团队的提案。尽管我们的实证研究结果表明消费者的政治观点取向会影响他们的信用度，但我们并不认为具有一定政治观点取向的消费者应该被纳入或排除在d-finance之外。相反，未来的研究应该研究如何确保消费者的政治观点取向不会影响他们获得数字金融的机会。

## Appendix A: Examples of Lifestyle Subdimensions and the Expanded Topics




## 附录 A：生活方式子维度和扩展主题的示例


To extract lifestyle patterns from consumers’ textual social media posts for credit risk assessment, the research team and the collaborating d-finance firm collaborated to identify the relevant lifestyle subdimensions with respect to activity, interest, and opinion. Using the standard instrument of lifestyle patterns (Plummer, 1971; Wells & Tigert, 1971; Vyncke, 2002), keywords were extracted from the relevant items of chosen lifestyle subdimensions. These keywords were then fed into a semi-supervised HDP topic model (Lau et al., 2018) to enrich the subdimension descriptions for credit risk assessment. Next, probabilistic language models (Lau et al., 2011) were built using these enriched descriptions (topics) to semi-automatically label Weibo posts based on the three lifestyle dimensions. These labeled Weibo posts were then used to fine-tune the mBERT transformer model to identify lifestyle-related risks in microloan clients’ social media posts. Table A1 shows some examples of typical items selected from the standard instrument for measuring consumers’ lifestyle patterns along the three lifestyle dimensions (Plummer, 1971; Wells & Tigert, 1971; Vyncke, 2002).




为了从消费者的社交媒体文本帖子中提取生活方式模式以进行信用风险评估，研究团队和合作的 d-finance 公司合作确定了与活动、兴趣和意见相关的生活方式子维度。使用生活方式模式的标准工具（Plummer，1971；Wells & Tigert，1971；Vyncke，2002），从所选生活方式子维度的相关项目中提取关键词。然后将这些关键词输入半监督 HDP 主题模型（Lau et al., 2018），以丰富信用风险评估的子维度描述。接下来，使用这些丰富的描述（主题）构建概率语言模型（Lau et al., 2011），以根据三个生活方式维度半自动地标记微博帖子。然后，这些带标签的微博帖子被用来微调 mBERT 变压器模型，以识别小额贷款客户社交媒体帖子中与生活方式相关的风险。表 A1 显示了从三个生活方式维度衡量消费者生活方式模式的标准工具中选出的一些典型项目的示例（Plummer，1971；Wells & Tigert，1971；Vyncke，2002）。

By feeding the keywords extracted from the item descriptions of the standard lifestyle instrument (Plummer, 1971; Wells & Tigert, 1971; Vyncke, 2002) into the semi-supervised HDP topic model (Lau et al. 2018), it becomes possible to discover more related terms from a vast corpus that are semantically and statistically relevant. The resulting highly probable terms for each relevant topic produced by the semi-supervised HDP topic model are then utilized to describe each subdimension. Table A2 presents some sample topics produced by our semi-supervised HDP topic model, with the original item description's seeding keywords underlined and highlighted. It is important to note that the semisupervised HDP topic model can identify semantically richer and more meaningful terms that are applicable to each lifestyle subdimension for assessing credit risk.




通过将从标准生活方式工具的项目描述中提取的关键词（Plummer，1971；Wells & Tigert，1971；Vyncke，2002）输入半监督 HDP 主题模型（Lau 等人，2018），可以从语义和统计相关的庞大语料库中发现更多相关术语。然后，利用半监督 HDP 主题模型生成的每个相关主题的高概率项来描述每个子维度。表 A2 展示了我们的半监督 HDP 主题模型生成的一些示例主题，其中原始项目描述的播种关键字下划线并突出显示。值得注意的是，半监督 HDP 主题模型可以识别语义更丰富、更有意义的术语，这些术语适用于评估信用风险的每个生活方式子维度。

Similar to the aforementioned methodology of enriching lifestyle subdimension descriptions, we applied the semisupervised topic modeling method (Lau et al., 2018) to enrich the descriptions of three opinion subdimensions, namely opinions about themselves and the future, opinions about business and economics, and opinions about politics and social issues.




与上述丰富生活方式子维度描述的方法类似，我们应用半监督主题建模方法（Lau et al., 2018）来丰富三个意见子维度的描述，即关于自己和未来的意见、关于商业和经济的意见以及关于政治和社会问题的意见。


## Appendix B: Computational Details of the Attention-based DCNN Image Analyzer




## 附录 B：基于注意力的 DCNN 图像分析器的计算细节


Krizhevsky et al. (2012) developed a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) named AlexNet. This network exhibits outstanding image analysis performance in the ImageNet LSVRC-2010 benchmark competition. Figure B1 highlights the architecture of the AlexNet-based DCNN. We utilized the pretrained AlexNet used by the open-source Multilingual Visual Sentiment Ontology (MVSO) system which classifies input images with respect to 4,421 semantic labels, also called adjective-noun pairs (ANPs) such as “Grand Casino” (Jou et al. 2015). To classify input images effectively according to various lifestyle dimensions and subdimensions, we extended the AlexNet-based DCNN with an attention model that assigns stronger weights to high-level features relevant to specific lifestyle dimensions. Figure B2 illustrates our attention model, which accepts an input feature map of a size N\*N\*C, where N\*N represents a two-dimensional (2D) feature map, and C denotes the number of channels. As shown in Figure B2, the attention model first convolves an input feature map of size N\*N\*C to a size of N\*N\*16 using two consecutive convolutional layers.




克里热夫斯基等人。 (2012) 开发了一种名为 AlexNet 的深度卷积神经网络 (DCNN)。该网络在 ImageNet LSVRC-2010 基准竞赛中表现出出色的图像分析性能。图 B1 突出显示了基于 AlexNet 的 DCNN 的架构。我们利用开源多语言视觉情感本体 (MVSO) 系统使用的预训练 AlexNet，该系统根据 4,421 个语义标签对输入图像进行分类，这些语义标签也称为形容词-名词对 (ANP)，例如“Grand Casino”（Jou 等人，2015 年）。为了根据各种生活方式维度和子维度对输入图像进行有效分类，我们使用注意力模型扩展了基于 AlexNet 的 DCNN，该模型为与特定生活方式维度相关的高级特征分配了更强的权重。图 B2 说明了我们的注意力模型，它接受大小为 N\*N\*C 的输入特征图，其中 N\*N 表示二维（2D）特征图，C 表示通道数。如图B2所示，注意力模型首先使用两个连续的卷积层将大小为N\*N\*C的输入特征图卷积到大小为N\*N\*16。


Then, an attention mechanism is utilized through a locally connected 2D layer with a sigmoid activation function to learn suitable attention weights. Following this, a convolutional layer with a linear activation function is added to duplicate the learned weights across the channel dimension c times. The resulting feature map is then transformed into a single feature vector of length c by averaging the weights. This approach ensures that the attention model operates like a weighted averaging operation over the input feature map. Since the upper convolutional layers of the DCNN represent relatively large receptive fields with many potential overlapping regions, an attention model applied to these layers may not be very effective due to the overlapping features. To overcome this issue, we applied the attention model to both low-level convolutional layers and high-level convolutional layers. The architecture of our attentionbased DCNN model for lifestyle pattern image analysis is shown in Figure B3.




然后，通过具有 sigmoid 激活函数的局部连接的 2D 层利用注意力机制来学习合适的注意力权重。接下来，添加具有线性激活函数的卷积层，以在通道维度上复制学习的权重 c 次。然后通过平均权重将所得特征图转换为长度为 c 的单个特征向量。这种方法确保注意力模型的运行就像对输入特征图的加权平均操作。由于 DCNN 的上卷积层代表相对较大的感受野，具有许多潜在的重叠区域，因此，由于重叠特征，应用于这些层的注意力模型可能不是非常有效。为了克服这个问题，我们将注意力模型应用于低级卷积层和高级卷积层。我们用于生活方式模式图像分析的基于注意力的 DCNN 模型的架构如图 B3 所示。

To acquire the attention weights and to fine-tune the softmax layer, we used the backpropagation algorithm with a batch gradient optimization method to the extended DCNN in an end-to-end manner. To increase the size of our labeled image dataset, we utilized a generative adversarial network (GAN) to produce a set of 30,000 labeled images for three different lifestyle dimensions, starting with a seeding input set of 3,000 labeled images (Mao et al., 2019). These highquality augmented images were applied to our end-to-end network fine-tuning process. Specifically, we employed the Adam optimization algorithm with a set of default parameters except the learning rate. We started with a learning rate of 0.001 for the first 30 epochs and then reduced it to 0.0001 for the following 30 epochs.




为了获取注意力权重并微调 softmax 层，我们以端到端的方式将带有批量梯度优化方法的反向传播算法用于扩展的 DCNN。为了增加标记图像数据集的大小，我们利用生成对抗网络 (GAN) 为三个不同的生活方式维度生成一组 30,000 张标记图像，从 3,000 张标记图像的种子输入集开始（Mao 等人，2019）。这些高质量的增强图像被应用于我们的端到端网络微调过程。具体来说，我们采用了 Adam 优化算法，除了学习率之外，还有一组默认参数。我们开始前 30 个 epoch 的学习率为 0.001，然后在接下来的 30 个 epoch 中将其降低到 0.0001。


## Appendix C: The Validity Test of the Proposed Lifestyle-based Risk Constructs




## 附录 C：建议的基于生活方式的风险结构的有效性测试


To evaluate the validity of the proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs, we performed a series of empirical experiments. The validity tests consist of two parts. First, we randomly invited 347 subjects who were frequent Weibo users to participate in a user study. These participants were given a briefing session of one hour, during which they were introduced to the concept of lifestyle patterns and the notions of AIOs, as illustrated in Table 3 of the main paper. They were provided with several examples for each lifestyle dimension and subdimension. Subsequently, the participants were asked to complete a questionnaire that was developed based on the classical instrument for measuring individuals AIO dimensions (Wells & Tigert, 1971). As a result, we were able to obtain the participants’ lifestyle patterns in terms of the corresponding AIO scores, which served as the ground truth. At the end of this stage, a total of 319 valid responses and their corresponding AIO scores were obtained.




为了评估所提出的基于生活方式的风险结构的有效性，我们进行了一系列实证实验。有效性测试由两部分组成。首先，我们随机邀请了 347 名经常使用微博的受试者参与用户研究。这些参与者接受了一个小时的简报会，期间向他们介绍了生活方式模式的概念和 AIO 的概念，如主论文的表 3 所示。他们为每个生活方式维度和子维度提供了几个例子。随后，参与者被要求完成一份基于测量个人 AIO 尺寸的经典仪器开发的调查问卷（Wells & Tigert，1971）。结果，我们能够根据相应的 AIO 分数获得参与者的生活方式模式，作为基本事实。本阶段结束，共获得319份有效回复及其对应的AIO分数。


For the second part of the validity test, we selected 319 subjects who provided valid responses. Each of these participants was asked to write three short articles, with a minimum of 100 words in each article, describing their activities, interests, and opinions. Additionally, they were required to submit 21 photos (with seven photos for each dimension), which best represented their AIO lifestyle dimensions. Then, we applied the mBERT model to identify subjects’ lifestyle patterns from the respective short articles (i.e., the AIO textual features). Moreover, we utilized the attention-based DCNN to extract subjects’ lifestyle patterns from the respective AIO subsets of photos (i.e., the AIO visual features). These extracted textual and visual features were then fed into the corresponding lifestyle-based risk constructs to calculate the respective AIO scores. Accordingly, we obtained a set of system-derived AIO scores for subjects. Table C1 presents the basic descriptive statistics of subjects’ AIO scores obtained from the classical AIO instrument (i.e., the ground truth) and those derived from our proposed opinion risk constructs.




对于有效性测试的第二部分，我们选择了 319 名提供有效回答的受试者。每个参与者都被要求写三篇短文，每篇文章至少 100 字，描述他们的活动、兴趣和观点。此外，他们还需要提交 21 张照片（每个维度七张照片），这最能代表他们的 AIO 生活方式维度。然后，我们应用 mBERT 模型从相应的短文章（即 AIO 文本特征）中识别受试者的生活方式模式。此外，我们利用基于注意力的 DCNN 从相应的 AIO 照片子集中提取受试者的生活方式模式（即 AIO 视觉特征）。然后将这些提取的文本和视觉特征输入到相应的基于生活方式的风险结构中，以计算各自的 AIO 分数。因此，我们获得了一组系统衍生的受试者 AIO 分数。表 C1 展示了从经典 AIO 工具（即事实真相）获得的受试者 AIO 分数的基本描述性统计数据以及从我们提出的意见风险构造中得出的分数。

Furthermore, we applied other state-of-the-art deep learning models to extract lifestyle-related textual features from the short articles provided by the subjects. We also applied other machine learning models to extract visual features from the lifestyle-related photos provided by subjects. These extracted textual and visual features were then fed into the respective lifestyle-based risk constructs to derive the corresponding AIO scores as illustrated before. This allowed us to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs, which were reinforced by different underlying textual or visual analytics models. For text analytics applied to subjects’ short articles, we employed two well-known baseline models, namely the convolutional neural network for text (TextCNN) (Ren et al., 2017), and the long short-term memory network (LSTM) (Hochreiter and Schmidhuber 1997). For visual analytics applied to subjects’ photos, we utilized two well-known baseline models, namely the classical LeNet-5 CNN (LeCun & Bengio, 1998), and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with two hidden layers (Pal & Mitra, 1992).




此外，我们应用其他最先进的深度学习模型从受试者提供的短文中提取与生活方式相关的文本特征。我们还应用其他机器学习模型从受试者提供的与生活方式相关的照片中提取视觉特征。然后将这些提取的文本和视觉特征输入到相应的基于生活方式的风险构造中，以得出相应的 AIO 分数，如前所述。这使我们能够评估所提出的基于生活方式的风险结构的有效性，并通过不同的底层文本或视觉分析模型得到加强。对于应用于受试者短文章的文本分析，我们采用了两种著名的基线模型，即文本卷积神经网络（TextCNN）（Ren 等人，2017）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）（Hochreiter 和 Schmidhuber 1997）。对于应用于受试者照片的视觉分析，我们使用了两个著名的基线模型，即经典的 LeNet-5 CNN (LeCun & Bengio, 1998) 和具有两个隐藏层的多层感知器 (MLP) (Pal & Mitra, 1992)。


To measure the validity of the proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs in relation to the ground truths, we adopted commonly used performance metrics such as Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) (Dhall & Hoey, 2016; Vo et al., 2018). Panels A and B of Table C2 summarize the comparative performance of the proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs powered by various analytics methods. Specifically, Panel A of Table C2 shows that the risk constructs powered by the mBERT model exhibit the highest performance in extracting AIO scores from subjects’ short articles. Our proposed approach outperforms alternative methods based on the TextCNN and LSTM models by 10. 36% and 14.20% in terms of RMSE, respectively. Besides, Panel B of Table C2 illustrates that the risk powered by the attention-based DCNN model achieves the best performance in extracting the AIO scores from subjects’ photos. Our proposed approach outperforms alternative methods based on the LeNet-5 DCNN and MLP with two hidden layers by 6. 38% and 5.08% in terms of RMSE, respectively. Overall, our experimental results validate that the proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs powered by the chosen deep learning models are effective in deriving AIO scores from subjects’ lifestyle-related multimodal contents. These risk constructs exhibit consistent effectiveness even when different analytics methods are utilized to extract textual and visual features from the multimodal contents.




为了衡量所提出的基于生活方式的风险构造相对于基本事实的有效性，我们采用了常用的性能指标，例如均方根误差（RMSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）（Dhall＆Hoey，2016；Vo等人，2018）。表 C2 的 A 组和 B 组总结了由各种分析方法支持的拟议的基于生活方式的风险结构的比较性能。具体来说，表 C2 的 A 组显示，由 mBERT 模型支持的风险构造在从受试者的短文中提取 AIO 分数方面表现出最高的性能。我们提出的方法在 RMSE 方面分别优于基于 TextCNN 和 LSTM 模型的替代方法 10. 36% 和 14.20%。此外，表 C2 的面板 B 表明，基于注意力的 DCNN 模型驱动的风险在从受试者照片中提取 AIO 分数方面取得了最佳性能。我们提出的方法在 RMSE 方面分别优于基于 LeNet-5 DCNN 和具有两个隐藏层的 MLP 的替代方法 6. 38% 和 5.08%。总体而言，我们的实验结果验证了所提出的由所选深度学习模型支持的基于生活方式的风险构造可以有效地从受试者与生活方式相关的多模式内容中得出 AIO 分数。即使使用不同的分析方法从多模式内容中提取文本和视觉特征，这些风险构造也表现出一致的有效性。

## Appendix E: Additional Robustness Checks




## 附录 E：额外的稳健性检查


## Alternative Regression Model




## 替代回归模型


In our main econometric analysis, we applied the ordinary least squares (OLS) regression model to examine the relationship between consumers’ deep-level diversity and their credit risk. However, the OLS model relies on the assumption that the residuals of the variables follow a normal distribution, which may not always be the case, especially for the focal variables. To address this issue, we applied a generalized linear model (GLM) (Serrano-Cinca et al., 2015), which is an extension of the OLS model that can account for predictor errors resulting from non-normally distributed residuals. The corresponding results reported in Table E1 confirm that the findings generated by the GLM model remain qualitatively the same as those generated by using the OLS model, thus reinforcing the validity of our econometric analysis.




在我们的主要计量经济分析中，我们应用普通最小二乘（OLS）回归模型来检验消费者的深层多样性与其信用风险之间的关系。然而，OLS 模型依赖于变量残差服从正态分布的假设，但情况可能并非总是如此，尤其是对于焦点变量。为了解决这个问题，我们应用了广义线性模型 (GLM)（Serrano-Cinca 等人，2015），它是 OLS 模型的扩展，可以解释非正态分布残差导致的预测误差。表 E1 中报告的相应结果证实，GLM 模型生成的结果与使用 OLS 模型生成的结果在质量上保持相同，从而增强了我们计量经济分析的有效性。

## Excluding Socially Active or Inactive Consumers




## 排除社交活跃或不活跃的消费者


Considering the possible disproportionate effects of consumers who demonstrate varying levels of social media engagement (i.e., individuals who spend varying time and efforts on social media platforms), we excluded the top and bottom 25% of consumers based on the volume of social media posts during the sampling period (Wang et al., 2021). We then tested our hypotheses using this subset of data again. The corresponding econometric results are shown in Table E2. Our robustness check confirms that the main econometric analysis results remain robust even after including only the moderately active (inactive) social media users.




考虑到表现出不同社交媒体参与程度的消费者（即在社交媒体平台上花费不同时间和精力的个人）可能产生不成比例的影响，我们根据采样期间社交媒体帖子的数量排除了顶部和底部 25% 的消费者（Wang 等人，2021）。然后我们再次使用这组数据来测试我们的假设。相应的计量经济学结果如表E2所示。我们的稳健性检查证实，即使仅包括中等活跃（不活跃）的社交媒体用户，主要计量经济学分析结果仍然稳健。

## Addressing the Potential Interaction Effects




## 解决潜在的交互影响


Considering the potential interconnectedness of activity risk, interest risk, and opinion risk, we took measures to address this issue by including two-way and three-way interaction terms in the main regression models. The econometric results reported in Table E3 show that the two-way and three-way interaction terms are all insignificant across all three models. This alleviates the concern about the interaction effects between proposed lifestyle-based risk constructs.




考虑到活动风险、利率风险和舆论风险之间潜在的相互关联性，我们采取了措施来解决这个问题，在主要回归模型中包含双向和三向交互项。表 E3 中报告的计量经济学结果表明，双向和三向交互作用项在所有三个模型中均不显着。这减轻了人们对所提出的基于生活方式的风险结构之间相互作用影响的担忧。

## About the Authors




## 关于作者


Qiping Wang is an assistant professor in the Department of Information Management at East China Normal University. Her research interests include social media analytics and AI for fintech. Her works have been published in Decision Support Systems, Information Processing & Management, Journal of Business Research, and IEEE Consumer Electronics Magazine.




王启平，华东师范大学信息管理系助理教授。她的研究兴趣包括社交媒体分析和金融科技人工智能。她的作品发表在《决策支持系统》、《信息处理与管理》、《商业研究杂志》和《IEEE 消费电子杂志》上。


Raymond Y. K. Lau is a professor in the Department of Information Systems at City University of Hong Kong. He is the author of over 200 refereed international journals and conference papers. His research work has been published in renowned journals such as MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering, ACM Transactions on Information Systems, INFORMS Journal on Computing, Production and Operations Management, etc. His research interests include financial technology (fintech), social media analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) for business. He was ranked on Stanford University’s Top 2% Scientists List between 2020 and 2023. He is a senior member of the IEEE and the ACM.




Raymond Y. K. Lau是香港城市大学信息系统系教授。他是 200 多篇国际期刊和会议论文的作者。他的研究成果发表在MIS Quarterly、Information Systems Research、IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence、IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering、ACM Transactions on Information Systems、INFORMS Journal onComputing、Production and Operations Management等知名期刊上。他的研究兴趣包括金融科技（fintech）、社交媒体分析和商业人工智能（AI）。他在 2020 年至 2023 年期间名列斯坦福大学前 2% 科学家名单。他是 IEEE 和 ACM 的高级会员。


Eric W. T. Ngai is a distinguished research professor in the Department of Management & Marketing of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. His current research interests are in the areas of e-commerce, management support systems and AI methods and applications. He has published papers in a number of international journals, including MIS Quarterly, Journal of the Association for Information Systems, Production & Operations Management, Journal of Operations Management, and others.




魏伟棠是香港理工大学管理及市场学系杰出研究教授。他目前的研究兴趣是电子商务、管理支持系统和人工智能方法与应用领域。他在多个国际期刊上发表论文，包括 MIS Quarterly、Journal of the Association for Information Systems、Production & Operations Management、Journal of Operations Management 等。


Jason Bennett Thatcher is the Tandean Rustandy Esteemed Professor at the Leeds School of Business of The University of Colorado Boulder. He is also a professor of management science at the Alliance Manchester Business School at the University of Manchester. Dr. Thatcher’s research examines the influence of individual beliefs and characteristics on adaptive and maladaptive post-adoption information technology use. His work appears in Journal of Management Information Systems, MIS Quarterly, Information Systems Research, Journal of Applied Psychology, Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, and other venues. He is currently mastering the art of dutch oven cooking and preparing for his next mountain man rendezvous.

# 公司比较网络对股票行业表现的动态预测能力


Kun Chen<sup>a,</sup>\*, Peng Luo<sup>b</sup>, Dongming Xu<sup>c</sup>, Huaiqing Wang<sup>a</sup>




陈坤<sup>a,</sup>\*、罗鹏<sup>b</sup>、徐东明<sup>c</sup>、王怀庆<sup>a</sup>


<sup>a</sup> Department of Finance, South University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen 518055, China




<sup>a</sup> 南方科技大学金融系, 深圳 518055


<sup>b</sup> School of Management, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China




<sup>b</sup> 哈尔滨工业大学管理学院, 哈尔滨 150001


<sup>c</sup> UQ Business School, The University of Queensland, St Lucia, QLD 4072, Australia




<sup>c</sup> 昆士兰大学昆士兰大学商学院，圣卢西亚，QLD 4072，澳大利亚


## A R T I C L E I N F O




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


Article history: Received 4 July 2015 Received in revised form 13 June 2016 Accepted 19 July 2016 Available online xxx




文章历史记录： 收到日期 2015 年 7 月 4 日 收到修订版 2016 年 6 月 13 日 接受 2016 年 7 月 19 日 在线提供 xxx


Keywords: Company network Sentiment analysis Vector autoregression Stock sector performance




关键词： 公司网络 情感分析 向量自回归 股票板块表现


## A B S T R A C T




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


As economic integration and business connections increase, companies actively interact with each other in the market in cooperative or competitive relationships. To understand the market network structure with company relationships and to investigate the impacts of market network structure on stock sector performance, we propose the construct of a company comparative network based on public media data and sector interaction metrics based on the company network. All the market network structure metrics are integrated into a vector autoregression model with stock sector return and risk. Several <sup>fi</sup>ndings demonstrate the dynamic relationships that exist between sector interactions and sector performance. First, sector interaction metrics constructed based on company networks are signi<sup>fi</sup>cant leading indicators of sector performance. Interestingly, the interactions between sectors have greater predictive power than those within sectors. Second, compared with the company closeness network, the company comparative network, which labels the cooperative or competitive relationships between companies, is a better construct to understand and predict sector interactions and performance. Third, competitive company interactions between sectors impact sector performance in a slower manner than cooperative company interactions. The <sup>fi</sup>ndings enrich <sup>fi</sup>nancial studies regarding asset pricing by providing additional explanations of company/sector interactions and insights into company management using industry-level strategies.




随着经济一体化和商业联系的增加，企业在市场上积极互动，形成合作或竞争关系。为了理解具有公司关系的市场网络结构，并研究市场网络结构对股票行业绩效的影响，我们提出基于公共媒体数据和基于公司网络的行业互动指标构建公司比较网络。所有市场网络结构指标都集成到具有股票行业回报和风险的向量自回归模型中。多项<sup>调查</sup>证明了行业互动与行业绩效之间存在的动态关系。首先，基于公司网络构建的行业互动指标是行业绩效的重要领先指标。有趣的是，部门之间的相互作用比部门内部的相互作用具有更大的预测能力。其次，与公司紧密度网络相比，公司比较网络标记了公司之间的合作或竞争关系，是理解和预测行业互动和绩效的更好的结构。第三，行业之间的竞争性公司互动对行业绩效的影响比合作性公司互动慢。通过提供对公司/部门互动的额外解释以及使用行业级策略对公司管理的见解，<sup>调查结果</sup>丰富了有关资产定价的<sup>财务</sup>研究。

## 1. Introduction




## 1.简介


As economic integration and business connections increase, companies actively interact with each other in the market in cooperative or competitive relationships. Such relationships often exhibit industry-related features. For example, competitive relationships often exist within an industry because of limited resources and customers. These cooperative relationships usually arise between the supply and demand sides across different industries. Complex interactive business relationships depict the economic market with intra-sector and cross-sector links. These links are helpful for understanding information and shock transfers within and across sectors [1–3]. For example, the spillover effect between sectors was observed during the global <sup>fi</sup>nancial crisis and the recent Chinese stock market crash. Consider the manufacturing sector and the utility sector in the Chinese stock market. Between June and July 2015, the manufacturing sector index<sup>1</sup> decreased by 29.96%, and the utility sector index decreased by 24.93%. The manufacturing sector suffered a much heavier loss than the utility sector. In market interactions, companies in the manufacturing sector have more business connections with other companies than companies in the utility sector. To understand market interactive structures and to explain the spillover effect between sectors, we designed this study.




随着经济一体化和商业联系的增加，企业在市场上积极互动，形成合作或竞争关系。这种关系通常表现出与行业相关的特征。例如，由于资源和客户有限，行业内经常存在竞争关系。这些合作关系通常发生在不同行业的供需双方之间。复杂的互动业务关系描绘了具有部门内和跨部门联系的经济市场。这些链接有助于理解部门内部和部门之间的信息和冲击转移[1-3]。例如，在全球金融危机和最近的中国股市崩盘期间，就观察到了行业之间的溢出效应。考虑一下中国股市的制造业和公用事业部门。 2015 年 6 月至 7 月期间，制造业指数<sup>1</sup>下降了 29.96%，公用事业指数下降了 24.93%。制造业的损失远大于公用事业部门。在市场互动中，制造业企业与其他企业的业务联系多于公用事业企业。为了了解市场互动结构并解释行业之间的溢出效应，我们设计了这项研究。


Previous accounting and <sup>fi</sup>nance studies have begun to establish the connection between market network structure and stock sector performance [1–3]. They have used trading data to create sector relationship graphs, and they have proposed the theory that sectoral shocks are transmitted to other sectors using networks of input and output linkages. However, the trade <sup>fl</sup>ow graphs are rather coarse tools for describing company relationships. In the <sup>fi</sup>eld of information systems (IS), some studies have




之前的会计和金融研究已经开始建立市场网络结构和股票行业绩效之间的联系[1-3]。他们利用交易数据创建部门关系图，并提出了部门冲击通过输入和输出联系网络传递到其他部门的理论。然而，贸易<sup>流</sup>图是描述公司关系的相当粗糙的工具。在信息系统（IS）领域，一些研究已经


K. Chen et al. / Information & Management xxx (2016) xxx–xxx




K.陈等人。 / 信息与管理 xxx (2016) xxx–xxx


constructed company relationship networks based on textual information mining. They have identi<sup>fi</sup>ed the co-occurrences of two companies’ names in documents [4–8]. This method helps to measure the closeness of two companies, but it cannot specify the types of comparative relationship, i.e., competitive relations or cooperative relations. In a real-world market, the relationship between Apple and Samsung is de<sup>fi</sup>nitely different from that between Apple and FoxCom. These different relationships have different spillover effects on stock performance. Therefore, to further investigate the connections between market network structure and stock sector performance, we focus on the following research questions.




基于文本信息挖掘构建公司关系网络。他们在文档中发现了两家公司名称的共现情况 [4-8]。该方法有助于衡量两个公司的紧密程度，但无法指定比较关系的类型，即竞争关系或合作关系。在现实市场中，苹果和三星之间的关系与苹果和富士康之间的关系截然不同。这些不同的关系对股票表现有不同的溢出效应。因此，为了进一步探讨市场网络结构与股票行业绩效之间的联系，我们重点关注以下研究问题。


(1) Does the company comparative network provide a stronger market indicator than the company closeness network?




(1) 公司比较网络是否比公司紧密度网络提供更强的市场指标？


(2) What are the intra-sector and inter-sector network effects on stock sector performance?




(2) 行业内和行业间的网络效应对股票行业绩效有何影响？


(3) What are the dynamics of the relationship between company comparative network metrics and stock sector performance?




(3) 公司比较网络指标与股票行业绩效之间的关系动态如何？


To answer these questions, we use public news<sup>2</sup> as a data source to build company networks because we believe that as an easily accessed Web-based data source, news describes richer business relationships between companies than simple trading data. Moreover, to identify network effects, we construct complex network metrics. First, we use comparative analysis, rather than co-occurrence analysis, to investigate the cooperative (positive) and competitive (negative) relationships identi<sup>fi</sup>ed by public information. Second, we construct inter-sector and intra-sector measurements to compare their different effects.




为了回答这些问题，我们使用公共新闻<sup>2</sup>作为构建公司网络的数据源，因为我们相信新闻作为一种易于访问的基于网络的数据源，比简单的交易数据描述了更丰富的公司之间的业务关系。此外，为了识别网络效应，我们构建了复杂的网络指标。首先，我们使用比较分析，而不是共现分析，来调查公共信息所识别的合作（正向）和竞争（负向）关系。其次，我们构建部门间和部门内的衡量标准来比较它们的不同效果。


In contrast to previous studies that aimed to detect the static correlations between company network and stock performances, our study uses a vector autoregression with exogenous variables (VARX) model to consider all of the intricate dynamic relationships among network metrics and stock sector performance. The timeseries model investigates continuous daily company network effects on stock sector performance, and it captures the dynamics of short- and long-term carryover effects over time.




与之前旨在检测公司网络和股票表现之间静态相关性的研究相比，我们的研究使用外生变量向量自回归（VARX）模型来考虑网络指标和股票行业表现之间所有复杂的动态关系。时间序列模型研究了公司网络对股票行业表现的连续日常影响，并捕捉了短期和长期结转效应随时间的动态变化。


This study has potential implications for theory and practice. Theoretically, our work con<sup>fi</sup>rms and extends <sup>fi</sup>nancial theories by introducing rich market network structure metrics based on public information. We use a time-series model to investigate the dynamic relationships between company comparative networks and stock sector performance. Our research also provides practical suggestions for sector-level strategies such as industry associations and investments.




这项研究对理论和实践具有潜在的影响。从理论上讲，我们的工作通过引入基于公共信息的丰富的市场网络结构指标来证实并扩展了<sup>金融</sup>理论。我们使用时间序列模型来研究公司比较网络与股票行业绩效之间的动态关系。我们的研究还为行业协会和投资等行业层面的战略提供了实用的建议。


We <sup>fi</sup>rst describe the theoretical background and hypotheses in Section 2. Section 3 introduces the data and the measurements. Section 4 describes the time-series model. The <sup>fi</sup>ndings are presented in Section 5. The <sup>fi</sup>nal section discusses the implications.




我们首先在第 2 节中描述理论背景和假设。第 3 节介绍数据和测量结果。第 4 节描述了时间序列模型。 <sup>最终结果</sup>在第 5 节中介绍。<sup>最后</sup>部分讨论了其影响。


## 2. Theoretical background and hypotheses




## 2.理论背景和假设


2.1. Intra-sector and inter-sector network effects on stock sector performance




2.1.行业内和行业间网络对股票行业绩效的影响


Stock sector performance has been demonstrated to be related to sector positions in market networks. In the <sup>fi</sup>nance domain, Aobdia, Caskey, and Ozel [3] constructed an industry network based on trade <sup>fl</sup>ows across different industries, and they found that <sup>fi</sup>rms in central industries are more exposed to systemic risks than other <sup>fi</sup>rms. Acemoglu et al. [1] argued that sectoral risks can be transmitted to other sectors through a network of input and output linkages in a system. Ahern and Harford [2] demonstrated that systematic risks constitute the aggregation of idiosyncratic shocks and that more central sectors in a network of intersectoral trade usually have higher returns because they experience greater exposure to systematic risks.




股票行业的表现已被证明与市场网络中的行业地位相关。在金融领域，Aobdia、Caskey和Ozel[3]基于不同行业的贸易流构建了行业网络，他们发现中心行业的企业比其他企业更容易受到系统性风险的影响。阿塞莫格鲁等人。 [1]认为部门风险可以通过系统中的输入和输出联系网络传递到其他部门。 Ahern 和 Harford [2] 证明，系统性风险构成了特殊冲击的聚合，并且部门间贸易网络中越中心的部门通常具有更高的回报，因为它们承受的系统性风险更大。


Because of the popularity of social media and Web 2.0, company interactions regarding sales, debts, and other <sup>fi</sup>nancial or operating activities are reported in public news in real time. Company networks based on keyword co-occurrence have been widely used to explain and predict <sup>fi</sup>nancial metrics such as company revenue; stock return; and risk. For example; Ma; Sheng; and Pant [6] predicted company revenue relationships based on a company network derived from company citations. Graph-theoretic measurements were used in the classi<sup>fi</sup>cation problem. Jin et al. [5] developed complex longitudinal features for company network evolution and proposed feature selection and prediction models to predict company pro<sup>fi</sup>t and revenue growth. Focusing on stock market performance; Creamer; Ren; and Nickerson [9] tested the relationships among company positions in networks; company stock returns; and volatility.




由于社交媒体和 Web 2.0 的普及，有关销售、债务和其他<sup>财务</sup>或运营活动的公司互动都会在公共新闻中实时报道。基于关键词共现的公司网络已被广泛用于解释和预测财务指标，例如公司收入；股票回报；和风险。例如;马;盛;和 Pant [6] 根据公司引用得出的公司网络预测了公司收入关系。图论测量用于分类问题。金等人。 [5] 为公司网络演化开发了复杂的纵向特征，并提出了特征选择和预测模型来预测公司利润和收入增长。关注股市表现；奶精；任； Nickerson [9] 测试了网络中公司职位之间的关系；公司股票回报；和波动性。


We expect that constructing sector-related metrics based on company networks might also provide a useful indicator for predicting sector performance. Compared with trade <sup>fl</sup>ow, which has been used in previous <sup>fi</sup>nancial studies [2,3], company networks encompass broader business relationships between companies.




我们预计，基于公司网络构建行业相关指标也可能为预测行业绩效提供有用的指标。与之前的<sup>财务</sup>财务研究中使用的贸易<sup>流</sup>流相比[2,3]，公司网络涵盖了公司之间更广泛的业务关系。


H1a. Sector interaction metrics constructed based on company networks have signi<sup>fi</sup>cant predictive relationships with sector performance.




H1a。基于公司网络构建的部门互动指标与部门绩效具有显着的预测关系。


To further investigate the sector-interactive characteristics, we construct two metrics: an inter-sector metric and an intra-sector metric. These two metrics have primarily been used in economics to distinguish trades between different industries or within the same industry [10,11]. These sector metrics have also been used in <sup>fi</sup>nancial studies that have investigated stock performances. Moskowitz and Grinblatt [12] and Aobdia, Caskey, and Ozel [3] demonstrated that inter-sector characteristics have predictive power for assessing <sup>fi</sup>rms’ stock returns. Conversely, Asness, Porter, and Stevens [13] found that intra-sector momentum is superior to inter-sector momentum in explaining stock returns. Because this study aims to inspect how sector-interactive characteristics affect stock returns, we followed the two popular metrics and proposed two competing hypotheses:




为了进一步研究部门交互特征，我们构建了两个指标：部门间指标和部门内指标。这两个指标主要在经济学中用于区分不同行业之间或同一行业内的交易[10,11]。这些行业指标也被用于调查股票表现的金融研究中。 Moskowitz 和 Grinblatt [12] 以及 Aobdia、Caskey 和 Ozel [3] 证明，行业间特征对于评估企业股票回报具有预测能力。相反，Asness、Porter 和 Stevens [13] 发现，在解释股票回报方面，行业内动量优于行业间动量。由于本研究旨在考察行业互动特征如何影响股票回报，因此我们遵循两个流行的指标并提出了两个相互竞争的假设：


H1b. The inter-sector metric has greater predictive power than the intra-sector metric.




H1b。扇区间度量比扇区内度量具有更大的预测能力。


H1b’. The intra-sector metric has greater predictive power than the inter-sector metric.




H1b’。扇区内度量比扇区间度量具有更大的预测能力。


## 2.2. Company comparative networks provide a stronger market indicator than closeness networks




## 2.2.公司比较网络提供比亲密网络更强的市场指标


In the business world, company comparative analysis refers to evaluating a list of company metrics to compare them. The targets are usually similar companies in the same industry, such as Ford versus Toyota and eBay versus Amazon. In IS and marketing research, comparative analysis has been extended to the analysis of comparative opinions between two entities [14–16]. Taking products as an example, comparative analysis aims to identify the relationship of two products as “product A is better than product B” or “product B is better than product A.” For example, Jindal and Liu [17,18] proposed using rules and naïve Bayes classi<sup>fi</sup>ers to identify comparative sentences and relationships in these sentences. Xu et al. [19] used a conditional random <sup>fi</sup>eldbased method to extract the comparative relationships between products from a sentence. Zhang et al. [8] proposed a sentiment analysis method for constructing product comparison networks on a coarse-granularity level. In a company analysis scenario, comparative analysis refers to identifying the relationships between companies, including competitive relationships and cooperative relationships. These relations are often hidden in news reports and other public information. Similar to previous sentiment analysis, competitive relationships usually exhibit negative comparative opinions, and cooperative relationships often feature positive comparative opinions.




在商业领域，公司比较分析是指评估一系列公司指标以进行比较。目标通常是同一行业的类似公司，例如福特与丰田、eBay 与亚马逊。在信息系统和营销研究中，比较分析已扩展到两个实体之间的比较意见分析[14-16]。以产品为例，比较分析的目的是识别两个产品的关系为“产品A优于产品B”或“产品B优于产品A”。例如，Jindal 和 Liu [17,18] 提出使用规则和朴素贝叶斯分类器来识别比较句子以及这些句子中的关系。徐等人。 [19]使用基于条件随机<sup>领域</sup>的方法从句子中提取产品之间的比较关系。张等人。 [8]提出了一种在粗粒度级别上构建产品比较网络的情感分析方法。在公司分析场景中，比较分析是指识别公司之间的关系，包括竞争关系和合作关系。这些关系往往隐藏在新闻报道和其他公共信息中。与之前的情感分析类似，竞争关系通常表现出消极的比较观点，而合作关系通常表现出积极的比较观点。


Although company comparative relationship networks are assumed to constitute a good market indicator, there is little evidence that supports this assumption. Inter-company relationships are currently extracted from textual news based on the cooccurrence of company names. The more frequently the documents mention two companies together, the closer those companies are to each other. This line of reasoning stems from the notion of memory-associative networks [20], and it has strong roots in the co-word analysis literature [21]. Company cooccurrence networks have been used to analyze company <sup>fi</sup>nancial performance.




尽管公司比较关系网络被认为构成了良好的市场指标，但几乎没有证据支持这一假设。目前，公司间关系是根据公司名称的共现性从文本新闻中提取的。文件中提及两家公司的次数越多，这些公司之间的关系就越密切。这种推理源于记忆关联网络的概念[20]，并且在共词分析文献[21]中有着深厚的根源。公司共现网络已用于分析公司<sup>财务</sup>财务绩效。


On the basis of above analysis, we want to build a company comparative network and compare its market predictive power with that of a company co-occurrence network. Thus, the following hypothesis is posited.




在上述分析的基础上，我们想要构建一个公司比较网络，并将其市场预测能力与公司共现网络进行比较。因此，提出以下假设。


H2a. Company comparative analysis provides a stronger sector interactive indicator than company closeness analysis.




H2a。公司比较分析提供了比公司紧密度分析更强的行业互动指标。


To further investigate the sentiment of comparative opinions, we divide company comparative relationships into two categories: cooperative (or positive) relationships and competitive (or negative) relationships. Sentiment analysis has been widely adopted in <sup>fi</sup>nancial studies to predict stock prices [22]. One research stream uses the polarity value of news as a predictive measure of stock performance, e.g., Li et al. [23], Yu, Duan, and Cao [24], and Tetlock, Saar-Tsechansky, and Macskassy [25]. The other stream inspects the differential impacts of positive and negative news on stocks. For example, Chan [26] found less drift for stocks with good news than for those with bad news. Van [27] found that arrival of bad news had a greater impact on volatility than did arrival of good news. This study aims to investigate whether a difference exists between the impact of cooperative (positive) relationships and competitive (negative) relationships. Thus, we propose the following competing hypotheses.




为了进一步研究比较意见的情绪，我们将公司比较关系分为两类：合作（或积极）关系和竞争（或消极）关系。情绪分析已广泛应用于金融研究中来预测股票价格[22]。一个研究流使用新闻的极性值作为股票表现的预测指标，例如，Li 等人。 [23]，Yu、Duan 和 Cao [24]，以及 Tetlock、Saar-Tsechansky 和 ​​Macskassy [25]。另一个流检查正面和负面消息对股票的不同影响。例如，Chan [26] 发现，有好消息的股票比有坏消息的股票漂移更小。 Van [27]发现坏消息的到来对波动性的影响比好消息的到来更大。本研究旨在调查合作（积极）关系和竞争（消极）关系的影响之间是否存在差异。因此，我们提出以下相互竞争的假设。


H2b. Cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics have greater predictive power than competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics.




H2b。合作（积极）部门互动指标比竞争（消极）部门互动指标具有更大的预测能力。


H2b . Competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics have greater predictive power than cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics.




H2b。竞争性（消极）部门互动指标比合作（积极）部门互动指标具有更大的预测能力。


## 2.3. The dynamics of the predictive value of company comparative networks




## 2.3。公司比较网络预测价值的动态


The previous literature has demonstrated the dynamics of stock market responses to word-of-mouth information and social media Luo, Zhang, and Duan [28] compared the short- and long-term effects of social media with those of conventional online behavioral metrics on a <sup>fi</sup>rm’s equity values. They found that social media metrics have faster predictive value. Additionally, Tirunillai and




先前的文献已经证明了股票市场对口碑信息和社交媒体的反应动态。Luo、Zhang 和 Duan [28] 将社交媒体与传统在线行为指标对公司股权价值的短期和长期影响进行了比较。他们发现社交媒体指标具有更快的预测价值。此外，蒂鲁尼莱和


Tellis [29] demonstrated that negative user reviews are related to stock returns, with signi<sup>fi</sup>cant wear-in effects. In dynamic analysis, the wear-in time, which is de<sup>fi</sup>ned as the time required to reach the peak predictive value, is valuable because it suggests a critical time period for decision-making, whereas the wear-out time, which is de<sup>fi</sup>ned as the time required before the predictive value reaches asymptotes, indicates the impact duration.




Tellis [29] 证明，负面用户评论与股票回报相关，具有显着的磨损效应。在动态分析中，磨合时间定义为达到峰值预测值所需的时间，它很有价值，因为它表明了决策的关键时间段，而磨损时间定义为预测值达到渐近线之前所需的时间，表明了影响持续时间。


Theoretically, the information diffusion model [30] has been widely used in the <sup>fi</sup>nance domain to explain the dynamic effects of information on stock returns. Hong et al. [31] demonstrated that bad news travels slowly through the investing public. Chan [26] also found that prices are slow to re<sup>fl</sup>ect bad public news. This study aims to investigate the differences in wear-in and wear-out effects on competitive and cooperative relationships. Thus, we propose the following two groups of competing hypotheses.




理论上，信息扩散模型[30]已广泛应用于金融领域来解释信息对股票收益的动态影响。洪等人。 [31]表明坏消息在投资大众中传播缓慢。 Chan [26] 还发现，价格对负面公共消息的反应速度很慢。本研究旨在调查磨损和磨损对竞争和合作关系影响的差异。因此，我们提出以下两组相互竞争的假设。


H3a. Cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics have a shorter wear-in time than competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics.




H3a。合作（积极）部门互动指标比竞争（消极）部门互动指标的磨合时间更短。


H3a . Competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics have a shorter wear-in time than cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics.




H3a。竞争性（消极）部门互动指标比合作（积极）部门互动指标的磨合时间更短。


H3b. Cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics have a longer wear-out time than competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics.




H3b。合作（正）部门交互指标比竞争（负）部门交互指标具有更长的磨损时间。


H3b . Competitive (negative) sector interactive metrics have a longer wear-out time than cooperative (positive) sector interactive metrics.




H3b。竞争性（消极）部门互动指标比合作（积极）部门互动指标具有更长的磨损时间。


## 3. Data and measurements




## 3. 数据和测量


## 3.1. Data processing




## 3.1.数据处理


The raw data set consists of one year (2013) of Chinese business news for 300 companies in the Shanghai–Shenzhen 300 Index.<sup>3</sup> These companies span 10 sectors<sup>4</sup> within the Chinese stock market, including materials, <sup>fi</sup>nance, energy, and daily consumption, among others. The news stories are collected from a general search portal,<sup>5</sup> which covers 3000+ online sources, including discussion boards, news wires, and blogs. To obtain a clear overview of the information sources, we focus on the top 100 online news sources ranked by a number of news items. We <sup>fi</sup>nd that the top 100 online news sources cover 76.89% of the total news items online (the total number of news items is 946,935). Among these sources, we identify 74 news websites, 21 discussion boards, and 5 blogs. Discussion boards have the largest number of news items because anyone can freely post opinions about companies or stocks on discussion boards. From the 74 news websites, we con<sup>fi</sup>rm that the major Chinese <sup>fi</sup>nancial web media is covered. It includes government-operated media, such as renmin.com and xinhua.com, and 4 major security newspapers in China (cs.com.cn, cnstock.com, p52.net, and zqrb.ccstock.cn). The websites also include some popular <sup>fi</sup>nancial portals such as ifeng.com, hexun. com, jinrongjie.com, eastmony.com, business.sohu.com, and <sup>fi</sup>- nance.sina.com.cn. In this paper, we want to use a broad range of big data to identify company relationships. Both regular news and rumors are important for investigating the impact of market information. Therefore, we use a variety of news sources.




原始数据集包含沪深 300 指数中 300 家公司一年（2013 年）的中国商业新闻。<sup>3</sup>这些公司涵盖中国股市的 10 个板块<sup>4</sup>，包括材料、<sup>金融</sup>能源和日常消费等。这些新闻故事是从通用搜索门户<sup>5</sup>收集的，该门户涵盖 3000 多个在线资源，包括讨论区、新闻专线和博客。为了获得对信息来源的清晰概览，我们重点关注按新闻数量排名的前 100 名在线新闻来源。我们<sup>发现</sup>排名前100位的网络新闻源覆盖了网络新闻总数的76.89%（新闻总数为946,935条）。在这些来源中，我们确定了 74 个新闻网站、21 个讨论区和 5 个博客。讨论区拥有最多的新闻条目，因为任何人都可以在讨论区自由发表有关公司或股票的观点。从74家新闻网站中，我们确认覆盖了中国主要的财经网络媒体。包括人民网、新华网等官办媒体，以及中国四大证券报纸（cs.com.cn、cnstock.com、p52.net、zqrb.ccstock.cn）。这些网站还包括一些流行的金融门户网站，例如凤凰网、和讯网。 com、金融街网、东方财富网、搜狐商业网和<sup>fi</sup>-nance.sina.com.cn。在本文中，我们希望使用广泛的大数据来识别公司关系。常规新闻和谣言对于调查市场信息的影响都很重要。因此，我们使用各种新闻来源。


In the next step, we perform data clearing to delete repeated or forwarded news. According to the ef<sup>fi</sup>cient market hypothesis (EMH) [32], <sup>fi</sup>nancial markets respond to market information in an ef<sup>fi</sup>cient manner. There are three forms of the EMH (the weak form, the semi-strong form, and the strong form), which differ in terms of the information that can be captured in a market (historical public information, current public information, and hidden information). In agreement with the EMH, we must identify the <sup>fi</sup>rst published news to determine the market time of information. In this step, we use the cosine similarity [33] to compare the similarity of documents. For each news item, we fetch documents within a 30-day time window before and after the news is published. With textual features and the cosine similarity, we compare the similarity of two documents. If the similarity between the two documents is greater than 90%, we assume that the two pieces of news are repeated or forwarded news. The one published later is then deleted. After this step, there are 363,421 news items remaining.




下一步，我们进行数据清理，删除重复或转发的新闻。根据有效市场假说（EMH）[32]，金融市场以有效的方式响应市场信息。有效市场假说有三种形式（弱形式、半强形式和强形式），其区别在于可以在市场中捕获的信息（历史公开信息、当前公开信息和隐藏信息）。根据 EMH 的规定，我们必须确定<sup>第一个</sup>发布的新闻，以确定信息的市场时间。在这一步中，我们使用余弦相似度[33]来比较文档的相似度。对于每条新闻，我们都会在新闻发布前后 30 天的时间窗口内获取文档。通过文本特征和余弦相似度，我们比较两个文档的相似度。如果两个文档之间的相似度大于90%，我们就假设这两条新闻是重复或转发的新闻。稍后发布的内容将被删除。此步骤之后，还剩下 363,421 条新闻。


To identify intercompany relationships, we <sup>fi</sup>rst exclude documents that only mention one company or mention more than <sup>fi</sup>ve companies because a document that includes many company names is less important than a document that mentions only a few companies [5]. There are 314,475 news items remaining. The next task is to locate target companies in news stories. In contrast to previous studies [6,7,9,24], which assume that news websites clearly label the news with a target company, we believe that labeling news stories is an important task for cases in which news is collected broadly from the Web. Therefore, we de<sup>fi</sup>ne several rules for identifying target companies. If a company name appears in the title, it is the target company. If no company name appears in the title, we determine the most frequently mentioned target companies by counting the number of times that company names occur.




为了识别公司间关系，我们首先排除仅提及一家公司或提及超过五家公司的文档，因为包含许多公司名称的文档不如仅提及少数公司的文档重要[5]。还剩 314,475 条新闻。下一个任务是在新闻报道中定位目标公司。与之前的研究[6,7,9,24]相比，这些研究假设新闻网站明确地为新闻贴上目标公司的标签，我们认为，对于从网络上广泛收集新闻的情况来说，标记新闻报道是一项重要任务。因此，我们定义了一些识别目标公司的规则。如果标题中出现公司名称，则为目标公司。如果标题中没有出现公司名称，我们通过统计公司名称出现的次数来确定最常被提及的目标公司。


In the subsequent step, we want to identify comparative opinions between companies using machine-learning methods. In the training procedure, we randomly select 3000 news items, which include 8980 sentences containing company names other than the target companies. Then, we manually label these sentences as depicting positive or negative relationships between the appearing company and the target company. The reasons for only using positive and negative labels have previously been summarized [24]. First, a sentence that includes subjective expressions always implies either positive or negative feelings, and “neutral” is a fairly vague concept. Second, no mature methods exist for ef<sup>fi</sup>ciently and accurately identifying neutral sentiments. Using the labeled dataset, we compute the area under the curve (AUC) [34] of different classi<sup>fi</sup>ers based on a 10-fold crossvalidation.




在下一步中，我们希望使用机器学习方法来确定公司之间的比较意见。在训练过程中，我们随机选择了3000条新闻，其中包括8980个包含目标公司以外的公司名称的句子。然后，我们手动将这些句子标记为描述出现的公司和目标公司之间的积极或消极关系。之前已经总结了仅使用正面和负面标签的原因[24]。首先，包含主观表达的句子总是暗示着积极或消极的感受，而“中性”是一个相当模糊的概念。其次，目前还没有成熟的方法来有效、准确地识别中性情绪。使用标记数据集，我们基于 10 倍交叉验证计算不同分类器的曲线下面积 (AUC) [34]。


The receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve illustrates the performance of a binary classi<sup>fi</sup>er system as its discrimination threshold varies. The curve is created by plotting the true positive rate against the false positive rate at various threshold settings. A ROC curve closer to the top-left corner indicates better dynamic performance. How close the ROC curve is to the top-left corner can be re<sup>fl</sup>ected in the AUC measurement, which is also used as an evaluation metric in this paper.




接收器操作特性 (ROC) 曲线说明了二元分类器系统在判别阈值变化时的性能。该曲线是通过绘制不同阈值设置下的真阳性率与假阳性率来创建的。 ROC曲线越靠近左上角，表明动态性能越好。 ROC曲线与左上角的接近程度可以在AUC测量中反映出来，这也是本文的评估指标。


During implementation, we use the bag-of-words feature model,<sup>6</sup> apply information gain (IG)-based feature selection, and tune the thresholds to test different classi<sup>fi</sup>ers’ performances using different feature sizes. We experiment with several popular machine learning algorithms including support vector machines (SVM), decision trees, random forest, and naïve Bayes. The results are displayed in Fig. 1. From Fig. 1 (a), we <sup>fi</sup>nd that classi<sup>fi</sup>ers perform best on the top 820 features ordered by IG. These 820 features are selected when the threshold of IG is set to 0. Fig. 1 (b) shows that the performance of SVM is much better than that of the other classi<sup>fi</sup>ers $( \mathrm { A U C } _ { \mathrm { S V M } } = 0 . 8 0 3 6 ,$ $\mathsf { A U C } _ { \mathrm { D e c i s i o n \_ T r e e } } = 0 . 6 2 1 8$ ${ \sf A U C } _ { \mathrm { N a i v e \_ B a y e s } } = 0 . 7 0 5 8 ,$ $\mathsf { A U C } _ { \mathrm { R a n d o m \_ F o r e s t } } = 0 . 7 1 0 8 )$ . Therefore, we use the 820 features and train the SVM model to classify company comparative sentences. We identify 13,110 negative relationships and 182,970 positive relationships. The ratio between the positive and negative relationships is supported by previous studies of sentiment classi<sup>fi</sup>cation using user-generated content [29].




在实现过程中，我们使用词袋特征模型，<sup>6</sup>应用基于信息增益 (IG) 的特征选择，并调整阈值以测试不同分类器使用不同特征大小的性能。我们尝试了几种流行的机器学习算法，包括支持向量机 (SVM)、决策树、随机森林和朴素贝叶斯。结果如图 1 所示。从图 1 (a) 中，我们<sup>发现</sup>发现分类器在 IG 排序的前 820 个特征上表现最佳。这820个特征是在IG阈值设置为0时选择的。图1(b)表明SVM的性能远优于其他分类器 $( \mathrm { A U C } _ { \mathrm { S V M } } = 0 . 8 0 3 6 ,$ $\mathsf { A U C } _ { \mathrm {决策 \_ T re e } } = 0 . ${ \sf A U C } _ { \mathrm { N a i v e \_ Bayes } } = 0 . 7 0 5 8 ,$ $\mathsf { A U C } _ { \mathrm { R a n d o m \_ For e s t } } = 0 7 1 0 8 )$ 。因此，我们使用820个特征并训练SVM模型来对公司比较句进行分类。我们确定了 13,110 种消极关系和 182,970 种积极关系。之前使用用户生成内容进行情感分类的研究支持了积极关系和消极关系之间的比率[29]。

## 3.2.网络建设


Each node in the network represents a company, and a direct link indicates a comparative relationship between two companies. The corresponding weight of each link indicates the sentiment strength of the comparison relationship. This network is formally de<sup>fi</sup>ned as follows.




网络中的每个节点代表一个公司，直接链接表示两个公司之间的比较关系。每个链接对应的权重表示比较关系的情感强度。该网络的正式定义如下。


Assume that each sentence in the news for target company c1, along with a mention of company c2, is mapped into a comparison tuple $\boldsymbol { \mathsf { t } } = \{ \mathsf { c } 1 , \mathsf { c } 2 , \mathsf { P } / \mathsf { N } \}$ , where P/N indicates that the comparative opinion from c2 to c1 is positive or negative.




假设目标公司 c1 的新闻中的每个句子以及提及公司 c2 都被映射到比较元组 $\boldsymbol { \mathsf { t } } = \{ \mathsf { c } 1 , \mathsf { c } 2 , \mathsf { P } / \mathsf { N } \}$ ，其中 P/N 表示 c2 到 c2 的比较意见c1 为正或负。

## 3.2.1. Company closeness (undirected) networks




## 3.2.1.公司紧密（无向）网络


All n tuples are aggregated to produce a single link with a weight. An edge between nodes c1 and c2 is introduced when $( N _ { p d } + N _ { n d } ) > 0 ,$ , and the weight of the link is $w = ( N _ { p d } + N _ { n d } ) ,$ <sup>ð þ</sup>where $N _ { p d }$ <sup>¼ ð þ</sup>denotes the number of positive sentences and $N _ { n d }$ denotes the number of negative sentences.




所有 n 个元组被聚合以生成具有权重的单个链接。当 $( N _ { p d } + N _ { n d } ) > 0 ,$ 时，在节点 c1 和 c2 之间引入一条边，并且链接的权重为 $w = ( N _ { p d } + N _ { n d } ) ,$ <sup>ð þ</sup>其中 $N _ { p d }$ <sup>¼ ð þ</sup>表示肯定句的数量，$N _ { n d }$表示否定句的数量。


## 3.2.2. Company comparative (directed) networks




## 3.2.2.公司比较（定向）网络


We construct two categories of directed networks: positive and negative networks. In a positive network, an edge from node c1 to $^ { c 2 }$ is introduced when $N _ { p d } > 0 ,$ and the weight is $w = N _ { p d } .$ Similarly, when $N _ { n d } > 0 ,$ , we can introduce a link from c1 to c2 and set the weight as $w = N _ { n d }$




我们构建两类有向网络：正向网络和负向网络。在正网络中，当 $N _ { p d } > 0 ,$ 时，引入从节点 c1 到 $^ { c 2 }$ 的边，权重为 $w = N _ { p d } .$ 类似地，当 $N _ { n d } > 0 ,$ 时，我们可以引入从 c1 到 c2 的边，并将权重设置为 $w = N _ { n d }$


## 3.3. Measurements




## 3.3。测量值


## 3.3.1. Measurements of stock sector performance




## 3.3.1.股票行业表现的衡量


On the basis of previous research [28,35], we use two common measures to determine sector performance: sector return and risk. Return or abnormal return refers to sector stock value beyond what is expected based on the stock market average. Risk, which refers to the vulnerability of sector stock value, can be measured as the standard deviation of the residuals of the returns as follows:




在先前研究的基础上[28,35]，我们使用两种常用的衡量指标来确定行业绩效：行业回报和风险。回报或异常回报是指行业股票价值超出股市平均水平的预期。风险是指行业股票价值的脆弱性，可以用收益残差的标准差来衡量，如下所示：


$R _ { i t } - R _ { f t } = \alpha _ { i } + \beta _ { i } \big ( R _ { m t } - R _ { f t } \big ) + \varepsilon _ { i t } , ( 2$ )where t is the subscript for the time period, $R _ { i t }$ is the return of stock i at time t, $R _ { m t }$ is the average market return represented by the Shanghai Security Exchange Composite Index, $R _ { f t }$ is the risk-free rate of return, $\alpha _ { i }$ is the intercept, and $\varepsilon _ { i t }$ is the model residual. Eq. (2) is processed for a rolling window of 250 trading days before the target day. The abnormal return of stock i (AR ) is measured as the difference between the observed return and the expected return, and the risk is the standard deviation of the model residuals as indicated below:




$R _ { i t } - R _ { f t } = \alpha _ { i } + \beta _ { i } \big ( R _ { m t } - R _ { f t } \big ) + \varepsilon _ { i t } , ( 2$ )其中 t 为时间段的下标，$R _ { i t }$ 为股票 i 在该时间点的收益t，$R _ { m t }$ 为上证综合指数代表的平均市场收益，$R _ { f t }$ 为无风险收益率，$\alpha _ { i }$ 为截距，$\varepsilon _ { i t }$ 为模型残差。等式。 (2) 针对目标日之前 250 个交易日的滚动窗口进行处理。股票 i 的异常收益（AR ）衡量为观测收益与预期收益之间的差值，风险是模型残差的标准差，如下所示：


$$
A R _ {i t} = \left(R _ {i t} - R _ {f t}\right) - \left(\alpha_ {i} + \beta_ {i} \left(R _ {m t} - R _ {f t}\right)\right). \tag {3}
$$




$$
A R _ {i t} = \left(R _ {i t} - R _ {f t}\right) - \left(\alpha_ {i} + \beta_ {i} \left(R _ {m t} - R _ {f t}\right)\right)。 \标记{3}
$$


## 3.3.2. Measurements of sector interaction metrics




## 3.3.2.部门互动指标的测量


The modularity is de<sup>fi</sup>ned as the fraction of edges that fall within the communities minus the expected value of the same quantity if the edges are assigned at random, conditional on the given community memberships and the degree of the vertices [36]. In previous research, the modularity has primarily been used for evaluating community detection [37,38]. This study introduces the modularity to measure the strength of the connection between the nodes within (or between) groups. We divide stocks into different groups based on the sector to which they belong, and we use the modularity to calculate the intra- and inter-group interactions. When computing the interactions of two groups, we treat the two groups as a whole to yield the modularity value of the entire group.




模块化被定义为落在社区内的边的分数减去相同数量的期望值（如果边是随机分配的，条件是给定的社区成员资格和顶点的度数）[36]。在之前的研究中，模块化主要用于评估社区检测[37,38]。本研究引入了模块化来衡量组内（或组间）节点之间的连接强度。我们根据股票所属的行业将股票分为不同的组，并使用模块化来计算组内和组间的相互作用。在计算两个组的交互时，我们将两个组视为一个整体，以得出整个组的模块化值。

Then the modularity Q is given by Leicht and Newman [39] as follows:

1 if $u = v$ and 0 otherwise, and $\begin{array} { r } { m = \sum _ { i j } w _ { i j } } \end{array}$ is the sum of the weights in the entire network.

## 3.3.3. Measurements of sector news sentiment




## 3.3.3.行业新闻情绪的测量


According to the EMH [32], stock price re<sup>fl</sup>ects all available market information. To control the in<sup>fl</sup>uences of market momentum on stock performances, we further measure the sentiment of market news [41]. The method of sentiment classi<sup>fi</sup>cation is similar to what we have undertaken in previous comparable relationship mining. We <sup>fi</sup>rst randomly collect 10,000 documents from the news set for labeling. We then select features and perform the test using the labeled data set.<sup>7</sup> With the trained classi<sup>fi</sup>er model, we perform binary classi<sup>fi</sup>cation of the whole news set. Then, we summarize the daily number of positive news about stock as $\boldsymbol { \mathrm { n _ { p } } }$ and the daily number of negative news about stock as $\mathrm { n } _ { \mathrm { n } } .$ The sentiment score of stock on that day is denoted as $n _ { p } - n _ { n }$ . For a sector measurement, the sentiment of individual stock is accumulated. Although other factors that in<sup>fl</sup>uence sector performance exist, as discussed in the conclusions section, we argue that price and market real-time news have covered the most important and popular parts of the available information in measuring an ef<sup>fi</sup>cient market.




根据有效市场假说[32]，股票价格反映了所有可用的市场信息。为了控制市场动量对股票表现的影响，我们进一步衡量市场新闻的情绪[41]。情感分类的方法和我们之前的可比关系挖掘类似。我们首先从新闻集中随机收集 10,000 个文档进行标记。然后，我们选择特征并使用标记的数据集执行测试。<sup>7</sup>通过经过训练的分类<sup>fi</sup>模型，我们对整个新闻集进行二元分类<sup>fi</sup>。然后，我们将每日有关股票的正面消息数量总结为 $\boldsymbol { \mathrm { n _ { p } } }$，每日有关股票的负面消息数量为 $\mathrm { n } _ { \mathrm { n } } 。$当天股票的情绪得分表示为 $n _ { p } - n _ { n }$ 。对于行业衡量，个股的情绪是累积的。尽管存在影响行业表现的其他因素，正如结论部分所讨论的，我们认为价格和市场实时新闻已经涵盖了衡量有效市场的可用信息中最重要和最受欢迎的部分。
