In Git-based FLOSS development platforms such as GitHub, there are two ways that contributors can add (merge) their tasks to the main project code. Contributors who have “push” (write) access to the project can directly add their tasks to the project. Push events are typically used by the core set of developers to include certain immediate changes in the project. In contrast, contributors who do not have write access to projects will need to issue a request to “pull” their tasks into the project. Once a pull request is submitted, a contributor with push access can choose to merge the task into the main project, suggest modifications, or reject it. This pull-based software development model allows a project to be “forked” (cloned) into a different local branch so that changes can be worked independently of the main project code. When a set of changes is ready to be added to the main project code, the contributors create a pull request. A member of the project’s core team (the contributors with push access) is then responsible for inspecting the changes and merging them into the project’s main project code (Gousios et al. 2014). It is important to note that once a project is forked, the local code branch might include contributions from several contributors who collaborate to implement changes before the pul request is made. Online Appendix A1 details the approach we used to calculate the number of tasks by identifying their associated push and pull request events using the GitHub project log data.




在基于 Git 的 FLOSS 开发平台（例如 GitHub）中，贡献者可以通过两种方式将其任务添加（合并）到主项目代码中。对项目具有“推送”（写入）访问权限的贡献者可以直接将其任务添加到项目中。推送事件通常由核心开发人员使用，以包含项目中的某些即时更改。相比之下，没有项目写入权限的贡献者将需要发出请求将其任务“拉”到项目中。提交拉取请求后，具有推送访问权限的贡献者可以选择将任务合并到主项目中、建议修改或拒绝它。这种基于拉动的软件开发模型允许将项目“分叉”（克隆）到不同的本地分支，以便可以独立于主项目代码进行更改。当一组更改准备好添加到主项目代码中时，贡献者会创建拉取请求。然后，项目核心团队的成员（具有推送访问权限的贡献者）负责检查更改并将其合并到项目的主项目代码中（Gousios 等人，2014 年）。需要注意的是，一旦项目被分叉，本地代码分支可能会包含多个贡献者的贡献，这些贡献者在发出 pul 请求之前协作实施更改。在线附录 A1 详细介绍了我们通过使用 GitHub 项目日志数据识别相关的推送和拉取请求事件来计算任务数量的方法。


## Version and Development Release




## 版本和开发版本


Each version is a snapshot of the project at a point in time. Version control is a system that maintains these snapshots of the project and records changes to a file or set of files over time and between versions. Such a system allows us to revert files back to a previous state, compare changes over time, determine the authors of the changes, and more.




每个版本都是项目在某个时间点的快照。版本控制是一个系统，它维护项目的这些快照并记录一个文件或一组文件随时间和版本之间的更改。这样的系统允许我们将文件恢复到之前的状态、比较一段时间内的更改、确定更改的作者等等。


In Git-based version control systems such as GitHub, we can define version as the snapshot of a project available at the end of a specific day. Based on this definition, we can say that a new version of a project is created on any day that sees tasks being added to the project. The new version differs from the previous version of the project by the tasks that have been included to it through push and pull request events created on that day. A version in this context can be compared with a development release (Michlmayr and Fitzgerald 2012). Development releases are aimed at contributors interested in working on the project or experienced users who need the most updated version of the code. Development releases need not be thoroughly tested and documented (unlike major releases) and may not ensure stability. These releases come with the latest code changes that will be merged to the project after some unit testing and/or some form of peer review. Online Appendix A2 details the approach we used to operationalize versions using the GitHub project log data.




在基于 Git 的版本控制系统（例如 GitHub）中，我们可以将版本定义为特定日期结束时可用的项目的快照。根据这个定义，我们可以说项目的新版本是在任务添加到项目的任何一天创建的。新版本与项目的先前版本的不同之处在于通过当天创建的推送和拉取请求事件包含在其中的任务。这种情况下的版本可以与开发版本进行比较（Michlmayr 和 Fitzgerald 2012）。开发版本面向对项目感兴趣的贡献者或需要最新版本代码的有经验的用户。开发版本不需要经过彻底的测试和记录（与主要版本不同），并且可能无法确保稳定性。这些版本附带最新的代码更改，这些更改将在经过一些单元测试和/或某种形式的同行评审后合并到项目中。在线附录 A2 详细介绍了我们使用 GitHub 项目日志数据来操作版本的方法。


## Degree of Superposition




## 叠加度


While theorizing collaboration through open superposition, Howison and Crowston (2014) contended that in the case of FLOSS projects, tasks are implemented by individual contributors who realize some functional payoff from the creation of the task. Over time, these individual tasks are layered on top of one another to incrementally build the FLOSS software. The superposed organization of individual tasks accomplishes complex tasks by the process of productive deferral.




在通过开放叠加对协作进行理论化时，Howison 和 Crowston（2014）认为，在 FLOSS 项目中，任务是由个人贡献者实施的，他们从任务的创建中获得了一些功能性回报。随着时间的推移，这些单独的任务会相互叠加，以增量方式构建 FLOSS 软件。各个任务的叠加组织通过富有成效的延迟过程完成复杂的任务。


In essence, there are three characteristics of the concept of superposition that need to be considered: (1) task work is accomplished by individual contributors, (2) individual tasks are sequentially layered on top of one another, and (3) productive deferral occurs in order to accomplish complex tasks through (1) and (2). While individual task work and sequential layering of tasks define how superposed the organization of the tasks is, productive deferral provides the mechanism that allows complex work to be accomplished by a superposed organization of tasks. In our operationalization of superposition, we capture the two aspects of superposed organization of tasks, sequential layering of tasks and individual task work. Because productive deferral can be considered as a latent mechanism that allows the orchestration of work through superposition rather than being a part of the measure of superposed work structure, we do not include it in our operationalization of the construct.




本质上，需要考虑叠加概念的三个特征：(1) 任务工作由个体贡献者完成，(2) 个体任务按顺序层叠在另一个之上，(3) 发生富有成效的延迟，以便通过 (1) 和 (2) 完成复杂的任务。虽然单独的任务工作和任务的顺序分层定义了任务组织的叠加方式，但生产性延迟提供了一种机制，允许通过任务的叠加组织来完成复杂的工作。在叠加的操作化中，我们捕获了任务的叠加组织、任务的顺序分层和单独的任务工作的两个方面。因为生产性推迟可以被视为一种潜在机制，允许通过叠加来编排工作，而不是作为叠加工作结构衡量的一部分，所以我们不将其包含在构造的操作化中。


Consequently, we define the construct degree of superposition as the ratio of the total number of versions of the FLOSS project to the total number of individual task contributions to the project. Based on this definition, the degree of superposition for projects increases as they adopt a more sequential and individual development approach, reaching a value of 1 when each individual task contribution represents a new version, and decreasing as projects adopt a more concurrent and collaborative development approach in which more tasks are concurrently added to a version and more contributors are collaboratively working on tasks. We can also conclude that projects that predominantly adopt productive deferral to accomplish complex tasks will exhibit higher degrees of superposition than projects that do not adopt productive deferral mechanisms.




因此，我们将叠加构造度定义为FLOSS项目的版本总数与该项目的单个任务贡献总数的比率。根据这个定义，项目的叠加程度随着项目采用更加顺序和单独的开发方法而增加，当每个单独的任务贡献代表一个新版本时达到值1，并且随着项目采用更加并发和协作的开发方法（其中更多的任务同时添加到版本中并且更多的贡献者协作处理任务）而减少。我们还可以得出结论，主要采用生产性延期来完成复杂任务的项目将比不采用生产性延期机制的项目表现出更高程度的叠加。


Consider the example illustrated in Figure 4. Task A, developed by one contributor, and task B, developed by two contributors, are added to version 0 of the project, which was available on January 15. The addition of tasks A and B results in version 1 of the project on July 17. Task C, developed by three contributors, builds on the version that was available on July 17 (version 1), creating version 2 of the project. Task D, developed by one contributor, task E, developed by two contributors, and task F, developed by three contributors, build on the version available on July 21 (version 2), creating version 3 of the project. This example has six tasks (tasks A–F) and a total of 12 individual task contributions that result in the three versions; hence, the degree of superposition is 3/12, or 0.25.




考虑图 4 中所示的示例。由一名贡献者开发的任务 A 和由两名贡献者开发的任务 B 被添加到 1 月 15 日发布的项目版本 0 中。任务 A 和 B 的添加导致项目于 7 月 17 日发布版本 1。任务 C 由三名贡献者开发，基于 7 月 17 日发布的版本（版本 1）构建，创建了项目的版本 2。任务 D 由一名贡献者开发，任务 E 由两名贡献者开发，任务 F 由三名贡献者开发，均以 7 月 21 日可用的版本（版本 2）为基础构建，创建了该项目的版本 3。此示例有 6 个任务（任务 A-F）和总共 12 个单独的任务贡献，从而产生了三个版本；因此，叠加度为 3/12，即 0.25。


## Methodology




## 方法论


To understand the mechanisms through which superposition influences FLOSS projects, we conducted an empirical analysis of FLOSS projects hosted on GitHub. GitHub’s popularity among programmers, its developer-focused environment, its integrated social features, and the availability of detailed metadata make it a popular environment for FLOSS research (Kalliamvakou et al. 2014). Our adopted methodology comprised three steps: data collection, measurement, and analysis. In the data-collection step, we collected detailed project log data for a sample of FLOSS projects from the GitHub (GH) Archive database (https://www.gharchive.org). In the measurement step, using the collected project log data, we measured the dependent, independent, and control variables. Finally, in the analysis step, we carried out regressions at the project level to test the hypothesized relationships. By improving the data-collection, measurement, and analysis methods over the course of several months, we tried to ensure that the methodology we adopted was exhaustive and robust.




为了了解叠加影响 FLOSS 项目的机制，我们对 GitHub 上托管的 FLOSS 项目进行了实证分析。 GitHub 在程序员中的受欢迎程度、其以开发人员为中心的环境、集成的社交功能以及详细元数据的可用性使其成为 FLOSS 研究的流行环境（Kalliamvakou 等人，2014 年）。我们采用的方法包括三个步骤：数据收集、测量和分析。在数据收集步骤中，我们从 GitHub (GH) Archive 数据库 (https://www.gharchive.org) 收集了 FLOSS 项目样本的详细项目日志数据。在测量步骤中，使用收集的项目日志数据，我们测量了因变量、自变量和控制变量。最后，在分析步骤中，我们在项目层面进行了回归，以测试假设的关系。通过在几个月的时间里改进数据收集、测量和分析方法，我们试图确保我们采用的方法是详尽和稳健的。


## Data Collection




## 数据收集


We employed Google’s bigquery tool to query the archived project log data available in the GH Archive database (Grigorik 2012). Because this database is large (\~432 GB, with 134 million rows for the year 2014 alone; Google 2014), we needed the bandwidth provided by a tool like Google’s bigquery to run queries and export the results. We restricted our analysis to projects that were started during the first five months of 2014 to reduce the number and size of queries. Further, the event-level data collection for each project was restricted to the development work that was undertaken in the year 2014. In all, we ran more than 30,000 queries over a period of 20 days.




我们使用 Google 的 bigquery 工具来查询 GH Archive 数据库中可用的存档项目日志数据 (Grigorik 2012)。由于该数据库很大（约 432 GB，仅 2014 年就有 1.34 亿行；Google 2014），因此我们需要 Google bigquery 等工具提供的带宽来运行查询并导出结果。我们将分析限制在 2014 年前 5 个月内启动的项目，以减少查询的数量和规模。此外，每个项目的事件级数据收集仅限于 2014 年进行的开发工作。总共，我们在 20 天内运行了超过 30,000 次查询。


While GitHub provides a rich data set, care needs to be taken to overcome common perils in using this data set (Kalliamvakou et al., 2014). For example, projects that do not involve software development, are too small, or are mirrors or personal stores should be avoided. The complete list of perils identified by Kalliamvakou et al. (2014) and a summary of the methods we adopted to address these appear in Online Appendix A3. After filtering the data set to address the perils, we were left with a sample of 6,571 FLOSS projects, of which 3,086 are individual owned and 3,485 are organization owned, that we considered for our analysis.




虽然 GitHub 提供了丰富的数据集，但在使用该数据集时需要注意克服常见的危险（Kalliamvakou 等人，2014 年）。例如，不涉及软件开发、太小、或者是镜像或个人商店的项目应该避免。 Kalliamvakou 等人确定的危险的完整列表。 (2014) 以及我们为解决这些问题而采取的方法的摘要出现在在线附录 A3 中。在过滤数据集以解决危险后，我们留下了 6,571 个 FLOSS 项目样本，其中 3,086 个为个人所有，3,485 个为组织所有，我们将其用于分析。


## Measurement




＃＃ 测量


GitHub offers a good environment for measuring the degree of superposition and studying its relationship to the project’s popularity. More specifically, two features of GitHub make it ideal for this research




GitHub 提供了一个很好的环境来衡量叠加程度并研究其与项目受欢迎程度的关系。更具体地说，GitHub 的两个功能使其成为本研究的理想选择

• Number of individual task contributions = (1+2+3+1+2+3) = 12

![](/api/attachments/KGDF4WJB/fulltext/images/dfbc59929c9362a88985f6a999b900902db67f2d426de6215d26b3bfb14228e1.jpg)

First, the granularity of the data and the availability of time stamps for all events enabled us to clearly identify the versions of each project and the task order, which allowed us to operationalize the degree of superposition. Second, the availability of detailed contributor- and project-specific data allowed us to measure the dependent variable and create a rich set of controls. The different variables that we used in this research and their measures are detailed in the following subsections.




首先，数据的粒度和所有事件时间戳的可用性使我们能够清楚地识别每个项目的版本和任务顺序，这使我们能够操作化叠加程度。其次，详细的贡献者和项目特定数据的可用性使我们能够测量因变量并创建一组丰富的控制。我们在本研究中使用的不同变量及其测量方法将在以下小节中详细介绍。


Dependent Variable. Popularity of project is the dependent variable of interest for this research. As mentioned in the section “FLOSS Project Success,” we consider the popularity of the project to be an important measure of FLOSS project success. In GitHub, users can “star” projects to keep track of those they find interesting and also to show their appreciation for these projects (GitHub 2017a, Borges and Tulio Valente 2018). The number of stars a project has received indicates approximately the number of people who are interested in and show support for that project. Count of stars is therefore a commonly used measure for identifying popular projects in the GitHub environment: GitHub itself uses stars to identify trending projects and in its project rankings (GitHub 2017a), Jarczyk et al. (2014) use the log transformation of the number of stars as a measure of the quality and popularity of GitHub projects, and Tsay et al. (2014) use the number of stars as a measure of popularity and project establishment. In recognition of the usefulness of count of stars as a measure of popularity, we adopt it as the dependent variable to test our relationships.




因变量。项目的受欢迎程度是本研究感兴趣的因变量。正如“FLOSS项目成功”一节中提到的，我们认为项目的受欢迎程度是衡量FLOSS项目成功的重要标准。在 GitHub 中，用户可以为项目“加注星标”，以跟踪他们感兴趣的项目，并表达对这些项目的欣赏（GitHub 2017a，Borges 和 Tulio Valente 2018）。项目获得的星星数量大致表明对该项目感兴趣并表示支持的人数。因此，星星数量是识别 GitHub 环境中热门项目的常用衡量标准：GitHub 本身使用星星来识别趋势项目及其项目排名 (GitHub 2017a)，Jarczyk 等人。 (2014) 使用星星数量的对数变换来衡量 GitHub 项目的质量和受欢迎程度，Tsay 等人。 （2014）使用明星数量作为受欢迎程度和项目建立的衡量标准。认识到星星数量作为受欢迎程度衡量标准的有用性，我们采用它作为因变量来测试我们的关系。


Popularity measures have often been operationalized using count of downloads (e.g., Crowston et al. 2006, Grewal et al. 2006, Midha and Palvia 2012, Setia et al. 2012). In GitHub, a potential problem of using the count of downloads as a measure of FLOSS popularity is that this measure is available only for major releases of projects. Code reuse in GitHub can occur by forking a project, developing on the forked branch, and then merging that branch into a different project (without the actual download of a major release). This aspect of code reuse is not captured by the count of downloads. Further, this measure could underestimate the popularity of younger projects or projects that take longer to be packaged into a major release and distributed to end users. Because our study considers the first year in the life of a project, a relatively smaller percentage of projects in our sample sees major releases for which GitHub provides a count of downloads. Hence, we adopt count of stars rather than downloads as the measure of popularity in our study.




流行度测量通常使用下载计数来实施（例如，Crowston 等人，2006 年；Grewal 等人，2006 年；Midha 和 Palvia，2012 年；Setia 等人，2012 年）。在 GitHub 中，使用下载次数作为 FLOSS 流行度衡量标准的一个潜在问题是，该衡量标准仅适用于项目的主要版本。 GitHub 中的代码重用可以通过分叉一个项目、在分叉的分支上进行开发，然后将该分支合并到另一个项目中（无需实际下载主要版本）来实现。下载计数并未反映代码重用的这一方面。此外，这种衡量方法可能会低估较年轻的项目或需要较长时间才能打包到主要版本并分发给最终用户的项目的受欢迎程度。由于我们的研究考虑的是项目生命周期的第一年，因此样本中只有相对较小比例的项目看到了 GitHub 提供下载计数的主要版本。因此，我们在研究中采用星星数而不是下载量作为受欢迎程度的衡量标准。


Independent Variables. To study the influences of the degree of superposition and ownership on the popularity of a FLOSS project, we employed two independent variables, degree of superposition and project ownership. The degree of superposition was measured as the ratio of the total number of versions of the project to the total number of individual task contributions made to the project (refer to the section “Construct Development”). The method we adopted for identifying tasks within a project is based on the understanding that a task is a sequence of actions that leads to a change in the shared output of the project (Howison and Crowston 2014). The project logs maintained by GitHub provide detailed information regarding the timing and ownership of push and pull request events that allowed us not only to identify tasks for each project but also determine the version to which they belong. Online Appendices A1 and A2 detail the approaches that we adopted to identify tasks and versions leveraging the workflow of Gitbased FLOSS development platforms. Based on this operationalization, the degree of superposition for a project takes a value between 0 and 1. If degree of superposition = 1, all of the project’s tasks were implemented individually and added sequentially, with each individual task contribution representing a new version of the project. The degree of superposition decreases as a project adopts a concurrent development approach and approaches 0 as a greater number of individual task contributions get piled onto individual versions of the project.




自变量。为了研究叠加度和所有权对FLOSS项目受欢迎程度的影响，我们采用了两个自变量：叠加度和项目所有权。叠加程度用项目版本总数与对该项目做出的单个任务贡献总数的比率来衡量（参见“构建开发”部分）。我们用于识别项目中任务的方法基于这样的理解：任务是导致项目共享输出发生变化的一系列操作（Howison 和 Crowston 2014）。 GitHub 维护的项目日志提供了有关推送和拉取请求事件的时间和所有权的详细信息，这些信息使我们不仅可以识别每个项目的任务，还可以确定它们所属的版本。在线附录 A1 和 A2 详细介绍了我们利用基于 Git 的 FLOSS 开发平台的工作流程来识别任务和版本的方法。基于这种操作化，项目的叠加度取0到1之间的值。如果叠加度= 1，则项目的所有任务都单独实施并按顺序添加，每个单独的任务贡献代表项目的新版本。当项目采用并发开发方法时，叠加程度会降低，并且随着更多数量的单独任务贡献堆积到项目的各个版本上，叠加程度会接近 0。


To study the moderating influence of project ownership on the relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of a FLOSS project, we also used a flag, project ownership, that takes the value 1 if the project is owned by an organization and 0 if it is owned by an individual. Organizations in GitHub are shared accounts that can be used to centralize a group’s code and adopt a workflow that is suitable for business (Neath 2010). This workflow provides multiple levels of permission controls that enable companies to create nested teams with hierarchical access to the code, allowing them to replicate their organization structure on GitHub. Most companies hosting projects on GitHub use their own organization accounts to consolidate monitoring and management of their FLOSS projects. GitHub recognizes projects that are owned by organizations and makes this attribute publicly available through its application programming interface. By accessing this GitHubdetermined project attribute, we identify whether a project is owned by an organization or an individual.




为了研究项目所有权对FLOSS项目叠加程度和受欢迎程度之间关系的调节影响，我们还使用了一个标志，即项目所有权，如果项目为组织所有，则值为1；如果项目为个人所有，则值为0。 GitHub 中的组织是共享帐户，可用于集中一个组的代码并采用适合业务的工作流程（Neath 2010）。此工作流程提供了多个级别的权限控制，使公司能够创建具有对代码的分层访问权限的嵌套团队，从而允许他们在 GitHub 上复制其组织结构。大多数在 GitHub 上托管项目的公司都使用自己的组织帐户来整合对其 FLOSS 项目的监控和管理。 GitHub 识别组织拥有的项目，并通过其应用程序编程接口公开提供此属性。通过访问此 GitHub 确定的项目属性，我们可以识别项目是由组织还是个人拥有。


Control Variables. GitHub maintains detailed projectand user-level data, which allow the introduction of a rich set of control variables. Consequently, we identified two kinds of control variables for our analysis, contributor/owner characteristics and project characteristics.




控制变量。 GitHub 维护详细的项目和用户级数据，这允许引入一组丰富的控制变量。因此，我们确定了两种用于分析的控制变量：贡献者/所有者特征和项目特征。


Contributor/Owner Characteristics. <sub>We identified</sub> three measures to control the influence of contributor and project owner characteristics on the relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of a project. An increase in the number of contributors is often associated with an increase in the number of task contributions and consequently an increase in the popularity of the project (Stewart et al. 2006, Subramaniam et al. 2009). At the same time, as the number of contributors increases, there is a tendency to adopt a more concurrent form of development to coordinate multiple contributors. In addition to the number of contributors, the average number of contributions per contributor is also expected to positively influence the popularity of a project (Subramaniam et al. 2009). Hence, we also control for the average number of commits per contributor, where a commit is any change or set of changes that is locally saved to file (GitHub 2017b). Lastly, we control for the experience of the project owner in terms of the number of FLOSS projects in which the owner participates. The existence and density of prior ties between the project owner and contributors have been found to positively influence the probability that the project will attract more individuals (Rebeca and Garc´ıa 2009). Based on this finding, we would expect that the experience of the project owner plays a role in enhancing the popularity of the FLOSS project.




贡献者/所有者特征。 <sub>我们确定了</sub>三种措施来控制贡献者和项目所有者特征对叠加程度与项目受欢迎程度之间关系的影响。贡献者数量的增加通常与任务贡献数量的增加相关，从而导致项目受欢迎程度的增加（Stewart 等人，2006 年；Subramaniam 等人，2009 年）。同时，随着贡献者数量的增加，有一种趋势是采用更加并发的开发形式来协调多个贡献者。除了贡献者数量之外，每个贡献者的平均贡献数量也有望对项目的受欢迎程度产生积极影响（Subramaniam 等人，2009 年）。因此，我们还控制每个贡献者的平均提交次数，其中提交是本地保存到文件的任何更改或一组更改（GitHub 2017b）。最后，我们根据业主参与的FLOSS项目数量来控制项目业主的经验。人们发现项目所有者和贡献者之间先前关系的存在和密度会对项目吸引更多个人的可能性产生积极影响（Rebeca 和 Garc´ıa 2009）。基于这一发现，我们预计项目业主的经验对提高FLOSS项目的受欢迎程度起到了一定的作用。


<sup>Project Characteristics.</sup> We identified eight measures to control for different project characteristics. First, we controlled for project size, measured as megabytes of code. Smaller projects are usually associated with fewer contributors and contributions than are larger projects. Thus, projects of different sizes are expected to differ in terms of their capacity for attracting contributors and coordinating new tasks (Setia et al. 2012). Second, we controlled for the number of programming languages. While projects that involve multiple languages may have greater functionality, coordinating contributions across different languages can be challenging. Third, we controlled for the average task size, measured as the average number of commits made within the project’s tasks. As the tasks within a project increase in size and complexity, the average number of commits per task increases. It is important to control for the average task size in the project because projects with a greater number of large tasks will have a higher need for cowork than projects with smaller tasks. Fourth, popular FLOSS projects see continuous enhancement and maintenance of the code, which results in multiple stable versions delivered one after another (Raymond 1998). The project completion flag identifies whether the project ended within the data-collection period (i.e., in 2014) and became inactive. Because popular projects show continuous activity, we expected project completion or a short project life to be negatively correlated with the popularity of the project. Fifth, we controlled for the type of license attributed to the project. We classify licenses as being either restrictive or permissive. FLOSS software that adopts a restrictive license follows a “copyleft” policy that forces any enhancement made to the software to be bound by the same or compatible license scheme (Singh and Phelps 2013) Permissive licenses, by contrast, do not have the copyleft feature and allow contributors to use opensource software to build proprietary or “closed” software. Previous studies of the impact of the FLOSS license type have found that the type of license used influences a project’s popularity and the number and productivity of contributors (e.g., Colazo et al. 2005 Stewart et al. 2006). Hence, we used the flag restrictive license regime to control the effect of the type of license (restrictive versus permissive) on the popularity of a project. Sixth, we controlled for the average idle time between tasks in a project. The average idle time between tasks in a project is a measure of the activity level of the project. Popular FLOSS projects have been found to show high activity, with releases occurring early and often (Raymond 1998). This relationship has also been empirically observed, with project activity found to positively impact the popularity of the project (Subramaniam et al. 2009). We also include two fixed effects: the fixed effects of the main programming language and the fixed effects of the month of creation. Despite mixed results in the extant literature, the type of programming language used has been found to be an important antecedent to FLOSS project success (Subramaniam et al. 2009). Further, the ease of coordinating development activities may differ across programming languages, with languages more conducive to modular architecture displaying greater ease of coordination (Baldwin and Clark 2006). We controlled for these effects by including a dummy variable for each programming language used in our sample. Lastly, time is expected to influence the nature of routines associated with FLOSS projects (Lindberg 2015). Because our analysis includes projects that were started during the first five months of 2014, it was necessary to include the fixed effects of the month of creation to control for the influence of time on the hypothesized relationships.




<sup>项目特征。</sup>我们针对不同的项目特征确定了八项控制措施。首先，我们控制项目大小（以兆字节代码为单位）。较小的项目通常比较大的项目涉及更少的贡献者和贡献。因此，不同规模的项目在吸引贡献者和协调新任务的能力方面预计会有所不同（Setia et al. 2012）。其次，我们控制了编程语言的数量。虽然涉及多种语言的项目可能具有更强大的功能，但协调不同语言的贡献可能具有挑战性。第三，我们控制了平均任务大小，以项目任务中的平均提交次数来衡量。随着项目中任务的规模和复杂性增加，每个任务的平均提交次数也会增加。控制项目中的平均任务大小非常重要，因为具有大量大型任务的项目比具有较小任务的项目对协作的需求更高。第四，流行的FLOSS项目会不断增强和维护代码，从而导致多个稳定版本相继交付（Raymond 1998）。项目完成标志标识项目是否在数据收集期间（即 2014 年）结束并变为非活动状态。由于受欢迎的项目表现出持续的活动，我们预计项目完成或较短的项目生命周期与项目的受欢迎程度呈负相关。第五，我们控制了项目的许可证类型。我们将许可证分为限制性许可证和宽松性许可证。采用限制性许可证的 FLOSS 软件遵循“copyleft”政策，强制对软件所做的任何增强都受到相同或兼容的许可证方案的约束（Singh 和 Phelps 2013）相比之下，宽松许可证不具有 Copyleft 功能，并允许贡献者使用开源软件来构建专有或“封闭”软件。先前对 FLOSS 许可证类型影响的研究发现，所使用的许可证类型会影响项目的受欢迎程度以及贡献者的数量和生产力（例如，Colazo 等人，2005 年；Stewart 等人，2006 年）。因此，我们使用标志限制性许可制度来控制许可类型（限制性与许可性）对项目受欢迎程度的影响。第六，我们控制了项目中任务之间的平均空闲时间。项目中任务之间的平均空闲时间是项目活动水平的度量。人们发现流行的 FLOSS 项目表现出很高的活跃度，发布较早且频繁（Raymond 1998）。这种关系也已通过经验观察到，项目活动对项目的受欢迎程度产生积极影响（Subramaniam 等，2009）。我们还包括两个固定效果：主要编程语言的固定效果和创建月份的固定效果。尽管现有文献的结果好坏参半，但所使用的编程语言类型已被发现是 FLOSS 项目成功的重要前提（Subramaniam 等人，2009 年）。此外，协调开发活动的难易程度可能因编程语言而异，更有利于模块化架构的语言显示出更容易的协调（Baldwin 和 Clark 2006）。我们通过为示例中使用的每种编程语言添加一个虚拟变量来控制这些影响。最后，时间预计会影响与 FLOSS 项目相关的惯例的性质（Lindberg 2015）。因为我们的分析包括 2014 年前 5 个月开始的项目，所以有必要包括创建月份的固定效应，以控制时间对假设关系的影响。


## Analysis




＃＃ 分析


We include two regression models in our analysis. The main regression model is based on ordinary least squares (OLS) with the log transformation of the number of stars as the dependent variable. The second model, based on the negative binomial approach, addresses the count nature of the dependent variable. Hypothesis 1 predicts that the degree of superposition has an inverted U-shaped relationship with the popularity of a project. To test this hypothesis, we included the square of the degree of superposition and created a polynomial regression model. Hypothesis 2 predicts that the project ownership moderates the relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of the project. To test this hypothesis, we introduced the interactions of project ownership with the degree of superposition terms in the regression models. The following section details the results of the regression models and the checks we employed to ensure the validity of the results.




我们的分析中包括两个回归模型。主要回归模型基于普通最小二乘法 (OLS)，以恒星数量的对数变换作为因变量。第二个模型基于负二项式方法，解决因变量的计数性质。假设1预测叠加程度与项目的热度呈倒U型关系。为了检验这个假设，我们引入了叠加度的平方并创建了一个多项式回归模型。假设2预测项目所有权调节叠加程度与项目受欢迎程度之间的关系。为了检验这个假设，我们在回归模型中引入了项目所有权与叠加项程度的相互作用。以下部分详细介绍了回归模型的结果以及我们为确保结果的有效性而采用的检查。


## Models and Results




## 模型和结果


From Table 2, which provides the means, standard deviations, and correlation coefficients for the variables used in the analyses, we can observe a strong positive skew in some of the variables. In particular, the residuals of the variables stars, size of project, and average task size show significant positive skew in their distribution.




表 2 提供了分析中使用的变量的平均值、标准差和相关系数，从表 2 中，我们可以观察到某些变量存在强烈的正偏斜。特别是，变量星号、项目规模和平均任务规模的残差在分布中显示出显着的正偏态。


To normalize the positively skewed data, statistical texts commonly recommend the use of log transformations (Carte and Russel 2003, Singh et al. 2013). After log transformation of the variables stars, size of project, and average task size, their residuals were found to closely match a normal distribution. Moreover, pre vious research that uses the number of GitHub stars as an outcome measure recommends using its log transformation. For example, Jarczyk et al. (2014) used the log transformation of the number of stars to measure project quality because of the power-law distribution that GitHub stars follow.




为了对正偏态数据进行标准化，统计文本通常建议使用对数变换（Carte and Russel 2003，Singh et al. 2013）。对变量星号、项目规模和平均任务规模进行对数变换后，发现它们的残差与正态分布紧密匹配。此外，之前使用 GitHub 星数作为结果衡量标准的研究建议使用其对数转换。例如，Jarczyk 等人。 (2014) 由于 GitHub 星数遵循幂律分布，因此使用星数的对数变换来衡量项目质量。


Table 3 provides the results of the regression models we employed. Models 1a–c provide the results of the stepwise log-linear OLS regression analysis. Models 2a–c provide the results of the negative binomial regression analysis with the number of stars as the dependent variable. Because the inclusion of higherorder terms (the square of the degree of superposition and the interaction terms) in the regression equation may lead to computational errors owing to multicollinearity (Aiken and West 1991), we also tested the results for the mean-centered model. In the meancentered model, multicollinearity, as indicated by the variance inflation factor, is less than 5 for all constructs This indicates that the results are not confounded by multicollinearity (Hair et al. 2010). Further, to correct for any potential heteroscedasticity in the error terms, we used heteroscedasticity-consistent standard errors in all our models (Hayes and Cai 2007).




表 3 提供了我们采用的回归模型的结果。模型 1a–c 提供逐步对数线性 OLS 回归分析的结果。模型 2a-c 提供了以星星数量作为因变量的负二项式回归分析的结果。由于回归方程中包含高阶项（叠加度和交互项的平方）可能会因多重共线性而导致计算错误（Aiken 和 West 1991），因此我们还测试了均值中心模型的结果。在均值中心模型中，所有结构的多重共线性（如方差膨胀因子所示）均小于 5，这表明结果不会因多重共线性而混淆（Hair 等人，2010 年）。此外，为了纠正误差项中任何潜在的异方差性，我们在所有模型中使用了异方差性一致的标准误差（Hayes 和 Cai 2007）。


## Hypothesis Linking the Degree of Superposition and Project Popularity




## 叠加程度与项目热度关联的假设


Hypothesis 1 predicts a nonlinear relationship be tween the degree of superposition and the popularity of a FLOSS project. This nonlinear relationship resembles an inverted U-shaped curve, with the turning point representing the maximum value of project popularity. To test Hypothesis 1, we regressed the dependent variable (project popularity) on the independent variable (degree of superposition) and its squared term. It is essential to retain the linear term degree of superposition (Aiken and West 1991) because leaving it out would assume that the turning point occurs at 0 degrees of superposition (Haans et al. 2015). We followed the three-step procedure proposed by Lind and Mehlum (2010) to confirm th presence of an inverted U-shaped relationship in Model 1b. In the first step, we checked the direction and significance of the coefficient of the squared term degree of superposition. From Table 3, Model 1b, we can see that $\beta _ { 2 } \left( - 2 . 4 5 3 , p < 0 . 0 1 \right)$ is negative and signifi cant, a necessary condition for the existence of an inverted U-shaped relationship (Lind and Mehlum 2010, Haans et al. 2015). In the next step, we checked whether the slopes at both ends of the data range (i.e., when the degree of superposition = 0 or 1) are significant and in the directions characterizing an inverted U. For an inverted U-shaped relationship to exist, the slopes at the low end of the range of the independent variable (i.e., when the degree of superposition is 0) should be positive and significant, whereas those at the high end of the range (i.e., when the degree of superposition is 1) should be negative and significant (Lind and Mehlum 2010, Haans et al. 2015,). We tested Model 1b to confirm that the slope when the degree of superposition is 0 is positive and significant $( d y / d x _ { x = 0 } = + 2 . 8 6 6 , p < 0 . 0 1 )$ and that when the degree of superposition is 1, the slope is negative and significant $( d \bar { y } / d \bar { x } _ { x = 1 } = - 2 . 0 2 3 , p < 0 . 0 \bar { 1 } )$ . In the last step, we checked whether the turning point lies within the data range for the degree of superposition (i.e., the turning point should lie between the values 0 and 1 for the degree of superposition). The turning point for the quadratic equation is given b $- ( \beta _ { 1 } / \bar { 2 } \bar { \beta _ { 2 } } ) y =$ $\mathtt { a } ^ { * } x ^ { 2 } + \mathtt { b } ^ { * } x + \mathtt { c } - b / ( 2 ^ { * } \mathrm { a } ) .$ <sup>5</sup> Because our sample was large, the delta method (Rao 1972) could be used to calculate the confidence interval. Using this method, the test for the 99% confidence interval for the turning point confirmed that it lies between 0 and 1 0.530 < $( - \beta _ { 1 } / 2 \beta _ { 2 } ) = 0 . 5 8 6 < 0 . 6 4 2 )$ . The results of these three tests provide the necessary and sufficient conditions (Lind and Mehlum 2010) to support Hypothesis 1. That is, the popularity of a FLOSS project increases with an increase in the degree of superposition unti it reaches a maximum (the turning point), after which any further increase in the degree of super position will result in a decrease in the popularity of the project.




假设1预测了FLOSS项目的叠加程度和受欢迎程度之间存在非线性关系。这种非线性关系类似于一条倒U型曲线，拐点代表项目受欢迎程度的最大值。为了检验假设 1，我们将因变量（项目受欢迎程度）与自变量（叠加程度）及其平方项进行回归。保留线性项叠加度至关重要（Aiken 和 West 1991），因为忽略它会假设转折点发生在 0 叠加度处（Haans 等人 2015）。我们遵循 Lind 和 Mehlum (2010) 提出的三步程序来确认模型 1b 中存在倒 U 形关系。第一步，我们检查平方项叠加度系数的方向和显着性。从表 3 模型 1b 中，我们可以看出 $\beta _ { 2 } \left( - 2 . 4 5 3 , p < 0 . 0 1 \right)$ 为负且显着，是倒 U 形关系存在的必要条件 (Lind and Mehlum 2010, Haans et al. 2015)。下一步，我们检查数据范围两端（即叠加度 = 0 或 1 时）的斜率是否显着以及在倒 U 形特征方向上是否显着。为了存在倒 U 形关系，自变量范围低端（即叠加度为 0 时）的斜率应为正且显着，而范围高端（即叠加度为 0 时）的斜率应为正且显着。叠加的值是 1) 应该是负值并且显着 (Lind and Mehlum 2010, Haans et al. 2015,)。我们测试模型1b，确认叠加度为0时斜率为正且显着$( d y / d x _ { x = 0 } = + 2 . 8 6 6 , p < 0 . 0 1 )$，叠加度为1时斜率为负且显着$( d \bar { y } / d \bar { x } _ { x = 1 } = - 2 . 0 2 3 , p < 0 . 0 \bar { 1 } )$ 。在最后一步中，我们检查转折点是否位于叠加度的数据范围内（即转折点应位于叠加度值 0 和 1 之间）。二次方程的转折点为 b $- ( \beta _ { 1 } / \bar { 2 } \bar { \beta _ { 2 } } ) y =$ $\mathtt { a } ^ { * } x ^ { 2 } + \mathtt { b } ^ { * } x + \mathtt { c } - b / ( 2 ^ { * } \mathrm { a } ) .$ <sup>5</sup> 因为我们的样本很大，所以可以使用 delta 方法（Rao 1972）来计算置信区间。使用此方法，对转折点的 99% 置信区间进行检验，确认其位于 0 和 1 0.530 < $( - \beta _ { 1 } / 2 \beta _ { 2 } ) = 0 之间。 5 8 6 < 0 。 6 4 2)$ 。这三个检验的结果为假设1提供了充分必要条件（Lind and Mehlum，2010）。即，FLOSS项目的受欢迎度随着叠加度的增加而增加，直至达到最大值（转折点），之后叠加度的进一步增加将导致该项目的受欢迎度下降​​。

Hypothesis 2a predicts that the influence of the degree of superposition on the popularity of a project is lower for organization-owned FLOSS projects than for individual-owned FLOSS projects. This interaction effect is expected to flatten or reduce the curvature of the inverted U-shaped relationship. To test this interaction effect, it is sufficient to check the significance and direction of the coefficient of the interaction with the squared term degree of superposition $( \beta _ { 5 } ;$ Haans et al. 2015). From Model 1c (Table 3), we can see that $\beta _ { 5 }$ is positive and significant (2.928, p < 0.01), confirming that organizational ownership tends to flatten the inverted U-shaped relationship. Thus, Hypothesis 2a is supported, and we can conclude that organizational ownership of FLOSS projects tends to reduce the influence of the degree of superposition on the popularity of the project. Figure 5 plots the relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of the project for individual- and organization-owned FLOSS projects based on the results of Model 1c (Table 3). The flattening effect can be observed in the plots, with organization-owned FLOSS projects exhibiting a relatively flat curve compared with individual-owned FLOSS projects.




假设2a预测，叠加程度对项目受欢迎程度的影响对于组织拥有的FLOSS项目要低于个人拥有的FLOSS项目。这种相互作用效应有望使倒U形关系变平或减少曲率。为了测试这种相互作用效应，只需检查相互作用系数与平方项叠加度 $( \beta _ { 5 } ;$ Haans et al. 2015) 的显着性和方向就足够了。从模型 1c（表 3）中，我们可以看到 $\beta _ { 5 }$ 为正且显着（2.928，p < 0.01），证实组织所有权倾向于使倒 U 形关系变平。由此，假设2a得到支持，我们可以得出结论：FLOSS项目的组织所有权往往会降低叠加程度对项目受欢迎程度的影响。图5根据模型1c的结果（表3）绘制了个人和组织拥有的FLOSS项目的叠加程度与项目受欢迎度之间的关系。从图中可以观察到扁平化效应，与个人拥有的 FLOSS 项目相比，组织拥有的 FLOSS 项目表现出相对平坦的曲线。

Hypothesis 2b predicts that the turning point for organization-owned projects occurs at a lower degree of superposition than for individual-owned projects. To test this hypothesis, we derived the turning points for individual- and organization-owned FLOSS projects and tested for their equality (Haans et al. 2015). Because the relationship is quadratic, the turning points are given by ${ \bar { \mathbf { \Gamma } } } - \beta _ { 1 } / ( 2 ^ { * } { \bar { \beta } } _ { 2 } )$ for individualowned projects (z = 0) and $- ( \beta _ { 1 } + \beta _ { 4 } ) / \ ( 2 ^ { \ast } ( \beta _ { 2 } + \beta _ { 5 } ) )$ for organization-owned projects $( z = 1 )$ .<sup>6</sup> The generalized Wald-type test for this nonlinear inequality rejects the null hypothesis that the turning points are equal $( \chi ^ { 2 } =$ 11.68, $p < 0 . 0 1$ ; Model 1c; Phillips and Park 1988). This provides support for Hypothesis 2b. The shift of the turning point can be observed in the plots shown in Figure 5. From the plots, we can observe that the degree of superposition at which popularity is at a maximum for organization-owned projects 0.415 is considerably lower than that for individual-owned projects 0.625 .




假设 2b 预测组织拥有的项目的转折点发生在比个人拥有的项目更低的叠加程度。为了检验这一假设，我们得出了个人和组织拥有的 FLOSS 项目的转折点，并测试了它们的平等性（Haans 等人，2015）。因为关系是二次的，对于个人拥有的项目 (z = 0) 和 $- ( \beta _ { 1 } + \beta _ { 4 } ) / \ ( 2 ^ { \ast } ( \beta _ { 2 } + \beta _ { 5 } ) )$ 对于组织拥有的项目 $( z = 1 )$ .<sup>6</sup> 这种非线性不等式的广义 Wald 型检验拒绝转折点相等的原假设 $( \chi ^ { 2 } =$ 11.68, $p < 0 . 0 1$ ; 模型 1c;菲利普斯和帕克 1988）。这为假设 2b 提供了支持。从图5所示的图中可以观察到转折点的转移。从图中我们可以观察到，组织拥有的项目0.415的人气达到最大值的叠加程度远低于个人拥有的项目0.625。


## Negative Binomial Regression Model




## 负二项式回归模型


Taking into account the overdispersed nature of the number of stars, we estimated the negative binomial model (Model 2; Table 3; see Cameron and Trivedi 2013, chapter 4). In this model, we used the original scale for the number of stars (not log transformed) as the dependent variable and regressed it against the quadratic terms of the degree of superposition and their interactions with the ownership flag. We followed the three-step procedure proposed by Lind and Mehlum (2010) to test Hypotheses 1, 2a, and 2b. We find support for the three hypotheses in the negative binomial model. Because the model predicts the log of the expected number of stars as a function of the predictor variables, the interpretations of the coefficient are like the log-linear OLS model (Model 1c) That is, for a one-unit change in the predictor variable, the number of stars is expected to change by the respective regression coefficient, given that the other predictor variables in the model are held constant.




考虑到恒星数量的过度分散性质，我们估计了负二项式模型（模型 2；表 3；参见 Cameron 和 Trivedi 2013，第 4 章）。在此模型中，我们使用星星数量的原始尺度（未对数转换）作为因变量，并将其针对叠加程度的二次项及其与所有权标志的相互作用进行回归。我们遵循 Lind 和 Mehlum (2010) 提出的三步程序来检验假设 1、2a 和 2b。我们在负二项式模型中找到了对三个假设的支持。由于该模型将预期星星数量的对数预测为预测变量的函数，因此系数的解释类似于对数线性 OLS 模型（模型 1c），即，对于预测变量的一个单位变化，假设模型中的其他预测变量保持不变，则预期星星数量将根据相应的回归系数发生变化。


In addition to the negative binomial model, we present three robustness tests in the appendix: (1) tests for model specification, (2) a test for the dependent variable, and (3) a test for the nature and treatment of data. In tests for model specification, we test whether the relationship is indeed quadratic and not due to a few outliers. As a test for the dependent variable, we include survival analysis to provide an independent view of project success that is not captured by counts of stars. Lastly, we include a falsification test to show that the observed relationships are more likely due to the theorized mechanisms rather than an outcome of the nature of the sample and the approach we adopted to operationalize the constructs.




除了负二项式模型之外，我们还在附录中提出了三个稳健性测试：（1）模型规范测试，（2）因变量测试，以及（3）数据性质和处理的测试。在模型规范测试中，我们测试该关系是否确实是二次关系，而不是由一些异常值引起的。作为对因变量的测试，我们纳入了生存分析，以提供项目成功的独立观点，而这种观点并未通过星星的数量来体现。最后，我们进行了证伪测试，以表明观察到的关系更有可能是由于理论机制而不是样本性质和我们采用的操作结构的方法的结果。


## Discussion and Contributions




## 讨论和贡献


Despite the FLOSS development model’s increasing prominence in practice and research, the antecedents to its success have not been completely understood. In particular, the sociotechnical aspect of its work structures and the role that this plays in a project’s ability to attract users and developers have received only limited attention from previous researchers (Howison and Crowston 2014). Considering the steady shift toward FLOSS projects in recent years and its expected acceleration in the future, clarifying the influence of its work structures is important for better understanding the phenomenon and informing project owners about how they can benefit from adopting this unique model of development. As a step forward in this direction, our research sought to unearth the mechanisms through which superposition influenced the success of individualand organization-owned FLOSS projects.




尽管 FLOSS 开发模型在实践和研究中日益受到重视，但其成功的前因尚未被完全理解。特别是，其工作结构的社会技术方面以及它在项目吸引用户和开发人员的能力中所发挥的作用仅受到了先前研究人员的有限关注（Howison 和 Crowston 2014）。考虑到近年来向 FLOSS 项目的稳步转变以及未来的预期加速，澄清其工作结构的影响对于更好地理解这一现象并告知项目业主如何从采用这种独特的开发模式中受益非常重要。作为朝这个方向迈出的一步，我们的研究试图揭示叠加影响个人和组织拥有的 FLOSS 项目成功的机制。


Using a large sample of FLOSS projects owned by individuals and a wide range of organizations, we find that the emergence of sequentially layered and individual task work, referred to as the superposed organization of work, can enhance the popularity of a project. Superposed organization of work encourages task effort by satisfying intrinsically motivated contributors’ need for greater work autonomy (Howison and Crowston 2014). The contributors’ increased task efforts may be invested in adding new functionalities and improving the quality of the project, resulting in an overall increase in the popularity of the project. For individual-owned projects, as the degree of superposition increases from 0 to its turning point, the popularity, measured as the average number of stars for the project, is found to increase by more than five times, from 11.53 to 71.79, holding everything else constant, whereas for organization-owned projects it is found to increase from 28.26 to 38.08 (see Model 1c, Table 3). As mentioned in the initial part of this paper, an increase in popularity signifies project success— because greater popularity implies a larger community of users participating in bug identification and improvement of ideas (Crowston et al. 2006). And some of these users, over time, may progress to become active developers for the project (Krishnamurthy 2005, Subramaniam et al. 2009).




通过使用个人和广泛组织拥有的 FLOSS 项目的大样本，我们发现顺序分层和个人任务工作（称为工作的叠加组织）的出现可以提高项目的受欢迎程度。叠加的工作组织通过满足内在动机的贡献者对更大工作自主权的需求来鼓励任务努力（Howison 和 Crowston 2014）。贡献者增加的任务努力可能会投资于添加新功能和提高项目质量，从而整体提高项目的受欢迎程度。对于个人拥有的项目，随着叠加度从 0 增加到转折点，在其他条件不变的情况下，以项目的平均星星数衡量的受欢迎度增加了五倍多，从 11.53 增加到 71.79，而对于组织拥有的项目，发现它从 28.26 增加到 38.08（见模型 1c，表 3）。正如本文开头部分所提到的，受欢迎程度的提高意味着项目的成功，因为更高的受欢迎程度意味着更多的用户社区参与错误识别和想法改进（Crowston 等人，2006 年）。随着时间的推移，其中一些用户可能会成为该项目的活跃开发人员（Krishnamurthy 2005，Subramaniam 等人 2009）。


Although our study confirms the proposition laid out by Howison and Crowston (2014) by showing that superposed organization of tasks has important benefits in terms of enhancing the success of a project, it also indicates that the degree of superposition exhibits decreasing returns to scale and eventually dampens project success. We theorize that as the degree of superposition increases, delays due to the avoidance of concurrent work and cowork may induce a sense of frustration and loss of control for the contributors, which tends to influence the success of the project negatively. In our study, the decreasing returns are evident for both individual- and organization-owned projects,<sup>7</sup> both of which show an overall negative influence of the degree of superposition beyond the turning point. For individualowned projects, the average number of stars is found to decrease from 71.79 to 37.12 as the degree of superposition increases from its turning point to its highest value of 1, keeping everything else constant, while this number decreases from 38.08 to 20.78 for organization-owned projects. These findings have strong implications for both theory and practice.




尽管我们的研究证实了 Howison 和 Crowston (2014) 提出的命题，表明任务的叠加组织对于提高项目的成功具有重要的好处，但它也表明叠加的程度表现出规模收益递减，并最终抑制项目的成功。我们的理论是，随着叠加程度的增加，由于避免并发工作和协同工作而导致的延迟可能会给贡献者带来挫败感和失去控制感，这往往会对项目的成功产生负面影响。在我们的研究中，个人和组织拥有的项目的回报递减都很明显，<sup>7</sup>两者都显示出转折点之后叠加程度的总体负面影响。对于个人拥有的项目，随着叠加度从转折点增加到最高值 1，在其他条件保持不变的情况下，平均星数从 71.79 减少到 37.12，而对于组织拥有的项目，这个数字从 38.08 减少到 20.78。这些发现对理论和实践都具有重要意义。


## Implications




## 影响


Our research contributes to IS and organization theory in three ways. First, our study advances the existing literature on motivation (e.g., Ryan and Deci 2000, Ke and Zhang 2010, von Krogh et al. 2012) and work structures (e.g., Howison and Crowston 2014, Lindberg et al. 2016) in FLOSS projects because it takes a significant step in establishing the role of work organization as a key driver for contributors motivations and also as an antecedent to project success. Sociotechnical mechanisms associated with work structures have been largely neglected in studies of communities of practice. For example, the theory of network governance (Jones et al. 1997) identifies four social mechanisms that emerge in communities of practice to overcome coordination challenges—imposing access restrictions, collective sanctions, reputational identity, and creating a macroculture. By progressing the research agenda initiated by Howison and Crowston, (2014) and Lindberg et al. (2016), we demonstrate that work structures can perhaps be a fifth mechanism of network governance that not only helps overcome coordination issues but also motivates contributors in FLOSS-like environments. Further, although SDT has predominantly been used to study the motivation of the contributors in FLOSS environments (e.g., Lakhani and Wolf 2005, Roberts et al. 2006, Ke and Zhang 2010), relatively few have tried to link individual motivation to the success of the project (von Krogh et al. 2012). By providing theoretical arguments and finding empirical support for an inverted U-shaped relationship, our study shows that the complete picture of individual motivation in the context of task work often goes beyond the three psychological needs postulated by SDT. From the standpoint of motivational theories (e.g., SDT), our study cautions against assuming that the mechanisms operating at the individual level directly scale up to the team or project level. Our findings suggest that the difficulties in scaling these mechanisms up to the project level manifest as boundary conditions describing the application of theories from one level of analysis to another. Understanding these boundary conditions and their implications for project success can be beneficial because it enriches the response to the question raised by von Krogh et al. (2012, p. 650): “How and why do OSS developers produce high-quality software when they do?”




我们的研究通过三个方面对信息系统和组织理论做出了贡献。首先，我们的研究推进了 FLOSS 项目中关于动机（例如，Ryan 和 Deci 2000、Ke 和 Zhuang 2010、von Krogh 等人 2012）和工作结构（例如 Howison 和 Crowston 2014、Lindberg 等人 2016）的现有文献，因为它在确立工作组织作为贡献者动机的关键驱动因素以及作为贡献者动机的先决条件方面迈出了重要一步。项目成功。在实践社区的研究中，与工作结构相关的社会技术机制在很大程度上被忽视了。例如，网络治理理论（Jones et al. 1997）确定了实践社区中出现的四种社会机制，以克服协调挑战——施加访问限制、集体制裁、声誉认同和创建宏观文化。通过推进 Howison 和 Crowston (2014) 以及 Lindberg 等人发起的研究议程。 （2016），我们证明工作结构也许可以成为网络治理的第五种机制，它不仅有助于克服协调问题，而且还可以激励类似 FLOSS 的环境中的贡献者。此外，尽管 SDT 主要用于研究 FLOSS 环境中贡献者的动机（例如，Lakhani 和 Wolf 2005、Roberts 等人 2006、Ke 和Zhang 2010），但相对较少的人试图将个人动机与项目的成功联系起来（von Krogh 等人 2012）。通过提供理论论据并寻找倒 U 形关系的实证支持，我们的研究表明，任务工作背景下个人动机的整体情况往往超出了 SDT 假设的三种心理需求。从激励理论（例如 SDT）的角度来看，我们的研究警告不要假设在个人层面运作的机制直接扩展到团队或项目层面。我们的研究结果表明，将这些机制扩展到项目级别的困难表现为描述理论从一个分析级别到另一个分析级别的应用的边界条件。了解这些边界条件及其对项目成功的影响可能是有益的，因为它丰富了对 von Krogh 等人提出的问题的回答。 (2012, p. 650)：“OSS 开发人员如何以及为何生产出高质量的软件？”


Second, our research advances the literature surround ing organizational participation in FLOSS projects (Fitzgerald 2006, Stewart et al. 2006, Wagstrom 2009, Capra et al. 2011, Spaeth et al. 2015) by enhancing our understanding of how organizational participation influences FLOSS projects in general and their work structures in particular. Practically, organizations seek to benefit from the strengths of open collaboration but are unsure about how to integrate it with their own strengths. By trying to introduce controls and/or speeding up development, organizational involvement can “kill the goose that lays the golden egg”<sup>8</sup> by undermining the community process. This leads to a trade-off between openness and control (Engestrom¨ 2007, Jarvenpaa and Lang 2011, Teigland et al. 2014), which, when effectively managed, can lead to the success of FLOSS projects (Teigland et al. 2014). Our inquiry is one of the first to understand this trade-off in the realm of work structures and the nature of the ownership of FLOSS projects. With organizational ownership, the increased net extrinsic motivation of the contributors and the higher time cost of money undermine the need for openness and autonomy of work, allowing the project owner to exert a greater influence on the relationship between superposed work structures and project success. The extent to which the organization owner can influence the relationship between superposed work structures and project success depends on the models of organizational involvement. The greater the organization owner is willing to invest in the coding model of engagement by contributing code and employees’ time, the lesser will be the overall influence of superposed work structures on the success of the project. The greater the organization owner invests in the support activities of the FLOSS project, the greater is the time cost of money—creating a higher need for efficient development practices in lieu of superposition.




其次，我们的研究通过增强我们对组织参与如何影响 FLOSS 项目及其工作结构的理解，推进了有关 FLOSS 项目组织参与的文献（Fitzgerald 2006、Stewart et al. 2006、Wagstrom 2009、Capra et al. 2011、Spaeth et al. 2015）。实际上，组织寻求从开放协作的优势中受益，但不确定如何将其与自身优势相结合。通过尝试引入控制和/或加速开发，组织参与可能会破坏社区进程，从而“杀鸡取卵”<sup>8</sup>。这导致了开放性和控制之间的权衡（Engestrom¡ 2007，Jarvenpaa 和 Lang 2011，Teigland 等人 2014），如果有效管理，可以导致 FLOSS 项目的成功（Teigland 等人 2014）。我们的调查是最早了解工作结构领域和 FLOSS 项目所有权性质之间这种权衡的调查之一。有了组织所有权，贡献者净外在动机的增加和资金时间成本的增加削弱了对工作开放性和自主性的需求，从而使项目所有者能够对叠加的工作结构和项目成功之间的关系施加更大的影响。组织所有者对叠加工作结构和项目成功之间关系的影响程度取决于组织参与的模式。组织所有者越愿意通过贡献代码和员工时间来投资参与编码模型，叠加的工作结构对项目成功的总体影响就越小。组织所有者对 FLOSS 项目支持活动的投资越大，资金的时间成本就越大，从而对高效开发实践（而不是叠加）产生更高的需求。


Third, our work develops a clear construct for the concept of superposition that can be used for future theory development anchored around this construct. A well-defined theoretical construct with delineated scope conditions is essential to the process of building strong theory (Sutton and Staw 1995; Suddaby 2010). As a step toward this goal, we have defined and operationalized the construct (degree of superposition) and examined its behavior in relation to project success under different contextual conditions—that is, at low and high degrees of superposition and under different ownership types and models of organizational engagement. In doing so, we have tried to establish the scope conditions associated with space and value for the construct (Suddaby 2010). Further, this construct can be easily operationalized using task-specific data that are available in the change logs for projects. We believe that this construct not only will help researchers to advance the theory of superposition and unearth new relationships but also can be used as a tool to measure and monitor project work structures.




第三，我们的工作为叠加概念开发了一个清晰的结构，可用于围绕该结构的未来理论发展。具有界定范围条件的明确理论构建对于构建强有力的理论的过程至关重要（Sutton 和 Staw 1995；Suddaby 2010）。作为实现这一目标的一步，我们定义并实施了该结构（叠加程度），并检查了其在不同背景条件下（即低和高叠加程度以及不同所有权类型和组织参与模式）与项目成功相关的行为。在此过程中，我们尝试建立与构造的空间和价值相关的范围条件（Suddaby 2010）。此外，可以使用项目变更日志中提供的特定于任务的数据轻松地操作此构造。我们相信，这种结构不仅将帮助研究人员推进叠加理论并发现新的关系，而且还可以用作衡量和监控项目工作结构的工具。


## Limitations and Directions for Future Research




## 未来研究的局限性和方向


Although we have carefully tried to ensure theoretical and methodological rigor in this research, there are certain limitations that need to be considered. First, our choice of GitHub as a source of data was based on its popularity among programmers, its integrated social features, and the availability of detailed metadata. While GitHub offers a good data set for the purposes of this study, certain perils are associated with its use (Kalliamvakou et al. 2014). To minimize the effect of these perils, we introduced multiple controls, filters, and manual checks. The details of the perils in using this data set and the checks we adopted to overcome them are listed in Online Appendix A3. Second, our operationalization of tasks and versions is tuned to Git-based platforms like GitHub and limited to the nature of data made available by that platform. When it comes to operationalizing tasks, we have taken special care to ensure that each identified task is unique (i.e., we have avoided double counting of tasks) and made a significant change to the shared output of the project (see Online Appendix A1 for details). However, it is possible that some events involved a greater amount of effort and implemented larger changes to a project than others. Ideally, each event should be manually analyzed to determine whether it made a significant change to the shared output of the project before qualifying it as a task But this is practically very difficult because many active projects have several hundred events in a year. However, to minimize the impact of varying task sizes across projects, we included the control variable average task size of the project in our regression models. When it comes to versions, we operationalize it as the state of the project at the end of a specific day of activity (see Online Appendix A2 for details). While this operationalization allows us to generalize the construct and leverage the workflow of Git-based FLOSS development platforms, the actual meaning of versions may differ across platforms and sometimes even across projects. This problem is exacerbated by the fact that the literature is overloaded with multiple terms that conflate the meaning of versions for example, major release, minor release, development release, user version, and patches.<sup>9</sup> Despite these issues, we have retained the term version and presented one approach to operationalize it. Future studies could tune their approach for operationalizing versions to one that is more suitable for the nature of workflow adopted by the platform under study. As a robustness test to confirm that the observed results were not due to the way we have operationalized the constructs, we included a falsification test (results provided in the appendix) to show that the hypoth esized relationships are not significant in projects that are unlikely to see the mechanism of superposition in action. Third, we used counts of stars as the measure of success because it captures the popularity of a project. In their empirical analysis of FLOSS project success, Crowston et al. (2006) found that the common measures used for success, such as popularity, are correlated with each other but that project lifespan was unique in not correlating with the other measures of success. Given this multidimensiona nature of the success construct, we included surviva analysis to provide an independent view of project suc cess not captured by counts of stars. The result of the survival analysis provides support for Hypotheses 1 and 2a but is not significant for the shift in the turning point proposed in Hypothesis 2b (see the appendix for details). The nonsignificance may be because the meaning of the lifespan of a project might be slightly different for organization-owned FLOSS projects— that is, while successful individual-owned projects are expected to remain active for a prolonged period, organization-owned projects may come with specific end goals and timelines. The mixed results we have seen for Hypothesis 2b call for a deeper inquiry into the temporal effect of the work structure, which might exhibit changes across years and along the life cycle of a project (Lindberg 2015). The temporal effect of superposition provides a potential area for future research, which can try to unearth the scope conditions for the construct associated with time (Suddaby 2010). Understanding the temporal effect can deepen our understanding about the impact that the life-cycle stage of a FLOSS project has on its work structures and how the impact may differ in large, mature projects such as Eclipse, Firefox, and GNOME. Fourth, one of our goals in taking up this research was to call attention to the importance of sociotechnical mechanisms invoked by the work structures in FLOSS projects. Along this line, we have tried to enrich the theory of superposition by establishing a better context and identifying boundaries to its influence. However, Lindberg et al. (2016) identified unresolved developer and developmental interdependencies that tend to be resolved through two unique sociotechnical mechanisms, direct implementation and knowledge integration. While these mechanisms seem to address dependencies outside the purview of superposition, they are possibly related to the productive deferral mechanism of superposition because they serve the same purpose of addressing complexities in coordinating development work. Because productive deferral has been treated as a latent mechanism in this study, a more thorough development of this concept may be necessary to integrate the works of Howison and Crowston (2014) and Lindberg et al. (2016) so as to provide a full picture about the role of work structures in FLOSS projects. Although these linkages remain unresolved and require deeper investigation, our study contributes to the literature by taking a modest step forward in enriching our understanding of work structures in FLOSS development and the mechanisms through which superposition influences FLOSS project success in individual as well as organizational contexts.




尽管我们在这项研究中仔细尝试确保理论和方法的严谨性，但仍存在一些需要考虑的局限性。首先，我们选择 GitHub 作为数据源是基于它在程序员中的受欢迎程度、集成的社交功能以及详细元数据的可用性。虽然 GitHub 为本研究目的提供了良好的数据集，但其使用也存在一定的风险（Kalliamvakou 等人，2014 年）。为了最大限度地减少这些危险的影响，我们引入了多种控制、过滤器和手动检查。在线附录 A3 中列出了使用该数据集的风险的详细信息以及我们为克服这些风险而采取的检查措施。其次，我们对任务和版本的操作化是针对基于 Git 的平台（如 GitHub）进行调整的，并且仅限于该平台提供的数据的性质。在实施任务时，我们特别注意确保每个确定的任务都是唯一的（即，我们避免了任务的重复计算），并对项目的共享输出进行了重大更改（详细信息请参见在线附录 A1）。然而，某些事件可能比其他事件需要付出更多的努力并对项目实施更大的更改。理想情况下，在将每个事件定义为任务之前，应手动分析每个事件，以确定它是否对项目的共享输出做出重大更改。但这实际上非常困难，因为许多活动项目一年内有数百个事件。然而，为了最大限度地减少项目之间不同任务规模的影响，我们在回归模型中包含了项目的控制变量平均任务规模。当谈到版本时，我们将其操作为特定一天活动结束时项目的状态（有关详细信息，请参阅在线附录 A2）。虽然这种操作化允许我们概括构建并利用基于 Git 的 FLOSS 开发平台的工作流程，但版本的实际含义可能会因平台而异，有时甚至因项目而异。由于文献中充斥着多个术语，这些术语混淆了版本的含义，例如主要版本、次要版本、开发版本、用户版本和补丁，这一事实加剧了这个问题。<sup>9</sup>尽管存在这些问题，我们仍然保留了术语“版本”，并提出了一种实现它的方法。未来的研究可以将其操作版本的方法调整为更适合所研究平台采用的工作流程性质的方法。作为稳健性测试，以确认观察到的结果不是由我们操作结构的方式造成的，我们包括了一个证伪测试（结果在附录中提供），以表明假设的关系在不太可能看到叠加机制发挥作用的项目中并不重要。第三，我们使用星星数量作为成功的衡量标准，因为它反映了项目的受欢迎程度。在对 FLOSS 项目成功的实证分析中，Crowston 等人。 （2006）发现用于成功的常见衡量标准（例如受欢迎程度）彼此相关，但项目生命周期的独特之处在于与其他成功衡量标准不相关。鉴于成功构造的多维性质，我们纳入了生存分析，以提供项目成功的独立观点，而不是通过星星的数量来捕获。生存分析的结果为假设1和2a提供了支持，但对于假设2b提出的转折点的转变并不显着（详见附录）。之所以无意义，可能是因为对于组织拥有的 FLOSS 项目来说，项目生命周期的含义可能略有不同——也就是说，虽然成功的个人拥有的项目预计会在很长一段时间内保持活跃，但组织拥有的项目可能会有特定的最终目标和时间表。我们在假设 2b 中看到的好坏参半的结果要求对工作结构的时间效应进行更深入的探究，这可能会在项目的数年和生命周期中表现出变化（Lindberg
2015）。叠加的时间效应为未来的研究提供了一个潜在的领域，可以尝试挖掘与时间相关的构造的范围条件（Suddaby 2010）。了解时间效应可以加深我们对 FLOSS 项目生命周期阶段对其工作结构的影响的理解，以及这种影响在 Eclipse、Firefox 和 GNOME 等大型成熟项目中有何不同。第四，我们进行这项研究的目标之一是引起人们对 FLOSS 项目工作结构所调用的社会技术机制的重要性的关注。沿着这个思路，我们试图通过建立更好的背景并确定其影响的界限来丰富叠加理论。然而，林德伯格等人。 (2016) 确定了尚未解决的开发人员和开发相互依赖关系，这些依赖关系往往通过两种独特的社会技术机制来解决，即直接实施和知识整合。虽然这些机制似乎解决了叠加范围之外的依赖关系，但它们可能与叠加的生产性延迟机制有关，因为它们具有解决协调开发工作中的复杂性的相同目的。由于生产性延迟在本研究中被视为一种潜在机制，因此可能有必要对这一概念进行更彻底的发展，以整合 Howison 和 Crowston (2014) 以及 Lindberg 等人的工作。 (2016) 以便全面了解工作结构在 FLOSS 项目中的作用。尽管这些联系仍未解决并且需要更深入的调查，但我们的研究在丰富我们对 FLOSS 开发工作结构以及叠加影响个人和组织环境中 FLOSS 项目成功的机制的理解方面迈出了适度的一步，为文献做出了贡献。

## Test for Outliers




## 异常值测试


To guard against the possibility that a few extreme ob servations are driving the results, it is common for re searchers to exclude outliers from the sample and then reestimate the model (Haans et al. 2015). We adopted Cook’s distance (Cook 1977) to eliminate outliers from Models 1b and 1c (see Table 3). On reestimating the models after the exclusion of outliers, we found that our conclusions remained unchanged.




为了防止一些极端观察结果驱动结果的可能性，研究人员通常从样本中排除异常值，然后重新估计模型（Haans et al. 2015）。我们采用库克距离（Cook 1977）来消除模型 1b 和 1c 中的异常值（见表 3）。在排除异常值后重新估计模型时，我们发现我们的结论保持不变。


## Test for the Dependent Variable: Survival Analysis




## 因变量检验：生存分析


In their empirical analysis of FLOSS projects’ success, Crowston et al. (2006) found that the common measures used for success, such as popularity, were correlated with each other but that project lifespan was unique because it did not correlate with the other measures of success. Given this finding, the inclusion of survival analysis provides an independent view of project success that is not captured b counts of stars. In the survival analysis, we tested our hypotheses using the likelihood that a FLOSS project would become inactive as the dependent variable (Hosmer et al. 2008). In this model (Table A.1), the dependent variable is a combination of a binary variable that indicates whether a project became inactive within three years of its inception and a continuous variable that measures the number of active days for the project.




Crowston 等人在对 FLOSS 项目成功的实证分析中。 （2006）发现用于成功的常见衡量标准（例如受欢迎程度）彼此相关，但项目生命周期是独特的，因为它与其他成功衡量标准不相关。鉴于这一发现，生存分析的纳入提供了项目成功的独立观点，而这种观点并未通过星星的数量来捕获。在生存分析中，我们使用 FLOSS 项目变得不活跃的可能性作为因变量来检验我们的假设（Hosmer 等人，2008 年）。在此模型中（表 A.1），因变量是二元变量和连续变量的组合，二元变量指示项目是否在启动后三年内变得不活跃，而连续变量则衡量项目的活跃天数。


We use the semiparametric Cox regression model for the survival analysis because it relaxes the specification requirement for the baseline hazard function (Hosmer et al. 2008). Because the dependent variable in this model is an inverse measure of project success, Hypothesis 1 predicts a noninverted U-shaped relationship between likelihood of project inactivity and degree of superposition. Model 3c (Table A.1) provides the results of the survival analysis with the likelihood of inactivity of the project as the dependent variable. In this model, we find support for Hypotheses 1 and 2a. However, a left shift of the turning point when organizations own FLOSS projects (Hypothesis 2b) was not observed. We discuss the implications of these results in the discussion section of this paper.




我们使用半参数 Cox 回归模型进行生存分析，因为它放宽了基线风险函数的规范要求（Hosmer 等人，2008）。由于该模型中的因变量是项目成功的倒数衡量标准，因此假设 1 预测项目不活动的可能性与叠加程度之间存在非倒 U 形关系。模型 3c（表 A.1）提供了生存分析的结果，以项目不活动的可能性作为因变量。在此模型中，我们发现假设 1 和 2a 得到支持。然而，当组织拥有 FLOSS 项目（假设 2b）时，没有观察到转折点左移。我们在本文的讨论部分讨论这些结果的含义。


Test for Nature and Treatment of Data: Falsi<sup>fi</sup>cation Test The mechanisms through which superposition influences the popularity of a project are restricted to FLOSS-like environments. In these environments, superposition mini mizes the interdependencies among contributors, thereby satisfying their need for autonomy (Howison and Crowston 2014), which, in turn, increases their task efforts (Ke and Zhang 2010). Thus, in FLOSS-like environments, superposition characterized by sequential and individual development is more effective in motivating contributions than is engagement in concurrent development. In non software-development environments, where the primary activity is information gathering and storage, we do not expect this mechanism to be prominent. This is because in non-software-development projects such as creating lists, collating best practices and examples, and storing informa tion, cowork does not undermine the autonomy afforded to the contributor because there are limited interdependencies between individual tasks. Thus, in these environments, we do not expect the hypothesized inverted U-shaped relationship to exist between the degree of superposition and the popularity of a project. In the falsification test, we use non-software-development projects such as personal stores, mirrors of other projects, lists, and other examples obtained from GitHub. In this sample, the presence of an inverted U-shaped relationship between degree of superposition and project popularity would indicate that either (1) the nature of the data and the operationalization of the constructs could cause an inverted U-shaped relationship or (2) there exist interdependencies between tasks in the sample that allow the mechanisms of superposition to operate in these non-software-development projects. By reading the project descriptions, we excluded projects that could potentially have task-level interdependencies (e.g., editing wikis, tutorials) from the test because they could potentially adopt a super posed work breakdown structure. After further elimination of projects that were either too small or had very few contributors, we were left with a sample of 260 non-software-developmen projects. Table A.2 lists the results of the regressions carried out with this sample. Model 4a is a linear regression model that tests the linear relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of the project. The results of this model show that the coefficient of the degree of superposition term is negative and significant within the




数据性质和处理的测试：虚假测试​​ 叠加影响项目受欢迎程度的机制仅限于类似 FLOSS 的环境。在这些环境中，叠加最大限度地减少了贡献者之间的相互依赖性，从而满足了他们的自主需求（Howison 和 Crowston 2014），这反过来又增加了他们的任务努力（Ke 和Zhang 2010）。因此，在类似 FLOSS 的环境中，以顺序和个体开发为特征的叠加在激励贡献方面比参与并行开发更有效。在非软件开发环境中，主要活动是信息收集和存储，我们预计这种机制不会很突出。这是因为在非软件开发项目中，例如创建列表、整理最佳实践和示例以及存储信息，协同工作不会破坏给予贡献者的自主权，因为各个任务之间的相互依赖关系有限。因此，在这些环境下，我们并不期望项目的叠加程度和受欢迎程度之间存在假设的倒U型关系。在证伪测试中，我们使用非软件开发项目，例如个人商店、其他项目的镜像、列表以及从 GitHub 获取的其他示例。在此示例中，叠加程度和项目受欢迎度之间存在倒 U 形关系表明，(1) 数据的性质和构造的操作化可能导致倒 U 形关系，或者 (2) 示例中的任务之间存在相互依赖性，允许叠加机制在这些非软件开发项目中运行。通过阅读项目描述，我们从测试中排除了可能具有任务级相互依赖性的项目（例如，编辑维基、教程），因为它们可能采用叠加的工作分解结构。在进一步剔除过小或贡献者很少的项目后，我们留下了 260 个非软件开发项目的样本。表 A.2 列出了对该样本进行回归的结果。模型4a是线性回归模型，测试叠加程度与项目受欢迎度之间的线性关系。该模型的结果表明，叠加项的度系数为负，且在区间内显着。

95% confidence interval (<sup>−</sup>2.233, p < 0.05). Model 4b includes the quadratic term of the degree of superposition to test for a curvilinear relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of the project. We found that inclusion of the quadratic term does not increase the model fit $( \Delta R ^ { 2 } = 0 . 0 0 \dot { 5 } , p > 0 . 1 0 )$ and that the coefficient of the quadratic term is not significant $( p > 0 . 1 0 )$ . These results support the conclusion that the relationship between the degree of superposition and the popularity of the project for this sample of non-software-development projects is linearly decreasing, as indicated by Model 4a. This means that concurrent task organization was preferred over the superposed development approach for this sample of non software-development projects. Because the mechanisms of superposition that result in our curvilinear hypothesis are restricted to FLOSS development projects, the results of this falsification test provide additional support for the ob served relationships in the main models (see Table 3, Models 1b and 1c) being due to the theorized mechanisms rather than an outcome of the nature and treatment of the data.




95% 置信区间 (<sup>−</sup>2.233，p < 0.05)。模型4b包含叠加度的二次项，用于检验叠加度与项目受欢迎度之间的曲线关系。我们发现包含二次项不会增加模型拟合 $( \Delta R ^ { 2 } = 0 . 0 0 \dot { 5 } , p > 0 . 1 0 )$ 并且二次项的系数并不显着 $( p > 0 . 1 0 )$ 。这些结果支持这样的结论：对于该非软件开发项目样本，叠加程度与项目受欢迎程度之间的关系呈线性递减，如模型 4a 所示。这意味着对于这个非软件开发项目样本，并发任务组织比叠加开发方法更受青睐。由于导致我们的曲线假设的叠加机制仅限于 FLOSS 开发项目，因此该证伪测试的结果为主要模型（参见表 3，模型 1b 和 1c）中观察到的关系提供了额外的支持，这是由于理论机制而不是数据性质和处理的结果。
