## Discussion




＃＃ 讨论


This study complements the experience sampling study by demonstrating causal effects of expected and discrepant IT events on different IS use patterns. As hypothesized, individuals engaged in an automatic IS use pattern during expected events, characterized by non-computer-related thoughts and exploitive behaviors. Discrepant IT events, instead, triggered a change from an automatic to an adjusting IS use pattern. That is, the three components of an IS use pattern—emotions, cognitions, and behaviors—changed following the discrepant IT event. As hypothesized, this adjusting IS use pattern was composed of negative affect, computer-related thoughts, and adaptive behaviors. However, the pattern composition with respect to physiological arousal was different than hypothesized: individuals demonstrated lower physiological arousal following discrepant events (rather than higher, as hypothesized). This may be due to individuals’ shift of attention from the task to the event, as attentional responses to emotionally evocative stimuli have been associated with a decrease in heart rates (Beauchaine 2001; Hamann et al. 2002).




本研究通过证明预期和差异 IT 事件对不同 IS 使用模式的因果影响来补充经验抽样研究。正如假设的那样，个人在预期事件期间会自动使用信息系统，其特征是与计算机无关的想法和剥削行为。相反，不一致的 IT 事件引发了从自动到调整的 IS 使用模式的变化。也就是说，信息系统使用模式的三个组成部分——情绪、认知和行为——在不一致的信息技术事件发生后发生了变化。正如假设的那样，这种调整信息系统使用模式由负面情绪、与计算机相关的想法和适应性行为组成。然而，关于生理唤醒的模式组成与假设的不同：个体在差异事件后表现出较低的生理唤醒（而不是如假设的那样较高）。这可能是由于个人的注意力从任务转移到事件，因为对情绪唤起刺激的注意力反应与心率降低有关（Beauchaine 2001；Hamann 等人 2002）。


This study also demonstrates that there is a transition as time passes from the adjusting pattern adopted immediately after a discrepant event to an automatic one (because users either resolved the event—those in condition two—or they gave up —those in condition three). Finally, results demonstrate a causal relation between the exploitive behaviors of automatic IS use patterns and short-term task performance. In summary, expected events, discrepant IT events, and time result in distinctive IS use patterns: automatic and adjusting. The existence of these patterns is demonstrated by changes in values of the three pattern components (emotions, cognitions, and behaviors).




这项研究还表明，随着时间的推移，从出现差异事件后立即采用的调整模式到自动调整模式会发生转变（因为用户要么解决了事件（条件二），要么放弃了（条件三）。最后，结果证明了自动 IS 使用模式的剥削行为与短期任务绩效之间的因果关系。总之，预期事件、差异 IT 事件和时间导致了独特的 IS 使用模式：自动和调整。这些模式的存在是通过三个模式组成部分（情绪、认知和行为）的值的变化来证明的。


![](/api/attachments/FSMWA42R/fulltext/images/2a7afa96c683f870766ef59133407c6286ccc468374283fff6e771322ed7e7c5.jpg)  
Figure 3. Results of the Experiment (Study 2)




![](/api/attachments/FSMWA42R/fulltext/images/2a7afa96c683f870766ef59133407c6286ccc468374283fff6e771322ed7e7c5.jpg)  
图 3. 实验结果（研究 2）


Further examination of these results along with those of the previous study will be addressed in the general discussion. Before doing so, it is important to highlight the methodological strengths of this study because they support the internal validity of our results. First, this study investigated actual behaviors, rather than self-reported behaviors, the norm in IS research (e.g., Barki et al. 2007; Burton-Jones and Straub 2006), thus avoiding desirability biases. Second, the different data collection methods allowed for the measurement of constructs as they occurred, thus avoiding mono-method bias, priming, and consistency artifacts (Salancik 1984) often occurring in the measurement of IS use (Straub and Burton-Jones 2007). Third, the double-blind design reduces experimenter and response bias (Shadish et al. 2003). Finally, this study used physiological measurement, a method that allows for the measurement of physiological states and their changes, responding to recent calls from researchers in management (Elfenbein 2007) and IS (Dimoka et al. 2011).




对这些结果以及先前研究的结果的进一步检查将在一般性讨论中进行。在此之前，重要的是要强调这项研究的方法论优势，因为它们支持我们结果的内部有效性。首先，这项研究调查的是实际行为，而不是自我报告的行为，这是 IS 研究的常态（例如，Barki 等人，2007 年；Burton-Jones 和 Straub，2006 年），从而避免了意愿偏差。其次，不同的数据收集方法允许在构建发生时对其进行测量，从而避免在测量信息系统使用时经常出现的单一方法偏差、启动和一致性伪影（Salancik 1984）（Straub 和 Burton-Jones 2007）。第三，双盲设计减少了实验者和反应偏差（Shadish et al. 2003）。最后，本研究使用了生理测量，这是一种可以测量生理状态及其变化的方法，响应了管理学（Elfenbein 2007）和 IS（Dimoka 等人，2011）研究人员最近的呼吁。


## General Discussion and Conclusions




## 一般讨论和结论


Drawing on coping, affect–object, and automaticity theories, this research conceptualizes and empirically demonstrates the existence of dynamic IS use patterns, or groups of emotions, cognitions, and behaviors that occur together as a result of different IT events. Specifically, results demonstrate that users engage in two main IS use patterns, automatic and adjusting. The most prevalent is the automatic IS use pattern, which takes place during expected IT events: it is characterized by emotions and cognitions unrelated to the IT being used, and by exploitive behaviors, that is, users interacting with an IT in a straightforward manner to accomplish a task. In contrast, the adjusting IS use pattern is triggered by discrepant IT events and is characterized by negative affect related to the IT being used, lower physiological arousal, computer-related thoughts, and adaptive behaviors aimed at modifying an aspect of the IT.




本研究利用应对理论、情感-客体理论和自动性理论，概念化并实证证明了动态信息系统使用模式的存在，或者是由于不同信息技术事件而一起出现的一组情绪、认知和行为。具体来说，结果表明用户有两种主要的信息系统使用模式：自动模式和调整模式。最普遍的是自动 IS 使用模式，它发生在预期的 IT 事件期间：其特征是与所使用的 IT 无关的情感和认知，以及利用行为，即用户以直接的方式与 IT 交互以完成任务。相比之下，调整信息系统使用模式是由不一致的信息技术事件触发的，其特征是与所使用的信息技术相关的负面影响、较低的生理唤醒、与计算机相关的想法以及旨在修改信息技术某个方面的适应性行为。


These two IS use patterns appear and disappear over time as different (expected versus discrepant) events occur. Interestingly, the effects of discrepant IT events fade over time regardless of whether the event is resolved. That is, the adjusting pattern that occurs immediately after a discrepant IT event weakens as time passes and transitions into an automatic pattern. Finally, results demonstrate that IS use patterns are important for performance: their exploitive behavioral component results in short-term performance.




随着不同（预期与差异）事件的发生，这两种 IS 使用模式会随着时间的推移而出现和消失。有趣的是，无论事件是否得到解决，不一致的 IT 事件的影响都会随着时间的推移而逐渐消失。也就是说，在差异IT事件之后立即发生的调整模式随着时间的推移而减弱并转变为自动模式。最后，结果表明信息系统使用模式对于绩效很重要：它们的剥削行为成分会导致短期绩效。


## Theoretical Implications




## 理论意义


This research makes several contributions. Responding to calls for richer conceptualizations of use (e.g., Burton-Jones and Straub 2006) , we developed a configurational construct of IS use patterns as they occur naturally in the workplace. Constructs are relevant when they can give valuable explanations to important questions (Barki et al. 2007), and we believe that IS use patterns do so in several ways. First, these patterns change over time based on IT events and discriminate between the different ways in which IT is actually used. In doing so, this research goes beyond traditional adoption/continuance theories and clarifies the direct effects of technology (as opposed to cognitive representations of the IT artifact) in relation to IS use.




这项研究做出了多项贡献。为了响应对更丰富的使用概念化的呼声（例如，Burton-Jones 和 Straub 2006），我们开发了一种在工作场所自然发生的信息系统使用模式的配置结构。当结构能够对重要问题提供有价值的解释时，它们就是相关的（Barki et al. 2007），并且我们相信 IS 使用模式可以通过多种方式做到这一点。首先，这些模式会根据 IT 事件随时间而变化，并区分 IT 实际使用的不同方式。在此过程中，这项研究超越了传统的采用/延续理论，并阐明了技术（而不是 IT 工件的认知表征）对 IS 使用的直接影响。


Second, the behavioral component of IS use patterns helps to disentangle why specific types of use lead to performance, while other types do not, responding to calls for research in this area (Burton-Jones and Straub 2006). For example, two people might be using the same technology for the same amount of time for a given task but have different short-term performance—because one has an automatic use pattern while the other has an adjusting one. That is, it is how the technology is used (the actual behaviors with the technology) that relates to performance. Future research could investigate this further. For example, although exploitive behaviors lead to better short-term performance for certain types of tasks, automaticity implies a certain lack of control (Ortiz de Guinea and Markus 2009), and as such, exploitive behaviors might be detrimental to highly unstructured tasks requiring innovation. As described earlier, adjusting patterns may have positive impacts on longer-term performance because of the learning that occurs regarding important application functionalities or “work-arounds,” thus enabling more effective usage behaviors in future IT interactions. Consequently, IS use and work task performance are closely intertwined, implying a need for a much closer connection between IS and organizational research (Orlikowski and Scott 2008).<sup>11</sup>




其次，信息系统使用模式的行为成分有助于理清为什么特定类型的使用会带来绩效，而其他类型则不会，这响应了该领域研究的号召（Burton-Jones 和 Straub 2006）。例如，两个人可能在相同的时间内使用相同的技术来完成给定的任务，但短期表现却不同，因为一个人具有自动使用模式，而另一个人则具有调整性使用模式。也就是说，技术的使用方式（技术的实际行为）与性能相关。未来的研究可以进一步研究这一点。例如，尽管剥削行为可以在某些类型的任务中带来更好的短期绩效，但自动化意味着一定程度的缺乏控制（Ortiz deGuinea 和 Markus 2009），因此，剥削行为可能不利于需要创新的高度非结构化任务。如前所述，调整模式可能会对长期性能产生积极影响，因为可以学习重要的应用程序功能或“解决方法”，从而在未来的 IT 交互中实现更有效的使用行为。因此，信息系统的使用和工作任务绩效紧密相连，这意味着信息系统和组织研究之间需要更加紧密的联系（Orlikowski 和 Scott，2008 年）。<sup>11</sup>


Third, the prevalence of automatic IS use patterns supports recent theorizing challenging the commonly held assumption that users often reflect about IT and its possibilities (Ortiz de Guinea and Markus 2009). That is, we might be confusing the way users appear to work (reflective about IT) with the way they actually work (unreflective about IT) (Lee 1998). This insight is important because a central focus of any scientific field should be the identification and empirical examination of its implicit theoretical assumptions (Gray and Cooper 2010; Silva 2007).




第三，自动信息系统使用模式的盛行支持了最近的理论，挑战了普遍持有的假设，即用户经常反思 IT 及其可能性（Ortiz deGuinea 和 Markus 2009）。也就是说，我们可能会混淆用户的工作方式（对 IT 的反思）和他们实际的工作方式（对 IT 的不反思）（Lee 1998）。这种见解很重要，因为任何科学领域的中心焦点都应该是对其隐含理论假设的识别和实证检验（Gray and Cooper 2010；Silva 2007）。


Fourth, IS use patterns also provide possible explanations for the formation of IT perceptions (Benbasat and Barki 2007). When things go smoothly—as they do most of the time—the IT goes unnoticed, and so might its benefits (the automatic use pattern). It is only when difficulties (discrepant IT events) occur that users focus on the IT, doing so in negative terms (the adjusting use pattern). Taking into consideration that emotional experiences play an essential role in the creation of memories (Anderson and Draper 1991), perceptions of IT value might be negatively laden because negative experiences have a stronger role than positive ones in their determination (Taylor 1991). This provides a complementary explanation for why negative attitudes about technologies persist and why a perceptual gap exists between how an IT actually performs and organizational members’ (users’ and managers’) perceptions of its importance (Hirschheim et al. 2003; Peppard and Ward 1999). This insight raises possibilities for future research. For example, studies could investigate whether persistent prejudices against technology and IS professionals (Akbulut-Bailey 2009) follow the same automatic and implicit associations as with other stereotypes (Banaji and Hardin 1996; Nosek et al. 2007). This would help in developing strategies to overcome such negative stereotypes so that IT can become noticeable in positive rather than negative ways. This would be helpful for (1) identifying what to do so that IT gets the favorable attention of users and decision makers, (2) developing guidelines to reduce users’ negative perceptions of technology, and (3) better understanding the reasons for why we struggle to attract students to our majors (Looney and Akbulut 2007).




第四，信息系统的使用模式也为信息技术认知的形成提供了可能的解释（Benbasat 和 Barki 2007）。当事情进展顺利时（大多数情况下都是如此），IT 就会被忽视，其好处（自动使用模式）也可能会被忽视。只有当困难（不一致的 IT 事件）发生时，用户才会以消极的方式关注 IT（调整使用模式）。考虑到情感体验在记忆的创造中起着至关重要的作用（Anderson 和 Draper 1991），对 IT 价值的认知可能会充满负面影响，因为消极体验在其决定中比积极体验具有更强的作用（Taylor 1991）。这为为什么对技术的负面态度持续存在以及为什么 IT 的实际执行方式与组织成员（用户和管理者）对其重要性的看法之间存在感知差距提供了补充解释（Hirschheim 等人，2003 年；Peppard 和 Ward，1999 年）。这一见解为未来的研究带来了可能性。例如，研究可以调查对技术和信息系统专业人员的持续偏见（Akbulut-Bailey 2009）是否遵循与其他刻板印象相同的自动和隐性关联（Banaji 和 Hardin 1996；Nosek 等人 2007）。这将有助于制定克服此类负面刻板印象的策略，从而使 IT 能够以积极而不是消极的方式变得引人注目。这将有助于 (1) 确定要做什么以使 IT 获得用户和决策者的积极关注，(2) 制定指南以减少用户对技术的负面看法，以及 (3) 更好地理解我们难以吸引学生就读我们专业的原因（Looney 和 Akbulut 2007）。


Finally, this research complements traditional adoption/continuance theories (e.g., TAM) in several ways. For example, traditional research explains whether an individual will use (or continue to use) a given system based on behavioral beliefs (or evaluative perceptions of IT) (e.g., Bhattacherjee 2001), but cannot describe what happens during the utilization of a system. Our research helps to fill this gap. Furthermore, traditional research argues that behavioral beliefs are updated as users engage in direct experiences with technology (e.g., Bhattacherjee and Premkumar 2004; Venkatesh and Goyal 2010), but does not explore such direct experiences. This paper partially addresses this issue: in the first study, we found that deliberative decisions about use do not appear to be reexamined during the utilization of a system, either during expected or discrepant events. Future research could focus on the criticality or number of discrepant IT events necessary for users to question their decisions to utilize a given system.




最后，这项研究在几个方面补充了传统的采用/延续理论（例如 TAM）。例如，传统研究根据行为信念（或对 IT 的评估认知）解释个人是否会使用（或继续使用）给定系统（例如，Bhattacherjee 2001），但无法描述系统使用过程中发生的情况。我们的研究有助于填补这一空白。此外，传统研究认为，当用户参与技术的直接体验时，行为信念会更新（例如，Bhattacherjee 和 Premkumar 2004；Venkatesh 和 Goyal 2010），但没有探索这种直接体验。本文部分解决了这个问题：在第一项研究中，我们发现在系统使用过程中，无论是在预期事件还是不一致事件期间，似乎都没有重新审查有关使用的深思熟虑的决定。未来的研究可能集中于用户质疑其使用给定系统的决策所必需的差异 IT 事件的重要性或数量。


It is also worth further discussing the role of emotions in the automatic use pattern. As we suggested earlier, affect is unrelated to the system being employed and its valence is indeterminate (it can be negative, neutral, or high) in the automatic IS use pattern. This is due to the intrinsic nature of affect: during expected events, the strongest affect experienced by users relates to something else in their work or personal lives that cannot be predicted a priori. This implies that affect with respect to the system will likely be positive or neutral in the automatic use pattern because the technology functions smoothly. However, without explicitly asking individuals about their affect toward the system being utilized (and possibly introducing priming artifacts into the inquiry method), this cannot be tested. Instead, we opted to ask general questions (i.e., what are your feelings?) without artificially provoking them to think about the system.




情绪在自动使用模式中的作用也值得进一步讨论。正如我们之前所建议的，情感与所使用的系统无关，并且在自动 IS 使用模式中其效价是不确定的（可以是负的、中性的或高的）。这是由于情感的内在本质：在预期事件期间，用户体验到的最强烈的情感与其工作或个人生活中无法先验预测的其他事物有关。这意味着在自动使用模式中对系统的影响可能是积极的或中性的，因为该技术运行顺利。然而，如果没有明确询问个人对所使用的系统的影响（并且可能将启动工件引入到查询方法中），则无法对此进行测试。相反，我们选择询问一般性问题（即您的感受是什么？），而不是人为地激发他们思考系统。


Other patterns of IS use need to be developed, such as those resulting from discovery (positive unexpected) events. One such pattern might be characterized by positive affect, high arousal, computer-related thoughts, and adaptive behaviors. As noted earlier, we observed few discovery events, suggesting that exploratory IT use—“the search for novel and innovative ways of doing things” (Burton-Jones and Straub 2006, p. 236)—may be rare. Nevertheless they represent a key area for study as they should lead to positive attitudes and performance.




需要开发信息系统的其他使用模式，例如发现（积极的意外）事件所产生的模式。一种这样的模式可能以积极的情感、高度的唤醒、与计算机相关的想法和适应性行为为特征。如前所述，我们观察到的发现事件很少，这表明探索性 IT 使用——“寻找新颖和创新的做事方式”（Burton-Jones 和 Straub 2006，第 236 页）——可能很少见。然而，它们代表了一个关键的研究领域，因为它们应该导致积极的态度和表现。


Further development of IS use patterns should also extend to the traditional task–technology fit literature (Goodhue 1998). For example, ideal profiles of IS use patterns could be identified and linked to different types of tasks and situations, creating a fit model of use patterns and tasks, in which different types of performance derive from use pattern/task pairings. This would extend TTF theory through (1) improving its precision by pairing types of use with types of tasks/situations, (2) giving it a more dynamic flavor by including transitions between ideal fit states, and (3) clarifying the types of tasks that would better fit with different use patterns.




IS 使用模式的进一步发展还应该扩展到传统的任务技术匹配文献（Goodhue 1998）。例如，可以识别信息系统使用模式的理想概况并将其链接到不同类型的任务和情况，从而创建使用模式和任务的拟合模型，其中不同类型的性能源自使用模式/任务配对。这将通过以下方式扩展 TTF 理论：(1) 通过将使用类型与任务/情境类型配对来提高其精度，(2) 通过包含理想配合状态之间的转换来赋予其更动态的风格，以及 (3) 阐明更适合不同使用模式的任务类型。


## Limitations and Strengths




## 局限性和优势


As with any research, our studies have several limitations that warrant future research. One is the focus on discrepant events that were not fatal—that is, in the second study, we only studied negative events that could be overcome or ignored.




与任何研究一样，我们的研究有一些局限性，需要未来的研究。一是关注非致命性的差异事件——也就是说，在第二项研究中，我们只研究了可以克服或忽略的负面事件。


As described earlier, other limitations include our focus on expected and discrepant events, but not on discovery events, as well as our measurement of short-term rather than longterm performance.




如前所述，其他限制包括我们关注预期事件和差异事件，但不关注发现事件，以及我们对短期绩效而非长期绩效的衡量。


Despite these limitations, this investigation of IS use patterns has several strengths, in addition to those already mentioned within each study. The multiple methods had important synergistic properties that allowed for insights that would have been difficult to discover with leaner methods (Mingers 2001). These methods complemented each other by compensating for the weakness of one with the strengths of the other (Jick 1979). For example, we were able to conduct a preliminary test of our hypotheses in a natural setting with rich qualitative data from employees, which added realism to our research. We then tested our hypotheses in a controlled laboratory experiment with students via quantitative data, which added precision to our investigation. By examining the data longitudinally in the quantitative study, we could examine different types of use patterns and how they changed over time. For example, we found that the effects of discrepant IT events faded over time regardless of whether the discrepant IT event was resolved or not. Such detailed analyses added accuracy and richness to our research. Further, they allowed us to detect phenomena that could not be detected had we studied effects cross-sectionally or had we asked users to reflect on their experiences a posteriori (removed from the use experience). If the IS field wants to gain an understanding of how actual IS use unfolds and is adjusted naturally as the context changes, we need to complement commonly employed methods (e.g., surveys) with those capable of reporting rich findings longitudinally when actual use is taking place. Thus, methods such as those used here— observational, experience sampling, and physiological—may serve the field well in studying individuals’ cognitions, emotions, and behaviors that can occur outside individuals awareness during use (Heaphy and Dutton 2008).




尽管存在这些局限性，除了每项研究中已经提到的优点之外，这项对 IS 使用模式的调查还有几个优点。多种方法具有重要的协同特性，可以实现使用精简方法难以发现的见解（Mingers 2001）。这些方法通过用一种方法的优点来弥补另一种方法的缺点来相互补充（Jick 1979）。例如，我们能够在自然环境中利用来自员工的丰富定性数据对我们的假设进行初步测试，这增加了我们研究的现实性。然后，我们通过定量数据在受控实验室实验中与学生一起测试了我们的假设，这提高了我们调查的准确性。通过在定量研究中纵向检查数据，我们可以检查不同类型的使用模式以及它们如何随时间变化。例如，我们发现，无论差异 IT 事件是否得到解决，差异 IT 事件的影响都会随着时间的推移而减弱。如此详细的分析增加了我们研究的准确性和丰富性。此外，它们使我们能够检测到如果我们横向研究效果或要求用户事后反思他们的体验（从使用体验中移除）则无法检测到的现象。如果信息系统领域想要了解信息系统的实际使用如何展开并随着环境的变化而自然调整，我们需要用那些能够在实际使用发生时纵向报告丰富发现的方法来补充常用的方法（例如调查）。因此，这里使用的方法——观察、经验采样和生理——可以很好地服务于研究个人在使用过程中意识之外可能发生的认知、情绪和行为（Heaphy 和 Dutton 2008）。


## Practical Implications




## 实际意义


This research has several practical implications, such as the training of students and employees. Because of the importance of difficult situations and errors for learning (Sein and Santhanam 1999), training should be reframed such that discrepant IT events are viewed as opportunities for learning. Given that discrepant IT events are unavoidable, training could focus less on error avoidance and more on helping users develop the skills to effectively deal with difficulties. The trainer could be a role model (Compeau and Higgins 1995), showing how unexpected events could be handled, and emphasizing that computing ability is an acquirable skill (Martocchio 1994), and as such, improved through overcoming difficulties. Recent research supports this approach to learning by proposing that learning is facilitated when stress is experienced near the time when the knowledge acquisition takes place (Joëls et al. 2006). Thus, trainers can emphasize the potential learning outcomes of discrepant IT events, because any knowledge acquisition is likely to be remembered in the future.




这项研究具有几个实际意义，例如学生和员工的培训。由于困难情况和错误对于学习的重要性（Sein 和 Santhanam 1999），应重新构建培训，将不一致的 IT 事件视为学习机会。鉴于不一致的 IT 事件是不可避免的，培训可以少关注避免错误，而多关注帮助用户培养有效应对困难的技能。培训师可以成为一个榜样（Compeau and Higgins 1995），展示如何处理意外事件，并强调计算能力是一种可以习得的技能（Martocchio 1994），因此可以通过克服困难来提高。最近的研究支持这种学习方法，认为在知识获取发生时经历压力会促进学习（Joëls et al. 2006）。因此，培训师可以强调差异 IT 事件的潜在学习成果，因为任何知识获取都可能在未来被记住。


This research also has implications for IS design and performance. Our results show that better short-term performance takes place when users do not think about the system and instead focus their behaviors on the accomplishment of their tasks. This suggests that application updates should be aimed at minimizing the attention drawn to the system. One way to accomplish this would be by using intuitive interfaces, avoiding major interface changes, and making updates and new applications resemble old ones.




这项研究还对 IS 设计和性能产生影响。我们的结果表明，当用户不考虑系统而是将他们的行为集中在完成任务上时，会产生更好的短期绩效。这表明应用程序更新的目的应该是尽量减少对系统的关注。实现这一目标的一种方法是使用直观的界面，避免重大界面更改，并使更新和新应用程序与旧应用程序相似。


## Conclusion




＃＃ 结论


This research represents an initial effort to (1) conceptualize IS use patterns as different configurations of emotions, cognitions, and behaviors; (2) study how these patterns change over time as a result of IT events; and (3) examine how these patterns relate to short-term performance. Our conceptualization of IS use patterns theorizes about types of use configurations, and our two studies empirically demonstrate their existence, providing an understanding of how IT is actually used in organizations. The IS field will benefit from further theoretical and empirical efforts on IS use patterns, the tasks for which they are appropriate, and their consequences for performance.




这项研究代表了以下初步努力：(1) 将信息系统使用模式概念化为情绪、认知和行为的不同配置； (2) 研究这些模式如何因 IT 事件而随时间变化； (3) 检查这些模式与短期绩效的关系。我们对 IS 使用模式的概念化对使用配置的类型进行了理论化，并且我们的两项研究凭经验证明了它们的存在，提供了对 IT 在组织中实际使用方式的理解。 IS 领域将受益于对 IS 使用模式、它们适合的任务及其对绩效的影响的进一步理论和实证研究。

## About the Authors




## 关于作者


Ana Ortiz de Guinea is an assistant professor of Information Systems at HEC Montréal. She holds a Ph.D. in Information Systems from Queen’s University, a M.Sc. from the University of Lethbridge, and a degree in Computer Science and Engineering from the Universidad de Deusto. Prior to returning to academia, she worked as an Information Systems consultant. Her previous research has been published in Computers in Human Behavior, International Journal of Human Resource Management, International Journal of e-Collaboration, Information & Management, Journal of Global Information Management, and MIS Quarterly.




安娜·奥尔蒂斯·德几内亚 (Ana Ortiz deGuinea) 是蒙特利尔 HEC 商学院信息系统系助理教授。她拥有博士学位。女王大学信息系统学士学位，硕士学位他拥有莱斯布里奇大学的学士学位和德乌斯托大学的计算机科学与工程学位。在返回学术界之前，她担任信息系统顾问。她之前的研究成果发表在《人类行为计算机》、《国际人力资源管理杂志》、《国际电子协作杂志》、《信息与管理》、《全球信息管理杂志》和《MIS 季刊》上。


Jane Webster received her Ph.D. from New York University and is the E. Marie Shantz Professor of MIS in the School of Business at Queen’s University in Canada. She has served as a senior editor for MIS Quarterly, Vice President of Publications for the Association for Information Systems, and advisor for AIS-SIGCHI. She has published in a variety of journals including Academy of Management Journal, Communication Research, Information and Organization, Information Systems Journal, Information Systems Research, Journal of Organizational Behavior, MIS Quarterly, and Organization Science. Her current research concerns information systems and technologies to support environmental sustainability.




简·韦伯斯特获得博士学位。纽约大学博士，加拿大女王大学商学院管理信息系统 E. Marie Shantz 教授。她曾担任 MIS Quarterly 的高级编辑、信息系统协会出版物副总裁以及 AIS-SIGCHI 顾问。她在多种期刊上发表过文章，包括《管理学会杂志》、《传播研究》、《信息与组织》、《信息系统杂志》、《信息系统研究》、《组织行为杂志》、《MIS 季刊》和《组织科学》。她目前的研究涉及支持环境可持续性的信息系统和技术。

Since changes are expected after each discrepant event, the interaction between time and condition for each event should be significant.</td></tr><tr><td>Time x Condition for Discrepant IT Event 2: F(2,98) = .27, p &gt;.10 Time: F(1,98) = .30, p &gt;.10</td></tr><tr><td>Time x Condition for Discrepant IT Event 3: F(2,94) = 2.56, p &lt; .05</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="3">Physiological Arousal (Heart Rate)</td><td>Time x Condition for Discrepant IT Event 1: F(2,96) = 20.42, p &lt; .001</td></tr><tr><td>Time x Condition for Discrepant IT Event 2: F(2,96) = 3.32, p &lt; .05</td></tr><tr><td>Time x Condition for Discrepant IT Event 3: F(2,93) = 1.46, p &gt;.10 Time: F(1,93) = 7.34; p &lt; .01</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="8">Cognitions</td><td rowspan="4">Computer-Related Thoughts</td><td>Mauchly's test for sphericity assumption:  $\chi^2 (299) = 1842.85; p < .001$ </td><td rowspan="8">Because the measures of computer-related thoughts, non-computer related thoughts, exploitive behaviors, and adaptive behaviors were measured continuously and coded for each minute of the experimental task, an overall trend analysis through repeated measures ANOVA was performed for each variable. Repeated measures ANOVA with more than 1 degree of freedom for the repeated measures, which is the case here, requires a check for sphericity. The sphericity assumption is “equality of variance of the differences between treatment levels” (Field 2005, p. 428); that is, “[a]ll pairs of levels of the within-subjects variable need to have equivalent correlations” (Tabachnick and Fidell 2007, p. 329). However, when time is a within-subjects independent variable, which is the case here, the assumption of homogeneity of covariances is likely to be violated (Tabachnick and Fidell 2007). In these cases, the use of significance tests that adjust for violations of the sphericity assumption provide a valid F-ratio, such as Greenhouse-Geisser or Hyundt-Feldt (Field 2005; Tabachnick and Fidell 2007). More specifically, Girden (1992) recommends the use of the Huynh-Feldt correction when estimates of sphericity (denoted as ε) are greater than .75, and the use of the Greenhouse-Geisser adjustment when sphericity estimates are less than .75. Consequently, this recommendation was followed. Since changes are expected after each event, the overall effect of time should be significant indicating changes in these variables over the whole period of time; and the specific interaction between time and condition after each discrepant IT event should be significant indicating changes in the variables between conditions as the discrepant IT events take place. These effects fade over time, eventually becoming insignificant, as can be seen in the figures of this appendix.</td></tr><tr><td>Greenhouse-Geisser estimate of sphericity: ε = .39</td></tr><tr><td>Overall Test: Time: F(18.46, 904.76) = 3.55; 2007）。在这些情况下，使用显着性检验来调整违反球形度假设的情况可提供有效的 F 比，例如 Greenhouse-Geisser 或 Hyundt-Feldt（Field 2005；Tabachnick 和 Fidell 2007）。
更具体地说，Girden (1992) 建议当球形度估计值（表示为 ε）大于 0.75 时使用 Huynh-Feldt 校正，而当球形度估计值小于 0.75 时则使用 Greenhouse-Geisser 校正。因此，该建议被采纳。由于预计每次事件后都会发生变化，因此时间的总体影响应该是显着的，表明这些变量在整个时间段内的变化；并且每个不一致IT事件之后时间和条件之间的特定相互作用应该是显着的，指示当不一致IT事件发生时条件之间的变量的变化。这些影响会随着时间的推移而逐渐减弱，最终变得微不足道，如本附录中的图表所示。</td></tr><tr><td>Greenhouse-Geisser 球形度估计：ε = .39</td></tr><tr><td>总体测试：时间：F(18.46, 904.76) = 3.55； p＜ .001</td></tr><tr><td>对比：不一致 IT 事件 1 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 110.62； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 2 的时间 x 条件：F(2,98) = 24.77； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 3 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 15.81； p＜ .001</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="4">与计算机无关的想法</td><td>Mauchly 的球形假设检验：$\chi^2 (299) = 959.71； p < .001$ </td></tr><tr><td>Greenhouse-Geisser 球形度估计：ε = .48</td></tr><tr><td>总体测试：时间：F(23.14, 1597.56) = 13.02； p＜ .001</td></tr><tr><td>对比：不一致 IT 事件 1 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 34.40； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 2 的时间 x 条件：F(2,98) = 12.13； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 3 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 5.20； p＜ .05</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="8">行为</td><td rowspan="4">自适应行为</td><td>Mauchly 的球形假设检验：$\chi^2 (299) = 901.17； p < .001$ </td><td rowspan="8">与之前的解释相同。</td></tr><tr><td>Greenhouse-Geisser 球形度估计：ε = .55</td></tr><tr><td>总体测试：时间：F(26.26, 1286.81) = 2.17； p＜ .05</td></tr><tr><td>对比：不一致 IT 事件 1 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 38.48； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 2 的时间 x 条件：F(2,98) = 16.88； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 3 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 14.25； p＜ .001</td></tr><tr><td rowspan="4">剥削行为</td><td>Mauchly 的球形假设检验：$\chi^2 (299) = 625.87； p < .001$ </td></tr><tr><td>Greenhouse-Geisser 球形度估计：ε = .59</td></tr><tr><td>总体测试：时间：F(14.19, 1390.33) = 6.76； p＜ .001</td></tr><tr><td>对比：不一致 IT 事件 1 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 13.32； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 2 的时间 x 条件：F(2,98) = 7.96； p＜ .001 不一致 IT 事件 3 的时间 x 条件：F(2, 98) = 4.22； p＜ .05</td></tr></table>

# Popular Concepts beyond Organizations: Exploring New Dimensions of Information Technology Innovations \*




#组织之外的流行概念：探索信息技术创新的新维度\*


Ping Wang




王平


College of Information Studies

pwang@umd.edu

## Abstract




＃＃ 抽象的


The abundance of innovation concepts in the world of information technology and their differentiated influence on the design, production, and use of IT in oraanizations make it important that we understand what shapes these concepts themselves. Taking the perspective that an IT innovation concept emerges and evolves beyond organizational boundaries in a community, I argue that the prevalence or popularity of the concept in IT discourse positively influences the adoption of the underlying innovation. Then with the aim to explore what makes an IT innovation concept popular, my empirical analysis of the once highly popular concept ERP (enterprise resource planning) suggests that (1) the popularity of ERP was influenced positively by the prevalence of highlighted business problems that ERP was claimed to solve; (2) ERP's popularity was influenced negatively by the prevalence of related innovation concepts; and (3) these influences largely disappeared after ERP passed its peak popularity. These results imply that the popularity of an IT innovation concept responds to the broader climate of business and relies on the right type of attention drawn and released by other concepts in a network of concepts. Going beyond the dominant paradigm, this paper helps broaden IT innovation research along two new dimensions: toward the innovation concept, as a complement to materiar innovation, and toward community-level analysis, as an extension of the traditional oraanizational analysis. The paper also suggests that practitioners evaluate an innovation concept's fit with the broader environment and relationship with other popular concepts, as a way to make sense of the innovation and anticipate its impact on IT practice.




信息技术世界中存在丰富的创新概念，及其对组织中 IT 的设计、生产和使用的不同影响，因此了解形成这些概念本身的因素非常重要。从 IT 创新概念在社区中出现并超越组织边界的角度来看，我认为该概念在 IT 话语中的流行或流行会对潜在创新的采用产生积极影响。然后，为了探讨是什么让IT创新概念变得流行，我对曾经非常流行的ERP（企业资源计划）概念进行了实证分析，结果表明：（1）ERP的流行受到ERP声称要解决的突出业务问题的普遍存在的积极影响； （2）ERP的普及受到相关创新理念盛行的负面影响； (3)这些影响在ERP过了流行高峰期后就基本上消失了。这些结果表明，IT 创新概念的流行对更广泛的商业环境做出了反应，并依赖于概念网络中其他概念所吸引和释放的正确类型的注意力。本文超越了主流范式，帮助拓宽了IT创新研究的两个新维度：创新概念，作为物质创新的补充；社区层面的分析，作为传统组织化分析的延伸。本文还建议从业者评估创新概念与更广泛环境的契合度以及与其他流行概念的关系，以此作为理解创新并预测其对 IT 实践影响的一种方式。


Keywords: Information technology innovation, innovation concept, discourse, community, popularity, enterprise resource planning.




关键词：信息技术创新、创新理念、话语、社区、人气、企业资源规划。


# Popular Concepts beyond Organizations: Exploring New Dimensions of Information Technology Innovations




# 组织之外的流行概念：探索信息技术创新的新维度


Guys like me and Hammer just kind of throw this stuff against the wall. Some of it sticks and some doesn’t.




像我和哈默这样的人只是把这些东西扔到墙上。有些会粘住，有些不会。


⎯ Thomas H. Davenport<sup>1</sup>




⎯ 托马斯·H·达文波特<sup>1</sup>


## 1. Introduction




## 1.简介


Reflecting on the decline of business process reengineering (BPR), an information technologyenabled concept that he introduced along with Michael Hammer and James Champy in the early 1990s, Thomas Davenport recently lamented the faddishness of the IT world. His expression “to stick” in the quote above means to become highly visible, prevalent, or popular in the on-going discourse about IT. Although numerous concepts like BPR exist, few of them stick. When an IT concept sticks, it often brings about profound innovations in IT practice. Consider knowledge management (KM), which Davenport popularized with Laurence Prusak a few years after BPR was introduced. The KM concept emerged to become a highly popular topic across the trade and popular press and the subject of much academic research. KM has been translated into an \$8.8 billion worldwide market for software vendors and consultants (Malhotra, 2005) and one of the most important corporate performance-enhancement initiatives.<sup>2</sup> When an innovation concept fails to stick, i.e., when it fails to attain a certain level of popularity in IT discourse, the failure tends to forestall the development and diffusion of related material innovations.




托马斯·达文波特 (Thomas Davenport) 最近反思了业务流程重组 (BPR) 的衰落，这是他与 Michael Hammer 和 James Champy 在 20 世纪 90 年代初与 Michael Hammer 和 James Champy 一起提出的一个信息技术概念，他最近对 IT 世界的流行感到遗憾。上面引文中他所说的“坚持”意味着在正在进行的 IT 讨论中变得高度可见、流行或流行。尽管 BPR 等概念存在很多，但很少有人能够坚持下去。当一个IT理念深入人心时，往往会带来IT实践的深刻创新。以知识管理 (KM) 为例，在 BPR 推出几年后，达文波特 (Davenport) 与劳伦斯·普鲁萨克 (Laurence Prusak) 一起推广了知识管理 (KM)。知识管理概念的出现成为业界和大众媒体的热门话题以及许多学术研究的主题。知识管理已为软件供应商和顾问带来了价值 88 亿美元的全球市场（Malhotra，2005 年），也是最重要的企业绩效提升举措之一。<sup>2</sup>当创新概念未能坚持下去时，即当它未能在 IT 讨论中达到一定程度的受欢迎程度时，这种失败往往会阻碍相关材料创新的发展和传播。


Despite so much at stake, the dominant paradigm for IT innovation research is primarily focused on the adoption of new IT in the material, rather than conceptual, form. An IT innovation in the conceptual form can be referred to as an IT innovation concept, which I define as a collective idea for the development and utilization of an IT innovation. Either BPR or knowledge management, for example, represents a concept that broadly addresses what the innovation is, why organizations should undertake the innovation, and how to do so. In contrast, an IT innovation in its material form corresponds to the physical aspects such as hardware, software, and the processes enabled. Thus far, there has been little sustained research to understand who creates IT innovation concepts, how they are developed, why some concepts become highly popular but others don’t, and what differen concepts may entail for the adoption, implementation, and use of IT innovations.




尽管存在如此多的利害关系，但信息技术创新研究的主导范式主要集中在以物质形式而非概念形式采用新信息技术。概念形式的IT创新可以称为IT创新理念，我将其定义为开发和利用IT创新的集体理念。例如，业务流程再造（BPR）或知识管理所代表的概念广泛地阐述了创新是什么、为什么组织应该进行创新以及如何进行创新。相比之下，物质形式的 IT 创新对应于硬件、软件和启用的流程等物理方面。迄今为止，几乎没有持续的研究来了解 IT 创新概念的创建者、这些概念是如何开发的、为什么某些概念变得非常流行而另一些概念却没有，以及不同的概念对于 IT 创新的采用、实施和使用可能需要哪些内容。


To account for the cause and effect of an innovation concept, we should examine the collective that generates and develops it. Each collective is a community of diverse organizations interested in an innovation; members of the community talk and write about the innovation. I theorize that concepts more prevalent or popular in this on-going conversation are more likely to prompt the adoption of underlying innovations. Then the crucial question is: What makes an IT innovation concept popular?




为了解释创新概念的因果关系，我们应该考察产生和发展它的集体。每个集体都是对创新感兴趣的不同组织组成的社区；社区成员谈论并撰写有关创新的文章。我的理论是，在这场正在进行的对话中更普遍或流行的概念更有可能促进潜在创新的采用。那么关键的问题是：是什么让IT创新理念流行起来？


As an initial step to answer this question, I conducted an empirical study to examine the popularity of ERP (enterprise resource planning), arguably the most popular IT innovation concept in the past few decades. I hypothesize that the popularity of ERP was determined by the prevalence of the problems that ERP was purported to solve and by the popularity of innovation concepts related to ERP. The findings suggest that, first, the popularity of ERP, as measured by quarterly count of articles about ERP in publication outlets, was influenced positively by the prevalence of highlighted business problems that ERP was claimed to solve, but not by the problem ERP had originally been conceived to solve. Second, ERP’s popularity was influenced negatively by the prevalence of innovation concepts closely related to ERP, but not by concepts distantly related or unrelated to ERP. Third, the influence of problem discourse and related older concepts disappeared after ERP passed its peak popularity, but the influence of related newer concepts remained. These results imply that the popularity of an IT innovation concept responds to the broader climate of business and relies on the right type of attention drawn and released by other concepts within a network of concepts.




作为回答这个问题的第一步，我进行了一项实证研究来考察 ERP（企业资源规划）的受欢迎程度，这可以说是过去几十年来最流行的 IT 创新概念。我假设 ERP 的普及是由 ERP 旨在解决的问题的普遍性以及与 ERP 相关的创新概念的流行决定的。研究结果表明，首先，ERP 的受欢迎程度（以出版物中关于 ERP 的文章的季度数量来衡量）受到 ERP 声称要解决的突出业务问题的普遍性的积极影响，而不是受到 ERP 最初设想要解决的问题的积极影响。其次，ERP 的普及受到与 ERP 密切相关的创新概念盛行的负面影响，而不是受到与 ERP 关系较远或无关的概念的负面影响。第三，ERP流行高峰过后，问题话语及相关旧概念的影响消失，但相关新概念的影响依然存在。这些结果表明，IT 创新概念的流行对更广泛的商业环境做出了反应，并依赖于概念网络中其他概念所吸引和释放的正确类型的注意力。


As its principal contribution, the paper enriches the theoretical view that social cognition drives the diffusion of IT innovations (Iacono and Kling, 2001; Rogers, 1995; Swanson and Ramiller, 1997). Essentially, I argue that an innovation concept emerges from social cognition and that the popularity of the concept is one channel through which social cognition drives the innovation’s diffusion. To establish popularity as a distinctive construct in IT innovation research, my empirical investigation reveals some of the determinants of popularity. Both the theoretical arguments and the empirica findings demonstrate that IT innovation is not only an organizational endeavor but also a community undertaking beyond organizational boundaries. As such, when practitioners and researchers confront any new promising IT innovation, this research suggests that they evaluate an innovation concept’s fit with the broader business environment and relationship with other popular concepts, as a way to make sense of the innovation and anticipate its impact on IT practice and research.




作为其主要贡献，本文丰富了社会认知推动 IT 创新扩散的理论观点（Iacono 和 Kling，2001；Rogers，1995；Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997）。从本质上讲，我认为创新概念源于社会认知，而概念的流行是社会认知驱动创新扩散的一个渠道。为了将流行度确立为 IT 创新研究中的一个独特结构，我的实证研究揭示了流行度的一些决定因素。理论论证和实证结果都表明，IT 创新不仅是一项组织努力，也是一项超越组织边界的社区事业。因此，当从业者和研究人员面对任何新的有前途的 IT 创新时，本研究建议他们评估创新概念与更广泛的商业环境的契合度以及与其他流行概念的关系，以此作为理解创新并预测其对 IT 实践和研究的影响的一种方式。


## 2. Theories




## 2. 理论


Central to the research on IT innovation is the question: Why do some information technologies come to be applied widely among organizations, while others do not? Employing and extending Rogers’ (1995) seminal framework for the diffusion of innovations, IT scholars have studied information technologies as organizational innovations. Their research has converged to a dominant paradigm (Fichman, 2004). Under the paradigm, an IT innovation is defined as the organizational application of a new information technology (Swanson, 1994). Various organizational, technological, and environmental factors were found contributing to organizational IT adoptions. In a nutshell, “organizations that are larger, more diverse, have greater technical expertise, possess supportive senior management, operate in more competitive contexts, and perceive the innovation as more beneficial and compatible, are more likely to adopt a larger number of innovations, to adopt them earlier, and to implement them more thoroughly” (Fichman, 2004, p. 315).<sup>3</sup>




IT创新研究的核心问题是：为什么有些信息技术能够在组织中得到广泛应用，而另一些却没有？ IT 学者采用并扩展了 Rogers（1995）关于创新扩散的开创性框架，将信息技术作为组织创新进行了研究。他们的研究已趋于主流范式（Fichman，2004）。在该范式下，IT 创新被定义为新信息技术的组织应用（Swanson，1994）。研究发现，各种组织、技术和环境因素都有助于组织采用 IT。简而言之，“规模更大、更多元化、拥有更多技术专长、拥有支持性高级管理层、在更具竞争性的环境中运营、认为创新更有利、更兼容的组织，更有可能采用更多、更早地采用创新，并更彻底地实施创新”（Fichman，2004 年，第 315 页）。<sup>3</sup>


As models consistent with the paradigm have accomplished high predictability, Fichman (2004) suggested that the paradigm itself “may be reaching the point of diminishing returns” (p. 315) and identified several emerging research streams that do not presume the traditional assumptions of the dominant paradigm. In this spirit, I argue that the conventional focus on organization as the unit of analysis is too limiting, and IT innovation research should go beyond the organizational boundaries. I explain why next.




由于与该范式一致的模型已经实现了高度的可预测性，Fichman（2004）认为该范式本身“可能正在达到收益递减的地步”（第 315 页），并确定了几个新兴的研究流，这些研究流不假定主导范式的传统假设。本着这种精神，我认为传统的以组织为分析单位的做法过于局限，IT创新研究应该超越组织的界限。接下来我解释一下原因。


## 2.1. IT Innovations beyond Organizations




## 2.1.超越组织的 IT 创新


For adopters, it is clearly an organizational effort to implement the materials and processes associated with a new IT and assimilate them into work practices and routines. However, organizations increasingly rely on others in a broader environment to make sense of the IT and to formulate the adoption decision. Except for an IT’s inventor, all organizations learn about the technology from outsiders such as competitors, suppliers, customers, consultants, the trade press, and universities. Further, as an increasing number of organizations choose to purchase or outsource IT products and services rather than develop their own in house (Lacity and Willcocks, 1998; Swanson, 2003), organizational decision makers are increasingly subject to external dynamics in a market for information (Zucker, 1991). Therefore, analysis confined within the boundary of each adopter organization is inadequate to account for the process of IT innovations.




对于采用者来说，实施与新 IT 相关的材料和流程并将其融入工作实践和例程显然是一项组织工作。然而，组织越来越依赖更广泛环境中的其他人来理解 IT 并制定采用决策。除了 IT 发明者之外，所有组织都从外部人士（例如竞争对手、供应商、客户、顾问、商业媒体和大学）了解技术。此外，随着越来越多的组织选择购买或外包 IT 产品和服务，而不是自己开发自己的产品和服务（Lacity 和 Willcocks，1998；Swanson，2003），组织决策者越来越受到信息市场中外部动态的影响（Zucker，1991）。因此，仅限于每个采用组织范围内的分析不足以解释 IT 创新的过程。


In fact, a few innovation studies have examined a variety of actors and their activities outside the focal adopter organization, taking the economic-rationalistic, socio-relational, or socio-cognitive perspective (see Table 1 for a summary). Underlying the dominant paradigm Fichman (2004) described, the economic-rationalistic perspective focuses on the economic returns of IT innovations realized by organizations that rational decision makers run. From this perspective, the theory of network externalities explains why, for certain network technologies, the adoption decision depends on the number of other adopters (Brynjolfsson and Kemerer, 1996; Katz and Shapiro, 1986).




事实上，一些创新研究已经从经济理性主义、社会关系或社会认知的角度考察了焦点采用者组织之外的各种参与者及其活动（摘要见表 1）。在 Fichman (2004) 描述的主导范式的基础上，经济理性主义观点关注理性决策者运营的组织所实现的 IT 创新的经济回报。从这个角度来看，网络外部性理论解释了为什么对于某些网络技术，采用决策取决于其他采用者的数量（Brynjolfsson 和 Kemerer，1996；Katz 和 Shapiro，1986）。


Informational cascade theory, further, suggests that, when their private assessments of an innovation go against the weight of observed adoptions by others, prospective adopters may discount their own assessments and follow others to adopt the innovation (Bikhchandani et al., 1992; Walden and Browne, 2002). This “herd behavior” may be optimal because, according to the theory of rational expectations, the crowd’s average expected value of the innovation may approach the true value (Au and Kauffman, 2003). Common across these economic-rationalistic studies is the primary emphasis on other organizations that are also adopters of the innovations.




信息级联理论进一步表明，当他们对一项创新的个人评估与观察到的其他人的采用情况相抵触时，潜在的采用者可能会低估自己的评估并跟随其他人采用该创新（Bikhchandani 等，1992；Walden 和 Browne，2002）。这种“羊群行为”可能是最优的，因为根据理性预期理论，群体对创新的平均期望值可能接近真实值（Au and Kauffman，2003）。这些经济理性主义研究的共同点是主要强调也是创新采用者的其他组织。


Social perspectives, on the other hand, are primarily concerned with the factors and processes in the social environment of the focal innovating organization. Studies from the socio-relational perspective have examined the implications of interorganizational relationships on innovations. For example, research on social contagion has shown that adoptions are more likely to be imitated when the adopters, often in a network of competitors, are perceived as more successful, prominent, and similar to the focal organization (Greve, 1995; Strang and Macy, 2001). Exploring a broader set of “other organizations,” research on interorganizational IT has shown that adoption decisions are closely linked among organizations in the same value chain and that, in particular, power and trust among trading partners are important reasons for and consequences of innovations (Hart and Saunders, 1997; 1998). Moreover, taking an even broader view of social relations, innovation scholars have argued for “industrial infrastructures” for the innovations – networks of support and sponsorship by “other organizations” such as government agencies, research institutions, industry and professional associations (King et al., 1994; Lynn et al., 1996). For example, even though the Internet technology was invented in the 1960s, it had not been widely applied until the early 1990s when the United States government approved its use for commercial purposes (David, 2001).




另一方面，社会视角主要关注焦点创新组织的社会环境中的因素和过程。从社会关系角度的研究考察了组织间关系对创新的影响。例如，社会传染研究表明，当采用者（通常在竞争者网络中）被认为更成功、更突出并且与焦点组织相似时，采用者更有可能被模仿（Greve，1995；Strang 和 Macy，2001）。通过探索更广泛的“其他组织”，对组织间 IT 的研究表明，同一价值链中的组织之间的采用决策密切相关，特别是贸易伙伴之间的权力和信任是创新的重要原因和结果（Hart 和 Saunders，1997；1998）。此外，从更广泛的社会关系角度来看，创新学者主张创新需要“工业基础设施”——政府机构、研究机构、行业和专业协会等“其他组织”的支持和赞助网络（King等，1994；Lynn等，1996）。例如，尽管互联网技术是在20世纪60年代发明的，但直到1990年代初美国政府批准其用于商业目的时才得到广泛应用（David，2001）。


While the competitive, transactional, collaborative, and regulative relationships provide important social structures for innovations, cognitive bases are also essential. That is, organizations must understand the innovations they adopt and use. The socio-cognitive perspective of innovation research views other organizations as important sources for that understanding. For example, government authorities, as part of the industrial infrastructure just mentioned, may go beyond their regulative roles to influence the belief systems of the adopter organizations through persuasion and propaganda (King et al., 1994). Organizing vision theory suggests that various organizations interested in an IT innovation form a community where they create and develop a vision, “for organizing in a way that embeds and utilizes information technology in organizational structures and processes” (Swanson and Ramiller, 1997, p. 460). Management fashion theory highlights the roles of “management knowledge entrepreneurs” – consulting, media, and research organizations that create and disseminate management knowledge – in shaping the wave-like collective attention paid to innovations (Abrahamson, 1996a; Abrahamson and Fairchild, 1999). Similarly, research from the social construction of technology and social informatics traditions has studied the organizations that frame the innovations in their design and use (Bijker, 1987; Iacono and Kling, 2001).




虽然竞争、交易、协作和监管关系为创新提供了重要的社会结构，但认知基础也至关重要。也就是说，组织必须了解他们采用和使用的创新。创新研究的社会认知视角将其他组织视为这种理解的重要来源。例如，政府当局作为刚才提到的工业基础设施的一部分，可能会超越其监管角色，通过说服和宣传来影响采用组织的信仰体系（King等，1994）。组织愿景理论表明，对 IT 创新感兴趣的各种组织形成一个社区，在其中创建和发展愿景，“以在组织结构和流程中嵌入和利用信息技术的方式进行组织”（Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997 年，第 460 页）。管理时尚理论强调“管理知识企业家”——创造和传播管理知识的咨询、媒体和研究组织——在塑造对创新的波浪式集体关注中的作用（Abrahamson，1996a；Abrahamson 和 Fairchild，1999）。同样，来自技术和社会信息学传统的社会建构的研究也研究了在其设计和使用中框架创新的组织（Bijker，1987；Iacono 和 Kling，2001）。


Taking all of this into account, I suggest that IT innovation research extend its focus from organizational analysis to other organizations. The economic-rationalistic view of the other organizations essentially stays within the dominant paradigm (Fichman, 2004). Empirical research from the socio-relational perspective has been steadily increasing (Strang and Soule, 1998). Much remains to be explored on how other organizations shape social cognition, which, in turn, shapes innovations (DeSanctis quoted in Swanson and Ramiller, 1997, p. 458). Embedded implicitly or explicitly in the studies from the socio-cognitive perspective is the idea that an innovation not only takes place in adopter organizations where it is materialized, but also exists in a collective environment where adopters, vendors, consultants, investors, journalists, analysts, academics, and others are interested in developing the innovation as a concept. In this sense, a broader, community level of analysis of IT innovations is more than a simple shift in the level of abstraction. While the material aspect of an innovation is always associated with particular organizations, it is the innovation concept that travels across organizational boundaries (Newell et al., 2000).




考虑到所有这些，我建议IT创新研究将其重点从组织分析扩展到其他组织。其他组织的经济理性主义观点基本上停留在主导范式内（Fichman，2004）。从社会关系角度进行的实证研究一直在稳步增长（Strang 和 Soule，1998）。关于其他组织如何塑造社会认知，进而塑造创新，还有很多事情有待探索（DeSanctis 引用于 Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997 年，第 458 页）。从社会认知角度的研究中隐含或明确地体现了这样一种观念，即创新不仅发生在其具体化的采用者组织中，而且还存在于采用者、供应商、顾问、投资者、记者、分析师、学者和其他有兴趣将创新发展为概念的集体环境中。从这个意义上说，更广泛的社区层面的 IT 创新分析不仅仅是抽象层面的简单转变。虽然创新的物质方面总是与特定组织相关，但创新概念却跨越了组织边界（Newell et al., 2000）。

## 2.2. IT Innovation Concept




## 2.2. IT创新理念


Conceived in the community of organizations interested in an information technology, an IT innovation concept is a community idea about the development and utilization of the IT. For example, the customer relationship management (CRM) concept was created and developed by the CRM community. The once leading vendor Siebel Systems, despite its dominance in that community, never owned the concept; anyone interested in CRM can read, hear, write, and talk about the concept. Members of the CRM community may agree or disagree on certain aspects of the concept and, thus, promote or discredit the concept accordingly. In contrast, material elements of the CRM innovation (e.g., a CRM software package, a CRM implementation project, resources and processes involved in using CRM, and the data going into and coming out of a CRM system) often belong to particular organizations such as CRM vendors and adopters.




IT创新概念是在对信息技术感兴趣的组织社区中构思的关于IT开发和利用的社区想法。例如，客户关系管理 (CRM) 概念是由 CRM 社区创建和开发的。曾经领先的供应商 Siebel Systems 尽管在该领域占据主导地位，但从未拥有过这个概念。任何对 CRM 感兴趣的人都可以读、听、写和谈论这个概念。 CRM 社区的成员可能同意或不同意该概念的某些方面，从而相应地宣传或质疑该概念。相比之下，CRM 创新的物质元素（例如 CRM 软件包、CRM 实施项目、使用 CRM 所涉及的资源和流程，以及进出 CRM 系统的数据）通常属于特定组织，例如 CRM 供应商和采用者。


An innovation concept is similar to several notions in extant theories of social cognition. Specifically, as the product of social cognition, an innovation concept serves three functions in shaping the diffusion of the innovation. First, much as “technological frames” (Bijker, 1987) or “technologica action frames” (Iacono and Kling, 2001) simplify and condense elements of complex technologies and their potential use, an IT innovation concept theorizes a new IT by abstracting various stakeholders’ diverse interpretations of the technology into a potentially coherent meaning, which could help a large number of organizations comprehend and adopt the innovation. Second, besides meanings and interpretations, such theorization process also produces a quasi-theory that legitimates the innovation as an efficient solution to an important problem (Strang and Meyer, 1994). The strength of such theory and its effect on legitimating the innovation in part depend on and are signaled by the legitimacy of the actors contributing to the theory. Third, each innovation concept often carries an “organizing vision” for embedding and utilizing an IT in organizational structures and processes (Swanson and Ramiller, 1997). In this way, the innovation concept mobilizes material resources to realize the innovation.




创新概念类似于现有社会认知理论中的几个概念。具体而言，创新理念作为社会认知的产物，在塑造创新扩散方面发挥着三个作用。首先，就像“技术框架”（Bijker，1987）或“技术行动框架”（Iacono 和 Kling，2001）简化和浓缩了复杂技术的要素及其潜在用途一样，IT 创新概念通过将各种利益相关者对技术的不同解释抽象为潜在的连贯含义来理论化新的 IT，这可以帮助大量组织理解和采用创新。其次，除了意义和解释之外，这种理论化过程还产生了一种准理论，使创新合法化为重要问题的有效解决方案（Strang 和 Meyer，1994）。这种理论的强度及其对创新合法化的影响部分取决于对该理论做出贡献的参与者的合法性，并由该理论的合法性来体现。第三，每个创新概念通常都带有在组织结构和流程中嵌入和利用 IT 的“组织愿景”（Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997）。这样，创新理念就调动物质资源来实现创新。


In shaping the diffusion of IT innovations, innovation concepts serve the above three functions (theorization, legitimation, and mobilization) through community members’ ongoing conversation, or discourse, about the innovations. Discourse carries community members’ ideas, opinions, and beliefs underlying each concept. There are numerous discourse outlets in each community including advertisements, books, magazine articles, conference and exposition speeches, training materials, brochures, interview scripts, roundtable discussions, blogs, and so on. Discourse outlets serve as the developmental tools for community members to advance and promulgate the concept. Although for decades industry pundits and consultants have been engaging discourse to promote various innovation concepts in order to accelerate adoption, only recently has innovation research underscored the important role of discourse in enabling widespread diffusion of innovations (Abrahamson, 1991; Green, 2004; Swanson and Ramiller, 1997; 2004).




在塑造 IT 创新的传播过程中，创新概念通过社区成员关于创新的持续对话或讨论来服务于上述三个功能（理论化、合法化和动员）。话语承载着每个概念背后的社区成员的想法、意见和信仰。每个社区都有众多的话语渠道，包括广告、书籍、杂志文章、会议和博览会演讲、培训材料、小册子、采访稿件、圆桌讨论、博客等。话语渠道是社区成员推进和传播这一概念的发展工具。尽管几十年来，行业专家和顾问一直在利用话语来推广各种创新概念，以加速采用，但直到最近，创新研究才强调了话语在实现创新广泛传播方面的重要作用（Abrahamson，1991；Green，2004；Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997；2004）。


Students of discourse examine mainly two properties of discourse: the content and volume (Phillips and Hardy, 2002). In the former stream, innovation scholars have usefully investigated how actors strategically employ language to manipulate the content of discourse in order to advocate or oppose the adoption of innovations (e.g., Suddaby and Greenwood, 2005). In the latter stream, researchers have recorded the volume of discourse on particular innovation concepts in order to trace changes in the popularity of those concepts and then relate the changes to the diffusion of innovations (e.g., Abrahamson and Fairchild, 1999). A third research strategy has been to examine both content and volume, making it possible to understand the contexts in which volume patterns emerge and evolve and contents originate and shift in a discourse community. Although this study is primarily focused on the popularity of innovation concepts and its determinants in terms of the dynamic volume of discourse, as we will see, analysis of the contents (especially the sentiments expressed in the discourse) helps us understand the relationship between concept popularity and the adoptions of innovations.




研究话语的学生主要考察话语的两个属性：内容和数量（Phillips and Hardy，2002）。在前一流中，创新学者有效地研究了行为者如何战略性地运用语言来操纵话语内容，以提倡或反对创新的采用（例如，Suddaby 和 Greenwood，2005）。在后一流中，研究人员记录了有关特定创新概念的讨论量，以便追踪这些概念流行度的变化，然后将这些变化与创新的扩散联系起来（例如，Abrahamson 和 Fairchild，1999）。第三个研究策略是检查内容和数量，从而可以了解话语社区中数量模式出现和演变以及内容起源和转变的背景。尽管本研究主要关注创新概念的流行度及其动态话语量的决定因素，但正如我们将看到的，对内容（特别是话语中表达的情感）的分析有助于我们理解概念流行度与创新采用之间的关系。


## 2.3. Popularity of IT Innovation Concept




## 2.3。 IT创新理念深入人心


I define the popularity of an IT innovation concept as the prevalence of the concept in public discourse.<sup>4</sup> Once a concept is created, if the volume of discourse carrying the concept increases, the concept becomes more visible or prevalent, ascending in popularity. On the other hand, when discourse about the concept decreases, its popularity declines. The past several decades have seen many IT innovation concepts undergo wide swings in popularity.<sup>5</sup> The popularity of innovation concept has the potential to become an important construct in innovation research, because innovations are more likely to be adopted in practice if their associated concepts are more popular in the discourse, for the following theoretical reasons.




我将 IT 创新概念的流行度定义为该概念在公共话语中的流行程度。<sup>4</sup>一旦概念被创建，如果承载该概念的话语量增加，该概念就会变得更加可见或流行，受欢迎程度也会上升。另一方面，当有关这个概念的讨论减少时，它的受欢迎程度就会下降。在过去的几十年里，许多 IT 创新概念的受欢迎程度经历了大幅波动。<sup>5</sup>创新概念的受欢迎程度有可能成为创新研究的重要构建，因为如果相关概念在话语中更受欢迎，则创新更有可能被实践采用，原因如下。


Foremost, it is well documented that today’s managers suffer from information overload, that is, they receive information in excess of their available attention (Simon, 1971). Nonetheless, managers are constantly on the lookout for important new IT that they hope will bring benefits to their organizations. Innovation concepts more prevalent in the discourse are more likely to capture scarce managerial attention, thus increasing the likelihood of adoption. For example, “While on a business flight, a CEO reads in an airline magazine about an information technology innovation that promises fabulous returns to the adopting corporation. Returning home, the CEO demands immediate action from the senior information systems executive” (Ramiller, 2001, p. 287, emphasis added). While Ramiller analyzed the causes and implications of this problematic but often seen “airline magazine syndrome,” the innovation concept had to be popular enough to be reported in the airline magazine to begin with. In short, popularity helps bring an innovation onto managers’ “radar screens.”




最重要的是，有充分证据表明，当今的管理者遭受信息过载的困扰，也就是说，他们收到的信息超出了他们可用的注意力（Simon，1971）。尽管如此，管理人员仍在不断寻找重要的新 IT，他们希望这些 IT 能够为其组织带来好处。话语中更普遍的创新概念更有可能吸引稀缺的管理层注意力，从而增加采用的可能性。例如，“在商务航班上，首席执行官在航空杂志上读到一项信息技术创新，该创新有望为采用该创新的公司带来丰厚的回报。回到家后，首席执行官要求高级信息系统主管立即采取行动”（Ramiller，2001，第 287 页，重点是后加的）。虽然拉米勒分析了这种有问题但常见的“航空杂志综合症”的原因和影响，但创新概念必须足够流行才能在航空杂志上报道。简而言之，受欢迎程度有助于将创新带入管理者的“雷达屏幕”。


However, managers do not necessarily take action on everything that comes to their attention. In addition to the attention it helps attract, the popularity of an innovation concept brings out a host of meanings that increase the likelihood of adoption. On the one hand, popular innovations are often perceived as cutting-edge technologies advancing at the “forefront” of progress (Abrahamson, 1996a). In most cultures where norms of progress mandate that managers use state-of-the-art technologies to manage and operate their organizations (Granovetter, 1979), the popularity of an innovation concept renders legitimacy to those adopting the innovation. For instance, Staw and Epstein (2000) found that, when the total quality management (TQM) concept was very popular in the late 1980s to the mid 1990s, companies that adopted TQM had higher legitimacy (measured by corporate reputation and executive compensation) than did those without TQM programs. Hence, managers intuiting the positive relationship between popularity and legitimacy will adopt popular innovations to signal to other organizational stakeholders (e.g., stockholders, regulators, suppliers, and customers) that they conform to the mandate of progress, thus maintaining or enhancing their own and their organizations' reputation (Meyer and Rowan, 1977).




然而，管理者不一定对他们注意到的所有事情都采取行动。除了有助于吸引注意力之外，创新概念的流行还带来了许多意义，从而增加了采用的可能性。一方面，大众创新通常被视为处于进步“前沿”的尖端技术（Abrahamson，1996a）。在大多数文化中，进步规范要求管理者使用最先进的技术来管理和运营其组织（Granovetter，1979），创新概念的流行为那些采用创新的人提供了合法性。例如，Staw和Epstein（2000）发现，当全面质量管理（TQM）概念在20世纪80年代末至90年代中期非常流行时，采用TQM的公司比没有实施TQM计划的公司具有更高的合法性（以公司声誉和高管薪酬来衡量）。因此，管理者凭直觉了解受欢迎程度和合法性之间的积极关系，将采用流行的创新来向其他组织利益相关者（例如股东、监管者、供应商和客户）发出信号，表明他们符合进步的要求，从而维护或提高他们自己和组织的声誉（Meyer和Rowan，1977）。


On the other hand, it has been recently argued that the popularity of an innovation concept may be understood as an indicator of perceived utility of the underlying technology (Czarniawska and Sevón, 1996). Following this argument, innovation concepts more prevalent in the discourse are simply perceived to be more efficient and useful and, thus, rational, performance-driven managers adopt them. It is important to note the emphasis on the word “perceived” in the previous two sentences, since the popularity of an innovation concept does not necessarily correspond to the utility of the innovation measured objectively. As a matter of fact, Staw and Epstein (2000) found that organizations associated with popular management techniques did not have higher economic performance. Nevertheless, the illusionary link between popularity and perceived utility will occur whenever uncertainty and ambiguity surround the assessment of an innovation’s utility (Abrahamson, 1996b), a not uncommon situation where new IT is concerned. Under uncertainty and ambiguity, managers find themselves relying on unambiguous signals, such as concept popularity, as indicators of others’ assessment of the innovation to infer the utility of the underlying innovation (Bikhchandani et al., 1992). While the “wisdom of crowds” may be true in some cases but not in others (Surowiecki, 2005), utility inferred from popularity has been found in empirical research. For example, Gallaughe and Wang (2002) found that firms were willing to not only adopt Web server software products mentioned more frequently in the trade press (i.e., with a larger “mindshare”) but also pay more for these popular products (controlling for factors such as existing market share, cross-marke complementarities, standards, and trialability). Further, quite a few IT innovations whose associated concepts had been very popular became institutionalized in numerous organizations as useful and indispensable components of organizational information systems (Fichman, 2004). This ex post observation may prompt managers to expect current popular innovations to have the same favorable future course (Rosenberg, 1976) or destiny (Fichman, 2003), and this expectation may sway their decisions in favor of adoption when any innovation concept becomes popular.




另一方面，最近有人认为，创新概念的流行可以被理解为底层技术的感知效用的指标（Czarniawska 和 Sevón，1996）。根据这一论点，话语中更普遍的创新概念被简单地认为更有效、更有用，因此，理性的、绩效驱动的管理者会采用它们。值得注意的是，前两句中对“感知”一词的强调是很重要的，因为创新概念的流行程度并不一定与客观衡量的创新的效用相对应。事实上，Staw 和 Epstein（2000）发现，采用流行管理技术的组织并没有更高的经济绩效。然而，当一项创新的效用评估存在不确定性和模糊性时，流行度和感知效用之间就会出现虚幻的联系（Abrahamson，1996b），这种情况在新 IT 领域并不罕见。在不确定性和模糊性的情况下，管理者发现自己依靠明确的信号（例如概念流行度）作为他人对创新评估的指标，以推断潜在创新的效用（Bikhchandani 等，1992）。虽然“群体的智慧”在某些情况下可能是正确的，但在其他情况下则不然（Surowiecki，2005），但从流行度推断出的效用已经在实证研究中被发现。例如，Galaughe 和 Wang (2002) 发现，企业不仅愿意采用商业媒体中更频繁提及的 Web 服务器软件产品（即，具有更大的“关注度”），而且愿意为这些流行产品支付更多费用（控制现有市场份额、跨市场互补性、标准和可试用性等因素）。此外，相当多的相关概念非常流行的 IT 创新在许多组织中制度化，成为组织信息系统有用且不可或缺的组成部分（Fichman，2004）。这种事后观察可能会促使管理者期望当前流行的创新具有同样有利的未来路线（Rosenberg，1976）或命运（Fichman，2003），并且当任何创新概念变得流行时，这种期望可能会影响他们的决策，倾向于采用。


Summarizing these theoretical reasons, I argue that the prevalence of an IT innovation concept in the discourse, or its popularity, positively influences the adoption of the underlying material innovation by (1) attracting managerial attention, (2) representing the latest mandate of progress, (3) indicating perceived utility of the innovation, and (4) suggesting a favorable future of the technology. My argument, however, is subject to at least two important qualifications.




总结这些理论原因，我认为，信息技术创新概念在话语中的盛行或其受欢迎程度，通过以下方式对潜在物质创新的采用产生积极影响：(1)吸引管理层的注意力，(2)代表最新的进展任务，(3)表明创新的感知效用，(4)表明该技术的良好未来。然而，我的论点至少受到两个重要的限制。


The more obvious qualification is that the positive link between concept popularity and innovation adoptions is more likely to appear in the early to mid phases of an innovation’s lifecycle than in the late phase. For an innovation that has been proven to be ineffective, its late phase would see dwindling discourse go hand-in-hand with dwindling adoptions, hence, there would still be a positive correlation between concept popularity and innovation adoptions. On the other hand, innovations that become institutionalized would experience an increasing or stable adoption base and, at the same time, decreasing prevalence in the discourse (because there is nothing more to say or write about them), hence, there would be a less positive, or even a negative correlation between concept popularity and innovation adoptions (Green, 2004).




更明显的条件是，概念流行度和创新采用之间的正向联系更有可能出现在创新生命周期的早期到中期，而不是后期。对于一项已被证明无效的创新，到了后期，讨论的减少与采用的减少是同时发生的，因此，概念流行度与创新采用之间仍然存在正相关关系。另一方面，制度化的创新将经历不断增长或稳定的采用基础，同时，话语中的流行度不断下降（因为没有什么可说或写的），因此，概念流行度和创新采用之间的正相关性会减弱，甚至负相关（Green，2004）。


The other qualification speaks to the relationship among the adoptions of an innovation, its prevalence in the discourse, and the sentiments expressed in the innovation’s discourse. In a case study of the management innovation Quality Circles (QC), Abrahamson and Fairchild (1999) found that positive and emotionally charged language characterizes the rise of QC in discourse and practice, whereas reasoned and negative sentiments characterize QC’s decline. Based on this finding, the authors suspected that knowledge entrepreneurs (e.g., gurus, consultants, journalists, and scholars), motivated by extraordinary gains associated with popular innovations and facing severe competition in the knowledge marketplace, deliberately exaggerate the benefits of certain new technologies and use unusually positive language to promote the innovations to prospective adopters. Then, when such innovations fail to meet the expectations for whatever reason, these entrepreneurs debunk them with negative language. The success of this strategy, however, depends in part on the gullibility of the managers at prospective adopter organizations (Abrahamson, 1996b), and on the strength of the defense played by the stakeholders of existing technologies.




另一个限定条件涉及创新的采用、其在话语中的流行程度以及创新话语中表达的情感之间的关系。在管理创新质量圈 (QC) 的案例研究中，Abrahamson 和 Fairchild (1999) 发现，积极和情绪化的语言是 QC 在话语和实践中兴起的特征，而理性和消极情绪则是 QC 衰落的特征。基于这一发现，作者怀疑知识企业家（例如专家、顾问、记者和学者）受到与流行创新相关的非凡收益的激励并面临知识市场的激烈竞争，故意夸大某些新技术的好处，并使用异常积极的语言向潜在采用者推销创新。然后，当这些创新由于某种原因未能达到预期时，这些企业家就会用负面语言揭穿它们。然而，这一策略的成功部分取决于潜在采用组织的管理者的轻信程度（Abrahamson，1996b），以及现有技术的利益相关者所发挥的防御力度。


When the contest between the old and new is acute, positive sentiments may not always characterize the rise of an innovation’s discourse or adoptions. As a matter of fact, whether its discourse and adoptions will rise, in the case of a controversial innovation, becomes an open question.<sup>6</sup> In the world of IT, an example of such controversial innovations is open source software (OSS). In contrast to proprietary software, OSS is often developed in a public and collaborative manner and its source code is available for reuse, modification, and redistribution. Among the numerous OSS projects, Linux is one of the earliest and most prominent. Since Linus Torvalds invented this Unix-like computer operating system in 1991, Linux has been a controversial topic at the center of the debate over OSS and proprietary software. Employing the same methods Abrahamson and Fairchild (1999) used, I conducted a similar analysis on Linux. The upper panel of Figure 1 shows that both positive and negative sentiments were salient in the early to mid phases of Linux’ diffusion. Further, the lower




当新旧竞争激烈时，积极情绪可能并不总是代表创新话语或采用的兴起。事实上，对于一项有争议的创新，其讨论度和采用率是否会上升，成为一个悬而未决的问题。<sup>6</sup>在 IT 领域，此类争议创新的一个例子就是开源软件 (OSS)。与专有软件相比，OSS 通常以公共和协作的方式开发，其源代码可用于重用、修改和重新分发。在众多的OSS项目中，Linux是最早也是最突出的项目之一。自从 Linus Torvalds 于 1991 年发明了这种类 Unix 的计算机操作系统以来，Linux 一直是 OSS 和专有软件争论中心的一个有争议的话题。我采用与 Abrahamson 和 Fairchild (1999) 相同的方法，在 Linux 上进行了类似的分析。图 1 的上图显示，在 Linux 传播的早期到中期阶段，积极和消极情绪都很突出。此外，较低的

The raw data are the abstracts of articles whose titles, abstracts, or subjects contain Linux in the ABI/Inform Global database from 1994 to $^ { 2 0 0 7 . }$ The abstracts are scanned by the content analysis software General Inquirer, which classifies words into discrete semantic categories: positive and negative. Following Abrahamson and Fairchild’s (1999) approach, I counted the total number of words in the Linux article abstracts in each year t denoted by $X _ { t } ,$ as well as the yearly total number of words in each semantic category, $c = 1 \ \mathsf { o r } \ 2 .$ , denoted by Y<sub>tc</sub> <sub>actual</sub>. I regressed $\mathsf { Y } _ { t c \ a c t u a I }$ on X<sub>t</sub> to obtain regression coefficient $\beta _ { c . }$ Then I calculated a prediction, $\mathsf { Y } _ { t c \ p r e d i c t e d } ,$ of the number of words in the category c given the total number of words that year $X _ { t }$ using the equation: $Y _ { t c \ p r e d i c t e d } = \beta _ { c } ^ { \star } X _ { t } .$ Further, I calculated $Y _ { r e s i d u a I } = Y _ { t c a c t u a I } - Y _ { t c }$ <sub>predicted</sub>, which is the yearly deviation in the number of words in each category from the number of words in that category that would have been predicted given the total number of words in the abstracts that year. A negative value of $\mathsf { Y } _ { r e s i d u a I }$ in the “positive” category for Year t, for example, indicates that there were fewer positive words than expected in that year, so that the discourse was not particularly positive that year when compared with all other years. In contrast, a positive value of $\mathsf { Y } _ { r e s i d u a l }$ in the “positive” category for Year t indicates that the discourse was particularly positive that year when compared with all other years.

## Figure 1. Linux Sentiments, Article Counts, and Adoptions




## 图 1. Linux 情绪、文章计数和采用率


panel of Figure 1 shows that, despite the controversy around Linux, the rise of Linux discourse concurred with the increasing adoptions of Linux (as measured by quarterly Linux shipments) with a correlation of .93 (before the discourse peak). These findings suggest that the presence of negative coverage of Linux did not prevent the positive link between Linux discourse and adoptions from occurring, indicating a “no news is bad news” logic. Nonetheless, it must be acknowledged that when the negative coverage of an innovation surpasses a certain threshold, the link between prevalence to adoptions may collapse. In other words, when most people say or write that an innovation is a bad idea, the innovation’s prevalence in the discourse may still increase, but the debunking discourse may not be translated into adoptions. Therefore, the causal relationship between concept popularity and adoptions depends on the level of controversy associated with the focal innovation. A positive relationship may hold even with a relatively high level of controversy (such as in the Linux case).




图 1 的面板显示，尽管围绕 Linux 存在争议，但 Linux 讨论的兴起与 Linux 的采用率不断增加（按季度 Linux 出货量衡量）相一致，相关性为 0.93（讨论高峰之前）。这些发现表明，对 Linux 的负面报道并没有阻止 Linux 讨论和采用之间的积极联系发生，这表明了“没有新闻就是坏消息”的逻辑。尽管如此，必须承认，当一项创新的负面报道超过一定阈值时，普及率与采用率之间的联系可能会崩溃。换句话说，当大多数人说或写下一项创新是一个坏主意时，该创新在话语中的流行度可能仍会增加，但揭穿话语可能不会转化为采用。因此，概念流行度和采用之间的因果关系取决于与焦点创新相关的争议程度。即使争议程度相对较高（例如 Linux 案例），也可能保持积极的关系。


With these qualifications in mind, I contend that IT innovation research may benefit from studying the popularity of an innovation concept as a promising new construct. As Figure 2 shows, studies in the dominant paradigm for IT innovation research have traditionally investigated how organizational, technological, and environmental factors influence individual organizations’ supposedly independent and rational choices of material innovations (as indicated by Arrow 1). Complementary to the paradigm, the notion of the IT innovation concept suggests that adoption decisions, however independently and rationally made on the organizational plane, are also situated (and thus can be better understood) in a broader, interorganizational community where interested actors create and develop a grand concept for organizing an IT innovation in organizations. Specifically, popularity of the innovation concept aids the adoption of the material innovation (Arrow 2). As shown in Gallaugher and Wang’s (2002) study mentioned previously, both the factors traditionally investigated and popularity (which the authors called “mentions in the media” or “mind share”) had a significant impact on the adoptions and pricing of Web server software. However, because the susceptibility to external discourse may differ across organizations and change over time, the relative significance of the popularity effect, in comparison to that of other adoption drivers, may vary. For example, in “mindful” organizations where they attach much importance to their own organizational specifics (Swanson and Ramiller, 2004), the effect of popularity on adoption decision-making may not be vital. As an innovation concept rapidly rises to its peak ascension, the effect of popularity on adoption may become stronger, especially among the so-called “mindless” organizations or those who outsource their adoption reasoning, both relatively more susceptible to external discourse.




考虑到这些条件，我认为 IT 创新研究可能会受益于研究创新概念作为一种有前途的新结构的流行程度。如图 2 所示，IT 创新研究的主流范式传统上研究组织、技术和环境因素如何影响各个组织所谓的独立和理性的物质创新选择（如箭头 1 所示）。作为对范式的补充，IT 创新概念的概念表明，无论在组织层面上如何独立和合理地制定采用决策，也都位于（因此可以更好地理解）更广泛的组织间社区，在该社区中，感兴趣的参与者创建和开发组织组织中 IT 创新的宏伟概念。具体来说，创新概念的普及有助于材料创新的采用（箭头2）。正如前面提到的 Gallaugher 和 Wang（2002）的研究所示，传统上调查的因素和受欢迎程度（作者称之为“媒体提及”或“思想分享”）对 Web 服务器软件的采用和定价都有重大影响。然而，由于不同组织对外部话语的敏感性可能有所不同，并且会随着时间的推移而变化，因此与其他采用驱动因素相比，受欢迎程度效应的相对重要性可能会有所不同。例如，在“正念”组织中，他们非常重视自己的组织细节（Swanson 和 Ramiller，2004），受欢迎程度对采用决策的影响可能并不重要。随着创新概念迅速上升到顶峰，受欢迎程度对采用的影响可能会变得更强，尤其是在所谓的“无意识”组织或外包其采用推理的组织中，这两种组织相对更容易受到外部话语的影响。
