## Figure 2. Information Technology Innovation Concept vs. Material Innovation




## 图2.信息技术创新概念与物质创新


Further, the relationship between popularity and adoption should be understood as reciprocal because, as more organizations adopt the innovation, more community members are interested in talking, writing, hearing, and reading about the innovation concept, boosting its popularity (Arrow 3). Especially when organizations with high status undertake an innovation, these high-profile adoptions will literally elicit a high profile – a high level of public exposure – for the innovation, raising its perceived legitimacy and utility (Wang and Swanson, 2007). Although it is interesting to tease out the construct of popularity, the theoretical value of the construct in understanding innovation diffusion would be limited if popularity were entirely induced from adoption. What other factors might drive popularity? The answer to this question will eventually establish the popularity construct’s own legitimacy in IT innovation research, as opposed to its perception as a synonym of adoption in a tautological argument. Accordingly, my empirical investigation seeks to answer the research question: What, besides adoption, makes an IT innovation concept popular?




此外，受欢迎程度和采用率之间的关系应该被理解为相互的，因为随着越来越多的组织采用创新，更多的社区成员有兴趣谈论、写作、听到和阅读创新概念，从而提高了其受欢迎程度（箭头3）。特别是当地位较高的组织进行创新时，这些引人注目的采用实际上会引起创新的高知名度——高水平的公众曝光，从而提高其感知的合法性和实用性（Wang 和 Swanson，2007）。尽管梳理流行度的构造很有趣，但如果流行度完全是由采用引起的，那么该构造在理解创新扩散方面的理论价值将受到限制。还有哪些其他因素可能会推动受欢迎程度？这个问题的答案最终将在 IT 创新研究中确立流行结构自身的合法性，而不是在同义反复的论证中将其视为采用的同义词。因此，我的实证调查旨在回答以下研究问题：除了采用之外，是什么让 IT 创新概念变得流行？


## 2.4. Hypothesis Development




## 2.4。假设发展


Popularity is a property of an innovation concept, which belongs to the community where the concept is created and sustained. One challenge in exploring the determinants of popularity is that the community, as a whole, does not plan, coordinate, or take any action to directly boost or suppress the popularity of any concept and, thus, researchers cannot explain popularity simply by studying the characteristics of the community. In fact, the members of an innovation community discuss the innovation concept in various discourse outlets in largely free ways; hence, attempts to explain popularity in the aggregate (i.e., a community’s total volume of discourse on an innovation concept) miss the very opportunity to understand the pertinent context where community members select one concept to discuss over another, and, thus, lead their popularity to rise or fall.




流行度是创新概念的一种属性，它属于该概念被创造和维持的社区。探索流行度决定因素的一个挑战是，社区作为一个整体，不会计划、协调或采取任何行动来直接促进或抑制任何概念的流行度，因此，研究人员不能简单地通过研究社区的特征来解释流行度。事实上，创新共同体的成员在各种话语渠道上以基本上自由的方式讨论创新概念；因此，试图解释总体受欢迎程度（即社区关于创新概念的话语总量）的尝试错过了理解社区成员选择一个概念讨论另一个概念的相关背景的机会，从而导致其受欢迎程度上升或下降。


However, it is another challenge to track down the individual and organizational members of an innovation community and theorize how their traits and actions influence the popularity of the innovation concept in the discourse. Notwithstanding the obvious observation difficulty, stories of particular organizational and behavioral details that lead to an increased likelihood of discussing certain concepts defy theoretical prediction. The problem is that the diverse and dynamic membership of an innovation community makes it difficult to consistently predict what traits or actions matter, to what extent, and when they matter. This approach would neglect the fact that diverse members belong to the same community and, by interacting with each other, they come to develop, to varying degrees, similar appreciations and common sensitivities for innovation concepts. Blumer (1969) argued that it is these similar appreciations and common sensitivities that sharpen and direct diverse actors’ “feelings of discrimination,” which further channel their seemingly independent judgments and autonomous choices that turn out to be largely the same.




然而，追踪创新社区的个人和组织成员并理论化他们的特征和行为如何影响创新概念在话语中的受欢迎程度是另一个挑战。尽管存在明显的观察困难，但导致讨论某些概念的可能性增加的特定组织和行为细节的故事违背了理论预测。问题在于，创新社区的成员多元化且充满活力，因此很难一致地预测哪些特征或行动重要、重要程度如何以及何时重要。这种方法忽视了这样一个事实：不同的成员属于同一个社区，通过彼此互动，他们在不同程度上形成了对创新概念的相似欣赏和共同敏感性。布鲁默（Blumer，1969）认为，正是这些相似的欣赏和共同的敏感性加剧和引导了不同行为者的“歧视感”，这进一步引导了他们看似独立的判断和自主选择，但事实证明，这些判断和自主选择基本上是相同的。


One way to meet both challenges mentioned above is to focus on the prevalence of an innovation concept in each outlet of published discourse. On the one hand, published discourse outlets in democratic societies, whether they are trade press, popular press, or academic journals, independently select what topics to cover and how to cover them. Such autonomous practices mimic the processes by which members choose to participate in the community discourse. On the other hand, it is, in fact, these outlets’ business to represent what community members say and write about an innovation. Publication outlets, through interactions with their readers, contributors, advertisers, and peers, can and do sense similar appreciation and common sensitivities for specific topics. More often in alignment with the dominant topical trends across innovation communities than not, publication outlets serve as unwitting agents (Blumer, 1969) or careful gatekeepers (Allen, 1977) of the public in selecting concepts to pay attention to. Therefore, in order to explain the popularity of any innovation concept, the researcher may examine the prevalence of the concept in published discourse outlets and investigate the similar appreciation and common sensitivities that underlie popularity.




应对上述两个挑战的一种方法是关注创新概念在每个出版话语中的流行。一方面，民主社会的出版话语媒体，无论是商业媒体、大众媒体还是学术期刊，都独立选择报道的主题以及如何报道。这种自主实践模仿了成员选择参与社区话语的过程。另一方面，事实上，这些媒体的职责是代表社区成员对创新的言论和报道。出版机构通过与读者、撰稿人、广告商和同行的互动，可以而且确实感受到对特定主题的相似欣赏和共同敏感性。出版物往往与创新界的主导话题趋势保持一致，在选择要关注的概念时充当公众不知情的代理人（Blumer，1969）或谨慎的看门人（Allen，1977）。因此，为了解释任何创新概念的流行，研究人员可以检查该概念在已发表的话语渠道中的流行程度，并调查流行背后的相似欣赏和共同敏感性。


An apparent source for similar appreciation and common sensitivities is the practice of business and management, from which publication outlets and their contributors draw ideas and to which they build relevant discourse. One enduring emphasis in business and management is organizational performance (March and Sutton, 1997). On the one hand, managers routinely set targets for performance in finance, operation, marketing, customer services, employee relations, and the like. When gaps exist between the targets and the performance actually achieved, managers are motivated to find the problems causing the performance gaps and to search for innovative solutions to the problems, therefore narrowing the gaps (March and Simon, 1958). At any given time in an organization, there may be a number of performance gaps caused by numerous problems. Given the limited amount of managerial attention, those few problems and performance gaps that discourse highlights and brings to the top of managers’ agendas can prompt managers to search for possible solutions (Hilgartner and Bosk, 1988). On the other hand, numerous administrative and technologica innovations emerge and exist for improving business and management performance. Many of these innovations are solutions in search of problems (Cohen et al., 1972). One innovation may be purported as the solution to different problems at different points of time. For example, CRM was initially promoted as an automation tool for improving the efficiency of an organization’s sales forces, then as a backbone technology for enhancing the effectiveness of customer services, and now as a marketing innovation for market intelligence gathering (Wang and Swanson, 2008). Taken together, for an innovation concept to gain in relevance and appeal, the concept must be linked to a current problem or performance gap widely recognized in the practice of business and management (Swanson and Ramiller, 1997). Once an innovation concept is linked to a business problem, the pervasiveness of the problem can then be hypothesized to shape managers’ collective appreciation for its solution, and thus, the likelihood that the innovation concept appears in a discourse outlet. Empirical studies of management innovations have found evidence in support of this hypothesis. For example, the fluctuation of reported labor union activities was positively associated with the popularity of systematic management between 1879 and 1932 (Shenhav, 1995). Similarly, Abrahamson (1997) found that recorded voluntary turnover was positively associated with the prevalence of human relations/personnel management discourse between 1875 and 1992. In this study, I test this hypothesis in the context of IT innovations.<sup>7</sup>




类似欣赏和共同敏感性的一个明显来源是商业和管理实践，出版机构及其撰稿人从中汲取想法并建立相关话语。商业和管理中一个持久的重点是组织绩效（March 和 Sutton，1997）。一方面，管理者通常会在财务、运营、营销、客户服务、员工关系等方面设定绩效目标。当目标与实际实现的绩效之间存在差距时，管理者就会有动力去寻找导致绩效差距的问题，并寻找解决问题的创新解决方案，从而缩小差距（March和Simon，1958）。在组织中的任何特定时间，可能存在由众多问题引起的许多绩效差距。鉴于管理人员的注意力有限，话语中强调并提上管理者议程首位的少数问题和绩效差距可以促使管理者寻找可能的解决方案（Hilgartner 和 Bosk，1988）。另一方面，许多行政和技术创新的出现和存在都是为了提高业务和管理绩效。其中许多创新都是为了寻找问题的解决方案（Cohen 等，1972）。一项创新可能被认为是不同时间点不同问题的解决方案。例如，CRM 最初被推广为一种用于提高组织销售人员效率的自动化工具，然后作为增强客户服务有效性的骨干技术，现在作为市场情报收集的营销创新（Wang 和 Swanson，2008）。总而言之，要使创新概念获得相关性和吸引力，该概念必须与商业和管理实践中广泛认可的当前问题或绩效差距联系起来（Swanson 和 Ramiller，1997）。一旦创新概念与业务问题联系起来，就可以假设该问题的普遍性，从而影响管理者对其解决方案的集体评价，从而影响创新概念出现在话语出口的可能性。对管理创新的实证研究发现了支持这一假设的证据。例如，报告的工会活动的波动与 1879 年至 1932 年间系统化管理的普及呈正相关（Shenhav，1995）。同样，Abrahamson（1997）发现，有记录的自愿离职与 1875 年至 1992 年间人际关系/人事管理话语的盛行呈正相关。在这项研究中，我在 IT 创新的背景下检验了这一假设。<sup>7</sup>


Hypothesis 1. The prevalence of a business problem in discourse is positively associated with the volume of the discourse purporting an IT innovation as the solution in a discourse outlet.




假设 1. 话语中业务问题的普遍性与话语出口中声称 IT 创新作为解决方案的话语量呈正相关。


Concepts rarely arise in isolation. In the IT academic research community, Lyytinen and King (2004) observed that dynamic and diverse research subcommittees compete and coalesce around “markets of ideas.” Likewise, in the practical reality of innovating with IT, organizations and their decision makers are in the market for innovation concepts. Swanson and Ramiller (1997) argued that innovation concepts belong to various problem domains. In each domain, similar concepts addressing similar problems may overlap, blend, or clash with each other. To understand the ecology of innovation concepts in a problem domain, consider the notion of niche. In the ecological context, “the niche of an animal means its place in the biotic environment, its relations to food and enemies” (Elton, 1927). One species occupies one niche. Species of larger size occupy larger niches. If two species are consuming the same sources of food at the same time and place in the same stable community, as each niche has a finite amount of resources, one of the species will have the advantage and the other will become extinct. In short, complete competitors cannot coexist in the same niche. This phenomenon is called the principle of competitive exclusion (Gause, 1934).




概念很少单独出现。在 IT 学术研究界，Lyytinen 和 King（2004）观察到，充满活力和多样化的研究小组委员会围绕“思想市场”展开竞争和联合。同样，在 IT 创新的现实中，组织及其决策者也在市场中寻求创新概念。 Swanson 和 Ramiller (1997) 认为创新概念属于不同的问题领域。在每个领域中，解决类似问题的类似概念可能会相互重叠、混合或冲突。要了解问题领域中创新概念的生态，请考虑利基概念。在生态背景下，“动物的生态位意味着它在生物环境中的位置，它与食物和敌人的关系”（Elton，1927）。一种物种占据一个生态位。体型较大的物种占据较大的生态位。如果两个物种在同一个稳定的群落中同时、同一地点消耗相同的食物来源，由于每个生态位的资源数量有限，其中一个物种将占据优势，而另一个物种将灭绝。简而言之，完全的竞争对手不能在同一利基市场中共存。这种现象称为竞争排斥原理（Gause，1934）。


By the same token, each innovation concept can be likened to a species competing with other concepts for resources. What kind of resources does a concept consume? Just like an arctic fox subsisting upon guillemot eggs and the remains of seals killed by polar bears, an innovation concept consumes attention from the member organizations and their people in the community. Lions die if they eat grass only. Certain concepts require certain types of attention. For example, the concept of computer-aided software engineering (CASE) asks for attention mainly from system analysts and programmers. Their attention may also be “nutritious” to the object-oriented programming (OOP) concept, but not so much to CRM, which thrives on the attention from a different group of people. Because CASE and OOP “consume” the same type of attention (i.e., from the same group of people), the two concepts are related. Innovation concepts can be related for other reasons. They may be developed to solve similar problems; require common knowledge for understanding the problems or similar skills to implement the solutions; and/or share the practices, functions, or roles to be affected by the innovations. To the extent two innovation concepts are related, attention may flow from one to the other. Therefore, the discourses on related concepts relying on the same type of attention should be correlated (negatively) in terms of their popularity, while discourses for unrelated concepts not relying on the same type of attention should not be correlated. Studying the prevalence of four consecutive employee-management innovations in discourse, Abrahamson and Fairchild (1999) found a consistent tendency for the sharp downswing in the volume of an innovation discourse to antedate the sharp upswing in the next innovation discourse. They interpreted from this result that, in the employee-management innovation niche, the decline of an old innovation’s popularity triggers the rising popularity of the next innovation. In terms of attention flow, decreasing discourse for a concept releases the attention needed for a related concept to rise. This leads to the second hypothesis.




同样，每个创新概念都可以比作一个物种，与其他概念竞争资源。一个概念消耗什么样的资源？就像北极狐依靠海鸠蛋和被北极熊杀死的海豹残骸生存一样，创新理念吸引了成员组织及其社区人员的关注。狮子如果只吃草就会死。某些概念需要某些类型的关注。例如，计算机辅助软件工程（CASE）的概念主要需要系统分析师和程序员的关注。他们对面向对象编程 (OOP) 概念的关注也可能是“有营养的”，但对 CRM 的关注度却不那么高，因为 CRM 的蓬勃发展依赖于不同群体的关注。因为 CASE 和 OOP “消耗”相同类型的注意力（即来自同一组人），所以这两个概念是相关的。创新概念可能因其他原因而相关。它们可能被开发来解决类似的问题；需要了解问题的常识或实施解决方案的类似技能；和/或分享受创新影响的实践、职能或角色。当两个创新概念相关时，注意力可能会从一个创新概念转移到另一个创新概念。因此，依赖相同类型注意力的相关概念的话语在流行度方面应该是相关的（负相关），而不依赖同类型注意力的不相关概念的话语不应该相关。在研究话语中连续四次员工管理创新的流行情况时，Abrahamson 和 Fairchild（1999）发现，创新话语量急剧下降的一致趋势先于下一次创新话语量的急剧上升。他们根据这一结果解释说，在员工管理创新利基市场中，旧创新受欢迎程度的下降会引发下一个创新受欢迎程度的上升。就注意力流而言，一个概念的话语减少释放了相关概念上升所需的注意力。这引出了第二个假设。


Hypothesis 2. The prevalence of an innovation concept in discourse is negatively associated with the volume of the discourse on a related concept in a discourse outlet.




假设2：话语中创新概念的流行程度与话语出口中相关概念的话语量负相关。


## 3. Methods




## 3. 方法


To test the hypotheses, I have chosen to examine one IT innovation concept as an initial step to understand the making of popularity. If support is found, tests using discourses on other concepts should be in order. The copiousness of innovation concepts in IT poses a challenge: which concept to study? Following Benbasat and Zmud’s (1999) suggestion to increase the relevance of IT research, the concept to be studied should be relatively current and represent an innovation with significant market size. Additionally, its popularity should have gone through the full ascendant phase and part of the descendant phase so that there is sufficient variance to be explained by the factors identified above. These criteria eliminated concepts such as material requirements planning (MRP), since it is relatively old, data administration, since its scope is relatively limited, and cloud computing, since it is quite new. ERP, in contrast, meets the above criteria. In addition, ERP was arguably the most popular IT innovation in the 1990s (Robey et al., 2002) and potentially even the 20th century (Wagner and Newell, 2006). Further, since its origination, the term ERP has consistently focused on the domain of organizational IT applications, as opposed to the Internet and e-commerce, whose use has become quite general and diffuse. Fore these reasons, I study the popularity of ERP.




为了检验这些假设，我选择研究一个 IT 创新概念，作为了解受欢迎程度的第一步。如果找到支持，则应按顺序使用其他概念的论述进行测试。 IT 领域大量的创新概念提出了一个挑战：该研究哪个概念？遵循 Benbasat 和 Zmud（1999）关于提高 IT 研究相关性的建议，要研究的概念应该是相对当前的，并且代表具有重大市场规模的创新。此外，它的受欢迎程度应该经历了完整的上升阶段和部分下降阶段，以便有足够的方差可以通过上述确定的因素来解释。这些标准消除了诸如物料需求计划 (MRP) 等概念，因为它相对较旧；数据管理，因为它的范围相对有限；以及云计算，因为它相当新。相比之下，ERP 满足上述标准。此外，ERP 可以说是 20 世纪 90 年代（Robey 等，2002）甚至 20 世纪（Wagner 和 Newell，2006）最受欢迎的 IT 创新。此外，自诞生以来，ERP 一词一直关注组织 IT 应用领域，而不是互联网和电子商务，后者的使用已变得相当普遍和分散。基于这些原因，我研究了ERP的普及。


## 3.1. The ERP Concept




## 3.1. ERP概念


ERP represents a class of enterprise software that integrates an organization’s diverse business functions into one system. The heart of an ERP system is a central database that collects data from and feeds data into all the ERP system’s individual application components, called modules. These modules support diverse business functions such as finance, manufacturing, logistics, and human resources. When new information is entered or updated in one module, other related modules in the system are automatically updated.




ERP 代表一类企业软件，它将组织的不同业务功能集成到一个系统中。 ERP 系统的核心是一个中央数据库，它从 ERP 系统的所有单独应用程序组件（称为模块）收集数据并将数据输入其中。这些模块支持多种业务功能，例如财务、制造、物流和人力资源。当某一模块录入或更新新信息时，系统中其他相关模块也会自动更新。


Although enterprisewide systems have been in existence for decades, it was in April 1990 when Gartner Group introduced the ERP concept as the next-generation of MRP II (manufacturing resource planning) in response to many large manufacturing companies’ dissatisfaction with their MRP II systems (Keller, 1999). In 1992, market leader SAP introduced a client-server-based ERP package that quickly conquered the European and U.S. markets. Major ERP vendors (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Baan, and J. D. Edwards) enjoyed dramatic growth in the mid and late 1990s. By the end of 1998, more than 60 percent of the Fortune 1000 companies had implemented ERP core applications (Stein, 1999). With expanding functionalities and new interfaces added, ERP packages quickly spread from large companies to midsize companies, from European and U.S. markets to Asia Pacific and Latin America, from manufacturing and logistics companies to other vertical industries such as wholesale, healthcare, and banking. Since 2000, the adoption rates for ERP solutions have suggested a market in decline. Nonetheless, an increasing number of organizations have earmarked budgets to enhance their existing ERP systems.<sup>8</sup> Further, web-enabled applications have opened




尽管企业范围的系统已经存在了几十年，但直到 1990 年 4 月，Gartner Group 才引入了 ERP 概念作为下一代 MRP II（制造资源计划），以应对许多大型制造公司对其 MRP II 系统的不满（Keller，1999）。 1992 年，市场领导者 SAP 推出了基于客户端-服务器的 ERP 软件包，迅速征服了欧洲和美国市场。主要 ERP 供应商（SAP、Oracle、PeopleSoft、Baan 和 J. D. Edwards）在 20 世纪 90 年代中后期取得了巨大的增长。到 1998 年底，超过 60% 的财富 1000 强公司已经实施了 ERP 核心应用程序（Stein，1999）。随着功能的扩展和新界面的增加，ERP软件包迅速从大型企业扩展到中型企业，从欧美市场扩展到亚太和拉丁美洲，从制造和物流公司扩展到批发、医疗和银行等其他垂直行业。自 2000 年以来，ERP 解决方案的采用率表明市场正在下降。尽管如此，越来越多的组织已指定预算来增强其现有 ERP 系统。<sup>8</sup>此外，基于网络的应用程序已经开放


new market opportunities for ERP.




ERP的新市场机遇。


## 3.2. Data




## 3.2.数据


Among the discourse outlets for ERP, this study focuses on archived published discourse as the primary data source, mainly because archived publications offer the most reliable and systematic records of the discourse. They are free from the recollection bias commonly seen in interviews and technical difficulties often occurring in observations. Specifically, I counted articles under specific subjects in the ABI/Inform Global database (hereafter, ABI). ABI has provided indexing for more than 1,800 outlets or periodicals since 1971. Representing a wide variety of business-related disciplines and industries, these periodicals include academic journals (e.g., MIS Quarterly), industry-specific magazines (e.g., Chemical Week), trade press (e.g., InformationWeek), and popular press (e.g., Fortune).




在ERP的话语渠道中，本研究以存档出版物话语作为主要数据来源，主要是因为存档出版物提供了最可靠、最系统的话语记录。他们没有采访中常见的记忆偏差，也没有观察中经常出现的技术困难。具体来说，我统计了 ABI/Inform Global 数据库（以下简称 ABI）中特定主题下的文章。自 1971 年以来，ABI 已为 1,800 多家媒体或期刊提供索引。这些期刊代表各种与商业相关的学科和行业，包括学术期刊（例如，MIS Quarterly）、行业特定杂志（例如，Chemical Week）、商业媒体（例如，InformationWeek）和大众媒体（例如，Fortune）。


The first article on ERP appeared in ABI in October 1991 (Baer, 1991). The overall volume of ERP articles increased until 1999 and began decreasing in 2000, suggesting that a 45-quarter window (Q4 1991- Q4 2002) would be sufficient to map the popularity of the ERP concept. Since the popularity of an innovation concept helps attract managerial attention conducive for adoption, as I reasoned previously, I counted articles that feature ERP as a main subject, because they are more likely to catch readers’ attention than those mentioning it only in passing. In 1997, considering the large volume of articles focusing on ERP, ABI created a unique subject heading “enterprise resource planning” for ABI content analysts to categorize articles discussing ERP as a main subject.<sup>9</sup> To measure the volume of ERP discourse in each outlet, the dependent variable of the empirical study, searched in the titles and abstracts of all articles in ABI for the phrase “enterprise resource planning” for each periodical in each quarter<sup>10</sup> from 1991 to 1996 and found 125 articles. Then I asked two raters, who did not know the purpose of this study, to independently read the abstracts of the articles and put them in two categories: articles discussing ERP as a main subject and articles mentioning ERP in passing. The inter-rater reliability of the classification was 96 percent. For further analysis, I then retained 94 that both raters considered to be articles about ERP from 1991-96. Next, I counted articles listed under the ERP subject heading for each periodical in each quarter from 1997 to 2002.




第一篇关于 ERP 的文章于 1991 年 10 月发表在 ABI 上（Baer，1991）。 ERP 文章的总量在 1999 年之前一直在增加，并在 2000 年开始下降，这表明 45 个季度的窗口（1991 年第 4 季度 - 2002 年第 4 季度）足以反映 ERP 概念的受欢迎程度。正如我之前所推理的那样，由于创新概念的流行有助于吸引管理层的注意，从而有利于采用，因此我统计了以 ERP 为主题的文章，因为它们比那些只是顺便提及的文章更容易引起读者的注意。 1997 年，考虑到关注 ERP 的文章数量较多，ABI 创建了一个独特的主题标题“企业资源规划”，供 ABI 内容分析师将讨论 ERP 的文章作为主要主题进行分类。<sup>9</sup>为了衡量各网点 ERP 话语量（实证研究的因变量），在 ABI 中所有文章的标题和摘要中搜索每个期刊中每个期刊的“企业资源规划”短语。 1991年至1996年四分之一<sup>10</sup>，找到125篇文章。然后我请两位不知道本研究目的的评分者独立阅读文章摘要，并将其分为两类：以 ERP 为主题的文章和顺便提及 ERP 的文章。该分类的评分者间可靠性为 96%。为了进一步分析，我保留了 94 篇，两位评估者都认为是 1991-96 年有关 ERP 的文章。接下来，我统计了 1997 年至 2002 年每个季度每个期刊的 ERP 主题标题下列出的文章。


Hypothesis 1 is concerned with the prevalence of business problems in discourse. In its nearly twodecade evolution, ERP has been argued to solve a number of problems for organizations in many industries (O'Leary, 2000). The origins of such rationales differ and their own popularities vary over time. In this research, I study four problems to illustrate the impact of problem discourse on the popularity of ERP and the methods to examine such impact. First, one of the problems that ERP systems were originally claimed to solve is the fragmentation of information in large business organizations (Davenport, 1998). To see how much this problem was highlighted in the discourse, I counted articles in ABI about the information fragmentation problem. Specifically, for lack of a distinctive term, I first searched for articles under the subjects of both “information management” and “problems.” The search returned 319 articles published between 1991 and 2002 discussing various problems with information management. Second, to figure out which articles addressed information fragmentation specifically, I randomly selected 33 from the 319 articles and read their abstracts. I found five articles about information fragmentation. Based on my reading of the full-text of these five articles, I then compiled a list of keywords frequently used in discussing information fragmentation: technological silos, organizational silos, redundancy, error, delay, access difficulty, and inconsistency. Next, the two raters read the abstracts of the 319 articles found in the first step using the keywords for information fragmentation. They independently selected the articles that mentioned at least one of the codes in the abstracts. The inter-rater reliability was 93 percent. In total, there were 69 articles that both raters considered addressed information fragmentation. Finally, I classified the 69 articles by quarter based on their publication dates. In this way, I obtained data for the first independent variable, namely the number of articles about the information fragmentation problem published in ABI each quarter. Unlike the dependent variable, which measures the volume of ERP discourse at each periodical level, this independent variable aggregates article counts across periodicals each quarter. In fact, all independent variables are aggregate counts based on the assumption that the community members’ common sensitivities and similar appreciation for broader issues such as information fragmentation are more of community phenomena than are the properties of any particular periodical.




假设 1 涉及商业问题在话语中的普遍性。在其近二十年的发展过程中，ERP 被认为可以为许多行业的组织解决许多问题（O'Leary，2000）。这些理由的起源各不相同，而且它们各自的受欢迎程度也随着时间的推移而变化。在本研究中，我研究了四个问题来说明问题话语对ERP普及的影响以及检验这种影响的方法。首先，ERP系统最初声称要解决的问题之一是大型商业组织中的信息碎片化（Davenport，1998）。为了了解这个问题在讨论中的突出程度，我统计了 ABI 中有关信息碎片问题的文章。具体来说，由于缺乏独特的术语，我首先搜索了“信息管理”和“问题”主题下的文章。搜索返回了 1991 年至 2002 年间发表的 319 篇文章，讨论了信息管理的各种问题。其次，为了找出哪些文章专门解决了信息碎片化问题，我从 319 篇文章中随机选择了 33 篇并阅读了它们的摘要。我找到了五篇关于信息碎片化的文章。根据我对这五篇文章全文的阅读，我整理了一个讨论信息碎片化时经常使用的关键词：技术孤岛、组织孤岛、冗余、错误、延迟、访问困难和不一致。接下来，两位评分者使用关键词阅读第一步找到的319篇文章的摘要，进行信息碎片化。他们独立选择了摘要中至少提到一个代码的文章。评估者间的可靠性为 93%。两位评估者认为总共有 69 篇文章解决了信息碎片问题。最后，我根据发表日期对这 69 篇文章进行了季度分类。这样我就得到了第一个自变量的数据，即ABI每季度发表的关于信息碎片问题的文章数量。与衡量每个期刊级别的 ERP 讨论量的因变量不同，该自变量汇总了每个季度各期刊的文章数量。事实上，所有自变量都是基于以下假设的汇总计数：社区成员的共同敏感性和对信息碎片等更广泛问题的相似认识更多地属于社区现象，而不是任何特定期刊的属性。


Second, it has also been argued that ERP systems enable organizations to streamline operations, reducing operational inefficiency (Davenport, 1998; Wagle, 1998). Thus, I examine how the discourse about operational inefficiency is related to the popularity of ERP. Similar to information fragmentation, operational inefficiency may manifest itself in many forms and, accordingly, can be discussed with diverse terms. To measure the volume of discourse on operational inefficiency, I employed the same method I used for information fragmentation. I first search articles with the subjects “operations management” and “problems” in ABI. Then I developed a list of keywords for operational inefficiency in managing facilities, procurement, production (including planning, control, quality, inventory, and safety), maintenance, and research and development. Reading of article abstracts turned up 78 articles published between 1991 and 2002 that were selected by both raters as related to operational inefficiency. I classified them by quarter, and the second independent variable was established.




其次，也有人认为 ERP 系统使组织能够简化运营，减少运营效率低下的情况（Davenport，1998；Wagle，1998）。因此，我研究了有关运营效率低下的讨论与 ERP 的普及有何关系。与信息碎片化类似，运营效率低下可能以多种形式表现出来，因此可以用不同的术语来讨论。为了衡量运营效率低下的讨论量，我采用了与信息碎片化相同的方法。我首先在ABI中搜索主题为“运营管理”和“问题”的文章。然后，我针对管理设施、采购、生产（包括规划、控制、质量、库存和安全）、维护和研发方面运营效率低下制定了一系列关键词。阅读文章摘要后，发现了 1991 年至 2002 年间发表的 78 篇文章，两位评估者均认为这些文章与运营效率低下有关。我将它们按季度分类，并建立了第二个自变量。


Third, the Year 2000 (Y2K) conversion issue was brought to managers’ attention in the mid-1990s. To conserve computer memory and storage space and thus reduce the high cost of computing, programmers in the 1950s and 1960s used two, rather than four, digits to represent year. This practice became a programming convention, but it became clear later that software programmed this way would confuse years after 1999 with those a century ago. Worried that their legacy systems might break down when Year 2000 arrived, many companies found it more economical to completely replace their legacy systems with Y2K-compliant ERP systems (Minahan, 1998). To investigate the influence of this problem on the popularity of the ERP concept, I counted articles on Y2K, by searching the unique term Y2K or Year 2000 in the subjects and, when subjects were not available, in the titles and abstracts of articles. Along with the Y2K problem, the difficulty of maintaining inefficient and deficient legacy systems was brought to light. ERP was proposed and adopted to replace the legacy systems whether or not Y2K was the primary issue. Therefore, I counted articles on legacy systems, by searching the unique term “legacy systems” in the subjects, or titles or abstracts (when subjects were not available). In similar ways, I constructed the third and fourth independent variables (Y2K and legacy systems, respectively).




第三，2000 年 (Y2K) 转换问题在 20 世纪 90 年代中期引起了管理者的注意。为了节省计算机内存和存储空间，从而降低计算的高昂成本，20 世纪 50 年代和 1960 年代的程序员使用两位而不是四位数字来表示年份。这种做法成为了一种编程惯例，但后来人们发现，以这种方式编程的软件会将 1999 年之后的几年与一个世纪前的软件混淆。由于担心 2000 年到来时他们的遗留系统可能会崩溃，许多公司发现用符合 Y2K 的 ERP 系统完全替换他们的遗留系统更为经济（Minahan，1998）。为了调查这个问题对 ERP 概念普及度的影响，我通过在主题中搜索唯一术语“Y2K”或“Year 2000”来统计有关“Y2K”的文章，如果没有主题，则在文章的标题和摘要中搜索。随着千年问题的出现，维护低效且有缺陷的遗留系统的困难也暴露出来。无论Y2K 问题是否是主要问题，ERP 都被提出并采用来取代遗留系统。因此，我通过在主题、标题或摘要（当主题不可用时）中搜索唯一术语“遗留系统”来统计有关遗留系统的文章。以类似的方式，我构建了第三个和第四个自变量（分别是千年虫和遗留系统）。


Hypothesis 2 is about the relationship between an innovation concept and a related new concept. Among the several dimensions that define ERP’s relation with other concepts, the problems ERP addresses have continuously evolved. ERP systems grew out of the older manufacturing-planning software – MRP II. ERP markedly expanded functionalities from those of MRP II. ERP software offerings also have been extended to include new functionalities such as business intelligence (BI), data warehousing, and advanced planning and scheduling (APS). Consequently, it is difficult to draw a boundary and give a label to a clearly delineated domain or niche, where ERP and other concepts are related. To overcome this difficulty, first, I counted articles on MRP II, the precursor of ERP. Second, I counted articles on another innovation – business process reengineering (BPR), which has been argued to be closely related to ERP.<sup>11</sup> Third, I counted articles on two relatively newer innovations – CRM and SCM (supply chain management), because ERP, CRM, and SCM have been increasingly considered as related applications of an organization’s “Enterprise Systems” (Hendricks et al., 2007). Last, I counted articles on innovations such as EDI, decision support systems (DSS), and TQM, which may or may not be related to ERP. Strictly speaking, TQM and BPR are management innovations. However, as both involve the use of IT, attention to TQM and BPR may have flowed to IT concepts such as ERP. As illustrations, these seven innovations fall in a good range of relatedness to ERP.




假设2是关于创新概念和相关新概念之间的关系。在定义 ERP 与其他概念关系的多个维度中，ERP 解决的问题在不断发展。 ERP 系统源自较旧的制造规划软件——MRP II。 ERP 显着扩展了 MRP II 的功能。 ERP 软件产品也已扩展到包括商业智能 (BI)、数据仓库以及高级规划和调度 (APS) 等新功能。因此，很难划定界限并为 ERP 和其他概念相关的明确界定的领域或利基贴上标签。为了克服这个困难，我首先统计了ERP的前身MRP II的文章。其次，我统计了有关另一项创新的文章——业务流程重组 (BPR)，它被认为与 ERP 密切相关。<sup>11</sup>第三，我统计了有关两项相对较新的创新的文章——CRM 和 SCM（供应链管理），因为 ERP、CRM 和 SCM 越来越多地被视为组织“企业系统”的相关应用程序（Hendricks 等，2007）。最后，我统计了有关 EDI、决策支持系统 (DSS) 和 TQM 等创新的文章，这些创新可能与 ERP 相关，也可能无关。严格来说，TQM和BPR都是管理创新。然而，由于两者都涉及 IT 的使用，因此对 TQM 和 BPR 的关注可能会转向 ERP 等 IT 概念。举例来说，这七项创新与 ERP 有着很好的相关性。


Except for the topics of information fragmentation and operational inefficiency, which never had unique subjects in ABI, I used the same search strategy to count articles on all other nine topics (i.e., the dependent variable and eight independent variables). That is, when a unique subject was provided by ABI, I searched under that subject heading; when the subject was not available, I searched in article titles and abstracts and then eliminated irrelevant articles based on the two raters consensus. The content validity of this strategy and the factors measured this way can be assured in three parts. First, ABI’s assignment of articles to subjects is “accomplished and checked by trained and experienced content analysts, working in industry- and function-specific teams” (Abrahamson and Fairchild, 1999, p. 717). Second, the number of articles that had appeared in ABI before a unique subject was created typically was not very large and, thus, selecting relevant articles from the title/abstract search results was so straightforward that the inter-rater reliability scores ranged from 93 percent to 100 percent. Third, for each of the nine topics, I randomly selected three quarters when the unique subject heading was available in ABI. I downloaded the abstracts of all articles whose titles and abstracts contained the topic. Then the two raters read the abstracts and independently selected articles where the topic was a subject. For all 27 quarters (9 topics X 3 quarters/topic), the inter-rater reliability was 85 percent. Then I counted the articles selected by both raters. Across the 27 quarters, the correlation between the counts based on the title/abstract analysis and counts based on subject searches was .87. Therefore, these efforts provided reasonable confidence that the volume measures in quarters without a unique subject were consistent with volume measures in quarters with the subject.




除了信息碎片化和操作效率低下这些主题在 ABI 中从来没有独特的主题之外，我使用相同的搜索策略来统计所有其他九个主题（即因变量和八个自变量）的文章。也就是说，当 ABI 提供一个独特的主题时，我在该主题标题下进行搜索；当主题不可用时，我搜索文章标题和摘要，然后根据两位评分者的共识删除不相关的文章。该策略的内容有效性以及以此方式衡量的因素可以通过三个部分来保证。首先，ABI 的文章主题分配是“由训练有素、经验丰富的内容分析师在特定行业和职能团队中完成和检查的”（Abrahamson 和 Fairchild，1999 年，第 717 页）。其次，在创建独特主题之前，ABI 中出现的文章数量通常不是很大，因此，从标题/摘要搜索结果中选择相关文章非常简单，评分者间的可靠性得分在 93% 到 100% 之间。第三，对于九个主题中的每一个，当 ABI 中提供唯一主题标题时，我随机选择了四分之三。我下载了标题和摘要包含该主题的所有文章的摘要。然后两位评估者阅读摘要并独立选择主题为主题的文章。对于所有 27 个季度（9 个主题 X 3 个季度/主题），评估者间的可靠性为 85%。然后我统计了两位评分者选择的文章。在 27 个季度中，基于标题/摘要分析的计数与基于主题搜索的计数之间的相关性为 0.87。因此，这些努力提供了合理的信心，即没有唯一主题的季度的交易量测量与有该主题的季度的交易量测量一致。


## 3.3. Data Analysis




## 3.3。数据分析


Table 2 summarizes the operational definitions of all variables. The dependent variable is ERP article count $y _ { j q }$ for each periodical j in each quarter q in the study period (Q4 1991-Q4 2002). The rate at which each periodical publishes articles on ERP is hypothesized to be influenced by two factors: the volumes of problem discourse and discourses on other concepts. The notation $x _ { k j q }$ represents the kth independent variable for periodical j in quarter q.




表 2 总结了所有变量的操作定义。因变量是研究期间（1991 年第 4 季度至 2002 年第 4 季度）每个季度 q 中每个期刊 j 的 ERP 文章计数 $y _ { j q }$。假设每份期刊发表 ERP 文章的速度受到两个因素的影响：问题讨论的数量和其他概念的讨论量。符号 $x _ { k j q }$ 表示季度 q 中期刊 j 的第 k 个自变量。


As previously mentioned, the ERP concept’s popularity may have also come from the adoption of the material innovation. To control for adoption-induced popularity, I included the annual worldwide ERP software revenue as a control variable (in log form to reduce non-linearity). To partial out the effect of periodical-specific factors on the outcome, I included four more control variables: each periodical’s age, authorship and readership (academic/non-academic), frequency, and headquarters’ location (U.S.-/non-U.S.-based). To exclude the potential influence of time, a linear time trend (updated each quarter) was also included as a control variable. These control variables are denoted similarly as $x _ { k j q }$ for the kth variable for periodical j in quarter q.




如前所述，ERP概念的流行可能也来自于材料创新的采用。为了控制采用引起的流行度，我将全球 ERP 软件年度收入作为控制变量（以对数形式减少非线性）。为了消除期刊特定因素对结果的影响，我又加入了四个控制变量：每个期刊的年龄、作者和读者（学术/非学术）、频率和总部地点（美国/非美国）。为了排除时间的潜在影响，还包括线性时间趋势（每季度更新）作为控制变量。这些控制变量类似地表示为 $x _ { k j q }$，表示季度 q 中期刊 j 的第 k 个变量。


To infer causality, the dependent variable lagged one quarter behind all independent and control variables because every periodical in ABI publishes at least one issue per quarter, and it is reasonable and conservative to assume that topical decisions are made and updated at least once a quarter. Since the dependent variable is article count, I used count data regression (i.e., negative binomial regression).<sup>12</sup> In sum, the expected number of articles on ERP published by each periodical in each quarter can be modeled as a function of two factors and control variables:




为了推断因果关系，因变量落后于所有自变量和控制变量四分之一，因为 ABI 中的每份期刊每季度至少出版一期，并且假设主题决策至少每季度做出和更新一次是合理且保守的。由于因变量是文章数，所以我使用了计数数据回归（即负二项式回归）。<sup>12</sup>总之，每个期刊每个季度发表的 ERP 文章的预期数量可以建模为两个因素和控制变量的函数：


$\mu _ { j q } = \exp { [ \beta _ { O } + \beta _ { I } X _ { \mathit { I } j ( q - 1 ) } + \beta _ { 2 } X _ { \mathit { 2 } j ( q - 1 ) } + . . . + \beta _ { m } X _ { m j ( q - 1 ) } ] }$ where $\mu _ { j q }$ is the expected value of $y _ { j q } ~ ( \mathsf { i . e . , } \mu _ { j q } = \mathsf E [ y _ { j q } ] \ x _ { \mathit { 1 j } ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } , \ x _ { \mathit { 2 j } ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } , \ \ldots , \ x _ { m j ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } ] )$ and $\beta ^ { \prime } { \sf s }$ are parameters to be estimated.




$\mu _ { j q } = \exp { [ \beta _ { O } + \beta _ { I } X _ { \mathit { I } j ( q - 1 ) } + \beta _ { 2 } X _ { \mathit { 2 } j ( q - 1 ) } + 。 。 。 + \beta _ { m } X _ { m j ( q - 1 ) } ] }$ 其中 $\mu _ { j q }$ 是 $y _ { j q } $ 的期望值 ~ ( \mathsf { i . e . , } \mu _ { j q } = \mathsf E [ y _ { j q } ] \ x _ { \mathit { 1 j } ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } 、 \ x _ { \mathit { 2 j } ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } 、 \ \ldots 、 \ x _ { m j ( q - \mathit { 1 } ) } ] )$ 和 $\beta ^ { \prime } { \sf s }$ 为待估计参数。

## 4. Results




## 4. 结果


Between October 1991 and December 2002, 201 periodicals published 2,270 articles on ERP in ABI. Table 2 shows the descriptive statistics of the 17 variables. ERP article count (Variable 1) is the dependent variable. On average, each periodical published 0.81 article on ERP in each quarter with large variations. Among the control variables (Variables 2-6), Academic (Variable 3) and US (Variable 5) are dummies. On average, these periodicals were in business for about 46 years, mostly USbased, non-academically oriented, and published approximately 18 times a year. Variables 7 through 17 are independent variables representing the two factors: problem discourses (Variables 7-10) and discourses on other IT concepts (Variables 11-17). TQM evoked the largest volume, while the information fragmentation problem discourse was the smallest. Table 3 shows that most correlations between independent variables and the dependent variable are small but statistically significant. The correlations between several pairs of independent variables are quite high, especially those between information fragmentation (Variable 7) and operational inefficiency (Variable 8) and between Y2K (Variable 9) and legacy systems (Variable 10). So I calculated variance inflation factors (VIF) to check on multicollinearity.<sup>13</sup> The VIFs for four variables exceeded 5, a threshold for multicollinearity concern (Menard, 1995): information fragmentation (5.43), operational inefficiency (5.33), Y2K (6.32), and legacy systems (5.48). Although these VIFs are still well below 10, another frequently cited threshold (Hair et al., 1995), I chose to include only one variable from each highly correlated pair in the subsequent regression analysis. As shown in the regression results below, one half of the regression models included information fragmentation and Y2K; the other half included operational inefficiency and legacy systems. After dropping highly correlated variables, the VIFs for all explanatory (control and independent) variables in every regression model were below 3, well below the recommended threshold for multicollinearity concern.




1991年10月至2002年12月期间，ABI有201家期刊发表了2,270篇有关ERP的文章。表2显示了17个变量的描述性统计。 ERP 文章数（变量 1）是因变量。平均每个期刊每季度发表 ERP 文章 0.81 篇，差异较大。在控制变量（变量2-6）中，Academic（变量3）和US（变量5）是虚拟变量。平均而言，这些期刊的经营时间约为 46 年，大多在美国，非学术导向，每年出版约 18 期。变量7到17是代表两个因素的自变量：问题论述（变量7-10）和关于其他IT概念的论述（变量11-17）。全面质量管理引发的讨论量最大，而信息碎片化问题的讨论量最小。表 3 显示自变量和因变量之间的大多数相关性很小，但具有统计显着性。几对自变量之间的相关性相当高，特别是信息碎片化（变量 7）与运营效率低下（变量 8）以及 Y2K（变量 9）与遗留系统（变量 10）之间的相关性。因此，我计算了方差膨胀因子 (VIF) 来检查多重共线性。<sup>13</sup>四个变量的 VIF 超过了 5，这是多重共线性问题的阈值（Menard，1995）：信息碎片 (5.43)、运营效率低下 (5.33)、Y2K (6.32) 和遗留系统 (5.48)。尽管这些 VIF 仍然远低于 10（另一个经常引用的阈值）（Hair 等，1995），但我选择在后续回归分析中仅包含每个高度相关对中的一个变量。如下回归结果所示，一半的回归模型包含信息碎片化和Y2K；另一半包括运营效率低下和遗留系统。删除高度相关的变量后，每个回归模型中所有解释变量（控制变量和独立变量）的 VIF 均低于 3，远低于多重共线性问题的建议阈值。

Figure 4. Article Counts of Other Innovation Concepts and ERP




![](/api/attachments/QSHBPTKS/fulltext/images/04ee31cdb3c3dcf98bc3e938d6110bb06c7244e051b64f42c2f97dd3ae96a828.jpg)  
图 4. 其他创新概念和 ERP 的文章计数


Figures 3 and 4 portray the relationships between the ERP discourse and the two hypothesized factors. Because ABI itself has grown dramatically over the last three decades, all article counts in the figures were adjusted to factor out the variation in the total number of articles indexed by ABI. 14 As Figure 3 shows, the ERP discourse underwent a relatively gentle upswing until circa 1997-98 when it took a sudden leap until its decline starting in 2000. The rise of Y2K was remarkable and abrupt, which is highly correlated with the legacy systems discourse. In contrast, the discourses for information fragmentation and operational inefficiency were very small throughout. Figure 4 shows that relatively older innovation concepts (MRP II, BRP, EDI, TQM, and DSS), despite the varying degrees in their relations with ERP, reached their apogees and then began to decline when the ERP discourse was increasing. The aggregate discourse patterns shown in the figures do not show the specific context in which ERP’s popularity rose and fell in each periodical as a result of multiple factors (the two hypothesized factors, control variables, and unknown factors as well). Regression analysis of observations made at each periodical would reveal more precise insights into the microdynamics of publishing ERP articles than matching the overall discourse patterns Figure 4 displays.




图 3 和图 4 描绘了 ERP 论述与两个假设因素之间的关系。由于 ABI 本身在过去三十年中急剧增长，因此对图中的所有文章计数进行了调整，以消除 ABI 索引的文章总数的变化。 14 如图 3 所示，ERP 话语经历了相对温和的上升，直到 1997-98 年左右，突然飞跃，直到 2000 年开始衰退。Y2K 的崛起是显着而突然的，这与遗留系统话语高度相关。相比之下，关于信息碎片化和运营效率低下的讨论自始至终都很少。图 4 显示，相对较旧的创新概念（MRP II、BRP、EDI、TQM 和 DSS）尽管与 ERP 的关系程度不同，但都达到了顶峰，然后随着 ERP 话语的增加而开始衰落。图中显示的聚合话语模式并没有显示ERP在每个期刊中的受欢迎程度由于多种因素（两个假设因素、控制变量和未知因素）而上升和下降的具体背景。对每个期刊的观察结果进行回归分析，比匹配图 4 显示的整体话语模式，可以更准确地洞察出版 ERP 文章的微观动态。


Table 4 shows the results of a series of negative binomial regression analyses. All data (1991-2002) were entered into Models 1 and 2. Due to the multicollinearity concern discussed above, Model 1 included information fragmentation and Y2K; Model 2 included operational inefficiency and legacy systems. The significant coefficient for the control variable “quarter” suggests the substantial effect of time. Thus, I divided the data into two periods: 1991-99 and 2000-02. The former was the ascendant phase of the ERP concept when its discourse was increasing; the latter was the descendant phase when ERP discourse was declining. Models 3 and 4 were estimated with the 1991-99 data. Again, each model included only one of each highly correlated pair of variables for business problems. Models 5 and 6 were estimated with the 2000-02 data.




表 4 显示了一系列负二项式回归分析的结果。所有数据（1991-2002）均输入模型1和模型2。由于上述讨论的多重共线性问题，模型1包括信息碎片化和Y2K；模型 2 包括运营效率低下和遗留系统。控制变量“季度”的显着系数表明时间的显着影响。因此，我将数据分为两个时期：1991-99年和2000-02年。前者是ERP概念的方兴未艾阶段，其话语日益增多；后者是ERP话语衰落的下降阶段。模型3和4是用1991-99年的数据估计的。同样，每个模型仅包含业务问题的每对高度相关的变量中的一个。模型5和6是用2000-02年的数据估计的。

The results from the Wald chi-squired tests (similar to the F-test in OLS regression) indicate that all models are significant (i.e., at least one of the regression coefficients in each model is not equal to zero). The significant effect of the ERP market size (as a proxy measure for adoption) suggests that more adoptions were associated with more popularity. Nonetheless, a check on the standard coefficients for the Market variable in Models 3 and 4 revealed that its effect was not dominant and there were other factors whose effects were relatively stronger (e.g., the effect of Y2K, which I will discuss momentarily). This significant but not dominant effect implies that popularity is not entirely induced from adoptions. Therefore, the reciprocal relationship between adoption and popularity depicted in Figure 1 is not a tautological loop and, thus, it is theoretically interesting to study other factors that shape popularity.




Wald 卡方检验（类似于 OLS 回归中的 F 检验）的结果表明所有模型均显着（即每个模型中至少有一个回归系数不等于 0）。 ERP 市场规模（作为采用率的代理指标）的显着影响表明，采用率越高，受欢迎程度越高。尽管如此，对模型3和模型4中市场变量的标准系数进行检查后发现，其影响并不占主导地位，还有其他因素的影响相对较强（例如，千年虫的影响，我将立即讨论）。这种显着但非主导性的影响意味着流行并不完全是由采用引起的。因此，图 1 中描绘的采用率和流行度之间的相互关系并不是同义反复循环，因此，从理论上来说，研究影响流行度的其他因素是很有趣的。


Models 1 and 2 show mixed results from testing Hypothesis 1, which essentially proposes that the prevalence of the problem linked to an IT innovation concept drives the number of articles each outlet publishes about the innovation. Both the information fragmentation and Y2K problems were linked to ERP. However, in Model 1, only the prevalence of the Y2K problem in discourse is significantly associated with the volume of the ERP discourse as hypothesized, whereas there is no evidence fo any significant effect of the information fragmentation problem. Similarly, the operational inefficiency discourse does not show significant effects, but the discourse on legacy systems does. The mixed findings persist in Models 3 and 4 with the 1991-99 data. Hypothesis 2 proposes that closely related concepts rely on the same type of attention and, thus, the prevalence of a related concept should be negatively associated with the number of articles each outlet publishes about the focal concept. Consistent with this hypothesis, Model 1 shows that the four concepts (MRP II, BPR, CRM, and SCM) related to ERP were negatively associated with the volume of the ERP discourse. Distantly related concepts such as EDI and largely unrelated concepts such as DSS and TQM did not show significant influence despite that their downswing phases coincided with ERP’s upswing as shown in Figure 3. Similar results were found in Models 2-4. For both hypotheses, however, Models 5 and 6 with the 2000-02 data showed that neither the problem discourse nor related older concepts had any significant influence on ERP’s popularity during the descendant phase. However, the discourse on newer concepts (CRM and SCM) remained significantly negatively associated with ERP.




模型 1 和模型 2 显示了检验假设 1 的混合结果，假设 1 实质上提出，与 IT 创新概念相关的问题的普遍性推动了每个媒体发布的有关创新的文章数量。信息碎片化和Y2K问题都与ERP有关。然而，在模型1中，只有Y2K问题在话语中的普遍性与假设的ERP话语量显着相关，而没有证据表明信息碎片问题有任何显着影响。同样，关于运营效率低下的讨论没有显示出显着的影响，但关于遗留系统的讨论却显示出显着的影响。采用 1991-99 年数据的模型 3 和模型 4 中仍然存在混合的结果。假设 2 提出，密切相关的概念依赖于相同类型的注意力，因此，相关概念的流行程度应与每个媒体发布的有关焦点概念的文章数量呈负相关。与这一假设一致，模型 1 显示与 ERP 相关的四个概念（MRP II、BPR、CRM 和 SCM）与 ERP 话语量呈负相关。相关性较远的概念（例如 EDI）和很大程度上不相关的概念（例如 DSS 和 TQM）并未表现出显着影响，尽管它们的下降阶段与 ERP 的上升阶段一致，如图 3 所示。在模型 2-4 中也发现了类似的结果。然而，对于这两种假设，模型 5 和模型 6 以及 2000-02 年的数据表明，问题论述和相关的旧概念都没有对 ERP 在后代阶段的普及产生任何重大影响。然而，关于新概念（CRM 和 SCM）的讨论仍然与 ERP 显着负相关。


## 5. Discussion




## 5.讨论


Robust evidence was found that the discourses on Y2K and legacy systems and the four related innovation concepts (MRP II, BPR, CRM, and SCM) had significant associations with the volume of ERP discourse between 1991 and 1999.




强有力的证据表明，关于 Y2K 和遗留系统的讨论以及四个相关的创新概念（MRP II、BPR、CRM 和 SCM）与 1991 年至 1999 年间的 ERP 讨论量具有显着关联。


## 5.1. Business Problems




## 5.1.业务问题


The non-significant effect of the information fragmentation problem on the ERP discourse casts doubt on whether this problem that ERP was originally claimed to solve was a driver for the popularity of ERP. In fact, large organizations and their people have been frustrated by data management and information accessibility problems for decades. Various IT solutions have been introduced and implemented, but these problems (or their recent variants) have not been solved completely and therefore it is not uncommon for vendors and consultants to tout a new IT as an improved solution to information fragmentation. However, as indicated by the almost invisible curve in Figure 3, since the late 1980s discourse has failed to attract much attention to the information fragmentation problem, which could not help much with ERP’s popularity. Likewise, the operational inefficiency problem did not generate much discourse or impact on the popularity of ERP either. In the early 1990s, the pertinent business problem addressed by ERP systems was not clear. Like other emergent concepts, ERP was “a solution in search of a problem.”




信息碎片化问题对 ERP 话语影响并不显着，令人怀疑 ERP 最初声称要解决的这个问题是否是 ERP 普及的推动力。事实上，几十年来，大型组织及其员工一直因数据管理和信息可访问性问题而感到沮丧。各种 IT 解决方案已经被引入和实施，但这些问题（或其最近的变体）尚未完全解决，因此供应商和顾问将新 IT 吹捧为信息碎片化的改进解决方案并不罕见。然而，如图3中几乎看不见的曲线所示，自20世纪80年代后期以来，人们对信息碎片化问题的讨论并没有引起太多关注，这对ERP的普及没有多大帮助。同样，运营效率低下的问题也没有对 ERP 的普及产生太大的讨论或影响。 20 世纪 90 年代初，ERP 系统解决的相关业务问题尚不清楚。与其他新兴概念一样，ERP 是“寻找问题的解决方案”。


Similarly, the Y2K problem had been negligible in the technical and management discourse since a 1984 Computerworld article reported William Schoen’s first discovery of the problem and called managers to pay attention to it (Gillin, 1984). However, managers ignored this call, along with multiple pleas from the programming community to address the problem, until only a few years before the turn of the century. By the mid-1990s, as the apparent deadline was approaching, an increasing number of articles began to report that the potential danger of the Y2K problem and the effort needed to solve it had been underestimated. The nature and scale of the problem soon transcended the technological realm to the broad economic, political, and social arenas. Armageddon scenarios in which the millennium bug wipes out the entire global civilization frequently appeared in the public discourse in the mid-to-late 1990s. Nevertheless, the heated discussion of Y2K attracted considerable attention from many fields of society and instigated widespread fear of the malfunctioning of power, water supply, telecommunication, transportation, and defense systems, etc. In this way, Y2K transformed from a date-field conversion issue to a multi-field social problem. Hence, ways to address it naturally corresponded to the “spirit of the times” and gained immediate popularity. Just as they had considered hoarding bottled water and other emergency supplies in their own households before year 2000 arrived, managers were receptive to “silver bullets” that would come along to fix Y2K in their organizations. Fixing Y2K was an extremely labor-intensive process by which millions of lines of software code in an organization’s legacy systems had to be updated. After years of downsizing and outsourcing their IT departments, many companies no longer had the capability to undertake the conversion by themselves. They avoided the task by adopting Y2Kcompliant ERP systems to replace their legacy systems. Y2K acutely symbolized a host of problems with organizations’ legacy systems: high cost of maintenance, inefficiency, lack of knowledgeable workforce, etc. In this sense, ERP should not be viewed as overkill to the Y2K bug or problems with organizations’ legacy systems more generally. Rather, Y2K and legacy systems, as widespread business problems, served as catalysts for ERP’s own popularity.




同样，自 1984 年《计算机世界》的一篇文章报道 William Schoen 首次发现该问题并呼吁管理者注意以来，Y2K 问题在技术和管理讨论中一直被忽视（Gillin，1984）。然而，直到世纪之交前几年，管理者们都忽视了这一呼吁以及编程社区解决该问题的多次请求。到了20世纪90年代中期，随着表面上的最后期限的临近，越来越多的文章开始报道Y2K问题的潜在危险以及解决它所需的努力被低估了。这个问题的性质和规模很快超越了技术领域，扩展到了广泛的经济、政治和社会领域。 20世纪90年代中后期，“千年虫”毁灭整个全球文明的世界末日场景频繁出现在公众话语中。然而，“千年虫”问题的热议引起了社会多领域的高度关注，并引发了人们对电力、供水、电信、交通、国防系统等故障的普遍恐惧。由此，“千年虫”问题从一个日期字段转换问题转变为一个多领域的社会问题。于是，应对之道自然而然地符合了“时代精神”，并立即受到欢迎。正如他们在 2000 年到来之前考虑在自己家里囤积瓶装水和其他应急物资一样，经理们也乐于接受解决组织中千年虫问题的“灵丹妙药”。修复千年虫问题是一个极其耗费人力的过程，必须更新组织遗留系统中的数百万行软件代码。经过多年的IT部门精简和外包，许多公司不再有能力自行承担转型。他们通过采用符合 Y2K 标准的 ERP 系统来替换旧系统，从而避免了这一任务。 Y2K 尖锐地象征着组织遗留系统的一系列问题：维护成本高、效率低下、缺乏知识丰富的劳动力等。从这个意义上说，ERP 不应该被视为对 Y2K 错误或更普遍的组织遗留系统问题的杀伤力。相反，Y2K 和遗留系统作为普遍存在的业务问题，成为 ERP 自身普及的催化剂。


## 5.2. Related Innovation Concepts




## 5.2.相关创新概念


The inherent relationships between ERP and other innovation concepts may explain their differentiated associations in discourse. First, MRP II systems streamline information flows in core manufacturing processes, whereas ERP systems integrate information flows not only in manufacturing, but also in other processes and functions. Thus the ERP concept had to draw attention originally allocated to MRP II, as well as attention from people in other functions. In this sense, ERP is a much larger “species” that consumed more attention than MRP II did. That difference probably explains why the scale of ERP discourse far exceeded that of MRP II discourse in Figure 4.




The inherent relationships between ERP and other innovation concepts may explain their differentiated associations in discourse.首先，MRP II 系统简化了核心制造流程中的信息流，而 ERP 系统不仅集成了制造中的信息流，还集成了其他流程和功能中的信息流。因此，ERP 概念必须吸引最初分配给 MRP II 的注意力，以及其他职能人员的注意力。从这个意义上说，ERP 是一个更大的“物种”，比 MRP II 消耗更多的注意力。这种差异可能解释了为什么 ERP 讨论的规模远远超过图 4 中 MRP II 讨论的规模。


Most intriguingly, the BPR movement advocated radical redesign of business processes with the goal of dramatic performance breakthroughs. In the early 1990s, most reengineering projects discarded existing processes and came up with brand new processes only to find that there were no information systems to support the new processes (Kleiner, 2000). On the other hand, when ERP systems were introduced to large companies, managers found that they had to change their existing business processes according to the “best practices” packaged in ERP. Hence, the decline of the BPR movement in the mid-1990s might have released the right type of attention (characterized by its focus on business processes) for the rise of ERP. Furthermore, ERP gradually became a means to do BPR, as more and more firms adopted ERP systems with specific embedded processes that they aspired to obtain (Davenport, 2000). Hence, the relationship between ERP and BPR became less and less competitive over time. To see this time-dependent effect, I added an interaction term (BPR X time measured in quarters) to the regression models (Models 1-4), and the coefficient for the interaction turned out statistically significant and positive. However, due to its relatively small coefficient value, this interaction effect could not reverse the overall negative relationship between BPR and ERP, merely indicating that their relationship became less negative over time.




最有趣的是，BPR 运动提倡对业务流程进行彻底的重新设计，以实现显着的性能突破。 20世纪90年代初，大多数再造项目放弃了现有流程并提出了全新的流程，却发现没有信息系统来支持新流程（Kleiner，2000）。另一方面，当ERP系统被引入大公司时，管理者发现他们必须根据ERP中打包的“最佳实践”来改变现有的业务流程。因此，20 世纪 90 年代中期 BPR 运动的衰落可能为 ERP 的兴起释放了适当的关注（其特点是关注业务流程）。此外，随着越来越多的公司采用具有他们渴望获得的特定嵌入式流程的 ERP 系统，ERP 逐渐成为进行 BPR 的一种手段（Davenport，2000）。因此，随着时间的推移，ERP 和 BPR 之间的关系变得越来越不具有竞争力。为了查看这种时间依赖性效应，我在回归模型（模型 1-4）中添加了一个交互项（BPR X 以季度为单位测量的时间），并且交互作用的系数在统计上显着且为正值。然而，由于其系数值相对较小，这种交互作用并不能扭转 BPR 和 ERP 之间的整体负相关关系，仅表明它们的关系随着时间的推移变得不那么负相关。


In short, although it is difficult to argue that ERP, MRP II, and BPR addressed similar problems and resided in the same problem domain, it is fair to infer that ERP successfully drew relevant attention from these old concepts. On the other hand, ERP, CRM, and SCM, commonly referred to as typical applications of Enterprise Systems, inevitably consume similar types of attention, and their competition has been ever increasing. In contrast, EDI rose as a way to streamline the flow of transactional documents between businesses. While integrated systems and data within a business, promised by ERP, was a favorable condition for EDI, it was not a required condition. In fact, some firms engaged in labor-intensive manual processes to prepare the data for EDI. Accordingly, the analysis suggests that the discourses on EDI and ERP did not consume the same type of attention, as evidenced in the non-significant coefficient estimation for EDI. Similarly, the collapse of the DSS and TQM concepts did release attention, but the attention probably was not the right type for ERP.




简而言之，虽然很难说 ERP、MRP II 和 BPR 解决了类似的问题并位于同一问题领域，但可以公平地推断 ERP 成功地从这些旧概念中引起了相关关注。另一方面，ERP、CRM、SCM这些通常被称为企业系统的典型应用，也不可避免地受到类似的关注，其竞争也日益加剧。相比之下，EDI 的兴起是为了简化企业之间的交易文档流。虽然 ERP 所承诺的企业内部的集成系统和数据是 EDI 的有利条件，但这并不是必要条件。事实上，一些公司采用劳动密集型的手动流程来为 EDI 准备数据。因此，分析表明，关于 EDI 和 ERP 的讨论并未消耗相同类型的注意力，这一点在 EDI 的非显着系数估计中得到了证明。同样，DSS 和 TQM 概念的崩溃确实释放了注意力，但这种注意力可能不适合 ERP。


## 5.3. Effects Largely Vanished in 2000-2002




## 5.3. 2000-2002 年期间影响基本消失


The effects of problem discourse and related older concepts on ERP disappeared in 2000-02, but the effect of related newer concepts on ERP remained (see Models 5 and 6 in Table 4). In the 1990s, hundreds of discourse outlets advertently or inadvertently developed common sensitivities and similar appreciations for ERP in response to the overall patterns of discourses on Y2K, MRP II, and BPR. By 2000, ERP had already been very popular and was no longer a novel concept to most members of the community. On the one hand, the ERP concept had already been legitimated and, thus, its popularity no longer needed to be constantly justified by links to widespread problems. On the other hand, attention to ERP was so substantial that competition with related older concepts became a nonissue. Taking both points into consideration, I suspect that the common sensitivities and similar appreciations for ERP might have fragmented in the new millennium. As ERP implementation projects were underway and various organizational constituents were occupied by implementation processes and outcomes in many organizations, the once intensive or even passionate sensemaking of ERP declined. Therefore, whether and how to continue covering ERP became largely dependent on the specific preference of each discourse outlet. At issue in this period, however, was the increasing competition between ERP and newer innovations such CRM and SCM.




问题话语和相关旧概念对 ERP 的影响在 2000-02 年消失，但相关新概念对 ERP 的影响仍然存在（见表 4 中的模型 5 和 6）。 20世纪90年代，数以百计的话语渠道有意无意地对ERP产生了共同的敏感性和类似的评价，以应对Y2K、MRP II和BPR的总体话语模式。到2000年，ERP已经非常流行，对于大多数社区成员来说不再是一个新概念。一方面，ERP 概念已经合法化，因此，它的流行不再需要不断地通过与普遍问题的联系来证明其合理性。另一方面，人们对 ERP 的关注如此之大，以至于与相关旧概念的竞争不再是问题。考虑到这两点，我怀疑对 ERP 的共同敏感性和类似的欣赏可能在新千年已经支离破碎。随着 ERP 实施项目的进行，许多组织中的各个组织成员都被实施过程和结果所占据，曾经密集甚至热情的 ERP 意义建构下降了。因此，是否以及如何继续覆盖ERP很大程度上取决于各个话语出口的具体偏好。然而，这一时期的问题是 ERP 与 CRM 和 SCM 等更新的创新之间的竞争日益激烈。


## 6. Conclusion




## 6. 结论


The recent wave of mergers and acquisitions among enterprise software providers signifies a consolidating marketplace for material IT innovations. However, the marketplace for innovation concepts remains messy and inefficient (Pfeffer and Sutton, 2006). Anyone with an idea can enter and exit the marketplace with minimal cost. At any time, numerous IT innovation concepts are competing for the already scarce attention of practitioners. What these concepts propose and promote is often inconsistent and ambiguous. Their influence on the design, production, and use of IT in organizations is often different, and it is difficult to predict the impact of any particular concept. Thus far, IT innovation research has little to offer when it comes to the causes and production of IT innovation concepts and their consequences on the adoption and diffusion of IT innovations.




最近企业软件提供商之间的并购浪潮标志着重大 IT 创新市场的整合。然而，创新概念的市场仍然混乱且低效（Pfeffer 和 Sutton，2006）。任何有想法的人都可以以最低的成本进入和退出市场。任何时候，无数的IT创新理念都在争夺本已稀缺的从业者的关注。这些概念提出和提倡的内容往往是不一致且含糊的。它们对组织中 IT 的设计、生产和使用的影响往往是不同的，并且很难预测任何特定概念的影响。迄今为止，IT 创新研究在 IT 创新概念的成因和产生及其对 IT 创新的采用和传播的影响方面几乎没有提供任何帮助。


This paper has centered on the IT innovation concept, as opposed to the conventional focus on material innovation. Taking the perspective that an IT innovation concept evolves beyond the boundaries of organizations in a community, I have argued that the increased prevalence of an IT innovation concept in discourse, or its popularity, may lead to an increased likelihood of innovation adoption. Realizing that popularity is an often-talked-about but poorly understood concept itself, I have focused my empirical investigation on one question: What makes a concept popular? The empirical case study of ERP has three findings. First, when an IT innovation is framed as the solution to certain business problems, the prevalence of the problems that discourse highlights and brings to managers’ collective attention is positively associated with the popularity of the innovation; whereas the prevalence of the problems that discourse fails to highlight has no effect on the popularity of the innovation. Second, the popularity of concepts related to the focal innovation concept is negatively associated with the popularity of the new concept, because they rely on the same type of attention; whereas the popularity of concepts unrelated to a new concept has no effect on its popularity. Third, the effects of highlighted problem discourses and older related concepts on the popularity of a foca concept disappear after the concept passes its peak popularity, but the influence of newer related concepts remains.




本文的重点是信息技术创新概念，而不是传统的材料创新。从 IT 创新概念的发展超越社区中组织边界的角度来看，我认为 IT 创新概念在话语中的日益普及或流行可能会导致创新采用的可能性增加。意识到流行度本身是一个经常被谈论但人们了解甚少的概念，我将实证研究集中在一个问题上：是什么让一个概念流行？ ERP 的实证案例研究有三个发现。首先，当一项IT创新被视为某些业务问题的解决方案时，话语所强调并引起管理者集体关注的问题的普遍性与创新的受欢迎程度呈正相关；然而，话语未能强调的问题的普遍存在并不影响创新的受欢迎程度。其次，与焦点创新概念相关的概念的流行度与新概念的流行度呈负相关，因为它们依赖于相同类型的注意力；而与新概念无关的概念的流行度对其流行度没有影响。第三，当焦点概念经过其流行高峰后，突出问题话语和较旧的相关概念对焦点概念流行度的影响消失，但较新的相关概念的影响仍然存在。


Interpretation of the findings should remain tentative due to several limitations. First, ABI only includes published written discourse. Although many articles quote content from interviews and speeches, published discourse is only one type of discourse and may not be representative. Other types of discourse should also be examined using effective methods such as observation, interview, and survey in future research. Second, although the articles on the problems of information fragmentation and operational inefficiency were carefully selected following conventional qualitative analysis procedures, the selection process may still have left out some articles that discuss these two problems in ways not detected by this method. Therefore, research in the future may explore methods with higher reliability. Third, regarding the relationships between related innovations, this study only examined an ad hoc list of concepts, and their relatedness was heuristically inferred from previous literature. Future research should develop a more systematic method to select innovation concepts, formally theorize and measure their relatedness, and test the moderating effect of concept relatedness on popularity. Fourth, the empirical study has focused on only two factors (problem discourse and related innovations). Despite the significance of these factors, other drivers for popularity may also exist. For example, as alluded to earlier, future research could explore the influence of high-profile organizations producing or adopting IT innovations. Last, with respect to generalizability, although this single-case empirical study allowed me to generalize from the findings toward a theory of popularity, which, in turn, can be generalized to a richer theory of IT innovation (Lee and Baskerville, 2003), the findings themselves cannot be directly generalized to other innovation concepts. Therefore, an immediate direction for future research is toward validating the findings among other concepts, particularly associated with different levels of controversy, as highlighted by the discussion on Linux. Future research on multiple innovations should also examine the content of the discourse and assess how controversy and/or various sentiments shape the relationship between popularity and adoption.




由于存在一些局限性，对研究结果的解释应保持暂时性。首先，ABI 只包括已发表的书面言论。尽管很多文章引用了采访和演讲的内容，但发表的话语只是一种话语，不一定具有代表性。在未来的研究中，其他类型的话语也应该采用观察、访谈、调查等有效的方法进行检验。其次，尽管关于信息碎片和运营效率低下问题的文章是按照传统的定性分析程序精心挑选的，但挑选过程可能仍然遗漏了一些以这种方法无法检测到的方式讨论这两个问题的文章。因此，未来的研究可能会探索可靠性更高的方法。第三，关于相关创新之间的关系，本研究仅检查了临时的概念列表，它们的相关性是从以前的文献中启发式推断出来的。未来的研究应该开发一种更系统的方法来选择创新概念，正式理论化和衡量它们的相关性，并测试概念相关性对流行度的调节作用。第四，实证研究仅关注两个因素（问题话语和相关创新）。尽管这些因素很重要，但其他受欢迎的驱动因素也可能存在。例如，正如前面提到的，未来的研究可以探索生产或采用 IT 创新的知名组织的影响力。最后，关于概括性，虽然这个单例实证研究使我能够将研究结果推广到流行理论，进而可以推广到更丰富的 IT 创新理论（Lee 和 Baskerville，2003），但研究结果本身不能直接推广到其他创新概念。因此，未来研究的直接方向是验证其他概念中的发现，特别是与不同程度的争议相关的概念，正如 Linux 的讨论所强调的那样。未来对多种创新的研究还应该检查话语的内容，并评估争议和/或各种情绪如何影响受欢迎程度和采用之间的关系。


Notwithstanding these limitations, this study responds earnestly to Fichman’s call for IT innovation research to go beyond the dominant paradigm (Fichman, 2004). Theoretically, the paper contributes to the understanding of IT innovations along two new dimensions. The primary dimension is the innovation concept, as a complement of material innovation processes. Only by making the distinction between concept and material can one study and understand their relationship. I have argued that innovation concepts traveling across organizational boundaries constitute the reality of today’s IT world and shape the diffusion of innovations in material form. In particular, after introducing and theorizing popularity of an innovation concept as a potentially important driver of adoption, the paper has gone further to investigate some of the determinants of popularity. The empirical findings suggest that framing an innovation as the solution to a problem may not necessarily make the innovation concept popular. Rather, links to a widespread business problem that discourse highlights and brings to managers’ collective attention may popularize the innovation, even as an unintended or partial solution. This conclusion is consistent with findings from studies of popular management innovations (e.g., Abrahamson and Fairchild, 1999) and echoes Davenport, who argued that innovation concepts “that get picked up by the marketplace are the ones that resonate with the zeitgeist” (Kleiner, 2000, p. 30, original emphasis). Using Y2K and legacy systems as examples, the paper outlined a concrete way to discern and measure such resonance. Further, resonance with the zeitgeist might not guarantee imminent popularity if practitioners’ attention has been exhausted by other related innovations. For that reason, had MRP II and BPR prolonged their popularity somehow, ERP would not have reached the popularity that it did in the 1990s. To varying degrees, innovation concepts are related in idea networks that have more dimensions and are more dynamic than any predefined problem domains or niches found in previous research on popular management innovations. The structure of these idea networks and their impact on innovation practice are just beginning to be understood. While this paper has made an initial contribution to that understanding, future research should explore the fascinating structure of attention flowing through the networks of innovation concepts (Davenport and Beck, 2001).




尽管存在这些限制，这项研究还是认真响应了 Fichman 关于 IT 创新研究超越主流范式的呼吁（Fichman，2004）。从理论上讲，本文有助于从两个新维度理解 IT 创新。主要维度是创新概念，作为材料创新过程的补充。只有区分概念和物质，才能研究和理解它们之间的关系。我认为，跨越组织边界的创新概念构成了当今 IT 世界的现实，并以物质形式塑造了创新的传播。特别是，在介绍创新概念的受欢迎程度并将其理论化为采用的潜在重要驱动因素之后，本文进一步研究了受欢迎程度的一些决定因素。实证研究结果表明，将创新视为问题的解决方案不一定会使创新概念流行。相反，与话语强调并引起管理者集体关注的普遍存在的商业问题的联系可能会普及创新，即使是作为一种无意的或部分的解决方案。这一结论与流行管理创新的研究结果一致（例如，Abrahamson 和 Fairchild，1999），并与达文波特相呼应，达文波特认为“被市场接受的创新概念是与时代精神产生共鸣的概念”（Kleiner，2000，第 30 页，最初强调）。本文以千年虫和遗留系统为例，概述了识别和测量这种共振的具体方法。此外，如果从业者的注意力已经被其他相关创新耗尽，那么与时代精神的共鸣可能并不能保证立即流行。因此，如果 MRP II 和 BPR 以某种方式延长其受欢迎程度，ERP 就不会达到 20 世纪 90 年代那样的受欢迎程度。在不同程度上，创新概念与思想网络相关，这些思想网络比先前流行管理创新研究中发现的任何预定义问题领域或利基市场具有更多维度和更具活力。这些创意网络的结构及其对创新实践的影响才刚刚开始被人们所理解。虽然本文对这种理解做出了初步贡献，但未来的研究应该探索流经创新概念网络的注意力的迷人结构（Davenport 和 Beck，2001）。


The other new dimension of IT innovation research is the community, comprising diverse actors interested in developing an innovation concept. As concepts rarely stay within the confines of any particular organization, the conventional organizational analysis is inadequate to explain the IT innovation phenomenon. An innovative user, the traditional focus of adoption research, did not introduce the ERP concept. An innovative vendor, the traditional focus of new product development and marketing research, did not introduce the ERP concept. Rather, ERP was introduced by the market research firm Gartner Group. This type of organization is often bundled with other players and factors in the background or context in conventional diffusion research. In launching the ERP concept, Gartner played a leading role. Yet, ERP gained popularity through joint development by vendors, users, consultants, and others in the community. Hence, community-level analysis of IT innovations is warranted (Wang and Ramiller, 2004). This study has analyzed the community members’ on-going conversation, or discourse, about ERP. The findings suggest that such communities of interest are dynamic in terms of membership and size. For example, some members of the MRP II community may have joined the ERP community, whose members might have later departed to join the CRM community. Future research should study the dynamic constitution of innovation communities, the differentiated influences of community members, and the process by which members launch innovation concepts and sustain their popularity through discourse.




IT 创新研究的另一个新维度是社区，由对开发创新概念感兴趣的不同参与者组成。由于概念很少局限于任何特定组织的范围内，传统的组织分析不足以解释 IT 创新现象。创新用户（采用研究的传统焦点）并未引入 ERP 概念。创新型供应商，传统的新产品开发和营销研究的重点，没有引入ERP概念。相反，ERP 是由市场研究公司 Gartner Group 推出的。这种类型的组织通常与传统扩散研究的背景或背景中的其他参与者和因素捆绑在一起。在ERP概念的提出中，Gartner发挥了主导作用。然而，ERP 通过供应商、用户、顾问和社区中其他人的联合开发而受到欢迎。因此，对 IT 创新进行社区层面的分析是有必要的（Wang 和 Ramiller，2004 年）。本研究分析了社区成员关于 ERP 的持续对话或讨论。研究结果表明，此类利益共同体在成员和规模方面都是动态的。例如，MRP II 社区的一些成员可能已经加入了 ERP 社区，而其成员可能后来又加入了 CRM 社区。未来的研究应该研究创新社区的动态构成、社区成员的差异化影响力以及成员发起创新理念并通过话语维持其知名度的过程。


Taken together, the new dimensions make up a new lens to look at the IT innovation phenomenon. This new lens has relaxed rigid or even unrealistic assumptions implicit in the dominant paradigm. For example, the new perspective does not assume that the adoption of innovation is an independent individual decision based entirely on bounded rationality. Rather, each adoption is informed by a grand concept produced by a larger community. Nevertheless, the new lens does not reject insights from the dominant paradigm. As Figure 5 shows, complementary views from both lenses constitute a binocular view, bringing us much closer to the reality of IT innovations.




总而言之，新的维度构成了审视 IT 创新现象的新镜头。这种新的视角放松了主流范式中隐含的僵化甚至不切实际的假设。例如，新观点并不假设创新的采用是完全基于有限理性的独立个人决策。相反，每一次采用都是由更大的社区产生的宏伟概念决定的。然而，新的视角并不拒绝主流范式的见解。如图 5 所示，两个镜头的互补视图构成了双目视图，使我们更接近 IT 创新的现实。


![](/api/attachments/QSHBPTKS/fulltext/images/fa77c6fc3fdcdf388d56f06afcf5e79e1bf91873f133646faed4da3cc9b6926d.jpg)  
Figure 5. A Binocular View of Information Technology Innovations




![](/api/attachments/QSHBPTKS/fulltext/images/fa77c6fc3fdcdf388d56f06afcf5e79e1bf91873f133646faed4da3cc9b6926d.jpg)  
图 5. 信息技术创新的双目视图


Practically speaking, this study challenges both practitioners and researchers to pay attention to innovation concepts and their evolution on a larger stage. Today on that stage, ERP has lost its limelight to other popular concepts such as RFID (radio frequency identification). Before a vendor invests millions of dollars in a new product line for RFID, a company spends hundreds of thousands of dollars on adopting and implementing RFID, a consulting firm deploys an entire unit to consult on RFID, a researcher devotes a few of his/her most productive years to RFID research, and investors put billions in RFID stocks, they deserve to know why this 30-year-old technology<sup>15</sup> has become so popular today. Discourse analysis demonstrated here affords a useful tool for monitoring innovation concepts’ popularity and for explaining that popularity. As Arrow 4 in Figure 5 suggests, discourses on the business problems and related concepts shape the focal concept’s popularity. Those interested in RFID should be on the lookout for RFID’s link to widespread problems “in the spirit” of our time and arguments regarding RFID’s relationship with older innovations in the discourse. Based on their own evaluations of these claims and arguments, practitioners and researchers can then make informed decisions rather than jump on the RFID bandwagon mindlessly. Further, factors identified in this study such as problem discourse and related concepts can be used to forecast innovation concepts’ popularity. In this sense, the paper joins the broader effort to predict which innovation concepts will become highly popular. Notwithstanding the practical significance of the effort to predict, Alan Kay reminds us that “The best way to predict the future is to invent it”. Understanding the determinants of popularity will arm ambitious actors with the essential knowledge about how to make potentially useful innovation concepts popular. These knowledge entrepreneurs are shaping the concepts that will in turn shape the future landscape of IT.




实际上，这项研究挑战从业者和研究人员在更大的舞台上关注创新概念及其演变。如今，在这个舞台上，ERP已经失去了人们的关注，而让位于RFID（射频识别）等其他流行概念。在供应商投资数百万美元购买 RFID 新产品线、公司花费数十万美元采用和实施 RFID、咨询公司部署整个部门来提供 RFID 咨询、研究人员将其最富有成效的几年投入 RFID 研究以及投资者投入数十亿美元购买 RFID 股票之前，他们应该知道为什么这项已有 30 年历史的技术<sup>15</sup>在今天变得如此受欢迎。这里演示的话语分析提供了一个有用的工具，用于监控创新概念的受欢迎程度并解释这种受欢迎程度。如图 5 中的箭头 4 所示，对业务问题和相关概念的讨论决定了焦点概念的受欢迎程度。那些对 RFID 感兴趣的人应该关注 RFID 与我们这个时代“精神”中普遍存在的问题的联系，以及关于 RFID 与旧的创新之间关系的争论。根据他们自己对这些主张和论点的评估，从业者和研究人员可以做出明智的决定，而不是盲目地追随 RFID 潮流。此外，本研究中确定的因素（例如问题话语和相关概念）可用于预测创新概念的受欢迎程度。从这个意义上说，本文加入了更广泛的努力来预测哪些创新概念将变得非常流行。尽管预测的努力具有实际意义，但艾伦·凯提醒我们，“预测未来的最好方法就是发明它”。了解流行的决定因素将为雄心勃勃的参与者提供有关如何使潜在有用的创新概念流行的基本知识。这些知识企业家正在塑造概念，而这些概念又将塑造 IT 的未来格局。

## About the Author




## 关于作者


Ping Wang is an Assistant Professor at the College of Information Studies, the University of Maryland, College Park. His research addresses how and why organizations innovate with new information technologies. Specifically, his research seeks to understand the popularity of IT innovations and the effects of popular IT on organizations. At Maryland, he leads a multi-year research project, sponsored by the National Science Foundation, to apply computational linguistics to IT innovation research. Dr. Wang received his Ph.D. from UCLA Anderson School of Management. More information is at http://terpconnect.umd.edu/\~pwang/Research/.




王平是马里兰大学帕克分校信息研究学院的助理教授。他的研究涉及组织如何以及为何利用新信息技术进行创新。具体来说，他的研究旨在了解 IT 创新的流行程度以及流行 IT 对组织的影响。在马里兰州，他领导了一个由国家科学基金会资助的多年研究项目，旨在将计算语言学应用于 IT 创新研究。王博士获得博士学位。来自加州大学洛杉矶分校安德森管理学院。更多信息请访问 http://terpconnect.umd.edu/\~pwang/Research/。
