## Discussion




＃＃ 讨论


The success o f co mmun ity-ba sed p ro jects has attracted significant attention in the research community [86], and Wikipedia has been investigated extensively in recent years [39, 88]. Yet many of the studies on Wikipedia success, and specifically its article quality, have been rather anecdotal [27, 79], and our understanding of the factors driving Wikipedia content quality is still limited. In the current study, we explored the relationships between groups’ cognitive diversity, the conflict that arises during the collaborative authoring process, group members’ orientation, and the quality of Wikipedia articles created by these groups.




基于社区的项目的成功引起了研究界的高度关注 [86]，维基百科近年来也得到了广泛的研究 [39, 88]。然而，许多关于维基百科成功的研究，特别是其文章质量，都是相当轶事 [27, 79]，而且我们对推动维基百科内容质量的因素的理解仍然有限。在当前的研究中，我们探讨了群体认知多样性之间的关系、协作创作过程中出现的冲突、群体成员的取向以及这些群体创建的维基百科文章的质量。


The composition of Wikipedia has been described in previous studies, demonstrating that articles’ editor groups are characterized by a composition of a few highly active members and many occasional editors that make a few contributions [39], similar to the core-periphery structure that characterizes online communities and OSS projects [19, 47, 59, 65]. However, it is not clear how the core-periphery composition affects collaborative work processes and group performance. We argue that the main limitation of research on group composition in community-based projects is the underspecification of the dimensions on which composition is analyzed. To address this gap, we investigate two dimensions of Wikipedia groups’ composition: group members’ orientation and diversity in members’ knowledge.<sup>15</sup> We contribute to the literature of members’ roles by formulating the constructs of group members’ (administrative/content) orientation and by proposing measures for this construct. Our model demonstrates three ways in which these group composition constructs, through their interaction with task conflict, impact the quality of the article produced by the group. First, the presence of administrative-oriented members enables the group to diffuse and restrain task conflict [11, 14, 79, 84]. Second, the inclusion of content-oriented members draws on their domain-specific expertise [4] and directly affects article quality. Third, the interaction between cognitive diversity and task conflict generates a creative abrasion [55] that positively affects information quality.




之前的研究已经描述了维基百科的组成，表明文章编辑群体的特点是由一些高度活跃的成员和许多做出一些贡献的临时编辑组成[39]，类似于在线社区和OSS项目的核心-外围结构[19,47,59,65]。然而，目前尚不清楚核心-外围组成如何影响协作工作流程和团队绩效。我们认为，基于社区的项目中群体构成研究的主要局限性是对构成分析维度的不明确。为了解决这一差距，我们研究了维基百科群组构成的两个维度：群组成员的取向和成员知识的多样性。<sup>15</sup>我们通过制定群组成员（管理/内容）取向的构造并为此构造提出措施，为成员角色的文献做出贡献。我们的模型展示了这些小组构成通过与任务冲突的相互作用影响小组撰写的文章质量的三种方式。首先，行政型成员的存在使团队能够化解和抑制任务冲突[11,14,79,84]。其次，以内容为导向的成员的纳入利用了他们特定领域的专业知识[4]，并直接影响文章质量。第三，认知多样性和任务冲突之间的相互作用会产生创造性磨损[55]，从而对信息质量产生积极影响。


An important contribution of the current study is in documenting the effect of cognitive diversity—in interaction with task conflict—on information quality. Prior studies show that diversity of expertise and knowledge has the potential to enhance group performance [62], especially when the task is cognitively complex and requires multiple perspectives or entails creativity [3, 32], as is the case with Wikipedia’s collaborative authoring. Moreover, in cases where groups are cognitively diverse, conflicts related to the task at hand can produce a creative abrasion that results in more innovative solutions [55, 63]. The results of our study show that task conflict moderates the effect of diversity (effect siz $: = 0 . 4 8 ; p < 0 . 0 5 )$ such that when task conflict is low, cognitive diversity is detrimental, but when conflict is high, cognitive diversity has a positive effect on information quality. Our findings support earlier results of online groups [25, 94] and illustrate the value of creative abrasion in Wikipedia’s collaborative authoring. This moderation effect is illustrated in Figure 2.




当前研究的一个重要贡献是记录了认知多样性（与任务冲突的相互作用）对信息质量的影响。先前的研究表明，专业知识和知识的多样性有可能提高团队绩效 [62]，特别是当任务认知复杂且需要多种视角或需要创造力时 [3, 32]，维基百科的协作创作就是这种情况。此外，在群体认知多样化的情况下，与手头任务相关的冲突可能会产生创造性磨损，从而产生更具创新性的解决方案 [55, 63]。我们的研究结果表明，任务冲突调节了多样性的影响（效应大小 $: = 0 . 4 8 ; p < 0 . 0 5 ）$，因此当任务冲突较低时，认知多样性是有害的，但当冲突较高时，认知多样性对信息质量有积极影响。我们的研究结果支持了在线团体 [25, 94] 的早期结果，并说明了维基百科协作创作中创造性磨损的价值。这种调节效应如图 2 所示。


Task conflict, beyond its positive moderating effect, had a direct negative effect on information quality (effect s $\mathrm { i z e } = 0 . 4 2 ; p < 0 . 0 1 )$ . This main effect, in the presence of an interaction term, is interpreted as the effect of a given exogenous predictor when the moderator it interacts with is at its mean value [12]. Our findings can inform the organizational literature on group conflict and offer a possible explanation for the reported mixed effects of task conflict [18]. Note that while conflict has been discussed extensively in previous Wikipedia studies [14, 36, 43, 54, 71], to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to demonstrate the relationships between cognitive diversity, task conflict, and article quality.




任务冲突除了其积极的调节作用之外，还对信息质量产生直接的负面影响（效应 s $\mathrm { i ze } = 0 . 4 2 ; p < 0 . 0 1 ）$ 。在存在交互作用项的情况下，该主效应被解释为当与其交互的调节因子处于其平均值时给定的外源预测因子的效应[12]。我们的研究结果可以为有关群体冲突的组织文献提供信息，并为报告的任务冲突的混合效应提供可能的解释[18]。请注意，虽然冲突在之前的维基百科研究中已被广泛讨论[14,36,43,54,71]，但据我们所知，这是第一项证明认知多样性、任务冲突和文章质量之间关系的研究。


We also contribute to the growing body of literature on Wikipedia—and more broadly to the online communities’ literature—by demonstrating how the presence of administrative-oriented members contributes to the quality of the information good the group produces. There is extensive literature describing the roles of administrators in Wikipedia [43, 46, 71] and other communities [15], and their contribution in terms of quality assurance, conflict resolution, and the development of procedures, but there is little evidence to show how these efforts impact product quality. Our study contributes to the field by demonstrating how the inclusion of administrative-oriented members helps to restrain task conflict (effect $\mathrm { s i z e } = 0 . 3 4 ; p < 0 . 0 0 1 )$ . It is interesting to note that this effect acts as a double-edged sword: on one hand, it limits the negative direct effect of task conflict on information quality, and on the other hand, it limits the potential for creative abrasion, thus restricting the potential value of cognitive diversity. This contrasts with the all-positive view of administrators in extant online communities literature [14, 15, 43, 46, 54, 71, 79].




我们还通过展示以行政为导向的成员的存在如何有助于提高团体产生的信息质量，为维基百科上不断增长的文献做出贡献，更广泛地为在线社区的文献做出贡献。有大量文献描述了维基百科 [43,46,71] 和其他社区 [15] 中管理员的角色，以及他们在质量保证、冲突解决和程序开发方面的贡献，但几乎没有证据表明这些努力如何影响产品质量。我们的研究通过展示行政导向的成员的包容性如何有助于抑制任务冲突（效果 $\mathrm { size e } = 0 . 3 4 ; p < 0 . 0 0 1 ）$ 对该领域做出了贡献。有趣的是，这种效应是一把双刃剑：一方面，它限制了任务冲突对信息质量的直接负面影响，另一方面，它限制了创造性磨损的潜力，从而限制了认知多样性的潜在价值。这与现有在线社区文献中管理员的积极观点形成鲜明对比[14,15,43,46,54,71,79]。


![](/api/attachments/8S2JUVDG/fulltext/images/a55857cf5a00bd543ffdcdfff34a03d7eac4224cc57c16933e322b372fde72a0.jpg)  
Figure 2. Task Conflict Moderates the Effect of Cognitive Diversity on Information Quality




![](/api/attachments/8S2JUVDG/fulltext/images/a55857cf5a00bd543ffdcdfff34a03d7eac4224cc57c16933e322b372fde72a0.jpg)  
图 2. 任务冲突调节认知多样性对信息质量的影响


A third contribution of the current study is in demonstrating the direct positive effect of a group’s content orientation on the quality of Wikipedia articles (effect $\mathrm { s i z e } = 0 . 2 9 ; p < 0 . 0 5 )$ ). Although this construct has not been investigated to date in the context of Wikipedia, results from the related areas of user innovation [85], OSS projects [47, 52], and online communities [1] show that occasional contributors are essential in the design process because they sometimes possess expertise that surpasses the skills of those in official roles. In Wikipedia, Anthony et al. [4] demonstrated that the anonymous contributions (likely by those who are drawn to the article’s specific topic) are of higher quality in comparison to the contributions of registered members. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first study to demonstrate this effect at the group level. Our findings regarding the direct effects of group members’ orientation are of special importance, given that most extant research on online communities, in particular production communities, assumes that greater engagement leads to more successful projects, and thus focuses on the motivational factors driving participation and engagement [69, 72, 86]. Our findings reveal that this line of research provides only a partial explanation of the factors driving the success of online communities, and that the inclusion of occasional, content-oriented contributors (who are often less engaged and active) is essential to producing quality outputs. Another distinctive aspect of the current study is that it investigates performance at the group level; research on the motivations for participation in online communities focuses on individual performance, and the factors contributing to group outputs have been underinvestigated. The current study thus helps to fill this gap and explain how members’ orientation affects group output.




当前研究的第三个贡献是证明了群体的内容取向对维基百科文章质量的直接积极影响（效果 $\mathrm { size e } = 0 . 2 9 ; p < 0 . 0 5 )$ ）。尽管迄今为止尚未在维基百科中对这一结构进行研究，但用户创新 [85]、OSS 项目 [47, 52] 和在线社区 [1] 相关领域的结果表明，临时贡献者在设计过程中至关重要，因为他们有时拥有超越官方角色技能的专业知识。在维基百科中，安东尼等人。 [4] 表明，与注册会员的贡献相比，匿名贡献（可能是那些被文章特定主题吸引的人）的质量更高。据我们所知，我们的研究是第一项在群体层面证明这种效应的研究。鉴于大多数现有的在线社区（特别是生产社区）研究都假设更大的参与度会带来更成功的项目，因此我们关于小组成员取向直接影响的研究结果特别重要，因此重点关注推动参与和参与的动机因素[69,72,86]。我们的研究结果表明，这一系列研究仅对推动在线社区成功的因素提供了部分解释，并且偶尔包含以内容为导向的贡献者（他们通常参与度和活跃度较低）对于产生高质量的产出至关重要。当前研究的另一个独特之处是它调查了群体层面的表现。关于参与在线社区的动机的研究侧重于个人表现，而对群体产出的贡献因素的研究还不够。因此，当前的研究有助于填补这一空白，并解释成员的取向如何影响群体的产出。


## Conclusion




＃＃ 结论


This study con tributes to the gro win g resea rch on Wikipedia by developing and testing a framework for the determinants of the quality of group output. The study’s primary contribution is in demonstrating the multiple effects of group composition. The presence of occasional editors contributes to the group, as these content-oriented contributors often possess domain-specific expertise. Administratively oriented members, however, can help the group restrain and diffuse task conflict. Last, groups that contain members with diverse knowledge bases and experiences may benefit from the variety of opinions, especially in the presence of task conflict that promotes creative abrasion. Our contribution extends beyond the specific Wikipedia context: our formulation of the group members’ orientation construct and the findings regarding its effects can inform research on online communities, and the formulation of the relationship between cognitive diversity and task conflict contributes to the research on group work.




这项研究通过开发和测试群体产出质量决定因素的框架，为维基百科上不断发展的研究做出了贡献。该研究的主要贡献在于证明了群体组成的多重影响。偶尔出现的编辑会对团队做出贡献，因为这些以内容为导向的贡献者通常拥有特定领域的专业知识。然而，以行政为导向的成员可以帮助团队抑制和化解任务冲突。最后，包含具有不同知识基础和经验的成员的团体可能会从各种意见中受益，特别是在存在促进创造性磨损的任务冲突的情况下。我们的贡献超出了特定的维基百科背景：我们对小组成员的定向结构的阐述及其影响的发现可以为在线社区的研究提供信息，而认知多样性和任务冲突之间关系的阐述有助于对小组工作的研究。


In addition, our findings have two important implications for practice. First, our findings illustrate that it is difficult to compose groups for effective performance, since opposing ends along the group members’ orientation continuum—administrative and content orientation—both play an important role, and it would be challenging to optimize the effects of these opposing forces. Organizers of online production communities should strive to reduce entry barriers in order to entice the participation of occasional content-oriented contributors (who may possess relevant expertise) and increase group diversity; at the same time, they should strive to include some administrative-oriented members, which would streamline the production process and help diffuse conflicts. A second important practical implication is for managing task conflict and providing conflict resolution tools. Communities should encourage task-related conflicts while providing the tools for preventing conflicts from escalating and the mechanisms to resolve conflicts. Some (e.g., [7]) have suggested that the success of Wikipedia can be attributed to the diversity of opinions and knowledge bases it attracts (i.e., “the wisdom of the crowd” argument); our findings suggest that Wikipedia’s extensive conflict resolution mechanisms are responsible for unleashing the potential of this cognitive diversity. Another important aspect of Wikipedia’s conflict management is in preventing task-related conflicts from escalating into destructive personal conflicts; the Wikipedia community has developed an extensive set of behavior norms for preventing such conflict intensifications. Finally, our data-driven proxies of group composition variables offer a practical way for practitioners to analyze the effects of group composition and determine optimal arrangements for their specific settings.




此外，我们的发现对实践有两个重要的影响。首先，我们的研究结果表明，为了有效的绩效而组成团队是很困难的，因为团队成员的取向连续体中的对立端——管理取向和内容取向——都发挥着重要作用，并且优化这些对立力量的效果将是具有挑战性的。在线制作社区的组织者应努力降低进入壁垒，以吸引偶尔以内容为导向的贡献者（可能拥有相关专业知识）的参与并增加群体多样性；同时，争取吸纳一些行政型的成员，这样可以简化生产流程，有利于化解矛盾。第二个重要的实际意义是管理任务冲突并提供冲突解决工具。社区应鼓励与任务相关的冲突，同时提供防止冲突升级的工具和解决冲突的机制。一些人（例如，[7]）认为维基百科的成功可以归因于它吸引的观点和知识基础的多样性（即“群体的智慧”论点）；我们的研究结果表明，维基百科广泛的冲突解决机制有助于释放这种认知多样性的潜力。维基百科冲突管理的另一个重要方面是防止与任务相关的冲突升级为破坏性的个人冲突；维基百科社区制定了一套广泛的行为规范来防止此类冲突加剧。最后，我们的数据驱动的群体构成变量代理为从业者提供了一种实用的方法来分析群体构成的影响并确定其特定设置的最佳安排。


Our study provides preliminary results, and further research is warranted. The study concerns a large number of projects in one setting (i.e., Wikipedia). As such, it provides a useful context for the preliminary validation of our research model, as the setting controls for exogenous factors that might have interfered in an interorganizational study (e.g., differences in organizational culture and norms). We expect that our findings will generalize to other forms of community-based knowledge production projects beyond Wikipedia. However, it is possible that specific features of Wikipedia (both in terms of the social mechanisms and the underlying technological infrastructure) play a role in allowing the effects of group composition and task conflict (e.g., low entry barriers in Wikipedia may affect group composition). Hence, further research is warranted in order to test whether our findings hold in other types of online communities. Another way in which our study could be extended is in the operationalization and measurement of the outcome variable. We used university librarians as assessors; however, future studies may help validate our proposed model by using alternative methods for estimating quality. In addition, we conceptualized information quality as a single construct; we suggest that future research explore specific information quality dimensions.




我们的研究提供了初步结果，并且有必要进行进一步的研究。该研究涉及一种环境（即维基百科）中的大量项目。因此，它为我们的研究模型的初步验证提供了有用的背景，作为对可能干扰组织间研究的外在因素（例如组织文化和规范的差异）的设置控制。我们期望我们的发现能够推广到维基百科之外的其他形式的基于社区的知识生产项目。然而，维基百科的特定特征（无论是在社会机制还是底层技术基础设施方面）可能在允许群体构成和任务冲突的影响中发挥作用（例如，维基百科的低进入门槛可能会影响群体构成）。因此，有必要进行进一步的研究，以测试我们的研究结果是否适用于其他类型的在线社区。我们的研究可以扩展的另一种方式是结果变量的操作和测量。我们聘请大学图书馆员作为评估员；然而，未来的研究可能有助于通过使用替代方法来估计质量来验证我们提出的模型。此外，我们将信息质量概念化为一个单一的结构；我们建议未来的研究探索具体的信息质量维度。


Finally, our data-driven research method constrained the types of constructs that could be investigated. The availability of comprehensive records of wiki-based collaboration allows us to analyze group members’ actual ongoing behavior in its natural settings [39]. Still, the main limitations of this approach are that the measurement of constructs is restricted to available proxies and that other relevant factors that have not been recorded might be omitted. Alternatively, we could create groups in a laboratory experiment and test cause and effect relationships between relevant variables; however, it would be difficult to generalize these results to institutions such as Wikipedia. Thus, the proposed data-driven approach has advantages that—we believe—outweigh its limitations, and this approach has been valuable in the study of online communities [47]. That being said, we hope that future research would conduct more comprehensive investigation of the factors explaining the success of community-based projects, include additional relevant variables (e.g., members’ personal characteristics, such as expertise and motivations), and use more direct measures of these constructs.




最后，我们的数据驱动研究方法限制了可以研究的结构类型。基于 wiki 的协作的全面记录的可用性使我们能够分析小组成员在自然环境中的实际持续行为 [39]。尽管如此，这种方法的主要局限性在于，构建的测量仅限于可用的代理，并且可能会忽略尚未记录的其他相关因素。或者，我们可以在实验室实验中创建组并测试相关变量之间的因果关系；然而，很难将这些结果推广到维基百科等机构。因此，我们认为所提出的数据驱动方法的优点超过了其局限性，并且这种方法在在线社区的研究中很有价值[47]。话虽这么说，我们希望未来的研究能够对解释社区项目成功的因素进行更全面的调查，包括其他相关变量（例如成员的个人特征，如专业知识和动机），并对这些结构使用更直接的衡量标准。


In conclusion, we believe that Wikipedia can serve as a test bed for studying decentralized information technology–enabled production of knowledge-based goods. Research on Wikipedia is in the early phases, and the success of Wikipedia-like projects remains to a large extent unexplained. This study extends our current understanding of online production communities by enhancing our knowledge of the role of relatively unexplored, yet important, factors—cognitive diversity, task conflict, and group members’ orientation. We hope that this study will open the door to future research in the area.




总之，我们相信维基百科可以作为研究去中心化信息技术支持的知识产品生产的试验台。维基百科的研究还处于早期阶段，类似维基百科项目的成功在很大程度上仍然无法解释。这项研究通过增强我们对相对未探索但重要的因素——认知多样性、任务冲突和群体成员取向——的作用的了解，扩展了我们目前对在线生产社区的理解。我们希望这项研究将为该领域的未来研究打开大门。

Findings from OSS studies show that, for example, in the Apache project, a small core of committed insiders (4 percent of the members of the project group) was responsible for 88 percent of the contributions [65] and provided the majority of answers to questions posted on the Apache Usenet help site [48]. Similarly, in Wikipedia, core members are responsible for most of the edits [39].




2. OSS 研究结果表明，例如，在 Apache 项目中，一小群忠诚的内部人员核心（项目组成员的 4%）负责 88% 的贡献 [65]，并为 Apache Usenet 帮助站点上发布的问题提供了大部分答案 [48]。同样，在维基百科中，核心成员负责大部分编辑[39]。


3. While extant organizational theory conceptualizes task conflict as a mediator of the relationship between cognitive diversity and group performances [32, 73], this conceptualization may not be suitable for our study of Wikipedia. Theories related to diversity and conflict were developed and tested in settings with a clear temporal sequence in the measurement of constructs: group members’ knowledge is measured prior to beginning the specific task, conflict is analyzed during the work on the task, and group performance is assessed at completion. In addition, the group boundary is kept constant for the duration of the task. In the context of Wikipedia, however, such a temporal sequence could not easily be established. Wikipedia editor groups work on articles over prolonged time periods, gradually developing articles’ contents through an ongoing exchange of opinions, and members’ knowledge is likely to evolve over this time. Moreover, over time, the group changes, new members join and others leave, and thus the group’s cognitive diversity changes even if the knowledge base of each member was to remain constant. Hence, in our study of Wikipedia, we model the relation between cognitive diversity and task conflict as a moderation effect: the interaction between group members’ diversity in knowledge base and the task-related conflict experienced when working on the article affects the quality of the article.




3. 虽然现有的组织理论将任务冲突概念化为认知多样性和群体绩效之间关系的中介[32, 73]，但这种概念化可能不适合我们对维基百科的研究。与多样性和冲突相关的理论是在结构测量中具有清晰时间顺序的环境中开发和测试的：在开始特定任务之前测量小组成员的知识，在任务工作期间分析冲突，并在完成时评估小组表现。此外，组边界在任务期间保持不变。然而，在维基百科的背景下，这样的时间顺序并不容易建立。维基百科编辑小组在很长一段时间内处理文章，通过不断交换意见逐渐开发文章内容，成员的知识可能会在这段时间不断发展。此外，随着时间的推移，群体会发生变化，新成员加入，其他成员离开，因此即使每个成员的知识基础保持不变，群体的认知多样性也会发生变化。因此，在我们对维基百科的研究中，我们将认知多样性和任务冲突之间的关系建模为调节效应：小组成员知识库的多样性与撰写文章时经历的任务相关冲突之间的相互作用会影响文章的质量。

Thus, the upper limit of 3,500 words on article length excludes only extremely lengthy outliers. For details on Wikipedia article length guidelines, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article\_Length/. For statistics on article length, see [13] and http://stats.wikimedia.org/EN/TablesWikipediaEN.htm and http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size\_comparisons/.




7. 200 个字的下限不包括存根，存根约占所有维基百科文章的 30%。很长的文章很少见，因为维基百科的指南建议文章简洁，因此维基百科文章平均包含 460 个单词。因此，文章长度 3,500 字的上限仅排除极其冗长的异常值。有关维基百科文章长度指南的详细信息，请参阅 http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article\_Length/。有关文章长度的统计信息，请参阅 [13] 和 http://stats.wikimedia.org/EN/TablesWikipediaEN.htm 和 http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size\_comparisons/。


8. Each student was randomly assigned to analyze three articles. When analyzing an article, the students had to identify five alternative information sources that are relevant to the article’s topic, and they were given clear guidelines on considering the authority of these alternative sources, distinguishing between academic sources, government and nonprofit organizations, media institutions, and corporate and personal publications (e.g., a personal Web page). The students compared the contents of the Wikipedia article to the alternative sources, and based on this analysis they prepared an extensive report that included ten pieces of evidence (either validating or invalidating the Wikipedia information), open-ended comments, and ratings of their perceptions of the article’s quality. The students were instructed to consider factual accuracy, completeness of information, objectivity and biases, and representation (readability, clarity). To encourage diligent work, the students were marked on the sources they employed (credit was linked to the authority of sources) and the gravity of the evidence (detecting a factual error received more credit than detecting a typographical error). Initially, six students were assigned to each article. We only used reports from the students who consented to release their work for this study and utilized only articles with a minimum of three student reports. We later tested to make sure that the number of reports employed did not affect the article’s quality score.




8. 每个学生被随机分配分析三篇文章。在分析一篇文章时，学生必须确定与文章主题相关的五个替代信息来源，并为他们提供了明确的指导，以考虑这些替代来源的权威性，区分学术来源、政府和非营利组织、媒体机构以及企业和个人出版物（例如个人网页）。学生们将维基百科文章的内容与其他来源进行比较，并根据这一分析，他们准备了一份内容广泛的报告，其中包括十项证据（验证或否定维基百科信息）、开放式评论以及他们对文章质量的看法的评级。学生们被要求考虑事实的准确性、信息的完整性、客观性和偏见以及表述（可读性、清晰度）。为了鼓励勤奋工作，学生们对他们使用的来源进行了标记（信用与来源的权威性相关）和证据的严重性（发现事实错误比发现印刷错误获得更多的信用）。最初，每篇文章被分配六名学生。我们仅使用同意发布其研究成果的学生的报告，并且仅使用至少包含三份学生报告的文章。我们后来进行了测试，以确保所使用的报告数量不会影响文章的质量得分。


9. Modeling members’ orientation as a formative construct was not appropriate in this case because of concerns related to content coverage, as well as multicollinearity and network effects [17].




9. 在这种情况下，由于与内容覆盖、多重共线性和网络效应相关的担忧，将成员的取向建模为形成性结构是不合适的[17]。


10. Note that data on editors is based on how they chose to identify themselves, and data might be imprecise when an administrator chooses to edit articles while not registered or when a user contributes under multiple accounts.




10. 请注意，编辑者的数据取决于他们选择如何识别自己的身份，当管理员选择在未注册的情况下编辑文章或用户在多个帐户下进行贡献时，数据可能不准确。


11. Sparsity is often used in the analysis of online social networks to measure how connected the network is (see [92]). The network sparsity metric is analogous to our measure when we consider a pair of group members that have edited the same Wikipedia page as being connected.




11. 稀疏性通常用于在线社交网络的分析中，以衡量网络的连接程度（参见[92]）。当我们考虑一对编辑了相同维基百科页面的组成员作为连接时，网络稀疏度度量类似于我们的度量。


12. In order to corroborate the perception measures, we investigated an alternative metric of task conflict. The assessors were instructed to analyze the discussion pages and highlight the words related to task conflict. We then counted the number of conflict-related words and calculated their percentage from the overall number of words in the discussion page. After verifying interrater agreement, we calculated assessors’ average word-count percentage. We found that the word-count metric highly correlates (0.73–0.78) with the perception measures. Furthermore, the pattern of effects remains unchanged when the word-count metric replaces the conflict perception measures, thus further validating our analysis.




12. 为了证实感知测量，我们研究了任务冲突的替代指标。评估员被要求分析讨论页面并突出显示与任务冲突相关的单词。然后，我们计算了与冲突相关的单词数量，并计算了它们占讨论页面单词总数的百分比。在验证评估者之间的一致性后，我们计算了评估者的平均字数百分比。我们发现字数指标与感知指标高度相关（0.73-0.78）。此外，当字数指标取代冲突感知指标时，效果模式保持不变，从而进一步验证了我们的分析。


13. In order to address the concern raised by Goodhue et al. [28] regarding the statistical power of interaction effects in PLS (as compared to using multiple regressions), we ran a regression analysis and found that the interaction effect (as well as all other hypothesized relations) was still significant in the regression model.




13. 为了解决 Goodhue 等人提出的问题。 [28]关于 PLS 中交互效应的统计功效（与使用多元回归相比），我们进行了回归分析，发现交互效应（以及所有其他假设的关系）在回归模型中仍然显着。


14. It is worth noting that when running the model without the control variables, all the hypotheses were supported and all the paths were statistically significant.




14. 值得注意的是，当在没有控制变量的情况下运行模型时，所有假设都得到支持，并且所有路径都具有统计显着性。


15. Note that the activity-based core-periphery structure is fundamentally different from the composition dimensions that we are interested in. Our group composition constructs are defined at the level of the institution (i.e., Wikipedia): group members’ orientation and cognitive diversity were both based on editors’ activity patterns across Wikipedia. The core-periphery structure, on the other hand, is defined at the project group level (see [6] for a discussion of the difference between project-level and organization-level core-periphery composition in Wikipedia).




15. 请注意，基于活动的核心-外围结构与我们感兴趣的构成维度有根本不同。我们的群体构成结构是在机构（即维基百科）层面定义的：群体成员的取向和认知多样性均基于维基百科上编辑的活动模式。另一方面，核心-外围结构是在项目组级别定义的（有关维基百科中项目级别和组织级别核心-外围组成之间差异的讨论，请参阅[6]）。

## Appendix: Procedure for Analyzing Task Conflict in Wikipedia Discussion Pages




## 附录：维基百科讨论页面中任务冲突的分析过程


Ea ch a rticl e’s discussion pa ge wa s anl yzed, independently, by three research assistants, under the supervision of the authors. Assessors processed the documents in a random order.




每篇文章的讨论页面均由三名研究助理在作者的监督下独立分析。评估员以随机顺序处理文件。


Since the task at hand is the authoring of an encyclopedic entry, task-related conflicts are disagreements among contributors regarding the contents of the article being authored. The product of the authoring process should be an encyclopedic entry that is accurate, comprehensive, unbiased, and clear, and thus conflicts often relate to the accuracy, coverage, objectivity, and clarity of the article. Some examples of statements that contain evidence for task conflict are:




由于手头的任务是撰写百科全书条目，因此与任务相关的冲突是贡献者之间对所撰写文章内容的分歧。创作过程的产物应该是准确、全面、公正和清晰的百科全书式条目，因此冲突往往与文章的准确性、覆盖面、客观性和清晰度有关。包含任务冲突证据的一些陈述示例包括：


Jim was born in 1954 in Argentina, not in Belgium.

# Influence of self-efficacy on execution discrepancy and decision performance


![](/api/attachments/RANT7GYW/fulltext/images/2b6b2519ccbdcde7477502f8c971aa2d1f022eea54a4f5a034efb82cef5ab989.jpg)




![](/api/attachments/RANT7GYW/fulltext/images/2b6b2519ccbdcde7477502f8c971aa2d1f022eea54a4f5a034efb82cef5ab989.jpg)


Rong-Fuh Day <sup>a</sup>, Feng-Yang Kuo <sup>b,</sup>\*, Yu-Feng Huang b




Rong-Fuh Day <sup>a</sup>、Feng-Yang Kuo <sup>b、</sup>\*、Yu-Feng Huang b


<sup>a</sup> Department of Information Management, National Chi-Nan University, Taiwan




<sup>a</sup> 台湾国立暨南大学信息管理系


<sup>b</sup> Department of Information Management, National Sun Yat-Sen University, Taiwan




<sup>b</sup> 国立中山大学信息管理系，台湾


## A R T I C L E I N F O




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


Keywords: Self-efficacy Decision-making Eye-tracking approach Execution discrepancy




关键词： 自我效能感 决策 眼动追踪 执行差异


## A B S T R A C T




（代码、公式、图片引用或其他非语言内容，无需翻译。）


Researchers of decision-making and human–computer interactions have been concerned with the issue of action slips and the development of supportive functionalities to reduce the occurrence of the slips. However, it remains unclear how to measure slips in a decision-making context and how motivational factors can help to reduce action slips. In this study, we formulate the construct of execution discrepancy to represent an individual’s deviation from his/her planned actions and propose a self-regulatory model to explain the antecedents and consequences of this construct. The model specifies that self-efficacy exerts a positive influence on the reduction of execution discrepancy that, in turn, leads to enhanced decision performance. An experiment was conducted based on the multi-attribute decision paradigm, and decision-makers’ eye movements were tracked to measure their execution discrepancy. The results support our hypothesis that self-efficacy serves as an important moti vational factor to modulate cognitive efforts needed to reduce execution discrepancy during strategy execution. In addition to its theoretical and methodological contribution to the construct of execution discrepancy, this study may have essential implications for the design of technological artifacts that can predict and prevent possible action slips.




决策和人机交互领域的研究人员一直关注动作失误问题以及开发支持功能以减少失误的发生。然而，目前尚不清楚如何衡量决策中的失误以及激励因素如何帮助减少行动失误。在本研究中，我们制定了执行差异的结构来表示个人对其计划行动的偏差，并提出了一个自我监管模型来解释该结构的前因和后果。该模型指出，自我效能对减少执行差异产生积极影响，进而提高决策绩效。基于多属性决策范式进行了实验，通过跟踪决策者的眼球运动来衡量他们的执行差异。结果支持我们的假设，即自我效能感是调节减少策略执行过程中执行差异所需的认知努力的重要激励因素。除了对执行差异构建的理论和方法论贡献之外，这项研究还可能对能够预测和防止可能的行动失误的技术工件的设计具有重要意义。


## 1. Introduction




## 1.简介


Action slips are common in our daily experience. An action slip is an erroneous action that deviates from an individual’s intended action [1–4]. For example, people often commit slips such as mis-ordering, skipping, or repeating steps in a prescribed action sequence [2,3]. In critical settings, minor slips such as pressing an incorrect button on the control panel of an aircraft or misreading a gauge on a medical equip ment in clinical rooms can lead to serious consequences such as air ac cidents or iatrogenic injuries [5–8]. Given that action slips can affect various aspects in daily life [4], it is not surprising that examining action slips have been the focus of many recent studies in the Information Systems (IS) community [9–12].




Action slips are common in our daily experience. An action slip is an erroneous action that deviates from an individual’s intended action [1–4].例如，人们经常犯错误，例如顺序错误、跳过或重复规定的操作顺序中的步骤[2,3]。 In critical settings, minor slips such as pressing an incorrect button on the control panel of an aircraft or misreading a gauge on a medical equip ment in clinical rooms can lead to serious consequences such as air ac cidents or iatrogenic injuries [5–8]. Given that action slips can affect various aspects in daily life [4], it is not surprising that examining action slips have been the focus of many recent studies in the Information Systems (IS) community [9–12].


In general, these studies can be classified into two trends, the first of which concerns IS usage behavior. Polites and Karahanna [10] have proposed that classical predictors such as perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use might not suffice to explain usage behavior because action slips can impede the link between usage intention and actual usage. Specifically, during the introduction of a new system, users might intend to use the new system but turn to perform routines of old systems. This deviance from the intended system usage is considered an action slip that requires interventions to encourage more conscious control over behavior [10]. The importance of this line of study is that it points out an emerging IS inquiry that IT artifacts should not only sup port usefulness and ease of use, but also reduce the frequency of and loss from action slips.




总的来说，这些研究可以分为两个趋势，第一个趋势涉及信息系统的使用行为。 Polites 和 Karahanna [10] 提出，感知有用性和感知易用性等经典预测因素可能不足以解释使用行为，因为动作失误可能会阻碍使用意图和实际使用之间的联系。具体来说，在引入新系统的过程中，用户可能打算使用新系统，但转而执行旧系统的例程。这种与预期系统使用的偏差被认为是一种行动失误，需要进行干预以鼓励对行为进行更有意识的控制[10]。这一研究方向的重要性在于，它指出了一个新兴的 IS 问题，即 IT 工件不仅应该支持有用性和易用性，而且还应该减少操作失误的频率和损失。


The other trend comes from decision-making and decision support system (DSS) studies that attempt to address why a DSS does not always promote decision quality. One important factor that has been identified is the lack of system capabilities, including a lack of fit between system capability and task type [13]. In addition, in the scenario of multi-attribute decision-making, DSS failure can be explained with people’s tendency to choose effort-saving strategies but not accuracy-maximizing ones [14]. However, while not yet being empiri cally tested, a possible factor of DSS failure is the unrealistic assumption that decision-makers can always execute a strategy correctly. Specif ically, it has been suggested that action slips may negatively impact decision processes and outcomes and that an avenue for DSS to improve decision quality requires approaches that improve “better execution of an existing decision strategy” ([14], p. 370). For example, around 25 % of users without a DSS “iterate through the problem several times and … return to alternatives that had been previously eliminated” during the decision-making process ([15], p. 388). This dysfunctional behavior is specifically considered an action slip in the execution of an intended decision strategy [16], and therefore, several studies have proposed that DSS research should look for factors that can reduce the occurrences of action slips [14,16,17].




另一个趋势来自决策和决策支持系统 (DSS) 研究，这些研究试图解释为什么 DSS 并不总能提高决策质量。已确定的一个重要因素是系统功能的缺乏，包括系统功能和任务类型之间缺乏匹配[13]。此外，在多属性决策场景中，DSS失败可以用人们倾向于选择省力策略而不是准确性最大化策略来解释[14]。然而，虽然尚未经过实证检验，但 DSS 失败的一个可能因素是决策者始终能够正确执行策略的不切实际的假设。具体来说，有人认为行动失误可能会对决策过程和结果产生负面影响，并且 DSS 提高决策质量的途径需要改进“更好地执行现有决策策略”的方法（[14]，第 370 页）。例如，大约 25% 没有 DSS 的用户在决策过程中“多次迭代问题并……返回到之前已被淘汰的替代方案”（[15]，第 388 页）。这种功能失调的行为被特别认为是执行预期决策策略时的行动失误[16]，因此，一些研究提出DSS研究应该寻找可以减少行动失误发生的因素[14,16,17]。


Moreover, investigating action slips related to strategy execution is particularly important in modern electronic commerce (EC), in which online consumers are faced with numerous choice tasks but may not execute their choice strategy correctly because online consumers are frequently overwhelmed by the amount and speed of information. On line shops display products or services using multi-attribute presenta tion, in which alternatives are paired with the same attributes for consumer to compare and choose. Consumers are required to execute strategies, or a series of steps, to perform the multi-attribute tasks and then to choose one or more products from EC choice tasks. In reality, due to the lack of competence or the task complexity, people’s strategy execution can go wrong and, subsequently, their decision-making quality is compromised, leading to the reduction of consumer welfare. Again, there has been a lack of theoretical and empirical study on reduction of action slips regarding strategy execution in multi-attribute decision-making. Besides, it remains unclear how researchers can mea sure action slips in terms of strategy execution.




此外，调查与策略执行相关的行动失误在现代电子商务（EC）中尤为重要，在现代电子商务中，在线消费者面临着众多的选择任务，但由于在线消费者经常被信息的数量和速度所淹没，因此可能无法正确执行他们的选择策略。网上商店使用多属性展示来展示产品或服务，其中替代品与相同的属性配对以供消费者比较和选择。消费者需要执行策略或一系列步骤来执行多属性任务，然后从EC选择任务中选择一种或多种产品。事实上，由于能力的缺乏或任务的复杂性，人们的策略执行可能会出错，从而导致决策质量受到影响，从而导致消费者福利的降低。同样，对于减少多属性决策中策略执行的行动失误还缺乏理论和实证研究。此外，目前还不清楚研究人员如何衡量战略执行方面的行动失误。


To bridge this research gap, our study has chosen to incorporate the perspective of self-regulation to investigate action slips in strategy execution. In fact, studies of IS usage [10], decision-making [15], and consumer research [9] all point out that self-regulation factors such as engagement, mindfulness, or conscious control may play a critical role to reduce action slips. This is because failure of regulation, whether due to performing a distraction task or due to decrease of cognitive capacity, decreases the ability of goal-directed control and hence actual behavior might deviate from intention [18,19]. For example, the frequency of action slips might be as high as 6 times in a week in people’s daily life especially when peoples’ attention is diverted from the tasks at hand [20]. In consumer research, Labrecque (et al. 2017) also shows that action slips are more frequent when consumers’ attention are distracted; i.e., when people are using a new product relatively mindlessly and thought little about it.




为了弥补这一研究空白，我们的研究选择结合自我监管的视角来调查战略执行中的行动失误。事实上，对信息系统使用[10]、决策[15]和消费者研究[9]的研究都指出，自我调节因素，如参与、正念或有意识的控制，可能在减少行动失误方面发挥关键作用。这是因为，无论是由于执行分散注意力的任务还是由于认知能力下降，调节失败都会降低目标导向控制的能力，因此实际行为可能会偏离意图[18,19]。例如，在人们的日常生活中，每周行动失误的频率可能高达 6 次，尤其是当人们的注意力从手头的任务上转移时[20]。在消费者研究中，Labrecque（等人，2017）还表明，当消费者注意力分散时，行动失误会更频繁。即，当人们相对无意识地使用新产品并且很少考虑它时。


In brief, this study aims to examine factors that reduce action slips in strategy execution, and draws upon the self-regulatory literature because of its importance in researching goal-directed behavior. The core construct of self-regulation literature is self-efficacy, which refers to individuals’ belief in their competence in a specific task. People with high self-efficacy are more motivated to calibrate their behaviors with goals or intentions by maintaining attention in goal-striving activities. In light of this, we theorize that self-efficacy will help to reduce action slips of strategy executions in multi-attribute decision tasks and develop a model that explains the relationships of decision-makers’ self-efficacy, execution discrepancy, and decision performance [21–24]. The execu tion discrepancy is conceptualized as a human agency’s slips in self-regulating oneself to comply with his or her intended strategy in order to arrive at a goal state, whereas self-efficacy is considered as the contributory motivational factor to the engagement of attentional re sources that decreases discrepancy [25–28]. As depicted in Fig. 1, self-efficacy in carrying out the intended strategy is considered as the main antecedent to the execution discrepancy that manifests slip in the implementation of decision processes. To validate the model, we have conducted a laboratory experiment in which participants were required to perform multi-attribute decision tasks with their eye movements recorded [29]. In addition, the eye movement data collected through the tracking device is utilized as a measurement of attention. By applying the Needleman–Wunsch algorithm (NWA) [30] on eye movement data, we develop a process index to objectively measure how discrepancy occurs between the actual and predicted strategy execution behavior. We believe that our study can broaden our understanding of slips as well as provide inspiration for possible managerial and technological in terventions to reduce the occurrences of such behavior.




简而言之，本研究旨在研究减少战略执行中行动失误的因素，并借鉴自律文献，因为它在研究目标导向行为方面很重要。 The core construct of self-regulation literature is self-efficacy, which refers to individuals’ belief in their competence in a specific task.自我效能感高的人更有动力通过在追求目标的活动中保持注意力来根据目标或意图调整自己的行为。 In light of this, we theorize that self-efficacy will help to reduce action slips of strategy executions in multi-attribute decision tasks and develop a model that explains the relationships of decision-makers’ self-efficacy, execution discrepancy, and decision performance [21–24]. The execu tion discrepancy is conceptualized as a human agency’s slips in self-regulating oneself to comply with his or her intended strategy in order to arrive at a goal state, whereas self-efficacy is considered as the contributory motivational factor to the engagement of attentional re sources that decreases discrepancy [25–28]. As depicted in Fig. 1, self-efficacy in carrying out the intended strategy is considered as the main antecedent to the execution discrepancy that manifests slip in the implementation of decision processes. To validate the model, we have conducted a laboratory experiment in which participants were required to perform multi-attribute decision tasks with their eye movements recorded [29].此外，通过跟踪设备收集的眼球运动数据被用作注意力的测量。 By applying the Needleman–Wunsch algorithm (NWA) [30] on eye movement data, we develop a process index to objectively measure how discrepancy occurs between the actual and predicted strategy execution behavior. We believe that our study can broaden our understanding of slips as well as provide inspiration for possible managerial and technological in terventions to reduce the occurrences of such behavior.


The next section provides a general overview of the self-regulation perspective, reviews literature on self-efficacy and multi-attribute de cision-making, and presents our hypotheses. This is followed by a sec tion describing the NWA. Next, we describe our experiment and results, and then conclude with our findings’ theoretical and practical implications.




下一节提供自我调节视角的总体概述，回顾有关自我效能和多属性决策的文献，并提出我们的假设。 This is followed by a sec tion describing the NWA. Next, we describe our experiment and results, and then conclude with our findings’ theoretical and practical implications.


## 2. Literature review




## 2.文献综述


## 2.1. Modeling decision strategies of a multi-attribute decision




## 2.1.多属性决策的决策策略建模


The study of the multi-attribute decision, referring to people’s choice from a variety of alternatives that share the same set of attributes, has been an important topic in the fields of decision-making and DSS [14,15, 29,31,32]. For example, researchers have been concerned with how to design useful functions or interfaces to support multi-attribute deci sion-making in order to debias individuals’ decision-making process [15,33,34]. An important theory of multi-attribute decision-making is the adaptive decision-making framework developed by Johnson and Payne [35]. Their effort-accuracy tradeoff theory holds that a decision-maker evaluates strategies in terms of perceived effort and accuracy before selecting the most acceptable one from the strategy repository [29,31]. A variety of decision strategies, including the weighted additive rule (WADD), the satisficing heuristic, the equal weight heuristic, and the lexicographic heuristic, are available to guide a decision-maker’s cognitive operations to transform the initial problem state into the goal state in a step-by-step manner. Each step is further composed of elementary information processes (EIPs), such as reading, adding, and comparing, that are used by decision-makers to execute the selected strategy [29,31,35–37].




多属性决策的研究，是指人们从具有相同属性集的多种方案中做出的选择，一直是决策和决策支持系统领域的一个重要课题[14,15,29,31,32]。例如，研究人员一直关注如何设计有用的功能或界面来支持多属性决策，以消除个体决策过程的偏差[15,33,34]。 An important theory of multi-attribute decision-making is the adaptive decision-making framework developed by Johnson and Payne [35].他们的努力-准确性权衡理论认为，决策者在从策略存储库中选择最可接受的策略之前，会根据感知的努力和准确性来评估策略[29,31]。加权加性规则（WADD）、满足启发式、等权启发式、词典启发式等多种决策策略可以指导决策者的认知操作，将初始问题状态逐步转化为目标状态。每个步骤进一步由基本信息过程（EIP）组成，例如读取、添加和比较，决策者使用这些过程来执行所选策略[29,31,35–37]。


![](/api/attachments/RANT7GYW/fulltext/images/c01ab4bb5e13f7aef1e099d80fe3f7789be00ea372b966da0a979205e0ecfd7e.jpg)  
Fig. 1. The research model.




![](/api/attachments/RANT7GYW/fulltext/images/c01ab4bb5e13f7aef1e099d80fe3f7789be00ea372b966da0a979205e0ecfd7e.jpg)  
图1. 研究模型。


Previous studies have shown that the empirical execution steps for intended strategies are not always congruent with the theoretically predicted EIPs [15–17]. Specifically, Payne et al. [29] have suggested many factors to explain multi-attribute decision-making’s action slips (deviance between the intended and the executed strategy), including environmental stressors (such as time pressure and high level of distraction), computation demand (a certain step might require heavy computation), and memory constraint (people may lose track of their goal or sub-goal states). These factors can be generally categorized as limits in human cognition. However, there has been no study to examine the role of self-regulation to affect action slips in strategy execution. Our study therefore adopts the motivation factor of self-efficacy to explain the discrepancy between the actual strategy execution and the theoret ically predicted strategy execution.




先前的研究表明，预期策略的经验执行步骤并不总是与理论预测的 EIP 一致[15-17]。具体来说，佩恩等人。 [29]提出了许多因素来解释多属性决策的行动失误（预期策略和执行策略之间的偏差），包括环境压力源（例如时间压力和高度分心）、计算需求（某个步骤可能需要大量计算）和内存限制（人们可能会忘记他们的目标或子目标状态）。这些因素通常可以归类为人类认知的限制。然而，还没有研究探讨自我监管对战略执行中行动失误的影响。因此，我们的研究采用自我效能感的激励因素来解释实际策略执行与理论预测策略执行之间的差异。


## 2.2. Self-regulation perspective and self-efficacy




## 2.2.自我调节视角和自我效能


According to the self-regulatory perspective, human beings are characterized as being goal-directed agents, irrespective of whether the goals are self-generated or assigned by others. In pursuit of goals, an individual’s self-regulatory systems operate in concert to guide their activities along specific paths to particular goals [21,24,38]. Zimmer man [24] has provided the three-phase self-regulatory model. First, in the forethought phase, individuals undertake goal-setting and planning and generate self-motivational belief. This is followed by the perfor mance control phase in which individuals monitor and adjust their ongoing actions. Finally, in the self-reflection phase, individuals eval uate their performance and attribute their success or failure to a number of causes, which influence their future goal-setting and planning.




According to the self-regulatory perspective, human beings are characterized as being goal-directed agents, irrespective of whether the goals are self-generated or assigned by others. In pursuit of goals, an individual’s self-regulatory systems operate in concert to guide their activities along specific paths to particular goals [21,24,38]. Zimmer man [24] 提供了三相自调节模型。首先，在深思熟虑阶段，个人进行目标设定和规划，并产生自我激励的信念。接下来是绩效控制阶段，个人监控并调整他们正在进行的行为。 Finally, in the self-reflection phase, individuals eval uate their performance and attribute their success or failure to a number of causes, which influence their future goal-setting and planning.


In this self-regulation model, self-efficacy, referring to an in dividual’s belief in his/her competence in a specific task, is considered to be at the core of the motivation process [25,39]. Self-efficacy influences the extent of interest in working on a specific problem generated by that individual as well as the degree of effort exerted to sustain his/her work in the face of difficulties ([24–26], pp. 16–18). In addition, several theorists argue that self-efficacy plays an vital role in the goal-setting phase, which is responsible for setting the level of resource available for attaining a goal [23,28,40]. The level of self-efficacy further in fluences the goal-striving activities during the performance control phase. In brief, self-efficacy has been found to significantly predict effort engagement throughout all three self-regulation phases in a variety of tasks. In light of this, we theorize that self-efficacy will exert effect on strategy executions in multi-attribute decision tasks.




在这种自我调节模型中，自我效能指的是个人对自己在特定任务中的能力的信念，被认为是激励过程的核心[25,39]。自我效能影响个人对解决特定问题的兴趣程度，以及面对困难时为维持工作而付出的努力程度（[24-26]，第16-18页）。此外，一些理论家认为自我效能在目标设定阶段起着至关重要的作用，该阶段负责设定可用于实现目标的资源水平[23,28,40]。自我效能水平进一步影响绩效控制阶段的目标追求活动。简而言之，人们发现自我效能感可以显着预测各种任务中所有三个自我调节阶段的努力投入程度。鉴于此，我们推测自我效能感会对多属性决策任务中的策略执行产生影响。


## 2.3. Self-regulation perspective and strategy execution behavior




## 2.3。自律视角与策略执行行为


In this research, we integrate the self-regulation perspective with the adaptive decision-making theory to formulate a model of decisionmaking behavior. While the information processing paradigm charac terizes individuals as acting like mechanical processors of information, the self-regulation perspective adopts a humanistic approach with respect to the initiation and maintenance of individuals’ goal-directed behaviors. That is, the decision-making process contains a variety of motivational factors responsible for modulating cognitive resources needed to decrease execution discrepancy by aligning actual behaviors, operations, or steps with the intended ones [21,23,24,28,39].




在本研究中，我们将自我调节的视角与适应性决策理论相结合，建立了决策行为模型。虽然信息处理范式将个体描述为信息的机械处理器，但自我调节视角在个体目标导向行为的启动和维持方面采用了人本主义方法。也就是说，决策过程包含各种动机因素，负责调节所需的认知资源，通过将实际行为、操作或步骤与预期行为、操作或步骤保持一致来减少执行差异[21,23,24,28,39]。


Self-efficacy has been consistently shown to be a positive motiva tional factor that can increase the availability of people’s cognitive resource in a task [21,23,24,28,39]. Many past studies of self-efficacy have shown that high-efficacy individuals would invest greater cogni tive resource to complete the intended task [39,41,42]. For example, people with higher self-efficacy have higher level of persistence, amount of effort, and level of commitment to achieve an intended behavior [43]. That is, people can adjust the amount of cognitive resources to regulate task-related behaviors by monitoring their actual behaviors and align their behaviors with the intended ones. Importantly, the availability of cognitive resource, which can be affected by people’s attempts at self-regulation [44], may increase or diminish the ability to regulate behaviors when performing a task. For example, when people are deprived of available cognitive resources (e.g., after sleep deprivation), their ability to detect their own behavior errors decreased and, in turn, their accuracy and speed to perform tasks are both impaired [45]. Subsequently, people are also more likely to repeat the same errors and, thus, making many slips [45]. Similarly, time pressure at work may deprive some people of cognitive resources and, in turn, increase cognitive failures during work [46]. Therefore, because self-efficacy can increase cognitive resources available in a task and cognitive resources are needed for behavior regulation, it can be inferred that self-efficacy can reduce execution discrepancy.




自我效能一直被证明是一种积极的激励因素，可以增加人们在任务中认知资源的可用性[21,23,24,28,39]。过去的许多自我效能研究表明，高效能个体会投入更多的认知资源来完成预期任务[39,41,42]。例如，自我效能感较高的人为实现预期行为具有较高的毅力、努力程度和承诺水平[43]。也就是说，人们可以通过监控自己的实际行为并使自己的行为与预期行为保持一致来调整认知资源的数量来调节与任务相关的行为。重要的是，认知资源的可用性可能会受到人们自我调节尝试的影响[44]，可能会增加或减弱执行任务时调节行为的能力。例如，当人们被剥夺可用的认知资源时（例如，睡眠不足后），他们发现自己行为错误的能力就会下降，反过来，他们执行任务的准确性和速度都会受到损害[45]。随后，人们也更有可能重复同样的错误，从而犯下许多错误[45]。同样，工作中的时间压力可能会剥夺一些人的认知资源，进而增加工作中的认知失败[46]。因此，由于自我效能可以增加任务中可用的认知资源，并且行为调节需要认知资源，因此可以推断自我效能可以减少执行差异。


Evidence from decision-making literature has also suggested that self-efficacy can reduce execution discrepancy. For example, individuals deprived of cognition resources are more likely to adopt simplified de cision strategies that lead to sub-optimal solutions [29,47]. Addition ally, it is shown that low search efficacy leads to greater use of the availability heuristic, while low processing efficacy leads to greater use of the anchoring and representativeness heuristics [48]. All these three types of heuristics are considered intuitive ones that do not require extensive cognitive resource and, accordingly, are more likely to result in judgment and decision-making biases [49]. Conversely, a high level of self-efficacy can encourage the use of optimal decision strategies and thus reducing biases [48]. In short, findings from previous decision-making studies suggest that self-efficacy is critical for decision-makers to reduce execution discrepancy by modulating avail able cognitive resources in a task.




Evidence from decision-making literature has also suggested that self-efficacy can reduce execution discrepancy.例如，被剥夺认知资源的个人更有可能采用简化的决策策略，从而导致次优解决方案[29,47]。此外，研究表明，低搜索效率导致更多地使用可用性启发式，而低处理效率导致更多地使用锚定和代表性启发式[48]。所有这三种类型的启发法都被认为是直观的，不需要大量的认知资源，因此更有可能导致判断和决策偏差[49]。 Conversely, a high level of self-efficacy can encourage the use of optimal decision strategies and thus reducing biases [48].简而言之，之前的决策研究结果表明，自我效能对于决策者通过调节任务中可用的认知资源来减少执行差异至关重要。


Following this line of thought, we have formulated the construct of self-efficacy to carry out the intended strategy (SEIS), which is defined as the decision-maker’s belief about his/her own competence in applying a specific decision strategy to make a decision. Previous research into selfefficacy has shown that high-efficacy individuals would appropriate greater cognitive resource for the intended task [39,41,42]. Thus, it is likely that, for individuals of high SEIS, the execution of the strategy will receive greater cognitive resource support in the performance phase. Due to the increase in the available cognitive resource, decision-makers are likely to expend a higher level of concentration on the decision process [50]. As a result, the intended strategy will be executed more closely to the theoretically expected execution steps of the strategy.




遵循这一思路，我们提出了执行预期策略的自我效能感（SEIS）的概念，它被定义为决策者对自己应用特定决策策略做出决策的能力的信念。先前对自我效能的研究表明，高效能个体会为预期任务分配更多的认知资源[39,41,42]。因此，对于SEIS高的个体来说，策略的执行很可能会在绩效阶段获得更大的认知资源支持。由于可用认知资源的增加，决策者可能会在决策过程上花费更多的注意力[50]。因此，预期策略的执行将更加接近该策略理论上预期的执行步骤。


We conceptually defined the strategy execution discrepancy as the difference between the theoretically predicted and decision-makers actually implemented EIPs. Specifically, we relied on the eye-tracking technology to capture eye movements as a measurement for EIPs. In decision-making research, eye-tracking has been frequently used to capture the information currently being processed [51], and it is well established that the sequence of eye fixations can reflect the order of the corresponding information currently operated on [52–55]. On the one hand, the actual EIPs of the intended strategy are represented by the sequence of actual eye-fixation sequence (AEFS), which occurs during decision-making. On the other hand, according to the EIP’s prescription of the intended strategy, its theoretical fixation sequence can be pre dicted using the sequence of EIPs involved in the prescription. This theoretically predicted eye fixation sequence is abbreviated by theo retical eye-fixation sequence (TEFS, please also refer to Section 3.4). Given that self-efficacy is a motivational factor that increases cognitive resources availability and that cognitive resource availability is critical to reduce biases and errors in decision-making, we hypothesize that self-efficacy can reduce execution discrepancy. The following hypothe sis is proposed:




我们从概念上将策略执行差异定义为理论预测与决策者实际实施的生态产业园之间的差异。具体来说，我们依靠眼球追踪技术来捕捉眼球运动，作为 EIP 的测量值。在决策研究中，眼动追踪经常被用来捕获当前正在处理的信息[51]，并且众所周知，眼睛注视的顺序可以反映当前操作的相应信息的顺序[52-55]。一方面，预期策略的实际 EIP 由决策过程中发生的实际注视序列（AEFS）序列表示。另一方面，根据EIP对预期策略的处方，可以使用处方中涉及的EIP序列来预测其理论固定序列。该理论预测的眼睛注视序列缩写为理论眼睛注视序列（TEFS，另请参阅第 3.4 节）。鉴于自我效能是增加认知资源可用性的激励因素，并且认知资源可用性对于减少决策中的偏见和错误至关重要，我们假设自我效能可以减少执行差异。提出以下假设：


H1. For individuals of higher SEIS, the discrepancy between the empirical execution steps and the TEFS of an intended strategy will be smaller.




H1。对于 SEIS 较高的个体，经验执行步骤与预期策略的 TEFS 之间的差异会更小。


Likewise, less discrepancy implies there is more active monitoring during strategy execution and stronger adherence to a particular strat egy. There would be fewer slips (i.e., fewer additional steps needed to correct errors or to restore forgotten steps during the execution) and, in turn, execution efficiency is increased. Specifically, discrepancy result in more wasted effort, which involves redundant or repetitive work that does not promote performance but increases the overall execution time of a task [56]. For example, when using an electronic search engine, wasted effort is defined as individuals’ inquiries that are repetitive or redundant or those that are rejected by search engines [56]. In the multi-attribute decision-making task, wasted effort includes repetitive or redundant EIPs or those EIPs that used to reverse an error. Those wasted EIPs may not only raise the likelihood of accurate choices but also lead to increase in the overall decision time. We therefore hy pothesize that:




Likewise, less discrepancy implies there is more active monitoring during strategy execution and stronger adherence to a particular strat egy.失误会更少（即，纠正错误或恢复执行过程中忘记的步骤所需的额外步骤更少），进而提高执行效率。具体来说，差异会导致更多的浪费，这涉及冗余或重复的工作，这些工作不会提高性能，但会增加任务的整体执行时间[56]。例如，当使用电子搜索引擎时，浪费精力被定义为重复或多余的个人查询或被搜索引擎拒绝的查询[56]。 In the multi-attribute decision-making task, wasted effort includes repetitive or redundant EIPs or those EIPs that used to reverse an error. Those wasted EIPs may not only raise the likelihood of accurate choices but also lead to increase in the overall decision time.因此我们假设：


H2. The discrepancy between the empirical execution steps and the TEFS of an intended strategy is positively related to decision time.




H2。经验执行步骤与预期策略的 TEFS 之间的差异与决策时间正相关。


Similarly, when there is less discrepancy, a choice being made is more likely to be accurate, or congruent with the expectation of the intended strategy. It is highly likely that execution discrepancy not only includes repetitive or redundant EIPs but also erroneous ones, which are defined as the departures from the prescribed steps and choices [29]. For example, individuals can read a wrong value, make a wrong comparison, or miscalculate an addition or a multiplication. All those errors likely lead to a choice that is not prescribed by intended strategy. Therefore, we hypothesize H3:




同样，当差异较小时，所做的选择更有可能是准确的，或者与预期策略的期望一致。执行差异很可能不仅包括重复或冗余的 EIP，还包括错误的 EIP，错误的 EIP 被定义为偏离规定的步骤和选择 [29]。例如，个人可能会读取错误的值、进行错误的比较或错误地计算加法或乘法。所有这些错误都可能导致做出不符合预期策略的选择。因此，我们假设H3：


H3. The discrepancy between the empirical execution steps and the TEFS of an intended strategy is negatively related to the congruence between the actual choice and the expected choice.




H3。经验执行步骤和预期策略的 TEFS 之间的差异与实际选择和预期选择之间的一致性负相关。


Finally, following H2 (higher execution discrepancy increases deci sion time) and H3 (lower execution discrepancy increases decision ac curacy), it is possible that there exists a negative relationship between decision time and congruency. This relationship has been predicted in self-regulation literature, which indicates that people with high efficacy (usually experts in a field) can perform tasks both accurately and effi ciently [57]. For example, it has been shown that, compared with those with low efficacy, people with high efficacy in using Web search perform search tasks not only more accurately but also with less execution time [58]. The reason behind this relationship is self-regulative; i.e., high-efficacy people can make good use of their cognitive resources by filtering out distraction and focus on methods with which they are most efficacious [57,58]. In the context of multi-attribute decision-making, this good use of cognitive resource suggests the reduction of discrepancy by filtering out unnecessary EIPs and focus on the intended ones, reaching both accuracy and efficiency. Hence, the fourth hypothesis is stated as:




最后，根据H2（较高的执行差异增加决策时间）和H3（较低的执行差异增加决策准确性），决策时间和一致性之间可能存在负相关关系。这种关系已经在自我调节文献中得到了预测，这表明高效能的人（通常是某个领域的专家）可以准确有效地执行任务[57]。例如，研究表明，与效率低的人相比，使用网络搜索效率高的人执行搜索任务不仅更准确，而且执行时间也更少[58]。这种关系背后的原因是自我调节；也就是说，高效率的人可以通过过滤掉干扰并专注于最有效的方法来充分利用他们的认知资源[57,58]。在多属性决策的背景下，这种对认知资源的良好利用表明，通过过滤掉不必要的EIP并专注于预期的EIP来减少差异，从而达到准确性和效率。因此，第四个假设表述为：


H4. Decision time is negatively related to the congruence between the actual choice and the expected choice.




H4。决策时间与实际选择和预期选择的一致性负相关。


## 2.4. Eye movement as the measurement of discrepancy




## 2.4。眼球运动作为差异的测量


The eye-mind assumption states that people are likely to fixate on an object when their mind is processing that object’s corresponding inter nal representations [51]. This assumption has provided a general justification for using eye movement as a valid indicator to the under lying cognitive process. Many studies from different fields, such as visual search, perception, reading, arithmetic education, and IS research have further explored how eye movements reflect cognitive activities [58–67]. In the field of behavioral decision-making, eye movements have also been applied to observe the external information search to infer a decision strategy. A pioneer study relevant to the choice problem is conducted by Russo and Rosen [68], who used eye tracker to explore how people resolved multi-attribute choice problems. Lohse and John son [69] further compared the eye-tracking method with the comput erized information board on decision-related indices such as percent information searched, search pattern, reacquisition rate, and variability in information search. Their study suggested that the eye movement data can effectively measure decision-making processes and strategies. Based on these studies, the sequence of eye fixations serves as the approximation of decision-makers’ underlying decision process in our study.




眼心假设指出，当人们的大脑正在处理某个物体相应的内部表征时，他们可能会注视该物体[51]。 This assumption has provided a general justification for using eye movement as a valid indicator to the under lying cognitive process.来自不同领域的许多研究，如视觉搜索、感知、阅读、算术教育和信息系统研究等，进一步探讨了眼动如何反映认知活动[58-67]。在行为决策领域，眼动也被应用于观察外部信息搜索以推断决策策略。 Russo 和 Rosen [68] 进行了一项与选择问题相关的开创性研究，他们使用眼动仪来探索人们如何解决多属性选择问题。 Lohse 和 Johnson [69] 进一步将眼动追踪方法与计算机化信息板在决策相关指标（例如搜索信息百分比、搜索模式、重新获取率和信息搜索的可变性）上进行了比较。 Their study suggested that the eye movement data can effectively measure decision-making processes and strategies.基于这些研究，在我们的研究中，眼睛注视的顺序可以作为决策者潜在决策过程的近似值。


To measure the execution discrepancy from eye movements, we calculate the dissimilarity between the TEFS, which is derived in advance from a decision strategy’ theoretical EIPs, and the AEFS, which is collected empirically from the decision-makers’ performance during the experiment. To do so, we have adopted the method proposed by Day [70], who applied the string-editing approach [71–76] to calculate the similarity/dissimilarity between TEFS and AEFS. Known as the Lev enshtein distance [77], the similarity/dissimilarity between two strings (i.e., sequences) can reveal how divergent the empirical decision process is from the theoretical decision process. It measures the dissimilarity between two strings mainly by calculating how many edit operations (i. $\boldsymbol { \mathrm { e } } _ { \cdot \boldsymbol { s } }$ insertion, deletion, and substitution) are needed to transform one string into a target string; the more the edit operations are needed, the more dissimilar the two strings are. To find out the minimum number of edit operations necessary for the transformation and to align two sequences to each other along the entire length, also called global sequence alignment, Day [70] adopted the NWA [30] that allows flex ible specification of the cost of different edit operations optimal for a given situation. This adoption is depicted in Equation (1) (see below), which consisted of two steps: first, finding the local optimal solution, M (i,j) for two partial sequences, $\mathbf { x } _ { 1 } , \mathbf { x } _ { 2 } , . . . , \mathbf { x } _ { \mathrm { i } }$ in X and ${ \bf y } _ { 1 } , { \bf y } _ { 2 } , . . . , { \bf y } _ { \mathrm { j } }$ in $\mathrm { Y , }$ and, second, producing new aligned sequences. To find the local optimal solution, $\mathbf { M } ( \mathrm { i } , \mathrm { j } )$ is achieved with the best result among the three possible aligning conditions, when x and y are aligned, when $\mathbf { X _ { i } }$ is aligned with a gap, or when yj is aligned with a gap. As shown in Equation (1), S is a scoring function which generates a cost for each of the three aligning conditions. In the second step, the algorithm computes all the combi nations of partial sequences and then backtracks M(i,j) to produce new aligned sequences $\mathbf { X } '$ and Y’ for X and Y respectively. The details of the algorithm can be found in Day [70] and Needleman and Wunsch [30].




为了测量眼球运动的执行差异，我们计算了 TEFS 和 AEFS 之间的差异，TEFS 是从决策策略的理论 EIP 中提前导出的，AEFS 是根据决策者在实验过程中的表现收集的经验数据。为此，我们采用了 Day [70] 提出的方法，他应用字符串编辑方法 [71-76] 来计算 TEFS 和 AEFS 之间的相似性/相异性。两个字符串（即序列）之间的相似性/不相似性被称为 Lev enshtein 距离 [77]，可以揭示经验决策过程与理论决策过程的差异程度。它主要通过计算将一个字符串转换为目标字符串需要多少次编辑操作（即 $\boldsymbol { \mathrm { e } } _ { \cdot \boldsymbol { s } }$ 插入、删除和替换）来衡量两个字符串之间的不相似性；需要的编辑操作越多，两个字符串就越不相似。为了找出转换所需的最少编辑操作数并将两个序列沿整个长度相互对齐（也称为全局序列对齐），Day [70] 采用了 NWA [30]，它允许灵活指定针对给定情况的最佳不同编辑操作的成本。这种采用如方程（1）（见下文）所示，它包括两个步骤：首先，找到两个部分序列 $\mathbf { x } _ { 1 } 、 \mathbf { x } _ { 2 } 的局部最优解 M (i,j) 。 。 。 , \mathbf { x } _ { \mathrm { i } }$ 中的 X 和 ${ \bf y } _ { 1 } , { \bf y } _ { 2 } , 。 。 。 , { \bf y } _ { \mathrm { j } }$ in $\mathrm { Y , }$ ，然后生成新的对齐序列。为了找到局部最优解，当 x 和 y 对齐、$\mathbf { X _ { i } }$ 与间隙对齐或 yj 与间隙对齐时，$\mathbf { M } ( \mathrm { i } , \mathrm { j } )$ 在三种可能的对齐条件中获得最佳结果。如等式(1)所示，S是评分函数，其为三个对齐条件中的每一个生成成本。第二步，算法计算部分序列的所有组合，然后回溯 M(i,j) 分别为 X 和 Y 生成新的对齐序列 $\mathbf { X } '$ 和 Y'。该算法的详细信息可以在 Day [70] 以及 Needleman 和 Wunsch [30] 中找到。


$$
M (i, j) = \text { Max } \left\{ \begin{array}{l} M (i - 1, j - 1) + S (i, j) \\ M (i - 1, j) + S (i, \text { gap }) \\ M (i, j - 1) + S (\text { gap }, j) \end{array} \right.\tag{1}
$$




$$
M (i, j) = \text { Max } \left\{ \begin{array}{l} M (i - 1, j - 1) + S (i, j) \\ M (i - 1, j) + S (i, \text {间隙}) \\ M (i, j - 1) + S (\text {间隙}, j) \end{array} \right.\tag{1}
$$


## 3. Method




## 3. 方法


## 3.1. Participants, stimulus materials, and apparatus




## 3.1.参与者、刺激材料和设备


A total of 128 graduate and undergraduate students (36 males) participated in the experiment, who were recruited at a major university in Taiwan, with ages ranging from 18 to 28 years. The decision infor mation needed by the choice problem was organized into an information matrix, which has been adopted as the standard representation for multi-attribute decision [29,31,78]. In the experiment, the information matrix had four alternatives and four attributes (see Appendix A); it was shown on the screen in the resolution of 800 × 600 pixels. The EyeLink II (SR Research, Canada) eye tracker was applied in the experiment to record the subjects’ eye movements at a sampling rate of 500 Hz. The Data Viewer software (SR Research, Canada) was used to extract the fixation data for subsequent analysis and statistical processing.




共有128名研究生和本科生（36名男性）参与实验，他们是在台湾一所重点大学招募的，年龄从18岁到28岁不等。选择问题所需的决策信息被组织成信息矩阵，该矩阵已被采用作为多属性决策的标准表示[29,31,78]。实验中，信息矩阵有四种选择和四种属性（见附录A）；它以800×600像素的分辨率显示在屏幕上。实验中使用EyeLink II（加拿大SR Research）眼动仪以500 Hz的采样率记录受试者的眼球运动。使用数据查看器软件（SR Research，加拿大）提取注视数据以进行后续分析和统计处理。


## 3.2. Task and strategies




## 3.2.任务与策略


The experimental task involved the application of two strategies [29]: the WADD and the elimination-by-aspects (EBA). In order to make the performance of each task comparable, each task was provided with an equivalent variant derived from the same information matrix. The variant was created by randomly switching the columns of the four at tributes and/or randomly switching the rows of the four alternatives in the information matrix. Doing so ensured the variants to have the same level of complexity.




实验任务涉及两种策略的应用[29]：WADD和按方面消除（EBA）。为了使每个任务的性能具有可比性，每个任务都提供了从相同信息矩阵导出的等效变体。该变体是通过随机切换信息矩阵中四个选项的列和/或随机切换四个选项的行来创建的。这样做可以确保变体具有相同的复杂程度。


## 3.3. Measurement




## 3.3。测量


Two self-efficacy measures were developed, one for the WADD strategy and another for the EBA strategy. According to Bandura’s conceptualization, self-efficacy has two important dimensions: (a) magnitude, e.g., “whether I can complete a task”, and (b) gradation in strength, e.g., “How certainly I can complete a task” [25,79]. Therefore, our questionnaires, which uses Guttman’s scale [80], included these two dimensions to measure subjects’ self-efficacy.




制定了两项自我效能衡量标准，一项针对 WADD 战略，另一项针对 EBA 战略。根据班杜拉的概念，自我效能感有两个重要的维度：（a）强度，例如“我是否能够完成一项任务”，以及（b）强度的等级，例如“我如何确定能够完成一项任务”[25,79]。因此，我们的调查问卷使用了古特曼量表[80]，包括这两个维度来衡量受试者的自我效能。


The construct of Execution Discrepancy was developed to measure how an empirical decision process deviates from the decision process theoretically prescribed by an intended decision strategy. It was oper ationalized as the dissimilarity score between AEFS of the empirical strategy execution and TEFS of an intended strategy. In this study, the fixation on a specific piece of decision information was defined to be equivalent to the occurrence of read EIP. As a result, AEFS on a decision information matrix could be considered as the sequence of read EIPs underlying decision strategy. On the other hand, TEFS regarding the intended strategy could be derived by orderly transcribing the read EIPs involved in the EIP model of the intended strategy. Finally, the present study utilized the NWA to calculate and score the dissimilarity between TEFS and AEFS [30,70].




执行差异的构造是为了衡量经验决策过程如何偏离预期决策策略理论上规定的决策过程。它被操作为实证策略执行的 AEFS 与预期策略的 TEFS 之间的差异分数。在本研究中，对特定决策信息的固定被定义为等同于读取EIP的发生。因此，决策信息矩阵上的 AEFS 可以被视为决策策略基础上的读取 EIP 的序列。另一方面，关于预期策略的 TEFS 可以通过有序转录预期策略的 EIP 模型中涉及的读取 EIP 来导出。最后，本研究利用 NWA 来计算和评分 TEFS 和 AEFS 之间的差异[30,70]。


Decision time, representing execution efficiency, is measured with the length of time spent by subjects on completing a choice problem. This measurement is consistent with decision-making literature that efficiency can be defined in terms of the speed of decision-making [17, 81,82]. It was defined as the duration starting from the time when the information matrix for a decision problem was shown on the screen until a subject inputted his or her choice.




决策时间代表执行效率，用受试者完成选择问题所花费的时间长度来衡量。这种测量与决策文献一致，即效率可以根据决策速度来定义[17, 81,82]。它被定义为从决策问题的信息矩阵显示在屏幕上到受试者输入他或她的选择的持续时间。


Finally, the construct of decision accuracy is defined as whether a choice made by subjects is consistent with the theoretically prescribed choice of the assigned strategy. Note that our experiment required the subject to execute one of the two strategies, WADD and EBA, to complete a given task. When executed properly, there is only one theoretically prescribed choice of the assigned strategy. When discrepancy occurs decision-makers can perform wrong steps and EIPs (reading a wrong value, omitting a critical value, or made errors in comparison), which lead to an unprescribed choice. Following the DSS literature that defines accuracy as the deviation from the intended strategy (e.g., [83]), we consider a choice that equals to the prescribed one accurate and all other choices incorrect.




最后，决策准确性的构造被定义为受试者做出的选择是否与指定策略的理论规定选择一致。请注意，我们的实验要求受试者执行 WADD 和 EBA 两种策略之一来完成给定的任务。如果执行得当，理论上指定的策略只有一种选择。当出现差异时，决策者可能会执行错误的步骤和 EIP（读取错误的值、忽略关键值或在比较中犯错误），从而导致非规定的选择。根据 DSS 文献将准确性定义为与预期策略的偏差（例如，[83]），我们认为等于指定选项的选择是准确的，而所有其他选择都是错误的。


## 3.4. Design and procedure




## 3.4。设计与流程


The main antecedent factor in our research model is self-efficacy. In this study, the subjects were randomly assigned to receive different levels of training on decision strategies: a high-training environment and a no-prior-training environment. This manipulation was designed to increase the variance of subjects’ perceived self-efficacy [25,79,84], i.e., to reduce the possibility that subjects’ efficacy levels happen to cluster in a small range, which could lead to an adverse effect of reducing the power of the statistical test. In the high training environment, subjects undertook a two-hour training course on the six decision strategies one week prior to the formal experiment before joining the experiment. During this two-hour training course the subjects were taught six deci sion strategies that suggested for multi-attribute decision-making [29]. In contrast, the no-prior-training subjects received no prior training before the experiment.




我们的研究模型中的主要先决因素是自我效能。在这项研究中，受试者被随机分配接受不同级别的决策策略培训：高培训环境和无事先培训环境。这种操纵的目的是增加受试者感知自我效能的方差[25,79,84]，即减少受试者的效能水平碰巧聚集在一个小范围内的可能性，这可能导致统计检验功效降低的不利影响。在高训练环境中，受试者在正式实验前一周接受了关于六种决策策略的两小时训练课程，然后才加入实验。在这个两小时的培训课程中，受试者学习了六种建议多属性决策的决策策略[29]。相比之下，没有事先训练的受试者在实验前没有接受过事先训练。


All subjects in both environments participated in the experiment on an individual basis. The experiment consisted of two sessions: a 30-min ute training session and the eye-tracking experiment session. In the 30- minute session, each subject was instructed to watch a video which described how the WADD and EAB strategy work and then practiced each of the two decision strategies three times; in each practice, the subject received feedback about their decision time on the computer screen and decision accuracy immediately after their choice was entered into the computer. Upon completion of all practices, each subject was required to complete the scales of self-efficacy on the WADD strategy and EBA strategy respectively. Methodologically, the training session was critical to our experimental design because people might have varying knowledge and expertise regarding decision-making; the training session served to ensure that each subject would thoroughly learn the two target strategies, irrespective of whether he/she had participated in the two-hour training course.




两种环境中的所有受试者都单独参与了实验。该实验包括两个部分：30 分钟的 ute 训练部分和眼动追踪实验部分。在 30 分钟的会议中，每个受试者都被要求观看一段视频，该视频描述了 WADD 和 EAB 策略如何运作，然后将这两种决策策略分别练习了 3 次；在每次练习中，受试者在他们的选择输入计算机后立即收到有关他们在计算机屏幕上的决策时间和决策准确性的反馈。完成所有练习后，每个受试者都需要分别完成 WADD 策略和 EBA 策略的自我效能感量表。从方法上讲，培训课程对我们的实验设计至关重要，因为人们在决策方面可能有不同的知识和专业知识；培训课程的目的是确保每个受试者无论是否参加了两小时的培训课程，都能彻底学习这两个目标策略。


The eye-tracking experiment was conducted immediately after the training session. First, the experiment assistant put a padded leather headband of the eye tracker on the subject’s head, and then calibrated the eye tracker. Following this, the assistant launched a customized experimental program that took control of the following experimental procedure. Each subject was asked to undertake four trials, which were presented in the following way: first, the four trials were arranged into two pairs. Each pair consisted of one trial for WADD and one for EBA. While one pair was accompanied by background noise, the other pair was accompanied by silence. The purpose in introducing such back ground noise into the two trials was to compete for subjects’ attentional resource, which, in turn, increases the occurrence of slips in the decision process [2,4,85]. The experimental program then randomized the order of the two pairs, which was followed by random selection of the order of the WADD and EBA trials.




The eye-tracking experiment was conducted immediately after the training session. First, the experiment assistant put a padded leather headband of the eye tracker on the subject’s head, and then calibrated the eye tracker. Following this, the assistant launched a customized experimental program that took control of the following experimental procedure. Each subject was asked to undertake four trials, which were presented in the following way: first, the four trials were arranged into two pairs. Each pair consisted of one trial for WADD and one for EBA. While one pair was accompanied by background noise, the other pair was accompanied by silence.在两项试验中引入这种背景噪音的目的是为了争夺受试者的注意力资源，这反过来又增加了决策过程中失误的发生率[2,4,85]。然后，实验程序将两对的顺序随机化，然后随机选择 WADD 和 EBA 试验的顺序。


Each trial consisted of two screens. The first screen instructed the subject to complete a choice problem with an assigned strategy as accurately and quickly as possible. The following screen showed the information matrix depicting four protection lotion brands, out of which the subject was to select one. The information matrix remained on the screen until the participant inputted a choice in the program. The pro gram then recorded the subject’s choice, the duration time, as well as eye fixations throughout the entire session.




每个试验由两个屏幕组成。第一个屏幕指示受试者按照指定的策略尽可能准确、快速地完成选择问题。下面的屏幕显示了四个防护乳液品牌的信息矩阵，主题是从中选择一个。信息矩阵一直保留在屏幕上，直到参与者在程序中输入选择。然后程序记录了受试者的选择、持续时间以及整个过程中的眼睛注视情况。


After the eye-tracking experiment, a cash compensation of NT\$ 150 was paid to each participant for participating in the experiment. If a subject had participated in the two-hour training course in advance, an additional cash compensation of NT\$ 200 was paid.




眼动实验结束后，每位参与实验的参与者获得新台币150元的现金补偿。如果受试者提前参加了两小时的培训课程，则额外支付新台币200元的现金补偿。


## 4. Results




## 4. 结果


Two procedures were conducted in our analysis. First, the execution discrepancy score was computed. Then, we applied the partial least squares (PLS) approach to assess our research model, showing standardized regression coefficients between constructs and $R ^ { 2 }$ values for endogenous constructs [86,87]. PLS is used because it allows us to include multiple measures for the constructs in the research model and provides estimates of the paths among constructs and it is more straightforward to reveal a mediating effect among constructs [86].




我们的分析进行了两个程序。首先，计算执行差异分数。 Then, we applied the partial least squares (PLS) approach to assess our research model, showing standardized regression coefficients between constructs and $R ^ { 2 }$ values for endogenous constructs [86,87]. PLS is used because it allows us to include multiple measures for the constructs in the research model and provides estimates of the paths among constructs and it is more straightforward to reveal a mediating effect among constructs [86].
